tei:div.tei:p: ༷// ༷hūṃ rgirdoṭwāṃ: hūṃ/ //ni byedi/hūṃ ༷ṭwāṃ~X 5 51 dī ཿ dro7shāshā ༷ 20 ༵ chi 30 mi3sdusta 7
༄khya/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(da)gung thang bstan pa'i sgon mes brtsams/mirigasadaposkrunakhab/

za za/012ma za zathagozam zo11 7mjo zathagozazo na3zo zachomaloṣṭha 2005 12132ma 7—105—07464—71 bo bo khya mcho mang khoza ma — tho sa 29466—53 b.lo ༅ po01thamatshoṣṭhaja(2005)zo158416byutshosgom ṣṭha tshobo 6 som za dimo14 10khru135 977ya pa 46 4 0 shādithophomagramakhagra 1tho so༅ lotham2006 thaza 2 6ro1zashā6tho /mapomaza 850pa'i ma1168pa ba 1 2 yim 7 125yim0001—20khru tsho 3400zam smotshogrungolo tho 58 zlochislotshobo jaza

da rdo / / tshod pe shan shedape skrun gsal bshad/de yang gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'am mtshan yongs gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me dbang phyug sder 'bod pa'i dam pa de nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta lo ste spyi lo 1762lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge'i smad kyi yul du yab the bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khong dgung lo bdun par phebs dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du gdan drangs/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas dge bsten dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge'i sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/rim gyes rgya dang sog po'i skad yig sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas 'bras srungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang /mdzod/ 'dul ba/ tshad ma/ phar phyin bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rgyal ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/dgung lo nyer gnyis par dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/

༄/ /yo ca bayo yotshonasa'i khrung 4mdabus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs med du gyur cing / dbus gtsang gi mkhas mang dkyil na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyes gtsug tu bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/dgung lo nyer lnga bar yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/dgung lo sum cu bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen du 'khod pas gdan rabs nyer gcig pa yin/ de nas bzung yul mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba'i yo lang kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo lug lo ste spyi lo 1823lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/ dbal mang paṇḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas chen mang du byung ngo / /khong gi gsung rtsom ni phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sdom/ sgra dang snyan ngag sman dang rtsis/ lha ris thig tshad sogs sgyu rtsal skor gyi bstan bcos rnams gcig tu bsdus te po ti bcu gcig byas nas shing par du brkos yod pa de dag kun kyang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i legs bshad sha stagayin pas nged cag dpe skrun khang gis bla brang gi shing par gzhir bzung nas dpar du btab pa'i dge ba 'di yis thams cad bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig /mi rigs dpe skrun khang /2

༄/ / rkashadakar chagagator 'bul bsang mchod sogs kyi skor bstan srung dgyes pa'i mtshad sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / )rma rgyal spom ra'i g.yang 'bod phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i rol mtsho zhes bya thab ba((1gas 1sdus/ / /da4)lha gnyan chen po sngo la g.yu rtse'i gsol mchod rgyas pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / /62)rgyal ba mi pham mgon po la mdo chog gi lugs bzhin mchod tshul sogs bka' rtsom sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu bsgrig pa bzhugs so/ (82)dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs smon tshig gi skor drang srong chen po'i bden tshig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ (/92)bsngo ba rgyas pa dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs /sde/sgo (///rdo/༷//////)bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dge legs 'bum phrag ma gnyis bzhugs so/ / (239)legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (243)legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs 'phreng brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (253)

༄/ /gung ca bayo ཿsgran me'i ga4 4ma/zlos gar gyi bstan bcos yang dag lam du bkri ba'i rol rtsed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (267)nyams myong rgan po'i 'bol gtam yid 'byung dmar khrid ces bya ba ཿpa/((1ཿsa//sa /ces (291)tshig bkra sna tshogs kyi skor skal bzang mdongs mtha' dgyes pa'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (298)yul mchog dman du ma la phul ba'i springs yig gi skor sgra don rgyan gyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (313)snyan dngags kyi dper brjod rtsom 'phro can bzhugs so/ / (354)tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon tshig dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs so/ / (400)dge spyor gye mjug tu 'don rgyu'i smon tshig mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /(402)myur 'byon gsol 'debs kyi skor nyam thag skye bo'i gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (403)bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor dang lam rim gyi smon lam bzhugs ///5 //41/////4pa/////bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul bzhugs so/ / (419)mgon po grib sel la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dam tshig rdo rje'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (421)mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa bi har tisma / (425)dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i gtor 'bul dngos grub kun 'byung 2

༄/ / gagadang bstod pa rngams pa'i sgra sgrogs gnyis bzhugs so/ / (449)chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa kha skong gsang sgrub gyi bskang ba dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ / (453)chos rgyal rnam gsum gyi gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa ཿpa/(//ཿsa//sa/ //rdo (ma (55)dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub la 'jug pa'i man ngag khrag 'thung dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (467)rnam sras gtor 'bul bzhugs so/ / (479)rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po dregs pa lcam sring bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa las bzhi'i 'phrin las lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /(481)3

༄/ / gakho 'astob /༄7/ / gtor 'bul bsang mchod sogs kyi skor bstan srung dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅/ / hūṃ bde stong ye shes rang 'od 'bar ba yi/ / sgrib bral dag pa chos kyi pho brang nas/ / brtan pa'i 'khor lo khro bo'i zlos gar gyi/ / rnam rol phyi nang gsang ba'i gshin rje'i gshed/ / snying rje'i lha mchog myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ / dge sdig shan 'byed dam can chos kyi rgyal/ / 'dod khams dbang mo gshin rje'i gshed kyi lcam/ / bslab gsum bstan pa'i srung ma rnam thos sras/ / rang rang 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /bdag cag dam chos bsgrub pa'i mgon skyabs su/ / spyan 'dren thugs rje'i dbang gis myur byon te/ / zag med mchod gtor rgya mtshos dgyes par mdzod/ / oṃ gu ru ya mānta ka dharmā bā la sa ba ri wā ra i de ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis bsngo/ a: sogs btags pas mtshad pa dang nang mchod dbul/ hūṃ/ rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma gshin rje'i gshed/ /'bral med snying gi ze 'brur rtag bzhugayonas/ / thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam bzang rnams/ / gegs med mngon du 'gyur ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / skyes bu gsum dang gsang chen bstan pa yi/ / bka' srung ye shes spyan ldan khyed rnams kyis/ / las 'bras blang dor nges 'byung byang sems dang / / bde stong ting 'dzin rgyas pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / de yi gegs 1

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/gyur phyin ci log gi blo/ / rnam rtog rang mdangs phyi rol gdon dang bgegs/ / la sogs nye bar 'tshe ba kun zhi zhing / / mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / tshe rabs phreng bar dal ba'i rten thob cing / /mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ / yang dag lam bzang rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / sgrub pa'i legs smon 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ / mdor na rgyu 'bras zeg pa'i lam bzang rnams/ / rim bgrod zung 'jug go 'phang thob kyi bar/ / nam yang g.yel med lus dang grib ma bzhin/ / rtag tu 'grogs shing brtse bas skyong gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni gyi lang ri khrod pa dkon mchog chos 'dzin gyis 'di lta bu'i gtor 'bul mdor bsdus zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o /na mo gu ru bhya rang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas shing mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ hūṃ/ bde chen 'od gsal thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos kun sbyangs pa dag pa'i khams/ / brtan g.yo cir yang 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi/ / rang 'od 'jigs rung gnas mchog so so nas/ / myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gter/ / bde chen rgyal po gtum drag gdong bzhi pa/ / 'jam dpal khro bo'i bka' nyan srog gi bdag / 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ / la sogs dam chos sgrub pa'i mgon dang skyabs/ / ye shes spyan ldan srung ma 'khor dang bcas/ / thugs bskyed dam bca'i dbang gis 'dir byon te/ / mchod gtor rgya mtshos tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig / de nas rang rang gi sngags la ba bla ta btags pa'am/ a kā ro lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul/chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo nang mchod dang bcas dbul/ rnam sras kyi gtor ma byin 2

༄/ /gtor la la4 /rlabs logs su byed spro na de bzhin bya la dkyus su btang yang 'gal ba med par gsungs so/ / de nas/ hūṃ/ spyan ras gzigs dbang drag po'i skur bstan nas/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char 'bebs shing / / 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs pa kun sel ba/ / myur mdzad mgon po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / bde chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid he ru ka / gdong ma bzhir bcas srin po khros pa yi/ / gar mdzad rdo rje nag po gdong ba'i pa/ / yum bzhi bshan pa'i sde dang bcas la bstod/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul ni/ / bla ma yi dam chos srung sna tshogs su/ / snang ba gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog / blo bzang rgyal bstan srung ma'i gtso la bstod/ / rgyal kun yon tan gcig bsdus rin chen mang / / skye dgu 'phongs pa'i rgud pa las sgrol phyir/ / 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul bzung rnam thos sras/ / gnod sbyin yongs kyi sde dpon che la bstod/ / rgyal bstan srung ma'i gtso bo khyed rnams kyis/ / nad rims gdon bgegs nyer 'tshe ma lus dang / / nyes kun rtsa ba blo ngan bdud kyi dpung / / ma lus drungs nas 'byin pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / las 'bras blang dor bslab gsum nyams len dang / / phyin drug spyod pa bde stong ting 'dzin sogs/ / rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam bzang ma lus pa/ / gegs med mngon du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / dpon slob rnams kyi chos dang mthun pa'i tshogs/ / ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / / nad dang bgegs sogs bar du gcodapa'i tshogs/ / nye bar 'i bar byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes pa 'di yang rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i bi lig thu ku shri ngag dbang bstan 'phel gyis skyes bu gsum gye chos srung dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dang bca4pa'i gtor 'bul mdor bsdus shig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron 3

༄/ /gung ca bayo ཿ zas ryāng 'bum/mes briyopa'o/ /hūṃ/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khros pa'i gar mdzad pa/ / ye shes mgon po yum bcas gnod sbyin bzhi/ / 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa kun/ / bsil ba tshal gyi gnas nas 'dir gshegs shig / bde chenasgyu ma'i rol pa las byung ba'i/ / kun bzang mchod sprin phyi nang gsang ba'i rten/ / ma tshang med pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtsho yis/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas dgyes gyur cig / khyad par bzang po'i sman gyi bye brag dang / / bzang po'i dri ngad spro ba'i bsang shing sogs/ / legs par sbyar ba'i bsang mchod rgya mtsho 'dis/ / thugs rje'i gter chen dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag nyes pa'i tshogs/ / thugs dang 'gal ba gang bgyes byang gyur te/ / rtag tu brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs pa yis/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / dge 'dun thugs mthun bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas/ / 'gro kun dge bcu'i dpal la spyod pa sogs/ / legs byas lhun gyis grub pa'i mgon mdzod cig / ces mgon po'i bsang mchod bsdus pa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong ye shes grags pas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rdo rje 'chang sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ / ji ltar bka' bsgos g.yar dam bcas pa bzhin/ / gzhi lam byes kyi nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / mthun rkyen ma lus 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / bstan srung srog bdag dmar po 'khor dang bcas/ / rtag tu bsten cing gsol btab re ba bzhin/ / phyi nang dgra sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang / / chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i grogs mdzod cig / mdor na srung ma'i gtso bor khyod 4

༄/ /garṣa 'tshal /bsten nas/ / rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / ma g.yel ma g.yel lus dang grib ma bzhin/ / rtag tu srung skyob mdzod cig sa ma ya/ / zhes bstan srung srog bdag dmar po'i bsgul ba mdor bsdus 'di'ang nor 'dzinaskyong ba'i dbang phyug hal ha g.yas ru'i jing ju ja sag thu rgyal po buṭī ratnas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /bhyo/ ma lus rgyal ba'i yum gcig dbyangs ldan ma/ / ma ltar 'gro la brtse bas dbang gyur kyang / ma rung 'dul phyir drag mo'i skur bstan khyod/ / ma thogs dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs/ / ma dad rnam par g.yeng dang bag med dang / / ma rtogs 'khrul ba'i nongs pa bgyis rnams la/ / ma dang sring ltar brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ / ma lus spros bral dbyings su dag par mdzod/ / ma cig 'dod khams dbang mo dgyes pa'i rten/ / ma tshang med pa mkho dgu'i mchod pa'i sprin/ / ma lus dngos bshams yid kyis sprul nas kyang / / ma mo chen mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / ma rungs dgra yi sha khrag gtor ma'i tshogs/ / ma smad sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs te/ / ma bcos dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags na/ / ma lus 'azin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol/ / ma skyes dbyings su zhugs pa'i ye shes mes/ / ma dag kun sbyor dra ba drungs phyung yang / / ma rung gshed por nyams brgyas rol ba can/ / ma hwa de wī 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / ma cig khyod la gus pas gsol 'debs na/ / ma g.yel ma g.yel dpon slob sder bcas la/ / ma dad 'khu ba'i bgegs tshogs 'joms pa dang / / ma smad chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ / ma rig mun sel 'dren pa rtag brtan cing / / ma dag rnyog bral rgyal bstan phyogs mthar rgyas/ / ma rgan 'gro la rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal/ / ma lus lhun gyes 5

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgronaryā ga stem/grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di ni thu med bai si'i shog dgon gnas byams pa gling gi rgyun gyi srung mar dpal ldan lha mo bsten rgyur gtor 'bul zhig dgos tshul/dka' bcu bstan pa rgya mtshos bskul ma byung bar brten chos smra ba/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris/ /na mo badzra stir wā ya/ 'dir dpal ldan lha mo la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ bsang rdzas dang mchod gtor legs par bsham/ /skyabs sems sngon du btang la rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod gtor byin gyis rlabs te/ bhyo ma lus rgyal ba'i yum gcig dbyangs can ma/ /ma rung 'dul phyir khro mo'i zlos gar mkhan/ / ma cig 'dod khams dbang mo 'khor dang bcas/ / ma g.yel bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i mgron du byon/ / me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong yangs por/ / mi bzad khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i dbus/ / ma mo mkha' 'gro bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas/ / mi mthun rkyen rnams srung phyir brtan par bzhugs/ / mi 'gyur bde ba mchog gi rol ba las/ / mu mtha' yas pa ngo mtshar mchod pa'i sprin/ / ma tshang med par bshams shing legs sprul te/ / mi phyed dad pas 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / me dpung rab 'bar gser gyi mchod sdong cher/ / me tog sna tshogs sman spos phye mar sogs/ / ma lus bsregs pa'i bsang mchod rgya mtsho 'dis/ / ma dag nyes pa'i tshogs kun byang gyur cig / ma bcos dad pa'i yid kyis lha mchog khyod/ / ma ltar gdung shugs drag pos bsten bgyid na/ / ma lus bgegs dpung 'joms shing mthun pa'i rkyen/ / ma tshang med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / mi 'gyur rdo rje'i g.yar dam nyer dgongs te/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang / / mos ldan rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas/ / ma ltar brtse bas rtag tu skyong bar 6

༄ / /gtor 'basko ba kyisaskor/mdzod/ / ma lus sgrib bral rnam kun mkhyen pa'i dpal/ / ma thob de srid chos ldan bya ba kun/ / ma bcol bar yang brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ / ma cig khyod kyis brtse bas skyong gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan dase slong bsod nams grags pas bskul ngor/ / 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/bla ma yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / spyi dang khyed par dpal ldan lha mo la/ / rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / ma ltar byams shing brtse bas dgongs par mdzod/ / sgo gsum sdig ltung dam tshig nyams chag sogs/ / rmongs pa'i dbang gis ji sted bgyis pa kun/ / khyed rnams thugs rje bden pas lhag med du/ / zhi zhing legs tshogs lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon gyi thugs rje'i mthus/ / yul gyi klu gnyan sa bdag tshogs rnams kyi/ / ko long phrag dog sdug bsngal kun zhi nas/ / dga' zhing gus pas rtag tu grogs byed shog /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug bcom ldan he ru ka / gdong ma bzhir bcas khros pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ / dpal gyi mgon po yum bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrub phyir gnas 'dir gshegs/ / nag dkar dmar dang dud kha 'jigs pa'i zhal/ / gri thod ral gri mdung thogs phyag bzhi ba/ / gtum chen 'khor bcas pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi/ / gdan la dgyes dgur rol pas brtan par bzhugs/ / rmongs shing bag med dbangagis lha khyod kyi/ / dam tshig las 'das bsnyen sgrub chag pa dang / /nyams grib phog rnams brtse bas bzod bzhes shing / / spros bral chos kyi dbyings su byang bar mdzod/ / bde stong ting 'dzin bir gyis bris pa yi/ /mchodaspyin gnam sa bar snang gang ba sogs/ / phyi nang gsang rten ma tshang 7

༄/ /yo ca bayo yosgronace' khrung ཿma/med pa yis/ / dpal mgon 'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /sngon tshe khas blangs rdo rje'i g.yar dam bzhin/ / nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe yis/ / pha rol bsam ngan sbyor tsub phyir bzlog cing / / nad gdon nyer 'tshe kun las bsrung du gsol/ / rnam dag bslab gsum mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi/ / bstan pa'i bya ba dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing / / tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang snyan grogs (grags)sogs/ / mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / mdor na lha khyod bdag sogs 'khor bcas kyi/ / srung ma'i gtso bor snying nas mnga' gsol na/ / bdag gir bzhes te chos ldan 'dod don kun/ / smon pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig / ces pa 'di ni thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag dam pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rgyun gye zhal 'don du/ /7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /brkyangs bskums gar gyis rol pas drag po chung ma dang bcas rnam gnon ngan song srid pa gnas nas skrod/ / shes rab phag mor rjes chags rol pas srid mthar sbyor zhing mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde chen bdud rtsis myos/ /khro chags brjid ldan gzi 'bar gzugs sku'i mkha' dbyings rab dkar rus pa'i rgyan phreng rgyu skar tshom bus mdzes/ / te ru ka dpal dpa' bo'i dbang phyug de la btud nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la bstod par bgyi/ / dmar chen dri snom gcan gzan nga ro brgyud mar sgrogs shing ro langs kyis gang rab 'jigs dur khrod na/ / rba rlabs nam mkha'i mthar 'khyud bam chen mgo 'phreng wu ba rab gsal khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong / / 'ur 'ur nag po'i dud sprin dang 'dres srid pa'i pha mtha' za byed ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ / bad nyi dgra bo bsnol ma'i gdan la 8

༄/ /gtor 'tshal4 /brkyangs bskums gar mdzad lha mchog ma hā kā la khyod la bstod/ / yan lag rags shing lto ba rab 'phyang mi sdug srin po'i gzugs can mdog nag mun pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ / dmar ser me yi ral ba gsig cing bcu gnyis nyi ma 'bar 'dra'i sdang mig yon po'i tsha zar (zer) 'phro/ / ljags 'dril khrag gis rab bsgos mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing gtum drag ha ta'i gad rgyangs mthar/ / khro khro le zhes mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud cing sa gsum dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i khyon kun 'dar bar byed/ / gri gug gis gtub dgra snying khrag dron gyis gang thod pa zhal du stob cing dgyes pa'i rkan sgra sgrogs/ / gnam lcags ral gris bdud rigs mgo bo bregs te brgya phyed phreng ba khrag gi rgyun ldan mgul bar 'dzin/ / mdung thung bgegs kyi lto bar bsnun pa'i rgyu rlon ga shal la 'khrel sbrul nag chun po stong gis spras/ / g.yer kha'i sgra ldan 'og pags kyis bcings stag sham g.yo ba'i gar mkhan rdo rje nag po gdong bzhi pa/ / gang gi phyogs bzhir mig sman mar gad ro nyi ta ka gser gye brag ri rab mtho'i rtse mo can/ / mun nag dang 'dres me lce'i gos gyon gad mo rgod cing sa chen g.yo ba'i gom stabs bsgyur ba ba'in/ / g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo sigo li zhes rab gtum khro zhing rngams pa'i yum chen srin mo bzhi/ / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor sreg byed gzi byin me dpung 'bar ba'i 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas la bstod/ / mdor na mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don bslad brtan g.yo'i dngos kun mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde ba'i 'khor lo cher/ / sdom mdzad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams yongs kyi dbang phyug mchog gi gnas der bgrod pa ma rdzogs pa/ / de srid te ru ka yi bka' rtags rdo rje ri mos gtsug mdzes legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pa'i bgegs kyi dpung tshogs sde dang bcas pa 9

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/thal bar rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / 'dir smras pa/ dpal gyi mgon po rdo rje gdong bzhi bar/ / bstod pa'i rol mo rngams pa sgra sgogs 'di/ / byed po he ru ka yi zhabs bsten pa'i/ /btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me yin/ /na mo gu ru badzra ba ṇa ye/ 'dir rgyal chen rnam thos sras la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis nyer spyod spyan gzigs/ /dkar gsum gye gtor ma khang rtsegs ma 'am/ blum gtor zhi ba'i rgyan spras/ spyan gzigs g.yang rten gyi rdzas sogs dang bsang mchod rgyasapar bshams la/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po sogasayi dam gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal la gnas te/ / mchod rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las/ rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgyes par byed pa'i mchod gtor dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas phun tshogs pas sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ bai/ byang phyogs ri rab lhun po'i byang gi char/ / byang chub mchog brnyes mgon po rin chen mang / / byang chub sems dpa'i sku yi rnam rol te/ / byang phyogs skyong mdzad rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ / yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel mdzod 'dzin pa/ / yid 'ong lang tsho'i dpal ldan btsun mo dang / / yid tsam khro zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams 'gyur can/ / yid la gang bsam stsol ba'i rta bdag brgyad/ / 'khor sa gsum gyi gnod sbyin bye ba sogs/ /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas pa kun/ / 'khor 'das dbyer med chos dbyings pho brang nas/ / 'khor ba'i rgud pa sel phyir gshegs su gsol/ / bdag 'dzin ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te/ /bdag sogs sgo gsum nyes par spyad pa kun/ / bdag nyid che khyod thugs rje'i bden pa'i mthus/ / bdag med chos kyi dbyings su dag gyur cig /10

༄/ / gtor lasal4 /rnam bkra ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa yi/ / rnam nang mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa/ / rnam dag dang ba'i yid kyis 'bul lags na/ / rnam par rol zhing dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig / ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla rin chen bdun/ / ro brgya'i zas sogs nyer spyod nor dang 'bru/ / ru mtshon go khrab spyan gzigs gsang rten sogs/ / re ba'i sems kyis 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ / khyad par dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor ma yis/ / khyon yangs 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ / khyab par bkang zhing bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ / khyed la 'bul lo zag med dgyes par rol/ /bsung zhim sman sna brgya phrag bsreg pa yi/ / bsang mchod 'di yis nyams chag nyes pa kun/ / bsal te rmad byung bde bas dgyes gyur nas/ / bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / phul byung mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas/ / phun tshogs mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor snyan grags sogs/ /phan bde'i dga' ston gsar ba'i me tog gi / phon po g.yur du za ba'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / dad brtson shes rab rmad byung chos kyi g.yang / / tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan srid kyi g.yang / / gzugs bzang blo gsal ngag snyan rigs kyi g.yang / / mdzangs shing brtan la gzhung bzang grogs kyi g.yang / / kun stoms byams shing brjid chags rje yi g.yang / / khrel yod drang zhing mthu ldan bran gyi g.yang / / 'tshe bral bag phebs mthun pa gnas kyi g.yang / / mi zad gya nom 'phel ba nor gyi g.yang / / sha rgyas sru sdug stobs ldan phyugs kyi g.yang / / ro dang bcud ldan bde ster zas kyi g.yang / / 'phral yun dge zhing mthar phyin bya ba'i g.yang / / mi 'gyur bsngags 'os don mthun grags pa'i g.yang / / la sogs sred gsum 'jig rten mtha' dag na/ / legs tshogs phywa g.yang ji snyed mchis pa sogs/ / lugs gnyis dpal dang 'byor 11

༄/ /yo thang bstanaryāsgonaryā khrung ཿma/ba'i dga' ston la/ / longs su spyod pa'i dngos grub char bzhin phob/ / phywa g.yang chab srid dbu 'phang ri ltar mtho/ / phywa g.yang tshe dang bsod nams mtsho ltar bskyil/ / phywa g.yang snyan grags nyi zla ltar gsal pa'i/ / phywa g.yang 'dod dgu'i dpal chen deng 'dir khug / ma g.yel ma g.yel lhag pa'i lha khyod la/ / mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol 'debs na/ / mi mthun nyes kun zhi zhing mthun pa'i rkyen/ / ma lus bde blag nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ / thog med dus nas 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba kun/ / thugs rjes bdag gir mdzad pa'i mgon khyod kyis/ / thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i gru gzings la brten nas/ / thams cad srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ / tshe rabs phreng bar sa bcu'i mgon khyod kyis/ / tshad med thugs rje'i phyag gis nyer bzung nas/ / tshogs gnyis rlabs chen spyod pa mthar phyin te/ / tshe dpag med pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog / de yang sngar g.yang 'bod rgyas par byas pa'i skabs kyi rten sogs yod na/ / g.yang 'gug gi tshigs bcad rnams brjod pa'i tshe rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus srid pa gsum gyi phywa g.yang thams cad bsdus te/de dag la thim par mos pas g.yang 'gug gi dod thub cing / rdzas dngos su bshams pa med na'ang / srid zhi'i phun tshogs thams cad bsdus te rang gi sdod gnas bang mdzod la sogs pa thams cad gang bar mos pa bya'o/ /mjug tu mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par mos shing / / dkon mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pa la sogs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bsam gtan gyis 'di'i bsang mchod rgyas pa g.yang 'gug gi don tshang ba zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ /7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /12

༄/ /spyora'i thab /na mo badzra ba ṇa ye/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod gtor dam rdzasarnamasabyin gyi4brlabs la/ bai/ mdun du seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng / /bai yig mdog dmar 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras mdung dmar can/ / me 'od 'khyug pa'i bye ru'i lhun po bzhin/ sku mdog dmar po gzi byin lang tsho 'bar/ / dmar blum spyan bgrad mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs/ / g.yas na stag lpags rgyal mtshan mdung dmar dang / / g.yo na pa'i phyag gis rme'u le lcags kyu 'dzin/ / rin chen rgyan spras bse yi khrab rmog gsol/ / bstan srung gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas/ / gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig gis/ / byang phyogs lcang lo can gye pho brang nas/ / rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ / dam tshig pa dang dbyer med brtan par bzhugs/ / nongs pa ci bgyis 'gyod pas mthol bshags na/ / dmigs med snying rje'i shugs kyis dag par mdzod/ / bai/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar yongs phye ba'i/ / mi zad mchod sprin tshar du dngar ba ni/ / dag byed chu bzhis dri ma kun sbyong zhing / / nyer spyod 'dod yon dbang po'i dpyid du gyur/ / snyan cing brjid chags rol mos sa chen g.yo/ / ngo mtshar spyan gzigs mkha' la sprin bzhin gtibs/ / ri rab gling bzhir bcas pa'i maṇḍa lar/ / zas nor mkho dgu'i longs spyod phyur bur srungs/ / go mtshon phyag mtshan phyi nang gsang rten gyis/ / rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ / pha rol bsam sbyor ngan pa kun bzlog ste/ / bar chad sel zhing 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol/ / khyad par zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor gyis/ / rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgyes shing tshim gyur te/ / rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ / rjes su brtse bas bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ / stobs bcu'i dpal 3

༄/ /yo ca bstan ba'i sgronapo ga ཿma/mnga' bde gshegs rin chen mang / / gnod sbyin sde dpon nor lha'i skur sprul te/ / sgrub pa po la dngos grub char 'bebs pa/ / bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po khyod la bstod/ / chos 'byor dpal la 'khu ba'i gdug can rnams/ / rngam pa'i stabs kyis rdo rje'i mdung thung gis/ / bsnun nas phye mar brlag pa'i stobs po che/ / las bzhi'i mthar son khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bdag sogs deng nas byang chub sgrub pa la/ / nye bar 'tshe ba'i bgags rigs bzlog pa dang / / chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa yis/ / rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa'i grogs mdzod cig / ces pa 'di ni the bo rong phyogs kyi dgon pa bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi tshogs 'don du 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul sngags ram pa 'jam dbyangayonor bu/ rab 'byams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ dge slong bstan 'dzin grags pa rnams kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /na mo gu ru snyi ṣa dzre rā dzā ya/ 'dir bka' gter rig gnas spyi dang khyad paragaso ba rig pa'i bstan srung gtso bor grags pa zhing blon rdo rje bdud 'dul la bsang dang mchod gtor sogs 'bul bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis de'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa 'du byas te/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs gar sdegs mdzub mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ mchod gtor rnams asritas bsangs/ su bhāwas stong par sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i phyi nang gsang ba'i dmardzas spyan gzigs nam mkha' gang ba zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par gyur/ oṃ arnya ā ḍū nasasparshaya ka gi bar dang / sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab/ hūṃ mi 'gyur mchog tu yangs pa'i gzhal yas 14

༄/ / garṣa'༅ /khang / / me tog 'bras ldan sman gyi ljon pas bskor/ / mu tig 'od chags nor bu'i rgyan 'phreng can/ / ma lus dpal dang 'byor pas gtams pa nas/ / sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor kun stsol gnod sbyin gyi/ / sde dpon rdo rje bdud 'dul yab yum dang / / sde brgyad 'byung po'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas/ / sde 'dir thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis gshegs/ / mdun du rin chen 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i/ / steng du dgyes pa chen pos legs bzhugs nas/ / brtse bas dgongs te sngon byas nongs pa kun/ / spros bral chos kyi dbyings su sbyong bar mdzod/ / yid 'ong nyer spyod rol mo tshar du dngar/ / lhun stug 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga rdzogs/ / dam rdzas rgyan dang ldan pa'i gtor ma sogs/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ / lus sems gdung ba sel ba'i dri bzang gi / dad ldan spos dang sman sna brgya phrag sogs/ / sbyar ba'i bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i bsung zhim gyis/ / zhang blon 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / sku mdog mthing nag rab bajid khro bo'i tshul/ / phyag gnyis yid bzhin nor dang bum bzang bsnams/ / yum chen gnod sbyin dbang mo kun sgrub ma/ / bka' nyan rnam bzhi 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / sngon tshe rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos shing / / gsang ba'i bdag po'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ / rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par gso rig gi / bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi ngo bo legs rtogs shing / / gnyen po mi 'dzol sman rnams mthu dang ldan/ / bro 'tshal skye bo'i gdung sel gzhan phan gyi/ / 'phrin las yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ / mdor na bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ / phyi nang nye bar 'tshe ba kun zhi zhing / / chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor rdzogs ldan gyi/ / dga' ston lhun 15

༄/ /ca ca ཿna pa'izlanama'i gsung 'bum/gyis grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / ces mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni gso ba rig pa'i gnas la rnam dpyod yangs pa dar han yi sbyiblo bzang mchog grub kyis bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /sgrib bral ye shes lnga yi rang 'od ni/ / snang srid dregs pa'i rgyal po lngar bzhengs pa'i/ / gtsor gyur me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ / sku yi rgyal po khros pa'i rnam rol pa'i/ / gnod sbyin dgra lha chen po pu tra dang / / gsang ba'i yum chen bdud mo ro langs ma/ / las byed khyab 'jug blon po bya khrid dang / / ru 'dren sde bzhi sprul pa yang sprul bcas/ / bsam yas chos 'khor la sogs gnas mchog nas/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs te/ / rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod sde dang bcas/ / srung zhing skyong ba'i mgon du brtan par bzhugs/ / ma rung bsgral ba'i sha khrag don snod las/ / byung ba'i nyer spyod rol mo'i bye brag dang / / khyad par sbyangs rtogs sbar byas gtor ma'i tshogs/ / zag med bde chen ngang du dgyes par rol/ / pad nyi mi ro la gnas rta mchog steng / / gtum dregs tshul gyes 'gying ba'i dgra lha che/ / khro bo'i rdo rje gter bum legs bzung nas/ / bgegs 'joms dngos grub kun stsol khyod la bstod/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rdo rje'i g.yar dam bzhin/ / rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba dang / / khyad par rtse gcig sgrub cing mchod pa yi/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ / pha rol byad phur bsam sbyor ngan pa dang / / nad mug 'khrugs sogs rgud pa'i tshogs zhi zhing / / chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa/ / dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ / mdor na rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab bzhin/ / nyin mtshan 16

༄/ / gtor 'atsal /kun tu g.yel med grogs mdzad de/ / mi mthun 'tsho ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba yi/ / dge mtshan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i dpal stsol cig / ces pa 'ari ni wam pa dge bshelosprul sku blobazang dkon mchog rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ 1/btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /lhun grub bde stong ye shes gser 'gyur rtsis/ / tha mal snod bcud snang ba'i lcags kyi khams/ / bsgyur ba'i rang snang dag pa'i su warṇa/ / dag pa'i rten dang brten par shar pa ni/ / rab 'jigs zangs ris bskor ba'i gru gsum klong / / rakta'i rgya mtsho zhag gi rlabs 'phreng can/ / gdug pa'i gcan gzan sgra sgogs srin bya rgod/ / rngam brjid bzod par dka' ba'i dur khrod dbus/ / bse mkhar spug po mchong gi kha bad can/ / rab dkar thod pa'i phreng ba tshar du dngar/ / rgyu ma'i do shal khrag gi zham chu 'bab/ /mi lpags rgyal mtshan g.yo ba'i pho brang nas/ / mi ro rta ro bsnol ba'i gdan steng na/ / sgrol gyeng srog bdag dmar po chag tse can/ / g.yas pas zangs gri g.yon pas glo snying dang / / mda' gzhu 'dzin cing bse yi ru mtshon bsgreng / / g.yon na rigs pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ / mdog nag zangs gri lcags kyi phur ba bsnams/ / dred mo mi zan la zhon gcer mo'i gzugs/ / sna tshogs rgyan ldan gsang ba'i yum dang bcas/ / las byed gri thogs bshan pa'i tshogs rnams dang / / ma mo the'u rang la sogs gdug pa'i 'khor/ / gnam sa'i khor yug 'gengs pa'i lha srin tshogs/ / ma thogs dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig / dngos 'dzin chang gis myos pa'i gnyis 'thung blo/ / dge legs pad tshal 'joms byed gom pa'i stabs/ /log pa'i lam du bsgyur ba'i nyes ltung kun/ / thugs rje lcags kyus bzung ste byang bar mdzod/ / gzungs rig mos pa'i chu mtsho ma rnyog par/ / sna tshogs 17

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/mchod pa'i rgyu skar bkra ba ni/ / khrag gi mchod yon rnam lnga'i me tog spos/ / mar me dri dang zhal zas rol mo'i sgra / mdog dmar rta g.yag rwa skyes srin bya'i tshogs/ /'jigs pa'i gcan zan bse yi khrab rmog dang / /zangs gri glo snying bse mkhar srog 'khor sogs/ / ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin tshogs rnams 'bul/ / khyad par dmar chen gtor ma'i ri bo ni/ /rab mtho lhun po'i rjes 'gro sku gsung thugs/ / rdo rjes sbyangs rtogs spar byas bdud rtsi 'di/ / dgyes par rol la bcol pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /byang shar ma ru tse yi dur khrod na/ / dmar nag sgrol gying chen po srog gi bdag /nag po'i rtsa lag sde dang bcas pa la/ / 'jigs pa'i bskal ba ston mdzad khyod la bstod/ / mkhyen brtse'i rno ngar ldan pa'i zangs kyi gri /gnas lugs nam mkha'i dbyings su gdengs pa yis/ / bdag 'dzin gdon gye rang mdangs bdud sde'i mgo / gcig car gcod pa'i dpa' bo khyod la bstod/ /'jigs pa'i sku la rab bgos bse yi khrab/ / brag dmar ngos la glo snying khrag rgyun 'bab/ / rta gdong me lce g.yo bas 'khyud pa'i gar/ / snang srid rtse mor bsgyur ba khyod la bstod/ / rab 'jigs bdud mo bse yi lan phran can/ /las byed bshan pa'i sde dang gdug pa'i 'khor/ / rgyal bstan bsrung phyir mi g.yel brtson mdzad pa'i/ / bka' nyan 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas la bstod/ / dga' ldan bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /yangs pa'i ljongs 'dir bde skyid dpal 'bar zhing / / rgyal blon sder bcas mnga' thang dgung la bsnyegs/ / phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces yoro hor chen shog dga' ldan yar 'phel gling gi tshogs 'don du 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul rab 'byams pa 'jigs med nyi mas bskul ngor/ / 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesasbyar pa'o/ /18

༄/ /gawo khru4 /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir gnas chung dgra lha skyesagacig la gsol mchod mdor bsdus bya bar 'dod pas/ / dam rdzas rnams 'du byas te skyab sems sngon du btang / / rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'di ltar/ / hūṃ/ bgrang yas bde gshegs ye shes sgyu 'phrul las/ padma kā ra'i ge sar rdzogs pa'i dpyid/ / 'jam dpal snying po dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon/ / snang srid dregs ldan yongs kyi gtsug na rgyal/ / spros bral dbyings su zhugs pa'i ye shes mkhar/ / rnam 'dren thugs rje'i khams kyi rol pa las/ / cir yang 'char ba dregs pa'i sde dpon lnga/ / gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ / khyad par longs spyod 'khor lo grol ba'i gdangs/ / bzhin legs gar gye ri mo gsung gi rgyal/ /rig pa blon po rdo rje dregs ldan che/ / 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / 'od gsal darsha dri mas dben gyur kyang / / byis blo 'khrul ba'i ra ris bkra ba rnams/ / gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i yid kyis mthol bshags na/ / dmigs med thugs rje'i dbyings su dag par mdzod/hūṃ/ rdo rje 'chang dbang bden pa'i bkas btags shing / / rnal 'byor ting 'dzin mos pa'i mthu dpal las/ / sprul pa'i chos rgyal dgyes byed mchod pa'i sprin/ / mi zad mkho dgu'i lang tsho rgyas gyur cig / yid 'ong mchod yon dpal gyi 'dab brgya ba/ / bsung zhim spos dang mar me dri yi chab/ / bza' bca' btung ba ri dang rgya mtsho'i zla/ / rngam brjid beer bcas dgyes pa skyed phyir 'bul/ / g.yang gzhi rgyu ma'i lnga ldis chu mthongs 'gog / rta g.yag gcan gzan tshogs kyis sa chen khyab/ / nyer spyad go mtshon bar snang 'gengs pa 'di/ / sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes phyir 'bul/ / gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga sogs mchod sprin dang / / khyad 19

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'a4/par dgra sha khrag zhag gtor ma 'di/ / sbyangs rtogs sbar bas bdud rtsir byen brlabs nas/ / gus pas 'bul lo dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra yi nyer 'tshe kun/ / sdig can sdang ba'i dgra la phyir bzlog nas/ / chos srid rgyas pa'i las 'di khyod kyis sgrubs/ / hūṃ/ kun khyab kun bzang ye shes 'byung ba lnga'i/ / rang 'od sku lngar shar pa dbang po'i gzhu/ / ma rung gdug pa'i gshed por me yi 'od/ / 'phro ba dgra yi dgra la bdag bstod do/ / khyad par rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha che/ / gsung gi rgyal po rang rig gsang ba'i yum/ / rdo rje dregs ldan mi bzad mthu bo che/ / gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgyu mtshor bcas la bstod/ / rgyal gsung ha har ba'ad pa khrag 'thung lha'i/ / dkyil 'khor gnyan por rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ / bka' bsgos dam bcas tshul la nyer dgongs nas/ rnal 'byor dpon slob sder bcas srung bar mdzod/ / rgyal bstan spyi dgra rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgra /bsam sbyor ngan rnams thal bar brlag pa dang / / bstan dang bstan 'dzin bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sogs/ / bsrung zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ / mdor na byang chub sgrub pa'i gegs gyur pa'i/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi ba dang / / mthun rkyen tshe dpal stobs 'byor mnga' thang sogs/ / 'bad med lhun gyes grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / 'jug chog dkyus ltar bya'o1 zhes pa 'di ni thu med bai si'i shog dge slong blo bzang gis bskul ngor/ /7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris/ /na mo gu ru bhya khams gsum rnam par gnon pa'i dpal mnga' ba/ / khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad ngur smrig gi / gar gyis rol pa 'jam mgon blo bzang grags/ / srid gsum dregs ldan rigs kyi bdag por 20

༄/ / garṣa 'artsal /bzhugs/ / hrī / skye 'jig mtshan ma kun bral stong pa'i dbyings/ /bde gshegs ye shes rang mdangs sku lnga las/ / gnas chung sprul pa'i chos rgyal bee ha ra/ / 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dbyar gyi mkha' la chu 'dzin 'du ba bzhin/ sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan pos nyer bskul te/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul g.yo ba'i rlung shugs kyis/ / 'dir gshegs dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / kun tu rmongs pa mun pa'i smag rum na/ / sgo gsum nongs pa'i 'khrul ba ci bgyis pa/ / snyes par mthong ste mthol zhing bshags bgyid na/ / brtse bas dgongs te dbyings su dag par mdzod/ / bde stong ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rol ba las/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i snang brnyan 'bum spros te/ / dbang po kun la zag med bde ster bas/ / chos rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / ngo mtshar spyan gzigs tshogs kyis lha lam gang / / dgyes byed mchod pa'i rdzas kyis nor 'dzin khyab/ / snyan 'gyur gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ / dri zhim bsangs shing dud pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ / rgya mtshos sked bcings lhun po'i rjes 'gro ba/ / sim byed dri ro reg bya'i dpal 'dzin pa'i/ / dmar chen gtor ma btung ba'i rigs dang bcas/ / dgyes par rol la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / sngon tshe rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ / rdo rje'i g.yar dam gnyan po khas blangs bzhin/ / rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa bdag cag gi / chos srid don kun sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ / lnga phrag snyigs ma'i mun pa 'thib pa'i klong / / sangs rgyas bstan la than skyel srin bya'i tshogs/ / chos min spyod pa'i gar stabs g.yo ba kun/ / gzi byin nyi ma'i 'od kyis gzhom par mdzod/ / thugs rje'i mu khyud blum bskor 'phrin las kyi/ / rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i gser sbyangs 'khor lo 21

༄/ /yo thang bayoḥsgronayo gsung ཿma/yis/ / sa gsum dregs ldan mkho dgu'i longs spyod bcas/ / ma lus dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / mthu stobs dpung pa'i ru mtshon bsgrengs pa yi/ / dgra lha dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs kun/ / dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya las ma 'da' bar/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig / rab dkar shel gyi rdul brtsegs lhun po la/ / nyi 'od stong 'bar me lces 'khyud pa bzhin/ / gzi byin bzod dka' gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan/ / chos skyong chen po'i sku la bdag bstod do/ / drag po'i gad mo gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / nag phyogs bdud kyi rigs gyur ri dwags mo'i/ / bsam sbyor log pa'i mngal khur ltung mdzad pa/ / chos skyong chen po'i gsung la bdag bstod do/ / phyi rol 'jig rten dregs pa'i skur bstan yang / /dmigs med snying rje'i ngang las mi g.yo ba'i/ / ye shes bde stong mchog gi ngang du rol/ / chos skyong chen po'i thugs la bdag bstod do/ /bdag cag dpon slob dgon gnas dge 'dun sde/ / kun gyi srung ma'i gtso bor mnga' gsol na/ / bsam pa'i don kun lhun gyis grub pa yi/ / bkra shis rgya mtshos kun tu khyab par mdzod/ / ces gnas chung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po'igasol mchod 'di ni su nyid shog nas rab 'byams pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis lhag bsam dag pas chos sde chen po 'di nyid kyi srung ma'i gtso bo yin gshis/ khri ba'i bla brang dang spyi ba so sor yang 'di'i sku brnyan ra byung na legs pa'i gros 'debs kyis so sor grogs ldan phul phyin bgyis shing / de thog nas gsol mchod cig kyang dgos tshul byung bar brten/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bsta na pa'i sgron mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ /hūṃ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings bde ba'i dngos/ / snang ba 'dod dgur 'byor pa yangs pa'i klong / / gzhal yas 'od 'bar ru mtshon spyan 22

༄/ /spyor 'tshil /gzigs kyis/ / bskor ba'i dbus su yid 'ong gdan khri la/ / chos skyong rgyal po chen po sku lnga dang / / steng gi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam lha/ / phyogs su snang srid dregs pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs/ / ma tshang med par mgron du lhags pa rnams/ /tshogs la rol phyir dgyes bzhin bzhugs su gsol/ / oṃ ā ྅ rdo rje gsum gyi rol pa yis/ / nyes kun sbyangs te 'chi med bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ / nam mkha' khyab par byin gyis brlabs pa yis/ / rmad byung dgyes pa skyed pa'i nus ldan gyur/ / sngags drug phyag rgya drug dang / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / zhesasogayokyis brlabs la/ to zag med tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di/ / steng gi bla ma yi dam tshogs la 'bul/ /dgyes bzhin bzhes nas bdag sogs kun gyi rgyud/ / byin gyis brlabs te dngos grub ma lus stsol/ / to zag med tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di/ /chos skyong rgyal po sku lnga'i tshogs la 'bul/ / dgyes bzhin bzhes nas rdo rje'i g.yar dam bzhin/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / to zag med tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyan chen 'di/ gsang yum blon po 'khor tshogs bcas la 'bul/ / dgyes bzhin bzhes nas bdag sogs mi nor kun/ / rtag tu bsrung zhing skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod/ / to zag med tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di/ / yul lha gzhi bdag glo bur lhags pa sogs/ / tshogs la re zhing stos pa kun la 'bul/ / bzhes nas kun la phan bde'i bsam spyor mdzod/ / hūṃ gtsang mar sbyar ba'i tshogs 'khor rgya chen 'dis/ / rgyal ba'i bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes mdzod la/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin spel/ / bstan 'dzin thugs mthun bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas/ / sbyin bdag rgyal blon 'bangs bcas mnga' thang dar/ / yul du nad mug 'khrug sogs nyer 'tshe zhi/ / chos dang srid kyi 23

༄/ /yo ca ཿna pa'i sgroms ga4 4ma/legs tshogs ma lus pa/ / dkar phyogs tshes kyi zla ba bzhin du 'phel/ /rnam sad mchod yon bzhin du rgyun chad med/ / nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs shing rgya che la/ / ri rab lhun po lta bur brtan cing brjid/ / dpag bsam shing ltar lhun gyis grub par shog / ces pa 'di ni dur bin khu'u khed shog gi blo dang ldan pa dem chi rab 'byams pa bsam 'grub rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ /7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /na mo gu ru bhya rang yi dam du bskyed cing bsang mchod byin gyis brlabs la/ / oṃ mtsho skyes rdo rje rgyal dbang grags pa'i zhabs/ / kun mkhyen bzhad pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i/ / bka' srung 'brog gnas chen po'i tshul 'dzin pa/ / rma rgyal spom ra 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang / / khyad par rkang 'gro rin chen nor dang 'bru/ / go khrab spyan gzigs bkod pa mtha' yas pas lha yi dge bsnyen 'khor bcas dgyes gyur cig / dam rdzas gtor ma ri rab ltar spungs shing / / ja chang gser skyems btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ / oṃ ā hūṃ gis bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas/ / gus pas 'bul lo dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol/ / bsung zhim spos dang sman sna brgya phrag tshogs/ /bsregs pa'i dud sprin mkha' dbyings khyab pa yis/ / lha chen thugs dang 'gal pa'i nyes pa kun/ / byang zhing zag med dga' bdes tshim gyur cig / sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal sras dpa' bo mchog / dus mthar rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel phyir du/ / 'brog gnas srid pa'i lha chen tshul bzung ba/ / rma rgyal spom ra 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / dregs rtsal mthu ldan lha yi dge bsnyen che/ / yum sras blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa kun/ / sngon tshe 24

༄/ / gtor 'atsarya4 /rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos bzhin/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin mtha' dag skyong bar mdzod/ / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /gzhi lam byes kyi nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / chos dang srid kyi legs tshigs ma lus pa/ / yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / ces pa 'di nidad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog seng ges bskul ngor/ /7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /dpal he ru ka la na mo/ bsang rdzas rnams tshogs par byas/ lha'i nga rgyal gyi gdeng dang ldan pas 'di ltar/ / hūṃ he ru ka dpal dbyings rig dbyer med mkhar/ / char sprin gar gyi ri mo gdong bzhi ba/ / yum bzhi snyer gcig bshan pa'i sde dang bcas/ / 'dir gshegs bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig / khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid skyong ba'i lha/ / snang srid kha lo bsgyur ba'i drag rtsal can/ / gnyan chen pho ba rog po yum sras blon/ / kun dang dar rgyal spun gsum dung ri dkar/ / phag po hor yon gdar sgang chu sngon dang / / ra lam khyung rtse 'dru 'dru skya sngo ring / / shing chen shing chung mnga' sgro g.ya' spang ri/ / zhal dkar mtsho mo khra zug bse'i ri rgan/ / sgo mo g.yas g.yon rmog ri rdzas che chung / / brag dkar sogs la gnas bcas lha dang klu/ / mthu ldan dkar phyogs skyong ba ma lus pa/ /bsang mchod rgya mtshozhi mgron du 'dir gshegs shig / bswe/ mchog gsum mthu dang chos dbyings bden pa las/ / byung ba'i mchod sprin nam mkha' khyon gang zhing / / bsang shing sna tshogs bsregs pa'i dud pa'i sprin/ / beḍūr dbyar skyes lha lam 'gengs pa 'dis/ / bla ma yi dam chos srung thams cad dang / / stobs 'phrog nag po yab yum 'khor bcas bsang / / lha gnyan chen po sngo la g.yu rtse sogs/ / yul 'di'i gzhi bdag 25

༄ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 4ma/gnyan po ma lus bsang / / bsang ngo bsang mchod rgya chen 'di bzhes la/ / yul 'di'i sde dgon rje 'bangs thams cad dang / / khyad par bdag cag mi nor ltos bcas kun/ / srung skyob bya ra dus kun ma g.yel zhig / khyod mthu ga bur gzeg ma'i rtse dga' yis/ / mi nad phyugs nad dgra rkun gcan gzan dang / / sad ser than pa kha smras gyod sna sogs/ / rgud pa'i tsha gdung ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ / g.yung drung tshe yi rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /bsod nams stobs 'byor yal ga'i khyon yangs rtser/ / grags snyan dga' ba'i me tog 'dzum pa yi/ / rdzogs lda na gsar ba'i 'khri shing rgyas par mdzod/ / rjes chags utpal dmar po'i lcags kyu yis/ / yid 'ong grogs dang 'khor g.yog mnga' thang dang / / zas nor longs spyod mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor kun/ / dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig / ma nyes nyes par 'dzin pa'i phas kyi dgra/ / gdug pa'i sems 'chang gnod pa'i las byed pa/ / ma lus bdun brgyud bcas pa drungs phyung ste/ / thal ba'i rdul du rlog cig sa ma ya/ / mdor na mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ / tshe ring nad med sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas/ / kun yid chos la phyogs pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / zhes hor tshang spyi'i chos skyong dang 'brel bar yul lha'i gsol mchod 'di lta bu zhig dgos tshul ltar btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig / dkon mchog thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis smin pa'i/ / dkar phyogs skyong ba lha klu'i pad tshal las/ / dka' ba med par mthun dngos sbrang rtsi yi/ / dkor mdzod 'dren pa'i thabs tshul 'di na spro/ / de yang bod dang bod chen gnyis las/ chen po bod kyi yul du gtogs pas rtse brgyad lung ba phyogs su gyes/ / zhes lung bstan pa'i ya 26

༄ / /gtor 'as bsang kyi skor/gyal/ / spangs ljongs me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'brog gi sa mtshams phal skad la bsang gzhung du grags pa'i gnas bdag gtso bor gyur pa lha gnyan chen po khyung rtse'i bsang mchod rgyas par lag len du bstar bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ / dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs kyi gtor ma/ / bzang po'i sman sna gang 'dzom/ / phye mar sogs dang sbyar ba'i bsang rtsi/ 'bru shug mkhan pa ba lu sogs bsang shing / spyan gzigs dang rten 'brel gyi yo byad/ rnga gshang dung gling sogs kyi rol cha dang bcas sta gon tshags su tshud pa byas te/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar zhing shin tu 'i ba'i nyams can/zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas phyag g.yas legs par brkyangs pa'i mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pa sta zur la brten te skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas padma dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral ba'i thor cog bcings shing spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med kyis rgyas btab pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing / rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/pad zla'i gdan la zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i spyi bor yo/ mgrin par ā / thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ bsang rdzas dang mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyed du gyur/stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams kyi rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las/ lha gnyan chen po khyung rtse mthon po sogs bsang gzhung 'di na gnas pa'i lha klu dkar phyogs skyong pa mtha' dag mnyes par byed pa'i bsang rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyes mi khyab pas sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ arnya ā ཿ/ oṃ patt+waṃ ā :/ oṃ buzla ā ྅/ oṃ ju pe ā rtu/ rma ā lo ke 27

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ཿ sgron me'i khrung ཿma/〉 rtu/ oṃ gadhe ā :/ oṃ dzee wi tya ā ka/ oṃ shasta ā hūṃ/ oṃ subhā wa bi shudhe dha rma te badzra sid dhi hūṃ/ nam sarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shā mu khe rgya sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te spa ra ṇa hi mi ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā ṭwāṃ a tya nu tpa ri twad ta/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo gi te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dzwa tiṣā sed dhi lo tsa ni sarba aze sātho ni swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs ba rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / chos kyi dbyings gdod ma nas rnam par dag cing / kun rdzob tsam du rgyu 'bras bsru ba med pa'i rten 'byung bden pa chen po'i zhing sar/ bdag gi rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam dang rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gye sa bon btab pa rnams/mchog gsum bslu ba med pa'i thugs rje'i rlan gsher drod kyis smin pa las bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i mgron rnams spyan drangs pa bzhin thogs pa med par 'du zhing / mchod pa'i yo byad ji ltar mos pa bzhin thog pa med par lhun gyi grub par mchod yul rnams la dgyes pa bla na med pa bskyed cing / de la brten nas las bzhi'i 'phrin las gang bcol skad cig nyid du bsgrubs pa sogs ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bde blag nyid du smin par gyur cig / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang / / chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ / de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig / thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs 'od dkar snang bas yongs su khyab pa gangs 28

sa / /gtor 'a rdzobasang kyisasgor/can bod kyi yul gru/ rigs kun khyab bdag bzhad pa'i rdo rjes thugs bskyed dpung ba'i ka ba brtan pos yongs su bzung ba'i 'dul 'ing / mdo smad sa yi thig le bai ḍūr lhun po'i rjes su 'gro ba ri'i dbang po rtse mo mngon par mtho bas tshangs pa'i yul sa snyegs shing / rtsa ba rab brtan dbang chen gser gyi gzhi la zug pa/ 'bras bu phun tshogs pa'i bcud kyis spa ba'i rtsi shing dang / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i klung phran yongs su bskor ba/steng du chu 'dzin stug po'i bla re mngon par bres shing / glog phreng 'gyu ba'i gser gyi do shal can/ snyan brjid dbyar skyes rnga gsang rol mo dal gyis rgod cing gru char kun tu 'bebs pa/ phyi bltas brjid cing mdzes pa'i sa 'dzin mchog gi rnam pa la nang du rin chen bye ba'i khams las grub pa'i pho brang chen po gser g.yu'i rgya phibs tshar du dngar zhing / mkho dgu'i 'byor pa ma tshang ba med pa'i dbus na 'brog gnas lha yi dge bsnyen khyung rtse mthon po sku mdog nor bu chu shel bzhin du dkar zhing 'tsher la 'od zer 'phro ba/phyag g.yas mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dar mdung ru mtshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon na mthun rkyen dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs pa'i yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin pa/ nyi zla'i 'od la 'khu ba'i gser gyi go khrab gsol zhing / g.yas g.yon du stag ral dang gzig shubs can/ mdzes shing brjid la dpa' zhing rngams pa sogs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ nor bu'i sga srab can gyi rta mchog dkar po sprin gyi shugs can gyi steng na 'gying ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su gnyan rje gong sngon/ g.yon na zhang bo gnyan dmar/ mdun du blon po sgrog chen dang glang ri sogs bsang gzhung nyin srib kun tu gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag gnyan po'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ rang 'phags pa thugs rje chen 29

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de dag rnams la phog pa'i rgyud bskul te bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i mgron du skad cig nyid la thogs pa med par byon nas rang rang ji ltar mos pa'i gdan khri phun sum tshogs pa la dgyes pa'i nyams dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ kyai/ rmad byung bkra shis dge mtshan chu bo brgya/ / g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chu lha'i phyogs rol nas/ / snang srid skyong ba'i lha chen 'khor dang bcas/ / 'dir byon rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ / rigs kun khyab bdag bzhad pa'i rdo rje yis/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i gdangs su bsgrags pa'i bka'/ / ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig dran mdzod la/ / rnal 'byor yon mchod skyongs shig sa ma ya/zhes dam la bzhag mkha' dang 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ yongs su gang ba'i mchod yon dam pa 'di/ / lha gnyan chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / dgyes bzhin bzhes nas bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / oṃ ju mi pa tis pa ri wā ra a: pra tī tsā swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang / arnya gyi gnas su/ pābye/ pukhye/ ju pe/ṭwāṃ ༵༷ rdo rje/ dī/ma'i gyiblu lha rya tsho/gsasha ༷zhu diXs pa dīcu /na dī di~X/ du ༵ ṭwāṃnaṭwāṃrdoX ṭwāṃ ge brgya pa dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas de dag gi sdig sgrib bag chags gnod pa'i bsam sbyor la sogs pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas rgyud byin gyis brlab par bsams shing yig brgya bzla/ ka dag stong pa'i mkha' la dkar nag las/ / kha dog mi 'dra'i tshon ris ma dmigs kyang / / ga shed 'khrul ngor bkra ba'i nyes ltung kun/ /nga ro drag pos mthol zhing bshags par bgyi/ / ca co don med gtam gyis 30

༄/ / gtor la thu /'phya smod sogs/ / cha shas kun nas thugs dang 'gal bgyis shing / / ja chang phud dang gser skyems bsang gsol sogs/ / nya stong dus su ma bgyis mthol lo bshags/ / ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / tha mal spyod pa bag med gyur pa kun/ / da ni nyes par mthong ste bshasas bgyid na/ / na ma rer yang byang zhing dag par mdzod/ / pa ra mi ta'i dgongs don chos dbyings su/ / pha mtha' yas pa'i nyes ltung sgrib pa kun/ / ba mo'i zil ba nyi mas gdungs pa bzhin/ / ma lus lhag med byang zhing dag gyur cig / rtsa rgyud bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs kyis/ / tsha zer 'phreng bas 'dab brgya phye ba ba'in/ / dza ya'i bstan skyong 'khor bcas spyan lam du/ /wa ler mchod pa'i dngos kun rgyas gyur cig / zhwa lham bzhon pa nor bu'i sga srab dang / / za 'og gos bzang go khrab mtshon cha'i rigs/ / 'a 'ur zang zing 'byor pa'i yo lang sogs/ / ya mtshan rmad byung spyan gzigs tshar du dngar/ / rwa gdengs g.yag rgod gdug pa'i gcan gzan dang / / la lung kun tu rgyu ba'i ri dwags tshogs/ / sha rgyas sru sdug rta nor ra lug sogs/ /sa chen yangs pa'i khyon kun bkang ste 'bul/ / ha tor hrī yis ma dag skyon sbyangs te/ / a bṛ tar byas bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor 'di/ / ha lo'i 'dab ltar yangs pa'i ljags brkyangs nas/ / a la la zhes dgyes pa chen pos rol/ / ka ma la dang dri zhim bdug pa'i spos/ / kha dog gsal 'tsher sgron me'i phreng ba dang / / ga bur dris bsgos dri chab zhal zas sogs/ / nga ro snyan pa'i rol mor bcas te 'bul/ / ca co glu len mdzes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur/ / cha lugs mdzes ldan lha yi bu mo rnams/ / ja chang phud kyi mchod yon sgreng byed na/ / nya rgyas zla ltar dwangs shing dgyes par mdzod/ ta la'i 'dab 'dra lha shug mkhan pa sogs/ / tha dad bsang shing sna tshogs dud pa'i 31

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/sprin/ / da lta nyid du mkha' dbyings khyab byed pa/ / na bun bzhin du gtibs pa'i bsang gis mchod/ / pa sangs ltar dkar lhag bsam bden stobs kyis/ / pha mtha' yas pa'i mchod sprin rab 'byams dang / / ba bla bdud rtsi'i btung ba gser skyems sogs/ / ma lus mchod pa'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig / tsa tur 'phrin las 'bar ba'i 'od stong gi / tsha zer phreng ba'i rgud pa'i mun pa bzlog / dza lang rab rgyas gdug pa'i dmag jag dang / / wa ltar 'jab pa rkun po'i nyer 'tshe bzlog / zhwa ser bstan dang bstan 'dzin yon mchod la/ / za ngan kha zhugs lha 'dre'i gnod pa bzlog / 'a 'ur 'khrug long nad yams mu ge sogs/ / ya nga dus kyi chad pa thams cad bzlog / ra hu la dang btsan bdud ma mo sogs/ / la 'ur srog la brgal ba'i gnod pa bzlog / sha za mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul byad phur sogs/ / sa steng mi dang mi min gyis bsgrubs pa/ / ha la'i dug 'dra gnod pa'i rigs bzlog ste/ / amṛ ta mtshungs dngos grub char du bsnyil/ / zhes bskang bshags bzlog pa rnams bya/ / dkar gtor zur du 'bul bar 'dod na/bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ 'od du zhu ba las lha'i zhal zas dri ro phun sum tshogs pa mchod yul rnams la bde dga' khyad par can bskyed pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/oṃ zu mi pā ti sa pa ri wā ra i rda ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum mam bdun sogs kyis dbul/ bstod bskul ni/ ka ma lar skyes rig 'dzin yongs kyis rje/ / kha ba can ljongs bstan pa'i dpal du gyur/ / ga na gnas kyang sde brgyad gdug pa'i tshogs/ / nga rgyal ri bo 'joms mdzad de yis skyongs/ / ca co'i glu len lha klu'i 'khor gyis bskor/ / cha shas kun tshang 'byor pa'i dpal gyis brjid/ / ja sogs mchod pa lhur len sbyin bdag 32

༄༅/ /gtor 'bu' bas nga /skor/rnams/ / nya gang zla bzhin rgyas mdzad khyod la bstod/ / ta thā ga ta'i bstan pa rin chen yang / / tha ma'i dus 'dir sri zhu la ltos phyir/ / da nas bzung ste yon bdag mi nor kun/ / na tsha la sogs nyer 'tshe kun las srungs/ /pa tra'i dbyibs mtshungs gya gyu'i zol sbyor sogs/ / pha rol bsam ngan 'chang ba'i dgra sde kun/ / ba dan 'phyar ba'i dmag dpung ru mtshon gyes/ / ma lus bcom ste rjes med rlung la bskur/ / rtswa shing lo 'bras smin pa sa yi bcud/ / tsha grang chu char snyoms pa nam mkha'i gshis/ / dza yas legs bsngags dge bcu'i spyod pa sogs/ / wa ler 'dzoms pa sde bzhi'i dga' ston spel/ / zhwa ser bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mdo dang sngags/ / za 'og dar gyi sham bu rim brtsegs shing / / 'a 'ur grags pa'i g.yer kha 'khrol ba yi/ / ya mtshan rmad byung kun dga' rgyas par mdzod/ / rwa gdengs rdo rje 'bar ba'i phyag rtags rgya/ / la lung sde brgyad kun gyi spyi bo'i gtsug / tha rjen ri mor bzhag pa'i g.yar dam bzhin/ / sa steng bstan dang yon mchod 'khor bcas skyongs/ / ha sa badzra bka' las ma 'da' bar/ / a yi yul gye dgon chen lha 'bangs bcas/ / ha lo'i 'dab ltar srid 'byor rab rgyas shing / / amṛ ta mtshungs chos spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ / yi ge brgya pa brjod cing / / ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / / zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ che ba'i che mchog ma sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /smras pa/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu chen lha/ / sdig dang ma 'dres bsang mchod kyis/ / brngan zhing dkar po'i las bcol ba/ / sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs su bsngags/ / de yi cho ga 'di bris pa'i/ / dge bas yul khams mi nor kun/ / phan bde'i dpal gyis rab mdzes shing / / sbyin pa'i pha rol 33

༄/ /gung ca bayo ཿ sa'i ga4 ཿma/phyin rdzogs shog / ces pa 'di ni sbyin pa'i bdag po stag ring gnam kho sogs kyis yul lha khyung rtse'i bsang mchod rgyas pa zhig dgos tshul nan cher bskul ba ltar/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /phun tshogs 'dod dgur 'char ba'i bde ba che/ / dag pa 'od gsal dbyings su 'gyu ba'i gar/ / mgron rnams ma lus dgyes byed mchod sprin dngos/ / grub par mchog gsum bden pas byin gyis rlobs/ / snang srid dregs pa'i khrod na mthu dang rtsal/ / mi dman lha chen mer ru blon 'khor bcas/ / bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i mgron du 'dir byon te/ / mchog tu rab dga' dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs/ / dkar mngar sbyar ba bza' bca' btung ba'i phud/ / gnag rta ra lug gcan gzan go mtshon tshogs/ / bsang shing sman sna bsregs pa'i bsang mchod bcas/ / mchod sprin rgya mtsho bstar ro dgyes par rol/ / ma tshang med pa'i mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'di/ / snga ma'i 'phren las bsgrubs pa'i gtang rag dang / / phyi ma'i legs sor 'bul lo bzhes mdzod la/ / chad mthud yo ba srong zhing brjed pa skul/ / rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud bla mas bka' bsgos bzhin/ / bstan la dga' ba'i dkar phyogs lha khyod kyis/ / bya ba'i 'khor lo gtsugs lag khang chen 'di'i/ / mthun rkyen gang dgos sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / 'gro 'dug spyod lam 'khrul ba ci byung yang / / ma yis bu bzhin bzod pas brtser dgongs te/ / phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe thams cad las/ / srung zhing skyob pa'i 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig / yul phyogs 'dir yang sad ser than pa sogs/ / mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i rgud pa'i smag bcom ste/ / phan bde'i nyin byed dgung nas gsal ba yis/ / dga' ba'i rkang drug glu dbyangs bzhad par mdzod/ / ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa zam tsha gser khri rin po che 34

༄/ / gtor 'atsal /nas 'di gar rgyal ba seng ge ling ro'i lha khang bzhengs rgyu'i don du mer ru'i nags nas shing cha len skabs/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru badzra dhir wa ya/ dkar gsum mngar gsum dri bzang sman spos sogs kyi bsang mchod dkar gtor dang bcas pa bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal la gnas pas/ kye bde chen chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ / bde legs kun stsol bla ma mchog gsum dang / / bdag sogs skyong ba'i yul lha gnyan po rnams/ / bdag gis spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / khyad par yul 'di chos srid dge mtshan gyis/ / khyab mdzad ba yan sā dag no mo hong / / thu khum tu thu thu mid cir ga lang thu/ / thams cad thogs med thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs/ / ma rtogs 'khrul bas nongs pa gang bgyis pa/ / ma lus snying nas bshags so bzod pa bzhes/ / mchod pa'i sprin phung ma tshang med pa 'dis/ / mchog gsum yul lha'i tshogs bcas dgyes gyur cig / dri med 'od 'bar rin chen snod yangs su/ / dri zhim ro bda' bzang btung sna tshogs dang / / bsang shingasman sna sna tshogs sbyar ba yi/ / bsang mchod rgya mtshos mchod do dgyes par rol/ / mi 'dod nyer 'tshe ming gi lhag mar mdzod/ / mi nor longs spyod ma lus gong du spel/ / tshe dpal snyan grags phun sum tshogs pa yi/ / tshad med dngos grub dga' ston tshang bar stsol/ /sad ser than pa la sogs rgud pa'i mun/ / sangs te bde skyid nyi ma dgung nas shar/ / rje 'bangs chos srid 'byor pa rdzogs ldan gyi/ / rjes 'gro chab srid mnga' thang dar bar mdzod/ / mdor na dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ / 'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyes grub pa dang / / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lung rtogs dam chos kyi/ / rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs gyur 35

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgonaryā khrung 4ma/cig / ces pa 'di ni pa ron su nyid shog nas dad gtong blo gros sogs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa tho yon rab gsal gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesabri4pa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lha chen dgra 'dul dbang po'i bsang mchod bya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis mchod gtor spyan gzigs sman sna dri bzang sbyar ba'i bsang mchod sogs 'du byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang /rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ kye/ pa tra nor bu'i rgyan spras gzhal med khang / / pha mtha' mi mngon 'byor pa'i sprin gtibs shing / / ba dan 'phyang 'phrul dar gyi lda ldi sogs/ / ma tshang med pas rab mdzes pho brang nas/ / pa sangs ltar dkar dgyes pa'i 'dzum ldan yang / /pha rol dgra sde 'joms pa'i drag shul can/ / ba rin gnas bdag dgra 'dul dbang po che/ / ma lus 'khor tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ / pa ra mi ta'i dbyings su spros bral yang / / pha rol mthong min nyes spyod nongs pa kun/ / ba mo'i zil ba nyi mas gdungs pa ltar/ / ma bcos rang bzhin dag pa'i ngang du bshags/ / pañtsa 'dod pa'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing / / pha mtha' yas pa'i mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'dis/ / ba rin gnas bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang / / ma lus 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrubs/ / pa ta ka sogs yid 'ong spyan gzigs dang / / pha lam rdo rje'i go mtshon 'bar ba yis/ / ba rin gnas bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang / / ma lus 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrubs/ / pa sangs ltar dkar cang shes rta dang lug / pha bong g.yag 'dra bajid pa'i gnag gi khyus/ / ba rin gnas bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang / / ma lus 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrubs/ / pa tra ltar 'khyil bsang shing dud pa'i 36

༄/ /gtor 'bu44 /sprin/ / pha rol nam mkha'i khyon kun 'gengs pa 'dis/ / ba rin gnas bdag chen po'i thugs dam bskang / / ma lus 'gal rkyen sel thing mthun rkyen sgrubs/ / pa da spyi bor bsten cing gus mchod na/ / pha ltar byams shing 'gal rkyen bzlog pa dang / / ba spu g.yo ba'i gdung shugs drag po yis/ /ma ltar brtse zhing zas nor longs spyod stsol/ / pa pa sangs ltar dkar gsal brjid pa'i sku/ / pha rol dgra sde'i snyems pa 'phrog pa'i gsung / ba rin ljongs 'dir lhag par brtse ba'i thugs/ / ma lus dngos grub gter chen khyod la bstod/ / pū dza bsang mchod rgya mtsho 'di bzhes te/ / phu mda' zas nor bcud kyis 'gengs pa dang / / bu rgyud tshe dpal mnga' thang snyan grags sogs/ / mu mtha' yas pa'i dge legs char du snyil/ / padma'i dga' tshal nyi mas phye ba bzhin/ / phan dang bde ba'i dge mtshan 'bum ba'ad cing / /bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs kun zhi nas/ / ma lus legs tshogs 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ce4ba rin gye gzhi bdag lha chen dgra 'dul dbang po'i gsol mchod bskang bshags bstod pa kun tshang ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dad ldan sbyin bdag a ke si na ji lngathus bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /hrī legs byas klong 'khyil phun tshogs 'byor pa'i rlabs/ /'bum 'gyed gzhal yas rang bzhin ri bo las/ / lha gnyan sku bla mched gsum yum sras blon/ / 'bangs 'khor 'bum bcas 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs/ / khyod thugs dgyes byed ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /gnag rta gcan gzan ri dwags ra dang lug / gser dngul dar zab go mtshon sna tshogs dang / / ja chang phud dang bsangs mchod rgya mtsho 'dis/ /mchod do bzhes la padma kā ra yi/ / bka' rtags rdo rje'i rgya las ma 'dang 37

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 4ma/bar/ / nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gye mel tshe dang / / dgra sde'i dpung 'joms gnyen gyi kha 'dzin mdzod/ / mdor na bdag can mi nor ltos bcas kun/ / gtad do gnyer ro lha gnyan 'khor dang bcas/ / dam bzhag dus la babs kyis dam ma dral/ / mthu rtsal dus la babs kyis mthu ma chung / /gzhi lam byes kyi 'jigs pa kun srung la/ / mthun rkyen tshe dpal stobs 'byor rigs rgyud sogs/ / legs tshogs ma lus 'dod dgur dpyid 'jo ba'i/ / bkra shis snye ma g.yur du za bar mdzod/ / ces sku bla gsol mchod mdor bsdus 'di yang rang gi dpon po mi sde bcas kyis bskul ngor/ chos smra ba dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes rma 'gram nas bris/ /na mo lo ke shā rā ya/ bsang rdzas rnams 'du byas la skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas bas bsang rdzas byin gyis brlabs te/kye/ dge legs 'dod dgu'i gru char 'jo ba yi/ / mchog gsum thugs rje'i chu 'dzin dkar po'i 'phreng / / srid zhi'i gdung ba sel ba'i grib bsil gyis/ / snod bcud brtan g.yo kun la byin phob cig / dge bcu'i dpal 'bar sa yi thig le mchog / mkho dgu'i 'byor ba rdzogs ldan sprin bzhin gtibs/ / nang du rin chen bye ba'i gzhal med khang / / nyi ma stong phrag 'od kyi rtse dga' 'gyed/ / de na yangs pa'i ljongs 'di skyong mdzad pa'i/ /lha yi dge bsnyen pa yan mud khe zhes/ / drag rtsal mthu dang ldan pa'i lha gnyan che/ / yum sras blon 'bangs tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs/ / de ring bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i mgron du 'bod/ / rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs su 'bod/ / dpal 'byor mnga' thang spel ba'i g.yang du 'bod/ / mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bskyed la 'dir gshegs shig / yid 'phrog blta na sdug pa mdzes pa'i gzugs/ / rna ba'i bdud ster 'jo ba snyan pa'i 38

༄/ / gtor 'tshal /sgra/ / sim byed mngar ba'i bsung zhing 'thul ba'i dri/ / lus zungs rgyas byed bza' bca' btung ba'i ro/ / 'jam mnyen bde ster lha rdzas reg byar bcas/ / 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod tshogs rgya mtsho dang / / gzhan yang gnag phyugs go mtshon nor 'bru sogs/ / spyan gzigs mchod sprin nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ / khyad par sman dang dri bzang mtha' yas pa/ /bsregs pa'i dud sprin baiḍūr mchod sdong ngam/ / dbyar skyes sprin sngon bzhin du gtibs pa yis/ / lha yi dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas bsang / / nyes pa kun sel bsang mchod bdud rtsi yis/ / rko rlog thab gzhob nyams chag mnol ba sogs/ / lha chen thugs dang 'gal bgyis nongs pa kun/ / sangs zhing dag nas bde dgas tshim gyur cib / sngang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs kyi dpung tshogs choms/ / mi dang phyugs kyi nad rims bar chad sol/ / sad ser than pa 'byung ba'i nyer 'dzeg zlog /min mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i ba dan phyor/ / zas nor longs spyod dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas/ / mnga' thang rigs rgyud yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /thub bstan bshad sgrub nyi ma'i 'od bzhin gsal/ / sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / mdor na rtsa rgyud bla ma'i bka' lung bzhin/ / nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe yis/ / bdag cag yon mchod kun gye grogs mdzad de/ / legs tshogs lhun gyes grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / ces a ba ga shog gi gzhi bdag chen po ba yan mur kha'i bsang mchod rdzogs ldan spren phung zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson blo gros kyi nor dang ldan pa tho yon gu shri blo bzang tshul khrims kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes khrus pa dge legs 'phel/ /na mo badzra lha ra wā ya/ bsang rdzas rnams 'du byas te/ rang lha'i nga 39

༄/ /༅ ca bstan pa'i sgronayo khrung 'bum/rgyal gyi gdengs dang ldan pas/ kye/ phul byung dge bcu'i lang tsho dar ba yi/ / yangs pa'i ljongs 'dir gnyug mar gnas 'cha' ba/ / lha klu gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas dang / / khyad par dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu bo che/ / lhun chags bkra shis pa yan o bo gā/ / tsanti man thu hon gor the khi cong / / bkra shis mu run chos gra o ba gā/ / cha gan man taka har gan thu'i tso dang / / un 'dur mun thu nom gan un 'dir bcas/ / un 'dur bo rā chu mig 'or ki khu/ / er den chog tsha er den tho lo ge / o chir chog tsha bur han thu gu la/ / ul cos tho hos na mug war tsang go'u/ / sha ra ha da sha ra tha la che/ / na ren bu lag un 'der yul cos thu/ / cha gang zhir ke ba yan ha ra dang / / a'i bag gol bom pa bkra shis gling / / sogs gnas bstan la dga' ba 'i yul lha rnams/ / ma thogs dam tshig dbang gis 'dir gshegs te/ / bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i mgron du brtan par bzhugs/ /yid 'ong mchod sprin bkod pa mtha' klas bas/ / sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon gang zhing / / khyad par bai drurya yi mchod sdong gi / rjes 'gro dri zhim spos kyi dud sprin 'dis/ / lha gnyan chen po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ / nyams chag nyes pa'i dri ma kun byang ste/ / phul byung dga' bde'i 'dab phreng bzhad pa'i dbus/ / yid kyi re ba'i 'bras bzang smin gyur cig / khyad par sad ser than pa mu ge dang / / nad yams 'khrug long la sogs rgud pa'i rigs/ / myur du zhi nas chos 'byor dga' ston gyi/ /rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i rtse dga' rgyas par mdzod/ / mdor na bdag cag mi nor ltos bcas kun/ / lha gnyan 'khor dang cas la gnyer gtad na/ /'gal rkyen kun zhi legs tshogs ma lus pa/ / dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ / ces ming gan phyogs kyi yul lha'i gsol mchod 'di'ang dge 40

༄/ / gtor rsālab4 /slong blo bzang brtson 'grus kyis bskul ngor/ / btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo badzra snyi ra wā ya/ de'ang bsang rdzas dngos gtsang zhing rgya che ba dang /dkar gsum gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma/ rnga sil sogs sta gon legs par byas/skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang skad cig gis lhar bskyed cing bsang rdzas byin gyes brlabs nas/ kye/ ka bi'i stag rtse rtse rgyal nag yu sogs/ / kha rje dbang thang dpal bskyed yul gyi lha/ / ga shed mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa kun/ / nga yis spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /ca co'i dbyangs dang rol mo 'brug ltar sgogs/ / cha shas kun rdzogs gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ / ja chang dkar gsum rgya mtsho ltar bskyil te/ / nya rgyas zla ltar dwangs pa'i yid kyis dbul/ / ta la'i 'dab 'dra lha shug sngon mo sogs/ / tha dad bsang shing sna tshogs dud pa'i sprin/ / da lta nyid du lha lam dgengs bzod pa/ / na bun sngon po'i phreng ltar gtibs te 'bul/ /pa sangs ltar dkar mche gtsigs rgya stag sogs/ / pha rol 'joms pa'i gcanagazan sna tshogs dang / / ba glang cang shes rta dang ra lug sogs/ /ma lus spyan gzigs tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang / / tsa tur 'byung 'khrugs gag lhog gnyan gzer dang / / tsha ba'i rims sogs nad rigs kun zhi zhing / / dza lang rab rgyas gdong lnga'i dbang po bzhin/ / wa skyes lta bu'i dgra las rgyal bar mdzod/ / zha ltar spyi bo'i gtsug tu khyod bkur zhing / / za 'og rgyal mtshan bzhin du khyod 'phyar na/ / 'a 'ur cho 'phrul sna tshogs da dung bcas/ / ya mtshan 'phrin las thogs med dus la bab/ / ra ba btsan pos bskor ba'i srog mkhar bzhin/ / la lung gang du nyer 'tshe mi 'byung zhing / / sha 'od rdol bzhin zas nor longs spyod tshogs/ / sa 'dir 41

༄/ /ca ca bstan yo sgoname'i gsung 4ma/rdzogs ldan kun dga' rgyas par mdzod/ / ha ri tsan dan ngad ldang bsang mchod dang / / a mṛ ta yi rang bzhin mchod gtor 'dis/ / lha gnyan 'khor bcas tshim zhing dgyes gyur te/ / 'dod don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces rong ru'i phyogs kyi yul lha'i bsang mchod cig dgos tshul mgo ba snying khar sogs kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru ratna tra yā ya/ bsang rdzas 'du byas te skyabs sems dang bsang mchod byin rlabs sngon du btang la/ hūṃ/ rgyal mtshan tog gi bsam 'phel nor bu bzhin/ / dge mtshan snang bar khyab mdzad bla ma lha/ / mchog gsum rgya mtshor bcas pa 'dir byon te/ / bsang mchod 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i byin stsol zhig / dge legs mchog sbyin 'jig rten skyong ba'i sde/ / lo zla zhag dus sa bdag tshes kyi lha/ / khyad par pho lha mo lha dgra lha dang / / pha mes rgyud kyi skyes lha yul gyi lha/ / zhing lha phyugs kyi lha dang thab lha sogs/ / 'go zhing sdongs grogs mdzad pa thams cad dang / / gzhan yang ljongs 'di'i g.ya' spang brag gi ri/ / nags tshal phreng ba gcong rong lam gyi srang / /dal 'bab klung dang chu mig lteng ka mtsho/ / ne'u gseng thang dang mkhar khyem phyugs lhas sogs/ / kun la gnas bcas lha klu btsan dang bdud/ /dregs pa'i sder bcas yul gye gzhi bdag kun/ / rlung gi shugs ltar myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ / bsang mchod rgya mtsho'i mgron du legs byon nas/ / mthor brtsegs rin chen khri dang gdan sogs la/ / rab dga' rgyas pas brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / mkho dgu'i spyan gzigs yid 'ong tshar du dngar/ / snyan 'gyur rol mos rna ba bdud rtsir sgrub/ / bsung zhim ngad kyis dri 'dzin sim pa bskyed/ / dkar mngar bza' bca' btung 42

༄/ /gos 'atsarya4 /ba'i ro brgya bda'/ / dar zab pañtsa li ga'i gos bzang sogs/ / rnam lnga 'dod pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa yis/ / mchog dman bar ma'i mgron rnams dbang po'i yul/ / kun dga' gsar ba'i lang tsho rgyas gyur cig / khyad par rta gdong me lce 'gem bzod pa'i/ / byin zar brgya phrag sman dang shing sna sogs/ / bsreg pa'i dud sprin 'dod dgur 'char ba yis/ / snang ba bde dgar bsgyur bas rol gyur cig / gtsang mar sbyar ba'i bsang gi dag byed 'dis/ / bag med spyod pas thab gzhob rgo rlogs sogs/ / mi gtsang grib dang nyams chag nyes pa kun/ dri bral shel gong bzhin du dag par mdzod/ / rang spyod mi dge'i rlung gis bus pa las/ / phyi rol nad bdag lto 'gro khros pa yi/ / dug rlangs gag lhog 'brum sogs mi phyugs kyi/ / nad rims nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ / phan bde 'phrog byed mi dang mi min gyi/ / gnod pas mi badzi 'phang mtho'i dpal gyi 'dab/ / mnga' thang tshe dpal phywa g.yang rgyas pa'i rtser/ / bag yod dge bcu'i ge sar bzhad par mdzod/ / gzhis su mi nor phyugs kyi bde skyid spel/ / byes su don 'grub snyan pa'i grags pa rgyas/ / lam du dgra srung mtha' chu'i sgol 'don sogs/ / nam yang mi g.yel rgyab brten sdongs grogs mdzod/ / mdor na bstan pa'i nyi ma dgung du gsal/ / lus can phan bde'i pad tshal 'bum du bzhad/ / dga' skyid rkang drug glu dbyangs 'khrol ba yi/ / dge mtshan bye bas nor 'dzin khyab gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni lhag bsam dang mkhyen dpyod phul du byung ba dkar po gshong bla ma dkon mchog 'azin las kyis dme shul sde ba'i don du 'di 'dra zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mtshag bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang du 'gro ba'i phyogs kyi 43

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i me'i gsung ཿma/yul lha la bsang mchod bya bar 'dod pas bsang rdzas dkar gtor rnams sta gon byas te/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ hrī jo ma kridwa na na hūṃ phaṭa/ masu bhā wa shuste sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo ྅rta/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che brnams kyi nang du gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ.ā hūṃ/ lan gsum/oṃhrī khyi sa bsangs/ oṃsu bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i sa phyogs yul rigs 'di dag skyong ba'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i bsang rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig sa phyogs yul rigs 'di dag skyong pa'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pūr snur sur sur ā brta ya ā brta ya ho badzra spar ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ su bhā wa bi shudhe dha dha rmā te badzra si rnyirtu/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shwa mu khe bhyasarba tad khaṃ ugo te spar ṇa hi mi ga na ga khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇi/ a tya nu drun na twa da/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te saṃ bha ra sa bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sidhi lo tsa ni sarba atpa sādha ni swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad kyi mtha' dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin pa gshegs pa bzhi'i thugs rje byen rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par 44
