༄/ / gtor 'atsal /dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyis ji skad brjod pa'i don thams cad de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang / / chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ / don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ / de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ / thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig / kye bswo/ khor yug yid 'ong sa 'dzin phreng bas bskor/ / rab rgyas rtsi bcud 'bras bu'i lang tsho dar/ / dge mtshan bcu ldan sa yi thig le mchog / bag phebs nyams su dga' ba'i yul ljongs 'di'i/ / brag ri spang ri gangs ri ri gdong dang / / nags tshal shing gcig lam srang ne'u gseng / / mtsho dang chu klung chu mig grong sogs la/ / rten bcas lha klu gnas gzhi'i bdag po rnams/ / ma thogs dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs/ / dga' ba'i bro gar chil le gnas 'dir gshegs/ / dar mdung ru mtshon pur re gnas 'dir gshegs/ / 'dir gshegs rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ / kye/ me chu shing spyod 'gro 'ong zhag mal sogs/ / spyod lam nyes pas khyed dang 'gal bgyis rnams/ / ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang du gyur lags na/ / khro med bzod pa chen po'i dbyings su bzhes/ / bgro/ khyed rnams dgyes byed yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin/ / dngos bshams yid sprul bden pa bdar ba las/ / 'od 'bar mdzes pa'i ru mtshon pu ru ru/ / sra mkhregs rdo rje'i go cha shigs se shig / rnga gshang dung gling rol mo ldi ri ri/ / bsang shing spos kye dud pa chi li li/ / rta mchog stong gi rta skad tse re re/ / 'brong g.yag zhol chen rwa kha zeng se zeng / / gcan gzan gdug pa'i ngar skad 'u ru ru/ / mkha' la 'dab chags zlos gar ling se ling /dkar mngar zas sna sna tshogs nyil li li/ / ja chang 'o ma'i rgya mtsho khyil li 45

༄/ /yo ca bas yotshonasa'i khrung 4ma/li/ / mkho dgu'i yo byad rnam mang su ru ru/ / glu dang gar mkhan lha yi bu mo sogs/ /khyed rnams thugs la phul byung dga' bde'i dpal/ / sbyin byed ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ / rnal 'byor phyogs nas 'ong pa'i skyes su 'bul/ / mgron gyi legs skyes mi dman 'di bzhes la/ / phyi thag srong ba'i gzhung bzang khyed rnams kyis/ / skyes lan ma nongs mgron gyi shangs len mdzod/ / mtha' chu 'jigs pa'i lam las bde bar sgrol/ / 'go nad dgra rkun gcan gzan lam dang bsnol/ / thog ser kha smras gyod sna dgra la bsgyur/ /brjed pa bskul zhing 'dod pa'i re ba skong / / khyad par yul lha yul mi'i sems la dbang / / de phyir khyed cag gang la dbang ba'i yul/ /kun kyang rgyal ba'i bstan la rab gus shing / / rnal 'byor bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ / mdor na de ring bdag cag mi nor kun/ / khyed la bcol lo gnyer ro bdag mdzod la/ / nag phyogs dgra la rgyal kha ma sbyin zhig / re ltos 'cha' ba'i skye bo ma bslu zhig / dbang chen dkyil 'khor dam tshig ma 'dral zhig / pad 'byung rdo rje'i bka' las ma 'da' zhig /khyed rnams mchod cing bskul ba 'bras ldan du/ / sgrub pa'i dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ / lan mang du bsngo na/ kye/ me chu shing / zhes pa nas 'di'i bar 'don/ oṃ/ 'chi med dpal ster rab dkar bdud rtsi'i chus/ / dbang bskur thigs phreng ji bzhin lan tshar g.yo/ / tshe mthar phyin pa'i yul lha rnams kyi mthus/ / phyogs 'dir tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog / stag shar dpa' bo dgra la chas pa'i zhal/ / dmar nag nyi zla'i sdang mig g.yo ba can/ / gnas skyong dgra lha gzhon nu'i gzi byin gyis/ / nag phyogs g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog / mu tig 'khri shing yang dag rgyu ba bzhin/ /yid 'ong 'jo sgeg lang tsho kun dga'i dpyid/ / lha klu'i na chung sman po'i 46

༄/ / garṣa 'bu ba4 /tshogs kyi mthus/ / ljongs 'dir bde skyid 'dzom pa'i bkra shis shog /gser gyi rgya phibs 'bar ba'i khang bzang sogs/ / rang snang gzhal yas bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i/ / dge mtshan des kyang sa gzhi bcud ldan zhing / /rtsi shing lo 'bras smin pa'i bkra shis shog / dbyar skyes sgra ldan lha yi char chen bzhin/ / shis brjod dbyangs dang 'brel ba'i bstod tsheg 'dis / khyed thugs 'o mtsho dgyes dgur 'phyur ba las/ / legs byas rlabs phreng phyogs brgyar g.yo bar mdzod/ / cesagang du 'gro ba'i phyogs kyi yul lha'i gsol mchod lha ngo mi ngo 'phrod pa'i dga' ston zhesabya ba 'di ni/ spyir deng sang yul dus kyi dbang las so so'i 'dod sbyar gyi bsang spyi sger mtha' yas pa zhig snang bas da gzod bri dbos pa mi 'dug kyang / gcig tu phyogs 'gro lta bur 'di 'dra re dgos pa byung tshe yi ge mang po zhig klag kyang la la 'brel med dang / / phal cher spyi khyab bam me ba zhig la sa shig thog mdzu gu ltar gnad thog tu khel nges shig mi yong 'dug pas de 'drar phan pa srid snyam nas btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes zab rgyas mang ngo/ ma bsres shing / ming gsal gyi rigs ngor te skabs don 'dril bar bkod pa'o/ /rgyal kun ye shes 'khor lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / gtum chen khro bo'i gar gyis bzhad pa'i lha/ / bla ma yi dam rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyes/ / legs byas 'dod dgu yongs grub mchog sbyin mdzod/ / 'bigs byed phyir yang bzhengs pa ma la ya'i/ / dpal gyes spud pa'i ngo mtshar las rgyal ba/ / sna tshogs rkang 'thung 'phreng 'khrigs rdo rje'i brag / mkha' la bsnyegs pa lta bu'i rang 'od bzhin/ / nang ltar mtshan ma'i 'ching ba zad pa'i dbyings/ / ye shes zhing la dbang 'byor 'ja' tshon ltar/ / bkra ba'i snang ba mi zad 'byor pa'i sde/ / 'dod dgur longs su spyod pa'i sems dpa' che/ / nyi ma'i gnyen gyi zhal bzang gser 'od rlabs/ / 'dren byed padma'i 47

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/bdud rtsir smin pa'i bcud/ / spangs rtogs mngar ba'i sbrang rtsi'i dpal 'bar yang / / gdengs can zol gyis srid pa'i 'dam la gnas/ / 'gro ba'i las nyon mtha' ltar thugs rje'i mthu/ / drag tu 'phyur ba'i mtshan ma bdud rtsi'i chab/ / 'gro kun nyer 'tshor che bas lha yul gyi/ / bdud rtsi'i khengs pa mtho yang phyogs rer bsnyil/ / dkyil 'khor bdag po'i bka' srung sngags kyi bdag / bro 'tshal skye bo'i gdung sel sman gyi lha/ / rnal 'byor rtogs pa'i bog 'byin grogs kyi mchog / bde chen snying rje'i rol pa 'bum gyis rtsen/ / zad mi shes pa gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gyi/ / cha tsam spel pa'i bstod tshig ma li kha'i/ / 'phreng 'di dgyes pa'i thugs kyis legs bzhes te/ / nam yang mi g.yel thugs rjes dgongs par mdzod / / khyab bdag bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i bden tshig gis/ / gsol mchod 'phrin las gnyer du gtad pa bzhin/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin bdag cag yon mchod kun/ / rtag tu bsrung zhing skyong ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rigs kun zhi nas/ / mtho ris yon tan dpal 'byor mi nyams shing / / yang dag lam bzang bde blag bgrod pa yis/ / rnam kun mkhyen pa'i sa la reg gyur cig / ces kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sman chu'i lha mo'i gsol mchod byin rlabayokyi gter chen po dang 'brel bar 'don rgyu'i bstod tshig 'dod gsol dang bcas pa 'di ni/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gnas de nyid du bris pa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bsang rdzas gya nom pa dkar gtor sogs bshams te/ lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byen gyiyobarlab4la/bswo/ rtsa ba rab brtan khor yug brjid chags yangs/ / rtse mo mtho ba nyi zla'i rna lung can/ / rdza dmar khes chags mthon po la gnas pa'i/ / dkar 48

༄/ /gakho 'tshal4 /phyogs skyong ba'i lha gnyan mthu bo che/ / yum sras blon 'bangs bcas pa thams cad dang / / gzhan yang sde 'dir 'go zhing srung skyob pa'i/ / phyogs 'di'i lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba kun/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig / bswo/ sprin bral mkha' la gsal ba'i 'ja' tshon bzhin/ / rnal 'byor mos pa'i rol pa las byung ba'i/ / ngo mtshar mchod sprin ma tshang med pa 'dis/ / kun yid dga' bde'i sim pa thob gyur cig / ja chang dkar gsum btung ba mtsho ltar bskyil/ / ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas ri ltar srungs/ / go khrab ru mtshon snyan brjid rol mo'i tshogs/ /rkang 'gro rin chen nor 'bru'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ / khyad par dri zhim bsang shing sna tshogs pa/ / rab 'bar me lha'i zhal du bstab pa yi/ / dud sprin baiḍūrya yi mchod sdong bzhin/ / mkha' dbyings khyab par bsung zhim spro ba 'dis/ / bsang ngo bla ma yi dam mchog gsum bsangs/ / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu ma lus bsangs/ / khyad par khes chag mthon po 'khor bcas bsangs/ / nyams chag ma lus bsang gis dag gyur cig / bsang mchod rgya chen 'di yis dgyes mdzod la/ / bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ / nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe yis/ / bsrung zhing skyong ba'i 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig / mi nad phyugs nad thams cad phyir bzlog cig / dgra jag chom rkun tshogs kyi dpung chom la/ / zas nor longs spyod chos srid dpal 'byor kun/ / phun sum tshogs pa'i sdong grogs ma g.yel zhig / mdor na rtsa brgyud bla mas bka' bsgos bzhin/ / tshul ba'in bsten pa'i rnal 'byor yon mchod kun/ / rtag tu srung skyob g.yel med 'phrin las kyis/ / rdzogs ldan kun dga'i dpal la 'god par mdzod/ /ces ltaganyan khes chag mthon po'i bsang mchod 'di ni/ ha rol chin sde ba spyi'i don 49

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgronamatha ga4 4ma /du de ga'i dka' ram rnams kyis bskul ngor/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /phun tshogs dge bcu'i dpal yon 'bum/ / bzhad pa'i nor 'dzin thig le mchog / ba yan o lān o bo ga / la sogs yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ / lha klu gnyan po 'khor dang bcas/ / bsang mchod mgron du 'dir gshegs shing / / rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ / ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rol ba las/ / byung ba'i yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin/ / nam mkha'i khyon kun 'gengs pa dang / / khyad par bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs/ / sna tshogs bsang shing dud pa'i sprin/ / dbang po kun la bde ba'i dpal/ /sprun byed mchod pa'i sprin phung 'dis/ / lha gnyan 'khor bcas dgyes gyur cig / bsam sbyor 'khrul ba'i nongs pa yi/ / nyams chag nyes pa byang gyur cig / bdag cag dpon slob mi nor kun/ / bcol lo gnyer ro bdag mdzod la/ / phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad kun/ / skad cig nyid la zhi ba dang / / tshe dpal bsod nams mnga' thang dang / / rigs rgyud snyan pa'i grags pa sogs/ / chos srid dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ / dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dar/ /bstan 'dzin kun gyi bzhed don 'grub/ / sbyin pa'i bdag po'i dpal 'byor rgyas/ / rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod gyur cig / ces pa 'di'ang dar han bee li'i shog nas rnam dpyod yangs pa dem chis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal yum 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug mas/ / rje btsun bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / dge 'dun sde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing / /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / bdag cag dpon slob 50

༄ / /gtor shā pas krisaskor/dam chos sgrub pa la/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe gang yang mi 'byung zhing / rgyal rnams dgyes byed sgo gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ / smon pa bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / mdor na dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /rnam dag lam bzang sgrub pa'i srung ma'i gtso/ / khyod min ga'an na med pas brtser dgongs te/ / nam yang g.yel med bu ba'in skyong bar mdzod/ /dam can skyes bu chen po'i gtor chog khrag zhag ma'i kha skong ni/ ting nge 'dzin dang sngags rgya'i rol pa las/ / byung ba'i mchod yon nam mkha'i khams gang ba/ / dam can skyes bu 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / oṃ badzra sā gyo sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swā hā/ mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil nas reg bye bar dang /arnya gyi gnasasu pākyi nas spa rsha'i bar bcug ste dbul/ nang mchod ni/ dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ ā hūṃ/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ ā rtu/ bka' gter rigs gtad brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā rtu/ yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs rnamasakyi zhal du oṃ ā :/ dam can skyes bu chen po 'khor dang bcas ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ zhes pa rnams mngon rtogs kyi mjug tu sbyor/bskang ba'i mjug tu bskul ba bya ba ni/ dpal ldan gsang ba sngags kyi bka' srung che/ / rnal 'byor dgra lha dam can rdo rje legs/ / dgyes sde bstan ma bcu gnyis gang chen bzhi/ / btsan 'khor dge bsnyen sum brgya drug cu dang / / ma sangs spun dgu zu ra skyes drug sogs/ / ru 'dren las byed sprul pa yang sprul gyi/ / gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa kun/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrub phyir dgongs su gsol/ / rigs kun bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen nas/ / rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma rim byon gyes/ /51

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronace gsung 'bumarigs gtad byin rlabs rdo rje'i dam tshig gis/ / rigs sngags 'chang ba'i srung mar bskos pa bzhin/ / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod dgon gnas bcas/ / kun gyi srung ma'i gtso bo khyod bsten na/ / 'gyur med rdo rje'i g.yar dam nyer dgongs te/ / gang bcol 'phrin las sgrub la ma g.yel cig / nad rims gdon bgegs gdug pa'i cho 'phrul dang / / kha smras gleng gzhi nyer 'tshe pha rol gyi/ / bsam sbyor ngan pa'i byad kha phur kha sogs/ / gnod pa mtha' dag bzlog cing bsgyur bar mdzod/ / dge 'dun thugs mthun tshul khrims rnam par dag / mdo sngags bshad sgrub yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ / chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor rab rgyas te/ / blo bzang bstan pa'i dpal du 'gyur bar mdzod/ / khyad par bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i gnyen gcig pu/ / skyabs mgon dam pa'i zhabs brtan 'phrin las rgyas/ / ljongs 'dir chos srid legs tshogs dar ba yis/ / rdzogs ldan dpal gyi dge legs sbyin par mdzod/ / nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe yis/ / nam yang g.yel med bu bzhin skyong mdzad de/ / re ba'i 'bras bu ji ltar gsol ba kun/ / sgon pa bzhin du 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /tshe thar gtong tshul ni/ sha rgyas spu sdug g.yu yi rwa bzhi can/ / dgra la 'jigs pa'i skad dang bsdigs sgra ston/ / myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis stong gsum bskor/ / gser gyi ag tshom mdzes pa'i rwa skyes 'di/ /dam can skyes bu chen po'i rten du 'bul/ / yum sras blon 'bangs 'khor bcas rten du 'bul/ / rten las ma 'da' 'ben las ma g.yos par/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob srung zhing skyong bar mdzod/ / 'phyar ba tsam gyis dam nyams dgra yi thod/ / glad pa khrag bcas 'phyur byed tho ba dang / / dgra sde'i yul 'khor dkrug cing 'thor byed pa'i/ / rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khyug 52

༄/ /gtor 'tshil /pa'i spud pa 'di/ / dam can skyes bu chen po'i rten du 'bul/ / zhes pa nas/skyong bar mdzod/ nyin byed 'od la 'khu ba'i bso thebs dang / char sprin gtibs 'dra'i dar nag 'jol ber sogs/ / bstan dgra 'joms shing rnal 'byor skyong byed pa'i/ / nyer spyad go mtshon ma tshang med pa 'di/ / dam can skyes bu chen po'i rten du 'bul/ nas/ rnal 'byor dpon slob srung zhing skyong bar mdzod/ / ces pa 'di ni hal ha khu re chen mo nas lhag bsam rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa bka' bcu ngag dbang blo bzang gis rang gis grwa tshang du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i dam can gyi gtor chog 'don bzhin pa de la kha skong 'di rnams dgos zhes bskul ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brisapa'o/ /53

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / rma rgyal spom ra'i g.yang 'bod phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / sa brgyad dbang phyug sems dpa' che/ / srid pa chags pa'i lha chen tshul/ / rma rgyal sgom ra'i gzi byin gyis/ / 'dod dgu'i phywa g.yang char du snyil/ de'ang rma chen spom ra'i g.yang 'bod bya bar 'dod pas gza' skar tshes grangs dge bar de'i bris sku bshams la/ mdun du phying dkar gye steng du phywa ga'i ras dkar la gangs ri chen po mthar gangs phran gyis bskor ba'i lte bar padma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i steng du g.yang bre 'bru dang rin po ches bkang ba'i khar g.yang rten gyi gtor ma mngar gsum bsres pa'i thud dam/ mar las bcos pa dbyibs blum po nyi zla dang nor bu 'bar bas brgyan pa rin po che'i snod du bshams shing / mtha' skor mar gyi ril bus bkang / dkar gtor/ phye mar/ chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham/ 'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs kyi tsa ka li/ / mda' rgod g.yu dang me long gis brgyan pa dar tshon can/ zas sna/ go mtshon/ gos dar sogs spyan gzigs legs par bshams/ bdag skyed dang rma chen gyi bskang bshags bstod pa'i sar gzhung bzhin byas la bsang dud cher btang ste/a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las bsang mchod dam rdzas spyan gzigs g.yang rten gyi rdzas rnams lha gnyan chen po 'khor bcas dgyes par 54

ra / / 'ipa ngang 'bongasabyed cing / sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dpal rgyas par byed pa bkra bis dang dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sazi bid snu ra snu ra su ra su ra a btwa ya ho badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / zhes pa nas/ thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig / kye bas 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba na/ / mdo smad yul gyi gong ba na/ / nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na/ / gangs dkar shel gyi mchod rten yod/ / rtsa ba dbang chen ga'i la zug / rtse mo nyi zla'i mthongs la bsnyegs/ / sked na char sprin ling ling g.yo/ / gangs phran sum brgya drug cus bskor/ / de na rma rgyal spom ra bzhugs/ / de na yum chen gung sman bzhugs/ / de na sras po mched dgu bzhugs / / de na sras mo srun dgu bzhugs/ / de na gnyan chen sde ba'i bzhugs/ / rma rigs sum brgya drug cu bzhugs/ / bka' 'khor lha gnyan thams cad bzhugs/ / 'brog gnas rma rgyal spom ra che/ / de ring gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no/ / steng na g.yu 'brug gsung snyan sgrogs/ / 'dab chags gcan gzan rol tu khrid/ / brdzid pa'i gar stabs lings se lings/ / yon mchod g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / yum chen gung sman lha ri yang / / de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / dpa' ba'i sras po mched dgu yang / / de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / mdzangs pa'i sras mo spun dgu yang / / de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ bka' nyan gnyan chen sde ba'i yang / / de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / pho nya mngag gzhug thams cad kyang / / de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / shar phyogs rgyal mo tshe brtan ma/ /de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / lho phyogs g.yang lha 'brug rgyal ma/ / de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ nub phyogs g.yang lha phan byed ma/ de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / byang phyogs g.yang lha tshe 'dzin ma/ / de ring g.yang gi lha ru 55

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i g.yo ཿma/byon/ / gzhan yang mdo smad yul phyogs na/ / srid gsum sde dpon dgra lha che/ / bka' dang 'khor du gtogs pa kun/ / de ring g.yang gi lha ru byon/ / dar zab rin chen khri la bzhugs/ / yid 'ong mchod pa'i tshogs 'di bzhes/ / rab dgyes 'dzum pa'i zhal bstan nas/ / phywa g.yang 'bebs pa'i grogs mdzod cig / de nas a kā ros bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phywa g.yang 'gug pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'gong po mi ma yin gyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig gis 'dir bkug par gyur/ oṃ sadru bigyun nam sazo ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum/ oṃ susta ni sustanyu sogs lan gsum brjod de bsngos la/na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gye bden pa dang / khyad par du bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin gyes brlabs pa la brten nas bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas phywa g.yang 'gug pa la bar dugacod pa'i 'gong bo mi ma yin gyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad mchod spyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyes la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spongs la/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su songs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo'i ye shes kyirdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis bsregs shing rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za'o/ sum bha ni'i sngags brjod de bgegs bskrad/ de nas mda' dar g.yab cing / phywa khu ye/ / 'brog gnas lha yi dge bsnyen che/ / yum sras blon dang bka' 'khor kun/ / rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas 56

༄/ /margyalasanga'igar 'bogal/ / phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grul stsol/ / zas nor longs spyod stan grags sogs/ / dar zhing rgyas pa'i g.yang phob cig / phywa 'bobs de ni ma chung zhig / g.yang 'bebs de ni ma zhan cig / phun tshogs 'dod gu'i phywa dang g.yang / / dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du bsdus/ / phywa 'di ma pham khu ye gsungs/ /g.yang 'di ma nyams khu ye gsungs/ / dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len/ / yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol/ / phywa khu ye / dad brtson shes rab rmad byung ba/ / dkar po chos kyi g.yang phob cig / tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan pa/ / sprug po srid kyi g.yang phob cig / gzugs bzang blo gsal ngag snyan pa/ gtsang ma rigs kyi g.yang phob cig /mdzangs shing brtan la gzhung bzang ba/ / mthun pa'i grogs kyi g.yang phob cig / kun stoms byams shing brjid chags pa/ / mnga' bdag rje yi g.yang phob cig / khrel yod drang zhing mthu ldan pa/ mngag gzhug bran gye g.yang phob cig / nyer 'tshe med cing bag pheb pa/ / dga' ba'i yul gyi g.yang phob cig / mi zad gong du 'phel ba yi/ / dpal 'byor nor gyi g.yang phob cig / sha rgyas sru sdug 'gros bzang ba/ / gyi ling rta yi g.yang phob cig / stobs ldan 'o ma'i rgyud 'dzin pa/ / 'bri phyugs gnag gi g.yang phob cig / dog mo sa yi steng 'gengs pa/ / g.yang dkar lug gi g.yang phob cig / ro bcud ldan zhing bde ster ba/ / 'im mngar zas kyi g.yang phob cig / 'phral yun dge zhing bsam pa bzhin/ / 'grub pa'i las kyi g.yang po phob cig / sa steng kun tu khyab pa yi/ / mnga' thang man grags g.yang phob cig / phywa khu ye/ 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs g.yang gi lha/ / 'brog gnas rma rgyal spom ra yis/ / nyam chag byur gyi 'phrod chod la/ / phywa dang g.yang gi sgo phye ste/ / khyim la g.yang 'phel mi yis gang / / sgo 57

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sgron ཿ khrung ཿma/na g.yang 'phel phyugs kyis gang / / mdzod la g.yang 'phel nor gyis gang / / tshe la g.yang 'phel lo brgya 'tsho/ / de ring hu ye hu ldan no/ / de ring phywa ye phywa ldan no/ / phywa du ye/ 'dod dgu'i char 'brebs g.yang gi lha/ / yum chen gung sman lha ri yis / / nyam chag byung gyi ྾ / phywa dang g.yang gi ྾ / khyim la g.yang 'phel nga / sgo na g.yang 'phel nga / mdzod la g.yang 'phel nga / tshe la g.yag 'phel nga / de ring hu ye nga / de ring phywa ye ma / /phywa khu ye/ 'dod dgu'i nga / dpa' ba'i sras po mched dgu yis/ / nyam chag ྾ / phywa dang ྾ / khyim la ྾ / sgo na nga / mdzod la ྾ / tshe la ྾ / de ring hu nga / de ring phywa ྾/ / phywa khu ye/ 'dod dgu'i nga / mdzangs pa'i sras mo mched dgu yis/ / nyams chag ྾ / phywa dang ྾ / khyim la ྾ / sgo na g.yang ma / mdzod la ྾ / tshe la ྾ / de ring hu ra / / de ring snya ma / phywa khu ye/ 'dod dgu'i ྾ / / bka' nyan gnyan chen sde bzhi yis/ / nyam chagam / phywa dang nga / khyim nga / sgo ma / mdzod ma / tshe nga / de ring ma / de ring sbya ra / phywa khu ye/ 'dod dgu'i ྾ / pho nya mngag gzhug thams cad kyis/ / nyam chag sa / snya nga / khyim ma / sgom / mdzod ma / tshem / de ring hu nga / de ring sbya ra / / phywa khu ye/ bkra shis nyi ma de ring nas/ / yon gye bdag po 'khor dang bcas/ / lus la nad med gzi byin rgyas/ / sems la dga' bde'i snang bas khyab/ / bang mdzod rin chen nor gyis gang / / yul khams sde dang phyugs kyis khyab/ / grags snyan 'brug gi sgra bzhin sgogs/ /las rlung dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas/ / phun tshogs phywa dang g.yang gi tshogs/ / gang bsam dngos grub char ba'in phobs/ / mi nub g.yang gi rgyal mtshan tshugs/ / mi 'gyur g.yung drung brtan par mdzod/ / mi zad g.yang gi rgya mtsho skyil/ / phywa g.yang mi nyams srung ma mdzod/ / g.yang gi rten 58

༄/ /margyalasgomara'igashang 'bogaphur ma 'don cig / g.yang gi rwa ba ma stongs shig / g.yang gi dmu dag ma gcod cig / g.yang gi mtsho mo ma skems shig / g.yang sgo srung ba'i srung ma mdzod/ / phywa g.yang bskyil ba'i gnyer kha mdzod/ / mnga' thang dar ba'i dgra lha mdzod/ / nam yang mi 'bral dpung gnyen mdzod/ kye dgra lha yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ / khyed la g.yang rten 'dzug pa ni/ / myur mgyogs 'dzam gling yud kyis bskor/ / rnga rngog dar gyi cod paṇa can/ / cang shes sprin gyi shugs can 'di/ / de ring khyed la rten du 'dzug / 'di la khyed kyis g.yang rten mdzod/ / phywa g.yang nyams pa med pa dang / / gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ / rta yi lha ni bres po yin/ / des kyang rta g.yang gong du spel/ /kye dgra lha ྾/ khyed la ma/ 'jigs pa'i brag ri g.yo ba ba'in / ngar sgra sgrogs pas sa chen 'dar/ / rwa gdengs brjid pa'i zhol g.yag 'di/ /de rings/ 'di lam/ phywa g.yang ྾/ gong nas gong dus/ / g.yag gi lha ni dung pho yon/ / des kyang g.yag g.yang gong du spel/ / kye dgra lho / khyed lang/ mi zad 'o ma'i rgyud 'dzin cing / / spu sdug dbyar gyi chang sprin bzhin/ / sa steng mdzes byed zhol mo'i tshogs/ / de ring sa/ 'di la ma/phywa g.yang sa/ gong nas ma/ 'bri yi lha ni sham po yin/ / des kyang 'bri g.yangagong du spel/ / kye dgra lha ma/ khyed la ma/ 'jam pa'i spu sdug gos gyon zhing / / rwa bzhi 'khyil ba'i lha lug dang / / ag tshom mdzes pa'i lha ra 'di/ / de ring ma/ 'di la ma/ phywa g.yang ྾/ gong nas ma/ lug gi lha ni men bu yin/ / des kyang lug g.yang gong du spel/ / kyi dgra lha ma/ khyed la྾/ mdung ring dar gyi ba dan can/ / rno ngar dpal dang ldan pa sogs/ / dpa' bo'i ru mtshon 'di dag kyang / de ring sa/ 'di la nga/59

༄/ /gung thang bayo rsā sgroname'i khrung 'bum/phywa g.yang ma/ gong nas ma/ / kye dgra lha 'i/ khyed la ma/ snyug rgod tshigs pa dgu ba la/ / bya rgyal rgod po'i sgro yis brgyan/ / dar tshon me long dang bcas pa/ / de ring ྾/ 'di la ྾/ phywa g.yang ma/ gong nas nga/ / kyai dgra lha sa/ khyed la nga/ dkar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bskyil/ / mngar gsum 'brang rgyas ri ltar srungs/ / dri zhim bsang mchod sprin ltar gtibs/ / de ring khyed la rten du 'dzug / 'di la khyed kyi g.yang rten mdzod/ / phywa g.yang nyams pa med pa dang / / gong nas gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ / mdor na lha chen dgyes byed pa'i/ / rten rdzas g.yang rdzas tshang bar bsags/ / go mtshon spyan gzigs tshar du dngar/ / gus pas mchod cing gsol 'debs na/ / phywa dang g.yang gi dpal skyobs shig / mnga' thang rigs rgyud dar bar mdzod/ / tshe bsod bkrag mdangs 'phel ba dang / / mi mthun g.yul las rgyal par mdzod/ / kye srid pa'i lha chen 'khor bcas kyis/ / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kun/ / gzhis su sdod na yul lha mdzod/ / byes su 'gro na lam lha mdzod/ / g.yul du chas na dgra lha mdzod/ / rnyed pa tshol na nor lha mdzod/ / nyin gsum dus su bya ra mdzod/ / mtshan gsum dus su mel tshe mdzod/ / mi dang phyugs kyi nad yams chod/ / chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor spel/ / gsol lo mchod do lha gnyan che/ / ma g.yel ma g.yel srung ma'i gtso/ / rtsa rgyud bla ma'i g.yar dam bzhin/ / gang bcol las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs/ / 'dod don chos bzhin 'grub pa yi/ / bkra shis rgya mtshos khyab par mdzod/ / de nas gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o/smras pa/ lha chen thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ / dngos grub gru char 'jo ba yis/ / phywa g.yang rtsi bcud rab rgyas te/ / lus can bde dgas tshim gyur 60

༄/ / margyalasgomara'igashang 'bogacig / ces rma rgyal spom ra'i gsang 'bod phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i rol ma tsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gong sa mchog gi zhabs sdod du brtson ldan pa ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis bskul ngo / 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes g.yang 'bod kyi yig rnying sna tshogs 'dug pa las legs pa'i cha rnams bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'dis kung 'jig rten kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /oṃ su ste/ thub bstan 'dzin mar skal bzang zhing pa'i tshogs/ /phan bde lo tog longs su spyod pa'i phyir/ / bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chos grwa las/ / chos sbyin bdud rtsi'i gru char 'di phab bo/ /61

༄/ /༅ thang bstan pa'i sgron ཿ gsung 'bum/༄༅/ / lha gnyan chen po sngo la g.yu rtse'i gsol mchod rgyas pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄༅/ / baiḍūr sprin sngon 'khrigs pa ma he'i zhal/ / rab 'bar spyan gsum g.yo ba'i glog dmar 'od/ / dgra 'joms lta stangs thog gi zer ma can/ / khro bo gshin rje'i gshed pos dge legs stsol/ / ri klung nags tshal chu dang thang sogs la/ / rten bcas dkar phyogs 'jig rten skyong ba'i sde/ / mchod bstod bsten cing 'phrin las bcol ba yang / / sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog tu gsungs/ / blo gros ma la yar skyes dga' tshal du/ /legs bshad tsardon nags klung 'khrigs pa'i gseb/ / sna tshogs me tog phreng ba bzhad pa yang / / don gnyer rkang drug gzhon nu'i dga' ston yin/ / de'ang mdo smad sa yi thig ler rgyu ba'i snang srid dregs pa'i khrod na mthu rtsal nus pa'i dpung gis mngon par mtho ba/ 'brog gnas kyi sde dpon chen po gnyan rje sngo la g.yu rtse'i sgrub 'phrin rgyas pa nyams su bstar bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/dang por mchod rdzas spyan gzigs dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i mchod gtor dang bsang rdzas rgya che zhing dngos gtsang ba/ tshe thar byed rgyu'i rta g.yag ra lug sogs la mdzes pa'i dar gyi chun 'phyang btags pa rnams sta gon byas te/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la 'jigs byed sogs kyi bdag skyed rgyas bsdus gang rung byas/ rol cha bkram zhing bsang dud cher btang ste/ bsang rdzas rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/62

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/phaṭa/ phyag rgya ni/ lag pa'i sor mo phan tshun bsnol la gung mo gnyis rtse sprad nas bcag ste dal bar bcing ngo / / 'dod pa sgrub pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṭwāṃ arya nud pan na twad/ phyag rgya ni/ g.yas khro bo'i khu tshur bcing ste bsgrengs 'a mchod rdzas rnams la se gol gdab cing dgrol bar bya'o/ /thams cad kyis thob pa'i sngags ni/ nam sadru ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ salha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ phyag rgya ni g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yas mchog sbyin bya'o/ / mnyam por thob par byed pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru sru ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba atpa sā dha ni swāhā/ phyag rgya ni g.yas mi 'jigs pa bya'o/ / bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ / zhes sogs kyis bden stobs brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha sadra dha rmā su bhā wa shusgo ྅ haṃ/stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du ri bo mardo ra dang gser kyi bya skyibs la sogs pa'i snyems pa 'phrog par byed pa'i rab 'jigs brag gi ri bo rtse mo mtho zhing gzeng bas kun gsal dbyings su snyegs shing /rtsa ba brtan cing brjid pas nor 'dzin rnam par gnon pa/ steng na chu 'dzin stug po'i bla bre bres shing glog phran 'gyu ba'i gser gyi do shal 'phyang pa/snyan cing brjid pa'i dbyar rnga phyogs brgyar rgod cing / sbrang char dal gyis 'bebs pa'i rtsa bar nags klung stug po'i khrod na rgya stag ri khra sogs gcan zan gdug pa du mas dar skad sgogs pa / phyi rol sa 'dzin dbang po'i rnam pa can gyi nang du rin chen bye ba'i khams las grub pa'i pho brang chen po khor yug lcags ri'i rwa bas bskor zhing bang rim du mas mdzes pa'i rtse mor gser g.yu'i rgya phebs tshar du dngar ba/ de'i dbus su 'jigs pa'i bskal ba ston pa'i rlung dmar 'tshub pa'i shugs la mdo ba'i rta mchog kham pa nyi ma'i 'od la 'khu ba'i gser gyi sga srab sprad pa'i steng du srid pa'i lha gnyan chen po 64

ra 3/ / bsnga zungabagyi'isngo la g.yu rtse mdog dmar spug me 'od 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas srid gsum dpal 'byor 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang / ga yon na 'dod dgu'i dngos grub ster ba'i nor bu bsnams pa/ sku la stag thul dang g.yu khab dbu la bse'i rmog gzhu gsol zhing mchan khung g.yon na ngar mdung bsgreng ba/rked par rno ngar ldan pa'i gnam lcags kyi mdang dang / sra zhing mkhyegs pa'i gnam ru can gyi stag ral gzig shubs bcing ba/ de'i g.yas su lum gnyan ma ma le gu dkar gsal mdzes pa'i nyams dang ldan 'ing mda' dar dnganor gzhong bzung nas shwa ba yu mo la chibs pa/ g.yon na gnyan sras thor ri rgyal ba sku mdog dkar dmar dar mdung dang 'gas pa bzung nas g.yu 'brug sngon mo la chibs pa/ gzhan yang dregs rtsal myur mgyogs can gyi stag shar dpa' bo'i sras dang / mtshar sdug lang tsho can gye lha sman sras mo du mas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol tu bkra shis lha brag dkar po/ grogs byed mgo dkar mgo sngon sdong grogs zal dkar gnyan po/ ma thu dpung spos ri blum po/ ngar 'dzin skyes ri mthon po/ dmag bskul gnyan rje gong sngon/ gnyan dmag skya brgya long ba gtum drag rngam 'ing brjid pa'i 'khor tshogs 'bum gyis bskor bar gyur/ rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros / gar bzhugs sprul ba'i pho brang chen po nas lha gnyan 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs badzra i ku shadza gnyis su med par gyur/ kye rgya mtshos sked bcings nor 'dzin thig le mchog / gangs ris yongs bskor pur rgyal bod kyi byang / / bkra shis dge mtshan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i phyogs/ / dge bcu'i lang tsho dar ba'i yul gyi ljongs/ / lhun stug brag gi ri bo'i mgul ba nas/ / rab dkar chu 'dzin glog gi rol gar can/ / glal ba'i nga ro gsang 65

༄/ /gung ca bayo rsā sgroname'i ཿnga 4ma/ mthor sgrog pa'i klong / / rta mchog kham pa g.yu 'brug rgya stag dang / / shwa ba yu mo 'brong g.yag lce spyang sogs/ / sna tshogs bzhon pa'i steng na rab 'gying zhing / /'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul dpag med ston pa yi/ / lha gnyan chen po yumasras ming sring dang / / bka' yi las byed phyi nang blon po'i tshogs/ /dgra sde gzhom pa'i dmag gi dpung dang bcas/ / ma thogs ring ba'i tshul gyis 'dir byon te/ / rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /hrī snang srid dregs ldan yongs kyi rang rtsal la/ / bde stong ting 'dzin re khas rgyas btang ba/ / rig 'dzin grub dbang padma kā ra dang / / dbyer med blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bka'/ / gzhom med rdo rje'i gdangs su bsgrags pa yi/ / dam tshig gnyan po khas blangs dran mdzod la/ / bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba'i phyir/ / g.yel med bya ra mdzod cig sa ma ya/ / zhes spyan drangs te dam la bzhag de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ lha chen thugs la dgyes pa skyed byed pa/ / sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon gang ba'i/ / yid 'ong mchod yon tshar du dngar ba 'di/ / gus pas 'bul lo dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol/ / oṃ zu mi pa te sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tī tstsha sruhwa/de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog bdug spos sgron me dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs dang / arnya gyi gnas su puṣpe 〈pe ā lo ke gan dhe dzee wirgya shabha rnams bcug la 'bul/ de nas yig brgya nyer gcig bzlas la/ bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūṃ/ bla ma mchog gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas pa thams cad dang / / lha gnyan chen po gsang yum lcam sras tshogs/ / las byed pho nya dang bcas dgongs su gsol/ /nyes kun rtsa ba rang sems gdon gyi 'phrul/ / ma rtogs bdag tu 'dzin pa'i kha 'dzin gyis/ / sgo gsum 'khrul ba'i sbyod pa gang bgyis pa/ / mtha' dag 66

sa / //sde mchog gsum thugs rjes byang par mdzod/ / khyad par dregs pa'i lha gnyan mthu bo che/ / snang srid sde brgyad tshogs kyi rje dpon du/ / ma rtogs dbang gis brnyas smod sgro skur sogs/ / byis blos nongs ba gang brgyas mthol lo bshags/ / dus kyi mchod gtor bsang sogs chag pa dang / / mchod rdzas dman zhing mi gtsang rdzas kyis sbags/ / khas blangs lus shing gtang rag ma btang sogs/ / khyed kyi thugs dang 'gal rnams mthol lo bshags/ /mdor na log par zhugs pa'i nyes spyod klung / / gdung ba drag pos rnam dag dbyings kyi mthar/ / bzlog ste sdom sems tshu lon brtan bgyid na/ /dmigs med bzod pa chen pos dgongs gyur cig / de nas rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te thugasadam bskang ba ni/ / hūṃ/ rab yangs mkha' las 'ja' tshon dra ba dang / / chu gter che las rlabs kyi phreng ba bzhin/ / sngags dang ting 'dzin mos pa las byung ba'i/ / mchod pa'i sprin gyis sa gsum khyab gyur cig / dwangs bsil mchod yon 'khyil ba rol ba'i mtsho/ / sna tshogs mdangs ldan bzhad pa'i me tog phreng / / baiḍūr lhun po'i rjes 'gro bdug pa'i sprin/ / nyi ma stong phrag 'bar ba'i sgron me gsal/ / spos chu'i mtsho chen dri bzang na bun ldang / / lha yi zhal zas mngar ba'i ro brgya ldan/ / sban brjid rol mo sa chen ldir ba 'dis/ / lha gnyan chen po yab yum thugs dam bskangs/ / lcam sras blon po'i tshogs kyi nga / las byed 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i ma / rnal 'byor 'dod don 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ /bskal pa'i rlung gi shugs 'chang cang shes rta/ / sa gsum 'dar byed 'brong g.yag kham pa dang / / sru sdug 'jol ba'i lug dang rwa skyes tshogs/ / 'phur lding gar gyis rtsen pa'i 'dab chags dang / / sgo khyi gcan gzan gdug pa'i nga ro can/ / mi bsrun g.yul las rgyal ba rdo rje'i go / dgra 'joms 67

sa rdo //sde kyi/ / tshe bsod stobs 'byor mnga' thang snyan grags dang / / thos bsam sgom gsum rnam dkar bya ba'i tshogs/ / rgyas par mdzod cig lha chena'akhor bcas rnams/ / de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ wa rtu/ lan gsum gyis brlab/ akā ro mu kha sarba dha rma rṇa ā tya nu twari twatta oṃ ā : phaṭa swāhā/ bdun nam nyer gcig gis dbu' la gong bzhin mchod/ a don skye med nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ / ha nar bzhad pa snang grags sprin gyi sgras/ / sa gsum dkyil 'khor shig shig 'dar byed pa/ / sha za khrag 'thung bye ba'i sde dpon che/ / la lung phyogs kun nyul ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ / ra maṇa yi snyems pa mthar byed cing / / ya mtshan cho 'phrul bde 'thung rol pa'i gar/ / 'a 'ur drag po'i chu 'dzin klong na rol/ / za byed gshin rje khros pa'i rngam stabs kyis/ / zhwa ser bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba yi/ / wa skyes lta bu'i bgegs kyi dpung bcom nas/ / dza ya'i bstan pa skyong mdzad khyod la bstod/ / tsha zer phreng ldan mthu stobs gdengs ka yis/ / tsa tur 'phrin las 'dab brgya'i ge sa ra/ / ma lus gcig car bzhad pa'i grags snyan gyi/ / ba dan srid rtser g.yo ba khyod bsten na/ / pha ltar byams shing ma bzhin brtse ba yi/ / pa sangs ltar dkar dgyes pa'i 'dzum ston cig / na tsha 'khrug long byad phur 'tshe ba kun/ / da lta nyid du rmeg med drungs phyung ste/ / tha gru yangs pa'i dpal 'byor snyan grags tshogs/ / ta la'i 'dab ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / nya gang zla ba rgyas pa'i gzi byin can/ / ja chang phud dang bsang mchod rjes su 'brang / /cha lugs ma nges rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ / ca co'o gdangs ldan 'khor 69

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronayo rsāng 'bum/tshogs rgya mtshor bstod/ / nga cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas/ / ga na gnas kyang lha gnyan chen po khyod/ / kha tsam min par mchod cing skul byed na/ / ka ru ṇa yis sdong grogs g.yel med mdzod/ / ces pas bstod/ las la bskul ba ni/ kyai snang srid dregs pa yongs kyi rje/ / sngo la g.yu rtse mthu bo che/ / bka' yi las byed pho nya ba/ / gdug pa'i ru 'dren dmag gi dpung / / nam mkha'i dbyings na bya ltar 'phyo/ / rgya mtsho'i gting na nya ltar 'gyu/ / bar snang khams na rlung ltar g.yo/ / sprul ba yang sprul bsam las 'das/ / mun nag khams kyi sprin rum na/ / g.yu 'brug sngon mo ldi ri ri/ / klog zhags dmar po cha la la/ / gnam lcags thog gi ser ba 'beebs/ / go khrab gser 'od lam se lam/ / dar mdung ru mtshon zeng se zeng / / chas chas de ni dgra la chas/ / dgra bo'i yul 'khor thal bar rlog / gsol lo mchod do mthu ma chung / / brngan no rbad do rtsal ma zhan/ / ma nyes khon du 'dzin byed cing / / bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis/ / dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad/ / yi dam chos srung khyad du bsad/ / rnal 'byor bdag la brnyas shing smad/ / zas nor longs spyod phrog cing brkus/ / bsam pa ha la'i dug ltar gnag / sbyor ba sru gri'i so ltar tsub/ / sdig gcan bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di'i/ / pha rabs bu rgyud rtsad nas chod/ / che dang yang rgyud drung nas phyung / / rjes med thal ba rlung la skur/ / lha khyod bstan cing mchod pa yi/ / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod dang / / gnyen bshes 'khor g.yog longs spyod kun/ / gnyan gye rje bo 'khor bcas la/ / bcol lo gnyer ro bdag mdzod cig / nyin gsum rgyang nas bya ra mdzod/ / mtshan gsum drung nas mel tshe mdzod/ / mi nor phyugs kyi kha 'dzin mdzod/ / bya ba'i las la sdong grogs mdzod/ / byes su 70

ra / /shākagasabye gapo 'i'agro na skyel ma mdzod/ / chu dang 'phrang la sgrol 'don mdzod/ / nad dang gnod pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog / byad kha phur kha dgra la bsgyur/ / mi nor phyugs kyi god 'phro chod/ / yo srong chad mthud brjed pa skul/ / nyes tshogs rgud pa kun dang snol/ / legs tshogs bya ba kun dang sbyor/ / mthu dang gzi byin dpung skyed la/ / grags snyan lha yi rnga chen brdung / / tshe bsod g.yang gi rgya mtsho bskyil/ / bsam don lhun gyes grub pa dang / / yul du zas nor longs spyod 'phel/ / mtha' dmag lha 'dre'i gnod pa zhi/ / phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal bstan dar/ / 'gro kun dga' bdes 'tsho bar mdzod/ / mdor na rtsa rgyud bla ma'i bka'/ / khas blangs rdo rje'i tha tshig bzhin/ / ga yol med 'phrin las bsgrub pa yi/ / dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ / zhes drag bskul 'di dus dmigs bsal tshe gtong / de nas gtang rag gi mchod par sngags kyis 'bul ba sngar bzhin la/ ka dag spros bral dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / / kha dog ma nges rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ / ga na gnas kyang lus dang grib ma bzhin/ / nga cag bsrung zhing skyod mdzod khyod la bstod/ / ces pas bstod/yig brgya bzlas la/ gang yang bdag blo zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol / rten yod na/ lha gnyan chen po bris sku dang dbyer med du bzhugs/ 'khor rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing / rten med na/lha gnyan 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas/ cheba'i che mchog sogs dkon mchog gsum gye shis pa brjod/ phyi rten sger du btsug pa yod tshe/ bskang pa'i rjes su rta g.yag ra lug sogs la dar gye cod pan btasas/ go khrab spyan gzigs rnams bshams la/ 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bsangs te/ rta 'bul pa ni/ hūṃ myur mgyogs 'gros kyis rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon/ / yud tsam gcig la bgrod byed sprin shugs 'chang / / rnga rngog dar gyi cod pan rab 71

༄ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i khrung 'bum g.yo ba'i/ / mdzes ldan yid 'ong rta mchog kham pa 'di/ / dregs pa'i lha gnyan chen po'i rten du 'bul/ / bka' nyan 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i rten du 'bul/ / rten las ma 'da' 'ben las ma g.yo bar/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan phyogs brgyar dar ba dang / / rnal 'byor bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi/ / tshe dpal bsod nams snyan grags rgyas par mdzod/ / g.yag la/dbang sngon rdo rje'i rmig rtse'i zlos gar gyis/ / nor 'dzin bu mo'i bzhin ras 'dar byed cing / / ro 'dzin glog gi rtse dga' rgod pa can/ / 'jigs rung ngar sgra sgrogs pa'i zhol g.yag 'di/ / dregs pa'i lha gnyan chen po'i zhes sogs tshig phyi ma rnams 'dra/ lug la/ yid 'ong chu 'dzin 'phreng ba'i bla gos gyon/ / bai ḍūr ljon pa rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ / yid 'ong rwa bzhi 'khyil ba'i lha yi lug / sna tshogs dar gyi rgyan mang spras pa 'di/ / dregs pa'i zhes sogs dang / rwa la/ ag tshom ljon pa'i lo 'dab rab g.yo zhing / / yan lag kun tshang spyi gtsugs 'dab brgya'i rtser/ / yid 'ong rwa zung bung ba'i 'phur lding 'dzin/ / 'ba' sgra'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i lha ra 'di/ /dregs pa'i sogs dang / go khrab la/ mi bzad gnam lcags thog chen stong phab kyang / / 'bigs med pha rol g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i/ / rdo rje'i khrab chen zhol btags rmog dkar dang / / sra brtan phub sogs rnam mang go cha'i tshogs/ / dregs pa'i sogs dang / rno mtshon la/ dgra sde'i srog dbang gnam lcags lta bu yang / / skad cig tsam gyis rdul phran gnas 'god cing / / zho 'thung rus pa'i snyems pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ / mda' mdung ral gri la sogs mtshon cha'i rigs/ / dregs pa'i ྾ / bka' ྾ / rten sa / blo bzang sa / rnal 'byor ma / tshe dpal bsod nams snyan grags rgyas par mdzod/ / ces brjod cing me tog gi char dbab par bya'o/ /72

ri rdo ///re smras pa/ mngon 'dod gru gzings sngon dge'i ba dan can/ /dregs pa'i mthu dpung dri bzhon gyis bsgul na/ / rgya chen legs byas rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu/ / phyin par nges pas tshul 'di brten par rigs/ / sdang sems kho nas rbad par 'dod pa dang / / mngon 'dod tsam gyes 'grub par re ba yang / / rgyu 'bras ngang tshul shar nub rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ / byis pa'i 'doms kyis gzhal 'dod rmongs pa'i rtags/ / legs bshad tshon brgya'i rang mdangs lhan skyes su/ / bkra ba bdag blo dbang gzhu'i mtshams sbyor gyis/ / lha chen thugs kyi mkha' dang yangs pa'i ljongs/ / dge legs mdza' gcug snang bas 'brel gyur cig / ces lha gnyan chen po sngo la g.yu rtsi'i gsolamachod rgyas pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon zhes bya ba 'di mi dad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul ba'ingor/ 7chos smra ba'i spobs pa dge ba can btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes chos sde chen po dgon lung byams pa gling du bris pa'o/ /lha chen gnyan rje gung sngon rgya bsang mchod snyan pa'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/bkra shis dge mtshan me tog char 'bebs pa/ / 'jam dbyangs 'i khro dgyes bzhad rdo rje sogs/ / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum bcas pa yis/ /'bral med thugs rjes byang chub par du skyongs/ / de'ang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha chen mthu rtsal dregs pa'i mnga' bdag gnyan rje gung sngon gyi gsol mchod lag tu bstar bar 'dod pas dkar gsum mngar gsum dri bzang po'i shing dang sman sna brgya phrag sbyar ba'i bsang rdzas dkar gtor sogs 'du byas la skyabs sems sngon du btang rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs yi dam gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas mchod gtor rnams 73

༄/ /gung ca bayo ཿ me'i khrung ཿma/bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs sogs sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon yongs su gang ba lha gnyan 'khor bcas dgyes par byed pa'i mthu dad ldan par gyur/ oṃ sadra bid pū ra snu ra zhes sogs dang / sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab/bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes sogs kyis bden stobs brjod/ na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang chos dbyings rnam par dag cing rten 'byung bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthu las ji ltar brjod pa bzhin ru grub par gyur pa ni/ mtho zhing mdzes la brtan cing brjid chags pa'i ri rgyal lhun po'i rtse mo dgung sngon gnam la bsnyegs shing / rtsa ba dbang chen gzhi la zug pa/steng na g.yu 'brug sngon mo ldir ba/ bar na sbrang char zim bu 'bab pa/'daban rtsi shing lo 'bras smin pa/ khor yug ri bran stong gis bskor ba'i nang du rang snang dag pa lha'i gzhal med khang chen po shel gyi rtsig pas bskor zhing ka ba brgya dang ldan pa/ mu tig gi do shal dang gser g.yu'i rgya pheb sogs rgyan gyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbus na cang shes g.yu rngog sprin gyi shugs can nor bu'i sga srab sprad pa'i steng du snang srid dregs pa'i rgyal po gnyan rje gung sngon nam mkha'i mdangs dang ldan zhing nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas dar mdung lce brgyad dgung la 'phyar zhing / g.yon gyis 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang thugs gar 'dzin pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral gu dang g.yu khrab gser zhol mnabs shing / dbu la mu men gyi rmog mo gsol ba/ g.yas na stag ral mda' mos gang ba dang / g.yon na gzig shubs gnam rus brgyan pa/ zhabs la sag lham gsol zhing dgyes 'dzum bco lnga'i zla ba ltar rgyas pa/ mdun du yum chen g.yu sgron dkar mo mda' 74

sa rdo //sde dar me long 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can yu mo la bcibs pa/ sras smon pa don grub zla shel ltar mdzes shing dar sngon po'i na bza' can phyag gnyis bum bzang bsnams shing rta mchog ngang dkar la bcibs pa/ lcam gangs kyi yum chen kun bzang ma dmar mo seng ge la bcibs shing tshe bum 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi blon po spen dkar bse khrab gyon pa mi dmar rta dmar btsan mdung dmar po 'dzin pa/ rgyab kyi ma zhing khyung rtse sku mdog dkar po rta mchog dung gi mdog can bcibs shing dar mdung khra bo 'phyar ba/ g.yon na nye gnas lcang dkar gser gzhung rin po ches bkang ba bzung ste bzhengs pa/ gzhan yang gnyan dmag brgyad khri bzhi stong / snang srid kyi lham sri ni sde brgyad/ sman mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchog gsum bden pas bskul zhing / mngon shes spyan gyes gzigs nas dgyes bzhin mgron du byon par gyur/ kyai/ 'dzam gling gser ldan yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ / gangs can mdo smad nor 'dzin thig le na/ / dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gye lho stod na/ / rong khams kun gyi sa yi gong ba na/ / mi nor phyug gsum bde skyid 'dzom pa'i sa/ / sa yi dge bcu tshang ba'i yul gyi dbus/ / dbus ri sra brtan lhun chags brjid cing mtho/ / mtho khyad rtse mo nyi zla'i dbyings su bsnyegs/ / 'ja' tshon spren dang na bun stod g.yogs can/ / glog dmar 'khyug cing 'brug sgra ldir ri ri/ / ked skabs ri sul dar gyi sham bus mdzes/ / 'dab chags gcan gzan sna tshogs 'dod dgur 'phyo/ / rtsa bar chu mig rtsi shing phun sum tshogs/ / mi phyugs thams cad dga' skyid rtsed 'jos g.yeng / / phyi bltas ri bo nang bltas gzhal med khang / / sum rtsen lha yi 'byor ba ma tshang med/ / dpa' bo 'bum gyi rta rgyug 'ur ru ru/ / sman mo 'bum gyi glu snyan 75

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'ithonalo khrung 'bum/sil li li/ / nor bu'i gzi 'bar gser gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng / / 'byor ba'i g.yang chags brtsan po'i sku mkhar na/ / bzhugs pa gnyan gyi rje bo 'khor dang bcas/ / spyan 'dren mchod do de ring gnas 'dir byon/ / lha chen gnyan rje gung sngon gnas 'dir byon/ / yum chen g.yu sgron dkar mo gnas 'dir byon/ / sras po smon pa don grub gnas 'dir byon/ / lcam mo kun tu bzang mo gnas 'dir byon/ / g.yas kyi blon po spen dkar gnas 'dir byon/ / rgyab kyi ma zhing khyung rtse gnas 'dir byon/ / g.yon gyi nye gnas lcang dkar gnas 'dir byon/ / gnyan dmag bye ba phrag brgya gnas 'dir byon/ / lha klu sman mo'i tshogs kun gnas 'dir byon/ / byon nas rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ / kyi/ mchog gsum thugs rje'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ / rdzas sngags ting 'dzin 'byung ba lnga tshogs pas/ / yid 'phrog mchod pa'i 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa 'dis/ / lha chen 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / dkar gsum bdud rtsi'i mchod yon mtsho ru 'khyil/ / bsung zhim me tog sil mas sa steng khyab/ / mngar gsum bza' bca' gtor ma ri bzhin spungs/ / snyan 'gyur rol mos bar snang gang ba 'dis/ / lha chen gnyan rje gung sngon thugs dam bskang / / yum chen g.yu sgron dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang / / sras po smon pa don grub thugs dam bskang / / lcam mo kun tu bzang mo'i thugs dam bskang / / g.yas kyi blon po spen dkar thugs dam bskang / / rgyab kyi ma zhang khyung rtse'i thugs dam bskang / / g.yon gyi nye gnas lcang dkar thugs dam bskang / / gnyan dmag bye ba phrag brgya'i thugs dam bskang / / lha klu sman mo'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / / nyams chag nyes pa thams cad dbyings su spyongs/ / mthun rkyen bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / gzugs bzang mdog legs 76

ga rdo //sde/'gros mgyogs kyi lang rta/ / rngam 'jigs sgra sgrogs zhol po 'ol mo'i tshogs/ / sha rgyas g.yang mo lug dang tse tse ra/ / sgo khyi stag gzig gnyan gzan sna tshogs kyis/ / lha chen gnyan rje sa ma sa grub par mdzod/ / go bem khrab rmog rdza ri bzhin du bsnyil/ / rno dang ru mtshon nags kyi tshal ba'in bsgrengs/ / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'ja' tshon bzhin du bshams/ / ja phud chang phud rgya mtsho bzhin 'khyil bas/ / lha chen sogs 'gre/ sman lnga 'bru lnga snying po lnga la sogs/ / nas dkar gtsang ma'i zan dang sbyar ba yi/ /gtor ma kha dog dziro phun tshogs shing / / zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa 'dis/ / lha chen kho ra sa / / lha mda' tshigs drug rgod chen sgro yis brgyan/ / rno ngar mi bzad gnam lcags mde'u can/ / snang srid gsal ba'i me long mgul du btags/ / mdzes pa'i dar tshon sna lngas srud pa 'dis/ / lha chen ma nga sa/ / gser g.yu dar zab mkho dgu'i bang mdzod dang / / nor bu'i rgyan phreng lha rdzas na bza'i tshogs/ / 'dod yon rnam lnga bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad/ / spyan gzigs dkor nor ma tshang med pa 'dis/ / lha chen nga mo sa / / bzang drug tsandan dkar dmar a ka ru/ / lha shug mkhan pa ba lu su lu sogs/ / bsang shing sna tshogs phye mar zas sna kun/ / bsregs pa'i dud sprin nam mkha' gang ba 'dis/ / lha chen gnyan rje gung sngon thugs dam bskang / / zhes pa nas/ mthun rkyen bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i bsang mchod kyi/ / dri ngad bsung zhim phyogs brgyar 'thul ba yis/ / dme 'khon byi nal ro greb yug grib sogs/ / nyams grib rtsog grib thams cad sbyong gyur cig / sa gnyan rko zhing chu gnyan dkrug pa dang / / shing gnyan bcad pa thams cad bsang gis bsangs/ / rgyun gyi bsang gsol tshe thar chags pa 77

༄/ /ca ca ga pa'i 0me'i g.yo ཿma/dang / / thab gzhob nongs pa gang bgyis bsang gis bsangs/ / mdor na sgo gsum nyes pas lha mnol te/ / 'thib cing rmugs pa thams cad bsang gis bsangs/ / bde gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang / /'byam klas 'jigs pa kun dang bral sogs kyi/ / thugs rjes bsang mtshod mkho dgu'i longs spyod kun/ / ma tshang med pa'i rnam par shar ba yis/ / lha gnyan 'khor bcas dgyes shing tshim gyur te/ / mthun rkyen dngos grub char bzhin dbab gyur cig / kye/ / yul gyi lha gnyan chen po 'khor dang bcas/ / mthun pa'i bsang dang mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ / mngon shes sgrib pa med pa'i spyan bgrad de/ / mthu stobs thogs pa med pa'i dpung skyed la/ / bstan 'gro yongs la gnod pa'i spyi dgra zlog / yon mchod rnams la 'tshe ba'i sgos dgra zlog / pha rol gdug pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog / ban bon sngags pa'i mnan gtad phur kha zlog / kha rje dbang thang rlung rta rgud pa zlog / lo skag zla skag zhag skag thams cad zlog / bdun zur drug khram 'byung ba'i bzhi gshed zlog / pha khu rgas su mi 'jug che sri zlog / bu tsha 'tshar du mi 'jug chung sri zlog / mtshon sris smas shing chu sris khyer ba zlog / lceb sris 'phyo zhing phung sris dkugs pa zlog / rgyu zog 'phel khar nyams pa'i god sri zlog / bsam pa'i don la 'tshe ba'i dgra sri zlog / don med dgra yi kha smras ldang pa zlog / nyin gyi jag kha mtshan gyi rkun kha zlog / brgya sde'i mi kha nye du'i byol kha zlog / gza' tshang bye bral phu nu'i nang 'khrug zlog / mi yi na tsha phyugs kyi god kha zlog / tsha grang rngo sogs rta nad thams cad zlog / glo gor lhog pa nor nad thams cad zlog / 'ol 'gag 'bu sogs lug nad thams cad zlog / rlung mkhris bad gan mi nad thams cad zlog / ltag pa'i bdud gcod gdong gi mdangs 'phrog zlog /78

la rdo //sde/yas kyi bdud g.yos mas kyi sri lang zlog / bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon rigs sum brgya zlog / de snyed skrag cing dngangs pa'i ye 'brog zlog /thog ser gza' bdud btsan gyi gnod pa zlog / rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ltas ngan pa la zlog / gza' skar ngan dang dus sbyor ngan pa zlog / mdor na mi 'dod nyer 'tshe thams cad zlog / bzlog go sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la bzlog / bsgyur ro gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la bsgyur/ / mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ / zhes pa nas/ rgyas par mdzod cig yul lha'i tshogs/ / kyai mtsho skyes rdo rje rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bka' bsgos bzhin/ / dkar phyogs skyong pa'i lha chen khyod la bstod/ / gangs seng dkar mo bzhin du stobs rtsal rgyas/ / nags kyi rgya stag bzhin du bkrag mdangs rgyas/ / g.yu 'brug sngon mo bzhin du snyan grags rgyas/ / dkar phyogs ྾ / / nam mkha'i nyi zla bzhin du gzi mdangs gsal/ / glog dmar zhags pa bzhin du mthu rtsal myur/ / gnam lcags thog mda' ba'in du drag rtsal che/ / dkar phyogs ྾/ / ri rgyal lhun po bzhin du brtan cing brjid/ / lha dbang brgya byin bzhin du mnga' thang rgyas/ / yid ba'in nor bu bzhin du dgos 'dod stsol/ / dkar phyogs ma / / yul gyi lha chen dpag bsam ljon shing 'dra/ / nged cag yul mi shing gi lo 'dab yin/ /yul gyi lha chen yid bzhin rgya mtsho 'dra/ / nged cag yul mi mtsho yi nya mo yin/ / yul gyi lha chen dgung sngon nam mkha' 'dra/ / nged cag yul mi nam mkha'i rgyu skar yin/ / yul gyi lha chen ri bo spo mtho 'dra/ / nged cag yu la mi ri yi rtsi shing yin/ / yul mi'i bde skyid yul gyi lha la thug/ / yu la lha'i thugs rje skul byed bsang mchod yin/ / de ring bsang mchod rgya mtsho 'di 79

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonaryā gsung 4ma/ 'bul na/ / mthu rtsal dus la bab kyi mthu ma chung / / mda' dar g.yab mo g.yab po spyan ma rtul/ / lhang lhang lan gsum 'bod do snyan ma sra/ / myur mgyogs las la skul lo bang ma zhan/ / mi nor zas gsum dar 'ing rgyas par mdzod/ / bde skyid snyan gsum 'phel zhing brtan par mdzod/ / mgon skyabs dpung gnyen kha 'dzin rgyab brten mdzod/ / nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe mdzod/ / tshe dang bsod nams rlung rta dar bar mdzod/ /mnga' thang rigs rgyud snyan grags rgyas par mdzod/ / gzhis su chos srid legs tshogs 'du bar mdzod/ / lam du 'jigs sgrol bsu zhing sgyel bar mdzod/ / byes su bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ / mi phyugs nad dang god kha zhi bar mdzod/ / yul la g.yang chags zas la ro bcud 'dus/ / gos la bkrag 'khor lus la gzi mdangs rgyas/ / tsha la g.yung drung sems la dge blo skyes/ / 'di phyi'i bsam don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / mdor na bkra shis nyi zla 'od stong gsal/ / dge legs snang bas sa gsum 'jig rten khyab/ / nad mug 'khrug rtsod mun pa'i tshogs 'i nas/ / dga' skyid glu dbyangs srid rtser sgrog gyur cig / yig brgya lan gsum brjod pas bsang mchod dman zhing gtsang sbra ma thon pa sogs nyes pa rnams byang bar bsams la/ mgron rnams dgyes bzhin rang gnas su gshegs par gyur par mos te bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / tshe thar gtong na bskang ba'i 'phror/ rta nor sogs tshe thar gtong rgyu de la dar tshon gtsang mas brgyan/ dpral bar mar byugs/ gtsang spra byas te bsang gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khrid cing / rta la/ yul gyi lha chen snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ / khyed rnams 'gro ba'i tshe srog skyob la dgyes/ / sprin gye shugs 'chang cang shes rta mchog 'di/ / lha chen gnyan rje gung sngon rten du 'dzug / yum chen g.yu sgron dkar mo'i rten du 'dzug / ces pa nas/ lha 80

la rdo //bye/klu sman mo'i tshogs kyi rten du 'dzug / rten las ma 'da' 'bem las ma ga 'o bar/ / rab tu dgyes bas mthu dang dpung bskyed de/ / nag phyogs dgra sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang / / yon mchod mtha' dag tshe dpal mnga' thang rgyas/ / chos srid legs tshogs lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / zhol bo la /gzhan rnams 'dra zhing sprin gye shugs 'chad zhes pa'i zab tu/ rngam brjid ngar sgra sgrogs pa'i zhol pho 'di/ / zhes dang / zhol mo la/ brjid chags 'o ma'i rgyud 'dzin zhol mo 'di/ / zhes dang / lug la/ gzugs bzang sha rgyas lha lug dkar mo 'di/ / zhes dang / lug la/ gzugs bzang sha rgyas lha lug dkar mo 'di/ / zhes spyor ro/ / lha chen dgyes pa skyed pa'i dbyangs/ / dbyar gyi rnga gsang sgrog pa yis/ / dge legs bye ba'i gru char gyis/ / 'jig rten shis pas skyong gyur cig / ces lha chen gnyan rje gung sngon gye bsang mchod snyan pa'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ spyir lha chen 'di nyid sngon kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas dgon sde gsar 'debs kyi dus nas grogs lngan mdzad tshul gyi lo rgyus mang bas dkar phyogs skyong ba khyad par can yin stabs bsang mchod cig yod na legs par sems shing / / de'i nye 'khor du 'khod pa'i a mchog gi sbyin bdag rnams nas kyang skul ma byung bas mtshams sbyar/ de'ang lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rjes chos ba la bla ma yi dam dang chos skyong mnyis pa gal che/ 'jig rten pa la yul lha mnyes pa gal che gsungs pa bzhin grong pa rnams la lhag par mkho 'ing /de'ang snyan ngag mngon brjod sogs kyis bcings na go mi nus pas phal gtam gyi tshul du 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchogag kun dgas bgyis pa 'dis kyang skye bo rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig /81

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'itshonas gsung 'thum/༄7/ / rgyal ba mi pham mgon po la mdo chog gi lugs bzhin mchod tshul sogs bka' rtsom sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu bsgrig pa bzhugs so//༄7/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gye byams brtse'i thugs/ / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa/ / mi pham mgon dang yab rje blo bzang grags/ / dbyer med thugs rjes byang chub bar du skyongs/ /gang gi thugs rje byen rlabs bdud rtsi'i chus/ / yid kyi bum bzang gang bar 'dod pa rnams/ / mgon de'i zhabs rdul bsnyen cing mchod pa'i tshul/ /mdo chog snying por dril te 'god par bya/ / de'ang rje btsun byams mgon dang rje bla ma'i sku brnyan bris 'bur ci rigs/ sher phyin gyi mdo sde byams chos lnga sogs kyis gtsos pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten legs par dgram/ /gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa phun sum mtshogs pa bsham/ / theg chen gso sbyong dang 'brel ba byed na tho rangs lag ris mthong pa'i tshod tsam du bla ma'i rten gye drung du len cing / mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'i nges med kun slong legs par bcos te dge sems khyad par can gyi dad nas skyabs 'gro sems skyed rgyud dang 'dres nges pa byas la gnas dang yo byad sogs byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyengs rnam 82

༄/ /par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis rgyal ba mi pham mgon po rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa gang du spyan 'dren pa'i gnas 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa byams mgon nyid kyi thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i mthu las grub pa'i zhing khams yid dga' chos 'dzin lta bus gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba/yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsan dan sbrul gye snying po'i dri bsung ngad dang ldan pa'i lha'i me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ gser dang dngul dang mu tig gi phye ma sbram bur brdal ba/ utpal dang / ku mu da dang /padma 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs pa/ chu bya sna tshogs ldang ba'i mtsho dang dzing bu'i tshogs kyis mdzes shing / rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin dpag bsam gyi ljon pa tshar du dngar bas yongs su bskor ba dang / / de'i dbus su gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa rgya yongs su mi chad pa khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa chos kyi dga' bdes rol pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs par gyur/ de'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan dang bcas pa/ g.yas g.yon du rin po che'i khri'u chung du ma dang bcas pa/ de'i mtha' skor phyogs mtshams kun tu mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal 83

༄༅/ /gud thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/zas dang / na bza' dang / rgyan dang rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig / 'phags pa thams cad kyang gdan 'dzom nas de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig / ces lan gsum bzla/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzrashā ra bra ma rda ni/ ta thā ga tā ya arta te sa myakle budha ya/ tadu thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ma hā te dza badzre/ mahā bi du badzre/ mahā bo dhi tsatta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi madha pa saṃ kra maṇa badzre/ sarba garma ā wa ra ṇa bi shodha na badzre swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun sogs brjod/ yang / dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi brlab dang /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin nyid du gyur cig ces lan gsum bzlas/ de nas ma gha dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod ltar mgron gye tshul du spyan 'dren pa la thog mar gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas gsal 'debs dgos pas/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren rgyal ba mtha' dag gis/ /bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i rol gar bsgyur ba'i gnas/ / dzaspu'i dṛkṣa'i ljon pas mtshan pa yi/ / lho gling las kyi sa ba 'di yi steng / / dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri brgal ba na/ / 'dod pa'i lha gnas bzhi pa dga' ldan dang / /de yi logs su grong las dgon pa'i tshul/ / rgyal ba'i zhing mchog yid dga' chos 'dzin zhes/ / ma pham mgon gyi thugs bskyed las grub pa/ / dag pa'i zhing gi snod bcud 'byor pa'i dpal/ / ma tshang med pas yongs su brgyan pa'i dbus/ / chos kyi pho brang rgyal mtshan mthon po ru/ /84

༄ mdogadong lnga 'bar bas btegs pa'i nor bu'i khrir/ / stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' rgyal tshab byams pa mgon/ / nam mkha' dri med 'jam dpal snying po sogs/ / rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor te/ / 'gag med tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis zab rgyas chos/ / lhang lhang 'doms shing dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa rnams/ / ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed nyer dgongs te/ / bdag sogs mgon du nye bar 'byon par rigs/ / zhes snyan gnas dbab/ ma lus sems can/ zhes pa nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ / gang 'dir/ nas/ gsol bar bgyi'o/ khrus kyi khang ba/ ji ltar bltams pa/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la/ khyed sku rang bzhin/'di ni khrus mchog 'di ni sbyin pa'i zhes sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras zhes sogs tshigs bcad rnams kyi mthar sngags sbyar ba re re 'am gnyis gsum gyi mtshams su/ de dag sku la zhes sogs kyis sku dbye/stong gsum kun tu zhes sogs kyis gos rgyan gang bum rnams dbul/ / khrus khang nas tshur byon te mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri sogs la bzhugs par mos shing / phun tshogs gzi 'od phyogs bcur rab tu 'phro/ / zhes pa nas/ma pham mgon po'i dbu la phul ba yis/ / zhes sogs kyis dbu rgyan phul/byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing bsregs/ / ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel/ / chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ / dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ji snyed su dag nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mchod rdzas las grub pa'i/ / zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon rgya mtsho zhes sogs dang / zhing 'di 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /zhes sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun rnams dbul/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ / zhes pa nas/ nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig / long yod na ltung 85

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/bshags dang spyi bshags kyang 'don/ de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang / zhes pa nas/ byang chub chen por bsngo/ / zhing khams 'bul bar zhu/ oṃ badzra bhu mi ya 3/ zhes sogs nas/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'di nyid rgyal ba ma pham mgon po rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i mngon paratogs pa mtha' dag gegs med du skyes te 'bras bu sku bzhi'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par byin gyes brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs kyis maṇḍal rgyas pa dbul/ de nas rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal mngon par bstan te/ rgyal ba'i yum rnam pa gsum gyi dgongs pa'i don lhang lhang 'doms par mdzad cing / rang gi rgyud la'ang de dang de'i don rtogs pa'i bag chags khyad par can bzhag byung snyam pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas mngon rtogs rgyan dang byams chos gzhan bzhi'ang ji ltar 'tsham pa bklag pa'i mthar/ de'i dgongs don lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas zab yangs ma dang byin rlabs dpung zhus sam yon tan gzhir gyur ma/ lam rim smon lam sogs bsngo ba'i mtshams sbyor nan tan bya/ de nas 'khor rnams gtso bo la bsdu/byams mgon rang gi spyi po nas zhugs te snying gar bzhugs par bsams la/tshe rabs kun tu mi 'bral bar rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon pa shugs drag po dang bcas byams pas dam pa'i gzungs gang mang bzlas la byams smon gdon pa dang dge tshogs mtha' dag bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyur bsngo bas rgyas gdab par bya'o/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i gru gzings la/ / brten nas dga' ldan chos kyi zhing mchog der/ / skyes shing ma pham mgon gyes rjes bzung 86

༄ raste/ / yang dag lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ces rgyal ba ma pham mgon po la mdo chog gi lugasabazhin mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa 'di ni tal ha ro lod shog gi dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog grags pas yul mtha' der bstan pa'i rmang gzhi 'dzug pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag gis bskul ba ba'in/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar pa'i yi ge ba sngags ram dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang spyor ba'i tshes drug dkyus gcig tu nyams su len tshul lam bzang sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs/thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i khur 'dzin par/ / 'phags yul rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub las/ / 'dzam gling 'di na mtshungs zla gzhan med pa/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis par snying nas 'dud/ / gang la brten na srid 'i'i 'jigs mtsho las/ / yud kyis bgrod phyir sbyor pa'i chos kyi gzings/ /bog 'byin zab mo'i rnal 'byor ba dan gyis/ / mdzes par skal bzang don mthun 'jug par mdzod/ / de'ang byang chub lam rim chen mo'i dngos zin ltar bshes gnyen sten tshul gye rim pa sngon 'gro sbyor ba'i chos kyi khongs su bsdus te nyams su len tshul kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos 'jam dpal 'al lung du gsal par mdzad pa dang / yang lam rim gye dgongs pa yon tan rin po che sdud par/ ji skad smras bzhin byed dang bde gshegs byen rlabs can/ / zhes sbyor ba'i chos drug gi sgo nas skyabs yul rnams kyi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs te rgyud snod rung du byas pa la dngos ga'i lam gyi rtsa ba bshes 87

༄/ /ca ca bayo rsā ryā gsung ཿma/gnyen sten tshul gyi rtogs pa skyes nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa 'byung bar gsungs pa'i man ngag gis spyor ba'i chos drug sngon du btang nas gzod bshes gnyen sten tshul gyi dmigs skor skyong bar gsungs pa gnyi ga rje bla ma'i dgongs pa yin pas/ rjes 'jug so sos rang rang gi mos pa bzhin lag tu blang chog la/ 'dir 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir 'jam dpal zhal lung gi lugs bzhin dkyus gcig tu dril nas lag tu len tshul ni/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren rgyur bkur ste'i bsam pa dang / rang gi sgrib pa sbyong zhing zhing sbyong ba'i dmigs pa sogs dang bcas chu gtsang gis chag chag btab ste gnas khang byi dor byas la rje bla ma'i sku bris 'bur ci rigs sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram/ chu gtsang gi yon chab tshul bzhin du bsham/ me tog bdug spos mar me lha bshos sogs gang legs dang / 'phan gdugs rol chas sogs ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham/ bde ba'i stan la rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du 'khod de rang rgyud la legs par brtag dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas 'di ltar gdon par bya'o/ / rtse gcig dad pas rang gi sdig ltung dang / / lhan cig bye dor byas pa gtsang ma'i gnas/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin bstar ba'i dbus/ / skyabs yul ma lus dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ / bslu med rin chen gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ / dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / spangs rtogs mthar son sku bzhi'i bdag nyid mchog / ston pa sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / 'gog lam yon tan sde snod gsum dang bcas/ / skyob pa dam chos rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / rig grol brgyad ldan bsod nams zhing gi mchog /'dren pa dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs dang / / chos skyong srung ma rnams la skyabs su mchi/ / khyad 88

༄ rapar chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa/ / yab sras brgyud par bcas la skyabs su mchi/ / bla ma lha yi go 'phang myur thob nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro kun srid las bsgral bar bya/ / zhes skyabs 'gro'i tshig rnams lan mang du brjod cing bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi dmigs pas skyabs yul so so la brten pa'i nyes pa byang ste de dang de'i byen rlabs zhugs pas/ de dang de'i skyabs 'og tu chud par bsams/ de nas rje bla ma yab sras sogs tshogs zhing rnams ma gadha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod bzhin sprul pa'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa dang bcas mgron thabs su spyan drangs par bsams la/ dga' ldan lha brgya'i nas/ gshegs su gsol/ / 'jam mgon ye shes lnga yi sgyu 'phrul gar/ / yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang / / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung tshogs bcas/ / skyabs gnas ma tshang med pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes tshogs zhing spyan drangs te mdun du bzhugs pa'i rnam pa gsal gdab/skyabs yul de thams cad kyang rje bla ma'i thugs rje sgyu 'phrul kho na dang /de'angad lta la rang la dngos su snang du yod pa rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di nyid yin tshul dang / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis snyigs dus bshes gnyen gyi tshul du 'byon par gsungs pa'ang 'di nyid yin tshul bsams te/ thub pa'i dbang po/ rje bla ma/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i dadagus sbyong zhing sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa dang / sbyor bas bsten tshul khrus dang bsku mnye sogs kyi dod du khrus gsol byed pa zhal lung gi lugs yin pas/ khrus kyi khang ba/ zhes pa nas/stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa'i bar gyis khus gsol zhing goyodang rgyan 'bul ba sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ slar yang tshogs zhing gi gdan khri soso la bzhugs par mos te/ mdun gyi rnam mkhar seng khri/ zhes pa nas/89

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronayo gsung ཿma/gsal byed shog / ces bsag sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun brgyud dang 'dresanges su bya/ maṇḍal rgyas bsdus ci rigs phul te mjug tu/ bdag sogs 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad rin chen malhol bzang po mkho dgu'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa'i rnam par sprul te dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yab sras yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ / thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bshes gnyen la ma gus pa nas bden gnyis ngo bo tha dad du 'dzin pa'i bar gyi phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag 'gag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bshes gnyen la gus pa nas bden gnyis dbyer med ro gcig pa'i bar gyi phyin ci ma log pa'i blo sna mtha' dag skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rgyun babs/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa mtha' dag rang gzhan gyi rgyud la skyes par bsams te ma yengs pa'i sgo nas dmigs brtse ma ci 'grub bzla/dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes sogs kyi tshe skyabs yul rnams bsdus te rje bla 90

༄ ramar bstem zhing / de rang gi snying gar rang sems dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam la bsngo bsargyas gdab pa sogayospyi ltar bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhar sngon chos skyabs te yan chi'i sprul pa'i sku dkon mtshag bstan 'dzin rgya mchog dang / or du su hang gin pe zi'i shog gi lhag bsam dge ba dge slong dkon mchog dpal bzang / o ra du su o thog pe li'i shog dge slong ngag dbang dpal 'byor bcas kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang 'brel bar rigs gsum mgon po'i bzlas brjod byed zul byin rlabs gter chen zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /rgyal rnams 'gro kun skyabs su 'os pa'i rgyu/ / mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje dang / / skyob pa'i nus mthu lhag pa'i lhar shar ba/ / 'phags mchog rigs gsum mgon la gus btud nas/ / zab mo bla ma'i lam gyis gzhung bsrangs te/ / de yi sgrub pa mdor bsdus spel bar bya/ / de'ang rang gis byin rlabs zhu ba tsam la rje bla ma mgron thabs su spyan drangs pa'i gnas gsum du rigs gsum mgon po gsal btab pas chog la/ bum chog sogs kyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don byed par sngon du dam tshig pa bskyed de ye shes pa'i tshul du spyan 'dren dgos shing / rang nyid kyang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pa dgos/ bdag skyed rje bla ma byed par tshad ldan 'ga' zhig gis gsungs la/ 'on kyang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang gtam rgyud kyi rtogs pa/chos rje don rin par lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan byung tshul sogs gung mthun par dngos sprul gzhi rdo rje 'jigs byed mi'i gzugs su shar pa'i tshul rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos/ ma rung gdul dka' 'dul phyir gshin rje'i 91

༄/ /yo thang b.lo yosgronasa'i gsung la /gshed/ /mi yi gzugs kyi rnam rol tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du seng khri pad zla'i gdan la 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgyas glegs ral bsnams pa/ g.yas g.yon du seng khri chung ba gnyis la rgyal tshab mkhas grub rnam gnyis chos 'chad mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ gsum ga'ang chos gos rnam gsum dang paṇa zhwa gser gyi mdog can gsol te rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i rje bla ma'i dpral par de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing /g.yon utpal gnas pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing me tog gi phreng ba sogs gzhon nu'i rgyan dang cha lugs can/mgrin par padma'i rigs kyi mgon po spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing / 'og ma gnyis kyis shel phreng dang padma bsnams pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/thugs gar rdo rje'i rigs kyi mgon po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing ga g.yas pa rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i nyams dzogs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de dag gi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas rje bla ma yab sras rnams spyan drangs/ dga' ldan lha brgya'i/ nas/ gshegs su gsol/ dza : (ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mdun gyi 92

༄/ /nam mkhar seng khri/ zhes pa nas/ gsal byed shog ces pa'i bar gyis yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ rje bla ma'i thugs gar hūṃ yig gi thig le'i nang du mi yig gis mtshan pa'i mtha' la dmigs brtse ma'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas rang dang bsgrub bya rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byen rlabs ma lus pa thob par bsams la dmigs brtse ma bzla/ rje bla ma'i dpral pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs gar dhī yig la sngags phreng gis bskor ba'i 'od zer spro bsdus rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs/byams snying rje'i rtogs pa khyad par can rgyas par bsams la yig drug bzla/rje bla ma'i thugs ga'i phyag na rdo rje'i thugs gar hūṃ la sngags phreng gis bskor ba'i 'od zer spro bsdus/ phyi nang gi nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad sbyangs/ mthu stobs nus pa phun sum tshogs pa thob bar bsams la badzra pā ṇi bzla/ mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / sgrub gzhi bris 'bur gyi sku sogs yod na ye shes pa dam tshig pa dang bcas pa sku brnyan sogs kyi rnam par gyur par bsams la/ su pratiṣṭhas brtan par bya/ bum chog byed na gong ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ taste taste mahā hāste swā hā/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā dang bum pa'i chu dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du seng khri pad zla'i gdan la 'jam mgon bla ma/ zhes pa nas/bzlas pa'i bar 'dra/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la dmigs brtse ma bzla/ 93

༄/ /gung thang bstan yosgronayo ga4 ཿma/shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen pa'i yon tan thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la a ra ba tsa bzla/ rtogs pa khyad par can skyes par byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi brtse ba'i yon tan thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la yig drug phun sum tshogs pa thob par byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi nus pa'i yon tan thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng la thim/de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ badzra pā ṇi bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / mjug tu/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur bar bsams/ dmigs brtse ma dang rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs/ phyin drug gi tshigs bcad sbrel te khrus bya ba'am/ rnam 'joms lta bu'i bkru byabs srung ba'i 'gros sbyar te khrus bya zhing / mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan pa sogs skabs dang mthun par kha sgyur tshul shes na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhar sngon chos skyabs te yan che'i sprul sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / or du su hangagin pe zi'i shog lhag bsam dge ba dge slong dkon mchog dpal bzang gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa ratā ā na nta'o/ /de yang ji skad du/ ngo mtshar grags snyan 'brug gi sgra ldan pa/ / phul byung yon tan bye ba'i chu khur can/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i phrin las gru char gyis/ / bstan 'gro'i bde skyid snye ma rgyas gyur cig / ces shis par brjod pa'i tshig gis sngon bsus te/ srid gsum skye 'gro yongs kyi bla ma/ thar 94
