༄ mdo'adod thar bar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan/ shākya'i rgyal po'i chos kyi rgyal tshab/dge ldan bstan pa'i gdugs dkar gyen du 'degs pa'i grog thing /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho bsngo ba dang sdud pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal te ru ka dang gnyis su med pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhabs kyi padmo la spyi bos snye bar btud de/ skabs don gsol pa 'debs pa'i don gyi snying po ni/paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ mtha' dag 'gro ba'i bde legs rtsa ba kun/ / rgyal bstan phyogs bcur rgyas la rag las pas/ / de phyir bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dzin byed khyod/ / 'gyur med rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs su gsol/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mtha' klas lus can kun gyi gnas skabs mngon par mtho ba dang / mthar thug nges par legs pa'i bde dase ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas nyag gcig pur gyur pa ni/ ston pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can des/ ma bu gcig pa lta bu'i brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas 'doms par mdzad pa'i lung gi bstan pa rin po che dang / de don tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di gnyis las ma 'das la/ bstan pa rin po che de nyid yun du gnas pa'ang bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams pa med par 'dzin pa'i skyes mchog bstan pa'i bdag po rnams zhabs pad ring du brtan pa la rag las shing / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu'ang spyir gsung rab las bshad pa'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid tshang ba dang / khyad par du rjebatsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag la brten nas rje bla mas dag ther mdzad de rgyal bra'i dgongs pa mthar gtugs pa zab lam dbu ma'i lta ba dang /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa zung 'brel du byas te/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad yi ge na gcig kyang 'dor rgyu med par nyams len du 'khyer shes pa/ mdo sngags gang gi thad nas kyang 'khrul 95

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i ཿ gsung ཿma pa'i dri ma cung zad kyang med pa'i gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu 'di nyid 'khor lo gsum gye sgo nas tshul bzhin du 'dzin par byed pa ches shin tu nyag phra ba'i skabs 'dir/ rje btsun bla ma nyid ni nges pa'i don du 'jam mgon tsong kha ba chen po de nyid rang gis phye ba'i lam srol bzang po srid mthar spel pa'i phyir du bsam bzhin mi'i srid pa bzung ba yin na'ang / don mthun pa'i sgo nas snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams rang nyid gshegs pa'i lam bzang po der 'khrid pa'i slad du thun mong snang tshod dang mthun par gzhon nu nas rab tu byung 'ing / bshes gnyen dam pa du ma rigs kyi cod paṇa du bzhes te mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes par mdzad cing gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs lhag ma med par bcad/ de nas yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs su/ zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pa sngon gyi rje btsun mi la sogs grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma'i sgrub gnas dben pa'i ri sul g.ya' khrod rnams su byon zhing / mtho mtho rlung la bskur/ dma' dma' chu la bskur nas 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'khri ba drungs phyung ste/ ji skad du/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byis pa shin tu gos bzang gyon yang ni/ / khrel dang bral phyir nyes pa'i dri ma can/ / rgyal sras ngo tsha shes pa'i gos can ni/ / dgab pa med kyang nyes pa'i dri ma bral/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ / gos phyag dar khrod dang / / 'tsho ba dka' thub tsam la brten nas sku dang srog la'ang ltos pa med par mdzad de dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i sgo nas thugs nyams su bstar pa las/ lung gi bstan pa gdī ka lnga bcu pa nas rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa rung chu 'deb pa tshun chod kyi 'dul ba'i bcas rkyang phra mo nas bzung bden gnyis zung 'jug gi bar mtha' dag rang gis thugs su chud cing /96

༄ /don de nyid gdul bya rnams la'ang 'doms par mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas rgyal bstan rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i bka' drin bla na med pa ni kun gyi mngon sum du grub pa 'di bzhin lags la/ khyad par du da res kyang rang cag 'dir 'tshogs pa rnams la thugs brtse bas nye bar dgongs te zla ba phyed gnyis tsam gyi bar du thog mar thun mong lam sbyangs rim pa sngon du btang nas/ de'i 'og tu rgyud kyi ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs kyi bcud/ gsang chen rgyud sde kun gyi bla ma/ don dam 'od gsal gyi rim pa gtso bor ston pa'i rnal 'byor ma rgyud dung phyur phrag gcig dang bye ba drug gsungs pa'i yang rtse/ zab pa las kyang zab pa/ gsang ba las kyang gsang ba/ gra ma gong ma rnams kyi rim pa bzhin du snyan nas snyan du brgyud cing / zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thol le ba/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi dmar khrid zab mo dgyes bzhin lhug par stsal pa'i bka' drin bsab phyir mtshon byed dang /ched don mdo sde rgyan las/ de yi chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang / / skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ / 'byor pa'i dus sam rgud pa'i dus na yang / / sems can sdug bsngal dag gis 'jigs pa med/ ces dang /tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ snying rje dman pa'i nyid phyir yang / / gnas pa'i 'bad rtsol chen po mad/ / gang dag brtse ba chen po pa/ / ga'an gye ngor ni bzhugs pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ da lta snyigs ma lnga shin tu bdo ba'i dbang gis 'gro ba rnams dmu rgod 'dul bar dka' thing / drin lan log par 'jal ba mang mod kyang / de dag la khrel ba'i tshul mi mdzad par ma zad/ lhag par yang thugs brtse ba chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur rte /dper na bu chung spyos pas byed pa ngan pa ji 'dra zhig byas kyang pha mas 'brog 97

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/ dgon pa 'jigs su rung ba nas yal bar 'dor ba nam yang mi srid pa bzhin du/ rang cag rnams kyi mgon dang / skyabs dang / gling dang /dpung gnyen dam par mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por zhabs pad bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan par bzhugs nas zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad du bskor du gsol zhes/ ji skad du mdo las/dngos po dman yang bsam pa dam pa yis/ / rgyal ba mchod pa'i yon ni gzhal du med/ ces gsung pa ltar rin chen maṇḍal bzang pos thogs drangs dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas te/ rang cag 'dir 'tshogs pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig sgo nas kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa lags na/ re 'bras don smin gye zhal bzhes bzang po spyi por stsol ba mkhyen mkhyen lags/ zhes pa 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos chos 'khor lha sar dge 'dun sum stong lhag tsam la chos bka' zla ba phyed gnyis kyi bar du gnang ba'i gtang rag gi skabs su gang gi slob ma'i tha shal/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gus pa chen pos phul ba'o/ /gang gi thugs rje'i bdud rtsi'i gzeg ma tsam/ / snying la zhugs pas srid zhi'i gdung sel ba/ / bsru med mchog gsum zhabs kyi padmo la/ / gus pas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs/ / rnam dkar las la 'jug pa'i sgo gsum las/ / lus kyi bya ba phyag dang skor ba yi/ / phan yon mthong ste 'dag par byed pa ni/ / rlabs chen bsod nams sgrub pa'i thabs mchog yin/ / de yi phan yon mchod rten bskor ba'i mdo/ / pad dkar ting 'dzin rgyal po za ma tog / spyan ras gzigs dang gsal rgyal gyes zhus 98

༄ rasogs/ / mdo dang dam pa'i gsung rgyun mtha' yas pa/ / zur tsam ga'an du bkod las shes dgos la/ / 'dir ni de dag rnams kyi snying po'i don/ /mthong dang ma mthong phan yon mdor bsdus tsam/ / gzung bde go sla'i ngag gis rjod byed na/ / mchog gsum zhing la dad gus rtse gcig gis/ / bzlas brjod dang bcas bskor ba bya ba ni/ / nad rims dri ma 'khrud byed gtsang ma'i chab/ / gdon dang bgegs kyis mi tshugs srung ba'i mchog / dus min 'chi ba 'phrog byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / bag med bya ba'i rgyun gcod ral gri bzhin/ / sdig ltung mun pa sel byed sgron me dang / / sdug bsngal tsha gdung sel ba zla ba'i 'od/ / dad pa'i myu gu smin byed char gyi rgyun/ / byin rlabs klung rgyun 'bab pa'i 'jug ngogs zab/ / shes rab padma rgyas pa'i nyin mor byed/ / bsod nams rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta che/ / 'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba'i lam gyi rgyags/ / sus kyang 'phrog par mi nus nor gyi mchog / 'bras bu zad mi shes pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba dgyes byed mchod pa'i sprin/ / mngon mtho'i tshal du bgrod pa'i bzhon pa dang / / nges legs thar par 'jug pa'i them skas te/ / tshogs gnyis rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i gru bo che/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i nor bu yin/ / mkha' ltar rgya che rgya mtsho lta bur zab/ / lhun po'i spo ltar mtho ba'i bsod nams kyi/ / pha mtha' 'phags mchog rnams kyang ga'al dka' na/ / bdag ltas ji bzhin brjod par ga la nus/ / skor tshad gcig tu nges pa ma mchis kyang / / rten gtsor gzhal pa'i 'bum la skor tshad du/ / byed par rgyal dbang bdun pas gsungs pa bzhin/ / 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing mchog 'di la yang / / rten gtso jo bo'i skor tshad chig khri dang / / chig stong sum brgya byams skor khri phrag gsum/ / yin kyang brgya phrag tsam re lhag 99

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgronasa'i g.yo ཿma /dang bcas/ / song ste bsngo bas rgyas gdab byas na legs/ / rnyed par dka' ba dal 'byor rten bzang thob/ / mjal dka' mchog gsum rten dang mjal ba'i dus/ / don med le lo'i dbang du ma btang bar/ / myur ba myur bar snying po blangs na legs/ / 'di yis dge bas 'brel thogs lus canakun/ / mchog gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs gru gzings la/ / brten nas phra rags srid pa'i mtsho brgal te/ / sku gsum nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur cig /cesapa 'di ni gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po dmu dge'i slob zur lha ram pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan gyis de ga'i dgon pa'i rten du jo bo'i lha khang gsar bskrun bgyis skabs skor tshad phan yon dang bcas go bde ba zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesa'aphral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /rnam dag chos dbyings bde ba'i kun gsal las/ / zeg mchog longs spyod cha shas rdzogs pa'i zla/ / sprul pa'i 'od dkar bkod pa'i snang brnyan bcas/ / spros pas 'jig rten rgyan gyur de la 'dud/ / rgyal rnams thugs rje dbyar gyi lang tsho yis/ / yongs bzung gdul bya'i bsod nams 'dzin ma las/ / ji ltar 'tsham pa'i dge legs rkang 'thung 'phreng / / gtan bde 'bras bus spa ba ci yang 'char/ / bslab gsum chu gter lung gis rlabs 'phreng can/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rgya mtsho yang / mchog gsum rten gyi gdengs can dbang po'i byin/ / nyams pa med pa'i rten 'brel mthu la rag / de phyir ma 'ongs skye ba'i 'phreng ba kun/ / ston pa mchog des 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / / bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur rgyas bya'i phyir/ / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo mchog 'di bcoms/ / de yi ngo mtshar thog ma bar dang mthar/ / dge ba'i brjod pa zad mi shes pa las /100

༄/ /snying po ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i phung po ru/ / bsgrubs pa'i gleng gzhi mdo tsam spel bar bya/ / de'ang 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma/ rnam 'dren stobs bcu'i bdag nyid mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i sku la 'jam mgon tsong kha ba chen pos bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i rten 'brel du mdo las lung bstan pa bzhin dbu rgyan phul ba dang rnam pa mthun par jo bo rin po che'i sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ 7skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i gsan sbyang sogs chos srid kyi zhabs 'deg4su 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bkas er tem thu mer gen mkhan po zhes bskos pa'i don bzhin/ kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog nas de ltar gzengs bstod cing / dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi khye thog 20pa gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dkon mchog seṅge nas rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po 'dis mtshon/ mtha' dbus kun tu bstan pa rgyas pa dang / rang ga'an 'brel thogs kun kyang tshe rabs kyi phreng bar bstan pa'i snying po thos bsam sgom pas nyams su blangs te rgyal ba dgyes par byed pa'i rten 'brel du dmigasanas bzhengs pa'i 'dun pa bskyed cing / lang jus nas mgar ba 'di nyid 'ongs te nged la lung ston byams pa'i sku bzhengs pa da lta'i rgya bod kyi bzo bo kun gyi ngang tshul las ches ring du 'das pa'i ngo mtshar phul du phyin pas kyang dmigs rkyen byas te/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang tshan dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi'i lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar las mgo brtsams/ de nas bzung ste bar ma chad par sgrub pas 'dzin byed ces pa me byi'i dgun legs par grub/ phyi'i rgyu bzo mtha' dag shin tu bzang ba'i tshod kyis nang rten yang 'bad rtsol chen pos bsgrub te ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur 101

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgon ཿ khrung 'bum/gtams pa'i rim pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung mdo dbus ri bo rtse lnga sogs nas byung ba bcu lhagabyang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi tshems/ shā ri'i bu'i na bza'/ rgya garagrub chen du ma'i gdung rus sku sha/ nag po spyod pa'i rus rgyan/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshems/ jo bo rje'i snam sbyar dbu zhwa/ mar pa'i bor/ rje btsun mi la'i sgom thag na bza'/ po to ba'i dbu zhwa na bza' gdung rus/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i na bza'/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi sku sha/ phag mo gru ba'i dbu zhwa/ garma pakshi'i na bza'/ yang dgon pa'i dbu skra/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i na bza' snam sbyar/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i rdo rgyus kyi sgom thag bang kheb/ bu ston rin po che'i na bza'/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sgu chos/ lho brag grub chen gyi tshems gdung dril/ chos rje don rin po che'i phyag phreng / rje rin po che'i dbu skra na bza' sku chos sku gzan dbu zhwa snam sbyar/ rgyal ba blo bzang don 'grub kyi na bza' bzhugs 'bol/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dbu skra/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi tshems dbu lo dbu zhwa sku gzan bzhes rtsam/ zhwa lu bsod nams mchog grub kyi na bza'/ rgyal dbang lnga ba'i mgul srung shangs mtshal/ gdung dril na bza'/ gu ru chos dbang gi zhabs lcag po bo grub chen ye shes bzang gi sku chos/ rig 'dzin ngag dbang rdo rje'i 'gan sbyar/ khra tshang ba'i snam sbyar/ bdud rtsi chos sman/rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i dbu skra na bza'/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes gyi na bza' dbu lo/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku gzan dbu lo/rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa na bza' gdung tshwa/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi dbu skra sku chos sku gzan/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i na 102

sa /bza'/ ba so sprul sku ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gis sku 'gag/ se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan gye sku sham/ ba so sprul sku ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma'i dbu zhwa/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i na bza' phyag phreng gser 'dzab/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i tshems dbu lo na bza'/ rdor phreng mi tra sogs gnang dus kyi bum chu'i rgyun/ gdung tshwa/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs/ khri chen dpal ldan grags pa/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan rnams kyi na bza' gdung rus/ dbon slob byams pa rin po che'i sku chos/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i tshems dbu lo na bza'/ gdung dril/ sku ldug klong rdol grub dbang rin po che'i gdung dril na bza'/ 'on rgyal sras rin po che'i dbu lo gtsang chab/mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i phyag phreng / stong skor rin po che'i na bza'/ khri chen sprul sku 'jigs med rig pa'i seṅge'i na bza' dbu lo'o/ sgom chen blo bzang dkon mchog gi dbu skra/ bka' 'gyur ba 'jigs med rab rgyas kyi gdung ras bde mchog rang byon gyi na bza'/ sgrub phugs kyi sa/ mar ba'i bzhugs khri rdo a mo li ga'i dum bu/rje'i gsol lhung nang gi nas/ rtse lnga'i dpag bsam shing gi yal ga sgo mang mgon po'i gtor spu/ dga' ldan chos rgyal gyi na bza' dang zhal gyi nas/ sku 'bum tsan dan/ a ra pa tsa'i sgrub phugs kyi sa/ rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan dang mtsho ma dros pa'i bye ma/ gaṅgā'i chab ril/ ste thang jo bo'i khri'i sa/ ma pham g.yu mtsho'i siskyo ra/ tsa ru sogs dbus gtsang gi gnas chen mtha' dag gi sa sna gzhung gi rten sna 'dzom gang che'i phab rgyun/ gtsang dbus kyi rten bsdus dang ma ṇi ril bu khag mang po/ gtsang dang bya khyung sa skya rnams kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/ nā ga dzu na'i mi mthun kun 'jom sogs thor 103

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/bu smos kyis mi lang la/ nged kyi rten zhig dgos tshul nan che bar phreng ba ni lha'i bskyed tshogs byas pa dang gzungs sngags bgrang ba'i rten byas pa de rang gi dngos nas kyang phyag mchod kyi rten du byas pa 'gal ba med dam snyam ste bzhed pa bzhin byas pa yin/ gzungs kyi rim pa'ang / gzungs gzhug rgyas pa tshar nyer gcig 'breng dang bsdus pa tshar stong phrag re/ dmigs brtse ma/ rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po/ rdor sems yig brgya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi snying po/gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur dang bgegs mthar byed gnyis kyi sngags/ rigs byed ma'i snying po/ rta mgrin mgon po chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras rnams kyi snying po/ byams pas dam bca'i gzungs/ thugs rje chen po'i gzungs sogs khri phrag re las mi nyung ba/ skyabs 'gro khri phrag lnga/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud gcig mtshan brjod gdugs dkar tshar mang po/ po ti lnga'i rtsa ba tshar re/ thugs gar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis rje bla ma'i sku byen can/ 'od dpag med kyi sku sogs rje'i phyag tshwa 'ga' zhig dang /thub dbang byams 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub thogs med/ jo bo rje/ rje rin po che/ rdo rje 'chang rgyal po zla bzang / int+ra bodhe/ lu i ba/ dril bu ba/ lā li ta/ skyabs mgon rin po che'i 'khrungs rabs cha tshang /'jigs byed dpa' gcig 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs/ 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga/ dbyangs can ma/ rigs byed ma rnams kyi sku dri bzang bsgos pa'i shog bu la dpar du btab pa stong phrag re/ 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas man ngag ltar bri sgrub byas pa'i 'khor lo bzhi/ bgegs mthar byed dang gtsug gtor 'khor bsgyur gyi 'khor lo gnyis/ khri'i nang du gter bum gyi khar bri sgrub byas pa'i gnod sbyin dang tshogs bdag 'khor lo/1la

༄ / /gter rdzas rin po che'i rigs/ 'bru sna/ gos dar/ zas sna sogs dang / 7gong ma khang shi rgyal po'i gdan chan lung rgyal bo'i bzhes 'phro phyag nas/ 7gong ma'i pho brang gi mkhar sa dang thabs/ pe cing gi sgo dgu'i sa sogs bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang g.yang chags pa'i dngos po du mas dge mtshan gyi gter chen por bsgrubs so/ / bde gshegs 'phrin las zla zer phra mos kyang / / gdung sel bsil ba'i bde dga' mchog sbyin na/ / sku gsum rten gye cha shas yongs gang bas/ bsil zer byed pa snying gi thig le yin/ / 'on kyang legs byas ku mud bzhad pa la/ / log rtog ri bos sgrib med smos ci 'tshal/ som nyi chu 'dzin dra ba sel dgos pas/ / blo ldan rnams kyis rang sems byi dor gyis/ / bzhu btul lan grangs du mar byas pa'i gser sbyangs nyi 'od 'bar zhing / rdo rje pha lam/ mu tig su gaskyo/ g.yu byi ru/rin po che'i phra tshoms kyis mdzes par byas/ gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri dang rgyab yol la pha rol tu phyin pa drug mtshon pa'i khri drug 'gyog gi bkod pa dang mtha' skor du patra'i lhongs la 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma ha shang / rgyal chen bzhi sogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa thams cad kyang rgyu dang tshegs la ma gtsags par shin tu ru da dngos dag par bsgrub pas bzo khyad phul du phyin cing gser 'od 'khyug pa mig gi bdud rtsi lta bur bskrun pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rgyu song rags pa phyogs bsdoms su byasapar dngul rkyang srang drug brgya dang so lnga/ dung tse khron nyis stong ba'i bcu zhe gcig dang lnga brgya bcas song / sgyu ma'i nor rdzas kyis phung po bsod nams mi zad pa'i gter du bsgrubs pa yin te/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ / 'dren pa'i sku gzugs rab tu mdzes byas na/ / de ni mchog gyur skyes bu mang mchod 105

༄/ /yo ca bstan yo sgronaḥ gsung 'a4/'os/ / blo ldan phyug cing che nying rgya chen ldan/ / dbang ldan 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ zhes gnas skabs mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jim pa dang ni de bzhin rdo ba dang / / shing dang ri mor bris pa'i sku gzugs dag / shin tu mdzes shing blta na sdug par bgyis/ / ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di 'thob/ / ces dang / pad dkar las/ gang gis rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag / bsod nams rgyal mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ / bdag gis bris sam 'bri ru bcug kyang rung / de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ zhes nges legs byang chub kyi go 'phang nges par thob pa sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyasakyi chos thams cad tshad med pa de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yon phul ba'ang tshad med do/ / mtha' yas so/ / bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /mtshungs pa med do/ / dpag tu med do/ / grangs med do/ / zhes zhing gi mthu yin par gsungs so/ / 'dir phan yon zur tsam smos pa yin pas zhib tu mdo sde dang / de las bkol ba rje bdag nyid chen po/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po rnams kyi gsung 'bum du bzhugs pa dang / de dag las rags rim tsam kho bos mchod rten mthong grol chen mo'i dkar chag tu bsdebs pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ / slar yang dge ba gong nas gong du spel te byang chub mchog gi rgyur bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ sidhrachu/'dir 'bad las byung bsod rnams 'dzam bu'i 'bras/ / bde gshegs thugs rje ma dros mtshor smin pas/ / don gnyis phun tshogs rang 'od 'bar pa'i gzis/ / sa gsum rgud pa'i mun pa 'phrog gyur cig / rnam smin yon 106

༄/ /tan ri dwags mtshan ma can/ / dal 'byor cha shas yongs gang zla ba'i phreng / / chad med mngon mtho dge ba'i 'od dkar gyis/ / nges legs kun da'i snye ma 'dzum gyur cig / bsam sbyor rnam dag mthon mthing zur phud la/ / theg mchog bshes gnyen nor bu'i cod paṇa dang / / rna bar 'bral med legs bshad 'khyil ba'i rgyan/ / rnam dpyod lang tsho'i dpyid du 'bar gyur cig / zhen log 'khyag pas bcad pa'i srid pa'i mtshor/ / sred pa'i 'dren byed cha tsam mi g.yo zhing / / bslab gsum gshog rlabs g.yo ba'i thar 'dod kyi/ / ngang mo zhi ba'i rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig / pha rol phyin drug rin chen khams las grub/ / bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i bang rim mngon par mtho/ / byang chub sems gnyis nyi zla'i snang ba can/ / theg mchog lhun po'i rtse mor 'dzeg gyur cig / blo bzang thub dbang gnyis pa'i mdo sngags bstan/ / 'dzin skyong spel la 'jigs bral skyes mchog rnams/ / 'bas pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin gegs med du/ / rgyas pas rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab gyur cig / ltos bcas 'brel ba thogs pa rnams kyis mtshon/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ / bstan la thos bsam sgom pas rab zhugs te/ / yang dag lam bzang bde blag bgrod gyur cig /ljongs 'dir nad mug 'khrug bral bde 'byor rgyas/ / sde 'dir mdo sngags chos srid bshad sgrub 'phel/ / rten 'dir gtan gyi mdun ma 'grub pa sogs/ / deng 'dir smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub gyur cig / dge ba'i gru gzings smon pa'i ba dan can/ / mchog gsum thugs rje mthun pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ / bskyod nas phra rags srid mtsho'i pha rol tu/ / phyin te mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug khri zur dkon mchog sanis jo bo rin po che'i sku brnyan khyad 'phags gsar bskrun gnang 107

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/ste de la dkar chag smon tshig dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul gyi skul ma mdzad pa ltar/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /sems bskyed mchod pa'i phyag len ni/ chos thun snga ma nas dge sbyor dang / gad dar na bza' dbu zhwa sogs gang legs dgos tshul brda' sbyar/phyi nang kun tu chag chag / mchod pa rgya gang che/ me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa'i khri sogs bsham/ mchod gral du thub sku gcig dang sher mdo gcig nges par dgos/ brgya rtsa dang cha gsum gtong ba/ sher mdo sgrog mkhan sogs kyang bzhag tshogs su bsnyen bkur dang sbyin gtong yang rgya che ba gra bsgrig 'tshogs nas/ thog mar bla ma khri'i mdun nas yar phyogs te bzhugs nas gzhi bdag gtor ma phul/ sa gzhi dang mchod pa byin rlabs/mchod pa'i sprin gye gzungs tshar gsum/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs te yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas phul nas rten gyi drung du smon 'jug gi sdom pa blangs te legs par gsos/ khri khar phebs nas bla mas bskul te sher snying tshar gsum/ seng gdong ma'i sngags bdud zlog bcas/ spyi'i chos bshad/tshogs zhing gsal 'debs tshul/ rtsa ba'i bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i tshogs zhing rnams kyi yon tan/ bsags sbyang gal che bas yan lag bdun pa'i dmigs skor/ khyad par sems bskyed zhu ba la mchod pa gtso ba'i lo rgyus sogs bshad/ kun gyis lhan du/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag / ces sogs dang / mchod pa'i sprin gyi gsungs tshar gsum/ ma lus sems can kun gyi nas/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob par shog / ces pa'i bar gyis spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ slob ma rnams kyis phyag 'tshal bzhin du/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ 'dren pa mnyam 108

༄/ /med nas/ drin can bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar gsol 'debs phyag 'tshal du bsgyur/ sgrub pa po la/ mthun pa'i smon lam/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje/ bcom ldan 'das kyi/ phyag byar 'os pa ji snyed su dag nas/ bdag gis bstod/ / sa la bzhugs te/ me tog dam pa/ zhes sogs sho lo ka gsum/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i/ rin chen dbang gizhing 'di 'khor lo/ de las gzhan yang / nas/ nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig / sa gzhi ma tshar nyer gcig bdun re'i mtshams nas dbu bskul/phyag dang sprags pa'i ltung bshags tshar gcig bzhugs te spyi bshags tshar gsum/ slob ma rnams la mthong sdom 'dri/ thabs lags bya/ 'dod chags zhe sdang nas/ chen por bsngo/ ston pa shākya thub chen la bdag cag gi ston pas thug bskyed pa'i rten 'brel bzhin 'dir yang ston pa'i 'du shes kyis/ bla mar phyag gsum btsal du gzhug maṇḍal rgyas pa dang rngo na phul/theg pa mchog gi sems bskyed zab mo zhu ba'i yon du zhes tshig sgyur/ gsol gdab lan gsum pus btsug thal mo sbyar te rjes zlos bya/ chung 'bring thun mongaba'i dmigs sgor de dang de las lhag tshul skyabs 'gro thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs skor dman pa'i yid byed las skyob tshul sogs brda' sprad sdom pa'i rtsom byed du dgos tshul gsal btab nas/ spyod lam snga mas skyabs 'gro'i rjes zlos lan gsum/ de'i bslab bya phan yon dang bcas rgyas par bshad cing / dngos gzhi la yang lam rim ltar yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa mdor bsdus 'bul du gzhug dgos pas/ rab 'byams gsung rab/ nas/ bshes gnyen rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ ji snyed su dag / nas/ chen por bsngo/ / sa gzhi spos byugs ma/ byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam/ byang chub don gnyer gyi 'dun pa skyed tshul rgyas par bshad/109

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i 0sa g.yo las/dngos gzhi'i rjes zlos lan gnyis bya/ thog dus sogs brda' sprad de/yang rjes zlos gcig bya/ spro ba bskyed cing smon sems kyi bslab bya rgyas par bshad/ spyir bsngo ba gtso tshul dang / byams mgon la bcol tshul phyag len ltar brda' sprad/ byams smon 'don/ de dag rjes su bdag slob/zer ba'i tshe kha dar byams mgon la 'bul/ byams smon mjug tu/ byang chub sems mchog ma pha ma sems can ma dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe mo gtang rag maṇḍal lam rim smon lam bcas gsungs te grol/ slar gral du 'tshogs te/ chos spyod smon lam gang 'gro/ mjug tu bsngo ba/ zhwa spyon nas bstan 'bar ma dang / chos rgyal ma tshar gsum bcas bya'o/ lam sgron las/ ldog med par dam bcas pa'i/ byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya/ zhes dam bca' can ni sdom pa len tshul yin pas/ cho ga gcig gi khrod nas kyang byang sems kyi bslab bya srung mi nus pa rnams sems bskyed par bya'o snyam pa tsam byas na smon sems cho gas gzung bar 'gyur gyi/ sdom pa gzung ba ma yin par gsung / sems bskyed cho ga lam rim chen mor gsal la/ phyag len mdor bsdus yongs 'dzin rin po ches gsungs pa'i sems bskyed cho ga'i mjug tu gsal/ shin tu bsdus pa bde lam rang gi des yong /lam sgron las/ 'di ni skye pa gzhan du'ang dran don du/ / ji skad bshad pa'i bslab pa yongs su bsrung / zhes sogs gsungs so/ /na mo gu ru be/ de'ang dmigs brtse ma'i bsnyen pa byed tshul ni/ rje bla ma rigs gsum mgon po/ dga' ldan gye zhing bkod dam byams mgon gyi sku sogs 'di dang 'brel ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten legs par dgram/mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs kyi mchod pa gtsang ma bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang / dga' lha brgya ma maṇḍal rgyas bsdus ci 110

༄ /rigs dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan sa gsum ma'i/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i bar gyis rje bla ma'i rnam thar rjes su dran pa'i mos gus shugs drag gis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab la/ de nas ma dag pa 'khrud pa dang / mi shes pa bsal ba sogs kyi dmigs pa las tshogs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang bcas dmigs brtse ma ci 'grub bzla/deng nas brtsams te zhes sogs dang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung nas 'byung ba bzhin/ de ltar mkha' dbyings chu 'dzin dkar po'i dbus/ zhes sogs dang / rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / 'jam mgon bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs mthus/ / dge 'dun thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub 'phel/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rgyal ba dang / / yul ljongs 'dir yang nad mug 'khrug rtsod sogs/ / nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi nas rje 'bangs kun/ / chos srid rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa yi/ / byin rlabs zad mi shes pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / ces smon cing 'dod don zhu bas mtshams sbyar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'ibla ma rin po che/ zhes sogs kyis rje bla ma snying gar spyan 'dren zhing /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / / zhes sogs dang / chos rgyal ma sogs smon lam dang bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / 'di'ang dpyod lngan ye shes chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o /rnam rgyal bum pa tshad ldan bya tshul ni/ sngags rim las dus 'khor gyi bshad pa dang / zung 'jug gsal ba'i bshad pa gnyis bkod pa dngos zin mi 'dra ba ltar snang yang / gtso bo 'di bzhin byed dgos tshul lam/gang byas kyang rung ba'i gdam nga lta bu ma mdzad pa dang / snga ma'i steng nas 11 /

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'ispronasa'i khrung 'bum/rgya dpangs kyi tshad zhib tu gsungs te/ phyi mar 'grel rgyag skabs rnam rgyal bum pa tshad dang ldan pa nges par dgos kyi/ gzhan la nges gzung mi dgos tshul tsam zhig gsungs kyi/ tshad la bshad pa ma mdzad pas snga ma gnyis ka dgongs pa gcig pa'i dbang du mdzad par snang ngo / / 'o na snga mar lto ba'i blum la sor bcu drug dang / phyi ma las/ lto ba'i rgyar ni mtho lnga'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ji ltar mtshungs snyam na/ snga ma lto ba'i mtha' skor yin na ha cang phra bas byed lugs med la/ dkyil nas 'phred du yin na'ang de rkyang ba khor yug tu sum 'gyur byas tshe sor zhe brgyad las mi 'ong bas mtho lnga mi long mod/des na lto ba'i steng nas mgrin pa'i g.yas g.yon du gzhal bas sor brgyad brgyad de bcu drug dang / / bar gyi mgrin pa'i thad la sor bzhi ste nyi shu po sum 'gyur gyis bskor nas sor drug cu yin zhing / mtho gang la sor bcu gnyis 'byung bas mtho lngar bshad pa dang shin tu 'grig go / 'o na snga ma'i skabs su mchu'i mtha' nas mtha'i bar la sor brgyad yod pas/ cha gnyis mgul ba'i sbubs dang / cha gcig mchu gnyis kyi zheng du gsungs pas/mgul pa'i sbubs la sor brgyad kyi sum cha ste sor lnga dang nas gnyis 'byung bas/ de sum skor byas na sor re bzhi 'byung stabs mtho lngar bshad pa las sor bzhis lhag pa min nam snyam na/ mgul ba'i sbubs cha gnyis su gsungs pa ni cha bzhir bgos pa'i gnyis yin/ cha gcig mchu gnyis kyi zheng zhes pa'ang phyir g.yel pa'i thad la bzhi cha re re ste g.yas g.yon gnyis gar de 'dra re dgos pas mchu gnyis zhes gsungs pa yin nam snyam/mgrin pa'ang dus 'khor las dpangs sor drug dang / phyi mar sor mo brgyad kyi tshad kyis ni/ mgrin pa mtho zhing zhes gsungs pa gnyis kyang mi 'gal te/ snga mas drang por song ba'i cha de sor drug byas nas/ de'i steng 112

༄/ /du phyir g.yel ba'i chas sor do yod pa lam mchu zhes logs su smos pa dang /phyi mas de gnyis ka bsdoms te sor brgyad du byas pa yin no/ / de ltar na lho ba'i thad nas gzhal pa'i tshe zheng du sor nyi shu dang / 'og gzhi nas kha'i bar du sor nyi shu 'byung bas rgya dpangs mnyam/ kha'i zheng thang du sor brgyad dang / de nas mgrin pa'i rtsa ba bar du sor brgyad de 'di'ang rgya dpangs mnyam pas/ de gnyis ka la'ang dgos pa dang mtshon don sbyor tshul zhig yod dam snyam/ zhes pa 'di ni phran ratna ā nanta bdag gis rnam bum tshad ldan bzo tshul dus 'khor dang zung 'jug gsal ba gnyis ga'i tshig zin mi mthun pa ji ltar yin zhes zhus pa'i lan du stsal ba bzhin yi ger bkod pa'o/ /slob ma'i spyi bor padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hrī yig dmar po de la sa 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur ba las dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar ljang dkar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje/rtse gsum/ ral gri/ g.yon sdigs mdzub/ mdung thung rgyu 'gas bsnams pa/ dbu'i steng na rta mgo ljang gu gsum gyis rta skad drag tu 'tsher ba/ mgo 'phreng / glang lpags/ stag sham/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan sogs kyis spras shing khro bo'i nyams rdzogs pa/ zhabs g.yas bzhi bskum zhing g.yon bzhi brkyang ste klu brgyad badzis nas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhags pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā0 thugs shar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ rgyal kun sor rtog ye shes dngos/ / gtum chen khro bo'i skur bzhengs te/ / gdug pa'i gdon gsum mthar byed pa/ / rta 113

༄/ /ca ca b.lo yo ma'i g.yo ཿma/mchog rol par phyag 'tshal lo/ / sngags ci 'grub bzla/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byen gyis rlobs shig / dpal rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas byin gyis rlobs shig / bka' nyan chos srung rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig / rdo rje slob ma 'di steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa las skyobs shig / bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po'i gnod pa las skyobs shig / 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa las skyobs shig / nad rims gdon gegs mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad las srungs shig / skyobs shig / sba bar mdzod cig / rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / / khro rgyal rta mchog rol ba'i mthu stobs kyis/ / slob ma 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gye/ / 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig / dpal rta mgrin slob ma'i sbyi bo nas zhugs te snying gar thim pa spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang sprul pa'i khro chung dang me'i tsha tsha dpag tu med pas gtams pas/ gdon bgegs gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i srung ba chen por byin gyis brlab par gyur/ /khu dge legs bshad gling gi rten tho bsod nams rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs/rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i blo gros chu shel khams/ / thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dpal du shar pa'i mgon/ / thar 'dod kun da'i tshogs kyi gnyen gcig pu/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ / ring nas goms pa'i smon lam rlabs po che/ / nor bu don yod zhags pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /114

༄/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor mchog gsum rten gyi tshogs/ / gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo mtshar e ma rmad/ / gang gi thugs bskyed lte ba las thon pa'i/ / ba'ad sgrub rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i gdugs dkar po/ / srid zhi'i bla na phan bde'i bsil sbyin mkhan/ / legs bshad gling zhes grags pa'i g.yer kha 'khrol/ / gang du skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing gi mchog / byin rlabs mi zad 'dod pa 'jo ba yi/ / mchog gsum rten gyi snye ma g.yur za ba'i/ / ngo mtshar bkod pa mdo tsam spel bar bya/ de'ang blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che mdo smad lho rgyud kye ljongs 'dir spel ba la thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i mthu grub pa lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu song yang sbas pa'i brtul zhugs lhur mdzad de bka' gdams lha chos bdun ldan gyi rnam thar gtsang ma'i sgo nas gdul bya mtha' dag smin grol gyi lam la sbyor ba 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul rje btsun bla ma dam pa blo gros rgya mtsho dpal bzang po zhes grags snyan srid pa gsum nas g.yo ba de nyid kyi gdan sa 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas thub bstan rin po che'i rgyan du gyur pa'i chos sde chen po khya dge legs bshad gling zhes grags pa 'dir bla ma yab sras kyi thugs bskyed la brten nas 'dus pa'i mchog gsum gyi rten dang / ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i phung po mtha' klas par bzhugs na'ang / gtso bor gyur pa ni sa gsum gyi yid bzhin nor bu gcig pu gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi zhing dam par rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis ched du bsngags pa ni bla ma'i gdung rten yin pas/ mgon po de nyid kyi sku gdung rin po che bzhugs pa'i pho brang byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi nang rten gyi rim pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'phel gdung gsum/sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung gcig mi 'khrugs pa'i sku stong /115

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/sman bla'i sku nyis stong bde gshegs brgyad kyi sku nyis stong / rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ bla ma yi dam sogs kyi sku 'dra khyon sdom na khri phrag gnyis dang stong phrag drug lhag thub dbang byams pa sogs kyi li sku re/ bde gsang gnyis kyi rtsa rgyud/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum/sman mdo brgyad brgya pa/ spyod 'jug rje'i lam rim sngags rim/gsal sgron/ bslab bya chen mo la sogs pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos kyi po ti mang po/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gzungs sngags rin po ches bris pa dang spar ba mang po/ bka' gdams mchod rten/ 'brom ston pa'i dbu skyes/ paṇa chen shākya thi dang / bu ston rin po che/ rje btsun rga lo sogs kyi na bza'i dum bu re/ rje tsong kha pa'i gsang chab ril bu/ na bza'i tshal bu/ paṇa chen sku gong ma'i phyag sen/ sku mtshal/ na bza'/rgyaladabang lnga ba'i na bza'/ shangs khrag paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi dbu skra dang gsang chab ril bu/ na bza'/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i dbu skra na bza'/ phyag 'phreng / spub khang dpon slob dang /mkhar rdo dpon slob kyi na bza'i tshul bu/ gling dpon pa'i dbu thod/ ra ring chos grags dang / rje chos skyong rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/ klu 'jim las grub pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga/ smṛ ti dang paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag tsha/ shar 'bum pa'i dung rang byon sogs byin rten rnams so sor dngos su bzhugs la/rten rnying mang po'i phab rgyun 'khrul med cig kyang gzungs gzhug tu phul yod pa de'i nang du bsres pa'i rten gyi rim pa ni/ shā ri'i bu dang / pha dam pa rgya gar gyi ring bsrel/ o rgyan rin po che/ ban de ye shes sde/ khri srong lde btsan/ ma cig lab sgron sogs kyi dbu skra/ chos 'phags dang zhang pradzñā gu ru'i tshems/ jo bo rje sha bo sgang ba/ dbyer sgom zhabs/ grub chen 116

༄/ /khyung bo/ dwags po lha rje/ phag mo gru pa/ lha lung dpal rdor/ bu ston rin po che sogs kyi gdung rus/ lho brag mar pa/ rje btsun mi la/ ras chung rdor grags/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab sogs kyi dbu lo/ rngog blo ldan shes rab/ rje btsun red mda' pa/ rje tsong kha pa/ 'dul 'dzin grags rgyan/ mkhas grub rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ dben sa pa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rgyal sras rin po che/ de mo spul sku/mnga' ris sprul sku/ gzims khang sprul sku/ pha bong kha ba dpal 'byor lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rong bo'i skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs kyi na bza'i tshul bu/ rgyal dbang gong ma lnga'i dbu skra/ sa chen kun snying /grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍita/ bla ma 'phags pa sogs kyi dbu lo dang na bza'/ garma rabs bdun gyi dbu skra/ na bza'/ kun mkhyen legs pa don grub dang / skye ba bdun pa'i sku sha/ bo tong pa phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / zhwa lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po'i na bza' sogs bzhugs par gsung ba'ang 'khrul med nges dag kho na yin/ ga'an yang rgya gar rgya nag bal bod sogs kyi sa sna rdo sna sogs byin can mang po bzhugs thing /rin po che sna tshogs/ dri bzang sna tshogs kyi thum bu dum dang bcas pas go mtshams med par gtams pa'i snying por sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu sgom chen rin po che'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa la brten nas cung zad kyang ma nyams pa phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril bsnams shing skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku la sman 'dam dang gser sbyang gis byugs te gsum lda na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam par byas te mthong thos dran reg ma lus pa mngon mtho nges legs kyi dpal la sbyor ba'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'phro bzhin par bzhugs so/ /phal ba'i sa bon cung zad btab pas kyang / don gnyis gser gyi snye ma 117

༄/ /gung ca bayo ba'i sgronasa'i g.yo ཿma/'dod dgu ru/ / skye ba'i zhing mchog lag tu chud pa'i tshe/ / 'das pas snying po longs shig shes ldan dag / phyag 'tshal lus kyis non sa'i rdul grangs kyi/ / 'khor sgyur grangs med 'thob par rgyal bas gsungs/ / de ltar rnam dkar las la ma 'bad na/ / dal 'byor rten bzang thob pa don re chung / / gang gi ba spu'i bu ga gcig tsam yang / / bsod nams zhing gi dam par bsngags pa de'i/ / rags pa'i gzugs sku tshang bar bsod nams kyi/ / zhing du thob pa skal bzang e ma rmad/ / dpal ldan bla ma de nyid kyi thugs kyi sras po mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug sgom chen rin po che blo bzang bkra shis kyi sku gdung mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs pa'i rten gyi rim pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung 'khrul med/ jo bo rje'i dbu lo dang na bza'/sa paṇa dang chos rje don grub rin po che'i na bza'/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i dbu lo/ na bza' gdung ras/ lho brag grub chen gyi na bza'/ rwa lo'i na bza'/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ rgyal tshab rje'i na bza'/ mkhas grub rje'i na bza' dang dbu lo/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i na bza'/ ba so chos rgyan gyi dbu lo dang na bza'/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gye dbu lo/ phyag dpe/na bza'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i dbu lo dang phyag sen/ paṇa chen blo bzangaye shes kyi na bza'/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ rong bo chos pā rin po che dang / skal ldan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/'khon ston gye na bza'/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ dpon slob byams pa rin po che/ mkhar rdo bzod pa rgya mtsho/ khri chen rgyal mtshan seng ge dung dkar 'brug grags/ bya khyung mkhan po sogs kyi na bza'/118

༄ /lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ bka' 'gyur ba no mon han/ grub dbang stobs ldan rin po che/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po/ khri chen ngag dbang bkra shis/ chas pa sprul sku rnams kye dbu lo/ smin grol chos kyi rgyal po dang /sgom chen rin po che nyid kyi dbu skra/ rje chos skyong rgya mtsho dang / khri nam mkha' bzang gi gdung rus/ grub pa'i dbang phyug nyid kyi pur tshwa rje bla ma'i sku stong phrag bzhi/ sman bla'i sku stong phrag bzhi/ tshe dpag med dang sgrol ma'i sku stong phrag re/ bde gshegs brgyad/ 'od dpag med/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jigs byed/ rnam rgyal ma sogs kyi sku stong phrag lhag tsam/ 'phags bod kyi rten sna du ma bsdus pa'i ril rgyun mang po/ rgya gar rgya nag mnga' ris/ bal po/ dbus gtsang / mdo smad sogs kyi gnas chen du ma'i sa sna chu sna gnas rdo shing sna sogs dang /gzhan yang dri bzang po'i sman dang / spos kyi rigs/ rin po che'i phye ma sogs gos dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang bcas go mtshams med par bsgrigs pas yongs su gtams shing / snying por gyur ba ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i gtso bo chos sku'i ring bsrel zhes grags pa stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs 'jug cha tshang ba sogs bri bsgrubs tshul bzhin du bgyis pa'i gzungs kyi rigs mtha' yas pa bzhugs so/ blo bzang rgyal kun mkhyen brtse yid bzhin nor/ / gang la brten pa'i gzugs sku'i za ma tog / byin rlabs bkra shis gzi 'od stong 'bar bas/ / sa gsum dge legs snang bas yongs su khyab/ / gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul 'dab brgya'i snying po las/ / byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar 'bum 'dzag pas/ / lam bzang lus stobs rgyas pa'i bhra ma ra / / nges legs kun dga'i ra bar rtsen gyur cig /dpon slob rin po che nas bzhengs par mdzad pa 'du khang phu'i dri gtsang khang 119

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/gi rten gtso thub pa'i dbang po dang bcas bka' gdams lha bzhi/ rigs gsum mgon po sogs zhi drag gi sku mang du bzhugs pa rnams kyi nang rten ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms te bkod na/ 'phel gdung 'khrul med bco lnga/ 'jon dmar las grub pa'i byams pa/ rdo nag las grub pa'i dzam lha/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi sku 'di gsum ga'ang ring bsrel bzhes pa'i byin can 'khrul med yin/gzhan yang rten 'dam sna tshogs las grub pa'i thub pa dang mgon po'i sku byin can/ paṇa chen smṛ ti/ rje rin po che/ rgyal dbang paṇa chen sogs kyi phyag tshwa ci rigs/ rje rin po che dang / 'jigs byed kyi sku me 'dzin ma/'jam dbyangs kyi phyag 'bas kyi rjes dang / tshems dpar ma/ sha ba ri dbang phyug jo bo rje/ rje bla ma/ thang stong rgyal bo/ rgyal dbang /paṇa chen/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs mkhas grub mang po'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud sogs dam pa mang po'i zhal 'don phyag dpe po ti du ma/ gser dngul zangs gsum sogs kyis bris pa'i gzungs 'jug cha tshang brgya phrag mang po/khyad par du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i paṇa zhwa dang sku 'gag rgyun bsnams kyi ḍū ma ru dang rdor dril/ rje lung rigs rgya mtsho dang /dpon slob rin po che rnam gnyis kyis gsol ba'i snam sbyar dang rigs lnga/dpon slob rang nyid kyis rgyun du 'chang ba'i dam tshig gi rdor dril/ 'jon dmar las grub pa'i dbang dril sogs rdor dril byin can 'ga' re/gdung rus las grub pa'i oṃ rang byon/ rje dge 'dun grub pa dang /'dul 'dzin thag ma pa sogs kyi gdung rus dang gangs thigs mang po/rten bsdus/ skye bdun/ bdud ste ril bu sogs ril bu'i rigs sna tshogs/120

rardo /sa /rin po che'i phye ma dang / dri bzang sna tshogs kyis byur bur gtams 'ing /sku rnams kyi cha tshad dang rten rnams kyi bzhugs tshul/ gter 'khor gyi sgrub tshul dang rab gnas sogs rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba ba'in rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang mthun par legs par bsgrubs te 'gro ba'i bsod nam sa kyi 'ing sa dam par byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'phro bzhin par bzhugs so/ /tshogasaganyis sa bon dus su smin pa las/ / mthong thos dran res rdon lnga na chos kyi skus/ / rab tu phye ba'i ngo mtshar rten gyi phreng / / sgrib bra' lha yi 'a/ma du skar tshogs bzhin/ / bsod nams zhing sa gathin po 'di 'dra 'a phyag mchod rnam dkar sa bon ci zebs kyis/ / don gnyis 'bras bzang smin pa'i dga' ston la/ / 'dod dgur longs su spyod cig shes ldan dag /'du khang steng gi li ma khang du yang / thugs kyi gsang ba zab mo stobs dang mi 'jigs pa sogs kyi bdag nyid chos sku'i rten du grags pa mtshad rten brgyad kyi nang bzhugs ni/ mchod rten re re'i nang du sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gnyis re/ dpal a ti sha'i dbu skra dang / rnal 'byor nga chen po byang chub rin chen gyi dbu skra/ lho brag phyag rdor gyi na bza'/ / rje tsong la ba chen po'i dbu lo na bza'/ gsang chab ril bu/ rgyal tsha brje'i dbu lo/mkhas grub rje'i dbu lo/ rje blo bzang don grub kyi na bza'/ parṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi na bza' dang dbu lo/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/bsod nam rgya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho rnam gsum gyi dbu skra/ rgya' dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi dbu lo dang na bza'/ rje drung rin po che'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i dbu lo dang / na bza'/ mnga' ris sprul sku'i dbu skyes/ zhang ba dam chos dpal 'bar ba'i tshems kyi dum bum/121

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 4ma/dwags po bsod nams rin chen gyi gdung rus/ lha rje dge ba 'bum gyi dbu thod/ grub chen dpal 'bar ba'i tshems/ rje blo gros bzang po'i gdung rus/ grub chen na ga pa'i tshems/ byang ba 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen gyi gdung rus/ grub chen dka' bcu bsod nams dar rgyas kye tshems/ chos rje blo bzang dar rgyas kyi gdung rus/ khri chen blo bzang chos 'phel gyi gdung rus/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i gdung rus sogs gdung rus mang po ma rgyan rin po che'i na bza'i tshal bu/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i dbu skra/sa skya paṇa chen gyi na bza'/ lcags zam sprul sku'i dbu skra/ dung dkar 'brug sgra'i na bza'/ rje padma 'phrin las kyi dbu skra/ pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi na bza'/ sgrub khang dpon slob kyi na bza'/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyi na bza' sogs dam pa mang po'i na bza'i tshal bu/ gser dngul las bzhengs pa'i po ti mang po/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs rigs sna tshogs dang sku par du ma/ sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'igadung rus las grub pa'i ril bu sna tshogs/ dbu skra sna tshogs dang na bza' sna tshogs bsres pa'i phye ma/ sind+ra ra'i rigs sna tshogs gangs thigs mang po/ skye bdun rigs mi 'dra ba mang po'i ril bu/ rgya gar nag bal bod sogs kyi gnas chen mang po'i sa rdo byin can sna tshogs/ dzam 'khor dang tshogs bdag 'khor lo sogs byin rlabs can du bsgrubs shing / de dag gi bar bar du dri bzang sna tshogs dang / rin po che sna tshogs dang /bzangasman sna tshogs kyis legs par bkang zhing / gser tshon mdzes par gsol nas spyan dbye'i cho ga rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bzhin phyag len du bstar gos dar sogs kyi na bza' dang / mchod pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pa phul nas 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa dam par bzhugs so/ / las nyon mi 122

༄ mdobazad gdug pa'i mkha' lding gi / phan bde'i srog dang bral ba'i keng rus kyang / / gsos nas mngon mtho nges legs bde dga' la/ / sbyor byed sngags kyi mchod sdong e ma rmad/ /yang dmigs brtse ma'i lha khang du bzhugs pa'i 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa dang / bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa/ sangs rgyas mtshan legs gsum gyi sku'i nang bzhugs ni/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gnang ba'i dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo/ dbu skra dang na bza'/ shangs mtshal ril bu/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos phyag bzo mdzad pa'i rje rin po che'i rdo sku/ paṇa chen sku gong ma'iphyag tshwa paṇa chen nyid kyi sku/ sku 'di'i phyag tshwa bka' gdams lha bzhi /gzhan yang ston pa yab sras gsum gyi sman sku sogs dang sātstsha/ rje rin po che dang / rgyal dbang gong ma rnams kyi na bza'i tshal bu 'phel gdung sogs rten sna tshogs las grub pa'i ril bu'i tshogs mang po/ bla gzungs dang rgyud sde bzhir bshad pa'i gzungs gzhug nor rgyun 'khor dang bcas pa/ rwa lo sprul sku'i phyag 'phreng / dpon slob rin po che'i sku chos dang dbu paṇa/gnas chen mang po'i sa sna sogs byin rlabs kyi rten dang / bkra shis pa'i rdzas mtha' klas pas gtams shing dam ye dbyer med du bsgrubs pas gzi byin lham me bar bzhugs so/ /yang dbyin blum mchod rten gyi nang rten ni/ yang dag par dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / jo bo'i phyag nas/ rnal 'byor pa chen po byang chub rin chen gyi dbu skra/ dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen gyi gdung rus dang na bza'/ rgyal bu gzhon nu don grub kyi chibs bsngags ldan gyi tshems/ smṛ ti'i phyag tshwa thub pa'i sku/ dge ba 'bum gyi gdung rus/123

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/lho brag phyag rdor gyi shangs phyis/ rje tsong kha pa'i dbu skra dang na bza' sna tshogs/ gsang chab ril bu/ byang chub shing gi da rang byon/ rje'i phyag tshwa mi 'khrug pa'i sku/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gye dbu skra/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ byang ba 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen gyi gdung rus/ grub chen dpal 'bar ba'i gdung rus/'bri gung zhabs drung gi dbul lo/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi gdung rus dang na bza'/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ rgyal dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu skra dang na bza'/gsang chab ril bu/ dung dkar 'brug sgra'i sku rags/ rje drung rin po che'i skra lo dang na bza'/ rgyal dbang blo bzang don grub kyi na bza' tshil bu/paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo dang na bza'/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi dbu lo dang na bza'/ gsang chab ril bu/ gtsang dka' chen rin po che'i dbu lo dang na bza'/ khri yang steng ba'i gdung rus dang na bza'/ rgyal sras sprul sku'i skra lo/ sgrub khang dpon slob dge legs rgya mtsho'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ mnga' ris sprul sku'i dbu lo/sems dpa' sprul sku'i skra lo/ stong skor rin po che'i dbu skra/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba/ phyag mdud/ dpon slob rin po che'i me cha/ phyag phreng / khri rin po che 'ga' yi na bza'/ chos rje blo bzang sbyin pa'i dbu skra/ dge slong a rigs pa'i dbu thod/ pur tshwa'i sa/gdung rus sna tshogs dang / na bza' sna tshogs bsres pa'i phye ma rten 'dus ril bu dang / bdud rtsi ril bu sogs ril bu sna tshogs/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas/ chos skyong 'ga' re'i sku 124

༄ /brnyan sogs sku spar du ma/ rgyud sde bzhi'i snying po dang / gzungs chen sde lnga sogs gzungs rigs sna tshogs/ bzang spyod dang gdugs dkar mang po/tshogs bdag 'khor lo sogs dang / dri bzang sna tshogs/ gnas chen mang po'i sa sna chu sna dang / bkra shis pa'i rten rdzas du ma dang bcas 'gro ba'i zhing sa dam par bzhugs so/ /byams mgon thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul dus kyi mthar/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phyir/ / mkhas shing grub brnyes bstan 'dzin skyes mchog gi / rnam rol bla ma yab sras zhabs la 'dud/ / gzhan phan rmad byung thabs mkhas mdzad bzang gis/ / 'gro rnams dga' ldan zhing du 'khrid pa'i phyir/ / snang brnyan mthong ba don ldan bzhengs pa yi/ / dgos don bzhed pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig / phyis su'ang mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gye skyes chen dam pa kha dro'i dpon slob blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang /bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po mkhas grub bstan 'dzin rnam gnyis nas sngon sgom chen rin po ches lung bstan dang bka' phebs kyi don bzhin jo bo'i lha khang du gsar du bzhengs pa rgyal ba byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan mthong ba don 3 na gyi nang rten ni/ thub pa'i dbang po'i 'phel gdung gsum/ jo bo rje dang /'brom rin po che/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ lho brag grub chen/ rje btsun red mda' ba/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyi dbu skra/ mkhas grub khyung po dang / chos rje sgam po pa rnam gnyis kyi gdung rus/ rgyal ba tsong ba pa chen po'i dbu lo dang / na bza'/ gsang chab ril bu/ byams chen chos rje dang 'jam dbyangs chos rje dang gnyis kyi dbu skra dang / na bza'/ rgyal tshab rin po che dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa rnam gnyis kyi dbu lo/ rje dge 'dun grub kyi gdung rus/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub/125

༄/ /yo ca bayo ཿtshonama'i khrung 4ma/grub chen chos kyi rdo rje/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes rnam gsum gyi na bza'/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dbang po/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes rnam gsum gyi dbu skra/ na bza'/ gsang chab ril bu/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen lnga ba chen po/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho rnams kyi dbu skra dang gsang chab ril bu/ rong po bskal ldan rgya mtsho/lcangs ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs/ khri rgyal mtshan seng ge khri ngag dbang mchog ldan/ dpon slob byams pa rin po che/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po/ / dpon slob rin po che/sngags 'chang stobs ldan rgya mtsho/ rje btsun grags pa bshad sgrub/ sgom chen blo bzang bkra shis/ chas pa blo bzang 'phrin las/ co ne dpon slob sangs rgyas dpal bzang / kerte blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ kyo gya dpon slob/ dgon li mkhas mchog be ru dpon slob mthu stobs rgyal mtshan sogs khong rnam gnyis nas chos 'brel mnos pa'i bla ma rnams kyi dbu skra dang na bza'/ srog shing gi ngos bzhir gzungs chen sde lnga gser zhun gyis bris pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i snying bo/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi gso sbyong tshar shin tu mang po sogs chos sku'i ring bsrel 'dri sbar grangs las 'das pa bri bsgrub dang / gos dar gyi na bza' brtsegs ma mang po phul te go rim ma 'khrugs par bzhugs pa'i bar mtshams dri bzang sna tshogs kyi phye mas gtams pa/ bris 'bur ci rigs pa'i sku brnyan gyi rim pa'ang rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ thub dbang / mi 'khrugs pa/ sman bla bde gshegs 126

༄ rabargyad/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/ bka' gdams lha bzhi/ byams pa/ bcu gcig zhal/ sgrol dkar ljang / rigs gsum mgon po/ rje yab sras/ lam rim brgyud pa/nye sras brgyad/ gnas brtan bcu drug dzo dkar/ nor lha/ mgon chos rnam sras sogs kyi sku brnyan mang po dang / gzhan yang byin rten sku 'bum tsan dan shing gi cha shas lo ma/ rten bsdus ril bu/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ skye bdun dang / na ṇi dung phyur mang po bsgrubs zin gyi ril bu sogs dang / rgya gar nag bal bod/ tsā ri/ ri bo rtse lnga sogs gnas 'gang che mang bo'i sa sna chu sna rdo sna bkra shis pa'i rten rdzas du ma dang dzi dkar dang / tshogs bdag gi gter 'khor sogs stod smad bar gsum du bzhugs rgyu'i gzungs gzhug gi rim pa paṇa chen rin po che dang / rgyal dbang gi gzungs gzhug gi rnam gzhag dang mthun par bsgrubs te/ rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dam pa'i phyag bzhes nyams pa med par bsgrubs te/'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa bla na med par bzhugs so/ /skor tshad ni rten gtso la gzhal te/ de la 'bum phrag gcig 'gro ba'i tshod la skor 'bum zhes brtsi ba'i grol 'dug pa bzhin/ sku gsung yid bzhin nor bu'i mchod rten rnam gnyis la gzhal ba'i dbang du btang na nang skor khri tsho gcig dgon pa'i phyi skor la stong tsho gnyis dang lnga brgyas grangs legs par 'gro zhing / skor ba byed tshul dang / phyag mchod skor ba rnams kyi phan yon sogs ni dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung las 'byung ba dang /kho bo'i mchod rten mthong grol chen mo'i dkar chag tu bris yod pa sogs las shes par bya'o/ / ma 'ongs skye dgu tshe lo brgyad khri'i tshe/ / ma pham bstan pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug 'dod rnams/ / rnam 'dren de la brten pa'i legs 127

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/ byas kyi/ / bsod nams gru gzings tshags su tshud par gyis/ / dal pa'i rten thob rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ / rlabs chen bsod nams 'ing gis mi phongs pa/ / 'di 'dra'i rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i dus/ / don med kyi nar sdod rnams kye ma ho/ / phyag mchod skor ba la sogs lus kyi las/ / bzlas brjod gsol 'debs chad med ngag gi las/ / rtse gcig mos gus bsgom pa'i yid las rnams/ / rtag tu sgrub pas dal 'byor don yod mdzod/ / de lta'i rnam dkar lhur len skye bo rnams/ / dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dngos/ / bla ma yab sras thugs rje'i kyo ba yis/ /nam yang mi gtong srid las 'dren par nges/ / mchog gsum rten dang brten pa 'di dag la/ / gus pa lhun len 'brel thogs sgye bo kun/ / mi khom gnas su nam yang mi sgye bar/ / dal ba'i rten la lam bzang bgrod gyur cig / gang gi thugs rje byin rlabs la brten nas/ / dgon gnas 'dir yang khrims lda na 'dus pa'i tshogs/ / bshad sgrub dang bcas dbyar mtsho bzhin 'phel bas/ / dge ldan lugs bzang yun du skyong gyur cig / rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi spyan snga ru/ / rdo rje'i g.yar dam lhur bzhes srung tshogs kyis/ / mchog gsum rten dang dpon slob yon mchod kun/ / rtag tu srung skyob bya ra ma g.yel mdzod/ / mdor na bstan 'dzin tshogs rnams zhabs pad brtan/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ / 'gro kun chos 'byor bde dges 'tsho ba yi/ / dge legs rgya mtshos nor 'dzin khyab gyur cig / ces khya dge legs bshad gling gi rten rnams kyi dkar chag phyogs bsdebs su byas pa 'di ni/ snga ma'i dkar chag ldeb ris su bzhugs pa rnams ha cang bgres spyon gyis nub par nye bas skye bo rnams kyi dad pa'i gsos su 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes dad brtson pa dge slong dkon mchog dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon 128

༄ ramachog bstan pa'i sgron mes dgon gsar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling du bris pa'o/ /yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi zhal nas/ dri med lung rigs sgra snyan sgogs pa'i tshal/ / rmad byung thos bsam gling gi sde chen 'dir/ / rgyan drug mchog gnyis lta bu'i mkhas mang gis/ / yongs gang bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog / ces gsungs pa ltar/ mdo rgyud tshad ma'i lung dang dpyad gsum dag pa'i rigs lam gyi dbyangs snyan skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsir spro zhing / thub bstan mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar mdzad pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis lta bu'i mkhas mang 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i snyan dbang zab mo'i drung du gang zhu na/ rgyal ba mi yi nyi ma rnam 'dren shākya seng ge de nyid skye rgu tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su byon te/ mchog gi sprul ma'i mdzad pa'i gtso bo ni chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba 'di yin/ de'ang bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyis mdzod dang 'dul ba/ bka' bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor gyis dbu ma dang phar phyin/ bka' tha ma legs phye'i chos 'khor gyis rnam rig pa'i lugs rnam 'grel ltar gsungs pa yin pas/ chos 'khor gsum/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ chos phung brgyadakhri bzhi stong zer ba thams cad kyis bka' pod lnga po 'di gsungs pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'ang lung rtogs gnyis las ma 'das shing /rtogs pa'i bstan pa bslab pa gsum du grangs nges/ lung gi bstan pa sde snod gsum du grangs nges/ des na tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ston byed 'dul pa yin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa ston byed mdo sde kun gyi gco bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ shes rab kyi bslab pa ston byed mngon pa gnyis yod pas mngon pa mdzod/ mngon pa gong ma dbu ma/ rigs pa'i mngon pa rnams 'grel yin pas 'di lnga'i tshig don la ma 'dus pa'i sangs 129

༄/ /༅ ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung lam/rgyas kyi bstan pa zhig med/ rgya gar paṇa grub gnam kyi skar ma lta bu byon pa'i nang na nyi zla ltar grags pa 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis yin/de'i nang nas klu sgrub yab sras gnyis kyis dbu ma/ thogs med sku mched gnyis kyis phar phyin dang mdzod/ phyogs glang chos grags gnyis kyis gtan tshigs gsum dang blo rigs bdun sogs tshad ma'i skor/ yon shāka gnyis kyis 'dul ba'i dgongs don bkral te rgya gar chos kyi 'byung gnas zer ba de byung ba yin/ de'i rgyun chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyis byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir spyan drangs te mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad sgrub gnyi ga'i sgo nas spel/ khyad par mnyam med jo bo chen pos lung bstan te rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang ne'u tog btab nas rtsod gra'i srol btsugs/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge sogs kyis je rgyas su btang / lhag par 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras kyis gdan sa chen po gsum la sogs pa btab nas bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ mdo las bstan pa byang nas byang du dar bar gsungs pa dang / bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bod byang gi phyogs nas byang phyogs su/ / mi khyod kyi sprul pa dam pa zhig / ces sogs kyi lung bstan dus la bab pa na bshad grwa kun gyi chu mgo gangs la thug pa lta bu gsang ne'u tog nas kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje nyid la/ nyid kyi legs par bshad pas sa steng khyab par lung bstan byung ba bzhin/ sngon med kyi legs bshad bka' pod chen po lnga mdzad pas deng sang stod dza ti'i me tog bkra ba nas shar rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du thos bsam rnal ma zhig byed 'dod pa kun gyi mig gcig pur gyur pa 'di byung ba yin/de'i nang nas kyang thugs bskyed kyi bka' bab pa dang / byin rlabs kyi bcud 'khyil pa ni gong gi lung bstan bzhin bod chen po mdo khams smad kyi 130

sa bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos gra chen po bkra shis 'khyil 'di nyid dang /de'i nang nas kyang grwa tshang thos bsam gling 'di nyid yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis grwa tshang 'di'i chos 'chad nyan/ 'grig lam kun spyod sogs gra ma chagagru ma nyams pa zhig bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa bar gal che bas/khur len gnas skabs kyi las sna rnams kyis byed dgos stabs dbyar chos dgun chos gnyis kyi mtshams su dge bskos gsar ba lang skabs bca' yig gi steng nas tshogs gtam rgyas pa re 'bul ba'i srol yod pa bzhin zhu ba 95 /'o lags so/ / mdo rgya cher rol pa las/ 'chi dang 'pho dang 'chi 'pho dus byed pa/ / phangs shing sdug pa'i skye bo rtag tu 'bral/ / phyir mi 'ong zhing 'phrad par 'gyur ma yin/ / shing las lo 'grul 'dra zhing klung rgyun mtshungs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung ste 'khor ba 'dir las kyi rlung gis bdas te gnas mtho dman sna tshogs par lus bzang ngan ci rigs pa re blangs/ lus re re blangs pa'i skabs su de'i ming la tshe 'di zhes btags nas der yun ring zhig sdod rgyu'i grab shom/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la sogs pa don med pa'i bya ba mang po zhig la mgo 'khor nas bsdad yod pa'i thog tu 'chi bdag gi pho nyas slebs te/tshe de'i lus longs spyod gnyen nye du grogs mdza' bshes thams cad shul du bzhag rang nyid gcig pu mar nang nas spu bton pa bzhin 'jig rten phyi ma'i gnas su 'gro dgos pa ni mtho tshangs pa dang brgya byen 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal po tshun chad nas/ dma' 'bu srin phra mo yan chad kyi steng du khyad par med par 'bab nges pa yin/ de thog tu babs pa'i tshe na thabs gang gis kyang bzlog tu med pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/131

༄/ /༅ ca bayo pa'i sgonama'i ga4 'bum/mgyogs po'i 'gros dang stobs kyis bzlog tu med/ / zas nor sman dang sngags kyis bzlog tu med/ gsungs pa ltar yin/ de lta bu'i zlog med kyi 'chi ba de che chung rgan gzhon thams cad kyi steng du go rim nges pa med par gnam rdo bzhin du bab pa las da lan khyod kyi thog tu babs pa yin/ de la 'gyod pa dang skrag pas go mi chod/ 'jigs pa'i 'phrang 'di nas thar ba dang phyi mar bde ba nas bde bar 'gro ba'i thabs shig byed dgos/ de'i thabs nye 'brel shul na yod pa rnams kyis dge rtsa sdig dang ma 'dres pa zhig byas/ nged cag la'ang rang ngos nas nus pa med rung bla ma dkon mchog la blo bkal te cho ga tshul dang mthun par byas/ gtso bor dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa khyod rang gis sems 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang la sogs pa'i dbang du ma btang bar/ skabs 'di yar 'gro mar 'gro'i so mtshams/ skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad bla ma dkon mchog la gtad dgos pa'i dus su 'dug snyam nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs thub na/ bla ma dkon mchog gi ngos nas thugs rjes gzigs pa skad cig kyang dus las yol mi srid pas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad 'dzom lugs 'dis gtan du skyid pa'i mgo zhig tshugs thub par 'dug snyam du dga' ba skyed dgos/ da lta chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis rkyen byed pa'i snang ba yid du 'ong mi 'ong sna tshogs pa 'char mod kyang / gson pa'i dus na rmi lam rmis pa dang 'dra bas de la dga' bas chags pa skye don dang / mi dga' bas 'jigs skrag skye don gang yang med/ der chags sdang gi blo skyes na slar yang ma dag pa'i skye gnas dman pa rnams su 'khrid pa'i nyen yod pas/ dran shes ba'in shugs drag tu bsten nas dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu tshud nges pa zhig byed dgos/ des na nged kyis dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor gye 132

༄ mdo'akhor lo'am dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhal phye ste cho ga tshul bzhin du bsgrubs/ nyam thag lus can rnams kyi mgon skyabs su smon lam gyi mthu lhag par btsan pas mtshan thos pa tsam gyis kyang ngan song ngan 'gro'i skye sgo mtha' dag bkag nas zhing mchog bde ba can du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan bla na ma mchis pa mgon po 'od dpag med nye ba'i sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs te mdun du bzhugs yod pas/ nged kyis gsol 'debs kyi tshigs brjod pa'i rjes su 'brangs te re sa gzhan na med pa'i dad gdung shugs drag po skyed par mdzod/ /'o de'ang rnam snang mngon byang las/ bskal ba bye ba du ma ru/ / sdeg pa gang zhig byas pa yang / / 'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba yis/ / de ma thag tu zad 'gyur na/ / grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ tshul 'a brten na smos ci dgos/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba phra rags kyi mtsho las rgal bar byed pa'i thabs la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa las zab pa med cing / gsang sngags rdo rje zeg pa de la spyod pa'i tshul dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ sngags kyi rtsa ba dang por tshul khrims te/ zhes dang por dbang rnam par dag pa thob/ de nas dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad tshe gcig nyid la bde blag tu 'grub nus bing /tha na dad pa bcos ma tsam gyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor lan gcig mthong ba tsam gyis kyang bskal ba du mar bsags pa'i sdig ltung mtha' yas pa skad cig nyid la sbyong nus pa yin/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las kyang / ngas bris mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / / gtsang ma'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ / zhes mngon mtho'i rten khyad par can thob pa dang / mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal por/ 'khrugs bzhin pa yi sems kyis bltas na yang / de dag gis kyang byang chub mchog 133

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i g.yo ཿma/'di 'thob/ / ces mthar thug nges legs thob par gsungs pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa brjod kyis mi lang / dbang chog 'di nang du'ang / tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / / 'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang / /sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob 'gyur na/ / lha mi'i bde ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes gnas skabs mthar thug gi dgos don thams cad sgrub nus par gsungs yod pa 'di yin/ dbang bskur ba la grub chen dril bu zhabs kyis/dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar/ / rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste/ / zhes dkyil 'khor du bcug cing lha ngo ston pa sogs sngon du byed dgos/dkyil 'khor ston pa'i rim pa'ang phyi rim dang nang rim nas ston tshul rgyud dang grub chen gyi bzhed srol sna tshogs pa yod kyang / skabs 'dir rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ sgo pa rdo rje lcags kyu nas bcom ldan 'das la thug gi bar du bstan to/ / zhes gsungs shing / rdo rje 'byung ba las kyang de ltar gsungs pas phyi rim nas ston dgos/ de'ang 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs srung ba'i 'khor lo me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rim pa gnyis su yod pa'i nang ma'i shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog byang sgor rdo rje 'bebs pa/ phyi'i shar lhor bdug spos ma/ lho nub tu me tog ma/ nub byang du mar me ma/ byang shar du dri chab ma/ nang gi shar lhor sgeg mo/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma/ nub byang du glu ma/ byang shar du gar ma/ shar gye rtsibs dang po la rdo rje sems dpa'/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rgyal po/ gsum pa la rdo rje chags pa / bzhi pa la rdo rje legs pa/ lho'i rtsibs dang po la rdo rje rin chen/ gnyis pa la rdo rje gzi brjid/ gsum pa 1༅

༄/ /la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bzhi pa la rdo rje bzhad pa/ nub kyi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje chos/ gnyi4pa la rdo rje rnon po/ gsum pa la rdo rje rgyu/ bzhi pa la rdo rje smra ba/ byangagi rtsibs dang po la rdo rje las/ gnyis pa la rdo rje srung ba/gsum pa la rdo rje gnod sbyin/ bzhi pa la rdo rje khu tshur rnams dang / shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma gī/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma/ shar du ngan song sbyong pa'i rgyal po/ lhor rgyal mchog rin chen/nub tu shākya rigs dbang / byang du me tog cher rgyas/ dbus su dkyil 'khor lo gye 'khor mtha' dag spro zhing sdud pa'i byed po chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad de lha so bdun gye rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ces brda sprad/ /de'ang kun mkhyen bla ma mchog gi zhal gyi bum bzang las/ ngag dbang lha mo mgrin mtshor zhugs pa las/ / blo bzang legs bshad chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgogs/ / thub chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng mkhas pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zab yangs chos tshul mi zad ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dbyangs can dad pa'i bu mo longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'o mtshor ci dgas rol ba'i gar dang lhan cig / blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad snyan pa'i rdza rnga phyogs brgyar 'khrol ba'i khri chen mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi dus mchod dang 'brel bar rnam thar lo rgyus cung zad zhu bar byed pa la/ de'ang khri thog lnga bcu ba rje btsun shes rab seng ge'i rnam 'phrul du lha dang bla ma'i lung gis zin pa'i skyes mchog mdo sngags bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag135

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs dpal bzang po de nya had mdo smad kyi yul 'dir sku 'khrungs/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du phebs nas thos bsam mthar phyin te kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i nang gi thugs sras gcig bur gyur/ rgyud smad kyi mkhan por phebs nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi 'chad nyan rmang btsugs shing / 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi tshig don kun la rje bla ma'i dgongs pa ltar gyi dag ther mdzad de par du bskrun pas phyi rabs kyi bla gra thams cad legs pa'i lam du dbugs dbyung / rgyud khang gsum dang gzhis ka mang po sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas rgya cher bskyangs te/ dga' ldan khrir phebs/ rje bla ma'i gser gdung chen mo bzhengs shing / gdan sa chen po bzhi'i chos srid kyi khur ma lus pa bzhes te ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa'i srog shing gcig pur gyur/ rgyal dbang thams can mkhyen pa ye shes rgya mtsho dang / khri chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang mchog ldan sogs gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob kyis nor 'dzin yongs su khyab/mthar mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung zhugs la phul bar 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sku rang byon du phebs/ de nas mi ring bar dga' ldan shod du sku 'khrungs/ lhan skyes dam pa'i rang bzhin dang /'khrul bral lung gi gtan tshigs la brten nas gdan sar bkod/ dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grar phebs yod pa'i skabs sde khri rin po che sogs nas 'char bstan pa ltar / yul mdo smad kyi ma ga dha bzang mo dpon mo rnam rgyal sgrol mas gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang du zhus te mchod gnas su gdan drangs/ gdan sa chen po 'di ka rang du gsan sbyong mthil phyin pa mdzad pas/ mdo sngags/ sgra snyan/ sman rtsis sogs rig gnas rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid sogs dam pa du 136

༄ /ma las chos kyi bdud rtsi ngoms med du bzhes pas dbang lung khrid man ngag phyagabazhes sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa yongs kyi gter du gyur/byams snying rje mtshungs pa med pa'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur pas skal ldan rnams la mos pa bzhin du chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'dod dgur stsal pas mtha' 'khob 'di yang chos kyi 'byung khungs lta bur mdzad/ lhag par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dang sngar nas thugs bskyed smon lam lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis rdo rje 'chab dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs nas dgon par phra nyag gi skabs su gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong lan gnyis mdzad de chos srid zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bskyangs pa sogs bka' drin bsam las 'das/ de nas dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi ri khrod btab ste lam thun mong ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas zhi lhag gi bar dang /gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs bstan pa'i gnad kun rdzogs pa'i nyams bzhes lhur mdzad de sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ de nas snyan grags kyi ba dan dkar pos sa steng kun khyab par gyur te/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos kyang gser gyi rgyal khab chen por gdan drangs nas bkur gzos bla na med pa mdzad/ de nas gdul bya'i tha ma ma hā tsi na'i yul gyi 'gro ba rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod de dgung lo so gsum pa sa mo yos kyi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin gzugs sku'i bkod pa nyer zhi'i dbyings su bsdus te dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i mdun sar phebs pa'i dus chen khyad par can yin pas thams cad kyis de don thugs la bzhag nas bla ma'i yon tan shes pa'i dad pa/ bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i gus pa/dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa/ lta 'dur dbyangs dang bcas 137

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sgronama'i ga ཿma/pa'i zhal 'don/ bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i kun spyod/ rgya chen thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba/ lam gye gtso bo gsum gyi nyams len/ mtshan bcas mtshan med pa'i rnal 'byor/ gsang chen rim gnyis zab mo'i ting 'dzin/ dge tshogs gong du spel ba'i bsngo smon sogs sgo thams cad nas thugs yengs spyan yengs su ma song bas bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs gnad du 'gro nges shig ci nas kyang bka' drin skyong bar zhu/ /de'ang ji skad du/ skyabs mgon thams cad gzigs pa chen po'i zhal nas/ skye dgu'i bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ zhes pa nas/ rgyal tshab dam par 'dud/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ lhar bcas skye dgu yongs kyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa 'di nyid phyogs brgyar spel ba la thugs skyed dang rnam dpyod mtshungs zla med pa'i grags pa lha'i rnga bo che'i dbyangs snyan 'jig rten gsum du khyab pa khri chen dpal ldan grags pa zhes bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen bla na med par gyur pa de nyid yul mdo smad kyi ljongs dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas mchog rgan gyi brag dkar gyi nye 'dab gnyan chen sngo la g.yu rtse'i lha zhol hor tshang ko nyin gyi lung pa'i dbon sa seni bco brgyad sogs rim par 'ong pa'i brgyud/ rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa shing sā la chen po lta bur yab mgon po seng ge dang yum skyid mo yag gnyis kyi sras su dge mtshan du ma'i ltas dang bcas te 'khrungs/gzhon nu nas theg mchog rigs kyi nus pa yongs su smin pas nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems kyis thugs rgyud bskul te rab tu byung zhing dbus gtsang chos kyi mdun sar dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grar phebs rigs pa'i 138

༄/ /sgo 'byed bsdus gra nas bzung bka' pod chen po lnga la sbyangs pas smra ba'i dbang phyug chen por gyur/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi cod pan du bkur te mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho nas chu bcu ba bzhin du bzhes pas thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang ste chos kyi mdzod du gyur/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog nas kyang shin tu dgyes pa chen pos phas bu skyong ba bzhin spyan ras kyis btsa' bar mdzad/ khri rgyal mtshan se chos gra zhugs te dam pa 'di nyid dge rgan tu brten nas nyin gcig gsol tshigs kyi snyan gsan phab ste gdan 'dren la pheb pa'i shul du dam pa 'di dang yulagacig pa'i dge bshes kyi ming can phrag dog gis rgyud dkrugs pa zhig gis bzhes par dug btab/ phyi nyin rgyal mtshan sene tshang dge rgan gye mdun du phebs nas ma bde tshul zhus pas nga yang kha sang nas bde rgyu mi 'dug yin mi shes pas nged rang gnyis dpon slob kyi mdun du 'gro zhes kun mkhyen bla ma mchog gi spyan sngar pheb/ gnas tshul zhus pa na nga'i dga' ldan gser khri gnyis la bstan bshig cig gis bsam ngan byas pa yin par 'dug gsung ste zhar la rnam pa gnyis ka dga' ldan khrir pheb rgyu lung bstan/ skyon med gsung nas bum chu gnang bas phyir spyi khang du pheb pa'i lam kha de rang du bskyugs te nyer 'tshe'i yul las rgyal bar mdzad/ smon lam gye mtshon btags gnang ste gdan sa gsum gyi mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs bshad dga' ston spel bas grags snyan dbyar rnga bzhin du ldir/ de nas rgyud grar phebs te sngags kyi gsan sbyong mthar phyin mdzad pas rgyud stod bla ma dbu mdzad dang rgyud pa mkhan po shar rtse'i mkhan sa rnams su rim par pheb/ khri thog lnga bcu pa khri dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i rjes su nga gcig pa rje 'di nyid 'jam mgon bla ma'i chos kyi khri la mnga' gsol te gser mdog cod paṇa 139

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgronas gsung 'bum/'chang ba yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur/ dga' ldan nas ngag dbang mchog ldan zer ba zhig la rma chen gyi lha thor bsang gtong du bcug skabs khos gyon pa zhig byung na snyam 'phrin bcol byas pa mngon shes kyis mkhyen te phyag mdzod la ster du bcug pa sogs gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa'ang shin tu mang /yer ba'i rgyud khang gsar rgyag dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur sogs kyang rgya chen po mdzad/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin mdzad de dbu ma'i gsan sbyong skabs kyi brtsi bzhag 'bul ba gnang zhing / paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi zhabs drung nas bsnyen rdzogs bzhes dus las slob mdzad/ rgyal ba mgar thar du chibs bsgyur ba'i zhabs phyir phebs shing de nas mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan pa'i sku gdung zhugs la phul bar 'jam dbyangs dang 'jigs byed kyi sku rang byon/sngags kyi yi ge mang po thugs ljags spyan gsum/ zhun thigs nor bu dga' 'khyil gyi dbyings can sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rten mang po byon pas skye bo rnams dad pa'i sa la bkod/ de nas ma 'gyang bar sku gong ma'i 'khrungs yul de nyid du sku 'khrungs/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan ni kun mkhyen bla mas phar phyin skabs dang po'i bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad las/ da dung lnga phrag drug skad bden snyam nas/ / thub dbang 'khor gyi rgyal sras dpa' mang gis/ / thub bstan spel ba'i thugs skyed mi 'dor bas/ / 'di phyi'i skal mnyam la bsams g.yar khral 'ang yin/ zhes sngon thub pa'i dbang po'i drung du kun mkhyen bla ma rang nyid nas lnga brgya tha ma'i dus su bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa dang / rgyal sras dpa' bo gzhan rnams kyis kyang de'i 'phro skyong ba'i dam bca' mdzad tshul zhal gyes bzhes pa dang / kun mkhyen gong ma mdo smad ru pheb khar sgom pa rin chen bstan 'dzin gyis mdo smad nas dgon btab nyid 140

sa / /kyi sku ring la rgyas mod kyang 'phro ci 'dra yin zhus par nga'i rjes la sangs rgyas byang sems du mas bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes nas bskyang 'ong gsung ba'i gtso bo gser khri rnams yin zhes kun mkhyen sku bar mas rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid la dngos su gsungs/ grub dbang sde khri rin po che nas tshogs chen 'du khang du kun mkhyen bla ma'i sku'i g.yas g.yon rgyal tshab mkhas grub gnyis kyi tshul du khri dge 'dun phun tshogs dang khye dpal ldan grags pa rnam gnyis 'bri rgyu'i zhal bkod mdzad pa'ang rten 'brel gyi sgo dang ma 'ong lung bstan lta bu yin pas/ dam pa 'di nyid hor tshang du 'khrungs nas ma 'gyang bar dgon gnas 'di nyid du yar pheb/ khri dge 'dun phun tshogs pa'i sprul sku dbus su 'khrungs kyang dpon mo rnam rgyal sgrol mas gdan drangs te mar pheb pas rnam pa gnyis ka zhal 'dzom/ bgres gzhon gyis 'dzin gra gong 'og yod kyang chos gra lhan du 'grim/ lo gcig than pa che bas khong rnam gnyis gra tshang dang bcas bya lag la char 'beb tu pheb/ char 'beb gnang tsam nyid nas glo bur du sprin bsdus te char drag chen po bab pas/ dam pa de nyid zhabs thang yin stabs gung thang rin po che'i chibs pa la rnam pa gnyis gas bcibs te gra pa gzhon pa kha shas dang bcas mgyogs 'gros kyis phebs pa bcos ma 'i mdzesalam gyis ma bslad pa'i dam pa'i ngang tshul dang thugs nang thin tu che ba'i rang rtags yin/ rgyus yod med kyi skye bo sus mthong yang dang ba 'dren pa zhi zhing dul ba'i rnam thar byams snying rje'i rang mdangs mngon par shar pa'i ya mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yin 'dug kyang sde rgan rin po che dag zhing du pheb pa'i rkyen gyes thugs skyo ba dang sku tshe de'i dngos kyi 'dul skal rdzogs pa'i dbang gis dgung lo bcu bdun gyi steng du mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan ma 'gyang bar yang srid 'byon rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba'i don 141
