༄/ /ca ca b.lo 4 sa rsāng 'am/bzhin de'i lo mjug la hor tshang 'bru 'dren gyi lung par khyu mchog gi rigs su 'khrungs/ dgung lo bzhi pa'i dus skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs drung du gtsug phud phul te mtshan 'jigs med grags par gsol/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus nas phyir phebs pa la chibs bsu zhu skabs 'di nas chos grar bzhugs dgos tshul gyi bka' gnang ba bzhin skyabs mgon mchog nas dgon pa'i 'chad nyan gyi khri mdzad pa'i thog ma'i nyin sde khri rin che'i sprul pa'i sku dang rnam pa gnyi ga chos grar lhan du zhugs te ring mo zhig nas thugs skyed smon lam lhan cig pa'i 'bras bzang dus su smin pa'i dge mtshan gsal bar shar/ skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs pad nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te 'jigs med rig pa'i seṅge zhes ngur sprig 'chang ba kun gyi rje bor mnga' gsol/ 'di nas dbu ma man chad la gsan sbyong gnang zhing / dgung lo nyer bzhi pa la dbus su phebs te lo ngo bcu'i ring bka' pod yongs su rdzogs par thugs gnyer gnang ste gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu'i dgongs don ma tshang ba med par thugs su chud/ rgyal ba yab sras/ yongs 'dzin rin po che/ rgyal sras rin po che/ klong rdol grub pa'i dbang phyug brag rgyab bla ma/ nyi ma thang dge bshes ngag dbang don grub sogs las mdo sngags kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ mdo smad du phebs te skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs drung nas kyang dbang lung khrid man ngag sogs gdams pa'i nor bu thugs kyi gan mdzod byur bur gtams/brag lung gi sgrub sde 'dzin skyong gnang zhing de phyogs kyi skye bo dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs te chos 'chad nyan sogs yar rgyas kyi zla ba bzhin 'phel zhing rigs grwa gsum btang ba sogs chos srid gnyis ga'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong bsam gyis mi khyab pa bka' drin bskyangs/142

༄ /skyabs mgon rin po cher rin 'byung gi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' mang du phul/ zhabs brtan lha khang gnas brtan brag ri ma'i bkod pa dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs tsha kho'i phyogs su'ang chibs bsgyur nas skye bo mtha' yas pa smin grol la bkod/ mdor na dgung lo bdun cu'i bar du skal ldan gyi gdulakhya so so la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par dbang lung man ngag sogs kyi char 'bebs pas thar 'dod yongs kyi ded dpon dang 'gro ba mchog dman kun la legs nyes blang dor ma lus pa gsal bar ston pa'i dmigs bur gyur te bstan 'gro kun la bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad bzang lhun gyis grub nas mthar gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'i dus chen la dmigs te/khyad par du rje btsun bla ma mchog gi yang srid 'khrul ba med pa myur du byon te gdan sar mnga' gsol nas rje gong ma ji lta ba bzhin mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar dang / bstan 'gror sman pa'i 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar pos nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon kun yongs su khyab pa'i dga' ston la dus myur ba nyid du longs spyod chog pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs smon rnam par dag pa'i mtshams spyor sogs nan tan du mdzad dgos ci nas kyang g.yel ba med pa zhu lags/ /ahā shā pā di pu dzā ba rā mi ta anu tpan ru rnye byom bha pata brati su biduston tsa zlode sha tra las ladza yo mā tra yenam smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ / ma skyes ma 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal ba ma lus skyed mdzad sher phyin ma/ / lhan skyes dga' ba'i mchog sbyin rnal 'byor ma/ / sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mi yi gzugs can 143

༄/ /ca thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 4ma/ ma/ / ma gcig lab kyi sgron mas deng 'dir skyongs/ / mang thos dam gtsang byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs/ / zhen med tshogs chen myur du rdzogs 'dod pas/ / dpen par rten dgram rkang gling ḍa ma ru/ / mchod gtor sogs bshams skyabs sems sngon btang ste/ / phaṭa/ gdod nas spros bral stong ba'i rang gdangs las/ / pad zla'i gdan ldar bdag nyid yum chen mo/ / ma gcig lab kyi sgron ma sku mdog dkar/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje rin chen padma dang / / las kyi mkha' 'gro sngo ser dmar ljang mdog / bcu drug lang tsho'i sgeg 'chang nu 'bur rgyas/ / g.yas na gser gyi cang te'u 'khrol lo lo/ / g.yon na dngul dkar dril bu sil li li/ / g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs ling ling bsgyur/ / gnag snum ral pa'i thor cog ldems se ldem/ / rus pa'i rgyan ldan dar gyi na bza' gsol/ / rab mdzes 'dzum zhing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan/ / phaṭa/ gnas gsum rdo rje gsum mtshan hūṃ 'od kyis/ / sde lnga'i mkha' 'gro spyan drangs dbyer med bstim/ /slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs bdud rtsi'i rgyas/ / dbang bskur rigs lngas dbu la brgyan par gyur/ phaṭa/ oṃ ā :/ ha ho tī / ma tshang med pa kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs/ / bde chen dbyings su dgyes rol ar li ho / / phaṭa/ dmigs med stong nyid shes rab pha rol phyin/ / bde ba mchog gis rgyas btab wa ra tī/ / gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dbang phyug ma/ / a ma lab kyi sgon mar phyag 'tshal lo/ / snying ga'i sngags dang sa bon 'od zer gyis/ / rgyal rnams mchod cing byen rlabs mtha' dag bsdus/ / rigs drug 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas sbyangs/ / kun kyang yum chen gsang gsum rol par gyur/ / bzlas pa thun mong du byed na gtso mo'i thugs dkar zla ba la a yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor bar 144

༄ rabasams te ga te bzla ba'am/ sa bon baṃ yig gi mthar/ oṃ ā tshu gu ru baṃ ha ri ni sa sirnyi dza zhes pas bskor par bsams nas bzlas kyang rung / so sor bzla bar 'dod na rang rang gi thugs gar sa bon sngags 'phreng bkod la oṃ budha ḍa ki nī hūṃ phaṭa sāhā/ zhes dang / budha'i tshab tu/ badzra/ radro/padma/ gaspo rnams bcug ste bzla/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang slar yang kun bzang mchod pas yongs su tshim/ / tshim yang dmigs pa ma mchis stong par shes/ / shes rab pha rol phyin dngos dbyings kyi yum/ / ru ma chen mkha' 'gro'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ tshogs 'khor bya bar 'dod na mchod gtor sogs bshams la/ oṃ ā shā ha ho hrī / chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings dang / / dbyer med bde chen rol pas/ / tshogs mchod zag med bdud rtsi'i/ / rgya mtsho chen por gyur cig / phaṭa/ yum chen thugs las 'od zer mkha' khyab spros/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing khams nas/ / dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i gnas mchog nas/ / mtha' yas mu med phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nas/ / mchog 'bring dman pa'i mgron kun 'dir lhags shing / / 'od gsal dag pa'i lha yi 'khor lor gyur/ phaṭa/ gnas dag pa mkha' spyod rdo rje'i grong / / yul dag pa dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs/ / rdzas dag pa snang stong mchod pa'i sprin/ / a la la zag med dga' ba'i ngang / /phaṭa/ / drin can rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchod dang / / stob cig rol cig bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ / yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs mchod/ /stob cig rol cig dngos grub char du phob/ / bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum mchod/ / stob cig rol cig thar pa'i lam du drongs/ / gsan gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mchod/ / stob cig rol cig sngags kye bog 145

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i 0 ཿ khrung ཿma/'byin mdzod/ / dam can chos srung rgya mtsho mchod/ / stob cig rol cig rkyen ngan bar chad sol/ / yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan po mchod/ / stob cig rol cig sdongs grogs gnas po mdzod/ / mkha' khyab rigs drug sems can mchod/ / stob cig rol cig sgrib pa byang gyur cig / gdon bgegs sha 'khon gnyer ba mchod/ / stob cig rol cig bu lon 'khor gyur cig /ces brjod cing re re bzhin 'bul ba'i stangs gar bya/ de nas tshogs rdzas lag tu thogs/ phaṭa/ bdag nyid dpa' bo'i dbang phyug / rang lus lha yi 'khor lo/ / a ho ma hā su kha/ kye ma bde ba chen po/ / ces brjod cing longs spyod/ kha khrus btab pa'i tshogs lhag gtor zhing / phaṭa/ 'byung po lhag la dbang ba thams cad mchod/ / stob cig rol cig re ba tshim gyur cig phaṭa/ zhen med kyi ngang nas sbyin pa btang / / dmigs med kyi dbyings su tshogs chen rdzogs/ / sgrib med kyi rang don chos sku brnyes/ /tshad med kyi 'gro ba'i don byed shog / lus sbyin ni tshogs 'khor gyi 'phro yin na spyan 'dren zur du mi dgos la/ min na yum chen thugs las 'do zer /zhes pa nas/ lha yi 'khor lor gyur/ ces spyan 'dren/ phaṭa/ rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gro rgyangs kyis thon/ / rang lus tsho snum bem po ling gis 'gyel/ / ye shes mkha' 'gros bam chen pags pa bshus/ / sha khrag phung khams dwangs snyigs so sor phye/ / phaṭa/ dwangs ma a las byung pa'i thod par bskol/ / sbyangs rtogs sbar byas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ bla ma yid dam mchog gsum srung ma'i tshogs/ / rigs drug gdon bgegs mgron rnams ma lus mchod/ / phaṭa/ snyigs ma dmar chen sha yi ri bo dang / /khrag zhag klad pa rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum srung ma'i tshogs/ / rigs drug gdon bgegs mgron rnams ma lus mchod/ phaṭa/146

༄ rapags pa dum bur gtubs pa zas nor sogs/ / lha mi'i longs spyod mkho dgu'i dngos por gyur/ / bla ma yi dam mchog gsum srung ma'i tshogs/ /rigs drug gdon bgegs mgron rnams ma lus mchod/ / 'khor 'das kun gyi dngos po gdod nas stong / / rnam pa rten cing 'brel 'byung cir yang snang 'char/ snang pa 'ja' tshon bzhin du mtha' nas bsdus/ / don gyi sher phyin spros bral dbyibs su phaṭa/ / ces pa 'di ni sprul sku dkon mchog bsod nams rgya mtshosabaskulangor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /slob ma'i spyi bor pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum chen shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma mi'i gzugs can ma gcig lab kyi sgon ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol lo lo khrol zhing / g.yon pas dngul dkar gyi dril bu gsil ba/ dar gyi na bza' gsol zhing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs ling ling bzhugs pa/mkha' 'gro sde lnga sogs dpa' bo ḍā kyi'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ rang bzhinadag pa'i klong nas ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ skyabs gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yum chen lab kyi sgron ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams sgo gsum gyi nyes spyod mtha' dag lasasbangs shig / skyobs shing / / steng gdon gza'i gnod pa las srungs shig / skyobs shig / bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po'i gnod pa las srungs shig / skyobs shig / 'og gdon klu'i gnod pa las srungs shig / skyobs shig / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa las srungs shig /147

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'itshanas gsung 'thum/skyobs shig /gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu'i gnod pa las srungs shig /skyobs shig / nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa las srungs shig /skyobs shig / 'go nad gag lhog gzer gsum las srungs shig / skyobs shig /rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa dang / kha smras gleng bajod sogs mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad las srungs shig / skyobs shig / sba bar mdzod cig / dus gsum rgyal ba skyed mdzad ma/ / yum chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /slob ma 'di la bsrungs zin gyi/ / sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig / gte dang mkha' 'gro lnga'i gzungs bzlas la phu gdab/'di'ang sprul sku dkon mchog bsod nams rgya mtsho'i ngor gnang ba'o/ /sman pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gcig tu 'gro ba kun la bu ltar brtse ba bo/ / gnyis med spros bral de nyid ji bzhin gzigs pa po/ / gsum mthar mdzad cig 'gro kun srid las sgrol ba po/ / bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi gdung ba sel ba po/ / lnga bdo'i snyigs dus byin rlabs lhag par myur ba po/ / drug cu'i dbyangs dang mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis brgyan pa po/ /bdun phrag bde gshegs smon lam lhan cig grub pa po/ / brgyad brgya pa sogs mdo sde du mar bsngags pa po/ / dgu tshigs snying rjes lus can mkha' ltar 'khyud pa po/ / bcu gnyis smon grub skyob pa bla na med pa po/ / khyod la rtse gcig gus pas mchod cing gsol 'debs na/ / nam yang 'bral med rjes bzung byen gyes brlab tu gsol/ / 'di'ang zhabs drung blo bzang gzhon nus sman bla'i po bstod nyung ngu zhig dgos zer bar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du smras pa'i yi ge pa dzisngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /148

༄ /hal ha rje btsun dam pa'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs bzhugs//ye shes lnga yi dkyil 'khor rab rdzogs pa/ / rgyal ba'i nyi ma rnam gzigs spyan snga ru/ / gyad kyi gtso bo mtha' med stobs gyur te/ / dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed tshe/ / lhag bsam dag pa'i rang mdangs ji bzhin du/ / mchod tshogs gsal zhing nyams pa med par gyur/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / de nas brtsams te mos pa spyod pa dang / / lhag bsam rnam dag rnam par smin pa yi/ / gnas skabs kun tu rdzogs smin sbyang byas phyir/ bar gyi bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi ring / / dag dang ma dag skye ba'i rnam rol gyes/ / bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mdzad/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / dngos 'dzin bag chags dang bcas sgrib pa kun/ / rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis bcom ste/ / nyi zla skar ma'i 'od skor zhing khams su/ / tha mar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ / de ba'in gshegs pa nam mkha'i thig le zhes/ / mkha' mnyam lus can kun gye mgon du gyur/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul pha mtha' gzhal med kyang / /bden tshig rdo rje'i lung gis zin pa bzhin/ / 'bar ba'i gtso dang spyod 149

༄/ /yo ca bstan ཿ sgroname'i ga4 ཿma/'chad dbang po'i zhabs/ / ra tan chen po biṣā rā dza sogs/ / rgya gar shar nub u rgyan mi yi yul/ / kun tu mkhas grub rgyal blon rnam par bstan/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bsil ldan ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs su yang / / rong zom chos bzang rgyal ba garma pa/ / 'brug sgra rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas ras chen dang / /u rgyan pa sogs rim dang dus mnyam du/ / byon pa'i skyes mchog grub mtha' ris med dang / / kun dga'i mtshan gyi snying po gsal byed pa/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bye brag blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ / 'phrin las rmad byung bkra shis dpal dang ldan/ / lung rtogs chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng byed cing / / 'gro ba'i yid kyi mun sel sgron me mchog / thub bstan dbang phyug 'jigs med rgya mtsho zhes/ / byang phyogs skye dgu'i 'dren pa gcig pur gyur/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'gro kun smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ / ma lus bdag gir bzhes pa'i thugs skyed bzhin/ / slar yang sprul pa'i gar gyis rnam rol zhing / 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang lhun grub ste/ / zab dang rgya che'i chos kyi dga' ston la/ / 'dod dgur spyod pa'i skal bzang myong ba dang / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro kun bde legs smin cing grol gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan dkon mchog skyabs kyis skul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar/ / dus mthar gsum ldan ngur smig 'chang ba'i tshul/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jam mgon tsong kha 150

/ /pa'i/ / thugs rjes smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub gyur cig / gang gi 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i thigs pa yis/ / blo gros 'dab phreng bzhad pa'i kun da'i tshogs/ / yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu 'phel ba yis/ / nor 'dzin khyon la dge legs mchog sbyin 'gyed/ / khyad par byang phyogs chen po hor gyi yul/ / gang du thub bstan dar ba'i dus bab kyis/ / mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes mchog dam pa rnams/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi rol pa ci yang ston/ / de las bdag cag bsod nams kun gsal ngos/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i cha shas yongs gang ba'i/ / yongs 'dzin bdud rtsi'i thig ler gsal ba la/ / bstod tshig rlabs phreng cung zad spro bar bgyi/ / blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lung rtogs bstan/ / bshad sgrub bya ba'i rol ba 'bum phrag gis/ / dar zhing rgyas mdzad thar 'dod 'gro ba'i mgon/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnam dag rigs kyi dga' tshal yangs po ru/ / rlabs chen thugs bskyed sa bon smin pa las/ / rgyal sras spyod pa'i yal 'dab rdzogs pa yi/ / bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon par gsol ba 'debs/ / mdo rgyud gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas par/ / rgya chen mang du thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ / thos don mtha' dag gdams par shar ba yi/ / nges don bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /legs par bshad pas blo gsal dga' ba bskyed/ / dri med rigs pas rgol ngan spobs pa phrogs/ / sdeb legs rtsom pas dga' ston 'gyed mkhas pa/ / smra ba'i dbang po mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / srid las nges 'byung 'dul khrims ka lā sha/ / byang sems sdom pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams/ / rnam dag dam tshig rma bya'i mdongs kyis mdzes/ / gsu ma ldan rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ / bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs bskyed 151

༄ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/grub pa'i mthus/ / gang la gang 'tsham thabs mkhas spyod pa yis/ / srid zhi'i gdung sel phan bde'i mchog sbyin pa/ / mtshungs gral 'gro ba'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ / yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rig sngags mthu/ / grub pas nag phyogs g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / / 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ / bslu med skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / khyad par bdag sogs gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ / zab cing rgya che'i chos kyi mdzod phye ste/ / don gnyis lhun grub dga' ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ bka' drin mtshungs med dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / dus gsum phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun las kyang / / yul dang dus kyi snyigs ma'i tha ma 'dir/ / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ma lus sgrub mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ / gang gi gsang gsum yon tan mtha' yas shing / / bka' drin phung po gzhal du med pa'i tshul/ / legs par bsams te khyod zhabs padmo la/ / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ / yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin du legs sprul te/ / dmigs med bde chen ngang du 'bul lags na/ / bdag la sman slad brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ / 'khor ba mu mtha' yas par 'khyams pa'i tshe/ / sna tshogs nyes pa ji snyed bgyes pa dang / / khyad par sdom gsum las 'das nyes ltung kun/ / gdung pa'i 'gyod pa drag pos mthol lo bshags/ / rang gzhan kun gyi dge tshogs mtha' dag dang / / khyad par dmigs med snying rje'i dpang gyur te/ / thar lam gsal mdzad rje btsun bla ma yi/ / rmad byung rnam par thar la rjes yi rang / / gang gi mkhyen rab nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ / legs bshad 'od stong 'bar ba'i nyin byed kyi/ / snang bas sa gsum lus can mtha' dag 152

༄ mdogi/ / kun rmongs mun pa'i dra ba bsal du gsol/ / ma dag snyigs ma'i gdul byar gang 'tsham du/ / bstan pa'i gzugs sku rags pa'i za ma tog / 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral gyi bar/ / mi shigs rdo rje'i khams su brtan par bzhugs/ / 'dis mtshon dge bas deng nas byang chub bar/ / mgon po khyod kyis 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / gdams dang rjes su bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin zhing / / mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes pa bsgrub par shog / rje btsun bla mas je ltar gdams pa bzhin/ nges 'byung shugs drag gzhan phan byang chub sems/ / srid rtsa gcod byed zab mo'i lta ba sogs/ / thun mong lam gye rtogs pa skye bar shog / de nas mgon khyod dkyil 'khor bdag po ru/ / bzhengs te gsang ba sngags kyi sgor bcug nas/ / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthar son pas/ / bla ma lha yi go 'phang myur thob shog / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / dge 'dun thugs mthun bshad sgrub gong du 'phel/ / ljongs 'dir dge bcu'i phun tshogs dar ba yi/ / shis pa'i dbyangs snyan srid rtser sgrog gyur cig /ces mkhas btsun bzang bo'i bdag nyid bstan pa'i gsal byed/ blo bzang bstan dar pa'i gsol 'debs smon tshig yan lag bdun pa dang 'brel ba zhig dgos tshul/yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dpal rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon chog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /'phags chen 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du/ gung thang pas zhu gsol/ rang gi skye yul mdzo dge dgon gsar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling du 'jog rgyur ston pa'i gos sku gsar bskrun bgyis pa'i dge tshogs la brten nas bstan pa spyi sgos dar zhing / 7skyabs mgon mchog gis gtsos pa'i 153

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgronas gsung ཿma/bstan 'dzin rnams zhabs brtan 'phrin las rgyas pa 'jig rten mtha' dag bde skyid kyis 'tsho zhing 'brel thogs thams cad tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mi 'bral ba sogs dang / khyad par phan tshun gye ma dgon bu dgon 'di dag tu bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba dbyar mtshon bzhin rgyas pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs rjes gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhu ba'i rten du dung tshe khron bcu gsum lha dar bcas 'bul lam zhu lags pas/ gong zhus ltar gyi spyan dmigs dang bcas chos rgyal ma gsung bzhin par shis bajod kyi me tog 'thor gnang bka' drin skyong bar zhu/ 'di 'ang mdzo dge dgon gsar gyi rten gtsor ston pa'i gos sku che ba khyad mtshar gsar bskrun gnang ste gra tshang bzhi'i dge 'dun mang gis phyag nas 'thor skabs tshogs chen zhal ngo la grul ba'o/ /legs nyes ci byung yang dkon mchog la blo snying gtod/ bya ba gang byed kyang las 'bras dpang por zhog / rkyen ci la thug kyang dam tshig dang sdom pa srungs/ 'di chos kyi bslab bya'i snying po tshig gsum yin/ sems khong yangs shing rang dpe gzhan la sbyor/ / gsar 'grogs chung la khrel dang phyi thag srings/ / zhib tu brtag cing brtsams nas mthar thon byed/ / 'di 'jig rten gyi bslab bya'i snying po tshig gsum yin/ zhes pa 'di'ang bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung ngo / /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ / snying nas mi phyed dad pas gsol 'debs na/ / gnas 'dir byin phob khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ /dbyar gyi chu mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa dang / / mdo sngags lam bzang bshad sgrub bya ba kun/ / yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i dge legs stsol/ / de'ang 'dus sde 'di nyid du zhal 'don gyi rim pa sogs sngar yod gzhir byas pa'i steng du shin tu gal che zhing nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig bsnan te khrigs su 'god pa 154

༄/ /la/ / rgyun du bstan pa'i gzhi ma gzhi gsum gyi phyag len yin pas gso sbyong ma chag pa dang / / de'i tshe 'phags pa'i gnas brtan rnams kyis lhan cig las nyams su phyong bar bsams la gnas bcu'i phyag mchog mgo nas yan lag bdun pa yan chad sngon du btang / de nas phyag btsal te snyan gsan phul nas phyir bcos sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ mjug gi bsngo ba'i 'phror/sangs rgyas sprul pa zhes sogs gdon/ dus bzang gi rim pa chos lngar bla mchod/ brgyad sman bla'i dus chen du grags pas sman chog bco lnga spyir legs grub sogs las rgyas pa'i las la bsngags par ma zad/ rnam rgyal ma'i rtog pa las kyang gtso bor gsungs pas rnam rgyal ma'i chog nyi shu lnga rje bla ma'i dus mchod yin pas 'jigs byed bdag 'jug / nyi shu dgu la dgu gtor te dus bzang lnga ma chad pa dgos/ tshogs 'tshogs skabs thams cad zhal yar phyogs te dal bus phyag 'tshal zhing sa gzhi byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren bcas sngon du btang la/ sho lo ka re dang phyag re 'grig pa byas te /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ / zhes sogs/ phun tshogs dge legs nas/ gsal mdzad bshes gnyen gyi bar ram/ yang na/ phun tshogs dge legs zhes pa'i sho lo ka da'i 'phror/ byams pa thogs med ces sogs tshigs bcad gsum dang / rab 'byams gsung rab ces sogs/ mthun pa'i smon lam zhes sogs dang / skyon gyis ma gos/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs ྾ / lcang lo can gyi nga / lha dang lha min ྾/ ji snyed su dag nas/ phyag 'tshal mtshad par bgyi/ / de nas ltung bshags dang spyi bshags byas la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang nas/ phyir bsngo ba'i bar dang / maṇḍal rgyas par phul/ dus gsum skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bshes gnyen la ma gus pa nas bdag gnyis su mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i /55

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/bar gyi phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag 'gag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas su mthong ba nas zung 'jug gi bar gyi lam gye rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar byin gye brlab tu gsol/ rkyen phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / zhes don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab/ de nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyis sems bskyed bzung la/ slar yang phyag dang sbrags/byang chub sems mchog ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad brgyad dgu tsam gsung rgyun bzhin bya/ dmigs btse ma 'don bzhin par sa la bzhugs te skyabs 'gro rgyas pa dang gnas bcu gsung / 'di yan chad tshogs phal cher la 'dra/bla mchod dus bzang skabs/ bde chen dad las zhes pa nas/ lus sprul phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar/ mchod pa'i skabs/ skyabs mgon rje btsun bla ma 'khor bcas la/ / sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul ba ni/ / bkod legs rin chen 'od 'bar snod yangs las/ / dag byed bdud rtsi'i mchod yon dal gyis 'bab/ / dang ba'i sems kyis phul byung zhing gi mchog / skyabs mgon thugs rje'i gter la 'bul bar bgyi/ / oṃ gu ru burto bo dhi sarba sarba dha rmā pā las pa ri war arnya pra tītstsha hūṃ sāhwa/ mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil sogs dang / arnyi gye gnas su pārya sogs bcug pas chu bzhi dbul/ rkang pa bar ba gnyis kye gnas su/ sdong bu sil ma 'phreng ba spel legs pa'i/ / mdzes pa'i me tog sa dang bar snang gang / / zhes pa bcug la/ oṃ gu ru nas ltar pukhye zhes sbyar bas mtshon te nyer spyod rol mo rnams dbul/ de nas/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo zhes sogs gsang 'dus nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rnams kyis nang gi nyer spyod 156

༄/ /dbul/ tshigs tha ma/ bla ma lha yi tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul/ /zhes sgyur/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po nas/ bla ma lha yi spyan la dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes sogs dang / 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal zhes sogs phyi nang gi 'dod yon dbul/ maṇḍal rgyas par phul la/ mjug tu bye ba phrag brgya'i zhes sogs dang / bdag gzhan ma/ sa gzhi ma sogs 'don/ de nas/dngos bshams yid sprul zhes sogs kyi mchod pa lhag ma gzhung bzhin bya/bshags pa'i mtshams su lhung bshags dang / sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi phyir bcos/ spyi bshags bcas kyi 'phror/ thog med dus nas/ zhes pa nas/thob phyir bsngo'i bar dkyus bzhin bya/ de nas thub dbang gi bstod pa/lam rim gsol 'debs/ byin rlabs nye brgyud kyi gsol 'debs dang /rje'i sku bstod/ rnam thar/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma'i sku bstod gsol 'debs kyi skor sogs bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod tshogs gang 'os 'don/ yon tan 'byung gnas man chad gzhung ltar la/ mjug tu lam rim bsdus don dang / smon lam rnam lnga/ bde gshegs ma/ byams chen ma/ lam rim smon lam bcas gsungs/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum ya ma bral ba'i lam la bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir de gsum gyi smon lam yang cha tshang ba byung na legs/ sman chog rgyas pa dngos dag byung na legs kyang / blo nas mi thon tshe gnad smin zhig dka' la/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sman chog bsdus pa 'di tshig nyung yang / snga ma'i don gcig kyang ma chad par nang du 'dus te ya mtshan che bas 'di nyid kyis 'thus/ thams cad la je rgyas su btang na nyog 'gro bas/ gtso bo'i skabs/ baiḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ ji snyed su dag ces sogs phyag mchod kyi tshigs bcad bdun dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ / zhes 157

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronayo g.yo 'bum/sogs tshigs bcad rnams kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bcas dbul/'dod chags zhe sdang nas/ phyir bsngo'o/ / zhes pa'i 'phror/ rgyal ba'i mtshan thos zhes sogs sbyor/ bzlas pa gang mang dang / smon lam sogs rgyas par bya/ rnam rgyal cho ga'i mgor/ rtsa ba'i sprul gzhi lta bu tshe dpag med yin pas/ tshe dpag med dang 'brel pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas tshe gzungs gang mang dang bla ma'i zhabs brtan gyi rigs sngon du btang na legs/ dbyar gnas lta bu sgos 'don yod skabs rnams su'ang sgrol ma gdugs sher/ seng gdong ma sogs sngar rgyun ma nyams pa'i thog / bla ma'i rnam 'byor dang 'brel bar tshe gzungs bzla/ sgrol dkar/ a ra pa tsa/ lo gyon ma sogs gzungs sngags ci rigs kyang bzlas na legs/bdag 'jug skabs gzhan gyi 'don pa bsdus tsam byas te dngos gzhi'i 'don rta dbyangs phyag len thams cad rgyud gra'i lugs srol zur ma nyams pa byas na legs/ dgu gtor la/ 'jigs byed mgon chos/ gser zhun ma sogs dang / lo mjug gi dgu gtor nyi ma gsum gyi skabs de'i steng du lha mo rnam sras/ bee gtse/ tha 'og pa rnams kyang bsnan te bya/ lo gsar tshes gcig la bla mchod sogs 'don pa gzhan rnams bsdus tsam byas la lha mo'i tshes gtor phyag len dang mthun par bstar na legs/ 'dir mdor bsdus kyi tho tsam bkod pa yin pas/ 'grig lam gyi rkang tshugs nas zhib cha rgyas par byas na legs/ co rna'i shog gi dgon rnam rgyal gling gi zhal 'don skor gyi 'don 'grig legs tshogs lhun grub ces bya ba 'di'ang de ga'i bla ma las sne thun mong nas bskul ngor co nee dgon chen nas gnang pa'o/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dus 'jigs mdzad bla ma lhas/ / tshad med thugs rje'i byin gyis dbang bskur te/ / gsang chen bstan pa'i sgron me 158

༄ mdo'achang ba po'i/ / bden tshig 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i lung / / snang zhing srid par rgyu ba'i lha 'dre'i tshogs/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rdo rje'i tha tshig gis/ / rdo rje'i g.yar dam bsgos pa nyer dgongs la/ / skye 'gro kun la gnod 'tshe'i bsam spyor spongs/ / khyad par dge 'dun 'dus tshogs dpon slob kun/ / thub bstan rin chen bshad sgrub bgyid pa la/ / rtag tu nyer 'tshe spong zhing mthun pa'i rkyen/ / ji ltar nus bzhin sgrubs shig sa ma ya0/ces snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la bka' bsgo 'di ni/ skyabs mgon rdo rje'i 'chang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gnang ba'o/ /dge sbyong dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me bdag / rang stobs kyis dkor spyong mi nus pas/ dad rdzas chud mi za ba'i phyir 'di ltar bsgrub pas mtshon/ dus gsum gye dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas phyag mdzod dge 'dun grags pa/ dpon po blo bzang dkon mchog gnyer ba blo bzang dar rgyas/ ma rgan mo chog skyid sogs nye 'brel gra slob sbyin bdag bkolaspyad kyi dud 'gro sogs 'brel thogs rnams kyis gtsos/ mar gyur sems can thams cad mngon mtho nges legs kyi dpal la spyod pa dang / /khyad par dag pa'i zhing bde ba can du skyes nas mgon po 'od dpag med kyis 'bral med rjes su bzung ste/ yang dag pa'i lam bzang rim gyis bgrod nas mthar thug sku bzhi'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par gyur cig / ces pa 'di'ang dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi spyi 'jog tu cho 'phrul sgon lam gyi bcu gsum nyin bkram rgyu'i 'od dpag med kyi go4sku che legs khyad mtshar can gos chen rgyu bzang sna tshogs kyis bsgrub skabs de'i kha byang du stsal pa'o/ /bde stong dbyings su gdengs pa ma he'i zhal/ / srid gsum kham du byed pa rngam pa'i gar/ / bdud sde'i gshed du bsgyur pa'i khro chen gyi/ /159

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'izla sa gsung 'bum/bden gsung 'gyur pa med pa rdo rje'i lung / / snang srid lha 'dre 'byung po mi ma yin/ / kun la phyag rgyas btab ste bsgo ba ni/ / dkar nag las 'bras 'chol ba med pa dang / / rtsa brgyud bla ma'i g.yar dam gnyan po la/ /bsams nas rig 'dzin 'di nyid yon mchod bcas/ / kun la gnod 'tshe'i bsam spyor spong bar gyis/ / ring mo zhig nas mchod sbyin gtor tshogs kyis/ / brngan zhing lan chags 'khor bar byas zin gyes/ / da dung sha 'khon gnyer na dam tshig gi / rdo rjes mgo bo 'gems so shes par gyis/ / 'di'ang ma thog sprul sku'i mos 'dun bzhin stsal pa'o/ / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar kha sbyor bde chen gyis/ / spros bral ngang du srid mtha'i bar bzhugs nas/ / 'gro ba'i don mdzad yan lag bdun ldan mgon/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ / lhag bsam rnam par dag pas gang gi sku/ / mig gi bdud rtsir bskrun pa'i dge tshogs mthus/ / tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / rim gnyis lam gye bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / rab 'byams brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po kun/ / lhan skyes bde ba'i 'khor lor sdom mdzad pa/ / gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje/ / bcom ldan he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lhag bsam zhes pa nas dag pa mkha' spyod gnas der drang du gsol/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ / gtum drag khro bo chen po'i skur bzhengs te/ / ma rungs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs 'joms mdzad pa/ / bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigasabyed la phyag 'tshal/ / lhag bsam zhes pa nas phyi nang bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod/ / rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan stong gzugs sku/ / dmigs med bde chen thugs dang ro gcig pa/ / phyi nang gzhan gsum rnam par dag pa'i bdag / dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 1yi

༄/ /'tshal/ / lhag bsam zhes pa nas stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po grub par mdzod/ / rjes chags dga' bas rab myos bdag med mar/ / mi phyed dam du 'khyud pa'i bde ba ches/ / dgyes pa'i gar gyis rtsen pa'i he ru ga bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ / lhag bsam zhes pa nas lhan skyes bde chen 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ snying rje'i ngang las drag po'i skur bzhengs te/ / ma rungs gdul dka'i 'gro rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ / thugs rje'i gter chen myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ / ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal/ / lhag bsam zhes pa nas theg mchog lam bzang bgrod pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / blo bzang rgyal pa'i bstan srung kun gyi gtso/ /dkar nag las kyi blang dor shan 'byed pa/ / khams gsum skye 'gro yongs kyi srog gi bdag / dam can chos kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ / lhag bsam zhesapa nas dge ldan bstan dgra ma lus phye mar rlogs/ / rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje dbyengs phyug ma/ / snang stong srin po khros pa'i skur bzhengs te/ / bstan dgra 'joms shing bstan 'dzin bu bzhin du/ / skyong mdzad dmag zor rgyal mo'i zhabs la 'dud/ / lhag bsam zhesapa nas phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun las srung du gsol/ / phun tshogs dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i dpyid 'jo bas/ / rnal 'byor dpon slob sde dang bcas pa yi/ / 'dod don ma lus lhun gyis grub mdzad pa/ / rgyal chen rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lhag bsam zhes pa nas chos srid dpal 'byor mtha' dag rgyas par mdzod/ sho lo ka 'di rnams zhu ba po'i 'dun pa bzhin thang ga'i kha byang du stsol pa'o/ /gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med mgon gyi/ / gsung ngag rdo rje'i tshig don zab cing brling / / gsung zer rdo rje'i gzeg ma 'bum 'phro bas/ /gsung rab rdo rje rin chen 'phreng bar spel/ / de'ang paṇa chen snang ba mtha'ayas kyi mdzad pa'i lta mgur 'di nyid mtshan khu bu'i tshul gyis mdor 161

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithonama'i gsung 'bum/bsdus te bgrol ba la/ / klad gzhung mjug gsum las/ dang po klad kyi don mchod par brjod pa ni/ na mo gu ru bhya skyabs kun 'dus bla ma yid bzhin nor/ / thugs 'gro la phyogs lhung mi mnga' yang / / gang rtse gcig dran la/ nor bu rgyal mtshan gye rtser mchod na 'dod dgu 'byung ba ltar/'di phyi yi/ don bde blag stsol la snying nas 'dud/ / gnyis pa gzhung don la gnad bzhi'i sgo nas gtan la dbab pa/ gtan la phab pas bdag med sgom tshul/ de'i grub pa'i don dang gsum/ dang po la gnad bzhi las/ dgag bya nges pa'i gnad la dgag bya ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / 'dzin tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas srid pa'i rtse nas dmyal ba'i bar/ / skye rga dang 'chi bas 'khor ba 'dir/ / khong gzhan gyis bzung nas dbang med du/ / sdug sna dgu btang ba ma yin gyi/ / spyod 'jug las/ gnod pa'i tshogs rab 'phel pa'i rgyu gcig pu/ / bdag gi snying la nges par gnas 'cha' na/ gsungs pa ltar/gdon rang gi sems la gnas pa yi/ / dgra bdag 'dzin 'gong po 'di yin pas/ / kho'i zhen yul dzi bzhin ma rnyed par/ / dpyad dpyad kyang 'ben ma mthong bar mda' brdog pa ltar dgag bya khyab che chung gang rung du song nas/rtag chad mtha' ru lhung / / tha mal gyi lhan skyes shes pa la/ / yul gang snang bden pa'i tshul du snang / / snang tshul de'i steng nas dgag bya ngos zin dgos kyi/ grub mthas sgo btags ni grub mtha' de 'dzin kho na la snang zhing / de bkag pas bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi 'dzin tshul mi khegs pas/ 'di kun brtags shes pa'i 'dzin stangs dang / / don ma 'dres ngos 'dzin gnad du che/ / gnad dang po dgag bya'i snang tshul 'di'i/ / gting ma phyin rkun po nags shor la/ / rjes spang la gcod dang 'dra bas na/ / don 'di la myong ba phul phyin mdzod/ / gnyis pa dgag bya ngoyo'adzin tshul dngos kyi don la/ sgom thog nas lta 162

༄ / /ba tshol ba'i lugs kyis dang por zhi gnas sgrub dgos tshul dang / de'i steng nas dgag bya tshol tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshul 'di nyid ji bzhin nges pa la/ / sems zhi gnas sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ / deng dus kyi lta khrid skyong ba rnams/ / lam dbu ma'i tshul las ring du 'khyams/ gnyis pa ni/don bsdus na nga'am bdag de ni/ / rang sems kyi dbang gis phar ba'ag cing / / ming tsam gyi bya byed 'thad pa las/ / yul rang gi ngos nas grub pa med/ / med mod kyang rang ngos grub par snang / / don snang ba ltar du sems kyis zhen/ / gang zhen pa'i tshugs thub pa de nyid/ / des gyur na dgag bya nges par 'jog / gnyis khyab pa nges pa'i gnad ni/ chos gang zhig yod pa la gcig gam tha dad gang rung gi rnam par yong ba las gnas tshul ga'an mi srid pas/ spyi'i khyab pa de nyid kyi sgo nas btags chos kyi nga de nyid gdags gzhi'i phung po'i steng du bden par yod na/ de dang bden pa'i gcig tu yod pa'am/ bden grub kyi tha dad du yod pa gang rung las ma 'das pa'i tshul ston par/ de phung po lnga dang gcig tha dad/ / gang rung du grub pa las gzhan pa'i/ / tshul gzhan du grub thabs med pa ru/ / thag chod pa khyab pa nges pa'i gnad/ / gnad gsum pa gcig bral nges pa'i gdan ni/ da phung gcig yin/ 'jug par/gal te phung po bdag na de phyir de/ / mang bas bdag de dag kyang mang por 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar/ nga du mar thal dang phung po lnga/ / gcig 'gyur zhing rtsa she las/ nye bar len nyid bdag yin na/ / khyod kyi bdag ni med pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar las bras myong ba po'i rten bdag khas blangs pa don med par thal ba dang / len pa po nga dang blang bya'i phung po so sor med pas bya byed gcig tu thal ba ni/ nye bar blangs bya dang / / de len po zhes pa don med 'gyur/ bzhi ba bden pa'i du bral nges pa'i gnad ni/ / bdag phung po dag dang tha dad 163

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/du/ / grub gyur na tha dad tsam la 'brel med mi dgos kyang / tshugs thub kyi tha dad la/ 'brel med kyi khyab pas 'jug par/ skye 'jug byed po med pas de 'bras med/ / gzhan gyis bsags la gzhan gyis za bar 'gyur/ /gsungs pa bzhin las chud za ba/ dge sdig la/ / spang blang gi bya ba don med 'gyur/ gnyis pa gtan la phab pas bdag med sgom tshul la/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med rtogs tshul/ de mnyam rjes su sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshul de ltar gnad bzhis dpyad pa'i mthar/ / nga rang bzhin med par nges pa des/ / bdag med pa'i lta ba dang por rnyed/ de nas mdo las/ / ji ltar khyod kyi bdag gi 'du shes ni/ / shes pa de bzhin kun la blos sbyar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin chos kyi bdag med la'ang kha spos pa tsam gyis chog pas/ bzhi brgya par gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa/ / de ni kun gyi stong nyid yin/ / gcig gi lta po gang yin pa/ / de ni kun gyi lta po yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/gcig tu bral rigs pas dpyod tshul 'di/ / mig sogs kyi chos kun la sbyar te/ / yul gang snang ngo bo la ltos shig / don gnas lugs stong sang rjen par 'char/ gnyis pa de mnyam rjes su sgom tshul la gnyis las/ mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu sgom tshul ni/ gdon dngos 'dzin 'khrul bas dkrugs pa yi/ / yul kun rdzob cir yang 'char mod kyi/ / dpal rig shes lta ba'i rgyal poyis/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i don/ gnas lugs kyi ltad mo kun rdzob kyi spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba nam mkha' stong sang lta bu'i dgag bya chad tsam gyi dbyings la ltos shig ang / gnyis pa rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i sgom tshul ni/ don dpyad tshe rnyed pa'i chos med kyang / / rgyu rten 'brel du ma tshogs pa'i mthus/ / bar nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ / ngo mtshar ba'i kun rdzob bcing grol bya byed sogs ma 'chol bar bsnyon med du 'byung ba sgyu ma'i snang ba lta bu 'di la ltos/ gsum pa grub don la rtag mtha' khegasatshul/ chad mtha' khegs tshul/ mtha' gnyis 1yo

༄ mdospangs pa'i dbu mar grub tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ yod yod ltar bden par bzung ba'i nga / / tshul gang gis btsal kyang mi rnyed pa/ / bya nam mkhar 'phur ba'i rjes 'dra 'di/ / don gnas lugs lta ba rtogs pa yin/ gnyis pa chad mtha' khegs tshul ni/ rang ngos nas grub pa tsang med kyang / / bde sdug gi snang ba nyin mtshan kun/ / bsnyon par med 'char ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi/ / rten 'brel la bslu ba med pa'i rtags/ / gsum pa mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu ma ra grub tshul ni/ don bden par grub dang gtan med pa'i/ /mtha' gnyis ka dgag pa'i lta ba 'di/ / dpal klu sgrub yab sras dgongs pa bzhin/ / rje yab sras thugs bcud phyung ba yin/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa mjug gi don ni/ ces pa 'di'ang seng bzang sprul skus 'phrin yig gi lam nas bskul ba ltar/lta ba'i glu len pa po ni 7shākya'i dge slong blo bzang dpa' ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal lo/ / paṇa chen thams cad gzigs pa chen pos khong rang la stsal pa'i lta mgur 'dir 'grel pa zhig dgos zhes dam pa nyid nas bskul ma mdzad pa ltar/ /mchan 'grel gnad bsdus 'di 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/mgon po rdo rje'i ja mchod ni/ i a rgya/ ste ma bus/ dwo ma yong nga ja kho'u bzhag zig rem ma gcig 'thung da/ da phyi rgan gyi ja 'di bskol ni kho4sgo ra/ khyos de bden na dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin rgyu red/ de yin dus dkon mchog ga mchod kha zig ma 'phang nga 'thung na las 'bras e mi nyan ā/ a rgya mchod sus 'phen/ ha ha/ nga rgya bod hor gsum 'grim gi phyi rgan bzang ngan bar gsum rig gi gom rgan/ chos 'jig rten gnyi ga'i phar sne bud gi tshur sne bud ni bo yin dus mchod ngas 'phen/ mo kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes dbu mdzad drin can rtsa ba brgyud kyi bla ma rnams mchod/ de yin ā/ bu rgod po/ las zig rten 'brel bsgrig na mgo 'dzugs po bla ma yin mo/ rje bdag nyid chen pos ra/165

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i sgonasa'i khrung 4ma/de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ / rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ / lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa/ gsung grod ki mo/ de'i 'phro yā/ o gra tshang rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' rab 'byams dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzom pa/ rdo'u byur ru ru po ti lnga 'dom mā 'ja' mkhan/ snum tsi ri ri rgyud sde bzhi dbyang nga gyer mkhan/dmar ldem ldem ldem/ ser ljig ljig ljig sa thog thams cad gang yod ni po 'di mchod/ yin na yin na de yin/ mchod sa po dge 'dun yin mo/yin nes mi tshad/ dge 'dun 'dra pa'i snod med de/ brdzes dus e zig 'asgyu ra sgyu / ti hi khros bshad tsho'u a bltas na khye'u de'i don ma go zigadage 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med bsdes ni bo/ tshul khrims rnam par dgathos bsam sgom gsum yas ni/ rang gi sems na zas nor ra sred pa sru tsam zig med rung / chos skyong srung mas grogs yas/ dkar phyogs lhas mthun rkyen bsgrubs ni zas nor char 'bab 'bab yas/ yon bdag dad pa can gi bsod nam gi tshogs rdzogs ni bo de red/ mang ja e sngod ki/ thug pa e nur gi/ phog e che gi zer ris kha zed zed da 'dug ni tsho snod yin badzes nam red/ a rgya chos bshad bzang gi/ u gu'i dbyug pa 'di phyir re re 'khor mi gtong mo ā/ drag drag dra ma dri ma mtshan nyid pā khyab 'grig zer gyi zig gā yod/ sngags bā phyir zlog zer gyi zig gā yod/ yin rung gdan pa ngas de khrig khrig yin/ da khyo bshad kyi ma mang / ngas mchod gi 'phro 'phen ya/ mgon chos rgyal gnyis la sogs pa gra dpon slob thams cad kis sgrub sgrub/ bsten bsten/ mchod mchod/ bkur bkur/ bkyag bkyag pa'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan ldan thams cad mchod/ bzang yā sna tshogs 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ / chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi 166

༄/ /bkra shis shog / badzes dus khong rnam tsho gcig mchod na khong rnam pas ra 'phrin las tshul bzhin du sgrub rgyu red/ de yas na/ sku phyogs thams cad mkhyen pa sku tshe zhabs pad ri rgyal lhun po bzhin du brtan/ mdzad pa 'phrin las kis sa steng khyab/ dge 'dun gi chos 'chad nyan yar zla bzhin 'phel/yul phyogs su bkra shis/ lo legs/ bzang bzang / brgyan brgyan/bsam bsam/ 'dod 'dod thams cad po 'grub rgyu bo los yin/ thag gi chod pa de yin/ de thang mo snes bzung nge mchod 'phen ya e ris mchod /mchod / mchod mchod mchod mchod mchod mchod mchod mchod/ brgya mchod/ stong mchod/ khri mchod/ 'bum mchod/ je mtho rgya yar yar mchod/ lha rgyal lo/ phaṭa/ mchod/ 'dod dgu'i char pa 'beb bla ma yi dam lha/ 'dod khams dbang phyug chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ 'dod yon sna lnga'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ 'dod pa'i da yang gā rel/ don kun 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod mdzod mdzod/ de ja mchod gi mdor bstan red/ rgyas bshad yas na bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis jo bo yab sras/ rje rgyal bganyis pa tsong kha pa chen po yab sras/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sogs dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams mchod mdor na nyin mtshan med par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa thugs la bcang mkhan/ rjes su zhugs tshad ki blo sna chos la skor mkhan/ mdo rgyud gsung rab kun la nang byan chud mkhan/ thos don sgrub pas nyams su len mkhan gi bla ma skyes bu dam pa gang na su bzhugs po mchod/ dā 'phra 'phro re yo khi na/ dbyar tsha rgyu med/ dgun 'khyag rgyu medarwa grong chog brdas nas lung skyog dre dgon pa bag bug re gso gi yod 167

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgonasa'i khrung ཿma/mkhan gi bla ma rjo ram mchod khā re shis/ yi dam bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs thams cad mchod/ mgon chos rgyal gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i chosaskyong srung ma mchod/ chi gi mchod na 'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di gi mchod/ khos bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho khya shag shag shag yed khi ā/ khyod sdod sdod dā 'phrin bcol yed khi chug 'dod pa'i don kun brdzas dus chos 'chad nyan/ 'grig lam kun spyod/ mnga' thang snyan grags/ lkog gtam pa la 'gyed phog mang ja sogs chos srid kyi legs tshogs thams cad lhun gyes grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ dā de'i nang dwa mi 'dus ni zi gi med mo/ a tsa tsa/ thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jam mgon bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun dam pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung du gsol/de yang mkhas pa dang blun po'i khyad par kha bshad mkhas mi mkhas kyis 'jog pa min/ 'dun ma 'phyug ma 'phyug la zer/ 'dun ma mi 'phyug pa la bsam blo legs par gtong dgos/ mi lus thob kyang sngar yid la 'dzin rgyu'i snying po ci yang ma lon/ kha sang yan chad cig la shi ste dmyal ba'i me 'obs su lhung yod na ci 'dra zhig 'ong rgyu red/ de ltar ma song bar da lta dal 'byor gyi rten la gnas yod pa 'di dkon mchog gi thugs rjes stabs legs pa yin/ 'jig rten phyi ma zer ba der do nub sleb mi 'gro ba'i nges pa yang med cing / de rgya che la yun ring bas de'i 'dang zhig rgyag dgos/de la 'jigs shing skrag pa kho nas mi phan/ gang la brten na nam yang bslu ba med pa skyabs dkon mchog gsum yin pas/ skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang dkon mchog gsum la blo phugs gtod/ skyid sdug thams cad 168

༄ ragazhan zhig gis byas pa ma yin par rang gis bsags pa'i las kyi rnam smin rang gis myong ba yin pas/ mngon skog gi bya ba gang la yang las rgyu 'bras dpang bor zhog / khyad par sdom pa gsum sogs khas blangs rgyas che ba 'di/bla ma dkon mchog dpang du bzhag mna' chu tshun chad 'thung nas dam bcas pa yin zhing / 'di dang 'gal na sdig ltung gnyi ga'i cha nas nyes dmigs shin tu che/ sdom gsum tshul bzhin bsrung ba las lhag pa'i nyams len dang bstan pa'i snying po sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod pa'i myur lam zhig med par rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pas sdom gsum dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du gyis/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa dar ba'i yul du skyes pas mi chog rang nyid der zhugs nas snying po cig lon gyes skal ba ma chad pa byed dgos/ rtogs pa mtho dman gyi spyod pa thams cad gcig char du lag tu len tshul med kyang / tshe 'di'i snang shas gcod thabs sogs las dang po pa la gal che ba rnams dngos su lag len du btab/ zab mo'i lta ba dang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs gong ma rnams kyang yid kyis ma bor bar shar sgom re dang smon pa'i rnam pa tshun chad kyis bsgom na bstan pa yongs rdzogs la bag chags bzhag pa yin/ de dag nyams len gye dngos gzhi lags/ gegs sel rgyu gdon grib rtsa rlung sogs kyi gegs mang yang /sdug shos sdig grogs yin pas spangs dgos/ bogs 'byin byed tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi sgo mang yang / mthar thug bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer mi phyed pa'i rnal 'byor skyong dgos/ de ltar tshul khrims gtsang ma gzhir byas/ dge ba bre sogs phul gsog tu byas te/ de nyid khong khro sogs kyis ma bcom par bsngo smon rnam par dag pas rdzogs byang du rgyas thebs pa zhig gi ngang nas tshe mthar thon na pho rgod po don ma 'phyugs pa zer ba de byung ba yin 169

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i zanama'i gsung 'bum/pas rna rgyab tu ma btang bar snying la bcang par gyis shig/ ces pa 'di ni rangagi slob ma hal ha smon lam gyis bslab bya sems la 'dzin rgyu zhig dgos zer ba la 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gdams pa'o/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ / rig grol theg gsum 'phags pa'i dge dibheni dī/chog/ ṭwāṃ/dī dīṭwāṃgagru rna/zi ༷sdum dhriX can /hā ༷ ṭwāṃ tram̐ ༷/ra 'a/rdo༈ ṭwāṃbhe mtsho las bsgral te/ / rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i zhing du khrid mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / mi shigs g.yung drung tshe yi mchog sbyin pa/ / yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs kyi thugs rje dang / / bstan bsrung rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs bden pa'i mthus/ / zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas gyur cig / bstan dang 'gro la smin pa'i thugs bskyed kyi/ / sa bon grung po dus su smin pa yis/ / rnam dkar bshad sgrub 'bras bzang g.yur za bas/ / don gnyis dga' ston lhun gyi 'grub par shog / skye ba kun tu zhes pa nas myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong ngag dbang nor 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brisapa'o/ /rang gi spyi por padma 'dab bzhi yi/ / dbus dang phyogs bzhi snang byed dkyil 'khor la/ hūṃ hūṃ hrī hrī tai yig 'phro 'du las/ / dbus su bla ma kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang / / sku mdog sngon po rdo dril bsnol te 'dzin/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ / phyogs su ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ / mkha' 'gro gri thod 'dzin cing spyan ras gzigs/ / skyabs sbyin bum pa dang ni pad dkar 'dzin/ / mchog sbyin u 170

༄/ /tpal phyag bzung sgrol mar bcas/ / yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ gis ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs dbyer med brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / bdag sogs srid zhi'i 'jigs las sgrol ba'i phyir/ / bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i rnam rol la/ /gus par phyag 'tshal mchod tshogs kun 'bul na/ / bdag sogs smin cing grol bar byin gyis slobs/ / zhes gsol ba btab pas so so'i thugs ga'i sa bon la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs spyi po nas zhugs pas de dang de'i byin rlabs ma lus pa thob par bsam la/ na mo burto ya sogs dang / badzra ma hā kā la dang / nā ra kro dang / oṃ badzra rakṣa sa manta hūṃ phaṭa dang / oṃ tā re tu tta re tu re swāhā rnams rim par bzla/ de nas gdung shugs drag po dang bcas/ / thugs rje tshad med bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / byen rlabs mtshungs med bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / skyabs gnas bsru med bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / bka' drin 'khor med bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / las 'bras blang dor bstan nas ngan song gi / sgo 'phar gcod mdzad bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / bslab gsum bden pa bzhi yi 'jug ldog gis/ / thar par 'khrid mdzad bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i lam bzang gis/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs sgrol bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / dbang dang dam tshig rimaganyis rnal 'byor gyis/ / tshe 'dir mchog sbyin bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi gter/ / gnas skabs mthar thug yongs kyi skyabs gcig bu/ / rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin can/ /khyod min skyabs gzhan nam yang mi 'tshol bas/ / sprul pa'i gar brgya bde chen ro gcig tu/ / sdud mdzad rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma mkhyen/ / lha bzhi gcig tu dril pa'i byin rlabs chus/ / bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ / de nas sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad dang / / spyan ras 171

༄/ /gung thang bltan pa'isgonas gsung 'bum/gzigs dbang sgrol ma myur mdzad mgon/ / rnal 'byor ma rnams bla ma'i skur bsdus te/ / dpral mgrin snying kha lte bar bzhugs par gyur/ ces bsam zhing / na mo budha ya'i gsol 'debs gang mang bya/ rang lus gtum mo gyen du 'bar ba yis/ / bskul te bla ma'i sgu yi lha rnams zhu/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyes spyi po'i rtsa 'khor gang / / lus kyi sgrib pa byang zhing bum dbang thob/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang / / ngag gi sgrib pa byang zhing gsang dbang thob/ / bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gang / / yid kyi sgrib pa dag cing sher dbang thob/ / bla ma dang bcas zhu ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ / lus phu na yongs gang dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ / de nas bla mgon dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs dang / tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon pas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / zhes lha bzhi dril sgrub kyi dmigs rim mdor bsdus ba zhar la dka' drin rjes su dran tshul dang bcas pa 'di ni su nyid shog nas lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa rab 'byams pa 'jigs med grags pas bskul ngor/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /lags/ nyid nas dogs pa 'ga' zhig gnang 'dug pa'i don/tshogs zhing skabs rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal rang la phyogs sam/ thub dbang la phyogs gsung ba dben nas bka' 'bum du/ thub dbang la phyogs par gsung ba mdun du dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang 'dra bas/ gang zag khyad par can la don yang che ba zhig yin nam snyam yang / las dang po pa la blo (blang )dor bde ched ba rang la gzigs pa kho na ta lta'i khrid rgyun rnams su 'byung bar snang / g.yas g.yon gyi bla ma rnams kyang thub dbang la zhal phyogs par yongs 'dzin rin po che nas khrid gnang skabs gsung byung la/phur bu lcog gi gsung rgyun tho'u bkwan rin po ches zin bris mdzad par/172

༄/ /byams pa thub dbang la sku'i g.yon zur bstan te/ zhal rang la phyogs par gsung 'dug pas rje phur bu lcog pas kyang de gnyis blo la gang bde khyad med gnang gan yod pa yin 'dra/ sangs rgyas so lnga sogs yi dam gyi lha e yin gsung bar/ thub dbang dang rdo rje 'chang gnyis don la gcig kyang /mdo sngags so sor gsung dus kyi rnam pa'i ston tshul tsam yin pas/ mdo sngags so so'i nyams len skabs kyang de dang de'i rnam par bsam na rten 'brel che ba bzhin/ de dag rnams don la yi dam yin kyang / mdo rkyang ba'i nyams len skabs de'i cha nas bsam mi dgos sam snyam/ spyir lung gsum gyi ching gi skabs yi dam du gzung dgos par bshad pa ltar/ bsten sgrub bya ba'i yul gyi 'das lha thams cad yi dam du 'jog dgos pa 'dra lags/mchog sprul rnams kyi gtsug tor dbu skra'i rnam par yod dam/ sha rus kyi rnam par yod gsung ba/ snga ma ltar na dbu skra bsil tshe med 'gro bas phyi ma legs shing de yang da lta lhung bzed kha sbubab lta bur bshad cing byed pa mang na'ang / snga ma'i chag tshad 'ga' zhig tu 'bru'i phung po bzhin spyi bo bags kyis je mtho 'gyur bar bshad la/ rgya gar li ma 'ga' zhig tu 'ang de ltar 'byung ba 'thad dam snyam/ mtha'i mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can sogs su gsung gin 'dug la/ gong smos bzhin yi dam du 'gro yang / mdzad pa'i ldog cha nas phye bas gong 'og 'chol skyon mi 'byung ngam snyam/ bsnyen mtshams skabs thun mong yin min gyi srung 'khor mi sdud pas/ thun rjes ma la sa bon las bskyed e dgos gsung ba/ rgyu tshogs gnyis las dag pa'i snod bcud 'grub pa'i spyod byed du 'gro dgos stabs gnad tshang ba'i gzhi nas sa bon las bskyed pa lags/ mchod lha'i rtsa rtsi ka sogs ngo bo de nyid yin pa las rnam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'dzin par 173

༄/ /gung ca bam pa'isgonayo ga4 ཿma/gsung gin 'dug lags/ rtsa rtsi ka sogs la yab kyis 'khyud pa yin cing /de'i sngags bzla skabs gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dang tho ba gshin rje'i gshed gnyis kha'i yum gyi thugs gar 'khor lo ges mtshan pa dang / tho ba las mtshan pa 'god pa legs te/ gsum gdon gcig pas sngags mo ha ra nyis chog kyang / dang po bskyed skabs rang rang gi yab dang sa bon phyag mtshan gcig las skyes pas 'dir yang de dgos par mngon/ /lho sgo brgya stong sogs skur tshe cho ga grangs mnyam e dgos gsung ba/lcang skya thams cad mkhyen par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang de nyid nas dris lan mdzad pa zhig tu 'di dang cha mthun zhig gsungs 'dug pa ltar/ mtha' gcig tu grangs mnyam dgos pa'i gtan tshigs gzhan dka' yang phyag len sla chos su mi 'gyur ched mnyam dgos pa'i phyogs byas na legs sam snyam/gdugs dkar gyi rtsa zhal dang g.yas g.yon rgyab dang steng tshal rnams nyis brgya re gsungs pa/ rtsa zhal dngos dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal gyi tha snyad cher med la phyogs bzhi'i zhal rnams kyang brtsegs mar yod bas/ de las lhag pa'i steng zhal du 'jog tshul zhig kyang med rung de ltar gsungs pa ni/'khor tshal brgyad brgya po grangs mnyam par cha bzhir bgos pa'i mdun ma rnams la rtsa zhal sogs mdog mthun phyags bsdebs su btags pa tsam dang /de dag gi steng na yod pa kha dog mthun pa'i zhal nyis brgya la steng zhal du btags tsam las rgyu mtshan zur ba ma mthong / /rnam rgyal ma'i tshe sgrub skabs rnam rgyal mchod rten ci ste ma 'grigs tshe/bum pa'i nang du mchod rten lha bcas bskyed nas bsgrub e rung lags/zhus par/ rnam rgyal tshe sgrub skabs/ mchod rten ci ste ma 'grigs na de bzhin byas pas 'thus lags/174

༄/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i yi dam sgrub skor gyi dzam nag gi sgrub thabs su chu sbyin gyi gong du chu khyor ba gang kha la nye bar gtugs te/ rma igro ni sogs sngags lan bdun gyis kha dang sor mo sogs byin gyis brlabs par gsung bas/byin gyis brlabs rjes khyor ba'i chu de du ma pa'i chur blug gam ji ltar byed/zhus par/ dzam nag gi chu sbyin skabs kyang dmigs rnam skyong tshul nyid nas gsung ba de ka bzhin byas pas chog ste/ u tsu ṣṭha zhes pa 'chol ba dang spe ba gnyis ka la 'jug pas/ 'dir yang gtsang spe med pa gdol spyod lta bu sgos kyi rten 'brel la brten pa'i sgrub tshul zhig yin par mngon/ gtor ma mdun bskyed kyi lha de nyid la phul bas 'thus lags/ sngags ram pa'i mtshan btags skabs rgyud pa'i tshogs su bshad pa 'di ltar/ de'ang thun monga'im gyi dga' 'tshal yangs por rnam dag dbang gi sa bon smin pa las/dam tshig rdo rje'i rtsa ba rab tu brtan cing / rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lo 'dab g.yur du za ba/ 'phrin las bzhi yi me tog cir yang bkra zhing / rim gnyis lam bzang 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i gsang sngags yongs 'du'i ljon pa 'phags chen 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su zhu bar byed pa la/ sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis chos ldan gyi bya ba khyad par can la 'jug pa'i thog mar yul khyad par can la bstod cing skyabs su 'gro bar mdzad pa ni don chenapo dang ldan pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa las/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bskul ba yi/ / bstod tshig zhe ba 'di rnams kyis/ / rdo rje longs spyod bstod na ni/de yang sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhing khyad par can gyi mthu la brten nas gsang chen lam bzang nus pa yongs su smin te kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du 'grub pa'i phan 175

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgronasa'i ga4 'bum/yon bsam las 'das par ma zad/ gnas skabs su'ang ji skad du dkyil chog nyi shu pa las/ de bzhin gshegs rnams la bstod pa/ / de la sangs rgyas rdo rje sems/ / rang nyid grogs por nye bar gnas/ / zhes gsungs ba ltar/ yi dam chos srung rgya mtshor bcas pa rnams kyes sdongs grogs mdzad pa'i stobs kyis phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal te gnas skabs mthar thug gi chos ldan 'dod don ma lus ba bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba yin pas/ des na rang nyid kyis kyang skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar bzang po smon pa'i yul du byas nas yul khyad par can skyabs gnas yang dag la mchod bajod cung zad 'bul ba'i dbang du byas na/ rmad byung mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar longs spyod rdzogs/ / kha sbyor bde stong ro la rtag rol cing / / dmigs med thugs rje zhi ba'i mtha' spangs pa/ / rgyal ba yan lag bdun ldan la phyag 'tshal/ / zhes sogs rgyud gzhung brgyud 'debs ltar dang / zhes ma chod par brjod pa dang 'phrin las bcol ba de tsam zhig sngon du btang nas las su bya ba gang la 'jug pa yin zhe na sogs dkyus ltar ro/ /bla ma dang mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / de yang gting mtha' med pa srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams shing khyad par ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sa mang bar brdeg 'cha' pa'i skye bo rnams 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen po rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa zhes mtshan tsam rna ba'i lam du son pas kyang srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag sel ba'i 'dren pa gcig pu de nyid kyis bskal ba chen po grangs med pa gsum du bsags pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa rlabs po che'i mthu las grub pa/ dag pa'i zhing mchog bde ba can der 176

༄ /bgrod par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis zhing der skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo rgyal ba 'od dpag med la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang / zhing der skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag po sngar byas kyi dge rtsa rnams de'i rgyur bsngo ba gsum ya ma bral ba sogs der skye ba'i rgyu tshogs zhing bkod kyi mdo dang / de'i dgongs pa 'jam mgon bla mas zhing mchog sgo 'byed du gsungs pa sogs mthun rkyen rnams rang rgyud la tshang bar bsgrun zhing / 'gal rkyen tshe 'di'i lus longs spyod la chags pa sogs rgyang bsrings te/ dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang gi spyo bor kun bzang mchod sprin dbus/ / yid 'ong rma byas btegs pa nor bu'i khri/ / pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med 'dren pa bcom ldan 'od dpag med/ / thun mtshams 'od chags byu ru'i lhun po bzhin/ / lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar zhing / / mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas bdud rtsi'i lhung bzed bsnams/ / rdo rje skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ / gang gi tshogs gnyis spyod pas yongs sbyangs pa/ / sna tshogs rin chen rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing / / zag med bde dga' rgyas pa'i gzhal yas nas/ / ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs dbyer med gyur/ / mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob/ /yid la dran pas srid rtsa drung nas 'byin/ / ring du bsten na stobs bcu'i dpal ster ba/ / bla ma 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po yang / / rlabs chen bsod nams spel slad gus pas 'bul/ / zhing mchog dam par bgrod la gegs byed pa/ / nyes ltung sdig sgrib ma lus snying nas bshags/ / phan pa'i mchog sbyin rnam dkar legs byas kyi/ / dge tshogs sgrub pa kun la rjes yi rang / / bdag kyang zhing mchog dam pa der drangs te/ / zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston stsol mdzad 177

ro / /gung thang bstan ba'ilha sa gsung 'bum/cing / /ji srid khyod kyi go 'phang mngon gyur ba/ / de srid bdag gi 'dren par bzhugs su gsol/ / 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba mtha' dag kyang / /phan pa'i tshul gyis gnod la spyor ba yi/ / 'khor ba'i bde 'byor rgyu ru mi smin par/ / bde ldan zhing du skye ba'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / 'di snang 'gag tshe bcom ldan 'od dpag med/ / nye ba'i sras dang bcas pas zhal bstan nas/ / brtse ldan dgyes pa'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung ste/ / skad cig nyid la zhing der bgrod par shog / rin chen rang bzhin ri bo ljon shing dang / /mdzes pa'i ba gam tshogs kyis bskor ba yi/ / yan lag brgyad ldan rnyog bral dzing bu'i ngogs/ / 'dab stong padma'i spubs su skye bar shog /bsod nams brgyas bskrun rgyal ba'i zhal mthong zhing / / nyon mongs gdung sel gdam pa'i bcud myang ste/ / srid pa'i 'chi ba ring du dor ba yi/ /yid kyi khye'u kun dgas rtsen par shog / mkha' dbyings 'od zer dra ba mtha' dag las/ / snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis chos la skul byed cing / /gzungs spobs mthu ldan rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang / / lhan cig chos kyi dga' ston myong bar shog / zhing khams kun khyab sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes byed cing / / ma dag zhing gnas 'gro ba thams cad kyang / / yang dag lam bzang mchog la 'khrid par shog / mdor na bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / ring min rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor der skyes shing / / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa mthar phyin te/ / 'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson rnam par dkar ba'i lhag bsam mchog tu dge ba bstan 'dzin chos grags kyis bskul ngor dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams sngon du btang /178

༄/ /su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid skad cig gis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ 'al gcig phyagaganyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pas yu ba nas bzung ba'i utpa la'i steng na shes rab kyi ral gri dang sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ paṇa zhwa dang chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur par bsam la/ dmigs brtse ma ci 'grub bzla/ de nasamadun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po/ lto ba che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du ril bu rnams skad cig gis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po/ / zhes pa nas/zhabasardo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ ces pa'i bar sngar ltar brjod/ de'i spyi por oṃ dkar po/ / mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ / thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jig rten nas/ / bde gshegs seng ge'i nga ro sprul pa'i sku/ / chos kyi rgyal po kun mkhyen blo bzang grags/ / snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren phyir gshegs su gsol/ / rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / / tshad med thugs rjes 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs/ / rgyal ba kun gyis 'phrin las rgyas mdzad pa/ / dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ / oṃ su ma ti ki rti sa pa ri wā ra e bye hi badzra sa ma ya dza 179

༄/ /yo thang b.lo rsā sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/dza dza ྅ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa a mṛ tas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/oṃ arnya ā ྅/ oṃ pā 〉 rtu/ oṃ pukhye 〉 rtu/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ shasta ā rtu/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ / bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /dze btsun blo bzang grags pa la/ / 'bul gyis legs par bzhes nas kyang / / dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / oṃ gu ru su ma ti kerti arnya pra tī tstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar dang / a:gyi gnas su pākyinas shasta'i bar bcug la mchod pa phul/ blo gros khang bzang bslab gsum nor gyis phyug / bzang po'i 'phrin las gdul bya'i dpal du shar/ / grags pa'i 'od zer 'dzam gling phyogs bcur 'phro/ / blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ril bu rnams rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam pa can du gyur ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos skyong srung ma sogs skyabs gnas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od dang / 'od zer dang / bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang / rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i sku'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ ril bu rnams dang dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa dang bcas te dmigs brtse ma 'don/mjug tu/ oṃ gu ru su ma ti garti arnya sogs kyis mchod/ blo gros khang bzang sogs kyis bstod/ mjug tu/ ril bu rje btsun tsong kha pa'i rnam par 180

༄/ /bzhugs pa 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya zhing me tog gtor te/ smon lam shis brjod rgyas pa bya/ zhesaba'adi ni ab gnyid tshang hu thog thus/ tshogs chen du dge ldan ril sgrub byed skabs 'don cha'i rim pa zur du bkol te stsal pa'o/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas gzung ste/ / rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can gye/ / skyes mchog tshad mar gyur ba phal mo che'i/ /thugs dam rten dang na bza' nyer spyad sogs/ / gang zhig mthong zhing reg pa tsam gyes kyang / / gnas skabs nad gdon kun zhi tshe bsod rgyas/ /mthar thug thar pa'i sa bon bskrun nges pa'i/ / byin rlabs mi zad gter chen 'di na bzhugs/ / mchog gsum rten gyi 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal 'dir/ / skal bzang mgron du lhags pa'i rkang drug rnams/ / byin rlabs sbrang rtsi'i phung po nyer spyad de/ / dga' dang dad dang smon pa'i gar sgyur ces/ / ces pa 'di'ang nang rten rnams kyi kha byang du stsal pa'o/ /sna chogs yum gyi bum sgrub bzhugs so//bum sgrub byed na bum pa bsang sbyangs/ / stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung pa'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po lto ba che ba zhes pa nas dbyer mi byed par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du baṃ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du phro dang gri gug las bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas padma dkar po dang / g.yon skyabs sbyin gyiphyag rgyas utpal dkar po'i yu ba thugs gar bsnams pa snyan gyi thad shar 181

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i sgronalo na 'bum/rgyas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi por oṃ/ mgrin par bee thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dza nyu baṃ ho dbang lhas dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ bha ga wa ti bi shā mā ta arnya nas shasta pra tī tstsha hūṃ swāhā/ rgyal ba kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma/ / skye ba dang ni 'jigs pa spangs/ / kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ / sna tshogs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / de'i thugs gar zla ba'i steng du bro yig gi mthar sngags kyi bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te bstem/ yang de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa'i chu dang gcig tu 'dres pas/ tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du rdo rje tsher ma'i nad myong 'gyur gyi las ngan sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong ba'i nus pa can du byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ bro bi sha mā ta/ badzra gaspyo gan/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ma ma shirnyi ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ mjug tu yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / bum pa'i lha ye shes ba rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nasabum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ 'di yang rdo rje 'chang chos kyi nyi ma'i gsung gi mngon rtogs kyis gzhir byas te kha skong gi tshul du 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i chu shel khams/ / bzhin legs bcu drug lang tsho lha yi sku/ / mtshan dpe ri dwags mtshan ma'i rnam rol pa/ / srid zhi'i gdung sel zla ba spyan ras gzigs/ / bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod ji snyed bgyis pa dang / / khyad par dam rdzas ril bu'i bdag nyid du/ / sgrub cing 182

༄ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i bskul pa'i mthus/ / tshe rabs kun tu 'phags pas rjes 'dzin shog / ngan song skye sgo gcod byed thabs kyi mchog / sdig ltung nad brgya sel ba'i amṛ ta/ / ril bu 'di nyid gang gis myang ba kun/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las thar par shog / gang du sgrub pa'i yul phyogs rnams su yang / / 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs mthus/ / nad mug 'khrugs sogs nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / chos srid 'byor ba'i dga' ston rgyas par shog / mthong thos reg sogs 'brel ba thogs pa kun/ / 'di snang 'gag tshe spyan ras gzigs mgon gyis/ / lam mkhan mdzad nas bde ldan zhing khams su/ / skyes te 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong shog / de yi gsung gi dga' ston la rol cing / / thun mong lam sbyangs mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi/ / lam bzang mngon du gyur nas mi ring bar/ / phyag na pazo'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / mdor na bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang / / snying rje'i gter chen gang gis bden pa'i mthus/ /smon pa'i don kun gegs med myur 'grub nas/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba srid las sgol bar shog / ces smon lam bya zhing / shis brjod ni/ dge legs nyin mor byed pa'i 'od phreng gis/ / kun tu gsal byas lha yi rdzing ring ngos/ / go 'tshams med par til gyi gang bu ltar/ / yongs su dkrigs shing byin rlabs char 'bebs pa/ / rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang / / rab 'byams bde gshegs sras dang slob mar bcas/ / kun gyi brtse bas nyer dgongs bden pa'i mthus/ / ma lus phan bde'i gzhi rten rgyal ba'i bstan/ / 'khrul bral blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs mchog / ha sa badzra mdo sngags bka' srol kun/ / phyogs dus kun tu rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / srid na zla bral skyabs 183

༄/ /yo thang bayo ཿthonasa'i ga4 ཿma/mgon dam pa sogs/ / bshad sgrub zung du 'jug pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /thub bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i skyes mchog rnams/ / sku tshe bskal brgyar brtan pa'i bkra shis shog / mi yi lha rnams chos kyi srid skyong zhing / / mnga' 'bangs skyon bral dge bcu'i khrims kyis 'tsho/ / dzogs ldan dpal la 'khu ba'i bde 'byor gyi/ / kun dga' khong nas bzhad pa'i bkra shis shog /srid lam dub pa'i nyam thag 'gro ba kun/ / 'phags chen spyan stong mnga' ba'i rjes bzung ste/ / bzod dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ /zag med dga' ston rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / mdor na mi shis rgud pa'i mun tshogs kun/ / mchog gsum nyin byed gzi 'od kyis bcom nas/ /dge legs pad dkar phreng ba bzhad pa yi/ / ngo mtshar sbrang rtsi'i dog pa rgyas gyur cig / thugs rje chen po'i ril sgrub kyi mjug tu bya rgyu'i smon lam shis brjod 'di lta bu zhig dgo4zhes mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang lhag bsam dge ba can rab 'byams pa ngag dbang mchog ldan gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bal po'i gzhung nas 'phral du bris pa'o/ /bla ma 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir gshin po'i don du 'pho ba byed par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis cho ga tshad dang ldan pa sngon du 'gro bas mchog gsum gye bden stobs brjod de rnam shes dgug pa nan tan du byas pa'i steng nas bgegs sdig dri ma sbyang ba dang / lam sbyang bstan rnams legs par byas la/ slar yang skyabs yul rnams la gdung shugs drag pos mos gus dang gshin po de nyid yul du byas pa'i snying rje shugs drag pos gsal btab ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ / byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ nub 1༅

༄/ /phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ / nyam thag 'gro ba'i mgon po 'od dpag med/ / nye ba'i sras mchog brgyad sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs shig / sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing / / zhing khams kun khyab mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul/ / mi bzad nyes ltung ma lus snying nas bshags/ / rnam dkar dge pa'i tshogs la rjes yi ring / / bskal ba rgya mtshor mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ / dge tshogs kun kyang bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ / bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs par dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do skyabs su mchi'i/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun dgu sogs brjod/ de nas 'o lags so/ /'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba khyod nyon cig 'dul ba lung las/ skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba ste/ / 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba yin/ / zhes dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos/ mi rtag srin pos ma zos pa'i/ / sems can de ni 'ga' ma mchis/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba zhig blangs phyin skyes mtha' 'chi ba'i chos las ma 'das shing /gnyen mdza' bshes sogs dang lhan cig ji tsam 'grogs kyang brtse ba med pa 'chi bdag gi pho nyas glebs pa na phan tshun gtan bral du gyur nas n+ya ngan chen po ldang ba yang mchog dman bar ma kun gye thog tu yod pa'i 'jig rten spyi'i ngang tshul yin te/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/ mdza' ba yun ring 'khod 'khod nas/ / 'chi bas so sor bral 'gyur te/ / mya ngan chen po 185

༄/ /gung ca bayo ཿ sgoname'i khrung ༅ma/ldang bar 'gyur/ / de yang 'jig rten 'di na nges/ / zhes sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis gsungs pa ltar yin/ de lta bu'i 'chi ba de da lan khyod kyi thog tu babs te tshe snga ma'i snang ba ni nub/ phyi ma ma rnyed pas da ltar srid pa bar do na gnas pa'i skabs yin/ de yang gang gis shes na mdzod las/sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can/ / dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ / mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar gang du skye 'gyur gye phyi ma'i lus dang dbyibs mtshungs pa/ / dbang po kun tshang zhing las kyi rlung gis bdas te sngon bgrod dka' ba'i gnas rnams lta ci smos/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa'i pha rol tu yang skad cig tsam gyis sleb nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bu yod pa/ de'i stobs kyis sngar 'dris pa'i gnyen dang mdza' bshes la sogs pa thams cad kyi rtsar song ste gtam la sogs pa smras kyang lan mi ster zhing shi ba'i gtam byed pa sogs kyis sems lhag par skyo zhing sdug bsngal ba dang / las las grub pa'i dgra gnyen gye snang ba sna tshogs pas blo sna brid de/ res 'ga' dga' zhing spro ba dang / res 'ga' 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dga' sdug gi snang ba 'gyur ldog sna tshogs pa/ glo bur glo bur du 'byung ba'ang khyed rang bar dor gnas pa'i rtags yin/ sngar 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung thim pa'i stobs kyis ri bo snyil ba/ rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa/ nags la me shor ba/ bskal pa'i rlung g.yos pa lta bu'i sgra shin tu ya nga ba snying 'gas pa lta bu dang / dug gsum gyi rang gzugs dkaradamar nag pa'i g.yang sa chen po gsum du lhung ba'i nyams shar ba de dag gi tshe snga ma'i lus rten dor ba yin te/ da lta sngar dang mi 'dra bar nang du rags pa'i khams dkar dmar mi gnas pa'i stobs kyis phyi'i nyi zla sogs kyi snang ba mi 'char zhing / lus la grib ma'ang med pa 'di rten de nyid dor 186

༄/ /zin pa'i rtags yin/ spyir chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin mod kyang /khyad par bar do'i skabs kyi bde sdug dga' 'jigs sogs kyi snang ba 'di ni rmi lam du mes tshigs pa dang / lha'i dpal 'byor la spyad pa bzhin dngos gnas la phan gnod ci yang 'byung rgyu med par ma zad/ de la 'khrul snang du ngo ma shes par rjes su 'brang na skye gnas ngan pa sna tshogs su 'khrid pas shin tu bsgrim dgos/ rigs drug so sor skye ba'i rtags kyi snang ba 'char tshul yang / dmyal bar skye na lcags khang dang gangs ri'i 'khyag spub/ yi dwags su skye na mya ngam gyi thang dmar po sogs rang rang gi gnas kyi bkod pa shas cher 'char la kha dog ni dmyal ba'i bar do sol ba lta bu/ yi dwags kyi bar do du ba lta bu/ dud 'gro'i bar do chu lta bu/ 'dod pa'i lha mi'i bar do gser lta bu gzugs khams pa'i bar do ni dkar por mngal 'jug gi mdo las gsungs/ 'gro tshul lha'i bar do gyen dang / mi'i bar do thad kangan song gi bar do spyi'u tshugs su 'gro bar gsungs la/ mdzod 'grel las/phyi ma'i 'gro ba de dang de'i 'gro tshul dang cha mtshungs par yang bshad/ khyad par 'khor ba'i btson ra'i nang du 'khrid byed kyi gtso bo srid pa yin pas/brdzus te skye na gnas la srid pa skye/ drod gsher las skye na dri ro la srid pa skye/sgong dang mngal las skye na rigs mthun gyi gang zag mthong ste tshul min gyi spyod pa la log par zhen pa'i dbang gis mtshams sbyor ba yin thing / de ltar skye ba blang phyin 'phral dang yun du sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ de bas khyed rang gi mgon skyabs su bdag gis/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba 'od dpas med pa 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam khar spyan drangs nas bzhugs yo da cing /zhing dang dngos po bsam pa phun sum tshogs pas dge rtsa rnam par dag pa byed bzhin pa 'di yin pas khyod rang gis kyang 'khrul snang gzhan gyi rjes su ma 187

༄/ /ca thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'brang bar dge rtsa 'di dag blos blang ste dga' ba bsgom pa dang / khyad par rgyal ba 'od dpag med la dad gus shugs drag pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab na bar do'i sems can chu nang gi gzings ltar du kha sgyur sla bas/ngan 'gro'i skye sred bzlog nas zhing khyad par can du skye ba la the tshom med pas nged kyis ji ltar brjod pa bzhin du blo lings kyis bkal nas re sa gzhan na med pa'i blo ltos bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa dang / mthar mgon po 'od dpag med kyi thugs gar 'pho ba'i 'dun pa shugs drag po mdzad par zhu/nyam thag 'gro la lhag par thugs brtse zhing / / mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob/ / lha mi'i ston pa rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ / bslu med skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / mi bzad khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson ra ru/ / sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar pa'i 'gro kun dang / /khyad par 'khrul snang gshin rjes khrid pa yi/ / skyabs med bar do'i 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ / 'di snang zhen pa'i 'ching ba dral du gsol/ / nyon sdig ltung ma lus sbyang du gsol/ 'jigs rung gshin rje'i g.yul las bskyab tu gsol/ / 'khrul snang bar do'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol/ / mi khom ngan song skye sgo bcad du gsol/ / zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ / mgon khyod thugs rjes 'od kyi lcags kyu yis/ / tshe 'das rnam shes gyen du drangs byas te/ / gnyis med ye shes hrī yig la bstem nas/ / zhing mchog bde ba can der khrid du gsol/ / mgon khyod sras kyi thu bor 'gyur bar mdzod/ / khyod min skyabs gzhan med do thugs rjes gzigs/ / zhes pa'i bar lan gcig gam gsum bya/ de nas/ nyig lan gsum dang / phaṭa lan gcig brjod pas shin po'i rnam shes mgon po 'od dpag med kyi thugs dang bsres te bde ba can du 'phang bar bsam la/188
