༄ rargyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ / padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ / snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ / lung bstan pa yang tshe 'das der thob shog / ces bsngo bas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/zhes gshin por 'pho ba byed tshul bsdus pa bar do'i chos bshad dang bcas pa 'di yang a mtsho dgon pa'i khri ba zhabs drung ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge'i ba ni dge tshul dpon mchog bsam grub kyis bris pa'o/ /de'ang thun re bzhin kun slong gi steng nas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi gnad tshang bar byed tshul dgos zer ba la grwa pa thams cad ma lus par 'tshogs pa la grwa tshang yongs rdzogs zer ba bzhin so so bar song na rdzogs mtha' med pas nyams len sna gcig la'ang thams cad rdzogs pa dbos/'o na dmigs skor phyi ma rnams mi dgos sam snyam na ma yin te/ a gar so lnga thun gcig la spyor ba sna tshang yang rlung nad tshab can de thun gcig gis mi sel bar mang po bstud nas 'thung dgos pa dang 'dra/ re re la'ang thams cad tshang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bstan pa yongs su rdzogs ma rdzogs zhes pa gdul bya'i skyon mtha' dag spong ba'i thabs dang / yon tan mtha' dag sgrub pa'i thabs tshang ma tshang yin la/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs ni sangs rgyas kho na yin pas sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs rnal mar 'gro ba la bstan pa yongs su rdzogs dgos pa yin/ bsam sbyor de 'dra zhig byung na de la rnam kun dzogs pa'i sbyor ba zer/ 'o na sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa rang gis chog gam snyam na/ de bsam tshul la thug yod/ rgyu'i bsam mno ci yang med par 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob na snyam pas mi chog dbus su 'gro bar thag chod pa la lam dang cha rkyen lam grogs thams cad kyi 'dang 'ig 189

༄/ /yo ca ཿna pa'ithonalo khrung 'bum/yod dgos/ skas gdangs mang po 'dzeg pa'i dus mtho dman gyi khyad yod kyang gom pa 'degs pa'i bya ba dang / khang thog tu 'gro 'dod kyi 'phen pa la khyad ci yang med pa bzhin/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs skor la go rim yod kyang kun slong gi bsam sbyor sna gcig po des 'khyong dgos/ lha'i gos de bsgril na sen mo'i bar du tshud/ / kha phye na lus kun khebs pa zhig yod zer ba bzhin/ sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i kun slong de'ang rgyas bsdus byed tshul shes dgos te/ sangs rgyas thob par bya zhes pa yon tan kun rdzogs par bya zhes pa yin la/ de rdzogs pa la srang mda'i mtho dman bzhin skyon kun spong dgos/ skyon la sgo gsum du yod cing / der yang phra rags gnyis re yod pas/ rags pa mdos sbyong zhing / phra ba sngags kyis sbyong dgos la/ rags pa ma sbyangs par phra ba spyong tshul med pas sngon la mdo dang / phra ba sngags la ma brten par sbyang mi nus pas sngags te gnyi ga tshang dgos pa de yin rags pa'ang lus ngag gi nyes spyod gtso bor sbyong zhing sdom byed so thar yin la/ de'i rtsa ba chung 'bring gi lam gyes 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi sdug bsngal bsams nas nges 'byung rnam dag skye ba la thug yod/ yid kyi nyes pa'i rtsa ba ngar 'dzin yin/ des rtsa ba byas te rang gzhan so sor bcad nas chags sdang gis blang dor go log pas phung khrol thams cad byas pa yin pas ngar 'dzin de don dam byang chub kyi sems kyis sbyong blo ngan phyi ma thams cad byams snying rje'i rtsa ba can kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyis spyong bas skyes bu chen po'i lam thun mong ba der tshang / skyon phra mo spong bar sngags kyis snon pa 'debs dgos la/ de'ang mtshan bcas kyis lus ngag dang /mtshan med kyis yid kyi nyes pa sbyong tshul yang shes dgos la/ mthar gtugasan lus kyi nyes pa sbyong byed bskyed rim phra rags/ ngag gi nyes pa 190

༄ rasbyongabyed kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rdzogs rim/ yid kyi nyes pa sbyong byed don dam 'od gsal kyi rdzogs rim yin/ zung 'jug ni de gnyis tshogs pa la 'jog pas log na med/ de ltar sgo gsum gyi skyon phra rags zad par spangs te sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur pa ni sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin/ 'bras bu de 'dra ba zhig thob pa'i phyir de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rgyu tshogs kyang ma tshang ba med pa zhig bya'o snyam du mig rgyang bsrings/ yid rgya bskyed de/ shin tu goms pa'i lam srang la bsam mno btang ba bzhin dmigs 'og tu rug ge tshud pa zhig byung na kun slong rang la lam rim tshang ba dang / bstan pa'i gnad rdzogs pa bya ba de byung ba yin no/ / sarba marga li/ /191

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs smon chig gi skor drang srong chen po'i bden chig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / rgyal ba ma lus skyed pa'i yab gyur kyang / / rgyal sras tshul gyes zhing khams rab 'byams su/ / rgyal ba'i chos 'dzin thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthus/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / sngon tshe dbang po'i tog gi spyan snga ru/ / dam bcas tshe na snying stobs chen po zhes/ / sras bcas rgyal bas bsngags brjod bden pa'i mthus/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / lta spyod gtsang ma'i brgyud pa spel ba'i phyir/ / thub pa'i drung du shel dkar 'phreng ba phul/ / chos dung gnang zhing lung bstan bden pa'i mthus/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / lta ba rnam dag rtag chad mtha' las grol/ / sgom pa rnam dag bying rmug mun pa sangs/ / spyod pa rnam dag rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / mang du thos pa rgya cher btsal bas mkhas/ / thos don ji bzhin rgyud la sbyar bas btsun/ / kun kyang bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo bas bzang / / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / drang nges gsung rab ma lus 'gal med du/ / gang zag gcig gi nyams len gdams pa ru/ / ngas (nges) pa rnyed pas nyes spyod mtha' dag 'gags/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / lung chos sde 192

ra ji/ / (shāthab /:rebasdobashasnod gsum gyi 'chad nyan dang / / rtogs pa'i bstan pa bslab gsum nyams len te/ / mkhas shing grub pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung / / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / phyi ru nyan thos spyod pas zhi zhing dul/ / nang du rim gnyis rnal 'byor gdeng dang ldan/ / mdo sngags lam bzang 'gal med grogs su 'khyer/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / rgyu yi theg par bshad pa'i stong ba nyid/ / 'bras bu'i thabs kyis sgrub pa'i bde chen dang / / mnyam sbyor chos phung brgyad khri'i snying po'i bcud/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / skyes bu gsum gye lam gye srung ma'i gtso/ / myur mdzad mgon dang rnam sras las gshin sogs/ / bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / mdor na dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan/ / mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin dam pas sa steng gang / / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba yis/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni lhag bsam rnam dpyod yangs pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang bstan pas bskul zhing / spyir deng dus rje bla ma'i bstan pa 'di ni zungs zad kyi nad pa sman pas bor ba bzhin du bdag tu 'dzin pa 'ga'ang ba mi snang bas cung zad re bsring thub na'ang ci ma rung snam du smon pa'i yid kyis/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo yākhro mai tra ye/ byams pas bsgrubs pa'i mdzes sku mtshan dpe'i dpal/ / byams pa'i shugs kyis legs 'doms tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /byams brtse'i ye shes chos kun mngon byang chub/ / byams mgon thugs rje'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ring nas goms pas thugs la zhen pa yi/ /byams chen bdud rtsis zhe sdang me dpung bcil/ / mi bzad bdud kyi snyems pa mthar byed cing / / grags pa'i mtshan gyes phyogs bcu'i zhing kun 193

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'ithonas khrung las/khyab/ / gang gis yongs su bzung ba'i dag pa'i zhing / / dga' ldan gnas mchog yid dga' chos 'dzin zhes/ / snyan pa yid 'ong bdud rtsi'i gzeg mas kyang / / yid la zag med dga' ba'i dpal ster pa/ / der ni skye ba'i myu gu 'grub pa dang / / rgyal ba'i zhal bzang dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang /zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi myong ba'i phyir/ / legs sgon phreng ba mdo tsam spel ba 'di/ / rgyal tshab mgon gye dam bca'i dpung ba dang / rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i thugs rjes byin rlabs dang / rgyal yum chos dbyings rnam dag bden pa'i mthus/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa nas bzung ste/ sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bsgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal pa dang / bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig mchis pa thams cad gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas/ 'chi ba'i dus la nye bar bab pa na/ stobs bcu mnga' ba rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po rgyalasras bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal mngon sum du ston par gyur cig de nas 'jigs pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bu bu 'khor ba'i 'ching thag gnyen bshes zas nor sogs la zhen pa spangs shing 'khrul snang za zi'i rjes su mi 'brang bar nga'i sku dang zhing gi bkod pa yid la gyis la dag pa'i zhing du shog cig ces brtse ba'i gsung gis dbugs 'byin par gyur cig de'i stobs kyis lus dang sems la sdug bsngal phra mo tsam yang med par dge ba'i bsam pa khyad can gyi ngang nas shi 'phos te dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du 'dab stong padma'i spubs su rdzus te skye ba len par gyur cig de ma thag tu chos kyi pho brang rgyal 194

ra ji/ /ngasago 11sa pa'i36gamatshan mthon por mi pham mgon po'i drung du lhags shing / de'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis 'bar ba gser gyi lhun po nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa lta bu/'jig rten gsum gyi mdzes sdug ma lus pa gcig tu bsdus pa lta bu/ tshogs gnyis dag pa'i spyod pa mtha' dag gzugs su shar ba lta bu mig gi bdud rtsir gyur te dga' ba dang spro ba dang dad pa'i shugs phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel bar gyur cig de na bzhugs pa mnyam med jo bo chen po dang / blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po la sogs pa bdag nyid chen po kun gyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal zhing / de dag thams cad kyis kyang brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig de nas kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po nam mkha' gang ba yongs su sprul te rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad mnyes par byed par gyur cig des rjes su bstan pa la brten nas ris su ma chad pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje shugs drag tu skyes pas rgyud bskul zhing / rgyal ba'i yon tan mthong bas yid drangs te bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par gyur cig sems bskyed nas kyang rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob pa'i phyir du thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams su bgrod nas gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa zad mi shes pa nod par gyur cig de'i don thos pa dang /bsam pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyis ma tshang ba med par gtan la phab ste/nyan thos kyi lam dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi dbye ba shes par byas nas srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i zeg pa chen po'i thabs mkhas kyi nye ba'i lam la mkhas par byed par gyur cigade nas dbang du byed pa bsgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab zhi gnas dang /lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas dmigs pa dang rnam pa dang mtshan nyid 195

༄/ /yo ca bayo lo sgronaḥ khrung 'a4/yongs su rdzogs pa'i theg pa gsum gyi rtogs pa'i rigs ma lus pa la slob par gyur cig sems kyi rang bzhin yongs su sbyangs pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma ci rigs pa dang bral nas goms pa dbang du gyur pa'i rtse mo'i sbyor ba thob par gyur cig / gang la bslab par bya ba dmigs pa'i yul mtha' yas pa dang / ched du bya ba go rims bzhin du slob cing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshang ba'i go cha ma nyams pa dgos te/ de'i tshogs ma tshang ba med pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i sras kyis gong ma rnams su mthar gyis 'jug par gyur cigade nas nges par 'byung ba'i sgrub pa mtshan ma med cing rtsol ba med pa'i lam gyis zo chun gyi 'khor lo gcig car bsgyur ba bzhin du sgrib pa ma lus pa 'byin pa'i sbyor ba mthar thug pa skad cig ma gcig gis mngon du byed par gyur cig de'i skad cig gnyis par gang la dmigs nas sems bskyed pa chos kyi sku spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin pa brnyes nas dag pa dang ma dag pa'i gdul bya rnams la gang 'tsham du sku'i bkod pa bstan te lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par 'khor ba'i mthas gtugs par 'gro ba kun gyi phan pa dang bde ba'i nyer 'tsho'i rten du gyur cig na mo ratna tu yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ shākya mu na ye/ ta thā gtā ya/ ar ha te saṃ mya kle bu dha ya/ ta du thā oṃ a dzi ti/ a dze te/ a pa rā dze te/ a dzi tan dzā ya/ ha ra ha ra/ mai tri a ba lo ki te/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hā sa ma ya sirnyi/bha ra bha ra/ ma hā bo dhi martse bī dze/ sma ra sma ra/ a sma ki sa ma ya/ bo dhi bo rnyi/ ma hā bo dhi swāhā/ oṃ mo hi mo hi/ ma hā mo hi swāhā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni sma ra swāhwa/ lan gsum/ na mo bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / khyad par rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po'i thugs bskyed dam bca'i mthu dang / gzungs kyi bden pa la brten nas ji ltar smon pa'i don thams cad 196

༄/ /dgoldanabastanapargyasapa'ide bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig 'bras bu dman pa 'khor bar 'ching byedakyi rnyed bkur snyan grags la sogs pa'i rgyur cung zad tsam yang mi smin par gyur cig gal te skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par dga' ldan gye gnas su skye bar ma nus na'ang dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang po brgyud mar thob cing byams mgon thugs rje'i gter gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig khyad par skye dgu tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus su byams mgon rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'jig rten du shar ba'i tshe 'khor gyi thog mar skyes nas gsung gi bdud rtsi la ngoms med du longs spyad de sa lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rnams bde blag tu bgrod nus par gyur cig dge ba'i rtsa ba 'didag gis mtshon bdag dang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad khong khro dang / lta ba ngan pa dang / log par bsngo ba la sogs pa'i skyon gyis cung zad tsam yang mi nyams par dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyis gang du bsngos shing bsngo bar 'gyur ba dang / rgyal sras chen po 'jam dpal kun bzang sogs kyis ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu de dang de dag 'grub pa'i rgyu rnam/ par dag pa kho nar gyur cig nam zhig 'di snang 'gag par nye ba'i tshe/ /byams mgon zhal mthong dad pas yid drangs te/ / dga' lda na gnas su padmo las skyes nas/ / rgyal ba sras bcas mnyes par byed par shog / zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud myangs te/ / bla med byang chub mchos tu sems bskyed cing / / theg gsum lam gyi rtogs rigs yongs rdzogs nas/ / mthar thug sku bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog / mdor na dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun/ / 'bras bu dman (pa'i ) rgyu ru mi 'gyur par/ / byams mgon 'khor gyi thog mar skyes gyur te/ / yang dag lam bzang gegs med mthar phyin shog / ces dga' ldan yid dga' chos 197

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung la /'dzin du skye ba'i smon lam 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog thabs mkhas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes skal mnyam rnams la phan pa'i slad go bde bar 'bol rtsom du bgyis pa 'dis kyang skye bo rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig pu/ / dus gsum bde gshegasasras kyi thu bo'i tshul/ / rnam 'dren yongs kyi ye shes gcig bsdus dngos/ /kun gzigs mkhyen pa'i gter gyes ring du skyongs/ / sgrib bral ye shes gser gyi thur ma yis/ / skal bzang thar 'dod blo mig 'byed pa'i gnyen/ /khyod zhabs gus pas bsten pa bdag cag gi / mi shes rmongs pa'i dra ba gcad du gsol/ / yang dag lam gye rjes su mngon phyogs pa'i/ /legs smon yid kyi 'dun pa ma lus pa/ / gegs med smon bzhin 'grub pa'i dpang mdzad de/ / thugs rje'i bden pa mngon sum bstan du gsol/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa'i skye 'phags lus can kun gye rnam dkar phung po bdag cag gi thos bsam sgom pa'i dge tshogs dang chabs cig tu bsdoms shing khyad par du tshul khrims rnam par dag pa sogs rgyal ba'i sras kyi smon lam 'grub pa dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i rgyu tshogs lnga bcu rtsa lnga gsungs pa sogs kyi rjes su bslab pa'i mthu la brten nas snying rje'i snying po can gyi yang dag pa'i lta bas blo mig phye ste thar pa bla na med pa'i grong khyer du 'jug par gyur cig / 'jig rten phyi mar 'pho ba'i tshe skye 'chi'i snang ba kun la mtshan mar mi zhen cing de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje dang rgyal ba kun gzigs kyi sku dang gsung gi snang ba mngon du gyur pa'i dad pas yid drangs te de nyid kyi zhing khams yongs su rdzogs shing dag la rdul med pa bsags pa zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung du 198

༄/ /dgoldanabastagapargyasapa'ima'ibye ma snyed tsam du tha gru yangs shing gang la gang 'dod kyi rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rang bzhin du snang ba sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pas gtams shingakhyang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rab tu byung ba sha stag gis gang ba de lta buraskye bar gyur cig skyes ma thag tu stong gsum bcu'i tshad dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung na de bzhin gshegs pa kun gzigs sku dpag tshad brgyadakhri bzhi stong mnga' ba 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi ri bo ltar lham mer bzhugs shing 'khor dpag tshad bzhi khri nyis stong tsam gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba mngon sum du mthong bar gyur cigamathong ba'i mod la tshig gis mtshon mi dgos par rmongs pa dang som nyi'i dra ba yongs su chad de zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi tshogs don ma lus pa bde blag tu rtogs par gyur cig chos dang don mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pa mos pa spyod pa'i sa la snying rje byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba gsum sbyong zhing khyad par du de kho na nyid kyi don thos bsam dang sgom byung gi shes rab kyis gtan la phab ste gzung 'dzin rtog pa mngon gyur pa nyams smod cing grangs med dang po'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig de nas bden pa mngon par rtogs pas sa rab tu dga' ba la chos kyi dbyings bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa kun tu 'gro ba'i don du rtogs pa'i stobs kyis sbyin pa'i phar phyin lhag par thob par gyur cig rjes la mngon par rtogs pas bsdus pas lhag ma rnams la'ang spang blang don dam par med kyang tha snyad du mchog gi don du mthong bas tshul khrims lhag pa sogs chos nyid gzigs tshul gyi dbang gis bzod pa dang brtson 'grus dang bsam gtan dang shes rab dang thabs mkhas dang smon lam dang stobs dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnams lhag par thob par gyur cig sa dang por skad cig ma gcig la sangs rgyas brgya 199

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'isgonasa'i gsung ཿma/mthong ba dang de dag gis byin gyes rlobs pa dang bskal ba brgyar gnas pa dang snga phyi'i bskal pa brgya gzigs pa dang ting nge 'dzin brgya la 'jug pa dang 'jig rten gye khams brgya g.yo ba dang zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang zhing brgya sprul pa dang sems can brgya smin pa dang chos sgo brgya 'byed pa dang lus brgya sprul pa dang lus re re la 'khor byang sems brgya brgya dang ldan pa ste yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis thob cing / sa lhag ma rnams la yon tan sde tshan bcu gnyis po de dag re re zhing stong phrag dang 'bum phrag dang bye ba brgya phrag dang bye ba stong phrag dang bye ba 'bum phrag dang bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dang stong gsum 'bum phrag gcig gi rdul grangs dang stong gsum grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul grangs dang brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i stong gsum gyi rdul grangs dang mnyam pa thob par gyur cig sa dang por thun mong ma yin pa'i bslab pa gsum dang zag med kyi phung po sbyong pa'i rten 'grub cing /gnyis par tshul khrims/ gsum par ting nge 'dzin/ bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa gsum la/ byang chub phyogs mthun dang bden bzhi dang rten 'brel shes pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa 'grub cing / sa lhag ma rnams su bslab pa'i 'bras bu grub pa dang rnam par grol ba'i phung po yongs su spyod par gyur cigamador na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lus sogs rnam smin gyi skye ba 'dzin pa'i khyad par dang rmi ltas kyis khyad par spangs bya spangs pa'i khyad par sogs rim pa bzhin du mngon 'gyur te ma dag sa bdun du grangs med gnyis pa'i tshogs dang / mtshan ma med cing rtsol ba med pa dag pa'i sa gsum du grangs med gsum pa'i tshogs yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig de nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrib pa ma lus pa drungs phyung nas rang don phun tshogs chos kyi sku mngon du byas te gzhan gye don la thogs pa med par 'jug pa stobs bcu'i 200

ra ji/ / 15bsgyu /:rebaste gasgonas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las yongs su sgrol bar gyur cig dus gsum gyi dge tshogs mtha' dag kyang dmigs med kyi lta bas yongs su zin pa'i dbang gis nam yang mnyam pa med pa dang de'i mthu la brten nas gnas lugs zab mo'i don la thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin cing thabs khyad par can gye grogs dang bcas pas srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag bsal te don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal la myur du reg par gyur cig na mo mdzi shrī ku mar sgru tā ya/ tarya thā/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze/ shudhe bi shudhe/ shodha ne bi shodha/ sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nir ma le/ dza ya bā re/ ru ru tsa le/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhwa/ lan gsum/ rnam 'dren kun gyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / phyi nang gshin rje'i gshed po lha ra wa/ / ngur sprig gar mdzad blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang / / dbyer med thugs rje'i bden pa chen po'i mthus/ / bdag gzhan dus gsum dge tshogs ma lus pa/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thugs bskyed dang 'dres te/ / snying rje'i snying po can gyi lta ba yis/ / srid zhi'i 'ching ba gcod pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 'khrul bral blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ / thos bsam sgom pa gegs med mthar phyin nas/ / bla ma lha yi go 'phang mngon gyur te/ / 'gro kun byang chub mchog la 'godagyur cig / ces pa 'di ni rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa rab 'byams pa grags pa chos bzang gis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /tshul khrims phung po yongs rdzogs bcom ldan 'das/ / tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dam pa'i chos/ tshul khrims ldan 'ing mang thos dge 'dun rnams/ / tshul bzhin smon pa 'grub pa'i dbang po mdzod/ / deng nas 201

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i ga lam/brtsams te skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / dal 'byor rten thob dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / /tshul bzhin thos bsam sgom pa'i rim pa yis/ / rnam dag rgyal ba'i bstan la slob gyur cig / khyad par mngon mtho nges legs kun gye rgyu/ / bstan pa'i rtsa ba ston pa'i gdung 'tshob mchog / nyon mongs dgra 'joms thar pa'i sgo gcig pu/ / so thar sdom pa tshul bzhin srung gyur cig / srid dang zhi ba'i g.yang sa las sgrol zhing / /dge tshogs mi zad byang chub gter du sgrub/ / rgyal rnams gshegs bshul 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ / byang sems sdom pa tshul bzhin srung gyur cig / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun gyi sgo/ / yid dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'du ba'i rten/ / ma bsgom gyur kyang myur du 'tshang rgya'i lam/ / gsang sngags sdom pa tshul bzhin srung gyur cig / brgya la ltung ba'i sgo bzhi ci rigs kyi/ / dbang gyur nyes bas gos kyang bshags bsdams dang / / rang rang phyir bcos 'bad pas ltung ba dang / / zhag tu mi 'grogs 'phel kha chod par shog / de ltar tshul khrims dag pa'i mchod rkong du/ / ting 'dzin zhun mar sdong bu tshogs pa las/ / shes rab zab mo'i me lce 'bar ba yis/ / mthar 'dzin rmongs pa'i mun pa drungs 'byin shog / chos phung kun 'dus sde snod gsum la mkhas/ de don bslab gsum nyams len snying bor byed/ / skal bzang gzhan yang tshul der bkri ba yis/ / rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed gyur cig / bslab gsum ngo bo tshogs gnyis mthar son te/ / rig dang rkang bar ldan pa stobs bcu'i dpal/ / thob nas mkha' mnyam ma rgan 'gro ba rnams/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig / ces tshe rabs kun tu tshul khrims rnam par dag pa srung nus pa'i smon tshig cig dgos zhes sor du su'i shog nayodad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog mtha' yas/ dkon mchog chos ldan gnyis kyis 202

da / / sdo//thab pa/rebaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras dri med grags/ / rgya gar yul na zla ba grags pa sogs/ / ljongs 'dir kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa zhes/ / 'khrungs rabs rim byon rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / de yi thugs bskyed chu bo rnam bzhi'i rgyun/ / ngo mtshar dge mtshan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i bcud/ / ring bsrel rnam bzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ / dpag yas phyur bur gtams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khyad par mdo smad mun pa'i smag rum du/ / mdo sngags bshad sgrub zung 'jug thub pa'i bstan/ / rgyas mdzad rgyal bas lung bstan chos kyi sde/ / dpon slob sde dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / phyi mar bslab gsum ldan pa'i rten thob nas/ / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang lhan cig tu/ / bstan la thos bsam sgom pas rab zhugs nas/ / srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog / skyabs mgon yab sras rnams kyi zhabs brtan cing / / dge 'dun thugs mthun bshad sgrub bstan pa dang / / 'gro la chos srid 'byor pa'i bde dga' rgyas/ / dge mtshan ma lus 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces dgon pa'i bla grwa rten bca4phyi nang bsdoms par phyag 'tshal smon tshig dang bcasapa zhig dgos tshul dge slong 'jam dbyangs bde chen gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /bslu med bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ / nyam thag 'gro la brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ / rmad byung thugs rjes bden pa'i dpung bskyed nas/ / bdag gi legs smon 'grub pa'i dpang mdzod cig / 'dis mtshon bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gyis/ / dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa ci mchis pa/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i rnam dkar dge tshogs dang / / dbyer 203

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronama'i gsung 'bum/med ro gcig dbor (ngo bor)'dres gyur cig / de mthus nyes dmigs che la mnog chung ba/ / 'khor ba'i bde 'byor rgyu ru mi smin zhing / / khong khro lta ba ngan la sogs pa yi/ / nyes bas nam yang gzhom par ma gyur cig / mi bzad nyes ltung sgrib pa kun byang zhing / / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ / gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bzang ma lus pa/ / bde blag nyid du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / 'di snang 'gag tshe bla ma lhag pa'i lhas/ / zhal bstan dbugs 'byung ngan 'gro'i sgo bkag ste/ / dam chos sgrub pa'i rten bzang rim brgyud de/ / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam pas rjes 'dzin shog / de nyid bsam dang sbyor bas legs bsnyen cing / /'bral med gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud myang ste/ / thos bsam sgom pas nyams su blangs pa yis/ / yang dag lam gyi btsan sa zin par shog / khyad par byams mgon nyin byed 'od stong gis/ / theg mchog rigs kyi sa bon smon pa las/ / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis 'dab brgya bzhad pa yis/ /mkha' mnyam lus can rkang drug tshim byed shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson mtshag tu dge ba bde chen rgya mtshos dge spyor gang byas kyi mjug tu 'don rgyu'i smon tshig cig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o /sgrib bral bde gshegs thugs kyi me long ngos/ / dhī rtu yi ge'i rnam rol ye shes lha/ / rgyal kun mes por gyur kyang gzhon nu'i tshul/ / mgon po mkhyen pa'i gter gyis ring du skyongs/ / phyi ma'i tshe rabs mi ltung phreng ba kun/ /'jam mgon bdud rtsi'i 'od dang 'grogs pa las/ / byin rlabs snang ba'i dpal yon gyis bskyangs te/ / yang dag lam gye mkha' dbyangs bgrod gyur cig / kun byang blang dor mtha' klas 'dzin ma'i khyon/ / blo 204

das thas pa/ste/gros nam mkha'i khams kyis kun khyab cing / / gting zab chos kyi de nyid 'byed pa yi/ / gtugs pa med pa'i shes rab thob gyur cig / ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i dra ba kun/ / gcod pa'i shes rab ral gri'i rno rgyun gyis/ / dngos por 'dzin pa'i 'ching ba drungs phyung ste/ / rnams par grol ba'i gling du 'jug gyur cig / gdung rab kun gyi de nyid legs rtogs nas/ / 'jigs bral 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ / mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs bsgrengs nas/ / 'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed gyur cig / 'khrul bral blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /ngoms pa med pa'i thos pa mthar phyin te/ / yang dag sgrub pa snying por byed pa yis/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab 'phel gyur cig / mdor na blang dor lta ba'i mig gcig pu/ / rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab mchog thob nas/ / ma nor zeg mchog lam bzang rim bgrod de/ / rnam kun mkhyen pa'i gling du 'jug gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson lhag bsam dge ba rab 'byams pa blo bzang rab brtan gyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bsta na pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma dang / / bslu med mchos gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i mthu/ / rgyu 'bras rten 'byung bden stobs tshogs pa yis/ / gang btab smon pa'i 'bras bu 'grub gyur cig / 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs ci bgyis dang / / theg gsum skye 'phags yongs kyi rnam dkar tshogs/ / gcig tu bsdoms te ma lus 'gro ba'i phyir/ / bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ / skye zhing skye bar dal 'byor rten thob cing / / bshes gnyen dam pas 'bral med rjes su bzung / / skyes bu gsum gyi lam la blo sbyangs te/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin sgrub gyur cig /1 05

༄/ /yo ca bayo yosgroname'i gatshi ཿma/bstan pa'i snying po gsang chen theg pa'i sgor/ / zhugs nas dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung / / rim gnyis lam gyi bgrod pa mthar son te/ / zung 'jug go 'phang bde blag myur thob shog / khyad par dus gsum dge ba ci bgyis pa/ / don med 'khor ba'i rgyu ru mi smin zhing / / mi mthun rkyen gyis nam yang mi gzhom par/ / bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo gros kyi nor dang ldan pa sman pa dkon mchog bstan dar gyis sgo gsum gyi dge tshogs rnams chud mi za bar byang ba'i phyir byang chub mchog tu bsngo bsargyas 'debs pa'i smon tshigs cig dgos zhes bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha mchog thugs rje'i mthus/ / phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ / 'khrul bral blo bzang rgyal ba'i mdo sngags bstan/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig / rnam dag khrims ldan lhag bsam go cha bgos/ / mdo sngags thub bstan yongs rdzogs bshad sgrub kyis/ / 'dzin skyong spel nus dam pa'i skyes bu yis/ / chos grwa che 'di yongs su gang gyur cig / dri med lung rigs smra ba'i tshogs rnams la/ / phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe mi 'byung zhing / / chos dang mthun pa'i longs spyod dpal 'byor sogs/ / mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis grub par shog / 'dren mchog 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i dpal la sogs/ / dam pa'i mgon rnams zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / / bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba yi/ /'phrin las sa steng kun tu khyab gyur cig / mdor na yul du dge bcu'i dpal 'byor rgyas/ / dge 'dun thugs mthun thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel/ / dge tshogs kun kyang mkha' mnyam lus can kun/ / bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro'i gzungs 206

༄ / / )zagapa༄1sa pagazhug bla brang chen mo nas khur len byas te bsgrub skabs spel tshig cig dgos zhes zhus te gnang ba'o/ /yon tan rin chen bye ba'i khams las grub/ / dngos kun mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rdul dang bral/ / rdul med bsags pa'i zhing gi dpal gyur pa/ / kun gzigs 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba skyod pa'i yab gyur cing / / 'khor ba srid dang nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par/ / rgyal dang rgyal sras skye 'phags sna tshogs kyi/ / rnam 'khrul cir yang ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ / khyad par dbang po'i tog gi spyan snga ru/ / mtha' bral lta bas yongs bzung rdo rje zeg / spel ba'i thugs bskyed dam bca' lhun gyis grub/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang por phyag 'tshal lo/ / ded dpon mchog gis sprul pa'i grong khyer bzhin/ / rmad byung bkod par 'tshang rgya'i tshul bstan tshe/ / gdul bya zeg pa mchog la sbyor mdzad pa/ / rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ror phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun mkhyen bla ma'i mdo sngags chos tshul la/ / thos bsam sgom pas tshul bzhin bslab pa sogs/ /dus gsum dge tshogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / smon pa'i re 'bras lhun gyes 'grub bar shog / nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags ma thag /ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ / skyes nas rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro yi/ / zhal bzang mig gi bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog / theg mchog rigs kyi sa bon ma nyams pa/ / gzhan phan byams dang snying rje'i chus brlan pas/ / rgyal sras spyod pa'i lo tog rab rgyas te/ / 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i rten du 'gyur bar shog / khyod sku mchod sdong dang bcas mthong tsam las/ /mtshan 'dzin dmigs gtad zhig pa'i stong pa dang / / ming tsam lhag mar lus pa'i rten 'byung gnyis/ / zung 'jug rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rnyed par 207

༄/ /yo thang bas pa'itshanas gsung 'bum/shog / rgyal kun gsung gi gsang mdzod spyod pa'i mchog / sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje theg / rmad byung thabs mkhas zab mo'i myur lam du/ /zhugs nas rim gnyis dga' ston myong bar shog / gzungs spobs mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mchog thob nas/ / skad cig rer yang glog gi rol rtsed bzhin/ / sangs rgyas zhing mang bgrod de rgyal kun las/ / bogs 'byon zab mo'i gdams pa nod par shog / zab mo'i lta ngang myur lam gsang ba sngags/ / zung du 'jug pa rdo rje'i 'phrul sbyog gis/ / kun rtog bzhon par bcas pa'i dpung bcom ste/ / bde chen dang po'i mgon po nyid gyur cig / mu mtha' yas pa'i rab 'byams zhing du yang / / gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i bkod pa yis/ / rgyal bstan yang snying mdo sngags zung 'jug lam/ / spel bas 'gro kun srid las sgrol gyur cig / ces ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i zhing du skye ba 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'di nyid dad brtson ldan pa kha kya'i rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bsam gtan gyiyobaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brisapa'o/ /kun rtog spros pa'i dra ba nyer zhi ba/ / mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i/ / ye shes mtshan dpe'i gzugs kyi rol gar mkhan/ /mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gang gi mtshan tsam dran pa'i 'od rnon gyis/ / rmongs pa'i mun sangs blo gros 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /phye ste legs bshad sbrang rtsis gtams mdzad pa'i/ / snyan pa phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu khyab/ / de phyir bdag kyang rtse gcig gus pa yis/ / khyod sku'i snang ba yid la rtag 'god cing / / bzlas brjod mchod pa'i las la brtson bgyid na/ / brtse bas dgongs te byin rlabs myur stsol cig / rgya chen mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mjing / / phul byung rnam dpyod gru 208

ra / / (shāthag pa:re /sa shagazings kyis brgal te/ / thar 'dod don mthun tshogs kyi re skong ba'i/ /'chad pa'i shes rab phun tshogs thob gyur cig / dri med rigs pa ral gri'i rno rgyun gyis/ / ma rtogs log rtog 'khrul ba'i dra ba kun/ / gcig car nyid dugacod la thogs med pa/ / zla bral rtsod pa'i shes rab rgyas gyur cig /rjod byed phun tshogs rna ba'i bcud len zhing / / don zab kun byang blang dor ji bzhin ston/ / thub bstan rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur pa/ bde blag rtsom pa'i shes rab 'phel gyur cig / chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs zab mo'i don/ / rgya che'i phung khams skye mched kun rdzob chos/ / rig gnas lnga sogs shes bya'i gnas kun la/ / mkhas pa'i rlabs chen shes rab thob gyur cig / zab brling bka' dang bstan bcos dka' gnad kun/ / ma nor ma 'dres myur du 'byed pa yi/ / zab gsal myur ba'i shes rab la brten nas/ / gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin gyur cig / ji snyed thos bsam 'bad pas shes pa kun/ / shes kyi khe dang rnyed grags 'dod pa'i rgyur/ / mi 'gyur rang sems 'dul thabs 'ba' zhig tu/ / goms bas yang dag lam bzang bgrod gyur cig / srid gsum 'khor ba'i gnas la zhen log cing /rang nyid gces 'dzin nyes dmigs mthong ba yis/ / sred dang zhi ba'i g.yang sa kun spangs te/ / mi gnas mya ngan 'das la bgrod gyur cig /mdor na shes rab rtsibs stong 'khor lo yis/ / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bsgyur te/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i gnas la 'god gyur cig / ces mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs shing shes rab 'phel ba'i don gyi smon tshig 'di ni si nyid g.yas ru'i shog nasadad brtson ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub gyisabaskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesasbyar ba'o/ /209

༄/ /gung ca bayo ཿtshonama'i gsung 4ma/skyabs gsum kun 'dus shākya mu ni dang / / gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang sogs/ / rgyal dang rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa la sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ / dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrub pa'i mchod par 'bul/ / khyod min re ba'i skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med thugs rjes zungs/ / phyag skor bzlas brjod sogs la brtson pa yi/ / rnam dkar 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs mthus/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams/ / zhabs pad brtan cing thub bstan rgyas gyur cig / drin can pha mas thog drangs 'gro ba kun/ / ngan song g.yang sa las grol dal 'byor gyi/ / rten thob bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung ste/ / yang dag lam la gegs med slob gyur cig / khyad par 'di nas shi 'phos gyur ma thag / bde ba can du padmo las skyes te/ / mgon po 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong zhing / / gsung gi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston myong gyur cig / shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ / ma pham 'jam dbyangs gsang bdag spyan ras gzigs/ / bde bshags 'khor bcas rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i/ / bden pas smon lam ci btab myur 'grub shog /ces dang / sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / / zhes sogs bya'o/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyobs/ / las 'bras bslu med tshul la nges rnyed nas/ / blang dor tshul bzhin nus par byen gyes rlobs/ / sdom gsum bka' drin stsol mdzad bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so srid pa'i mtsho las sgol/ / bden bzhi'i blang dor tshul bzhin sgrub pa yis/ / thar pa'i rgyal 210

das / / sdo snyethag pa/rematshan tshugs par byin gyis rlobs/ / bka' drin gsum ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdud bzhi'i g.yul las skyobs/ /dam tshig rnam dag rim gnyis nyams len gyis/ / zung 'jug go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / skye ba kun tu/ zhes sogs bya/ zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa bka' bcu ye shes bstan 'dzin gyis bskul dor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dgon lung byams gling du bris pa'o/ /sde snod gsum gyi yal ga'i khyon yangs shing / / rnam dag bslab gsum 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud/ / 'gro kun gdung sel phan bde'i grib bsil can/ / rgyal bstan phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig / 'dren mchog blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho sogs/ / bstan 'dzin skyes bu mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / / bzhed dgongs gegs med lhun gyis grub pa yis/ /mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng gyur cig / khyad par kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde'i/ / thugs bskyed ji bzhin thub bstan 'byung gnas 'dir/ / bshad sgrub nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal mdzad pa'i/ / legs byas rgya mtsho ring du 'phel gyur cig / 'brel thogs 'gro kun gnas skabs bde 'byor gyis/ / 'tsho bas rdzogs ldan kun dga'i dpal 'bar zhing / /bskal bzang rnam 'dren kun gyis rjes bzung ste/ / bla med byang chub mtshag la 'god gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni sangs rgyas stong sku'i gzungs gzhug gi smon tshig tu stsal pa'o/ /bde ldan zhing nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / / dbyer med 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog 'od dpag med/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang rdo rje can la sogs/ /mthu chen rgyal sras dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcas/ / ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed rgya mtsho bzhin/ / bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dpung nya11

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgonasa'i gsung 'bum/gnyen du/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs te/ / bsod nams zhing du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs pa kun sel zhing / / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ / gnas skabs mthar thug kun gyi skyabs gcig pu/ / bla ma 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bdag lus longs spyod dge bcas mchod par 'bul/ /bsod nams phung po rdzogs phyir bzhes su gsol/ / rmongs pa'i bran du gyur te bcas rang gi / nyes ltung ci bgyis snying nas mthol lo bshags/ / e ma bde legs 'byung gnas rang gzhan gye/ / dge tshogs sman gye myu gu 'phel gyur cig / skal ba ji bzhin chos kyi bdud rtsi yis/ / srid thi'i gdung ba ma lus bsal du gsol/ / dus gsum dge tshogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / rang dang dmigs yul mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ / mi khom skye bas bar du mi gcod par/ / dal 'byor rten bzang rtag tu thob gyur cig / zeg mchog bshes dang dge ba'i grogs kyis bskyangs/ / tshang la ma nor rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal/ / lam gyi gtso bo gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs te/ / byang chub gzhung lam drang bor bgrod gyur cig / khyad par tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags pa'i tshe/ / gnad gcod 'khrul snang sdug bsngal mi 'byung thing / / 'od dpag med mgon sras dang bcas pa yis/ / dbugs dbyung dga' dad ngang nas 'pho gyur cig / bde ba can du padmo las skyes nas/ / snang mtha' yas pa'i zhabs pad gus bsten cing / / zab rgyas gsung gi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa yis/ / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog /bla ma lha yi go 'phang myur thob ste/ / lhun grub 'azin las gru gzings 'bum sbyar nas/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs ma rgan 'gro ba rnams/ / phra rags srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol gyur cig / bslu med mchog gsum thugs rje rgya mtsho 212

ras ji/ / /sbyo1thab pa:redang / / bdag gis ci bgyis dge tshogs gago'i klung / / rnyog bral chos kyi dbyings su dbyer med pa'i/ / bden mthus smon pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig / ces pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug bstan pa'i gsal byed sprul ba'i sku dkon mchog dam chos yar 'phel nas smon tshig 'di lta bu zhig dus tshes 'dir 'bri dgos zhes sngar nas bskul yod pa'i thog nyin der 'od dpag med kyi gos sku gsar bzhengs kyi thig 'debs dus dang 'grig pas/ thig 'debs sa de nyid nas 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sug bris bgyis pa'o/ /gang gi mtshan tsam rna bar lhung bas kyang / / ngan song skye ba'i rgyun lam yongs bcad de/ / thar pa'i mchog sbyin rnam par snang mdzad dang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag bgyid do/ / de yi rgyud don 'grel byed ṭīka chung zhes/ / nyung gsal legs bshad nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'di/ / par du bskrun pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ / mi khom ngan song g.yang las grol gyur cig / rtag tu dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob cing / / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung ste/ / thun mong lam sbyangs sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ / rgyud don ji bzhin nyams su nyen par thog / sgo gsum bya bar bcas pa'i lcags kyi khams/ / phyag rgya rnam bzhi'i gser 'gyur rtsis bran te/ / mngon byang lnga yis rnam snang sku thob nas/ / mkha' mnyam/ 'gro drug 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni snga sor skyabs mgon 'jigs med dbang po'i bkas ṭīka chung 'di nyid dus 'khor grwa tshang gi 'dzin grwa gsham ma'i 'dzin chos su gtong ba'in pa yin kyang bris nor rgyun 'byams kyis yid brtan shin tu dka' bar brten/ dpon slob las thog pa mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid zhabs drung 'jam dbyangs skal ldan nas rgyu sbyar te thugs khur bzhes shing / smra ba'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog chos ldan sogs kyis zhus dag legs par bgyis te par du bskrun pa'i par byang du/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ / nya13

༄/ /yo ca bam 4sgronama'i gsung 4ma/rlabs chen thugs bskyed sa bon smin pa las/ stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' gser bzang padma stong / / bskal bzang chu gter gcig tu bzhad pa yi/ /thub dbang slob mar bcas pa rnams la 'dud/ / gang gis dang por byang chub thugs bskyed de/ / tshogs gnyis mthar son mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /bgrang yas gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa'i/ / spyod tshul ma smad rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas/ / rgya cher ston pa mdo sde bskal bzang zhes/ / rgyal sras byed (bye) ba'i 'jug ngogs zla med 'di/ / gser sbyangs dag pa'i khams las legs bris pa'i/ / rnam dkar 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs mthus/ /deng nas bzung ste skye ba'i 'phreng ba ru/ /theg mchog bshes gnyen dam pas rjes gzung ste/ / rlabs chen tshogs gnyisaspyod pa mtha' dag la/ / rgyal ba rnams kyi rjes su slob gyur cig /phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rgyas pa dang / / 'dren pa mchog rnams zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / / dge mdun thugs mthun bshad sgrub 'phel ba yis/ /lus can phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / khyad par sgron me'i bskal pa 'di nyid la/ / rgyal ba rnams kyis thugs rjes yongs bzung ste/ / phra rags srid pa'i rgya mtsho nyer brgal nas/ / bla med gtan bde'i btsan sa zin gyur cig / 'brel thogs skye bo puṇḍa rī ga'i tshogs/ / rgyal ba'i nyi ma stong gis yongs smin te/ / nges legs sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams pa yis/ / bde chen rkang drug glu dbyangs sgrogs gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dus 'khor slob zur blo bzang 'jigs med pas mdo sde bskal bzang gser zhun gyes bris te dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i smon tshig cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /214

ra / / sdomathab ba/re dge 'dis mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i/ / rnam dkar ji snyed gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / nam zhig 'di snang 'gag par gyur ma thag / yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas su skye bar shog / de nas ma pham rgyal ba'i dbang po yi/ / zhal bzang mig gi bdud rtsir rtag 'grogs shing / /'bral med zhabs kyi padmor gus btud nas/ / legs gsung gdams pa'i dga' ston myong par shog / zab cing rgya che'i lam bzang ma lus pa/ / ji ltar gdams bzhin nyams su blangs pa yis/ / sa dang lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ / sku bzhi'i go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / ces dge rtsa gang byas byams mgon gyis rjeyosu'adzin pa'i rgyur bsngo ba'i sgon tshig mdor bsdus pa 'di'ang skul pa po'i 'dun pa bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bri4pa'o/ /lhan skyes bde ba mchog gi tshon brgya'i mdangs/ / lus can bsod nams ka shi'i ras bzang ngos/ / skal ba ji bzhin 'phos pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyi/ / 'phreng ba tshar du dngar rnams phyag gi yul/ / khyad par blo bzang rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ / zhal skyin zab rgyas chos kyi 'od stong gis/ /thar lam snang byed 'gro ba'i nyi ma der/ / dang pa'i dngos po kun gyes lan brgyar 'dud/ / thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun bla ma yis/ / skye zhing skye bar 'bral med rjes 'dzin zhing / / mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par bsgrubs pa yis/ / yang dag lam gyis togs pa mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa gsol dpon blogros dar rgyasakyis bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i 'khrungasarabs zhal thang byin rlabs kyi gter du gyur pa gsar bzhengs skabs kha byang smon tshig cig dgos tshul ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o /215

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ཿtshonasa'i khrung ཿma/dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ / 'gro kun srid zhi'i 'dzigs las sgol pa'i gnyen/ / spros pa'i mtha' bral bcom ldan 'das ma la/ / mi ldog dang ba'i yid kyis phyag bgyid do/ / gang gi don ston pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung / / gser zhun khu bas legs bris dge 'dis mtshon/ / sngon bsags legs byas chu klung ma lus pa/ / byang chub mchog gi rgya mtshor gzhol gyur cig / deng nas brtsams te skye zhing skye ba ru/ / dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rten rnyed cing / / srid pa'i 'byor ba sbrul gdug ltar mthong ste/ / rnam dag tshangs spyod brtul zhugs 'dzin par shog /mtshan nyid kun ldan theg mchog dge pa'i bshes/ / bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten byed cing / / rgyal ba'i mdo sngags chos tshul ma lus pa/ /thos bsam sgom pas nyams su len par shog / khyad par sher phyin dgongs don chos 'phags kyis/ / ji ltar gdams bzhin bdag la 'doms byed cing / /bdag kyang lus dang srog la mi lta bar/ / rtag tu ngu bzhin de la slob par shog / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ / sgrol la zhum med snying rje'i go bgos te/ / phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i nyams len gyis bsdus pa'i/ / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtshor slob par shog / dag pa'i zhing mchog kun tu sgyu 'phrul gyes/ / bgrod de mthas yas rgyal rnams mchod byed cing / /las nyon sdig ltung dri ma kun byang nas/ / byang chub mchog tu lung bstan thob par shog / bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis gshog rlabs kyis/ / srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las rab grol te/ / theg pa mchog gi lam lnga rim bgrod nas/ / rnam dag chos sku'i gling du son par shog / de nas 'od zer phreng ba re res kyang / / dag dang ma dag zhing kun snang byed cing / /rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal las grol te/ / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i 216

ra / / sa gapa(1sa pa'ilam la 'god par shog / tshul der bsam sbyor dngos po ci rigs kyis/ /'brel ba thogs pa'i skye bo thams cad kyang / / gnas skabs tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel/ / mthar thug sa lam rtogs pa myur bgrod shog / mi dge'i bshes dang sdig pa'i grogs la sogs/ / mtha' dag bdud kyi ga yul ngo pham byas te/ / 'gro kun zeg pa mchog la gzhol gyur nas/ / rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / bstan 'dzin skyes bu mtha' dag zhabs brtan cing / / phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan phyogs brgyar spel/ / 'jig rten kun tu chos 'byor rgyas gyur te/ / don gnyis dga' ston lhun gyi grub par shog / nam yang mi bslu mchog gsum thugs rje dang / / snang stong zung 'jug chos dbyings bden pa'i mthus/ / bdag gzhan dge ba'i 'bras bu ma lus pa/ / dam pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin sgrub gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni bla brang chen mo'i mdzod pa dar han kun dbas brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam gsar bskrun gyi smon tshig cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris so/ /'dis mtshon rnam dkar sa bon ci mchis pa/ / dga' ldan chos kyi mdun sa der sbrum zhing / / byams mgon gsung gi bdud rtsis bran pa las/ / theg mchog rigs kyi myu gu smin par shog / khyad par tshe 'di'i snang ba bgag gyur te/ / gnyen med grogs med bar dor 'khyams pa'i tshe /khyod gsung tshangs dbyangs snyan pos dbugs phyung ste/ / yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas der drang du gsol/ / de nas khyod kyis ji ltar gdams pa bzhin/ / sems bskyed rtsa brtan spyor bzhi'i yal 'dab g.yo/ / mkhyen gsum 'dab yangs chos sku'i ze'u 'bru can/ / mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni sprul sku dge 'dun rgya mtshosabaskul ngor btsun 217

༄/ /༅ ca bayo ཿsgronas gsung lam/pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes byams chen mthong ba don ldan gyi mdun du sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i bdag nyid la/ / stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mos yang dag sbyor/ / dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo ngur sprig gi /gar mdzad 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ / de yi gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i gzeg ma yang / / skal bzang 'chi med nyer 'tsho'i dga' ston du/ /sgrub slad par du bskrun pa'i legs byas mthus/ / lam bzang 'di yis 'gro kun sgrol gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog 'phrin las kyis skyabs mgon mchog gi gsung rgyun 'khrul med grwa tshang gi tshogs 'don du mdzad pa'i zhabs 'degayosu par du bsgrubs pa'i tshe smon tshig cig dgos tshul ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes brisapa'o/ /dpyid dang thog le mnyam sbyor bde ba cher/ / brtan g.yo'i dngos kun sdud pa te ru ga'i/ / rtse gcig ting 'dzin sbyor ba la zhugs pas/ /yang gcig mi bskyod dgyes bzhad rdo rje dran/ / bsam zhing bsam zhing dad pas mchi ma 'khrugs/ / bsgom zhing bsgom zhing dran pas snying rtsa 'dar/ /a la la rang sems bdag nyid bla ma lha/ / nam yang 'du 'bral med de e ma ho/ / rnal 'byor ma dpal bye ba a ra li'i/ / dbyangs kyis tshogs su rol pa'i gtsug gi nor/ / khyab bdag bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gis/ / dag pa'i snang bar dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun stsol/ / dpa' bo gang gis sras su bzung ba der/ / zhing sngags lhan cig skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun kyang ma ltar dngos grub mchog sbyin phyir/ / brtse bas gzigs pa ma g.yel rjes 'dzin mdzod/ / bde chen rgyal po bla ma rdo rje 'chang / snying gi chu skyes ze'u 'brur bzhugs pa yis/ / kun tu rtog pa rmongs pa'i dgra bcom 218

༄ / / che gapa(1sa pa'inas/ / spros kun 'od gsal dbyings su sdud par mdzod/ / de yi sgyu 'phrul bde ba'i rol pa ches/ / rtsa khams phyi nang snod bcud dngos po kun/ / dag pa'i 'khor lor bsdoms pa'i bkod pa yis/ / sa gsum khyon la gcig car dbang mdzod cig / bsgyur ro bsgyur ro bde chen lha yi gar/ / 'khrol lo 'khrol lo stong pa'i ḍā ma ru/ / bteg go zung 'jug nam mkha'i dbyings su ya/ / phe phe sa gsum spyod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ / zhes pa 'di ni khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas nyid zhi ba'i dbyings sugazimayopa'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes tsam la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsnyen mtshams shig tu gnalopa'i tshe/ lha'i sku la yid ci tsam gtad pa bzhin/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i rnam pa'i yid ngor lam gyis 'char ba zhig byung ba'i rkyen gyis/ bla ma yi dam dbyer mi phyed pa'i mos gus dang / skyo shas kyis mtshamasasbyar te/ 'di'i lam rim gnyis sogs kyi brtan pa ma thob kyang / cung zad mos pa'i bag chags brtas pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gang dran glur blangs pa'o/ /bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum gcig bsdus nas/ / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i sgron me sbar ba'i phyir/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyi rnam rol pa/ / bla ma drin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ / bdag gi dus gsum dge tshogs ci bgyis kun/ / mchog gsum thugs rje'i rgya mtsho dang 'dres te/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub pa'i rgyur/ / byin gyis rlobs cig bla ma thugs rje can/ / rten 'dir phyi nang nyer 'tshe mi 'byung bar/ / rnam dag dam chos sgrub pa mthar phyin cing / / gnad gcod sdug bsngal med par 'pho ba'i tshe/ / bla ma lha yi zhal mthong dbugs 'byen shog / de nas bar do'i 'khrul snang mi 'byung zhing / / dag pa'i zhing dam dal ba'i rten bzang mchog / blangs te khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ / 'bral med 219

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par shog / de yis ji ltar rjes su gdams pa bzhin/ / tshang la ma nor bstan pa'i sgor zhugs te/ / dam tshig sdoms pa mig 'bras ltar bsrung zhing / / rim gnyis rnal 'byor gru gzings la brten nas/ / zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur cig / mdor na mchog gsum yi dam chos skyong kun/ / gcig tu bsdus pa bla ma'i thugs rjes yis/ / gnas skabs mthar thug smon pa'i gnas rnams kun/ / gegs med bde blag nyid du 'grub gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni lhag bsam dang mkhyen dpyod phul du phyin pa'i rang gi slob ma or tu su'i bla zur blo bzang yon tan nas 'dun pa drag pos bskul ba ltar / 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ /mi zad byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / mi dge'i las kyi dri ma kun sbyong zhing / / mi 'gyur bde ba mchog la sbyor mdzad pa/ / mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thog ma med nas dug gsum dbang gyur te/ / sgo gsum nyes pa ji snyed bgyis pa dang / / khyad par sdom gsum bcas mtshams las 'das pa'i/ / nyes ltung mtha' dag snying nas mthol bshags na/ / brtse ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang / / nyes kun drungs 'byin spros bral dbyings kyi stobs/ / zung 'jug bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / mi shes dbang gis bcas pa'i nyes pa dang / / nyin re bzhin du mched pa 'phel kha'i 'phro/ / rnam smin mi zad ltung ba'i ngo bo kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / bla ma rdo rje spun dang mchog gsum rten/ / pha ma la sogs zhing dang bsam spyor mjug / mthu chen shugs drag nyes pa gang bgyes rnams/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byen gyes zlobs/ / dkon 220

da / / cha gapa15sa pa'imachog gsum gyi dkor dang khyad par du/ / dge 'dun 'du sgo gson gshin dad zas sogs/ / me mdag lta bu bag med spyad pa kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyes rlobs/ / deng nas skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /mi bskyod rgyal bas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ / las dang nyon mongs g.yang sa las bsgral (bsgal)nas/ / yang dag lam gyi srol du 'dzud bar shog / khyad par tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gag ma thag / dgyes pa'i zhal bstan gsung gi dbugs dbyung ste/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ / khrid cing sras kyi thu bor 'gyur bar shog / mdor na rtag tu dal 'byor rten thob cing / / dam pas rjes bzung nyes ltung rgyang bsrangs te/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa yongs rdzogs nas/ / mi 'khrugs mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni hal ha thu she yogung gi shog dadabartson blo dang ldan pa dge slong ngag dbang tshangs dbyangs kyis mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga cha lag sbyin sreg dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul byung yang / sngar gso rig gzhan phan gling du 'dzug rgyur de'i mngon dkyil khrus dbang sbyin sreg dang bcas cha tshang ba nged kyis sngar nasabasgrigs yod pa des 'thusapar snang bas/ / de'i kha skong gi tshul du skul ba po'i 'dun pa ltar gye 'dod gsol smon tshig 'di ni/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru shrī te ru kā ya/ brtan g.yo'i dngos kun lhan skyes bde ba che'i/ / sgyu 'phrul dra bar sdom mdzad te ru ka / stong nyid bha ga bzang mo rdo rje yum/ / mnyam sbyor bla ma dang po'i mgon des skyongs/ / zung 'jug sar gshegs grub mchog pham mthing pa/ / rags pa'i za ma tog gi bkod pa'i lus/ / dpa' bo rnal 'byor mar bcas skur bzhengs te/ / skye dgu'i mgon por sgyu ma'i gar gyis rtsen/ / 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg dge ba 221

༄/ /yo ca b.lob lo gsung ཿma/yis/ / sa bon nyungs 'bru'i tshad kyang bla ma lha'i/ / thugs rjes yongs bzung yal ga'i phyogs rdzogs pa/ / sa gsum khyab pa'i bsod nams dbyid du 'bar/ / de slad bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ / ji srid byang chub rdo rje'i gnas thob par/ / thugs rje kyo bas nam yang mi gtong zhing / / mchog thun dngos grub bye ba'i dga' ston stsol/ / khyad par mtha' bral lta bas rgyas btab pa/ / zab gsang rdo rje theg pa'i lam bgrod nas/ /ring min te ru ka yi gnas thob ste/ / 'gro kun bde chen sa la 'god gyur cig / de yang rten mchog 'di la lo rgyus ci rigs 'dug kyang / pham mthing pa rgya nag tu byon tshul rje'i gsung du'ang 'byung ba dang / dam pa du ma'i gsung gung 'grigs pas lo rgyus yongs grags ltar 'thad dam snyam/ de nyid sor bzhag la smon tshigadang bcas pa 'di ni/ 7gung thang pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bde mchog rang byon nyid kyi mdun du bris pa'o/ /mchog gsum ngo bo drin can bla ma la/ / gsol ba 'debs so 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun 'gag cing / / yang dag lam bzang skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bslab par bya ba'i rim pa mtha' yas kyang / / rtsa ba rang rgyud 'dul ba nyid yin pas/ / legs nyes kun gyi byed por rang sems 'di/ / rgyun du dran shes srab kyis kha lo bsgyur/ / nam yang dkon mchog gsum la blo phugs gtod/ / bya ba thams cad las 'bras dpang por zhog / khas blangs bslab khrims nyams len mthil du gyis/ /nam phugs mi bslu 'dun ma'i yang rtse yin/ / nang bar ldang ba'i dus nas kun slong bcos/ / rgyun par sgo gsum las la bag zon gyis/ / nyal khar dge sdig ltung ba'i bsngo bgrang bya/ / ltung bar zhag tu mi 'grogs gdams pa'i mthil/ / nor rdzas ci tsam 'byor yang 'khyer sa med/ / dgra gnyen 222

༄ / / che gapa(1la sgo'imang yang rang nyid gcig pur 'gro/ / gtan du phan pa chos las gzhan med pas/ / spun pa ma 'phyar dge la gcig tu dril/ / nges 'byung byang sems bcos ma tshun chad dang / / lta ba'i sgra spyi tsam gyis zin nas kyang / / gsang chen lam la bag chags 'jog nus na/ / yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal ba yin/ / sdig grogs spong zhing chos mthun grogs la brten/ / bya ba mi mang gang brtsams mtha' ru 'don/ / gzhung bzang blta zhing shes tshad rgyud la spyor/ / 'di yang lugs gnyis bya ba'i sdom zhig yin/ / nyer mkho'i bslab bya rags bsdus bsnyad pa 'dis/ / dran gso bgyis te 'jam mgon bla ma yi/ / zhal chems byang chub lam gyi rim pa la/ / brten nas don gnyis dga' ston sgrub par mdzod/ / ces pa 'di ni 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesarang gi slob ma zhabs drung dkon mchog rnam rgyal la gdams pa'o /dge 'dis mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i/ / rnam dkar ji snyed gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / nam zhig 'di snang 'gag par gyur ma thag / yid dga' chos 'dzin gnas su skye bar shog / de nas ma pham rgyal ba'i dbang po yi/ / zhal bzang mig gi bdud rtsir rtag 'grogs shing / /'bral med zhabs kyi padmor gus btud nas/ / legs gsung gdams pa'i dga' ston myong bar shog / zab cing rgya che'i lam bzang ma lus pa/ / ji ltar gdams bzhin nyams su blangs pa yis/ / sa dang lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ / sku bzhi'i go 'phang bde blag thob gyur cig / ces dge rtsa gang byas byams mgon gyis rjes su'adzin pa'i rgyur bsngo ba'i smon tshog mdor bsdus pa 'di 'di'ang skul ba po'i 'dun pa bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /223

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgron lo gsung ཿma/smras pa/ bdag gnas srung ba'i ra bar tshogs kyi gzhi/ / sngags rgya'i drod gsher gyis smin rten brten pa'i/ / dpag bsam ljon pa dmigs med bsung 'phro zhing / / phyi nang bzlas brjod 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud/ /rgyud sde gnyis pa'i gtsor gyur 'di yi srol/ / gsang chen bstan pa rdzogs pa'i khur 'khyer ba/ / skyabs gcig 'jigs med dbang pos phye ba'i tshul/ / bsam gyin gzur gnas dad pas mchi ma 'khrugs/ / mgon de'i bka' drin phung po bsab pa'i phyir/ / tshul 'dir 'bad pa lhur len skye bo rnams/ / rnal 'byor bzhi yi gru gzings la brten nas/ / dag pa'i sku gnyis nor bu'i dpal thob shog / ces pa 'di ni rab 'byams pa dkon mchog brtson 'grus kyis gang ci'i mthun rkyen sbyar te rnam snang mngon byang gi tshogs par du bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ par byang smon tshig cig dgos tshul ltar/ btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'o/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dzam bu'i 'bras/ / brtse chen ma dros klong du rol pa las/ / gser mdog lang tsho'i dpal 'bar gzugs kyi sku/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / 'jam dbyangs dgyes dgur bzhad pa'i gzi byin gyis/ / dpal ldan 'jigs med mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs/ / kun gye dbang por mnga' gsol drin can rje/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med gtsug na mdzes/ / khyod gsung nor bu'i cod pan legs bcings te/ 'jam mgon gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i gzeg ma brgya/ / gcig car 'gyed pa'i thabs kyi 'od dkar can/ / legs smon zur phud rtse mor 'grogs gyur cig / bsru med skyabs kyi mchog gyur rin chen gsum/ / dngos brgyud bla ma yid dam lha tshogs dang / / khyad par 'dren mchog yab sras brgyud par bcas/ / ye shes mgon po chos rgyal phyi 224

ra / / che ga nang gsang / / dpal ldan lha mo rnam mang thos sras dang / / rdo rje dregs ldan la sogs srung mas kyang / / ji ltar smon pa'i 'dod don ma lus pa/ /gegs med lhun gyis grubapa'i grogs mdzod cig / de yi mthu las skye zhing skye ba ru/ / 'khrul bral 'jam mgon bla ma'i rang lugs la/ / gzhan dring mi 'jog nges pa rnyed gyur te/ / thos bsam sgom pas tshul bzhin slob par shog / mdor na rje btsun bla ma yab sras kyis/ / dgyes bzhin rjes bzung gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ / longs su spyad de sa lam rim bgrod nas/ / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni mong gol jin shog nas dad brtson rnam dpyod dang ldan pa tho yon ngag dbang rin chen gyis skyabayomagon rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi bka' lung spyi bor bcings te 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung 'bum par du brko ba'i 'dun pa shugs drag yod pa'i skabs de nyid gegs med 'grub cing tshe rabs thamasacad du 'jam mgon bla ma yab sras kyis rjes su'adzin pa'i smon tshig dgos tshul ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs dri ma med/ / tshe gcig 'tshang rgya mdo sngags zung 'brel lam/ / 'phel phyir bshad sgrub las la gzhol ba yi/ /bshes gnyen nges pa don gyi bstan 'dzin mchog / gang gis chos kun snying po lam rim gzhung / / dpyad gsum dag pa'i mdo dang sbyar ba yi/ /mtshams sbyor don gyi 'brel zab rgya che zhing / / rtsa tshig nyung ngu'i tshul gyes gzung sla ba/ / mdo btus gnyis pa lta bu'i legs bshad 'di/ / gzur gnas thar 'dod yongs kyi 'jug ngogs te/ / snyigs dus chen po'i dbang dang rtog ge yis/ / blos byas mu cor gtam gyi do zla min/ / de phyir rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ / 'jam dpal snying po'i zhal lung dgongs 'grel gyi/ / par 'di dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ / lhag bsam rgyu 225

༄/ /gung ca b.lo ཿsgronas gsung 'a4/nghruṭwā dī/rsha pa'i ṭwāṃ/ ༵ ༵༈ hūṃn/ tu /daX zhiXs rshakhru~X rdoX 'jaX nghru~X ṭwāṃX kun kyang lam bzang 'di nyid dang / / mi 'bral thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin shog / ces mkhayobatsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi gter mdzod nges don gyi bshesaganyenadam pa bka' bcu smra ba blo bzang tshe 'phel bas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs srung zhus kyi 'grel ba 'di nyid mong gol cin tshogs chen dge bskos chos rje ye shesalas grub kyis rgyu sbyar te par du bskrun pa'i tshe par byang smon tshig cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron meyobris pa'o/ /oṃ ā gind+ra dīrya sirnyi: hūṃ/ oṃ ā ratna mabye nd+ra sidhi hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ 〉 sudī mu ne shakhyi bhya sā ra sidhi hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā ratna shā san dī paṃ sidhi hūṃ hūṃ/dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang / / bden mthus 'dren pa mchog rnams zhabs brtan cing / / dge 'dun thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub rgyas/ / lung rtogs bstan pa dar bar byin gyis rlobs/ / yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje'i mthus/ / sdig ltung dam tshig nyams chag kun byang zhing / / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dga' ston la/ / 'dod dgur longs su spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ / dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / rdo rje'i g.yar dam gnyan po nyer dgongs te/ / dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / / srung skyob g.yel ba med pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / 'dod dgu'i dpal ster nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang / /lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i mthus/ / log 'tsho dang bral chos mthun 'byor pa sogs/ / bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs stsol/ / rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'phags ma yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 226

༄/ /dgoldagabagasargyasapa'i 'tshal lo/ / dgos 'dod kun 'byung ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal kun bskyed mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba las sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lhag pa'i lha mchog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / nad rims kun sel ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jigs pa brgyad skyob ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'chi med dpal ster ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / tshe yi mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ye shes rgyas mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rab mdzes yid 'phrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gsung snyan dbugs 'byin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rab 'byams 'phrin las lha mor phyag 'tshal lo/ / byin rlabs gter chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thugs rjes gzigs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / las nyon sdeg sgrib zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / nad gdon bar chad sel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / blo kha chos la phyogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / lung rtogs yon tan 'phe' bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / skye 'gro dbang du 'du bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / bstan dgra rtsad nas chod par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / bstan 'dzin sku tshe brtan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / yul khams bde skyid rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / thams cad dge la gzhol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / rnam dkar lam du 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub par byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa 227

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'itshonasa'i gsung 'bum/'di ni dad ldan dge slong dkon mchog rab rgyas kyis bskul ngor/ skabs 'gar blo 'khul ba la 'di 'dras phan yang srid snyam/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4thol byung du smras pa'i yi ge pa bsngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /brgyad bzhi'i mtshan mchog tshangs dbyangs kyis gsungs pa'i/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung kun gyi mchog / brgyad stong gzhung gi sbas don mngon par rtogs/ / brgyad kyi rim pas sa lam mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni brgyad stong pa'i gdong yig tu stsal pa'o/ /zab mo rten 'byung gtam gyi 'od stong gis/ / srid zhi'i rgud pa'i mun pa mthar byed cing / / nges legs sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rgyas mdzad pa/ /thub dbang smra ba'i nyi ma der phyag 'tshal/ / gang gi mgur nas drug cu'i tshangs dbyangs kyis/ / legs gsungs chos phung brgyad khri'i snying po 'di/ /'dzin cing spel mdzad rgyal sras slob mar bcas/ / 'phags bod mkhas grub bye ba'i tshogs la 'dud/ / khyad par zab mo lta ba'i mtshon rnon gdengs/ / bde chen gsang ba sngags kyi go bgos te/ / nyon mongs dgra sde 'joms mdzad tsong kha pa/ yab sras brgyud par bcas la snying nas ༷byebye /༵rji/༷ kyig ༵ṭwāṃ rdo byedī trī ṭwāṃX/ ༷bye ṭwāṃ hūṃtram̐ ༷ byeX rdoX/ ṭwāṃṭwāṃX dhi niṭwāṃbhe rgyal ba'i bstan la rab zhugs te/ / rnam grol don gnyer blo bzang yon tan gyis/ / sher phyin stong phrag brgyad pa'i glegs bam 'di/ / rnam dag bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsgrubs/ / 'dis mtshon sdom gsum bcas mtshams la gnas shing / / mdo sngags bstan la thos bsam sgom pas zhugs/ / mchog gsum rten bzhengs rnam dkar mchod sbyin sogs/ / dus 228

༄/ /dgoldagabastanapargyasapa'igasum dge ba'i dngos po ci bgyis pa/ / bsdoms nas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yi/ / thugs bskyed zag med dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang / / gcig tu 'dres te bdag sogs 'gro kun gyis/ / bla med byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig / gnas skabs dal ba'i rten bzang rnam smin gyi/ / yon tan brgyad ldan bar ma chad du thob/ / bshes gnyen dam pas 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing / / bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten gyur cig / de yis gdams shing rjes su bstan pa yis/ / srid las nges par 'byung ba'i skyo shas kyis/ / gzhon nu nyid nas bstan la rab byung ste/ / bslab khrims mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung gyur cig / rang nyid ji bzhin drin can ma rnams kyang / / srid mtshor lhung la bzod med snying rje yis/ / lhag bsam byang chub sems kyi go bgos te/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod la slob gyur cig / khyad par sher phyin zab mo'i dgongs pa'i don/ / 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thugs kyi bcud/ / mthar 'dzin nad brgya sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ /zab mo rten 'byung ji bzhin rtogs gyur cig / de nas byang chub rdo rje bla ma lhas/ / dkyil 'khor mchog tu dbang gis smin byas te/ / dam tshig sdom pa rnam par dag pa yis/ / dngos grub gnyis kyi sgo brgya 'byed gyur cig / rdo rje 'chang chen gangs kyi ri bo las/ / 'ongs pa'i rgyud sde rnam ba'i'i chu klung kun/ / nyams myong rgya mtshor gcig tu 'khyil ba yi/ / yang dag sgrub la rtse gcig gzhol gyur cig / kun rdzob bskyed rim phra rags rna' 'byor gyes/ / tha mal skye shi bar do gsum sbyong zhing / / rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas sgyu 'od gnyis/ / zung 'jug don dam rdzogs rim mthar phyin shog / mdor na bshes gnyen ded dpon gyis drangs shing / / mngo sngags lam gyi gru gzings legs bzung ste/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho myur 229

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlanas gas 'bum/brgal nas/ /sku gsum nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur cig / dge ldan bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'phel zhing rgyas/ /mi yi dbang phyug chab srid mnga' thang dar/ /'gro kun dge bcu'i dpal la spyod pa yis/ / rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje byin rlabs dang / srung ma'i nus mthu bdag cag mos pa'i stobs/ / zab mo rten 'byung chos dbyangs bden pa kun/ / tshogs pas smon pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid or du su'i sman pa bla zur blo bzang yon tan gyis sher phyin stong phrag brgyad pa'i glegs bam ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba gsar bsgrun bgyis te nged la ched gtad kyis byin nas des mtshon pa'i dge rtsa rnams kha bsgyur ba'i smon tshig cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa'o/ /rgyal kun spangs dang rtogs pa'i byang chub mchog / phyogs mthun lam dang bcas pa'i dngos po nyid/ / gzugs skur shar ba skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing / /ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams pa yis mchod sdong che 'dir bsam sbyor ci rigs kyis/ / 'brel thogs phyag mchod skor ba byed rnams dang / / mthong thos dran reg kun gye shes rgyud la/ / thar pa'i sa bon grung po thebs gyur cig / ngan song gsum sogs mi khom gnas rnams su/ / nam yang mi skye dal 'byor rten thob cing / / mtshan nyid bcu ldan theg mchog bshes gnyen gyis/ / 'bral med dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin par shog / de nas mdo sngags zung 'brel lam bzang la/ / gegs med thos bsam sgom pas tshul bzhin du/ / zhugs nas rgyal sras spyod pa mthar phyin te/ / 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog tu 'gyur bar shog / dge 230

ra / / sdo /thab pa/re'adun sde rnams bslab gsum nyams len 'phel/ / skye bo kun kyang dge bcu'i nor gyis phyug / bstan pa'i snying po yun du gnas pa yis/ / lus can phan bde'i rtsa ba tshugs gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni rnam dpyod yangs pa dka' bcu dgogamachogasbyin pas bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me4bris pa'o/ /gangagi mtshan tsam mthos shing dran pas kyang / / mi khom ngan song skye ba'i sgo bcad de/ / zhing mchog bde ba can du 'khrid mdzad pa/ / mgon po 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de yi sku gzugs phul byung bzhengs pa la/ / mthun rkyen sgrub par byed pa rnams kyis mtshon/ / pha ma rigs drug 'brel thogs 'gro ba kun/ / rtag tu 'od dpag med kyis rjes 'dzin shog / nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba na/ / zhes sogs dang / bar do'i snang ba shar bar gyur ma thag / cesasogs/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ zhes sogasadang / dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ / zhes sogs/ shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ ces pa nas/ bden pas smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog / ces pa 'di ni/ 7btsun pa dkonamachog bstan pa'i sgron mes rang gzhan gnyi ga mi bslu ba'i phyir dkor rdzas kyi snying po lta bur 'od dpag med kyi gos sku dpangs 'dom bcu bdun/ zhe4(zheng ) 'domabacu gcig lhag tsam gsar bskrun bgyis skabayolhag bas ca nam dag gis lasakhur 'dzin pa bka' bcu dkon mchog bstan dar gyis gtsos bzo bo rnams nas smon tshig cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar go rim tsam bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa'ang sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /zla ba'i 'khri shing rol pa'i 'jo sgeg gis/ / zla bral spobs pa'i mchog sbyin gang gi zhabs/ / zla tshes ri mo gtsug gis gus bsten na/ / zla ltar 231

ro / /gung thang bston bsgozla me'i gsung 'bum/gsal ba'i shes rab snang ba stsol/ / rnam mang gzhung lugs tshig don 'dzin pa dang / / bzung ba mi brjed dran pas skyong ba dang / / de yi dgongs don ji bzhin rtogs pa yi/ / gzungs spobs shes rab thob par byen gyes rlobs/ / thos pas sgra spyi'i go ba myur du chags/ / bsam pas sgo 'dogs lhag ma med par chod/ / sgom pas rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur ba yis/ /bstan la tshul bzhin slob par byin gyis rlobs/ / tshad ma sde bdun rigs pas blo mig phye/ / dbu phar zab rgyas lam gyis gzhung bsrangs shing / /'dul mngon ji bzhin blang dor la 'bad pas/ thar pa'i lam du tshud par byin gyis rlobs/ / rnam grol sa bon bskrun nus 'chad mkhas dang / / log rtog dra ba gcod nus rtsod mkhas te/ / thub bstan rgyan du 'gyur ba'i rtsom mkhas kyis/ / mang thos dga' ston myong bar byin gyis rlobs/ / bshad pa lung rigs tshad mas gzhan dag dang / / sgrub pa bslab gsum dag pas rang nyid ni/ / yang dag lam la gcig tu sbyor ba yis/ / don gnyis lhun gyes grub par byin gyis rlabs/ / de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi yab gcig la/ /bye ༷ bhe shlau sdi / tt+waṃ/༷ ༷/hūṃ bye/ hūm̐ ༷ ༵/ dīsku/༷tī ṭwāṃX hūṃng pa ༷/ṭwāṃhūṃ mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni snyi gru ra tna ā nanta'o/ /232

༄ / /baspyo ༅rgyas / ca༅tha'i 'acas/ngog ga༄7/ / bsngo ba rgyas pa dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/༄za/ / phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyis bsngo ba'i dpang po dang smon lam gyi mthun 'gyur thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul grangs snyed las 'das pa'i zhing khams mtha' yas shing mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i ston pa bde bar gshegs pa 'khor rgyal sras dpa' bo nyan rang slob mar bcas pa thams cad dngos kyi sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyis thog drangs bdag sogs mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la gzigs shing dgongs su gsol/ rang cag rnams kyis 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di nyid mtshon byed du byas rang gzhan skye 'phags thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa sbyin pa las byung ba dang / tshul khrims las byung ba/ sgom pa las byung ba bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po rnam pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i tshogs ji snyed cig mchis pa mtha' dag gcig tu bsdus shing bablums te bsdoms pa'i mthu la brtenanas lus can yongs kyi sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi nad ma lus pa sel ba'i sman gcig pu/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i bde dge ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag tu'ang dpal a ti sha dang 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po rnam gnyis kyis lung dang rigs pa dri ma med pa'i sgo nas 233

༄/ /yo ༄na yo sgronama'i ga 'bumadag zer mdzad de 'khrul ba'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba gser sbyang btso ma lta bu mdo sngags bshad sgrub zung du 'jug pa'i lugs mchog rmad du byung ba 'di nyid phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig / ston pa mnyam med stobs bcu mnga' ba rnam 'dren shākya seng ge de nyid nas nye bar bzung 'od srung chen po sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gyi srol 'byed shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyis gtsos 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis la sogs pa 'phags yul paṇa grub gser gyi ri bo'i phreng ba lta bu rim par byon pa thams cad dang / bod yul mun pa'i smag rum du dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me gsal bar mdzad pa rigs gsum kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal lo paṇa gong ma bka' drin can rnams dang /khyad par du'ang lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal lha gcig dī baṃ kā ra/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i srog shing 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/sras kyi thu bo sku mched rnam pa gsum la sogs pa lha chos bdun ldan gyi rnam thar gtsang ma'i srol 'dzin pa'i bka' gdams gong ma rim byon/ sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag mar pa mi la sogs bka' rgyud gong ma rnams pa dang / sa chen kun dga' snying po yab sras/ 'chad nyan gye srol bzang po dar rgyas su mdzad pa lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen/ cha pa chos kyi seng ge snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin zirde grub pa sogs dang / bye brag tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba nyid dngadabyer ma mchis pa sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar tsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi zhal snga nas dang / rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ 'dul 234

sa / /bsngo casal cayosgore 'jugs(gaga'adzin chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje bkra shis dpal ldan/ gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa nas bzung rgyal dbang phyagan padma rje btsun blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho la thug gi bar rgyal ba gong ma brgyad dang / paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sogs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma gsum dang /mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje/snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan/ don gye slad du mtshan nas smos te bdag gi mkhan rin po che yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro zhing sdud pa'i bdag nyid can rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal snga nas la sogs pa rang cag rnams kyi bla ma dam pa gong ma gzugs sku'i bkod pa nyer zhi'i dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa rnams thugs zag pa med pa'i dgongs pa khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig da lta bstan 'gro'i dpal du zhal bzhugs pa rnams kyigatsug na mngon par mtho ba rgyal dbang mchog gi sprul ba'i sku rin po che'i zhal snga nas dang / snang ba mtha' yas ngur smrig gar gyes rol pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma chen po thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa lag skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas la sogs pa rang cag 235

༄/ /yo thang b.lo yosgronaryā khrung 4ma/rnams kyi bla ma dam pa bstan 'gro'i dpal du zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku tshe zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing / bstan 'gro'i gsos su gyur pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa 'phrin las rmad du byung ba rnams dbyar gye chu gter bzhin du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig rgyal ba'i lung gi zin pa'i chos grwa chen po 'dis mtshon gdan sa chen po bzhi la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rnams kyang thugs mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba'i sgo nas lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len/ lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan/gsang chen rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub la sogs pa 'khor lo gsum gyes bsdus pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po rnams yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa de dag gi thugs rje dang / rang cag rnams kyis dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa gus zhabs kyi sgo nas mchod par byed pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa rnams kyis tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag ste myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig sangs ma rgyas pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du'ang ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i skye gnas ngan pa rnams su dus skad cig tsam yang mi skye bar gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i rten bzang po brgyud mar 'thob cing / rten de dag la'ang gzhon nu nyid nas rab tu byung ste mkhan slob kyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig mtha' dag mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung ba'i steng nas lam thun mong ba bshes gnyen sten tshul nas bzung zhi 236
