༄ / /bzla ༅sal ca46) 'jugs(btagalhag gi bar gyi lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rnams skye ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig de ltar lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du btang nas thun mong ma yin pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i 'jug sgo dbang rnam par dag pa mnos/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul ba'in du bsrung / smin byed bskyed pa'i rim pa ste lam rim pa dang grol byed dzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi bgrod pa la brten nas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe dang ldan pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa rnams kyi sngon las dang 'phral rkyen las byung ba'i phyi nang gi nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba mnga' thang rigs rgyud snyan pa dang grags pa sogs legs pa'i tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad bong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi drug dam can chos kyi rgyal po phyi nang gsang gsum/ dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo re ma ti/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras la sogs pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis bka' bsgos shing dam tshig gnyer du gtad pa'i chos srung ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis de dag la lus dang grib ma ba'in du 'grogs te skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs mdzad par gyur cig klu'i rgyal po dga' po dang nyer dga' bo la sogs pa ston pa'i 'al mthong zhing bstan la dga' ba'i dkar phyogs kyi lha klu spyi dang / khyad nga ra du'ang sa phyogs yul rigs dgon gnas dge 'dun gyi sde gtsug 'a/ga khang srung zhing skyong bar byed pa'i gzhi bdag gnas bdag dkar po'i pyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams kyi dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu stobs gzi brjid 237

༄༅/ /gung thang bsan pa'itshonachu gsung 'bram/nus pa rnams mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur ciganag po'i phyogs la dga' ba'i 'byung po las ngan sdig can mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyi bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad nye bar zhi nas bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems skyed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur ciga'ajig rten gyi khams 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu nad mug 'khrug rtsod la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i nyer 'tshe rgud pa'i rigs mtha' dag lhag med du zhi nas char chu dus su 'chabs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa sogs bkra shis dang dge mtshan gye dpal rgya chen po rgyun mi 'chad du 'byung bar gyur cig mdor na bdag sogs mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig 'jam dpal dpa' po zhes sogasasam/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba zhes sogs bya/ 'di'ang 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes tshogasachosasogs kyi mjug tu ngag lam nasagang thon gyis bsngo ba rgyas par byas pa de bzhin yi ger 'khod pa zhig dgos zhes har chen rā ja sag gi shog nas dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog dar rgyasakyis bskul ba'i ngor bris pa'o/ /238

da / / rabad phro 'debabag༄/ / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dge legs 'bum phrag ma gnyis bzhugs so//༄7/ / spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i steng / / seng khri padma nyi zla'i dbus/ / dgyes bzhin bzhugs shig drin can rje/ / byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje'i gter/ / skyabs gsum kun dngos mgon khyod la/ / sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / / gsol ba 'debs so drin can rje/ / byin gye rlobs shig thugs rje'i gter/ / lus dang longs spyod dge tshogs bcas/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul/ / dgyes bzhin bzhes shig drin nga 'i/ / rnam smin 'bras bu mi bzad pa'i/ / sgo gsum nyes ltung ma lus bshags/ / byang bar mdzod cig drin ma nga/ / 'phral dang yun du bde ster ba'i/ / sngon byas dge la rjes yi rang / / spel bar mdzod cig drin can ma sa/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro la rjes brtse bas/ / mya ngan mi 'da' srid mtha'i bar/ / bstan par bzhugs shig drin can rjes/ / zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi yis/ / nyon mongs nad gyis gdungs pa kun/ / zhi bar mdzod cig brin can nga nga/ / 'di ltar bskrun pa'i dge tshogs mthus/ / bzod dka' 'khor ba'i btson ra las/ / thar bar mdzod cig drin can rje/ / yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa yi/ / ma rnams srid las sgrol 'dod blo/ / skye bar mdzod cig drin can rje/ / bdag med 239

༄/ /yo ca bayo ༅sotsho ga las/bdag du bzung byas te/ / nyes kun bskyed pa'i gdon chen 'di/ / dbyung bar mdzod cig drin can rje/ /skye shi'i 'khrul snang ha la'i dug / sku gsum 'chi med bdud rtsi ru/ bsgyur bar mdzod cig drin can rje/ / kun rtogs chu 'dzin spang ba'i mkhar/ / lhan skyes bde chen nyin mor byed/ / 'char bar mdzod cig drin can rje/ / mdor na deng nas byang chub par/ / khyod min re sa gzhan med do/ / rjes su zung shig drin can rje/ / sgo gsum spyod pa mtha' dag kyang / /don med las su mi 'gyur bar/ /khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig bsgrub nus par/ /byin gyis rlobs shigs ma/ / chos ldan smon pa ma lus pa'i/ / 'bras bu gegs med 'grub pa yi/ / dpung gnyen mdzod cig drin can rje/ / byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje'i gter/ / ces brjod cing rnam pa kun tu yang zama'i snang ba dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /tshul 'di ni dad brtson rnam dpyod ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gyiyobaskul ngor/btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgrog mes bris pa'o/ /dge legs 'bum phrag padma dkar po'i tshal/ / lhag bsam nyin byed snang ba dang 'grogs pas/ / dal 'byor zil dngar rdzogs pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ / thar 'dod bung ba'i nyer 'tsho rgyal gyur cig / 'jig rten che dgu'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ / kheng dregs spangs te dam pa'i mgon la brten/ / mos gus nyams med dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrungs/ / bshes gnyen thugs kyi sras po khyod la 'dud/ / tha snyad spun pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /nang don 'phags bod mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs la/ / sbyangs pas dri med rigs pa'i dga' ston myong / / smra ba'i dbang po mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gnad thang mar brdal ba'i bshad pa dang / /grub mtha'i de nyid 'byed pa'i rtsod pa dang / /tshig don phun tshogs rtsom pa'i dga' ston 240

sa / /blar mtshoga'abyoramakhasa'akhasab 'debagal/ / dbang bsgyur bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / las 'bras blang dor tshul la nges rnyed pas/ / mngon lkog med par dran shes bag yod kyis/ / bslab khrims dag pa nyams len mthil du mdzad/ / gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnyed bkur zang zing 'byor ba'i yo lang rnams/ / rnam smin khur chen 'gel ba'i dgrar gzigs nas/ / mchog gsum zhing du bsngos te don ldan mdzad/ / dad ldan skye bo'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ / thub bstan rin chen ring du gnas 'dod pa'i/ / thugs bskyed shugs drag dri yi bzhon pa can/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa'i dri bzang 'phro/ / bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon pa rtag brtan shog / nam yang mi bslu dkon mchog bden pa'i mthus/ / bstan pa'i sgon me bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / / bdag kyang deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / dgyes bzhin 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par shog / zab rgyas gdams pa bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ / yang dag lam bzang lus stobs rab rgyas nas/ / bla ma lha yi go 'phang myur thob te/ / ma lus 'gro ba srid las sgrol gyur cig / ce4pa 'di ni rang gi gam gcar dad brtson tshul khrims ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin gyes bskul ngor/ 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs tsong kha pa'i/ / mdo sngags gzhung lugs mtha' dag spel slad du/ / rlabs chen smon lam mchog gis bskrun pa'i sku/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mer gsol ba 'debs/ / de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab mthus/ / mgon khyod zhabs zung srid mthar brtan pa dang / / bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rjes bzung legs bshad dga' ston myong bar shog / 'dis mtshon dge bas 241

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum/mar gyur 'gro ba rnams/ / theg mchog dge ba'i bshes dang mi 'bral zhing / / rab 'byams rgyal pa'i chos tshul kun bzung nas/ / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan slob ma blobazang dka' bcus bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mesasmrasapa'o/ / mgo lam /242

das /bye ga༄7/ / legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄7/ / oṃ bde legs su gyur cig / rin chen sems kyi rtsa ba brtan/ /rlabs chen tshogs gnyis yal ga rgyas/ / sku gsum 'bras bzang snye mas dud/ / sangs rgyas ljon pa de la 'dud/ / snang ba dpe ru shar pa yi/ / rnal 'byor de la gdams ngag mang / / nags klung sdug po'i do ra ru/ / shing lo'i phung po zad pa med/ / dpag bsam shing la rten byas na/ / dgos 'dod thams cad char du bsnyil/ / de bzhin bshes gnyen dam pa la/ / brten na legs tshogs lhun gyis 'grub/ / bshes la mi gus skye bo des/ / gzhung brgya shes kyang don mi 'gyur/ / shing skam lo brgya chur 'phangalang / / lo 'dab skye ba srid na med/ / dad ldan rang bzhin bzang po der/ / tshigs bcad gcig tsam gyis kyang phan/ / rkang 'thung gsar ba'i myu gu de/ / chu char gzegs ma yis kyang 'phel/ / tsher ma can dang dug shing gis/ / mi dgos bzhin du sa 'di gang / / mi khom ngan song skye ba ni/ / sa yi rdul bzhin bgrang las 'das/ / tsan dan sa mtshag ljon pa de/ / 'jig rten 'di na srid pa tsam/ / dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang yang / / brgya lam thob pa ma bkag tsam/ / dal 'byor snyeng po ma blangs na/ / dud 'gro'i rten dang gnyis su med/ / a smra'i 'bras bu mi spyod 243

༄/ /yo ca bstan rsā ryā gsung 'bum/na/ / er na da dang khyad par ci/ / mdangs dang lo 'bras me tog sogs/ / ljon pa gcig kyang dus kyi 'gyur/ / bye rga na dang 'chi ba yi /zlos gar skad cig skad cig bsgyur/ / ring du 'brel ba'i shing lo de/ / lan gcig brul pa slar mi 'byor/ / 'dza' (mdza') ba yun ring 'khod 'khod nas/ / nam zhig gtan tu 'bral bar 'gyur/ / sdong po gshags gtub dras pa yis/ / shing mkhan myur du ngal bar 'gyur/ / bskal bar de 'dra'i las bsgrub kyang / / dmyal bsrung rnams ni ngal ba med/ / ji srid mi dge ma zad pa/ / de srid sdug bsngal 'khor mor myong / / dug gi sa bon gnas kyi bar/ / dug lo skye ba chos nyid yin/ / gang zhig gsum la skyabs song ba/ / de la srid zhi'i rgud pa med/ / ljon pa che la bsten pa bde/ / gcan zan gdug pas gtse mi nus/ / rtsa ba rul ba'i ljon pa la/ / bsten par byed pa blun po'i rtags/ / rang yang 'khor bar byeng pa la/ / skyabs su 'dzin rnams kye ma 'khrul/ / dug dang sman gyi myu gu las/ / 'bras bu 'chol ba 'gar yang med/ / dge dang mi dge'i las las kyang / / 'bras bu gzhan 'byung gnas ma yin/ / thog med dus nas bsags pa'i las/ / bskal ba brgyar yang chud mi za/ / ta la'i shing 'bras stong phrag 'thor/ / skam yang rlan dang 'phrad na skye/ / sa bon chung smin n+ya gro ta'i/ / yal 'dab rgyas pas rgyangs grags khebs/ / kham gcig zas kyi sbyin pas kyang / / 'bras bu 'khor los bsgyur ba 'thob/ / rnam bkra srid pa'i 'khor lo 'dir/ / don ldan snying po 'ga' ma mchis/ / chu shing rlon pa'i sdong bo la/ / rtse rting kun na snying po med/ / ljon shing lo brgyar skyes pa yang / / nam zhig tshe na 'gyel bar 'gyur/ / srid pa'i rtse mor phyin nas ni/ / slar yang mi bzad ngan 'gror 'gro/ / bur shing khu pas rab bsgos na/ / tig ta'i kha ba sel bar 244

da / /ཿsang mdzathaganus/ / lam gye bden pa rab goms pas/ / sdug bsngal rtsa ba kun 'byung spong / / ka gdung lcam dang dral ma rnams/ / tshogs pas yid 'ong lding khang ste/ / lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum tshogs pas/ / thar pa dam pa'i khang bzang 'grub/ / dzan du'i sa bon de'i sa bon/ / gzhan las skye phyir thog ma med/ / mtha' med 'khor bar skyes pa na/ / pha mar ma gyur su zhig yod/ / rta glang brgya yi khur lce ba/ / shing rta chen po gcig gis 'dren/ /nyan rang kun gyis ma long ba'i/ / khur te rgyal sras phrag na mdzes/ / shing gzhan 'bras bu blangs pas 'dzad/ / dpag bsam shing 'bras zad pa med/ / dge ba gzhan 'bras sbyang pas 'dzad/ / byang chub sems dge phyir zhing 'phel/ / yongs smin 'bras bus spa ba yi/ / rkang 'thung de la skye bo 'du/ / 'jung med gtong ba'i dpal yon can/ / de yis skye dgu'i re ba skong / / mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyis/ / rtsa ba tshul khrims lasagazhan med/ / yal 'dab g.yur du za ba yi/ / rtsa ba sdong bu nyag gcig yin/ / tsher ma zug pa'i lan du slar/ / khu tshur brdeg pa ba'ad gad rgyu/ / gnod byed la yang slar khro ba/ / rang nyid nyams pa'i rgyu ru zad/ /rgyu dus brtson pa ma btang na/ / 'bras dus yon tan thams cad skye/ / rtsa ba rlan dang ma bral na/ / rtse mor lo 'bras smin par 'gyur/ / sdong po rlung gis cher bskyod na/ / 'bras bu sa la 'brul ba ltar/ / bying rgod g.yeng bas rab g.yos pas/ / ting 'dzin dmigs pa stor par byed/ / bsam gtan rnam par dag pa las/ / mngon shes la sogs yon tan 'byung / / sdong bu nyams pa med gyur na/ / me tog ge sar mgo spyog ldem/ / shing gi ral gri g.yul gyi ngor/ / 'phyar pa dgra yi dga' ston yin/ / ltar snang nyi tshe'i lta ba yi/ / srid rtsa gcod 'dod kye hud mtshar/ / ha ri tsandan bzang po 245

༄/ /yo ca gan pa'iyome'i ga ཿma/yi/ / lus kyi tsha gdung sel bar byed/ / snying rje'i bcud ldan lta ba yi/ /dug gsum nad brgya drung nas 'byin/ / shing las skyes pa'i srin bu yis/shing de zad par byed pa bzhin/ / 'dod chags lam skyes ye shes kyis/ /'dod chags nyes pa zhi bar byed/ / shing skya rlan gyis zin pa las/ / be ḍūr mdang su 'pho ba ltar/ / tha mal snang ba 'od gsal gyis/ / sbyang ste dag pa'i lha skur ldang / / yal 'dab yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ / ljon pa'i grib ma kun tu bsil/ / yon tan ma lus rdzogs pa yi/ / rgyal ba skye dgu'i mgon tu gyur/ / de ltar shing gi bstan chos las/ / chos kyi lam bstan sarga ste/ / da ni 'jig rten tshul lugs 'ga'/ / bshad do rna ba brlag ste nyon/ / chos ldan rgyal po'i gzi byin gyis/ / dgra sde rnams kyang dbang du 'du/ / ma la yar skyes dri bsung de/ / bung pa 'gug pa'i pho nya yin/ /rgyal ngan chab 'bang gzir ba der/ / nam zhig g.yog kyang 'khor mi 'gyur/ / sran phud dbyug pas gtor na yang / / dbyug pa'i ngos la 'byar mi srid/ / blon dang 'bangs kyis ma bkur na/ / rgyal po chen po ji ltar gnas/ / gdung ma ka bas ma btegs na/ / rgyal po'i pho brang gang las 'byung / / rje dpon bzang po'i bka' drin gyis/ / g.yog 'khor mnga' thang dar bar 'gyur/ / ljon pa che la bsten pa yi/ / 'khri shing rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs/ / tsher ma'i shing la bsten byas na/ / gnad du zug pa'i sdug bsngal skye/ / skye po ngan la brten byas kyang / / phyi phyir sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bskyed/ / chab 'bangs bde skyid rgyas pa de/ / rje dpon nyid kyi che ba'i rtags/ / rab rgyas yal ga'i khyon yangs pa/ sdong po rtsa ba'i mdzes rgyan yin/ / g.yog 'khor rgud pa'i sde dpon de/ / rang nyid 'byor yang ngo tsha'i rgyu/ / sdong po ci tsam sgom na yang / / yal 'dab med na gcer bu yin/ /246

༄/ /shingagabasdong rul rtsa bar gnas pa'i mi/ / nyin mtshan kun tu bag phebs bral/ /gtso bo ngan pa'i g.yog 'khor yang / / rtag tu sems khral gdung bas gzir/ / dpon ngan g.yog 'khor 'bros na'ang / / sde dpon bzang pos bskrad kyang 'du/ / tsher shing 'bor ba'i sbra ma ra/ / tsu ta'i shing las bskrad kyang 'khor/ / rje dpon gsar tshe byams byed kyang / / phyi nas bsgrub dka'i dpyasal 'beb/ / shing la char skyobs byed mod kyang / / rjes su thig phreng lce bar 'bab/ ljon pa'i grib bsil kun la snyoms/ / nyi zla'i snang ba kun la snyoms/ / sprin gyi chu char kun la snyoms/ / rgyal po'i bka' khrims kun la snyoms/ / gtso bo bzang yang 'khor ngan na/ / de yi drung du bsnyen par dka'/ / gdug pa'i sbrul gyis dkris pa yi/ / tsardon ljon pa su yi bsten/phyi nang smin dang ma smin pa'i/ / a smra'i 'bras bu rigs bzhir gsungs/ /mi yang sems dang spyod pa gnyis/ / dag dang ma dag dbye ba mang / // mkhas pa yon tan kun ldan de/ / rloms sems med par zhi zhing dul/ /snye ma'i khur gyis brjid pa yi/ / ljon shing rtse mo dud de gnas/ / yon tan med pa'i skye bo de/ / nga rgyal mgo 'phang ci las mtho/ / 'bras bu'i bcud kyis ma bzung ba'i/ / ljon pa rengs pa chos nyid yin/ / lhan skyes yon tan med gyur na/ / phyi tshul bcosapas ci la phan/ / yal 'dab med pa'i shing skam der/ / cod pan btags kyang ga la mdzes/ / bslab sbyang dus na g.yeng ba des/ / mkhas 'dod re ba 'bras med yin/ / me tog sad kyis khyer ba yi/ / / shing la 'bras bu'i re ba med/ / blo gros rtsal dang mi ldan na/ / go sa mtho yang khrel ba'i gzhi/ / shing las byas pa'i seng ge de/ /'jigs 'jigs 'dra yang snying po med/ / dri zhim bsung ngad mi ldan na/ /tsardon yin zhes smras kyang rdzun/ / dam pa'i tshul dang mi mthun na/ / dam 247

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronama'i gsung 'bum/par khas 'che don dang bral/ / dman pa rgyal sar bton na yang / / ma rabs spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug / chu shing gyen tu skyes na yang / / 'dab ma thur du 'phyang bar 'gyur/ / a gar dum bu brgyar gtub kyang / / lhan skyes dri bzang mi gtong ltar/ / dam pa ci tsam rgud na yang / / bzang po'i rang bzhin ga la 'dor/ / shug pa'i lo ma mer bcug na/ / lhag par dri bzang rgyas pa bzhin/ / dam pa rnams la gnod byas pas/ / phyir zhing de yi che ba 'don/ / dam pa dben par gnas na yang / / grags snyan lha yis sgogs par byed/ / lho yi ri las skyes pa yi/ / tsardon dri bsung rlung gis 'gyed/ /'khyog pa'i shing de bsrang na yang / / rlan dang 'phrad tshe ya yor 'gyur/ / rang bzhin ngan pa bcos na yang / / rkyen dang 'phrad tshe rang mtshang ston/ / klad chung rang bzhin ngan pa la/ / yon tan yod kyang phan mi thogs/ / rtsa ba dug tu gnas pa yi/ / me tog mdzes kyang su la mkho/ /tsardon shug pa'i ka ba gnyis/ / gdung ma 'degs pa'i nus pa mtshungs/ /snying stobs ldan na dbul phyug gnyis/ / bya ba byed pa'i dus su 'dra/ /longs spyod mnga' thang mnyam na yang / / bzang ngan las la sbyar na shes/ /phra sbom mnyam yang chur 'phang na/ / shing gi mgo mjug shes par nus/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo yul gzhan du/ / brin shing kun gyes bkur bar 'gyur/ /nags su skyes pa'i shing gis ni/ / gzhan du shing gi bya ba byed/ / shing bal rlung gis bdas pa de/ / ri rtser mi sdod gshong du chags/ / blo chung phyogs mthar 'khyams 'khyams nas/ / mtha' mar rgud pa'i gnas su lhung / /skyon gyis gos pa ches sla ste/ / yon tan slob pa de lta min/ / shing la me lce mched sla yang / / chu bo so sor 'gyed par dka'/ / ma rabs skye bo gnyis 'grogs na/ / phugs su rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phongs/ / gtsub shing zung 248

༄/ /thadashibaskya ryādu brdar ba yis/ / mjug tu gnyis ka bsreg par byed/ / phun sum tshogs pa'i ljon pa yang / / chu dang 'grogs na rtsa ba 'byin/ / ya rabs yon tan ldan pa yang / / grogs po ngan pas nyams par byed/ / 'bras ldan shing gnyis sbyar ba las/ / 'bras bu phung gsum 'byung ba ltar/ / blo dang ldan pa gnyis 'grogs na/ / sngon med legs pa'i blo gros skye/ / ljon pa'i grib bsil bsten pa yi/ / glang pos shing gi rtsa ba 'byen/ / g.yog 'khor ngan pa bsten pa yis/ / legs byas rtsa ba nyams par byed/ / shing sdong gtsug gis bkurab yis/ / 'dab chags 'gro tshe bya thal gtong / / zla grogs ngan pa brten na yang / / nam zhig rjes ngan bzhag nas 'gro/ / ngan par ci tsam phan btags kyang / / lan du phan pa'i re ba med/ / shing gis rtag tu me gsos kyang / / me yis de nyid thal bar byed/ / blo dang mthu ldan re res kyang / / mchog dman kun gyi dgos pa bsgrub/ / 'od ma'i gnam ru gcig gis kyang / / nyag phran stong gi bya ba byed/ / longs spyod dpal dang mi ldan na/ / rigs rus mtho yang dgos pa chung / / dgos pa'i grib bsil med gyur tshe/ / rtse mo mtho bas ci la phan/ / rtsa ba bsod nams med gyur na/ /bsags pas dbul pa mi sel de/ / sdong po brlan dang bral ba la/ / yal gar chu bos byug kyang ci/ / bun dang bskyed kyis nor spel bar/ / 'dod kyang rtsa ba stor pa mang / / shing skyes bcad nas sa gzhan du/ / btsugs pa phal cher skam par 'gyur/ / g.yang sa mthon por skyes pa yi/ / sa ha ka ra'i 'bras bu bzhin/ / rang gzhan gang la'ang mi phan pa'i/ / longs spyod che de lba ba yin/ / longs spyod spel bar 'dod pa yis/ / cha shas gtong ba man ngag ste/ / ljon shing yal ga rgyas 'dod na/ / rtse mo 'breg pa thabs su bzang / / dman pas bsags kyang mi 'grub la/ / bsod nams ldan pas 249

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa4 sgoname'i gsung las/btang yang 'byor/ / brlan sar bcad kyang skye ba'i shing / / skam sar btsugs kyang ga la skye/ / lam kha'i shing gi 'bras bu de/ / byes pa'i rdo char 'bebs pa'i rgyu/ / bdag po ngan pa'i longs spyod kyang / / phal cher dgra yig yab mo yin/ / bsod nams dman pa'i skyes bu der/ / dpal 'byor byung na srog kyang brlag / smin ma'i shing gi rtse mo la/ / 'bras bu chags pa nyams pa'i ltas/ / bur shing gcod pa ro yi phyir/ / wa skyes gsod pa pags pa'i slad/ / don mthun 'joms pa nor gyi don/ / rgyal por rgol ba 'bang kyi ched/ / shing la thog mar thig 'debs kyi/ / dras shing gtubs nas bsgyur du med/ / bya ba'i thog mar bsam dgos kyi/ / rjes nas gyod brngal blun po'i rtags/ stabs legs tsam gyes don grub kyang / / blo dang ldan par su zhig rlom/ / lo ma 'khum nas nyal bas shing / / sems ldan bsgrub pa mu stegs lugs/ / srang mdor lo 'dab nyal nyil du/ / gnas pas shing de kun gyi badzi/ / don med 'chol ba'i gtam mang ba'i/ / mi de kun la ngo thang chung / / mi ngan byas pa chung na yang / / drin che'i yus kyis rna ba 'gems/ / bud shing rlon pa me chung yang / / dud pa nag pos tshang mang 'gengs/ / shing la lan cig sbrul gnas de/ / phyis kyang mthong tshe 'jigs pa ltar/ / rku dang rdzun la gcig zhugs pa'i/ / mi der rtag tu dogs pa skye//tsher ma rno yang brag ri la/ / bsnun na rtse mo 'jil bar byed/ / skyes bu dam par phrag dog gis/ / smod pa rang gi dma' 'bebs yin/ / gnas min la yang dul ches na/ / snyigs pa'i dus 'dir kun gyi brnyas/ / shing bal 'jam mo 'jam mo zhes/ / kun gyi gdan du mi byed dam/ / shing skyes drang po mdzes na yang / / sga shing 'khyog po ci las bzang / / rang bzhin drang na bzang mod kyang / / res 'ga' ldem po rgyal bas gsungs/ / mde'u 250

ra / / tso pa dzams/med pa'i mda' 'phen pa/ / dgra bo spyan 'dren pho nya yin/ / dgra bo 'joms pa'i mthu med na/ / don med dpa' skad ci la smra/ / gnyen la ha cang byams pa yang / / 'khon gyi rgyu ru 'gro ba mang / / bur shing mngar po spyod ches na/ / ma zhus sgregs pa skyur mo 'byung / / shing dgra sta re yin mod kyang / / de'i (yi)yu ba shing gis byed/ / dgra yis brtsams pa'i phung khrol kyang / / phal cher rtsa ba gnyen gyis byas/ / sdong po gcod pa'i thabs snyes na/ / rang gi steng du lhung bar 'gyur/ / dgra la ha cang sdang ba yang /rang gi gshed du 'gro ba mang / / shing skam dgu par mi nus de/ / rlan gyis bgos na las su rung / / dgra po mi bsrun sems ldan yang / / thabs la mkhas na 'dul bar nus/ nyi zlas mi phyed mya ngan med/ / na chung rkang gdub reg pas 'byed/ / legs par bshad kyang mi go pa'i / / ma rabs la la smad pas thul/ / nags na gnas rnams khang bzang dang / der gnas skyed mo'i tshal la dga'/ / 'tsho bas dbul ba rab byung dang / / rgyal bas myos pa khyim la phyogs/ / nags der skyes pa'i spre'u yang / / 'bras bu bzang na gzhan du 'gro/ / rgud tshe snying du sdug pa yi/ / bu yang gzhan gyi phyogs su 'bros/ / nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa der/ / don med nam mkha'i bya yang 'khor/ / gang na bde skyid 'dzom pa der/ / ma bsdus par yang skye bo 'du/ / shing gi 'bras bu legs bskyangs na/ / lo 'dab la sogs zhar la 'byung / / dam pa'i chos la brtson byas na/ / srid kyi dpal mang de yis 'grub/ / de ltar lugs gnyis blang dor kun/ / shing gi khyad par kho na yis/ / mtshon byed gtam gye sbyor ba 'di/ / sngon med mkhas pa'i dga' ston yin/ / gang mgrin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ru/ / dbyangs ldan ngang mo rnam rol ba/ / de yi kha las legs bshad kyi/ / rba rlab 'khri shing ci yang g.yo/ /251

༄/ /gung thang bayo ཿtshanasa'i khrung 'a4/grags snyan nor bu'i zhags pa yis/ / rgya bod 'dzin ma'i mtha' bcing ba/ / dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi ta'i/ / legs bshad lam la brten pa yin/ /don gyi sgo lcags mkhyud ('khyud) gang la/ / dpe yi lde mig khru gang pa/ / de lta'i gzhung yang snang mod de/ / mkhas blun su yi dbang du byas/ / lugs gnyis blang dor shes 'dod rnams/ / dpe yis sor mo tsam min par/ /don gyi zla shel ltos shig dang / / ngo mtshar ri dwags mtshan ma yod/ /'dir 'bad legs byas na gro ta'i/ / sa bon smin pa'i dge mtshan gye/ /yal ga phyogs bcur rgyas pa yis/ / 'gro ba kun gyi don byed shog /ces legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis yal 'dab brgya ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni mthong snang sna tshogs kyis rkyen byas te btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes tshwa rgan sman chur phyin pa'i lam khar gang dran sug bris su bgyes pa'o/ /

༄/ /chu'ibastanabacog༄7/ / legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs 'phreng brgya ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄7/ / mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / / thugs rje'i yid bzhin nor gyis gtams/ / mdzad pa'i rlabs phreng g.yo ba can/ / thub dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho rgyal/ / rnyog bral dwangs pa'i chu rgyun gyes/ / lus can gdung ba zhi byed ltar/ / legs bshad gsar ba'i bdud rtsi yis/ / blo ldan skye bo dbugs dbyung bya/ / dri bzang bsgos pa'i chu gtsang de/ / mchod yon zhabs bsil bsang gtor sogs/ / gang du byas kyang legs pa ltar/ /legs bshad gtam ni kun la mdzes/ / lugs gnyis blang dor shes pa yis/ / gnas skabs mthar thug don 'grub ste/ / brtag pa kun la mkhas pa yi/ / ded dpon rgya mtshor zhugs pa bzhin/ / chu bran brgal bar mi nus des/ / rgya mtshor rkyal gyis ga la chod/ / ya rabs lugs kyang mi shes na/ / chos kyi de nyid ji ltar rtogs/ / gzur gnas rig par ldan pa des/ / gzhan gyi yon tan len par byed/ / spang ljongs gtsang ma'i dal 'gro ma/ / lhung lhung zer zhing me tog 'thu/ / ngan pas phyogs mtha' bskor na yang / / skyon gyi rigs rnams sdud par byed/ / ngam grog sa ral can kyi chus/ / 'dam gyi snyig ma 'dren dang mtshungs/ / yon tan dang por slob dka' la/ / shes bzhin med na nyams pa sla/ / chu thigs bsags pas 253

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i yo khrung 'bum/'gengs dka' yang / / bo na gcig car nyid du 'dzad/ / dka' spyad khur du 'khyer nus na/ bya ba gang yang dka' ba med/ / chu yi nang du zhugs pa der/ / char gyis lhag par gnod mi 'gyur/ / rgyun chags brtson pa ma btang bar/ / bags kyis bsgrub na ci yang 'grub/ / chu bo dal gyis 'bab pa yis/ / yangs pa'i sa chen bskor nas 'gro / bya ba chen po yun gyis sgrub/ / ngang thung 'bad pas mthar mi phyin/ / klung chen dal yang ring 'gro la/ / rba rlabs drag kyang cher mi 'gro / bya ba nyams kyis mi lcogs na/ /gzhan gyis rbad kyang byar mi rung / / rkyal mi shes na gzhan dag gis/ /bskul yang chu nang cig phyir mchong / / chu bo thun mong mchod yon te/ / nyi zla thun mong sgon me gsal/ / dam pa thun mong gtsug rgyan dang / dam chos thun mong bdud rtsi yin/ / dar chen gru gzings rgya mtsho'i rgyan/ / sprin bral zla ba nam mkha'i rgyan/ / mkhas pa'i skye bo bstan pa'i rgyan/ / ru 'dren dpa' bo dpung gi rgyan/ / ya rabs mdzangs spyod dpon dang 'bangs/ /phan tshun legs tshogs gong du spel/ / rgya mtsho che dang chu bo rnams/ / res mos tshul gyis grogs su 'byung / / rje bo ngan dang g.yog ngan pa/ / gnyis gas gnyi ga rgud byed de/ / rdza gsar nang du chu blugs na/ / gnyis ka chud zos brlag par 'gyur/ / shes rlom dbang can mang ba yi/ / yul khams 'dun gros 'jig 'gyur te/ / g.yas g.yon kun nas chu 'bur ba'i/ / sa la mkhar khyim brtan mi srid/ / rje 'bangs mthun na dgra sde yis/ / thub dka' so sor gyes na min/ / rta yis brgal dka'i chu bo yang / / mang du gyes na lug kyang bgrod/ / chos ldan rgyal pos khral bsdus kyang / / de nyid kyis ni 'bangs rnams skyong / / sprin chen rgya mtsho'i chu drangs te/ / dal gyi 'chabs pas 'dzin ma skyong / / rgyal ngan 'bangs kyi zas nor kun/ /254

༄/ /chu'ibastanabacogaphrogs kyang da dung ltog cing bkren/ / rgod ma kha yis rgya mtsho'i chu/ /'thungs kyin rtag tu 'bar dang mtshungs / / gtso bo ngan pa rtag bkur yang / / gsug dang bral ba tsam gyis sdang / / chu bo nyin zhag mang bskol kyang / / me dang bral ba'i mod la grang / / khengs dregs gdug tsub che ba yi/ /dpon la su yang brten mi spro/ / shin tu 'khrugs pa'i rba klong du/ /nya la sogs kyang sdod mi byed/ / brtse zhing phan gdags nus pa der/ / skye bo thams cad ngang gis 'du/ / yid bzhin gye ni rgya mtsho'i ngogs/ / 'gro ba kun gyis sten par byed/ / che mtho bsten pas dpal 'thob kyang / / de las lhag pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung / / rgya mtsho rin chen 'byung gnas de/ / gdug can na kra'i grong yang yin/ / rgyus med mi la gsar 'grogs kyis/ / yid brtanabyed pa nyams pa'i rgyu/ / rgyal sras ngang ba'i sde dpon yang / / mtsho gsar bsten pas snyi yis zin/ / rna ba srab pa'i mdza' gcug de/ / ring min dbyen gyis so sor gtong / / chu dang 'o ma ro gcig tu/ / 'dres pa ngang ba'i mchu yis 'byed/ / mkhas pas bden rdzun brtags nas byed/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes su rgyug / chu nang cal gyi sgra bsgrags pas/ / gcan gzan ri dwags phal cher bros/ / 'grogs na legs spyod 'phel 'grib las/ / dge dang sdig pa'i grogs 'gyur te/ / dwangs bsil 'dra yang phan gnod las/ / sman gyi chu dang dug chur 'jog / sdig grogs g.yem ma'i 'dzum dkar las/ / sha tsha'i gdug rtsub khro gnyer bzang / / than khyer sprin gye mdog dkar yang / / chu ldan sprin nag zhing ba'i gsos/ / blo ldan rang bzhin bzang po de/ / mchog dman bar ma kun gyis bsten/ / 'jug ngogs bde ba'i dzing bu la/ / skye bo thams cad dga' bzhin 'jug /khengs dregs spyod pa rtsing ba la/ / don med rnams kyang dgra ru ldang / /255

༄/ /yo ca bayo ཿ lo gsung 'bum/rgyag cing 'phyang ba'i gago ma/ / dza hū khros pas hub kyis btung / / nyam chung steng du dpa' thal na/ / nyam nga'i g.yang du ltung 'gyur te/ / chu la rkyal gyis dregs pa'i nya/ / skam la yar na 'chi bar 'gyur/ / rigs ngan cung zad 'byor na yang / / rgyal po lta bu'i khengs dregs 'dzin/ / gcong rong dog mo'i chu bran de/ / 'ur sgra rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'dra/ / yangs pa'i rgyal khams ma mthong ba/ / sa mtha'i blun po rang mthong che/ / khron pa'i chu la 'gying ba yi/ / rus sbal rgya mtsho'i gtam gyis shi/ / tha shal rnams ni mgu sla zhing / / mgu ba'i mod la khrel yang sla/ / phu thag thung ba'i chu bran de/ / brubs dang bri ba yud tsam yin/ / ma rabs gces par bskyangs na yang / / drin du mi tshor 'khrug par byed/ / bsil ba'i chu yis bran na yang / / rdo zhun lhag par khol zhing tsha/ / dam pa rnams la gnod byas kyang / / khro med bzod pas bde bar gnas/ / btso yi sngags kyis btab pa'i chu/ / khol bzhin pa yis bran kyang bsil/ / khrel med rnams la phan btags kyang / / bya ba zin na brjed par 'gyur/ / chu bo'i pha rol brgal ba na/ / gru gzings ltos pa med par 'dor/ / mi ngan re re'i byed pas kyang / / yul khams chen po phung bar byed/ / drang srong gdug pa mchongs pa yis/ / si ta tshal brgyar gyes zhes grags/ / dmu rgod skye bos sun phyungs rnams/ / dam pa la yang yid mi ches/ / chu zlas bslus byas ngang ba yis/ / nyin mo'ang pad rtsa za mi byed/ / skye bo ngan pa bcos na yang / /rkyen dang phrad tshe rang mtshang ston/ / chu klung 'ol kha bsgyur ba de/ / brubs tshe sngar gye lam du 'gro/ / dam pa mtho dman 'byor rgud sogs/ / cis kyang rang bzhin mi 'gyur te/ / chu bo bsil lam tsha na yang / / rlan gyi rang bzhin ga la 'dor/ / mi bsrun skye bo gdams pa las/ / nan tur las kyis 256

༄/ /tshibastokhacogagadul bar sla/ / gos kyi dri ma 'khyud pa la/ / gtsang ma'i chu las 'gyur byed bzang / / lus can nang gi skyon yon rnams/ / phyi rol spyod pas mtshon nus te/ / chu skyar ldang bas chu bo dang / du ba las ni mer shes bzhin/ /gzhan gyi skyon yon mthong sla yang / / rang gi spyod tshul mthong par dka'/ /mtsho nang nam mkha'i zla skar kun/ / gsal yang rang gi gting mi mthong / /bsam ngan g.yo sgyu'i bya ba ni/ / lam rgyug 'drang yang phugs su 'phung / /chu klung gya gyur bgrod pa yang / / bab kyis thur nas thur du 'gro / rigs rgyud zad 'dod bu ngan skye/ / bsod nams zad 'dod bsam ngan 'char/ / rang nyid brlag 'dod rig pa rgod/ / chu mig skam 'dod snyig ma mang / / blun pos ngal brgyas bsgrubs na yang / grags pa blo ldan gzhan gyis 'khyer/ / ri las skyes pa'i padma yang / / bskyed pa'i grags pa chu yis 'thob/ /lung rtogs yon tan mi ldan yang / / dam par sgrogs pas skye bo bslu/ / sbrang char bcud dang bral ba yi/ / than khyer sprin gyi 'brug sgra bzhin/ / snyigs dus rang byung kun mkhyen rnams/ / sbyangs tshe phal pa las kyang rtul/ / rang byung chu tshan sngar tsha yang / / bskol na chu grang rjes su khol/ / dred po kha yis chos bshad mkhan/ / shes rgyud gdol pa las kyang thu/ / dgun dus rlangs pa na bun bzhin/ / 'thibs pa'i klong de lhag par grang / / dam pa'i skye bo nyam thag kyang / / chos dang 'gal ba'i las mi byed/ / char sdod byi'u skom na yang / / sa la 'bab ba'i chu mi 'thung / /dge sbyor brtson par 'dod pa dang / / log pa'i 'tsho ba sgrub pa 'gal/ /me tog skyed par 'dod pa yis/ / chu tshan blugs na phan 'gyur ram/ / chen po re zhig rgud na yang / / slad nas gzi byen rgyas par 'gyur/ / 'khyag pa'i spubs su chud pa'i mtsho/ / so ga rim gyis 'phyur nas 'ong / / blo dang 257

༄/ /ca ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/rtsol ba zhan pa'i mis/ / phun tshogs thob kyang mod la 'grib/ / rdzing chung ltag chu chad pa de/ / gang yang myur du skam par 'gyur/ / nor med 'phyor dang kha zhim 'dod/ / gzhung lugs ma sbyangs mkhas khur 'dzin/ / chu rkyal mi shes mtsho brgal ba/ / bsam bzhin rang sdug nyos pa yin/ / mnga' thang blo rgya skyed ches pas/ / bsod nams tshad las 'gong mi rung / / mtsho chung rang gi khron pa yi/ / tshad las rgyas na bo bar 'gyur/ / don chen thog tu ma babs pa'i/ / dus nas thabs dang rim gro bya/ / chu lon sngar nas ma brtsigs na/ / brubs nas 'ol kha bsgyur ba dka'/ / don med las la phong btsugs nas/ / rang nyid nyams byed dpa' bo min/ / chu yi nang gi gzugs brnyan la/ / mchongs pas seng ge shi dang 'dra/ / dgra bo 'dul bar 'dod na yang / / spyod tshul dal zhing 'jam par bya/ / chu skyar 'jab cing 'gro ba yis/ / nya la sogs pa 'dzin la ltos/ / gzhan phyogs 'byor ba la sdang bas/ / rang gi bsod nams nyams par zad/ / chu klung drag por mchongs pa na/ / bdag nyid 'chi yi der mi gnod/ / de bas dgra las rgyal 'dod na/ / yon tan sgrub la 'bad par bya/ / chu bo che la rgal ba'i thabs/ / thang nas gru gzings 'chos pa yin/ / rang las bsod nams ma nyams na/ / dgra bo kho nas mi thub ste/ / chu mig rang nyid ma skam par/ /sa yis mnan kyang 'gog mi nus/ / dbul phyugs dar rgud mtho dman kun/ / sngon sbyang las kyi go rim ste/ / chu yi dkyil 'khor bsrubs pa las/ / ri gling khor yug rim bar chags/ / mkhas pa phal cher dbul 'gyur la/ / blun po'i skye bo nor gyes phyugs/ / rnyog ma can gyi chu bo la/ /sbal lcong 'bu srin lhag par mang / / brgya yi nang nas dpa' bo dang / /stong gi nang nas mkhas pa ste/ / ma dros mtsho las chu gser dang / / rgya mtsho 258

༄/ /spyobastadabacogache las nor bu 'byung / / blo dang mi ldan skye bo yis/ / 'byor ba ṅged kyang spyod mi shes/ / khyi ni skom yang chu klung la/ / hub kyis mi 'thung lngag par byed/ / rang gzhan su la mi phan pa'i/ / nor de med pa nyid dang mtshungs/ / chu med sa gzhi rgya che yang / / mya ngam thang zhes kun gyis 'dor/ / longs spyod spel bar 'dod pas kyang / / cung zad gtong tshul shes dgos te/ / khron chu bcus na 'phel 'gyur zhing / / bzhag na steg mas skam par 'gyur/ / blun rmongs 'byor pa rgya che yang / / sdug bsngal rgyu las ma 'das te/ / gser ri'i bar gyi rol mtsho rnams/ / rtag tu mun pa'i smag gis non/ / 'byor ldan bsod nams gsog dgos te/ / bsod nams nyams na rgud pa sla/ / ljon shing yal ga rgya che yang / / chu dang bral na skam par 'gyur/ / bsod nams mthu dang dge ba'i blo/ / phan tshun rgyur gyur skal ba bzang / / chu yis char dang char gyis chu/ / rgyas byed res mos grogs su 'gyur/ / kha bshad mang ngam nyung yang rung / / dgos don lag tu blangs na go / chu zheng che chung ci 'dra yang / / zab dang mi zab brgal na shes/ / legs byas srol 'byed mkhas pa ste/ / de yi rjes su 'jug pa sla/ / cang shes rta yis rab btsal ba'i/ / phyi bzhin khyi yang 'brang bar byed/ / mkhas pa kun la snyoms ldan zhing / / phyogs re'i mig can chags sdang che/ / bum pa gang ba bkur bar sla/ / phyed tsam gang ba yo 'khyol mang / / bsam tshad kha ru 'don pa der/ / gtad so med ces kun gyi brnyas/ / shag shag 'bab ba'i chu bo la/ / byis pa rnams kyang rgal bar byed/ / kha nyung bzhin 'dzum gnad phig pa/ / de la kun gyis bag zon byed/ / sgra med mer gyis 'gro ba yi/ / chu klung gting mtha' dpog par dka'/ / chu la ri mor bris pa bzhin/ / sdig sems med la 'dor bya 259

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i 0ryā khrung 'bum/zhing / / dge ba'i dam bca' rdo ba yi/ / ri mo bzhin du brtan par bya/ /bsam pa bzang na 'jig rten gyi/ / bya ba kun kyang chos su 'gro / zo chun la brten 'obs kyi chu/ / shin tu mtho ba'i ri rtser 'gro / gtso bor las 'bras dkon mchog la/ / blo phug gtad na ci bsam 'grub/ / lha yi rgyal pos char phab na/ / lo tog phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ / 'jig rten tshangs pa'i ral klong du/ / 'khyams pa'i sarga mthar son te/ / sgrib gnyis dri ma 'khrud pa'i phyir/ / dam pa'i chos kyi lam du 'dren/ / chu rigs bdun las mchog gyur ba'i/ / chu mgo gangs la thug pa bzhin/ / chos kyang 'khrul bral ma nor ba/ / rgyal ba'i bka' las 'byung ba dgos/ / de nas zab rgyas nyams len gyi/ / lam gsum rim par 'bab pa yi/ / gdams ngag tshang la ma nor ba/ / skal bzang rnam sad mchod yin/ / 'on kyang dus kyis cher snyegs tshe/ / 'jam dbyangs bla mas gsal mdzad de/ / rgya mtshor byings pa'i rig byed bzhi/ / nya yi gzugs kyis bton pa bzhin/ / 'di 'dra'i bstan dang mjal bzhin du/ / ltar snang lam la su zhig 'jug / lha yi chu bo gaṅgā'i rtsar/ / ba tsha'i khron pa su zhig rko/ / blo chung skal dman zab zab kyi/ / grags pas bsrus nas log par 'gro / smig rgyu chu ru 'khrul ba yi/ / ri dwags don med sdug bsngal myong / / chos kyi lam du 'jug pa la/ / dang por dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ / rgya mtshor bgrod 'dod bya ba'i mgo / ded dpon mkhas pa tshol ba yin/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ / dge legs rtsa ba bla ma ste/ / 'dzam gling rtsi shing lo 'bras kun/ / ma dros mtshor gnas klu yi drin/ / nga rgyal spangs te zhi dul gyis/ / dam chos snod du rung bar bya/ / chu bo sgang du mi gnas par/ /dma' ba'i gshong du 'khyil bar 'gyur/ / chos kun gcig car mi shes 260

༄/ /chu'ibastanabacogakyang / / ci tsam shes bzhin don du 'gyur/ / chu klung rdzogs par ma 'thungs kyang / ci tsam btung bas skom pa sel/ / thos mang nyams su ma blangs na/ / rang gi rgyud la mi phan te/ / chu nang lo brgyar gnas pa yi/ / rdo ba'i rang bzhin skam bor gnas/ / stong rkyal goms pa'i rim pa yis/ / rtag 'ju res 'ju mi 'ju ltar/ / thos bsam sgom pa sgra spyi la/ / brten pa'i tshul yang gsum du gsungs/ / mi yi gru gzings rnyed dus 'dir/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i ba dan la/ / brten nas srid mtsho brgal bya yi/ / gru 'di phyi nas rnyed par dka'/ / rigs drug skye sgo mtha' yas kyang / / dal brgyad tshang ba shin tu dkon/ / chu bo grangs med 'bab na yang / / yan lag brgyad ldan re re tsam/ / skyes pa'i skad cig de nyid nas/ / mi sdod 'chi bdag khar phyogs te/ / chu klung skad cig re re zhing / / phyir mi ldog par rgya mtshor 'gro / mi rtag srin pos bzung bzhin du/ / sos bder sdod pa ga la rigs/ / chu srin mche ba'i phrag gnas la/ / bde ba'i go skabs nam yang med/ / bsgrub kyang pha mthar phyin med pa'i/ / 'jig rten bya ba btsan chod bya/ / chu gnyer gcig rjes gcig non de/ / ci tsam bdas kyang zin dus med/ / blo rig stobs dang rtsal che yang / / dus kyi pho nya dbang med 'ching / / chu chen rlabs kyi gar mkhan ma/ / dgun dus 'khyag pa'i sbubs su tshud/ / sgo gsum mi dge'i spyod tshul 'dis/ / phyi ma'i skye ba ngan 'gror nges/ / ri bo'i zom nas 'bab pa'i chu/ / g.yang sa brgyud mar brdab cing 'phyo/ / de nas lo grangs bye ba brgyar/ / bsregs shing 'tsheng kyang 'chi mi nus/ / rdo sol ri la char gyi rgyun/ / babs pa bskal pa'i bar du khol/ /'jigs chen de las skyob pa'i skyabs/ / bslu med dkon mchog gsum las med/ / chu bo'i rgyun gyis khyer ba de/ / sgol byed mnyan pa kho nar nges/ /261

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mchog gsum byin rlabs mtha' yas kyang / / dad pa med na ji ltar skyob/ /rgya mtsho che yang char sdod kyi/ / bye'u'i skom pa sel mi nus/ / 'khor ba'i 'dam las ma brgal ba'i/ / 'jig rten pa la brten mi bya/ / chus khyer chu yis khyer ba la/ / 'jus na gnyis ka bying bar 'bar 'gyur/ / mchog gsum bsten na de yi khrims/ / las 'bras blang dor 'bad pa gces/ /ded dpon bsten kyang gru gzings su/ / mi sdod de nyid ji ltar sgol/ / snod bcud bde sdug snang ba kun/ / 'khrul med sngon bsags las las 'byung / /chu phor gang yang 'gro ba bzhir/ / snang tshul tha dad 'byung bar gsungs/ / dge dang mi dge chung ngu nas/ / bsags pas shes rgyud gang 'gyur te/ / char gyi thigs pa bsags pas kyang / / mtha' klas chu yi dkyil 'khor chags/ / gnas skabs dge ba ltar snang yang / / bsngo dang 'dun pas bslad pa mang / / mchog tu mngar ba gaṅgā'i chu/ / rgya mtshor 'dres na kha bar 'gyur/ / rmongs pa'i mun nag gis ldongs shing / / las kyi zhags pas bcings pa rnams/ / srid pa'i klung gis rab drangs te/ / mi bzad skye ba'i rgya mtshor 'gro / 'dod pa lan tsha'i chu bo ni/ / ci tsam spyad kyang mi ngoms pas/ / chu mtsho 'khyag pa'i ngang ba ltar/ / srid las nges 'byung skyo shas skyed/ / las nyon na kras yongs gang ba/ / sdug bsngal 'khor ba rgya mtsho las/ / sgrol byed bslab gsum gru bo che/ / bzung nas thar ba'i gling du gshegs/ / khyad par khas blangs tshul khrims ni/ / nyes ltung dri mas ma sbags pa/ / rgya mtsho ro dang mi 'grogs ltar/ / rtag tu dran shes brtan pos srungs/ / 'on kyang ma rgan sems can rnams/ / dor nas rang don byar mi 'os/ / rgya mtsho'i gling du gnyen bshes kun/ / 'bor ba ded dpon spyod tshul min/ / mtshor gnas g.yo dang mi bden pa'i/ / khyad par gsum ldan 262

༄/ /chu'ibastanabacogachu zla lta'i/ / 'gro la snying rje rnam gsum gyis/ / zeg chen lam gye srog rtsa tshugs/ / byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i dge / mi zad byang chen rgyur 'gro ste/ / 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu ma dros mtshor/ / lhung bas gser sbyangs khams su 'gyur/ / rgyal sras spyod pa mtha' klas kyang / / pha rol phyin pa drug tu 'du/ / ri sul la lung chu bo brgya/ / zam 'og gcig tu 'dril ba bzhin/ / rgyal sras rnams ni bdog pa kun/ / 'bras bcas gtong ste sbyin pa'i mchog / char gyes rtsa bcud lo tog kun/ / bskyangs kyang lan dang re ba med/ / rnam dag khrims kyis nyes ltung gi / rnyog pa ma lus drungs 'byin te/ / ke ta ka 'bras bye ma yis/ / chu bo rnyog ma dwangs par byed/ /dge tshogs ma lus sreg byed pa'i/ / khong khro'i dgra 'joms bzod pa ste/ /kun za 'bar ba'i me lce ni/ / gsod byed gnyen po chu yin no/ / rtag gus brtson pa ma btang na/ / mi 'grub bya ba ci yang med/ / chu thigs rtag tu 'bab pa yis/ / brag gi ri bo 'bigs la ltos/ / bying rgod skyon bral ting nge 'dzin/ / gsal bar yon tan thams cad 'char/ / beeḍūr me long phyis 'dra ba'i/ / dwangs mtshor gzugs brnyan ci yang gsal/ / dngos kun stong par dmigs pa yis/ / 'khor ba'i gdung ba kun sel te/ / chu klung mtha' dag a gasdus/ / hub kyis gzhal pas bdud rtsir 'gyur/ / klu sgrub blo mtsho rgya che bas/ / dngos por smra rnams spobs pa phrogs/ / rnam gnag gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i/ / rgya mtshos byis pa skrag par byed/ / zab mo'i de nyid 'byed pa la/ / thog mar dgag bya nges dgos te/ / rgya mtshor nor bu len pa la/ / 'jigs pa gar yod shes pa gces/ / gdags gzhi phung sogs 'dus pa la/ / nga 'o snyam du 'khrul ba ste/ / klung chen gdod nas brubs 'dra yang / / chu phran du ma 'dus pa yin/ / btags don rigs pas 263

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i 0sa gsung 4ma/dpyad pa na/ / ngo bos grub pa 'ga' med de/ / chu klung yur ba brgyar drangs pa'i/ / shul na zil ba tsam yang med/ / ston pas ji snyed bka' stsal pa/ / stong dang rten 'byung 'dir 'jug ste/ / sa steng chu bo ma lus pa/ /rgya mtsho chen por gzhol zhing 'bab/ / rang rgyud smin pa'i rgyal sras kyis/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis gdul bya skyong / / rgya mtshor 'jug myong ded dpon gyis/ / gzhan yang khrid nas nor la sbyor/ / rgyu yi theg pa'i lam ring yang / / gsang sngags thabs kyis myur du bgrod/ / thang du 'dren dka'i gru bo che/ / rgya mtshor zhugs na yud kyis 'gro / rdo rje can gyis legs gsungs pa'i/ / gsang sngags nus pa bsam mi khyab/ / gdung ba ma zhes bos pas kyang / / lha yi chu bo 'gug par byed/ / zung 'jug gdengs can bdag po'i gnas/ / rdo rje theg pa rgya mtsho che'i/ / 'jug ngogs bde ba'i 'bab stegs ni/ / dbang bzhi'i rin chen them skas yin/ / 'on kyang dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi/ / gzhi rten dam tshig sdom pa ste/ / rtsa ba chu mtsho skam gyur na/ / rlabs kyi 'phreng ba gang las 'byung / / de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / 'dod la spyod kyang zhen pa med/ / nya ni chu gting zab mo na/ / 'gyu yang chu yis 'tshub mi 'gyur/ / chags sogs nyon mongs nyes pa rnams/ / nyon mongs lam byed nyid kyis 'joms/ / rna bar chu son chus 'byin zhing / / mes tshigs me yis gdungs bas zhi/ / bskyed rim phra rags rnal 'byor gyis/ / skye shi bar do gsum sbyong ste/ / skal ldan shing rta'i mchod yon gyis/ / dug can dri ma 'khrud pa bzhin/ / dga' bzhi'i lhan skyes bde ba ches/ / stong bzhi'i yi shes rgyas 'gyur te/ / chu bo rnam bzhi'i rgyun 'bab pas/ / rta gdong me chen 'bar bar 'gyur/ / phra ba gnyug ma'i rlung sems las/ / sgyu ma lta bu'i skur bzhengs pa/ / dwangs pa'i chu las chu bur 2yo

༄/ /chu'ibastanabacogadang / / dag pa'i mkha' las chu 'dzin bzhin/ / rtswa rtse'i zil ba re rer yang / / zla ba'i gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin/ / dpe yi rim pa re res kyang / / 'khor 'das chos kun mtshon par nus/ / 'jig rten ya rabs spyod pa nas/ / mdo sngags lam gyi rim pa'i bar/ / dper bya gcig gis mtshon pa 'di/ / legs bshad 'phrul gyi rgya mtsho yin/ / longs spyod 'khor lo'i chu gter na/ / dbyangs ldan ngang mo rnam rol pa/ / de yi kha las legs bshad kyi/ / rba rlabs 'khri shing ci yang g.yo/ / gang yang bdag blo'i chu gter las 'khrungs legs bshad gsar ba'i zla ba ni/ / 'jig rten rmongs pa'i mun 'phrog snying gi gdung sel bsil ba'i reg pa can/ / de yi dge ba sa gsum rnam dkar 'od kyi gos bzang 'dzin pa des/ / skye dgu'i legs byas blo dang lhan cig bstan pa'i chu gter rgyas gyur cig / ces legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs phreng brgya ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni/sngar rang gi rgyud la bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir du rtsom pa'i khul/ / dus tshod la dpag pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung du bgrang rung tsam kha shas bris yod na'ang / shing gi bstan bcos de dar so che zhing / mthong byed mkhan mang du 'ong par snang bas de la 'grel pa zhig kyang byung na legasazhes/ / ba ron su nyid shog nas bsngags 'os yon tan du ma'i rgyan 'phreng 'dzin pa nom chi zhabs drung skal bzang dar rgyas kyis yang yang nan gyis bskul te bri bar brtsam yang / de'i chos kyi sarga lam rim las logs su mi dgos la/gzhan3mas go sla ba 'ba' zhig gtsor 'don dang / dpe'ang yongs grags mkhas blun thams cad la 'char bde ba kho nar sbyar stabs de las gsal du gtong rgyu med pa lta bur snang zhing / phyogs mthun gyi khungs dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi shes rab brgya ba/shes rab sdong bu/ skye bo gsathigs gsum dang / tsa na ka rgyal po'i lugs kyi bstan bcos/ ma su rakṣas byas pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos/ nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa tshigs su bcad pa'i mdzod/ mchog srid kyi tshigs bcad brgya ba/ dri ma med pa'i 265

༄/ /yo ca bayo ཿzla me'i khrung ཿma/dris lan rin po che/re phreng ba/ sa skya'i legs bshad rnams dang / gzhan yang 'phrin yig bslab bya sogs de mthun rnams drangs te bshad na tshig tshogs ches lce bar 'gyur bas/ 'dir ljon shing chu'i khams kyis rgyas par byed pa'i dpe dang mthun par/de nyid du ma tshang ba 'ga' zhig kha bskangs nasacung zad rgyas su btang / der mchog dman dang gtso phal gyi rim pas chos kyi sarga sngon du byas kyang / / 'dir gong nas gong du bgrod pa'i rim pas mjug tu byas te go rim bsdebs pa sogs don 'grel gyi tshul du byasanas/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yege pa ni gtsug lag lta ba'i blo mig can snyikhru ratna ā nantas bgyis pa 'di'ang / skye bo rnams la dge ba'i 'jug ngogs gsal ba'i rgyur gyur cig / sarba kā le the yo bha ba tu/ /266

ra / / bad /sgo ske9pa'eju༄/ / zlos gar gyi bstan bcos yang dag lam du bkri ba'i rol rtsed ces bya ba bzhugs so//༄/ / tshig don spobs pa nges pa'i tshig / so so rig pas 'gro don mdzad/ / thub pa'i dbang po la btud nas/ / rjes mthun rgyu la 'jug par 'os/ / de'ang rgya gar gyi slob dpon pradzā/ bod kyi btsun pa shes rab/sog po'i btsun pa bi lig rgya'i btsun pa cho dpre rnams lhan cig tu tshogs so/ /de nas cho dbre na re/ kying ta yan kri yu wan khru tsi yin tu/ rgya gar chos kyi 'byung khungs yin/ zhing yus shi hwan kyi hu mong ku/ deng sang chos dar sa bod dang sog po gnyis bzang bas/ yin tu tā shi yus tho stel gre tang wun cing gre shu lus te gre shi gri yus shin/ rgya gar bla masa'adi gnyis la chos kyi dri ba gnang ste thugs la gang 'bab blta dgos/pradzā na re/ sarnyispo dam pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar ldatyantaranta tigasum du dge ba zhig yin pas/ / ṣāshubhasbyatin a 'jug spyo yang de dang mthun pa zhig dgos/ btaro guspa shtsa sa tsa sārbhabre yo dzan/shes rab na re/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba zhig yin pas 'jug tshul yang de dang mthun pa zhig dgos gsungs pa shin tu thugs bden/ /bi lig na re/ te dam pa'i chos ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba zhig 267

༄/ /yo ca bstan ཿthonas ga4 ཿma/yin pas/ ge tu nom anu theblun se kulatomata gor ba tur sa'i na mun nu thul/ 'o 'jug tshul yang de dang mthun pa zhig dgos pa ngas kyang go lags/nohu yo so hū the kun lu ke tsonyilatu6 kherigazeki batshu metenem/tsho dbren re/ ban bzang bzang / sras/ shān sās/ kha'i chos kyi mgo nas khyed rnams thugs mthun byung ba rten 'brel bzang cing kyi tshuste la cung shinate ci lus ci kyo/ yān yin kyang da dung dri ba zhib mo mang po gnang ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dag ther byed dgos/ tang tshe kyis pi shus shyang 'un khri steng tuwa co/pradzña na re/ bho(bod dang sog po'i btsun pa gnyis legs par nyon/ shtsamorgo labee bande di su shiḍū / mam nga'i dri ba 'di la lan legs ༷ /༷ ༵rdo bhe~X/smo~X ṭwāṃ~Xṭwāṃkṛtasuprasgottarabremadzārna/ shāthog mar chos kyi rtsa sher rab na re/ chos kyi rtsa ba sems yin/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ byang chub ni chos la rag las/ chos ni sems la rag las zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/bi lig na re/ sed sems la chos kyi rtsa bar 'gro mi 'gro sna tshogs yod pas/khel no mon un tu su na tur 'od hu u lu 'od hu el teb po'i thu la/ chi khyod kyi de bshad pa zhib cha ma thon par 'dug / nu ze re khe le khu nig tha po lag san 'u ke'i/ / er dkon mchog ta la las/ te ni dzwa la 'a cha/ su dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar skyed pa ste/tsug 'u ri ta ya pu hu 'e khe me thu 'e gus khe khu'i pu ked/khe me khu ze ri gu then khi ge zhesasogs dang / da tu ra shi lun 'un tu sun tur sa'i thur 'o ro shi 'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ mu'i/ khe men nom lag san me thu no mon 'un tu su su tsug mun/ zhes gsungs pa ltar chos kyi rtsa ba 268

ra ji/ / 1 mkha 11pa'arobang gdad pa yin/shes rab na re/ khyod kyis zhib cha thon pa byas te/ nas la'ang sa bon rung mi rung sna tshogs yod pas nas myug gi sa bon la nas mi 'jog par/nas las gzhan zhig 'jog rgyu yin nam/bi lig na re/ 'ar nas kyi sa bon la nas las gzhan zhig 'jog rgyu med kyang / pa'i na khu rung gen tur 'ar ba'i 'a cha bu su ni ge ni thal pi hu yu ma 'u ṭwāṃ ༵ rdo ༷ tt+waṃ/nga didi ༵༷ ༷༵ dzādahu sa khe bordog dī miX rshagos mod/ pa'i mun cho dbre na re/ hu nas rul ba dang tshig pas sa bon mi rung ba ngas kyang shes/phru hās kyi tī bu khesalwa hūng / 'u lwa yi ji ji srusayin na'ang nas skya ba ze lcanal nas 'deb dgos/ yun/ māsagro / tu'usran ma/ ku khre/ to so ba sogs 'bru gang 'deb 'dod na'ang sa bon la 'bru rang rang 'deb dgos/ a yus te te ci shus ke shi hūng /shes rab na re/ ngas kyang sems yin tshad chos kyi rtsa bar bzhag pa min/ 'gro ba bzhi'i chos las mi 'da' ba'i sems shig 'jog rgyu yin/khyodakyis zer ba'i dad pa can gyi mtshams kyang de 'dra zhig dgos par rin chen 'phreng ba las gsungs yod/pradzñā na re/ lcayi 〉tasruprahū1sthā1mātāpari grahārbasārbhadriṣākhyed gnyis tshigagi zer lugs ma 'dra ba tsam ma gtogs don la mthun par snang / nga'i yid la 'thad pa byung / ma matsam na yo pa pa bstibhabata/bi leg na re/ tur 'gro ba bzhi'i chosalas mi 'da' tshul sogs dri rgyu 'dug stegen 'od hu'i nom 'a cha 'u lutapa hu yo su ther gu ni 'a su 'u hu pu ked/ khe don gyi rtsa ba blo rtse mthun yong na nges chog reg kun kun tu su 'o yo nu 'u tsu 'ur 269

༄/ /ca thang bam yosgronas khrung ཿma/tso til tu pa su the gu brer po lo mu'i/ tshig gi'u ge srunaspros pa'i mtha' mi chod/sa tshur la 'a ster se gu la'i ke'u lu tha su la mu'i/tshe dbre na re/ cing choyokyi rtsa ba gang yin la/ kyi kyi two tā zhi seng khyed bla ma dang btsun pa rnams mi mthun pa med pa de shin tu legs/ cung nī ya snu te te khi lī shin shān/ cin da dung yang chos 'di rgya che gting zab pas 'phros pa don can mang du gnang dgos/ ze cing triku lung tā shin o shin yun nī snyiyu lwan de phin shulwa/brasnyen re/ chos kyisasmosgyu 'jug sgo gang yin/ pa tār mukha ya kyita/shes rab na re/ chos kyi 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro yin te/ phyi nang gi khyad par yang skyabs 'gro'i steng nas 'jog pa mnyam med jo bo chen po'i dgongs pa yin/ bi lig na re/ nom po yu sha cin ne'i the'in 'o ro hu gru te 'e ze ge la yabu 'u la chos sam bstan pa spyi'i 'jug skyabs 'gro rtsa/ ye khe khu le ge nu ro hu 'e gu theg chen gyi 'jug sgo/ 'u te/ bo dhi sed khel 'e gu se khe sems bskyed/ khu/ thar ni 'in 'o ro hu 'e gu'u te a snyi shig mun khe men pu ku te tung 'al sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang yin par yongs su grags mod/ tar shig san 'a spu tsa/ 'e gun 'di la'ang dpyad rgyu zhig yod de/ tur chu shin ci le khu ne gen pu'i pu le ge / 'i the gel skyabs 'gro las logs su gyur pa'i bstan pa zhig med na 'di de'i sgor 'dzeg ya pu 'ul hu 'a cha ang khi ta po log san sha cin ci ge 'u ke'i pol pa su the gu nu'e gun ten tur thal pi phu yo su 'u ke'i/'i the skyabs 'gro las logs su gyur pa gelo ya bul hu' cha thu sār ni gen mun pol zhig yin na de nang pa'i chos pa su the re tho tho go chos ma yin pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ram/'o thu'i na nom pu su'i na kem pol hu 'u ge'i po yu/tshe dbre na re/ mong sog po'i btsun pas zer ba 'di bden pa 'dra kutā 270

da / /rngo sag 11 shārob che shīsashulwashulwa ze mo zhig 'dug shīs/ cheng mkhar gyi sgo dang mkhar gnyi ga mi gcig pa bzhin cho4kyi sgo dang chosasdin yus chang bī ze yu ye cing yus/ cing gnyi ga'ang sosor yod dgosargyu e yin/ phren i tang ke pe ya chi shin yān yus/shes rab na re/ de khyed gnyi gas ma go bar snang / sgo'ang pho brang gi khongs su 'du dgos pa ma gtogs/ de pho brang las logs su yod/ pho brang gi rtsig pa'ang pho brang las logs su yod/ / ka ba gdung ma sogs kyang pho brang las logs su yod na de tsho bsal shul nas pho brang zhig ston rgyu yod dgos kyang de ston rgyu mi rnyed/ de thams cad tshogs tsam la pho brang zhes phar btags pa tsam zhig yin/ de bzhin du skyabs 'gro'ang bstan pa la slob pa'i thog ma nas 'jug pa yin pas na sgo dang / zhugs nas nyams su len rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas na gzhung shing sogs su btags pa ma gtogs/bstan pa las logs su gyur pa'i de'i 'jug sgo zhig 'jog mi dgos/pradzñan re/ tad)de shin tu legs sems bskyed theg chen gye 'jug sgor bshad kyang / satsisasprudomahāyunasrubadnghamukhebhāṣitabyu/ ma theg chen gyi lam thams cad sems bskyed kyi yan lag tu 'du dgos/ hāyānasrusazepazeshtsasto dasruparikaresemabāyapreyodzarna/ ma gsang sngags kyi 'jug ༷ ༵༷༵ byeXtt+waṃdīṭwāṃ/dzhai~XshāṭwāṃṭwāṃkaXdī/dī bhe ngaka ༵dī 'abheṭwāṃ /༵ ༷ ṭwāṃ/ par/ kārnye/ binyun byed kyi rgyu 〉tsasru karakraze / kṛte grol byed kyi lam/muktasrumārga / mogrol ba 'brasabu ste sngags kyi lam 'bras thamasacad dbang gi ༷bhe~Xmālja na'/dus pa yin/ tsanabrinyitamachusrusazomārgadharmyaḥṣekasrubra ghabi lig na re/ sha bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro yin pa/cin nu 'o ro hu 271

༄/ /yo ca bayo ཿ sgo ga lam/'e gu'u te 'i khyod bden pa'i dbang du byas kyang de tsam gyis go mi chod/ thegal ya prul hu mun ne chi'u nen pol gong 'u'i med pe chu ze rethe tu'i khe rnar tho 'o tsha cu 'u lu bo lo mu'i/ 'i skyabs sa'agro ba'i rgyu the gel ya pu'ul hu shil tha gan 'i the gel ya pu'ul san khem ci skyabs su song ba'i tshad yi/ 'i the ge la ya pūl hu'i mun chi skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo/ nar/ the re de 'ang thun mong ba'i dbang du byas na yon tan shes pa/ chu ye rung khe'i na 'er khe bar 'u'i led bre su 'er te mi me tu khu/ 'i khyad par shes pa/ la ga li me tu khu/ 'a man khas len pa/ 'batu/bu gzhan du mi smra ba bzhi dang / sud thur 'u lu 'u gu le khu tur pe khi gīd/ ye rung khi'i pu su ho tho la turathun mong ma yin pa kun/ 'od hu'i na 'i 'o no rtogs pa'i khyad par/ lun 'i la gāl/ sur zil gnon gye khyad par bzhi/ 'e grer ta ru hu'i 'i lāl gāl tur pe/ 'ithe geskyabs susong ba'i phan yon sogs/ la ya pu gru lug san thu sa ler tem the legs par bshad dgos/ ri gu ze ni sa'i thur nom la hu khe reg ze'i/shes rab na re/ khyod kyis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu/ skyabs su song ba'i tshad/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo de'ang thun mong ba'i dbang du byas na yon tan shes pa/ khyad par shes pa/ khas len pa/ gzhan du mi smra ba bzhi dang / thun mong ma yin pa kun tu 'gro ba'i khyad par/ khas len pa'i khyad par/ rtogs pa'i khyad par/ zil gnon gyi khyad par bzhi/ skyabs su song ba'i phan yon sogs gang yin zhes dris pa de rgya che mdog kha po 'dug /yin kyang dri rgyu'i gtso bo lus snang / rang cag thams cad skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa yang yang khas blangs yod pa sha stag yin dus/ nges par rtsad gcod rgyu yin na kha nang du bskor te skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya gtso bor 'dri dgos/skyabs 'gro'i khongs 'dir gsung rab thams cad 'du bas/ slar 'phros pa 272

ra khye/ /rto brka (1 ma/rdozug b.rim bzhin byas chog /pradzñā na re/ dharmachos kyi gnas lugs gang yin rig pa phra mos dpyod la lan thob/ sruprakṛteyastobatabadushoshi)naparīlaṇaparihār〉sta/bi lig na re/ no chos kyi gnas lugs ni zab mo stong ba nyid yin/ mon a hu yo su 'a nu kun ho gro son chi nar mun/ ze de las gzhan du 'da' sa med pas chos kyi phyag rgya zer ba yin lags/ gu dī che pu sud thur ta pa hu 'o ron 'u gī thu la no mon mu tā khe me khu mun pu lu ge / shes rab na re/ gnas lugs stong ba nyid ces theg chen gyi grub mtha' smra ba thams cad zer yang stong nyid kyi 'jog mtshams mi 'dra/ khyod kyis ci 'dra zhig la bsam nas smras pa yin/pradzā na re/ 0stong nyid legs par go ba la dgag bya ngos zin dgos/rnyoshun+yatiruskyotatasabremadzān/ta de shes na de bkag pa'i stong pa shes sla/dzñalenatārshaṇatusrumakarashun+yas/ yuyi khyed gnyis dgag bya ji lta bu zhig 'gog dgos par 'dod pa yin/ rusatakismithasanagedhapremardzu maban/bi lig na re/ ha dgag bya phyi don bkag pa'i gag kheg stong nyid sems tsam pasa'adod pa lta bus go mi ra/ sen ho go son chi nar seng hi lun ze tu'i khen thu brer tha gā lag san me thu brer 'u lu tho gā cha mu'i/ thub dbu ma pa'i lugs 'dir dgag bya bden grub 'gog dgos/ 'u celathen nu 'e ne yo son tur ha gag ta hun 'u nen shigapu thug sen ne ha gā phu khe reg ze'i/ thob chi lan mdor bsdus na chos gang la'ang rnam rtog gis phar btags pa tsam zhig min pa kho rangagi ngos nas grub rgyu med pa yin/ hu ri yab su nom 'a lin tur chu bīn 'dahag 'e sder chi nag shi ne re'i tug sen the tu'i ni ge nī chi pu su ze re'u pu run tha lwa cha pu thug sen 'u kyi mun/273

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung ཿma/shes rab na re/ thag ring nas mi zhig dang tho yor zhig gshibs yod pa la mi gnyis 'dug bsam pa'i tshe/ tho yor gyi ngos nas mi ma grub pas rnam rtog gis phar btags pa tsam yin mod/ mi de'i ngos nas kyang mir grub pa med pas phar btags tsam yin nam/bi lig na re/ ho lo ga car 'e che ne ge thag ring nas mi zhig na khu mun ki ged ni dang tho yor zhig gshibs yod pa la mi gnyis 'dug bsam pa'i tshe/ gon ma zur lu ge ham thu bo'i tur ho yar khu mun po'i khe shrīn sa nag san chag tha/ma rūr ru'itho yor gyi ngos nas mi ma grub pas rnam rtog gis phar btags pa tsam yin mod/ na cug 'e che khu mun 'e se pu thug sen thu la thi'i 'dahag sder chi nag shi ne red tug sen the dus mun 'a mo'i/ khu mi de'i ngos nasakyang munathe gu ni cug 'e chi hphu khu mir grub pa med payophar btags tsam yin/ mun tur gu thug sen 'u ge thu la chi nag shi ne red tug sen the dus mun/ ze re ho yara'u perun cug 'e che khu mun tur bu thug sen 'e se bu thun nu yil gal po'i pu ge su ho tho lu 'u ge li che the'i yi la gal pagu bu'i de gnyis rang ngos nas mir grub ma grub kyi khyad byung na dngos smra ba dang khyad ci yod/pradzñā na re/ sade gnyis don dam par ram rang gi ngo bos grub ma grub kyis khyad par med kyang / dī b.ramazehaswālhabenasādhanasādhasrunasnyebaci/byushāhar risādhanasādhanaratha snyad du mir grub ma grub ma'i bya ba byed nus mi nus kyi khyad yod pas tha snyad kyi 'jog mtshams 'di go dka'/rasrukartakarashaklen klasrubhakṣabhastenabyubaharasamahitasāyamirdadzñābarlusta/ sa de gnyis ka yid ngor 'gal med grogs su song ba zhig dītamanatasanabirudharmastutake byung na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug rnyed pa yin pas gta sā hartadzayasrusnyimayapasgrontal byenamango mtshar che/ hāshasmoṇi/274

ra / /rngo sag kri pa'a'adzabartsa gatshe dbre nare/ tshe de go ba dka' mo 'dug zus nan ming / stel yun chi yān shingathan kyang tshig tsam rna bsathosana'ang gser dngul srang khri tsho rnyed pa las don chen po yo4pa4kyang don thog tu 'bab dka'/ hulwalwan gyin kung rte zhin tā bka' drin che/shes rab na re/ 'di go dka' bas ming sna tshogs btags/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ ji srid mig ldan skye bos ma dpyad pa/ /de srid dmus long brgya yis rab dpyad kyang / /glang chen gzugs la log pa'i tha snyad brgya/ / kun nas 'dogs pa'i mu cor 'phel ba tsam/ /zhes gsungs la/ de nyid kyis stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed na'ang de 'dra zhig gsungs yod/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pas/ a ma thal dkar gyi glang chen gzugs la/ gsungs pa'ang 'di tsho dang sgo bstun nas gsungs pa red/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis kyang / dmus long glang chen zhib phyags bzhin/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel thams cad na dpe 'di yang yang gsung 'dug /bi lig na re/ 'e ne 'u le ge dpe 'di'i khungs rgyas pa theg bsdus na yod/rīn 'og tel ke reng gu'i 'anu hu ri yang gu'i khu le gen tur bu'i/ 'e gu ni tsa'adi glang po che shed che ba dper byas pa la 'brel ci yang med/gā nu ye khe khu tshu nu 'u le ger len 'u'i le tug sen tur pa ril tu la gā yu 'u chi 'u ge/ tur gzugs che song ba mig can gyiyobaltas tsam na4su ye khe thu la ni tu then brer 'u tseg sen the tu'i 'e che tho lo mgo mjug tshang ma mthong go'i se gu li pu rin 'u tsen chi ta bachu thub kyang pa la'i dmus long gis lag myong byas na so hor ster gar 'e ster them thur khe len 'u'i led rpā su khi tshod mi zin pas ming sna tshogs 'dogs pa red/ rī gi me tel 'u ke'i 'el teb ne re ha ta mu'i/ ye khe shing rta chen po tshos ther ke nu 275

ra / /gung thang bstan pa'itshoname'i gsung 'bum/ji rim ne keg dpe spyor tshul 'di tsam go ba'ang gzhung chen mo rnams kyi rgyus yod dgos/ ched rpār 'u le ger pa ri tu 'ul san yo su 'e ne the tu'i gi me te khu'i tur hphuye khe gol no goti su tu lun ta sa hu khe reg the'i/ ler the thu zad sha ci nu gar hu 'in 'og khe meb sngon bod bstan pa'i 'byung khungs zer yang / chu/'e tu ge ma na gār gol yo su pu gu te tur ta sug san khi gedadeng sang gzhung lugs thams cad la rgyusayod pa / a dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun yod pa nga tsho sog po bzang bar 'dug snyi shig 'e shi u ba de sha nu 'ur gul ci lel bu'i 'a nu ma na'i mosgol sa'in pe'i nam/pradzñā na re/ shāsabastan pa'i 'byung khungs dang yul dbus zer ba de nged rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul yin/ nasrubhutabastaḥdzanabadamagyo〈butamamatārlubartasrudzanabadayate/ yu khyed tsho la mtha' 'khob zer ba yin yang smakipratāntathutairbu)bāyate:/ ma du su la mtha' 'khob zer dgos rgyanākimosngatyāntataipramadzānanodzñami shes par 'dug niṣaṇḍa/ dzāyul dbus dang mtha' 'khob kyang rang bzhin gyis 'grub pa med par nabadamargyabyuprattastetsaswabhābenamāsā dhe bstan pa 'phel 'grib la ltos te bar btags pa tsam yin/ nashāsanapistarābacoyānamadhīnapārābyu khyarnasgruyate/shes rab na re/ don dam rtogs pa la sngon du kun rdzob pa'i rnam gzhag gtan la phab ste tha snyad tshad grub la mkhas dgos/ re zhig kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag cig khyod la dri dgos/ bden pa bzhi la gang 'dren/bi lig na re/ tur pen 'u rten 'i nu bden pa bzhi ni/ tso pa lang dun 'u sdug bsngal bden pa nen/ pu khu ni gar gag chi len 'u kun 'byung bden pa nen/ thu red khu'i na 'u 'gog bden nen/ mu tshun 'u nen lu ke tur pe mun lam bden da nga bzhi yin/276

ra / / ste mkha spri1 'a'adzabang bshes rab na re/ phung bo lnga la gang 'dren/bi lig na re/ tur su'in tshog cha gzugs kyi phung po/ tshor ba'i phung po me ter khu'i na tshog cha/ hu ra 'du shes kyi phung po/ na me te khu'i na tshog cha/hu ri yān 'u'i led khu'i na tshog 'du byed kyi phung po/ cha/ bre 'in me te khu'i na tshogs cha lu rnam par shesapa'i phung po dang lnga yin/ gā tha pu mun/shes rab na re/ rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis la gang 'dren/bi lig na re/ ang yan lag dang po han ke shi gun mong ma rig pa/hagaho gnyis pa ya tu gār 'du byed/ hu ri yān 'u'i led khru/ gu tha gār gsum pa rnam shes/ ze'i na me te khri/ tu thu ger bzhi pa ming gsugs/ nee rin tur su/thabalnga ba skye mched/ tha gar thu skye mched/ rin thu ge khu/ tsar drug pa gwa tu gar khu rel che reg pakhru/ to lo bdun pa tshor ba/ tu gar me ter khru/ na'i brgyad pa ma tu gar hu ri ya sred pa/ hu'i/ ye dgupa su tu gār yab lenapa/hu'i/ ar bcu ba srid pa/ pa tu gar sanur/ ar bcu gcig pa/ pan ni ge tu gār skye ba/ thu ru khru/ ar bcu gnyis pa pan ho ya rga shi'i rten 'brel/tu gar 'u thu lo khu 'u khu khu'i na shi thun pa rel rnamasatu hu'i yin no gota mun/shes rab na re/ khams bco brgyad la gang 'dren/bi lig na re/ tur su ta gān 'u nur yin/ 'am than khur the khru nom loga'o ron nu cir gwa gan yi tsa goragazugs sgra dri ro rag bya chos te ༅ gyi khams drug/ ni tu chi khe ha bar khe le pe ye sed khel lu ge 'er khe then nu cir gwa'an yi tsa goramig rna ba sna lce lusayid de dbang po'i khams drug/ ni 0 nu the'i mig gi rnam shes nas yid kyi rnam shes kyi bar rnam shes kyi khams drug ste bco brgyad yod/ na me te khu'i 'e che sed khu lcan the'in me te khu'i khur the le ze'in me te khu'in cir gwa'an i tsa gor zla gā'ar pan na'i ma pu'i/ 'di grangs 'dren tsam yin/277

༄/ /yo ca b.lo rsā 0ma'i ga las/ne tho go tho go la hu'in the tu'i mun/ tha te de dag so so'i ngo bo/ gīr thus thu sun mun che nar/ u'i led byed las/ pu ri/ pel mtshan nyid/ ke nar/ i la dbye ba/ gal/ hu ri bsdu ba/ yal ga ma grangs nges/gad tho go u ye tser ke the ri go rim sogs dpyiyo na par shes pa la gu zen ni thu'il tur khur the le me te khu'i tur ho tha la the gu'u mel a sti dha rma me mngon pa kun btus ltar gtan la 'bebs dgos/ thu'i gi nu tha ta ba go la ga hu khe reg tha'i/tshe dbī na re/ phri teng ri mthon po rtser 'gro ba la'ang rtsa ba nas yar ga le ga ler 'gro dgos/ ko byan shus dzā chi sa shya byus shyas stel shang yus khang steng du 'gro ba la'ang skas tshigs 'og ma nas rim gyis 'gro dgosapa bzhin chos kyang go dka' ba rnams shes pa la gang sla ba de sngon du bslab nas rim pa bzhin byed dgos pa de nga'i blo la'ang shin tu 'bab pa byung teng lca nyepi lca this shya yas si stel shing / bye yus mi hwa yus te chi ji byen shi chi stes bee ti stel cin lul shin ci ming /pradzñā na re/ dhasmosru tredayayazuchos kyi snying po gang yin/ yati/shes rab na re/ chos kyi snying bo stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin lags/ bi lig na re/ no mon chos skad thun mong ba tsam la de byas chog kyang /'u ge ye rung khren the tu'i tur the re bol ba chu/ kun zab gnad mthar thug gi dbang du byas na deyogo mi chod/ o ni su ni thu'i na 'er khe tur 'u'i led pesu the gu rpār 'u lu tho go cha mu'i/ a mo bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes la byed dgos/go lang ho go san 'il gal 'u ge'i bel ge bi lig thur 'u'i led khu khe reg the'i/shes rab na re/ khyod kyi gtam de nga'i pha mi min sog po yin zhes pa ltar 'brel med kyi cal col du snang / stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa'i rgyu thabs shes ya ma bral ba de'i ming red/278

da / /ste mkha 11ngashā/rdobartsa gabade stong dbyer med kyi ye shes kyang de'i khongs su 'du ba ma gtogs de las gzhan du go na sangs rgyas kyi rgyur mi 'gro ba'i skyon yod/ lar khyed rnams chos la don gnyer che ba rjes su yi rang lags kyang / dang po nas zab zab mo dang / gang mtho gang myur gyi man ngag kho na zhig dgos pa 'dis kha gang la 'khor 'gro mi shes pa 'dug da lta rnying chos phal cher yang sog yul du sleb 'dug mod/ rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos kyang bod kyi srid skyong gi don du gterakha brgya lhag gi chos gsan nas rnying chos sa spel rdo spel gnang 'dug na'ang / sog po'i phyogs su rnying ma bkra mi shis gsung nas bkag cha kho na mdzad pa rnam thar dang khong gis gsungs pa'i bslab bya rnams su bltas pas gsal/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sngon sog po'i dmag yang yang song ste rnying ma la gnod 'tshe byas pas/ rnying ma'i bla ma chos skyong thams cad dang khon zhugs te ha cang dam sel che ba de'i stobs kyis yin par 'dugabi lig na re/ kun thub zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba sogs byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi gnad mthar thug dang / 'u tsel the re gu then bo dhi gi bu thu ge khu'i mu rin 'o ni 'u thu'i la ba/ bur sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i 'gang chesarnams 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i bzhed srol ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs 'di bzhin byed ha nu sha cin nu ye khe ni ro gu gol no go mdzu ke len i the gel pog to tsong kha pa'i na tha gā la lunaji rum ri bo dge ldan pa'i na yo su 'e ni chi len 'u'i led/ khu khe rig the'i 'a dgos mod mu'i/ 'a hu 'u gan4skabasakyi4'gal rkyen sel ba dang / ye sun gar shi nu gu che la 'a ril ga hu ba/ yi zas nor longasaspyod rṣa ba te ge mal 'ed le la 'ar pi dag hu/ 'er khe dbang sdud gtong ba/ tur hu ri yā hu/'a tag ma mtha' thun rwa re g.yug rgyu la'ang rnying ma la ba su thun rwa tho khi hu tser ke'i na ze tu'i tur chu rnying ma 'e ne chi hul khe reg thu po lo shīd them thig gar hu khi 279

༄/ /ca ca bam pa'itshonasa'i ga ཿma/le bar ni ge ne bu'i thu la theri me thu'i na khe reg thur pa ga sa ga 'ang ha run 'ab ba chu gar shil hu ya gān bu'i 'di nye bar mkho zhing rtags thon sla ba zhig 'dug pas de 'dra'i don du cung zad re nyams su blangs kyang 'gal ba ci yod/shes rab na re/ de 'dra zer ba de chos lugs gnyi ga la blo ma khel ba'i skyon yin/ sngon yang gcig gis phug dkon mchog la re/ 'phral pe ra dkar la re zhes phyogs gnyi ga gnon rgyu'i khul byas kyang blo rtse gcig dril gyis su la'ang gtod ma thub pas srung ba byas tshad gnad du ma song ba dang 'dra/tshe dbī'i na re/ shulwa de bden par 'dug shulwa shin zhis/ lu bya ba gang byed kyang sems la 'dzin rgyu gcig yod pa dgos/ lun te lus pi tre cu lwan shin/phiyu gzhan du 'gro na'ang rta gcig zhon pa ma gtogs gnyis zhon rgyu yin byas na bar du lhung yong / shed two kyi ching yis mā/ rulwa khrus shwang mā pi sa hūng kyān/phi bzo byed na'ang khab rtse gcig gis bzo ba ma gtogs rtse gnyis kyis bzo lugs med/yu hu rlung 'u yung 'i yān sten yulwa lcang shāng sten kyi pu khe shing / hwan bya ba thams cad de 'dra yin dus chos kyang de dang 'dra mod/ shi sten/ cing yī yu hris/shes rab na re/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul phran tshegs dang nyams snang ban bun 'byung sla bas/ de 'dra mgo 'khor nas bstan pa'i gnad ma nor ba bskyur te song na phan chung la gnod pa shin tu chen po 'byung ste/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ la la lus dang sems la ni/ / ting 'dzin cung zad bskyed nas kyang / / de la yid ches skyes pa dang / / log pa'i chos rnams bsten nas slu/ / la la mngon par shes pa dang / / rdzu 'phrul cung zad bstan nas kyang / / blun po yid ches bskyed nas ni/ / phyi nas chos log 280

༄/ / zlos nakhrulastanabacosayang kroba'iro'athetshogaston par byed/ / chos gzhan legs par ston na yang / / chos kyi gnad rnams bcos pa ni/ / shin tu 'jigs pa chen por 'gro/ / de 'dra ba las skyon byung mang / / dper na kha zas bzang po la/ / sbyar ba'i dug gis phal cher gsod/ / dug rkyang yin par shes na ni/ / 'ga' yang gsang par nus ma yin/ / de bzhin chos bzang 'ga' zhig la/ / chos log bslad pas pha rolasbra/ / zhes gsungs/ gtan gyi mdun ma'i rtsa ba yin pas khe nyen la rtog dpyod zhib mo byed dgos so/ /bi lig na re/ sdom gsum sdom gsum rab dbye'i lung khyod kyis 'dren mi dgos/ rab dbye'i lung chi rpār tha tha hu khe reg 'u ke'i/ chi nu tha thag san je gu ne che chu tho ter ha'i 'u le ger lu ge sel the nom lag san pu'i gi bi brer chu 'u tseg sen bu lu ge/ mun de nyid las/ khu she gur che/ thob mdor na sangs rgyas chil pa su pur ha nu sa'in tsar lig gsung ba dang lu gwa'/ 'o lang khi ki tso nyil tugwa lun 'u tse gu le ge daphal cher mthun par ston byed cing / / 'o ni su hu no go ti pu ru gwa 'u tse gu lug chi nomagand rnams log par ston pa'i chos// sa'i nas 'in me thu 'u tse gu leb legs legs 'dra bar ston na yang / chu/shi ma nu brer arnyisu lag san mun khe bdud kyi byin rlabs yin no zhes/ men/su mdo rgyud kun las gtso bar gsungs/ tur ta nd+ra bu khu ne che tho tor ha'i nom la ba'i/ 'e 'di dag ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ te ge sar mapar me thu ga rug san yo su ni/ thob chi'imado tsam nga yisabashad kyis nyon/ na dzi tu'i pi rpār 'u gu le mu'i so no sog thun/ rin chen bzang po rin chen bzang po khel mer chi pa'i hu'i na 'u ye tur/ sangs sangasargyas skar rgyal rgyas skar rgyal khe zhes bya ba/meg te khu bīr/ mang la'i 'a dpral banasani 'od 'byin zhing / cha'an ke rel gar gā gad/ ke bar snang la ni skyil krung 'cha'/ gen tsab sar thur tsa pi la 281

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonachu'i gsung 'bum/cu/ tsa re 'ga' 'jag ma'i khri larim taga'ang te re su nu shi re gan tur sdod sa gwan/ stong ba nyid kyi chos rnam/sa ston/ ho go son chi na ru na no mo ti 'u tse gu lun/ ye khe te 'a sa ran ni lu le se 6tu ri per 'u tsug byams dang snying rje che bar snang / te bre/ de yi chos kyis gzhan dag la/ the gu nu no mār tsa rim mud thur/ ting nges 'dzin yang skye bar byed/ sa ma dhi chuthu ru pe'i/ phe gu de la 'jug rten thams cad na tur yir thin chu tha khin bi shir pe'imos de la 'jig rten thams cad mos/ shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa dang / shākya mu ne 'in sha cin lu gwa'/ a'adra min cung zad bcos par 'chad/ ti pu su 'u chu 'u ne khe na ca sa ta ga bīr nom la pa'i/ te gu nu sha cin ma shi tel ke de yi bstan pa shin tu 'phel/ ra ste'i ze re 'u ye tur rin chen bzang po prerade tshe rin chen bzang po yis/ jir gwan sa sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad nas/ ra bu thu gel 'u'i led nt+ra/ pa thuting 'dzin brtan pas de drung byin/ sa madhi prer the gu nu ter ge te tsa lar pa'i/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas skar rgyal bar snang la/ skar rgyal ke gen tsab sar thur/ tsa pi lan sa gu cur no mi skyil krung bcas nas chos 'chad tshe/ nom la hu'in 'u ye tur/ rin chen rin chen bzang pos gzigs tsam gyis/ bzang po brer 'u tseg sen ze tu'i brer/ ga car thur 'un cu 'u khudababīs la lhung nas brgyal zhes grags/ khe mān 'al tar shi pa'i/ kher pe rin chen bzang gal te rin bzang zhes bya ba/ po khe meg te khu/ skyes mchog de tshe mi bzhugs na/te ge tu pog to ze re 'u ye tur 'e se lo ro shi pa su/ sangs rgyas skar rgyal sangs rgyas skar rgyal zhes bya ba'i/ khe meg tu khu'i na/ pu ru'u nom chos log bstan pa 'byung zhes gsungs/ sha cin gar hu khe men nom lags san/ nag po'iphyogs la dga' ba yi/ ha ra'i na tsug thur ba ya sug chi/ skar rgyal khe meg che ni gen skar rgyal zhes bya'i klu chen zhig ye khe klus/ ma skyes ngan zhig la zhugs nas ni/ gu'u thu rul thu ni gen tur 'o ro cu/ pur sangs rgyas gzugs 282

sa / / slos na(1bstan tshosapang thib rol tshogasu brdzus zhes gsungs/ ha nu tur su rpār ha glur bā khe men nom la pa'i le 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi bdud rigs 'ga'/ ne me thu'in tsu'i la thu tsa rim shi ma nu'i tsa gor thun/ khu mun pa hu thug tha nu tu ri gi pa ri cu mi'am 'phags pa'i gzugs bzung nas/ / pu ru ga'u sha cin ni tel ker grul khu'i na thu la sog po'i bstan pa spel ba'i phyir/ ta/ nom lu ga' ho chos dang bsres nas gnad rnams su/ li cu 'o ni su no god thur/ pu log chos bsres nas 'chad pa srid/ru 'u nom ho li cu nom la yu/ khe ces gsungasayod cing de ltar du nged rang gis kyang khas len pas/ men nom lag san/ bu'i ces gsungs yod cing de ltar du nged rang gis kyang khas len pasakhu ged the re me thu tu ra bi ta brer chu 'a man 'ab hu thu la/ su mdo sngags gang gi yin kyang bstan pa'i gnas rnams rje bla ma'i lugs 'di las gzhan zhig btsal dgos don yang med la/ tur thar ni 'a li nu mun pol ba chu sha ci nu 'o ni su no go ti pog to bla ma'i 'e ne yo su na' cha 'u bur ni ge ni 'e ri khu khe reg thu sa 'u ge'i/ ho bsresakyang mi chog li ci chu 'u lu pol hu/ ta rtun nu gu chel 'a ril 'phral gye rkyen sol tsam du rma la phan na khyi tshil yang bsten chog dus/ gu hu'in the tu'i tur thu sa la ba su shir han tur no ha'i na 'u gu khu ni shi thu khu chag pa'i tha la/ rnying ma'i na nom chu rnying ma'i tshas kyang de las thu ba zhig min 'gro/ the gu nee chi to ro ni gen bu su po lal tha'i/pradzña nare/ dhasposrubrite ya chos kyi 'brasabu gang yin/ ryate/shes rab na re/ chos nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin pa yongs su grags pa ltar yin pas/ bla mas kyang de la dri ba gnang ba min par 'dug gnas skabs kyi dbang du btang nas chos nyams su blangs pa'i lag rjes zhog tshad gang yin gsung bar 'dug / de ngas zhib tu brtag na tshe 'di snang gi bya ba sogs chos min la rgyab kyis phyogs nas blo kha chos kyi phyogs kho nar 'khor zhing sgo gsum gyis bya 283

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/ba gang byas chos kyi phyogs su 'gro ba zhig byung na chos thos bsam sgom gsum byas pa'i lag rjes zhog pa yin pa 'dra snyam/bi lig na re/ chi khyod kyi de chos byas pa dang chos byas pa'i lag rjes gnyis po rgyu 'bras go bzlog par snang / nom 'us le teg sen ki ged 'us le te khu'i na 'u ri ze re ho yar shil tha gan 'u dī mi tel ni chag sen bu'i/ 'u blo kha chos phyogs su 'khor ba zhig sngon du ma byung bar chos byed pa zhig gtan mi yong bas/yan no mo'i na cug thur cug gul khu ni gen 'u ri ta 'e se gar ba su nom 'us le te khu ni gan 'a shi ta 'u lu ye re khu/ the re nom de chos byed ba'i rgyu 'us le te khu'i na shil tha gan mun bo su nom 'us le te khu'in 'u re tur 'o to hu yo su 'u ge/ nom bo chos min gyis phyogs la blo log pa dang / su'in cug thur 'u yun 'ur ba hu ke ged/ nom mu'i cug thur chos kyi phyogs la blo 'khor ba gnyis kyang srang mda'i mgo 'jug gi mtho dman bzhin dus mnyam du yong dgos pas/ 'u yun cu gul khu ho yar hphu cing ne gu ru'i na so phrin 'ebasu gul kun ter po gi ni thu ṭwāṃ/ ༵ ṭwāṃ tt+waṃ ༵dīdhidī ṭwāṃrdo /༵ ༵rdo/ de'aX nghruhūṃ bye/ ༷ ༷ ༵༷ ṭwāṃ ༷༵ dadhiX ༷ 'ig yin gyi/ / nom 'us led khu'i na se gul chos byas pa'i 'phror yong rgyu zhig min/ tur ye re khu ne gen po su/ nom 'ang hā ran 'ab hu'in 'u dī 'a gol hu'i na chos nyams su blangs pa'i lag rjes zhog tshad la thag mi chod rgyu de tsam ci dgos/khem ci yen tur shī gāl 'u gī shil tha gān the dus ya grun khe reg so na thos pa byas pa'i lag rjes 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa zhig byung na de yin/san 'u le tug san nu 'u dī ye nom la hu them chi hu thog gor ba'i khu gur ba thur bel 'u ke ni gen ga ra pa su the re mun/ bi shel gan bu thun 'us le tug sen 'u rī yi dam pur han nu ni gru ri 'u ci khu hi ged bi lig pa ri te ho bi gen 284

da tsho/ / rngo sakha 11 ab jegajere gru then thur bel 'u ge sa yan mo gu'u ga ran bo la hu bu gu te'i na gu hu chi len hu me te ged khi cig 'ub chin ki ged 'ang thod har ze ri gu ten nu chi hu la khu ne gel bu gu te gi 'a ril ga hru 'u bu ri po su tu'i na thu sa 'a gru ye khe bu the gan chi ta hu ni gon garab su no mu 'in 'u ru 'a gol hu mun ye le te bu thug sen the gun tur se ci ge len 'us le te khu ya gun khe ragand rims gdon bgegs la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad bsal nas rang gzhan gye don rlabs po che sgrub nus pa zhig byung na chos kyi lag rjes zhog pa yin pa mngon sum gyis grub pas de la dogs pa byed ci dgos/ /tshe daste na re/ shi khyed mkhas pa rnamasakyisabashad na gcig gis bshad tshe gcig bden/ teng shul huwa tu kyāng bee cin/ tus shawa stes gnyis kyis bshad tshe gnyis bden pa ltabur 'dug pas/ yan/ stel shi shul shul shu lus da res khong rnam gnyis kyis bshad pa de gang bden rgya gar gyi bla mas thag gcod dgos/shece dzī yin tu shis wes ci phi'i phang /pradzā na re/ lo 'jig rten gyi grags tshod dang bstun na sog po'i btsun pas zer ba de'ang mi bden rgyu med rung / gasrusastutakaprakṛtetsānakulimosgolabandanarbutatatra:nāsatyanagrazebā/ bod kyi btsun pa khyod rang gis zer ba de la lung rigs kyi khungs rnam dag ston rgyu yod na spos shigabhoṭasrugomirngasunārbutatatragramāḍibishurnyesrudṛstontashāstakrazebhutabhāṣaya/shes rab na re/ sog po'i btsun pa khyod kyis thos pa'i 'bras bu 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa zer ba de'ang gcig shes gnyis shes thams cad gzhan zhig la bshad rgyu'i 'phen pa btang ste kha phyir bltas su song ba'i rtags red/ sangs rgyas bcom lda/sko 'das kyis/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nad dag tu/ / lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde/ / zhes 285
