༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronas ga4 4ma/thos don dben par nyams su len dgos par gsungs/ skyes rabs las kyang / thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ / ces thos pa'i 'bras bu sgrub pa la brtson dgos par gsungs pa red/ yang khyod kyis sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mngon shes dang grub rtags sogs la gtso bor ngos bzung ba de/chos byas tshad tshe 'di'i lag char song ba'i nang rtags phyir bstan par snang /thos bsam sgom gsum ji tsam byas kyang blo phugs tshe 'di'i mdun ma dang 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la shi spar 'tham nas bsdad na blo kha chos la ma phyogs pa yin pas mtshams 'di shes mkhan dkon par snang / khyod rang gis blo kha chos la phyogs pa de chos byed pa'i sngon du 'gro dgos ba'i sgrub byed gtong gi 'dug mod kyang / mi tshe chos la bskyal ba'i lag rjes kyi thad ka na da dung blo kha ma phyogs pa'i nang rtags bstan 'dug pa rgyab 'gal chen po yin/ deng dus chos byas zer mkhan phal mo che khas zer lugs dang phugs kyi zhe 'dod ma mtshungs pa 'di 'dra'i dbang gis 'bad pa chud zos su song ba mang bar snang /chos kyi 'bras bu nged kyis bshad pa de bzhin los yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gsungs pa'i dgos pa gnas skabs kyi rkyen sel tsam dang / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul phran tshegs sgyu ma mkhan gyi zlos gar lta bu zhig gi phyir du gsungs pa min/ 'ching grol thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems la thug pas blo sna 'di sgyur thabs 'ba' zhig la gsungs pa red/ de'i gnad kyis 'di cung zad cig kha yar skor thub na sangs rgyas kyi bzhed pa bskangs pa dang chos kyi lag rjes zhog par 'gro/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos kyang /dngosagrub kyi mchog nyon mongs pa je chung la song ba yin/ grub rtags kyi mchog 'dod pa je chung la song ba yin gsungs shing / dgon pa pa'i zhal nas kyang / man ngag gi mthil gang la byed zer na/ mngon par shes 286

da khye/ / :sgosag /kye ab che pasapa'am yi dam gyi lha zhal mthong ba la byed zer mi nyan pas/ las 'bras la nges pa je cher song nas dam sdom tshul bzhin du bsrung ba la byed dgos par gsungs/ jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyi gsungs tshul 'di dus kyi snyigs ma dang bstan pa'i tha ma 'di 'dra ba'i skabs su phan shin tu che bas/rang cag rnams kyis kyang de 'dra re la blo rtse gtad na nyen chung la khe che ba zhig yong /bi lig na re/ chi nu me tug sen yo sān the gu ni pi per 'e se me nyug khyod kyis go lugs de nga la'ang ma shar ba min/sen po su/ chib snyigs dus kyi skye bo col chung rnams kyi log rtog gi mtha' khegs pa'i phyir dogs pa slong thabs byas pa yin/cha gu'i 'a rad pi ra 'u chu khen nu gu du'i po ru gu 'ang hag gu'i 'u chi'i 'u mur khru thu la se cig gi hu tul ge khu 'ar ga gi 'us le teg sen mun/ chi per no ma lagakhyod kyis go lugs deng la'ang ma shar ba min/ san the re te ge re ci bka' gdams pa ni gud su tar sa'i tiri bu gud nom la gad/ khyod kyis bshad pa de bka' gdams gong ma rnams su ma zad mdo bstan bcos thams cad nas gsungs shing / / rje bla ma'i bodhi mu ru'i na cer ge to thor tur rje bla ma'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nang du'ang chu/ bi shel gag san nu se tī sichu mong hag ze re gru ten ni'i panī bu lam 'u chu ten bsgom pa pa'i dngos grub kyang ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa je chung du song ba la bya gsungs tur 'o ta gu lan 'us led khe men car lig po lig sen me thu me te khu khe reg tha'i/ khe zhes nan tan du gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan men shim tan nom lag san 'u chir shel tha gā na/ nom chosaji 'dra zhig bya4kyang de dang rang gi sems gnyis hir 'a ta li ni gen 'us led deb chu there ki ged 'e bu ru'i na sed nyil po sbyar nas zhu dag btang ho yar rī pa ril tu ste nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por e 'gro gul hū cas gad 'a ril gag san je re 287

༄/ /yo ca gas ༅ ma'i khrung 4ma/nis pa nis su'i yu run teg thur 'o tog san po 'u/ nir pān ki gad ham thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur e 'gro lta ba zhig byung na thos bsam sgom gsum po gcig gi 'a'i led tug chi'in shel tha gan tur 'o tog san po yu 'u cil ne gen gar pa su so nag san sa nag sa na pi shel gag san gor pa ni gen nu nu kher thu nee gen 'o tu hu ni gen pol pa su yi la gugs na nu sha cin 'er te ni gi 'e pu'i po su tu'igrogs sugacig 'gro ba zhig byung nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rang gzhan gyi kun tu sen tur ma ga ta lan 'a rab gan chi ta hu ne gen ye re khu munargyud la nges par spel nusapa zhig yong ba yin par 'dug / pu'i/pradzñā na re/ a ti shu shin tu legs/ st+waṃ/ dhasgrosrukarmāsarbakartayārjagastiram̐su dzñātredayasrumarmasākastobenasika je darabunarabaprastare kaslolañtsachos kyi gtam byas pa thams cad don zab la go bde ba snying po'i gnad mthun par byung bas 'bel gtam rgyas pa slar rim gyis byas chog cing /ajunāmabyukartayasru.irdashubha:na da res cung zad byas pa'i dge ba 'di'ang chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo ba'i mtsham sbyor gnang bar zhu/bimanā bahiṣāgatasthāthaparināmasruyukasāyi pra)bretsu/shes rab na re/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ chos tshul rnam par 'phel ba dang / / gegs kyi mtshan ma zhi ba dang / / mthun rkyen ma lus tshang bar shog / bdag dang gzhan gyi dus gsum dang / / 'brel ba'i tshogs gnyis la brten nas/ / rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa yi/ / bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /bi lig na re/ pi brer hphu pi'u pu ru'i na 'u ge yer nged rang gis nged rang gi skad kyi bsngo ba zhig byed dgos/ ye re gīl 'us led khu khe re ga tha'i/ nom mu'i chosakyi rgyal tsotsong kha pa'i/ na ha gan 'i la gug san tsong kha pa'i/ / no 288

ra / / cho sag 11ngasabang gamonatshas ྾ rnam par 'phel ba dang / / yo sa ni'i the 'ar bta gul khu tur/tho gegasakyi mtshan ma zhi ba dang / / to go tu'i har shel ta hu thod har pel ge the tu'i ni 'a mir la hu ke ged/ co khil ta hu'i nug chi li ho chir li 'u kyi pu red ke khu pol thu ga'imathun rkyen ma lus tshang bar shog / 'u per ki ged po su tu'i na gor pan chag lu ge bdag dang gzhan gyi dusagasum dang / parila'abrel ba'i tshogs gnyis la brten nas/ / tug sen ho yar chi grul gān tur shu the cu'i/yi la gug rgyalab blo bzang grags pa yi/ / san sum ti ki ti'i na/ sha bstanapa yun ring 'bar gyur cig / cin 'u ni 'u tagan tel ke re khu po la thu ga'i/tshe darpā na re/ 'ulwa teng yus se ke ci lcalwan yin su lwa nged rang gis kyang nged rang gi skad kyis bsngo ba zhig byed dgos/ yisung lcas/ shi chosakyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ / co hulwa lung tsong mkha/ chi chos ྾ rnam par 'phel ba dang /hulwa yus cin shing shen shīs/ i gegs kyi mtshan ma zhi ba dang / / byihu lwa spu ce ya byobre ya/ hu mthun rkyen ma lus ra par shog / hwa ci byad yung ci jus/yinabadag dang gzhan gyi dus gsum dang / / gyi sān shi shul kyi jus/ stel 'brel ba'i tshogs gnyis la brten nas/ / shyan yung te kung te sde/ cen rgyalab blobazang grags pa yi/ / cing su ma ti ki rte tso/ te tāng bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /wang yung pu ju was/pra dzña na re/ ma bdag gi ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /lngayabatarmaspyote shusten/ shā bstan dang 'gro ba kun la gang phan dang / /san:sabyupradzayahitañtsa/ ba khyad par rje btsun blo bzang grags pa yi/ /bibhaṭashākasrusumatikirte/ shī bstan pa'i snying po ring du gsal byed shog /ṣātrerdadīrghahasitakakhyochu/skad rigs rnam bzhi'i rin chen khams las grub/ / lung rigs nyi 289

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i nace' gasrung 'bum/zla'i rna cha zung gis mdzes/ / sngon med legs par bshad pa'i lhun po 'di/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i rgyan du gnas gyur cig / de'ang rig gnas chung ba lnga'i ya gyal zlos gar zhes pa rgya gar na skad rigasachen po bzhi'i sgo nas so sor 'don pa'i dbang gis zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs zer ba yin zhing /bod la skad rigs gcig las med pas zlos gar mtshan nyid pa mi 'ong bar gsung /'on kyang deng dus rgya bod hor gsum thams cad du bstan pa dar yod pas de dag so so'i skad kyis byayon skad rigs so so'i phyogs go zhing / 'di 'dra'i rkyen gyes chos kyi gnad 'gag gal che ba rnams la blo kha phyogs mkhan yang 'byung srid dam snyam pa dang /rang nyid so so yang dag par rigs pa bzhi 'grub pa'i rgyu mthun du bsams te/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i bgrang bya brgyad pa dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i yar tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa 'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan thogs par gyur cig /290

༄/ / nyamasasgo 'belagatamayida'abyubadamar khrig༄7/ / nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam yid 'byung dmar khrid ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / skye ba'i sa bon spangs pa yis/ / rga shi'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba/ / zag zad thub pa rnams la 'dud/ / 'khor ba'i rgyun lam gcad du gsol/ / srid pa'i 'brog dgon thang dkyil na/ / rgas 'khog rgad po nyal ba la/ / lang tshos dregs pa'i gzhon nu zhig / 'ongs je co 'dri 'di skad gleng / / rgad po 'gro 'dug bya byed kun/ / gzhan dang mi mthun cal col rang / / byed pa'i rgyun mtshan ci yin zer/ / de la rgad pos lan smras pa/ / yog li sha dar khrag dar gyi/ / 'phur ma lding khyod nga la nyon/ /nga yang lo 'ga'i sngon tsam na/ / khyod las lhag sgos lhag cig yin/ / brgyug na gye lang rta yang zin/ / bzung na byang kha'i 'brong yang thub/ / yang zor nam mkha'i bya dang mtshungs/ / mdzes pa lha phrug gzhon nu 'dra/ / bkrag mdangs can gyi gos kyang gyon/ / rin thang can gye rgyan yang btags/ /zhim mngar can gyi zas kyang zos/ / bang rtsal can gyi rta yang zhon/ / rtse rgod ma byas gcig kyang med/ / dga' skyid ma myong gcig kyang med/ / 'chi ba 'ongs dogs ga la yod/ / rga ba'ang thog tu 'ongs ma snyam/ mdza' bshes 'du 'dzi'i 'ar 'ur gyis/ / g.yeng nas mgo bo 'khor ba'i thog /rga ba'i sdug bsngal g.yo can 'dis/ / 'jab nas 'ongs te car gyis mnan/ / rang rgas rang gis ma tshor la/ / tshor ba'i dus su 'phyis nas 291

lhu/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i ga ཿma/gda'/ / shel gyi me long la bltas tshe/ / rang lus la yang sgyug re bro/ /spyir na lus sems thams cad nyams/ / lhag par mgo nas thur nyams te/ / rgas pa astikhyeñtsa'i chus/ / mgo nas dbang rab bskur ba 'dra/ / skra lo dung ltar dkar ba 'di/ / nag nog dri ma dag pa min/ / 'chi bdag mchil ma'i rgyang mda' de/ / ba mo'i zol gyes babs pa yin/ / dpral pa'i rwa gnyer khrig khrig 'di/ / bu chung rgyag pa'i zho gnyer min/ / tshe tshad lo mang 'das pa'i grangs/ / dus kyi pho nyas bris pa yin/ / blta 'dod zim zim mang ba 'di/ / mig tu du ba song ba min/ / dbang po nyams pa'i rab rib kyis/ / bsgribs nas bya thabs zad pa yin/ / rna ba gtad nas nyan pa 'di/ / lkog tu gsang gtam yod pa min/ / sgra kun rgyang na grags pa bzhin/ / shar te thos su re ba yin/ / sna chu thigs thigs 'bab pa 'di/ / mu tig do shal bstar ba min/ / gsal 'tsher lang tsho'i chab rom de/ / gdung byed nyi mas bzhus pa yin/ / so yi 'phreng ba lhung pa 'di/ /skye 'dod se'u brjes pa min/ / tshe 'di'i za kha tshang ba yis/ / za byed lag cha bsdus pa yin/ / kha chu thar thar byed pa 'di/ / sa la chag chag 'deb pa min/ / sngon spyad longs spyod thams cad la/ / zhen log thud kyis 'deb pa yin/ / mi gsal ldab ldib smra ba 'di/ / skad rigs gzhan zhig shod pa min/ / don med ngag 'khyal smra ches pas/ / lce yang a thang chad pa yin/ / bzhin ras bsdus shing mdog ngan pa/ / spre'u'i 'dra 'bag gyon pa min/ / g.yar po'i lang tsho phyir khyer bas/ / mi sdug rang mdog bstan pa yin/ / mgo bo yug yug byed pa 'di/ / gzhan gyi bya bar 'phya ba min/ /mthar byed dbyug pa'i sne phog pas/ / ma bzod klad pa 'dar ba yin/ /lam la kha gtad bsgur ba 'di/ / rgya khab bor nas tshol ba min/ / sa la 292

༄༄/ / nyamasaspyo 'belagatamathada'abyungadamarakhregalang tsho'i nor bu dang / / dran pa stor ba'i rnam 'gyur yin/ / langs tshe sug bzhi 'dzug pa 'di/ / phyugs kyi lad mo byas pa min/ / byin pas lus po ma theg pa'i/ / ram 'degs lag pas byed pa yin/ / sdod tshe chem gyi lhung ba 'di/ / grogs la 'khang ra byed pa min/ / spro dga'i sems kyi dpyang thag dang / / lang tsho'i zungs thag chad pa yin/ 'gro tshe yom yom 'khyor ba 'di/ / mi chen gom stabs byed pa min/ / na tshod khur bo ha cang rang / /lce bas yo drang shor ba yin/ / lag pa yab yab 'dar ba 'di/ / nor la hab sha byed pa min/ / lag par 'ong tshad gcig car du/ / gshin rjes phrogs kyis dogs pa yin/ / bza' btung nyung shas spyod pa 'di/ / zas la ser sna byed pa min/ / lto ba'i me drod nyams pa yis/ / mi rgan sgyel gyis dogs pa yin/ / gos chung srab bde gyon pa 'di/ / yang chas byas nas 'khrab rgyu min/ / nang gi lus stobs shor ba yis/ / gos kyang khur du song ba yin/ / stod dbugs 'tshang zhing phu 'deb pa/ / gzhan la sngags lcag brdeg pa min/ / dbugs kyi 'gyu ba breng breng 'di/ / nam mkhar yal 'dod snga ltas yin/ / bya spyod thams cad 'gyur ba 'di/ / col chung gang dran byed pa min/ / rgas pas gdon gyes zin pa yis/ / rang 'dod dbang na med pa yin/ / las don thams cad brjed pa 'di/ / snang chung tar rgyag byas pa min/ / rten gyi dbang po nyams pa yis/ / dran rig shes pa rdib pa yin/ / da lta nga la 'phya mi dgos/ / rgas pa ma bgos spyi na yod/ / lo gsum lon dus khyod la yang / / bang chen snga ma sleb nas 'ongs/ / ngas bshad rna bar mi 'gro ste/ / nyams myong nang nas skyes te 'ongs/ / deng sang tshe lo mar 'grib pas/ / nga yi lo tsam khyod mi sdod/ / gal te bsdad na tshod 'di la/ / kha yang cher grag mi nus mod/ / byas pa'i lan du gzhon nu 293

༄/ /yo ca bstan ba'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/yis/ / mis 'phya khyis 'gom bla 'tshong po/ / khyod 'dra byas te sdod pa las/ / sngon du shi na dga' zhes zer/ / lan du rgad po khrel 'dzum bcas/ / tshe ring skyid rgyag 'dod pa la/ / rgas pa mi 'dod a re glen/ /shi yang skyid rgyu dka' mo yin/ / dad zas dkor zas ma zos shing / / dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrungs/ / thos bsam sgom pa byas yod na/ / nam zhig shi yang skyid pa yin/ / nga ni de 'dra cung zad kyang / / sems la 'dzin rgyu mi 'dug pas/ / phung po rgas rung gson na dga'/ / zhag gcig yin kyang bsdad na snyam/ / byas pas gzhon nu blo 'gyur te/ / bden no bden no rgad po bden/ / mig gis mngon sum mthong ba dang / / khyod kyi bshad pa ngo 'phrod pas/ / dmar khrid sems la 'bab pa byung / / rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ya re nga / / rgan po go mthong rig gsum che/ / 'jigs pa de 'dra mi 'byung ba'i/ / thabs shig yod na drang por shod/ / byas pas rgad po 'dzum bzhin du/ / de yi thabs yod las kyang sla/ / byed kyang phal cher mi dgos mod/ / skyes tshad thams cad 'chi na yang / / rgas nas 'chi ba nyung shas yin/ / dgos rgyu mi 'chi'i thabs dgos kyang / / de ni gang du song yang med/ / sngon byon sangs rgyas byang sems dang / / skyes chen rgyal blon thams cad 'das/ / da lta bzhugs pa kun kyang 'da'/ / khyod rang gcig pur gang nas sdod/ / de bas chos shig byed nus na/ / rgas pas lus po rgud na yang / / sems la dga' spro'i gdeng zhig yod/ / 'chi ba thog tu babs na yang / / bu chung pha khyim 'gro ba 'dra/ / thabs kyi yang rtse 'di las lhag /sangs rgyas la yang gsung du med/ / mi rgan nga yi snying gtam yin/ / 'on kyang ngas bshad kha na med/ / rang don rang gis bsam blo thongs/ / byas bas gzhon nus legs legs/ / 'on kyang gnyen gyi las don dang / / khang 294

sa / / 'beb gtam ba'abyungacasalang khrigagazhi nom pa'i gtong len sogs/ / bya ba las don 'phro mang bas/ / lo 'gar khom pa mi 'dug kyang / / de rjes nges par chos shig byed/ / de dus nged gnyis 'phrad dgos zer/ / rgad po shin tu ma mgu bar/ / khyod kyi bsam don stongs pa yin/ / lo 'ga'i 'phro nas byed snyam pa/ / nga la'ang snga mo zhig nas yod/ / las 'phro mi rgan kha spu bzhin/ / bcad kin bcad kin je mang yin/ / lo 'ga' lo 'ga' ma tshar ba'i/ / ngang la mi tshe tshar nas thal/ / phyi bshol 'di yis thams cad bsrus/ / khyod la chos kyi re ba med/ / don med kha bshad nyi ma 'phul/ / de bas khyed rang yul du song / / rgad po ma ṇi 'don du chug / byas pas gzhon nu ha las te/ /rgad po rtog dpyod mi gtong bar/ / de 'dra zer lugs gang na yod/ / bya ba las don 'di tsam zhig / bskyur nas 'jog lugs ji ltar yod/ / byas pas rgad pos a ha ha/ / nga la de skad byas chag ste/ / lho phyogs 'di na bya ba'i 'phro/ / e 'grub rtog dpyod mi gtong ba'i/ / rgad po btsan po ma zhig yod/ / de la gros shig e chud ltos/ / de yis hab rgyug byas pa'i nyin/ /rgan gzhon mtho dman thams cad kyi/ / las 'phro rtsi skud bregs pa bzhin/ / zed de bzhag nas 'gro kin snang / / de dus mi skyur thabs med yin/ / gnas lugs mi 'chol dbang med yin/ / nam rkyang bskyur nas 'gro ba la/ / da lta bskyur na don yod yin/ / 'on kyang phan par smra ba dkon/ / de bas de la nyan pa dkon/ / byas pas gzhon nus phyag btsal te/ / bla ma dbu gdugs skor mkhan nas/ / dge bshes che gnyan tsho la yang / / gdams pa 'di las zab mi 'dug / rgad po'i tshul bzung dge ba'i bshes/ / khyed kyis ci gsungs bzhin du byed/ / da dung gdams pa thugs rjes gzigs/ / byas par rgad pos 'o na legs/ / rgad pos ma myong 295

༄/ /gung thang bayo ཿ sgonas gsung ཿma/dgu myong yang / / dang por chos kyi rkang tshugs pa/ / 'di las dka' zhig mi 'dug pas/ / rgas shing 'khog nas yong sa med/ / byed na gzhon pa'i dus 'dir gyis/ / gzhon dus rkang zhig 'dzug thub na/ / rgas kyang lag len sla tshod red/ / chos kyi gnad cig go byung na/ / ci byas chos su 'gro tshod red/ / blo sna ma mang dran thog rang / / 'di nas chos la chig dril mdzod/ / rtsa ba bshes gnyen tshul bzhin sten/ / dam tshig sdom pa mig bzhin srungs/ / 'di snang 'khri ba rbad kyis chod/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan snying po la/ / thos bsam sgom gsum gcig tu dril/ / rgyab brten bsag sbyang la 'bad na/ / sangs rgyas lag pa'i rtse na yod/ / a re dga' la a re skyid/ / bu gces bsam pa 'grub nas yong / / byas pas gnyis ga (ka)gros mthun te/ / de yi nyin mo ring nas bzung / / chos brgyad dri mas ma sbags pa'i/ / dam chos sgrub pa lhur blangs so/ / de ltar rgan gzhon 'char sgo dang / / nyams la dpag pa'i gtam 'di yang / / rang gzhan mtha' dag nyams len la/ / blo kha phyogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig / rang la nyams myong ma mchis kyang / / sems can mos pa sna tshogs par/ / 'di 'dra yis kyang phan srid snyam/ / dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ / 'di'ang rtog bzo tsam zhig ma yin gyi bzhi brgya pa las/ / khyod ring gson pa la dga' zhing / / rgan nyid la khyod mi dga' na/ e ma khyod spyod skye bo ni/ / 'dra la dam pa lta bur 'gyur/ / zhes dang / de'i 'grel ba zla bas mdzad pa las/mi rgan po 'ga' zhig skyed mo tshal du zhugs pa la gzhon nu rnams kyis rgad po khyodagazugs ngan no zhes bzhad gad du byed cing de rnams kyis yun ring du gson par 'dod pa'ang yin te/ de'i phyir de rnams kyi spyod pa ni rmongs pa'i skye bo dang 'dra ba kho na la dam pa ltar 'gyur ro/ / de'i phyir de ltar na 296
༄ 'a obadag nyid kyi sdug bsngal rig pas gzhan 'chi ba na gzhan dag kyang 'di lta bu'i chos can no zhes skyo ba dang ldan par bya dgos so/ / zhes pa'i dgongs pa gsal bar byas pa yin no/ /297

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronaza' gsung 'bum/༄7/ / chig bkra sna tshogs kyi sgor skal bzang mdongs mtha' dgyes pa'i dbyar rnga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/༄wa/ / de'ang ji skad du/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ khyod ni rnam dpyod lus mdzes shing / / dar dir legs bshad mgrin pa'i dbyangs/ / ma lus mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ / rin chen rigs pa'i do shal 'phyang / / zhes gsungs ba ltar 'jigs med rnam par dpyod pa'i lus rtsal yongs su dzogs pa'i blo grogs kyi lang tsho dar la bab cing / skal bzang rna ba'i dpyid du 'jo ba'i legs bshad kyi glu dbyangs snyan po dar dir sgrogs pa'i smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs su mtho ba/ dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i yid la dga' ba mchog tu ster ba'i mdzes rgyan bla na med pa rgyal ba'i bka' la drang nges 'byed pa'i rigs lam dri ma med pa'i nor bu'i do shal phon po'i 'jo sgeg 'chang ba'i mkhas mang lha brgya'i mdun sa mchog 'dir/ 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i rol gar ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gzugs su bsgyur ba/ bkra shis dge mtshan bye ba'i dpal dang ldan pa'i grags snyan ba dan dkar po srid pa gsum gye bla na g.yo ba de nyid kyi dus mchod khyad par can dang 'brel bar/gro zhun zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i ring la rlabs chen smon pa'i mthu dang lhan cig gtong ba'i sgo brgya yongs su phye bas bsnyen bkur phul du phyin pa'i thog mdo sngags thub bstan yongs kyi gzhi 298

sa / /tshogasakra /tshogagarten kun gsal yangs pa'i go 'byed rmad byung thos bsam gling / rtsa bshad rgyud sde'i 'od stong spro bas rim gnyis padmo'i dga' tshal 'byed pa bstan pa'i nyi ma smad rgyud rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde/ rig gnas bsil ba'i zer brgya spros te gzhan dang thun mong min pa dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad srol kun da'i mdzes pa 'dzin pa e waṃ chos 'khor gling / legs byas chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i klong nas yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i char gyis lus can gdung ba sel ba gso rig gzhan phan gling bcas kyi dge 'dun thams cad gdan 'dzom ste/ legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston nyin re bzhin du bstar ba'i dge pa 'di dag gis mtshon/ rang gzhan skye 'phags kun gyis sgrub pa'i rnam dkar legs byas phung po/ bsod nams ye shes zung du 'jug pa'i tshogs gnyis spyod pa rgya mtshos bsdus pa'i dge ba'i dngos po/rab yangs phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i mtha' dang mnyam pa ji snyed cig bsags pa mtha' dag gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas/ legs nyes blang dor lta ba'i blo gros kyi 'dren byed ma rig pa'i ling tog gis ldongs ba'i 'gro ba mgon skyabs gling dang dpung gnyen med pa mtha' dag srid zhi'i mtha' dang bral ba'i theg pa mchog gi lam bzang brgyud de/ ye shes lnga ldan sku bzhi'i pho brang nyams dgar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan ston pa mchog tu bdag cag rnams myur ba nyid du 'gyur ba dang / ji srid bla na med pa'i go 'phang mchog der ma son pa'i tshe rabs kyi 'phreng ba kun tu'ang / mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan rten bzang rim par blangs te/ 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i rnam rol rje btsun bla ma yab sras kyis 'bral med rjes su bzung nas legs gsung bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis lus stobs gsos te/ nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba mtshan bcas mtshan med lam rim pa gnyis la sogs pa'i 299

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgroname'i ga4 ཿma/mdo dang sngags kyi bstan pa'i gnad don ma tshang ba med par thos bsam sgom pas nyams su blangs nas sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus dgyes par byed pa'i kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gye phung po phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu spro bar 'gyur ba dang / de ltar rang gis ji bzhin khong du chud cing tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba'i lam gyi gnad ma lus pa bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i shugs kyis yongs su bskyod de/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi thabs la mkhas pa'i gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi snang ba 'bum du 'gyed pas lus can snying gi mun pa yongs su bsal nas phan dang bde ba'i pad tshal cir yang bzhad pas thub bstan nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon kun ring du gsal bar 'gyur ba yin par thal/ de ltar yin no zhes pa'i tshul dang po de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ der ni ring du 'bad las tshogs gnyis ni/ / mkha' ltar yangs pa gang zhig bsags pa des/ / blo mig ma rig gis ldongs 'gro ba rnams/ / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang por bdag gyur cig / ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / / tshul gnyis pa de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ der ma son pa'i tshe rabs kun tu yang / / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ / bstan pa'i rim pa kun tshang lam gyi mchog / rnyed nas sgrub pas rgyal rnams mnyes byed shog / ces pa'i gzhungs 'di byung / tshul gsum pa de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ rang gis ji bzhin rtogs pa'i lam gyi gnad/ / shugs drag brtse bas drangs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ / 'gro ba'i yid kyi mun pa bsal byas nas/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring 'dzin/ zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin phyir/ /de'ang ji skad du/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i nyi ma mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ mkhas pa kun gyi zur phud la/ / bka' ye (yi) rtse 300

sa / /tshogabakra gatshogagadaga' bgyis pa khyod/ / dpal ldan phyogs rnams thams cad las/ / rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gser sbyangs rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i shugs kyis 'jigs bral chos kyi srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i zhabs sen gsar ba'i zla mas dpyod ldan dran dbang bye ba'i gtsug phud rtse mor ngal gso 'ing / smra ba ngan pa'i g.yul ngo mtha' dag bcom ste 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i ring lugs mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs pa mkhas grub bye ba'i bsti gnas rmad du byung ba 'dir/ grwa tshang bzhi'i dge 'dun mtha' dag 'al lhan cig mngon du gyur te/ dad ldan sa 'dzin bye ba'i rtse nas mchod bkur na bun spro ba'i chu 'dzin stug po mngon par 'khrigs/ rta 'dur dbyangs dang bcas pa'i mngon chos 'brug sgra snyan po dal gyis bsgrags/ rigs lam dri ma med pa'i 'phel gtam glog 'od gser gyi zhabs mngon par g.yo/dga' ba'i mig yangs gyen du g.yo ba'i mdongs mtha' rnams ni rjes su yi rang zlos gar cir yang bsgyur ba'i dge mtshan mtha' dag gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas/ srid zhi'i nad brgya sel ba'i sman gcig don gnyis legs tshogs nor bu'i 'byung khungs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i 'od kyi snang bas ma khyab pa'i phyogs kun tu mngon par 'phro zhing / gang du khyab kyang cung zad nyams pa rnams kyang skyes mchog bstan pa'i bdag po snyeng rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur ba rnams kyis slar gsos te lus can yongs la phan bde'i sgo brgya 'byed par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par du'ang sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i phung bo/ zab rgyas lam gyi gnad kun yongs su rdzogs pa byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i srol bzang nyams med dbyar gyi chu mtsho bzhin du rgyas te/ thar 'dod kun gye 301

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i ga4 'bum/yida'i nges par legs pa'i dpal yon sbyin pas rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ma lus bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang / lam bzang 'di nyid sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sdongs grogs lhur len pa'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu rnams kyi gzi byin dpal 'byor rgyas shing / sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyang tshe bsod stobs 'byor mnga' thang snyan grags thams cad gong du 'phel ba dang / tshe rabs kyi 'phreng bar yang lam bzang 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i skal ba mchog dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin par thal/ de ltar yin no zhes pa'i tshul dang po de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ bstan pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'am/ / khyab kyang nyams par gyur ba'i phyogs der ni/ / snying rje chen pos yid rab bskyod pa yis/ / phan bde'i gter de gsal bar byed par shog / ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gnyis pa de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i rmad byung 'phrin las las/ / legs grub byang chub lam gyi rim pas kyang / / thar 'dod rnams kyi yid la dpal ster zhing / / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ring du skyong / zhes ba'i gzhung 'di byung /tshul gsum pa de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ lam bzang bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub byed cing / / 'gal rkyen sel byed mi dang mi min kun/ / tshe rabs kun tu rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ / rnam dag lam dang 'bral bar ma gyur/ ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ /de'ang ji skad du/ smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po'i zhal nas/ rigs pa'i nyin byed khyod drin las/ / gangs can blo gsal bung ba'i tshogs/ / mtha' dag bstan pa'i pad tshal du/ / gsung rab sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston myong / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bshad sgrub sprang rtsi'i ro la rjes su chags pa'i blo gsal rkang drug tshogs kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi rten dam pa rgyal 302

dag ཿdzabagabastan padma'i dga' tshal rigs lam dri med 'od kyi snang bas 'byed pa'i nyin byed stong phrag 'bar ba'i 'dun sar brgal brtag cung zad bgyis pa sogs legs byas klung bgrogacig tu 'khyil ba'i dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i mthu la brten nas/ kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen de nyid kyi tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang / mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab/ gzhan phan gye mdzad pa/ mkha' khyab kyi 'phrin las sogrus bsil ba'i zer gyi rang bzhin rnams gdul bya'i snang ngor yang sngar las g.yo ba med cing / mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan gyi cha shas slar yang gsar du tshes pa'i mchog sprul zla ba gzhon nu 'dzam gling bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde kun da'i gnyen du 'gyur ba dang /tshul de la brten nas rnam dag bslab gsum ldan pa'i dge 'dun tshogs kyis gnas 'di yongs su gang ste/ bshad sgrub bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal bstan rin po che yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas chos spyod bcu yi dpal gyis dge legs gos dkarabyin pa'i yul gru kun kyang bstan la dga' ba'i lha klu rnams kyis chos bzhin bskyang4te/ rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston bkra shis rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis khyab par 'gyur ba yin par thal/ de ltar yin no zhes pa'i tshul dang po de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ thugs mkhyen rab mdzad spyod 'phrin las sogs/ / 'od dkar po'i bsil zer ma 'gyur yang / / sku'i cha shas gsar du tshes pa yi/ / mchog sprul pa'i zla ba myur du byen/ / zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gnyis pa de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ bslab pa gsum ldan ngur sprig 'dzin pa yi/ / 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gnas 'di yongs gang zhing / / rtag tu bshad sgrub bya bas srid mtha'i bar/ / thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung /303

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i sgonatse'i ga4 ཿma/tshul gsum pa de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ gang tshe theg pa mchog la chos spyod bcus/ / tshul bzhin sgrub la brtson pa de yi tshe/ / mthu ldan rnams kyis rtag tu grogs byed cing / / bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs kun khyab/ ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ /de'ang ji skad du/ snyan ba'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na grags/ /dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra bsgra sa pa/ / zhes sogs kyis bshad pa ltar/rang don gyi yon tan dam pa nyes ltung rnyog ma'i rdul dang bral zhing lung rtogs yon tan gyi rgyan 'phreng mdzes pa'i grags snyan ba dan dkar po 'jig rten gsum gye bla na g.yo ba/ gzhan don gye yon tan dri ma med pa'i lung rigs seng ge'i ngar skad dbyangs su bsgrags pas smra ngan yongs kyi snyems pa phrogs nas thar 'dod ri skyes mtha' dag rjes su skyong bar mdzad pa/ srid pa gsum gyi dkon pa'i nor mchog bshad sgrub chos kyi bang mdzod 'phags chen 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ rang cag gnyis kyis yon tan ma lus pa'i gzhi rten lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i snod dam 'byung khungs lta bur gyur ba dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i don las brtsams nas 'bol gtam cung zad bgyes te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bslab gzhi dkon mchog snod/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su dbye bar bya/ / zhes 'phags pa nye bar 'khor gye rnam par thar ba'i rjes su zhugs pa 'dis thog drangs/ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs chabs cig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas mkha' mnyam skye dgu yongs la phan bde'i lam bzang mtshon pa'i dmigs bu rgyal ba'i nyi ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byon nas legs par bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spyi dang /khyad par phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod/ nang phyin drug gi nyams len/ gsang 304

༄/ /tshogabakya tshogagab rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sogs bstan pa'i gnad kun rdzogs pa 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i lugs bzang gser mdog btso ma lta bu bde legs kun gye 'byung gnas gcig pu 'di nyid dar rgyas yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas chos sde chen po 'dis mtshon mtha' dbus kyi dge bdun rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing / nyon mongs pa'i dgra sde gdung bar byed pa'i dka' thub dam pa sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan dang /bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len sogs sgrub pa'i mchod pa gong du 'phel ba'i dbang gis rang cag rnams kyi mgon du bsam bzhin byon pa'i 'phags chen dam pa gong sa thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po rje btsun blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas sogs skyes mchog dam pa rnams sku tshe rdo rje'i khams su brtan pa'i zhabs sen bkra shis pa'i ri mo 'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan du 'grogs te bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa ba tshugs par 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas rang cag rnams kyang tshe rabs kyi 'phreng bar bstan pa'i gces mdzod tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rgyan dang ldan zhing / mang du thos pa'i dpal gyis brjid pa sogs bshad sgrub ya ma bral ba bka' gdams gtsang ma'i rnam thar lhur blangs pa'i stobs kyis ring por mi thogs par yang srid phra rags kyi rgya las rnam par grol te/ theg pa mchog gi dgra bcom bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang mngon du byas nas 'gro ba kun kyang zag med bde ba'i dga' ston mchog la 'god par 'gyur ba yin par thal/ de ltar yin no zhes pa'i tshul dang po de nyid ston par byed pa la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung ba bde/ / chos bstan pa yang bde ba yin/ / zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gnyis pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba ste/ / mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub 305

༄/ /gung ca bstan yo 0ma'i gsung ཿma/bde/ / 'phags pa rnams ni mthong ba bde/ / dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa bde/ zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gsum pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ tshul khrims ldan pa mthong ba bde/ / mang du thos pa mthong ba bde/ /yang srid rnam par grol ba yi/ / dgra bcom pa dag mthong ba bde/ / zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ /de'ang ji skad du/ mkhyen pa mkhyen pa'i gter la 'gran byed cing / / bzang pos thugs rje'i lha dang zhi dul gyes/ / u pa lir 'gran dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshogs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkhas pa'i yon tan gzhung brgya'i de nyid 'byed pa'i mkhyen rab mkhyen gter gzhon nu'i dpal la 'gran cing / btsun pa'i yon tan zhi dul gtsang ma'i rnam thar 'phags pa nye bar 'khor gyi mched zla/ bzang bo'i lhag bsam 'gro la rjes su chags pas 'phags mchog snying rje'i lha dang gnyis su med pa/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bdag nyid thos bsam sgom gsum gyi pha rol tu phyin cing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i 'phags chen 'dus pa rgya mtsho gser gyi ri bo'i phreng ba lta bu tshar du dngar ba'i mdun sar rang cag gnyisakyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi rtse mo/ rgyal yum rnam pa gsum gyi dngos bstan stong ba nyid kyi rim pa rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i shing rta chen po klusgrub yab sras kyi bzhed gzhung rgyal ba gnyis pas nyin mo bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pa zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung las brtsams te 'bel gtam cung zad bgyis pa 'dis mtshon/ dus gsum rnam dkar phung po gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas/ rnam 'dren thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs bskyed dang ting 'dzin sgyu 'phrul bye ba'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams nas mgron du bsus pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu rgyal dang rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 306

sa / /tshogabaku tshogagabastan 'gro'i dpal du byon pa thams cad dang / khyad par dge ldan bstan pa yongs kyi bdag po kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang po yab sras gnyis dang yang sgos rang cag rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med nyi ma'i zhal snga nas yab sras sogs zhabs zung g.yo med rdo rje'i khams su brtan cing / nges don zab mo'i dbyangs dang rgya che ba'i sa lam sogs legs gsung chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor te skal ldan thar 'dod yongs la phan bde'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad pa dang /tshul de la brten nas klu sgrub lugs bzang zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dang gsang chen rdo rje theg pa zung du 'jug pa rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi gdams pa'i nying khu dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs bzang kun gsal yangs pa'i 'khor lo log rtog chu 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yogs kun dang bral zhing /bshad sgrub nyi zla zung gis 'khyud pa'i 'od snang rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab par 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas mkha' mnyam ma rgan 'gro ba mtha' dag bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lha lam yangs por thabs shes zung 'jug gser sbyangs 'khor lo'i dgrod pa la brten nas sa bcu lam lnga rim gye bgrod de/ sku gsum gye go 'phang dam pa 'chi med dbang po'i nor bu'i khri 'phangs mthon po la myur ba nyid du 'khod par 'gyur ba yin par thal/te ltar yin no zhes pa'i tshul dang po de nyid ston par byed pa la/ thub dbang rdzu 'phrul bye bas mngon phos pa'i/ / rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal sras til gang tshogs/ / nges don zab mo drug cu'i dbyangs snyan gyis/ / tshim mdzad skal ldan bye ba'i mig 'byed shog / ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung /tshul gnyis pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ klu sgrub lugs bzang kun gsal 3(37

༄/ /yo ca bam pa'i sgronayo ga4 ཿma/stong ba'i mkha'/ / lta ngan sprin tshogs stug pos mi snang ba/ / thal 'gyur rnam dpyod rlung gis rab phye bas/ / stong ba'i mkha' dbyings thub bstan cher gsal shog / ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gsum pa de nyid ston parabyed pa la/ 'dir 'bad dge bas ma rgan 'gro ba kun/ / zeg chen zung 'brel nga las nu'i 'khor los/ / legs byas lam lnga'i them skas rtser son pas/ / sku gsum lha dbang gdan la myur spyod shog / ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ / de'ang ji skad du/ khrims ldan blo gros sder mo'i gdengs ka yis/ / sred pa'i tshang tshing bsrung ba'i nyon mongs sbrul/ / nyer bcom grags pa'i ba dan 'dab ma'i rlung / / ri bo ral ba'i sgra ldan dpa' ba'i sde/ / zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rnam dag khrims kyi gzi brjid ser skya'i me 'od lang tsho rgyas shing / rnam dag blo gros rno ldan sder 'phreng g.yo ba'i gtum drag shugs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag mya ngam srid pa'i tshang tshing las 'don pa'i go skabs 'phrog pa'i chags sogs nyon mongs nag po'i sbrul gdug phye mar 'thag pa'i snyan pa 'dab zung g.yo ba'i sgra skad stong phrag dbyar gye rnga gsang gcig car rgod pa'i sgra la co 'drir bgyid pa dran dbang 'dus pa 'bum sde'i mdun sar/ rang cag gnyis kyis dpyad gsum dag pa'i rigs pa rlung gi shing rtas rgyal ba'i dgongs zab dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i pha rol phyin gzhung zla shel/'gro ba'i legs byas shar ri'i rtse mor drangs pa'i dge tshogs la brten nas/'jam dbyangs mthon mthing lcang lo gser sbyangs khu bas bran te rang mdangs dmar ser gos kyi zol la brten pa'i yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs bzang dri bral sbrang rtsi'i dog pa mtha' dag phyogs kyi 'dab ma'i khor yug yangs pa'i ngos la grub pa'i ro brgya mngar bzhin phyi mtha'i bar du chags 308

༄ / /tshogabakra tshogagapar 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas dge ldan chos kyi srid la mnga' bsgyur rgyal dbang grags pa'i mu khyud mchog gi gtsos/ bshad sgrub sum rtsen dga' tshal skyong ba'i mkhas grub nye dbang tshogs kyi zhabs skyes dmar ba'i lang tsho skye dgu'i bde 'tsho'i dpyid du brtan cing 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i 'od kyi 'jug pa mtha' dbus kun tu rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas ma pham rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'phags yul shar ri'i rtse mor 'phags rte gsungagasang 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed ba'i mod la bdag yid 'ching ba'i sbub rgya grol te/ bslab gsum ge sar rgod pa'i bcud kyis mtha' klas lus can mtha' dag tshim par 'gyur ba yin par thal/ de ltar yin zhes pa'i tshul dang po de nyid ston par byed pa la/ bdag gis ji snyed bsags pa'i dge ba'i 'dis/ / bstan dang 'gro ba kun la gang phan dang / / khyad par rje btsun blo bzang grags pa yi/ / bstan pa'i snying po ring du gsal byed shog / ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gsum pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ nam zhig rdo rje gdan gyi ri bo'i spor/ / byams mgon nyin byed dbang po shar ba'i tshe/ / bdag gi blo gros padma kha phye nas/ / skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs rnams tshim byed/ ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ /de'ang mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal pos/ mkhas pa kun gye zur phud la/ / nas rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dran dbang bde 'byung bye ba phrag brgya'i ral pa'i zur phud la zhabs sen zla ba'i myu gu drag tu bzhad pa'i rtse dga' ltar byed cing / dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i lung rigs 'od dkar dra ba 'bum du 'gyed pas rgya mtsho mtha' dag gi mtshams kyi tha gru yangs pa'i phyogs kyi 'khor lo kun la dge legs kyi gos dkar ci yang sbyin par mdzad pa rgol ngan log par smra ba mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal ba'i 309

༄/ /ca ca bayo pa'i 0sa khrung 'bum/grags pa'i ru mtshon srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs pa zla bral mkhas pa'i dbang po 'bum phrag gdan 'dzom pa'i chos kyi gdan sa chen po 'dir/ drang nges rnam 'byed yin na/ rang cag gnyis kyis rnam 'dren stobs bcu mnga' ba yongs kyi thugs bcud/ zeg gsum 'phags pa'i skye bo kun gyi gshegs bshul 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi bzhed gzhung / gsungs rab ma lus pa drang nges kyi tshul du gtan la phab ste/ bstan pa'i snying po de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa'i sgon me/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung gi yang snying /drang pa dang nges pa'i don gyi bstan bcos chen po'i don las brtsams te/bsam gzugs yin na/ rang cag gnyis kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan kun gyi rgyur bsngags shing / zeg gsum 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs ma lus pa'i gzhi rten/ rnal 'byor dbang po mtha' dag gi gshegs bshul/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi go cha bgos pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams lam gong ma gong mar 'jug cing 'dzegs pa'i tshul 'jug sgrub dgu'i thog mar gsungs pa las 'phros te bsam gzugs stoms 'jug gi rnam bzhag rten 'brel yin na/ rang cag gnyis kyis zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes lugs 'byung ldog gi rim pas kun byang gi gnad mtha' dag ston byed kyi spyi sdom chen por gyur cing / bden pa bzhi'i tshul gyes thub pa'i gsung gi gces mdzod chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa mtha' bral dbu ma'i de kho na nyid dang don gcig tu gnas pa'i chos kyi de nyid zab mo rten 'byung gi rnam gzhag las brtsams te/ rigs pa'i glog 'phreng brgya ldan dal gyis bzhad pa'i lung gi 'brug sgra zab mo/ blo gsal mdongs mtha'i snyeng la mngon dga'i dpyid du gyur ba du ma spros pa'i dge tshogs 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar legs byas klung 310

༄/ /tshogababargyagacig tu 'dril ba'i mthu la brten nas rnam 'dren rgyal ba kun gyi bde chen snying rje'i sgyu 'phrul gcig tu bsdus pa'i rol gar bsil ldan ra ba'i ljongs kyi skye dgu'i phan bde'i rtsa ba/ sa steng gi thub pa'i bstan pa yongs kyi mnga' bdag gong sa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po che ge'i zhal snga nas kyis gtsos sa steng gi bstan 'dzin dam pa rnam zhabs zung g.yo med gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje'i khams ltar brtan cing / rnam dkar 'phrin las kyi snang ba chu gter ska rags can gyi 'dzin ma'i khor yug kun tu khyab par 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas phyi tshangs spyod kyi cha lugs ngur smrig chos gos gsum gyi 'dab ma mngon par mdzes shing / nang bslab gsum gyi nyams len sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar mchog gis gtams pa sde snod gsum gyi legs bshad rkang drug myos pa'i glu dbyangs brgyud mar sgrogs pas rgya mtsho'i gos can yangs pa'i khyon 'dir bshad sgrub kyi sde ji snyed cig mchis pa'i nang na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor tog bzhin mngon par 'phags pa'i chos kyi sde chen po 'dis mtshon phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing /'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang nam yang nyams pa med pa'i mthu la brten nas dge ldan lugs bzang 'di nyid mtha' dbus kyi 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba dang / tshul de la brten nas bdag kyang rtag tu bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon dang bcas shing /dpal a ti sha dang 'jam mgon bla ma'i rnam par thar pa bzhin thos bsam sgom pa ya ma bral bar gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blangs pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' dag bde blag nyid du khong du chud de/ yang dag pa'i lam gyi lus rtsal yongs su rdzogs nas rang gis ji ltar nges pa bzhin du skal ldan gdulakhya'i tshogs la spel ba sogs bshad sgrub zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas blo 311

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgonama'i gsung 'bum/bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs kun tu rgyas par byed nus par gyur ba yin par thal/ de ltar yin no zhes tshul dang po de nyid ston par byed pa la/gangs ri'i ra bas skor ba'i zhing khams 'di'i/ / phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang che ge rgya mtsho yi/ / zhabs padasrid mtha'i bar du brtan/ zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gnyis pa de nyid ston par byed pa la/ bslab pa gsum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi/ /nas phyogs bcur rgyas/ zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / tshul gsum pade nyid ston par byed pa la/ mdor na bshes gnyen dam pa mnyes byas nas/ /thub pa'i dgongs pa rnyed pa'i mang thos kyis/ / sgrub pa'i bya ba legs par mthar phyin te/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed/ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ /312

ras / / ra /re/jebangathab go༄/ / yul mchog dman du ma la phul ba'i springs yig gi skor sgra don rgyan gyi rol mcho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / bkra shis gang zhig rnam 'dren rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bkra shis gang zhig lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ / bkra shis gang zhig rig grol 'dus pa'i sde/ / bkra shis dge mtshan me tog char du snyil/ / bkra shis 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs zung gis/ / bkra shis rdul 'phreng bkod pa re res kyang / / bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs kun 'gengs bzhin du/ / bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gling du chibs bsgyur bar/ / bkra shis dga' ston 'phel byed bsu pa'i gdong / / bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs dang bcas/ /bkra shis ri mos mtshan pa'i lha dar 'di/ / bkra shis phun tshogs zla tshes dge bar phul/ /rnam grol zla ba nor bu'i me long ngos/ / ga'an phan ri dwags gzugs kyi 'jo sgeg can/ / srid zhi'i dge mtshan ri bo'i zur phud dang / / mdza' gcug bsil zer 'dab 'phreng bzhad pa'i drung / / thugs rje'i 'dzum dkar spro ba'i zhal gyi zla/ / 'gog med rtag tu 'char ba'i yid kyi mtsho/ /dga' dang skyo ba 'dar ba lhan cig pas/ / zhu 'phrin rlabs kyi phreng ba mchod par 'bul/ / 'gro kun phan bde'i gdugs dkar rtsibs ma stong / /rdzogs pa'i lte ba rgyal dbang 'phrin las kyi/ / snying por zhugs pa'i yu ba rab 313

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'itshonas gsung 'bum/brtan nyid/ / thub bstan nor bu'i tog kyang rang gir 'dzin/ / cher snyigs grang ba'i gdung ba rim bsal te/ / thugs bskyed nam zla dus su smin pa las/ / dbus 'gyur chos srid dbyar gyi lang tsho'i dpal/ / rab rgyas snyan pa'i 'brug sgra phyogs brgyar rgod/ / de tshe mdo smad nags kyi khang bu na/ / rang mkho'i sgro gdugs bskor bas mngon rlom zhing / / grong chog bhi ṣas 'tsho ba'i mdongs mtha' yang / / dga' ba'i gar stabs ling ling bsgyur bas brel/ / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i nyi ma yab sras kyi/ / bka' drin 'od rnon zer gyis phye ba yi/ / yab rje'i mchog sprul padmo'i ge sa ra/ / skal bzang rkang drug yongs kyi dpyid du smin/ / snang brnyan lha dar snam bub zung dang bcas/ / gnang skyes bzang po'i khur gyes non bzhin du/ / mnyes gshin bka' yi lcags kyus rjes bzung ste/ / spro dga' ling ba'i gar gyis phyag bgyid do/ / slad kyang rgyal bstan nyin mo'i snang ba ni/ / gang gi rjes 'gro gzugs sku nam mkha'i nor/ / skye dgu'i bsod nams mkha' la rtag 'char ba'i/ / thugs bskyed lhod pa med pa'i bka' drin zhu/ / bdag kyang srid pa ya nga'i 'phrang brgal te/ / gtan bde byang chub mchog gi btsan rdzong du/ / 'jug pa de srid thugs rje'i dpung tshogs kyis/ / bsrung skyob nam yang g.yel med brtse bas gzigs/ / rta tshag rje drung rin po che la phul ba'o/ /bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lte ba ru/ / gsang ba gsum gye rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i mthar/ / blum por 'khril ba snying rje'i mu khyud can/ /skyabs gcig chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs padmor/ / nyi mas ma yin sor mos ku mu da/ / rnam 'gyur nor bu'i gdegangs ka 'dzin pa'i gtsug / lan brgyar btud pa'i lha phyag mdza' na mor/ / kun dga'i don ldan snyan 'gyur 314

sardo / / rig /sa/gdabyangs kyi 'bras/ / ye shes a darsha ngos 'gro ba'i khams/ / bkra ba'i ri mo rang rig ljon pa sogs/ / 'dod dgur ston pa pha mtha' klas pa'i tshad/ /bzung bar mi spyod gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ / mkha' lding 'dab mas ma bsgralagaser ri'i phreng / / nyi ma stong phrag bdo ba'i dpung pa can/ / kun gyis phyag byas cod paṇa g.yo ba'i rdul/ / zhabs skyes chu mthongs 'gog pa'i char sprin bzhin/ / ma smad grags pa yangs pa'i sgra brgya yis/ / yon tan ral khur gsig pa gzhan grags kun/ / bcings sam klong du sim zhes gya gyu'i rgyar/ / bkod kyang rmongs la ral gri'i rno rgyun lo/ / rgyal dbang mchog tu grub pa gdengs ka las/ / mi mngon dbyings nas zab gsang glur len na/ / gdugs dkar rtsibs stong ldan pa'i grib ma de/ / 'jig rten dbang phyug thub dbang la yang bsil/ / rtsen no rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /'chad dang rtsom pa'i 'dzum dkar spro bas te/ / rtsod ngag ral gri'i 'khri shing g.yo bas kyang / / bdag pos brtul zhugs nyid du lhag par dgongs/ / kye ma ma la mu tig 'khri shing rtse/ / me tog phreng bas ma bzung brang 'gros bzhin/ / cung zad thos pa'i 'bras bu bsgrub pa las/ / g.yeng bar 'phyan pa bdag gi ngang tshul lags/ / rgyal bstan dar bar lung bstan byang dang po/ / 'phags yul ming don rim bgrod ngal gso'i stegs/ / rna ba'i grags 'bar dbus 'gyur ma la yar/ / byed po tsardon ljon pa mgon khyod tsam/ / de slad dag pa gnyis ldan chos sku'i khams/ / 'gro blor mtshon pa'i gzugs sku dbang gzhu'i mdangs/ / nges pa lnga ldan rtag pa'i rang bzhin du/ / 'gog med 'char ba'i bka' drin lhod med zhu/ / ring nas kha ba'i ro bda' yid kyi shing / / nges 'byung byang sems mngar ba'i rang ba'in du/ /byin gyis rlob byed bu ram bcud 'chang ba'i/ / bka' yig thigs phrang 315

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/brgyud mas lce bar mdzod/ / dri bcas khams dang byang chub dri ma med/ /mchog tu ring ba shar nub nam mkha'i mthar/ / brtse chen dgu tshigs zhags pas 'khyud pa'i gar/ / ye shes nyi ma chen por mtshams sbyor mdzod/ / khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku ye shes bstan pa rab rgyas kyi zhabs drung du phul ba'o/ /phun tshogs legs byas 'bum gyi dga' tshal du/ / rmad byung thugs bskyed sa bon smin pa las/ / dge legs 'dab 'phreng ba'ad pa'i dpal yon can/ / skyabs gcig padma dkar po'i zhabs drung du/ / gang gi mdzad bzang chu 'dzin dkar po'i klong / / re ba'i mig 'bur gtod pa'i mdongs mtha' ma/ / sor bcu'i sgro gdugs spyi bor bkod byas te/ / tshang tshing dben pa'i ljongs nas 'di skad gsol/ / kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer 'bum phrag gis/ / rgud pa'i mun pa ming gi mthar byed cing / / thub bstan pad tshal rgyas mdzad nyin mo'i mgon/ / gzi byin snang ba lham mer bzhugs lags sam/ / shis pa'i zla snang rol bas mtshan pa yi/ / 'phrin las phan bde'i rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ / yid 'ong snyan par grags pa'i rlabs kyi phreng / / kun gsal pha mthar spro bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ / srung ba thugs dam rdo rje'i yu ba brtan/ / bag yod mdzad bzang dar gyi sham bu bkra / gzhan phan bsil ba 'bebs pa'i gdugs gar po/ / srid zhi'i bla na 'khor bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ / dad ldan ge sar rdul phreng khyod zhabs la/ / chags pas bsod nams sbrang rtsi'i dpal 'dzin zhing / / zab mo'i chos dang phan pa'i bka' mchid kyis/ / snyan dgu'i rol mo 'khrol ba'in bzhugs lags sam/ / grong dang dgon pa'i ri gling khor yug tu/ /sbrang char snyoms par 'bebs pa'i rdzogs ldan sprin/ / dal gyis bskyod de 316

ris ji/ / dang /jigangar bgarang gnas bkra shis kyi/ / chu gter g.yas su 'khyil bar phyogs lags sam/ / 'di na mnyam gzhag gnyid kyi ting 'dzin dang / / lto 'grangs nyi mar sro ba'i rjes thob gnyis/ / spel mar spyod pa'i dge sbyong rgan po yang / / sos bde snang ba skyid pa'i ngang du mchis/ / slad kyang dge sems myu gu ches phra ba/ / nyams myong dpag bsam sdong por grub pa'i slad/ / byin rlabs thugs rje'i drod gsher gyis skyong zhes/ / gsol 'debs yid kyi re ba 'bras ldan mdzod/ / rgyu skar rang gis nya ba'i zla ba bzhin/ / bstan la ri mor bya ba'i rang skal gyis/ / rab byung ma nu'i 'phreng ba'i thog ma yi/ /bgrang bya gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ston du/ / tshe yi dpal ster lhag pa'i lha rnams mi zad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun sbrengs/ / bstan srung mtha' dag bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i gad rgyangs sgogs/ / lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub rnams shis brjod me tog char du bsnyel/ / bdag kyang dge mtshan 'bod pa'i g.yab dar dri bral lha rdzas mchog 'di phul/ / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i thog ma'i me yos lo gsar gyi skabs skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che tsha kho phyogs su chibs bskyod de bzhugs pa'i skabs phul pa'o/ /ka ma la dang nyin mor byed pa bzhin/ / kha tsam min par 'dun pa brtse gcig gis/ / ga na bzhugs kyang re ltos 'cha' ba'i yul/ / nga yi skyabs gcig dam pa'i zhabs pad mor/ / ca co'i stong 'ur g.yeng ba'i 'gro bsdad sogs/ / cha tsam bshol yang da dung sgrub phugs na/ / ja sogs 'dod srid rtogs pa 'og 'gyu'i 'phrul/ / nya bzhin 'khyug pa de yis mchid 'di gsol/ / ta le'i bla ma paṇa chen bog to sogs/ / tha mal tshul bzung 'dren pa mchog rnams dang / / da lta thugs yid gcig 'dres dge mtshan gyi/ / na bun mngon par gtibs bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ / pa ra mi ta'i 317

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'itshonama'igasung las/dgongs don las brtsams te/ / pha mtha' yas pa'i lung rigs brgal brtags kyi/ / ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs pa yis/ / ma lus mkhas pas bsngags bzhin bzhugs lags sam / / rtsa 'grel mtha' dpyod dang bcas 'dzin skyor sogs/ / tsha grang khyad du bsad pa'i dka' thub kyis/ /dza ya'i dgongs don zhib mor dpyad pa yis/ / wa le thugs la 'char bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /zhwa ser bstan pa'i 'byung gnas ma dros mtsho/ / za zi'i g.yeng ba'i rnyog ma dang bral zhing / / 'a 'ur lung rigs rlabs 'phreng bzhad pa'i klong / / ya mtshan mgrin rnga 'khrol bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ / ra ba khor yug rdo rje'i srung 'khor gyis/ /la 'ur nag phyogs bdud sde'i g.yul zlog cing / / sha tsha gus ldan slob 'bangs ltos bcas kun/ / sa thob bzhin du dga' bdes tshim par mdzod/ / ha ri tsardon mdog 'chang lha dar bcas/ / a re nyams dga' dgyes pa skyed pa'i phyir/ / gus ldan gus pa'i zhu mchid 'bul lags na/ / mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol/ /7'di'ang snga mgyogayosu sa sbrul lo phul pa'o/ /brtse chen nyi ma 'bar ba'i gdengs ka yis/ / zhun mar phab pa ye shes bdud rtsi'i chab/ / mtshan dpe'i chu mtshor 'khyil pa dge mtshan gyi/ /rlabs phreng phyogs kyi 'khor lor bzhad pa'i drung / / yid dbang dad pa'i sbrang char khur gyis non/ / ngag gi gsol 'debs snyan pa'i 'brug sgra rgod/ /lus kyi 'dud phyag glog gi rol rtsed bcas/ / mchid 'di gsol la thugs rjes yud tsam dgongs/ / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs rje bsdus pa'i dpyid/ /rgyal bstan 'dren par bzhengs pa'i gzugs kyi sku/ / srid zhi'i gtsug tor rtse mor rab 'phags pa'i/ / gzi byin snang ba lham mer bzhugs lags sam/ / mkhyen rab sngo bsangs sde la rgyal ba'i bka'/ / rgyan drug 318

das / / ra /ji nga/sababamachog gnyis gzhung gi chu ldan 'phreng / / brgal brtag rtsod pa'i nga ror glal ba yis/ / sa gsum dkyil 'khor 'gengs bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ /'di na skyabs mchog thugs rje brtsan po'i mthus/ / nyer 'tshe kyo bas lus la ma bzung yang / / ring nas srid par skyon mang goms pa'i sems/ / tshas kyis ma bzung btang stoms tsam gyi ngos/ / dbus 'gyur grags pa mtho ba'i ba gam rtser/ / gser mdog dpal gyi gzi 'bar du ntusti / / lung rigs dbyu gus bskul ba'i snyan pa'i sgra/ / rna ba'i bdud rtsir re bas gdungs bzhin par/ / gnas lnga rig pa'i cod paṇa ma snyigs pa/ / ye shes gzi chen lang tsho rgyas pa'i zhal/ / snying rje'i 'dzum gyis dkar ba zla ba'i mched/ /mngon du 'gyur ba'i nyin zhag bgrang zhing mchis/ / dpal ldan thub pa'i mkha' 'gro brgyas rtsen pa/ / de nyid gting mtha' yangs pa'i chu gter ngogs/ / mkhyen dpyod gzings kyis bsgral ba'i rgyu mthun 'bras/ / sa gsum skyes kyis 'gengs pa nor bus gtams/ / mi 'jigs spobs pa'i rang bzhin chos kyi rnga / / legs bshad rol mor che ba snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /ma rig srid pa 'khor ba'i g.yul bcom pas/ / thar pa rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ba mtshon/ / ming tshig brjod pa ma 'khrul brda sprod pa/ / brgal brtag smra ba'i rtse rgyal rigs pa'i rje/ / lung chos sde snod 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug / zhabs sen nor bu'i 'od kyis shis par sgrubs/ / gnas gsum shes bya'i 'khor lo 'dzin ma'i mthar/ / gnag pa'i rmongs pa mun pa'i phra men ma/ / gnod byed rigs pa'i 'od rnon ral gri yis/ / gnad du bsnun pa don gyi mngon spyod mdzod/ / smra ba dag gi gter grol zla ba'i zhabs/ / zhi dul gtsang ma'i rnam thar rin chen gsal/ / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gnas rgyud chen sogs/ / kun gyi mdzad pa'i rol gar gcig tu sgyur/ / mkhas 319

༄/ /yo ca gas pa'i sgonayo gsung 'bum/pa'i mkhas pa kun kyang gang gi bka'/ / mi 'gong mi yi khyu mchog gnas thob pa/ / 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po rim byon gyi/ / rnam thar rang gir bzhes pa'i bka' drin mdzod/ / bskyud med dngas sems zla ba'i me long ngos/ / skyabs gcig ri skyes mtshan ma rtag 'god na/ / skye zhing skye bar byin rlabs ga bur rgyun/ / skyug pas bdud rtsi'i gter du bdag grub mdzod/ /sems nyid gdod nas dag pa'i dbyings kyi mkha'/ / khams dang byang chub shar nub phyogs kyi char/ / thugs rje'i 'od zhags ring pos 'khyud pa yi/ /ye shes nyi ma chen por mtshams spyor mdzod/ / zhu 'phrin rab dkar dad pa'i 'o mtsho ru/ / thugs rje 'khor lo'i lag can rol pa'i rten/ / dri med lha rdzas dar gyi rlabs 'phreng can/ / rab myos dbyar gye dus tshes dge bar 'phyur/ / 'di'ang skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog sprul rin po cher lcags rta'i lo phul ba'o/ /blo bzang chos tshul yangs pa'i mkha' ngos la/ / mkhyen brtse'i 'od kyi dra ba 'bum 'gyed pa'i/ / smra ba'i nyi ma sa gsum skye rgu'i gnyen/ / bka' drin mtshungs med dam pa'i zhabs pad mor/ / gsang gsum 'od brgya 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyes/ / gtsug rgyan sor mo'i kurdo zum pa dang / / lhan cig dang ba'i 'dab brgya bzhad pa yi/ / snyan tshig sbrang rtsi'i dog pa mchod par 'bul/ / rgyal kun ye shes li khri'i rdul gyi tshogs/ / snyeng rje'i dkyel 'khor gcig tu rdzogs pa yi/ / nyin mor byed pa gang gi thugs rje ni/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i pad mo kun gyi dpyid/ / srid 'byor ri dwags mtshan ma chos brgyad kyis/ / bsil ba'i 'jig rten rmongs pa dga' byed tshe/ /lung rigs tsha zer spro ba khyod mthong nas/ / phyogs lhung ku mu da tshal zhum pa bzhin/ / dge ldan rang lugs gser bzang 'od kyi gos/ / phyogs kyi 320

ras / / ra /ji ngatha tegadapal mor bgos pa'i rked skabs na/ / mi mnyam grags pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa yi/ / skal bzang rkang drug g.yer kha'i phreng ba 'khrol/ / dpal 'byor 'khor 'bangs tshogs pa'i lding khang du/ / rang khyim gsal ba'i sgron ma grangs mang yang / / ris med 'jig rten kun tu khyab pa yi/ / legs byas snang ba'i gter de khyod kho na/ / ji sred thub bstan kun gsal bu mo ni/ / thugs rje'i 'dzum rlabs 'od kyis yongs bzung ba/ / de srid skye dgu'i legs byas padmo'i phreng / / kun dga' rgyas pa'i ge sar bzhad par 'gyur/ / de slad sri zhu'i rlabs phreng rol pa yi/ / rgya mtsho'i rked bcings rgyal bstan 'dzin ma'i rgyan/ / mkhas grub gser ri'i phreng ba mdzes pa'i spor/ / srid pa'i mig gcig bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog / de ltar gsol 'debs dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i glu/ / bka' drin sbrang rtsi'i chang gis myos pa yis/ / grwa slob bung ba'i 'phreng ba mgrin gcig tu/ / sgrogs pa'i dus ston dar ba'i dga' ba mtshon/ / khyod mthu nyi ma 'bar ba'i gdengs ka yis/ / yab rje'i thugs bskyed padmo kha 'bus pa/ / myur ba'ad sbrang rtsi gsar ba'i dus ston yang / / brgyud mar 'byung snyam rab dga'i glu dbyangs len/ / de lta'i zhu 'phrin dga' tshal du/ / nyi 'od zer gyis reg pa'i rten/ / bkra shis dar gyi 'dab yangs can/ / tshe mtha' yas pa'i me tog 'dzum/ / 'di ni thu bkwan rin po che dgung lo drug cur phebs pa'i ba yar skabs su phul pa'o/ /bde gshegs gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis khyim/ / grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gling du 'char ba'i 'gros/ / mkhyen yangs go la'i lam las mi 'da' ba/ /legs byas yongs kyi go 'byed mchog gi drung / / rtag tu khros pa mi rtag srin po'i khar/ / yongs bzung srid pa 'khor lo'i lto ba ru/ / rnam 321

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ཿlhanama'i sa 'a4/g.yeng rtsed 'jor rol ba'i btsun gzugs shig / snyan tshig ma li ka 'phreng skyes su 'bul/ / mdo rgyud legs bshad nor bus gtams pa yi /dbyangs can ngag gi longs spyod shing rta che/ / sgra don rgyan gyi 'khor lo gnyis ldan gang / / 'dren la zla bral mkhas pa'i ded dpon mchog / phul byung thugs bskyed pir gyis bris pa yi/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad bzang tshon brgya'i ris/ / skal bzang bsod nams ka shi'i ras bzang ngos/ / bkra bas dpyod ldan yongs kyi blo mig 'phrog / zab rgyas yon tan phung po'i chu khur gyis/ / sgeg ldan snying rje'i sprin sngon g.yo ba'i gar/ / grags pa 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyis rol pa mo/ / dpal 'byor glog gi do shal rtse dga' 'dzin/ / de yi ngo mtshar dge ba'i snying po can/ / bka' yig bdud rtsi'i char gyi zegs ma yang / / dad pa'i myu gu gsar ba'i yid kyi zhing / / rab dga'i sa ru bskrun pa'i dpyid du smin/ / 'di na sngon dge'i chu mtsho las skyes kyang / /yon tan sbub stong kha dog mdzes pa'i dung / / chos kyis sde chen du ma'i khang bzang rtser/ / gzhan dbang snyan pa'i nga ro sgrogs shing mchis/ /chos kyi rang bzhin gtsug lag rig pa'i glu/ / ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ / gzhan phan spyod pa zlos pa'i gar dang bcas/ /rgyal bstan do ra'i rgyan du rtag brtan ngos/ / rgya chen mkhyen rab rta mchog kha sgo las/ / dal 'bab nyams 'gyur rlabs kyi phreng ldan ma/ / kun rmongs 'khrud pa'i cho ga rdzogs pa yi/ / bka' drin mi bskyud rtag pa'i rang bzhin zhu/ /'degs mtshon lha dar dri med/ cod paṇa/ gos yug bcas zla tshes dge bar 'phul/ garma si tu pa la phul ba'o/ /mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin dmar ser li khri'i rdul/ / yang dag rdzogs pa 'jam mgon nyin mor byed/ / ngo mtshar 'bum du 'gyed pa'i 'od snang 322

ra ji/ / ba phuga'i/ste pas yegagis/ / blo gros 'dab brgya khong nas rgod par mdzod/ / ma smad yon tan ke sa (sar)rab myos pa'i/ / grags pa snyan sgrogs bung ba'i phreng ba can/ /bslab gsum 'dab rgyas sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan mchog / thub bstan do ra'i mdzes rgyan de yi drung / / khyod dang kun gzhi'i rang ba'in gcig gyur kyang / / byed po ma brtags 'khrul bas tha dad lus/ / rnam 'phrul gdung ba'i ri mo 'dzin pa des/ / 'phrin yig rang bzhin gsal byed gtam 'di lo/ / tshogs gnyis bisha garma'i mdzub rtse yis/ / legs bres gzugs sku ngo mtshar bkod pa'i gter/ / 'dod khams dbang mo dgyes pa'i rang bzhin mtshor/ / phun tshogs kun tu shar ba'i rol pa las/ / ke la sha mchog dha na ka ṭa gar/ / zab gsang stong pa'i sgra las drangs pa yi/ / rten cing 'brel 'byung rigs pa gdong lnga'i dbyangs/ / dngos 'dzin glang po'i klad 'gems gtam de snyan/ / glog 'od 'gyu ba'i ther bubs rtse mo'i grangs/ / lha dar dri bzang dag shog snga phyir bcas/ / longs spyod 'khor lo rkang ba drug pa'i tshang / / rdol las snyan sgog gsung 'phrin rim par 'byor/ / de tshe ldem ldem lus kyi rkang rten rtser/ / dga' ba'i gar bsgyur yid kyi tha ga pa/ / sna tshogs 'gyur ba'i gom stabs g.yo ba des/ / rnam dkar gos bzang sgrub pa'i 'dun par mchis/ / nyi zla kha sbyor mi shigs ga 'u'i dkyil/ / gtum dragakhro bo'i 'khor lo 'khrugs pa'i spubs/ / haṃ yig thig le rgyas pa'i utpa lar/ / grib ma gnyis pa'i grogs po khyod min su/ / brgya phrag 'phags bod gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnad/ / 'thad pa'i phyogs su nyer bkug dbang bo'i gzhu'i/ / rgyud las ma 'phos ngo mtshar nyag phran gyis/ / dran dbang ma lus lhan cig 'dar bar mdzod/ / gang la brten na mang thos dzam bu'i 'bras/ / bla med bde ba'i ye shes mchog gi rgyu/ / gser sbyangs dag pa'i 323

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgroname'i g.yo ཿma/khams su sgyur byed pa/ / khrims kyi chu mtsho bri ba med par mdzod/ / mdor na 'dzig rten lugs kyi mthun 'jug dang / / lha chos thos bsam sgom pa'i bgyi ba kun/ / las 'bras phra thig rgyal bas btab pa las/ / nam yang 'da' ba med par shad kyis skyongs/ / de ltar mkhas pa'i khri 'phangs mtho yi ri mo mkhan gyi las zam min/ / shes rgyud dul ba'i spyod pa btsun gyi sems med sder bzo'i snang brnyan min/ / rgyal ba dgyes khrel nges don yin gyi snyigs dus skye bo'i snang tshul min/ / de slad chos sems sbrel bas gtan 'dun 'chug med mdzod cig snying gi bu/ / zhu 'phrin dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i dbyar gyi rnga/ / ngang tshul gsal ba'i bde 'thung rgyas pa can/ don bzang sbrang char snying por 'dzin 'di'ang / / khyod thugs 'dzin ma'i gsos su smin gyur cig / deng dus phal cher lag pa'i sring mda' yis/ / 'phrin yig bteg pa'i bzhin ras rnam par 'gyur/ / khyod spyan bung ba sbrang rtsir zhugs pas thugs/ / dga' bas gang bar 'gyur snyam bdag gis bris/ /mkhan po sangs rgyas rdo rje'i mchog sprul rin po cher phul pa'o/ /rang khyim mtshan mo'i sgon me tsam min par/ / 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i lugs bzang gar khyab tu/ / thub bstan bya ba'i 'dab brgya rgyas byed pa'i/ / nyi mar mtshan gsol don mthun mchog gi drung / / thos bsam tshe na nyams len thed la bor/ / sgrub la phyogs tshe dkor gyi sgrib pas non/ / rga bas gzir bas snying la dga' bral yang / / 'phral la bder 'tsho de yis 'phrin 'di gsol/ / dbang 'byor 'phrin las nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ / dbang skur byin rlabs 'od rnon 'bum 'gyed pas/ / dbang phyogs skye dgu'i dad mos 'dab brgya'i tshal/ / dbang med phye ba'i dri bzang dge bar 'thul/ / skal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa/ / skal 324

ras / / ra :re/bye ngathab gabazang rnam 'dren stong gi snang brnyan ni/ / skal bzang bsod nams zhing du bskrun pa'i gtam/ / skal bzang yongs kyi rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ / bya dka' don che smra bsam las 'das pa/ / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i tshul/ / bya ma rta yi ngag las thos pa na/ / bya na bzang pos ngoms ba'in mchog tu sim/ / dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa de yi bkas/ / sa gsum bstan pa'i nyi mar lung bstan la/ / rnam gsum 'khor lo'i mdzad bzang 'bras bu yi/ / tshul gsum rtags kyis nges pa deng 'dir rnyed/ 'ari na mthong chos ri bo spo mtho'i ngos/ / lus sems rtsal gyi gom pa nyin re bzhin/ / dal med thur du bab kyang rtser phyogs pa'i/ / bgrod pa 'gal 'du'i gom 'gros byin pa 'dar/ / mthun snang bgrang byar kun la grags pa yang / / 'tsho ba'i dngos la glog gi mched zla dang / / 'byon bzhud cha la bskal ba'i ring ba yi/ / snang tshul mtshungs min srang la 'phyang mo nyug /dīrji tram̐de nghru ༷ tt+waṃba~Xd chen ma~X rjo sdi/ ༷༵/ba /ga~Xdīd ṭwāṃnis tt+waṃm ༵༵sa ma ༵bhe rnams/ / gong nas gong du spel ba'i bka' drin mdzod/ / 'al bzang mthong na dga' ba bdud rtsi'i 'od/ / 'dren byed kun dar 'grogs pa dga' ba'i dpyid/ / lhag bsam smon pa 'bras bur grub pa yi/ / ngo mtshar 'gog med rjes su gzung yang 'tshal/ / zhwa 'phrin rba rlabs rnam pa 'gyur ba'i mtshor/ / spyan ras ngang ba'i rgyal po rol ba'i rten/ / 'jam sprug rgyan kyi 'dab drug dri bzang can/ / bkra shis dar gyi rlabs 'phreng bcas te phul/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan yangs pa'i srid/ / skyong ba'i thugs bskyed phyag rgya'i lung / / mtha' dag rgya mtsho'i mtshams su spro/ / gang gi 'bas stegs 325

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgron ཿ khrung 'bum/nor bu'i khrir/ / dang ba lan brgyar 'dzin pa can/ / mang thos dge spyod rgan po yis/ / yid la brnag pa'i zhu mchid kyi/ / nor bu'i phreng ba lhug par spel/ / jo shāka zhabs sen byin rlabs kyi/ / gzi 'od 'bar ba dbus 'gyur gyi/ / ljongs su bde bar phyag phebs pa'i/ / gtam snyan rna ba'i bdud rtsir son/ / sngon dus yid bzhin rgya mtsho las/ / ded dpon nor bu len pa'i srol/ / da dung brjod pa ma nyams 'di/ / don la grub pa'i bka' drin mdzod/ / grags pa'i gsang tshig sde kyog gis/ / nges legs sgrub pa dbye dka'i lcags/ / rnam grol thub pa'i thugs gsang mdzod/ / rdzogs pa'i dpal la dbang bsgyur zhu/ / sa gsum shes bya'i gnas gnon pa'i/ /rigs pa'i gom rlabs ring po ni/ / khengs dregs stobs ldan mgo bo la/ /'god pa'i snyems pa rang gir 'tshal/ / go don rags pa'i rdul tshon dang / / tshig rkyang dwangs gsher chu yis kyang / / rnam dpyod kha bsgyur mi nus pas/ / go rigs zung du sbrel ba gnad/ / bka' pod rtsa ba'i cang shes rta/ / yab rje'i legs bshad sga srab can/ / mtha' dpyod lcag gis bskul byas na/ / rgyal bstan thang la dkyus thag chod/ / rtsa 'grel gzhung la ma reg pa'i/ / ngag rgyun zer zlos tsam zhig ni/ / rang brla lcag gis bral pa yi/ / byes pa'i rta rgyug a thang chad/ / 'bras dkar srungs pa'i sprin klong nas/ / rtsod pa'i glog 'phreng rol ba'i gtam/ / phyogs kyi 'khor lor glal ba la/ / mdongs mtha' rgan re zhing mchis/ / mgul chings dar gye bkrag mdangs la/ / ltos min bdud rtsi'i nang bcud can/ / bshes gnyen bum pa bzang po las/ / rnyog bral gtsang ma'i chos rgyun bzhes/ / gzhung lugs nyi tshe'i rgyal phran tshogs/ / bzod dka' thub bstan rgya mtsho'i bka'/ /'dzam gling khyab pa'i spyi lung gis/ / dregs ldan ral pa sa la snyil/ / mdor 326

das / / ༄ /je/ngathab gon lhag bsam rang bzhin brtan/ /mang thos yal ga brgyar bres pa/ /gzhan phan 'bras bus yongs dud pa'i/ /dpag bsam dbang por grub par mdzod/ /zhwa ser bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tu/ /tshe mtha' yas pa ltar brtan cing / /mdzad 'phrin dar ba'i rten 'brel gyi/ /gser mdog tshe sku'i lha dar bcas/ /shākya'i dge slong sdom brtson mang du thos pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes phul/ /tho'u bkwan mchog sprul rin po cher phul ba'o /༅ma ཿ rgob bcu gnyis pa skye la la bzhi stong go drug yod pa'i bye ba nyis brgya zhe ga༅ pa chu 'dzin ryāng zhes bya ba'i pasta rasaryās pa'o//rdosbyosbyosmyoṭwāṃjisirnoyibyegaco//spyadzi/ / saṭīdro3 lha/ / snyo/ ༵rdoshtsa3/sa/ saspra ༷ 327

༄/ /yo ca bayo yo ryā ga 'bum/dbyangs kyi rgyal mo rol pa'i dzing bu las/ / mos pa'i 'dzin byed zung du btud pa yis/ / myong ba med kyang 'chu ba gzar bus bzhin/ / snyan tshig bdud rtsi'i mchod yon skyes su sbrengs/ / kun khyab phyogs mtha' bral ba chos kyi dbyengs/ / lhan cig skyes dga'i nyi 'od kyis 'khyud pa'i/ / smin byed snang ba 'bum gye gter grol ba/ / dus mthar rdzogs ldan padmo'i dpyid du shar/ / thub chen bka' yi klung brgya gcig car du/ / gzhal bzod bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'dis/ / rig byed klog pa'i rtsal dang bsam gtan mthu/ / grub pa'i drang srong chen por rjes su dpog / nyes spyod dri ma yongs spangs thos bsam gye/ / 'od chags bshes gnyen mughi ga 'phreng yang / /'dren pa nor bu'i mdud 'dzin gyis spa ba/ / de tsho thub bstan sgeg mo'i mgul na mdzes/ / phul byung rnam dpyod lcags kyu'i gdengs ka yis/ / rtse dga' bag med skye bo'i nya chung dang / / khengs ldan glang po'i sde yang dbang byed na/ / gus pas yongs su bsnyen rnams smos ci dgos/ / deng dus cher snyigs mun pa 'thib pas phyogs/ / gar bltas gnag pa'i klong na 'phrin las kyi/ / glog 'od 'gyu ba khyod nyid gcig pu yis/ / yid la dge legs snang ba byin pas sim/ /'di na go skabs yangs pa'i yid kyi mkha'/ / dge blo thun mtshams snang bas mtha' brten yang / / 'di snang mun pas bags kyis bkab pa na/ / chos brgyad skar ma'i 'phreng ba phyi bzhin gsal/ / don min phyogs pa'i las rlung stobs po ches/ / bslu brid bya ba zin med rlabs kyi 'phreng / /rim par gnyer bas dal 'byor gzings stod pa/ / mthar byed na kra'i kha sgor gzhug gis dogs/ / 'on tang snying la sim pa'i skabs bral yang / / gzugs sgra 'dzin pa'i yul du 'gog med pas/ / mthong thos don 328

ra / / ra /je ngathababagaldan bde gshegs bden pa'i mthur/ / re bas rang sems spro ba bskyed cing mchis/ / slad kyang rgyal dbang grags bstan gdugs dkar po/ / srid zhi'i bla na 'khor ba'i byed po ru/ / zhabs pad g.yung drung gshis su brtan pa yi/ / thugs skyed brtsan po'i go cha lhod med ngos/ / 'jam dbyangs gdengs can rtse dga'i rol pa 'bum/ / mkhyen rab rgya mtshor bsgyur las 'chad rtsod rtsom/ / kun rmongs gdung ba gcod pa'i ral gri yi/ / 'khri shing rlabasakyi 'phreng ba gnam du rkyongs/ / mdza' gcug yid kyi nor bu chu shel ni/ /'phrin yig zla zer bdud rtsi bran pa yis/ / bsgyud pa'i dri ma yongs spangs dge legs kyi/ / gzi 'od 'bum phrag 'char ba'i bka' drin mdzod/ / sgra don 'dod 'jo'i 'o ma bsrubs pa'i bcud/ / gcam bu'i chu bcangs grog tu dril ba 'di/ / cod paṇa dri med dar gyi skog dang bcas/ /spro ldan zla ba'i dus tshes dge bar phul/ / 'di ni shing bzang sprul pa'i sku rin po che nas snyan ngag gi zhu shog tsurdos spras pa phul pa'i lan du stsal pa'o/ /rgyal gsung beeḍūr rgyud mang ri dwags gzugs/ / nyer 'chang dbyangs kyi rgyal mo kurdo'i gnyen/ / sgrib bral dngas pa'i mkha' la rnam pa kun/ /rol pa'i gar des yid mtsho skyong gyur cig / rab zhi sngo bsangs sde la rigs pa'i lus/ / bcu drug lang tsho rab rgyas rol pa'i rlabs/ / rgyal bstan kurdo'i ge sar gter grol bar/ / brtse ba bdud rtsi'i 'od chags de yi drung / / chos tshul gzigs pa'i thugs dang 'doms pa'i gsung / / gter gyur chos sku'i ngang las ma bzhengs kyang / / 'byor ldan bsod nams zhing du gzugs sku tsam/ / byes pa'i grangs phan gang zhig 'di skad lo/ / ma smad lung rtogs yon tan nor bu'i dpya/ / mu med 'dren pa skye ba'i shing rta 329

༄/ /yo ca gas ཿ sgronayo sa ཿma/mchog / legs byas smon pas legs bsgyur dpal gyi bus/ / sa skyong mchog rigs sā la'i ljongs su drangs/ / ri dbang myos bum mngon dga' sgra ldan chu bo bzhi yi do shal can/ / dbyig 'dzin sa srung steng 'gyeng grags dkar phyogs kyi spring yig spro ba po/ / sa yi 'byer 'jig rigs la brten kyang nges 'byung rtsa ba rab brtan pas/ / zhi dul spyod lam 'khrugs sngon goms dam pa'i bag chags e ma rmad/ / nyer 'tsho bsil zer byed pa 'bum rdzogs shing / / de yi thos bsam na kra'i grong khyer che/ / de las grags pa mu tig 'khri shing ni/ / phyogs kyi tha gru gzhal bzhin bzhugs lags grang / / 'di na las nyon ngal brgya'i chu khur gye/ / khongs las yud tsam glog gi dga' ldan pa/ / grags stong sprin sngon gsogs kyi rol gar mkhan/ / tshul bstan mkhan po'ang 'tsho ba bde bar mchis/ / mtshams 'bras/ slad kyang bstan la dge ba'i snying po can/ / skyon bral 'tsho ba sa ha ka ra'i ljon/ / grags snyan rkang 'thung 'phreng bas mngon dga' ba/ / ring brtan thabs kyi rwa ba g.yo med ngos/ / ke ra la yi na chung lan bu ltar/ / yang dag 'brel la don ldan dge ba'i 'phrin/ / ma bskyud mdza' ba bdud rtsi'i ro bda' ba/ / nam yang chad pa med pa'i dge legs mdzod/ / har chen tho yon mthu stobs nyi ma la'o/ /330

༄/ / 'jasno.ejesangs chagasdeb spyor dbang po rdoje// /ji ga ma — /lag 4 0 ) —— — ༷ / 7 —1 0 / / 7 / gsal byed thog ma'i dbyibs kyi ngo mtshar brdas/ / lung bstan me tog dkar po'i phreng 'thor ba/ / o ṭi ya na gnyis pa'i bste gnas su/ /'tsho gzhes grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba gang / / ka dag rang gsal rig pa'i mkha' ngos la/ / lhun grub zhi khro'i 'ja' sprin 'od lnga'i klong / / las ba'i'i gru char 'jo ba'i ngo mtshar kun/ / rigs pa'i rtsal du dzogs 'di e ma rmad/ / thub dbang rdor sems kun tu bzang po yi/ / zhal lung zeg dgu'i ste rgyal rdzogs pa che/ / mthong ba'i chos la 'od skur grol byed pa'i / snang bzhi'i lam gyi bgrod pa mthar son te/ / mdo sgyu sems sde'i bka' dang zab 331

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i ga4 'bum/mo'i gter/ / dag snang brgyud pa'i man ngag nor bu'i mdzod/ / skal ldan yongs la 'dod dgur bkye ba yi/ / grags pa'i dbyar rnga srid pa'i khong las brgal/ / rgyal kun sor rtog ye shes li khri'i rdul/ / sin ju'i rgya mtshor 'dab brgya'i rtser smin pa/ / dzasbu'i gling na che ba'i rig sngags 'chang / /padma kā ra'i gdung 'tshob khyod min su/ / kun bzang gdod ma'i gshis su kun rdzob kyi/ / ra ris zad kyang kun khyab thugs rje'i 'phrul/ / lnga rig shes bya'i gnas kun mngon gyur pas/ / gsung zin snyan dgur 'khrol de kun dga'i dpyid/ / snyigs ma'i sbyin bdag 'khyog po'i gnam ru dang / /'grogs pas 'phen bzung brgya yis sun phyung ba/ / rmongs pa drang por spyod pa'i nyag phran bdag / dben gnas dong ba'i khrod na bde bar mchis/ /slad kyang rtsa gsum thugs rje'i dga' tshal du/ / lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i dpag bsam ljon/ / byin rlabs rnam pa dang bcas 'bras bzang gis/ /dud pa'i dga' ston srid zhi'i dpal du mdzod/ / snang srid zil gnon che mchog he ru gar/ / bzhengs te yid srub dpung pa mthar byed cing / / snga 'gyur zeg pa nges gsang bstan pa'i bcud/ / spel ba'i thugs bskyed cho ga lhod med zhu/ / bden tshig snyan par sgrogs pa'i rkang drug khyod/ / bdog pa'i skyes kyi 'dab ma bskyod bzhin du/ / mtsho skyes gnyis pa brtul zhugs dbang po'i drung / / byin rlabs dri bsung ldang ba'i tshal der songs/ /ga thog nas dge rtse sprul skus snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i 'phrin yig byung ba'i lan du bskur ba'o/ /modrung / / gang can bstan pa'i srol 'byed padma 'byung / / de don rgyud la sbyor ba a ti sha/ / de la 'khrul ba sel mdzad tsong kha pa/ / rnam 332

ras / / rang deX ngatham khogasum dbyer med tshad ma'i lung gis grub/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan la de nyid dang / / dbyer med paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan kyang / / rnal 'byor nyams myong can gyes legs brtags na/ / chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab par gsungs/ / 'phags yul grub mtha' mang yang kri kri'i mdor/ / gsungs bzhin ston pa'i dgongs par mi 'gal na/ / gangs can grub mtha' tha dad thub dgongs su/ / 'gal bar sgrub pa phyogs lhung gtam du zad/ bla ma lha dang rang sems gdod ma'i gshis/ / dbyer med kun tu bzang po'i bdag nyid kyis/ / rang snang ris med kun tu khyab pa las/ / dgag sgrub sgor ler gcod pa byis pa'i blo/ / gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i bar lag kun 'gyel nas/ / snang srid rgya zeg chos kyi skur rdzogs pas/ / shugs 'byung lta sgom spyod pa'i rtsal 'chang ba/ / rig 'dzin mkha' lding dbang po'i gom rlabs kyis/ / thun mong theg dang tha snyad rig pa'i gnas/ / ri bo stong phrag gcig car bgoms pa na/ / rgyar chad phyogs lhung mkhas rlom mchil ba'i tshogs/ / mu cor sgrogs pa'i snyems pa dbyings su yal/ / dgongs pa'i gnad la smod pa'i chad mtha' dang / / kun la sgra bzhin zhen pa rtag pa'i mtha'/ / spangs te dbu ma'i lam gyes gsung rab la/ / drang nges 'byed pa rgyal ba nyid kyis bsngags/ / snang dang stong ba gtsor 'dzin sems klong las/ / khyad zhugs zung du 'jug pa man ngag gis/ / 'khrul rtog rang sar dag nas rig stong gi/ / ngo bo gcer mthong chos sku'i rgyal sa bon/ / sa rnying bka' dge gang la'ang rang rang gi /chos rgyun ji bzhin 'dzin pa nyin skar dus/ / dngas ma 'od skur grol byed mkhreg chod lam/ / padma'i dgongs bcud 'dzin pa khyod min su/ 'di na 333

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonasa'i gsung 'bum/rtogs pa'i zil mngar ma myong yang / /thub bstan pad mo rnam grol ze'u 'phru'i bcud/ /gcig kyang grub mtha'i 'dab 'phreng sna tshogs par/ / dang ba'i 'dren byed gtod pa'i khul du mchis/ /slad kyang rnga yab gling ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ /zeg pa rim dgu'i rtse rgyal rdzogs pa che/ /gser sbyangs 'khor lo chos tshul rab 'byams kyi/ /rin chen bdun ldan chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ /'di'ang gathog dge rtse sprul pa'i sku la'o/ /mnyam pa'i dṛtta yi ge dgu pa bri hati ste che ldan mal ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi dbye bas lnga brgya bcu gnyis yod pa las prasta ra2 lnga bas mngon par spras pa'o/smyosneXbhertezlohū rsha/spya1 dzālasgo ma ཿ༷waspra1 — /dzñā/ 334

da jo / / dang /bye ngathabadegadabyangs snyan 'azin gyis rab dga'i mchog sbyin phyir/ / dbyangs can dgyes pa'i blo gros bdag gis kyang / / dbyangs bdun rgyud du 'khrol ba'i stan tshig 'di/ / dbyangs kyi rgyal mo gnyis par skyes su 'bul/ / rgya chen lhag bsam yangs pa'i gan mdzod las/ / rlabs chen mdzad bzang dga' ston 'bum bstar te/ / sa chen skyong ba'i grags pa dbyar skyes kyi/ / rnga chen stong phrag ldir ba'i dbyangs de snyan/ / byams brtse'i spyan gyis bu bzhin gzigs pa'i ma/ / ma ga dha bzang gnyis pa khyod drin las/ / las dang skal bar ldan pa'i mnga' 'bangs kun/ / kun dgar spyod pa'i ngo mtshar e ma rmad/ / dri zhim 'dab stong rgyas pa'i ge sa/ / ra yig gnyis pas 'khyud pa'i rtse 'jo bzhin/ / bzhin bzang pho nyas btegs pa'i gsung 'phrin gyi/ / gyi na ba yang rab dga'i sa la bkod/ / 'di na tshang la ma nor rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'di 'drar mjal tshe snying po len dgos kyang / / 'di snang bya ba'i spun pa 'phyar ba bdag / 'di skabs zag phung 'tshe med bde bar mchis/ /tshogs bsags rgya ches mchog gsum bsnyen bkur dang / / tshad med byams brtses nyam chung 'gro ba rnams/ / tshul bzhin skyong sogs dge bcu'i 'khor lo yis/ / tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma'i rtsa ba tshugs/ / de lta'i legs byas kun gyi rten gcig bu/ / de ni mi yi dbang mo nyid lags pas/ / de slad sku yi mthun sgrub gang dgos pa/ / de de bsnyel ba med pa'i bka' drin mdzod/ / bdag 'drar bde chen dbyings su brtan g.yo kun/ / kun dgar bsrung ba'i nus pa dang bral yang / / yang yang yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho la/ / la 'ur gsol 'debs 'phren bcol nan tan bgyed/ / slad kyang bdag cag yon mchod sngar rgyun ltar/ / ltar chags 'brel zab bskyung ba med pa'i gsung / / gsung 'azin pho nya gaṅgā'i chu rgyun nam/ / nam mkha'i 335

༄/ /yo ca gan ༅ me'i khrung 'bum/lam la nyi zla'i 'gros bzhin mdzod/ /zung ldan 'phrin gye rkang drug sgra don 'dab/ /zung du 'brel khyod legs skyes sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /zung la phun tshogs dpal 'byor chos dang srid/ /zung 'jug rgyal khab kun dga'i tshal der songs/ /yi ge dgu pa dṛ ta tī la lnga 4 bcu g.yi pod pa las bāb drug pas nye bar bcings pa'o/ /yas /desemadzarjege /smos )/(( rabang 2 ma / rdo/rku ོ336

das / / ra /sde ngatha degagrags paṭwāṃd 'o/didiracha 'ahūṃ~X ༵nga rdo ngag nga chu rdoX /༷rdo sde/ da/ngad rjiX ༵ nghrudī dpal 'bor sa/ / sa mos gnyen gcig gyur pa de yi drung / / chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i mkhyen klong nas/ / sgra don zung 'jug rgyan gyi nor bu'i 'phreng / / pho nya zung gis legs par sprad pa bzhin/ / ngo mtshar zung ldan skyes kyi gdab lan 'bul/ / dge tshogs bye ba'i chu gter las 'khrungs shing / / dge mtshan cha shas yongs gang mdzes sku'i zla/ / dge bcu'i khrims kyi 'od dkar spro ba yis/ / dge legs kurdo'i dga' tshal gcig car 'byed/ / tha shal snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bdag 'dra yang / / thub bstan kai la sha ri'i rtse mo na/ / theg gsum chos kyi ral ba gsig pa yis/ / thar 'dod ri dwags skyong bar rlom zhing mchis/ / rgyal dang bla ma lha la dad pa brtan/ / rgyal bstan rgyas slad rnam dag lhag bsam 'chang / / rgyal khams mtha' dag ma ltar bskyang byas na/ / rgyal thabs bya ba gang brtsams lag na gnas/ / yi dam dam can rgya mtsho'i bskang 'phrin dang / / tshe sgrub sgrub mchod la sogs srung ba'i rigs/ / sna tshogs tshogs bsags rgya chen bcas bsgrubs na/ / myur bar bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur/ / sku tshe tshe mtha' yas pas byin rlobs shing / / bsod nam nam mkha'i khyon ltar rgya che la/ / snyan grags grags pa'i mu khyud ltar mtho ba'i/ / smon lam lam gsum 'bab pa'i rgyun bzhin byed/ / 'phrin yig pad mtshor bung ba'i spyan/ /spyan zur mngon par rol ba'i rten/ / rten 'brel legs skyes dang bcas pa/ / pa sangs ltar dkar yid kyis phul/ /337

༄/ /yo thang bayo yosgron ཿ 4 4ma/pe/sa zuX/zi )(11 do chaganaste/ cha ོ gu mi skye ba lnga ba'i dbyangs snyan chos kyi sgras/ /'gro drug rmongs pa'i gnyid las slong byed pa/ /lha chos bdun ldan bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kyang / /chos brgyad khol por gyur des 'phrin 'di gsol/ /dge tshogs byed po'i ri mo yongs smin las/ /dge legs tshon brgya 'bar ba'i gzi byen can/ /dge dbang gnyis pa nor 'dzin thig le khyod/ /dge mtshan lha dbang dpal la 'gran pa nas/ /snyan tshig dri bsung mngar ba'i mtsho las skyes/ /skyes bzang sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs bzung ba/ /ba mo'i mdangs ldan dar 338
