sardo / / rang sgo /spyogyis thog drangs te/ / te por son pas yid ni dga' bdes sim/ / 'di na na tshod yol ba'i dge spyong bdag / chos tshul tshul bzhin sgrub par ma nus kyang / / gsung rab rab 'byams thos pa'i sgra tsam la/ / dga' bas bas mthar de don sems shing mchis/ / chab srid yangs pa'i kha lo sgyur ba la/ /chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i mkhyen pa dang / / che chung kun la sman pa'i lhag bsam gnyis/ / chig dril byed pa phan bde'i rtsa ba yin/ / de slad sku yi mthun sgrub mi g.yel zhing / / zhing khams bde bar skyong ba'i mdzad khyab dang / / dang ba'i yid kyis bstan pa'i sri zhu kun/ / kun nas 'gran pa bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod/ / slad kyang brjed ngas dri ma 'khrud pa'i slad/ / dag byed bdud rtsi lta bu'i gsung 'phrin dag / yang yang chad pa med par stsol pa yang / / rjes su dgongs par mdzod cig mi yi rje/ /legs bshad dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i khu byug khyod/ / legs skyes lus 'degs bskyod pa'i gar dang bcas/ / legs tshogs sgo brgya phye ba'i mdun sa cher/ / legs byas rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i ched du dengs/ / chab thog 'di gsum so mang rgyal mo bsod nams sgol ma rgyal bu nor bu nam mkha' bstan 'dzin/sras mo bsod namasadabang mo gsum nalozung ldan gtso bor byas pa lta bu'i snyan tshig gi zhu shog tsurdoyosprayopa byung ba'i lan la 'phral du gnang ba'o/ /rmad byung thugs bskyed gdong lnga 'bar ba'i rtsal/ / rlabs chen 'khor lo gsum du bzhad pa'i byin/ / rgyal bstan kai la sha yi dpal gyur pa/ /mchog sprul smra ba'i seng ge dam pa'i drung / / rna ba'i sgo la thos pa'i lam byang yang / / don gyi zil mngar snying la ma sim pas/ / na tshod gyi nar yol ba'i rgan po yang / / spel legs 'phrin gyi skyes lan 'bul la spro/ / gzugs sku matwon dpe'i lang tsho lta na sdug / legs gsung snyan sgrogus bdud ste rna ba'i 339

༄/ /yo ca bayo rsā 0me'i gsung 'bum/byeṭwāṃ bye/ bhespra/ ṭwāṃṭwāṃ rte/dī ༷ ṭwāṃtrībye ṭīnapa babyeṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ bye ṭwāṃṭwāṃ niṭwāṃX ༵ṭwāṃ/ ༷ /ni ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ba'i tsha gdungs snyigs ma lnga/ / bcil ba'i cho ga rdzogs la rjes yi rang / /slad kyang bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan lha lam ngos/ /'phel ba rtsom pa tshes kyi zla ba bzhin/ / bshad sgrub dkyil 'khor rdzogs la mngon phyogs par/ / re pa'i yid kyi kurdo 'dzum zhing mchis/ / rang don spangs rtogs nor bus yongs gtams shing / / gzhan phan 'phrin las rlabs kyi 'khri shing can/ /dge legs chu gter gting mtha' bral ba'i ngogs/ / srung ba khor yug ri bo'i rten yang 'tshal/ / dbyangs can ngag gi longs spyod grol ba las/ / sgra don nyams dang 'gyur ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ / mdza' gcug 'dzum dkar 'phro ba'i mi na gas/ /snying la mngon dga'i mchog sbyin yang yang stsol/ / zhu 'phrin puṇḍa ri ga'i rtser/ / spyan ras bung ba rol ba'i rten/ / dar gyi ge sar ldem pa la/ / rgya yi ze'u 'brus spras te phul/ /༵ṭwāṃ 'arnyirdem ༷ ṭwāṃhūṃdhi ༷ ༷ hūṃshe /༵ /༷sdi ༷ ṭwāṃm ༵ga/ ni/ṭwāṃ hūṃX / ṭwāṃX bye lang tsho dkor gyis bsgribs/ / sha khrag lus kyi lang tsho rga bas bcom ci yang ma nus chos rdzu'i mkhar ba la/ / 'chel ba'i drang srong rdzun mas mchid 'di gsol/ / mkhas btsun bzang bo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ri dwags mtshan ma can/ / rgyal bstan chu gter spel ba'i gnyen mchog khyod/ / skal bzang bsod nams shar ri'i phrag na mdzes/ /rigus ldan rigus las padma dkar po ni/ / dus mthar dus kyi 340

ras / / dpa /ji ngathab khobyeṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༷ni kṣiṃ bye/baX/ ṭī ༷ tī/ ༷hūṃ/ ༷dzo ༷hūṃ geṭī dīṭwāṃXgo ṭwāṃ ni ༷/dir bsod nams sprang rtsi'i snying bo sdud rtsis padma som nyis 'dar ba bsten/ / ji ltar na'ang dpal 'byor dga' tshal chos kyi snang glus khol ba yis/ / don gnyis lhun grub rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi dga' ston rab rgyas e ma rmad/ / 'di nagatsug nor chu lha'i spyi bor 'phos/ / snying ga'i do shal shar phyogs dbang pos phyogs/ / rgan po mya ngam thang na dgras bcom bzhin/ / rtsi 'ing mang pos bsgor yang ga cig bur skyo/ / khyod sku'i snang ba yid la rtag 'god kyang / / yul gyis bskal bas re shig thabs kyis dben/ / 'on kyang bgrang bya bzhi yi gong ma ru/ / ma phyin mjal ba'i 'dun pa snying la gcag / de tshe gsung 'phrin nyams 'gyur rtsal rdzogs pa'i/ / gzhon nu lha rdzas cod parṇa 'phyang 'phrul can/ / tshur mus rgyags shing mdza' bas dud pa yis/ / yid kyi na chung dga' skyo'i spu long g.yo/ / slad kyang 'jam mgon ring lugs nor bu'i dpya/ / 'dren bzod gzugs sku gser gye shing rta che/ / 'khor lo batsho ldan kyis rol ba yis/ / byang phyogs skye 'gro'i dge lam yangs por mdzod/ / rmad byung lhag bsam nor bus yongs gtams pa/ / lhun grub 'phrin las chu bo rnams bzhi'i mdzod/ / gzhan phan rlabs phreng phyogs kyi mthar spro yang / / srung ba khor yug ri bos bskor ba gces/ / dge sbyong chen po'i cha lugs zhi dul spyod/ / mthong dgu'i rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon skrun/ / don ldan 'tsham pa'i gsung dbyangs chos kyi sgras/ / skal bzang gdul bya'i rna ba bdud rtsir sgrubs/ / 'phral gyi rnyed bkur sgyu ma'i bslu brid ngor/ / lhan skyes dam pa'i rang bzhin mi 'bor zhing / / mi mang cal sgogs 341

༄/ /yo ca shanarsāsgronayo sa las/rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i/ / gtam 'dun bzhed pa'i dam bca' brtan por mdzod/ /tshigs bcad mi snyoms 'theng rkang can/ / skyon yon nye'u 'dzin la brtson/ / zhu 'phrin chu skyar phru gu khyod/ / rab dkar lha rdzas mgrin bsrings te/ /songs dang dpal 'byor tshang tshing na/ / nags kyi bya tshogs ches mang yang / / mtsho 'di'i (ngang ) ba'i rgyal po zhig / gcig pur bzhugs pa'i skyo grogs zhus/ /phul byung yon tan dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa yi/ / bsil zer phreng ba bstan 'gro'i dge legs kyi/ / utpal dkar po'i skyed tshal mdzes pa'i dbyid/ / gang gi zhabs sen 'od kyis reg pa der/ / rgud pa'i kha gdangs dus kyi nor skyong gis/ / bdas te sngon byon dam pa'i khrir 'gom yang / /rnyed pas gdungs pa'i blo mig thur du phyogs/ / skal dman da ri dra yi zhu 'azin ni/ / dpal 'byor ti se'i gangs ri la gnas shing / / nag phyogs bdud sde bsreg pa'i gzi byin 'bar/ /'dzam gling skyong pa mi yi dbang phyug gi /zur phud rtse mor mdzes pa kun da'i gnyen/ / dge ldan ring lugs 'dzam bu na da yi/ / 'od phreng dregs pa'i rol ba lha yi rnga/ / zab gsang yan lag rdzogs pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / sgrib pa'i g.yul ngo bcom pa'i nga ro mtho/ /'di na thun gsum smag gi klong / / gnod pa'i bu yug 'tshub pa yi/ / sde chen mar me'i sdong bu la/ / sprang bu mdza' bas 'khyud cing mchis/ /yab rje'i mchog sprul dam pa'i 'phrin las la/ / sman pa'i gru char re ba'i mdongs mtha' ma/ / gang gi thugs rje'i sprin la mig gtong na/ /dbugs dbyung dbyar rnga'i gdangs snyan gsang mthor sgogs/ /legs byas 'od kyi 'khri shing dra ba can/ / gzugs sku'i nyi ma rtag pa'i rang bzhin las/ / byin rlabs drod du 'bar ba'i bka' yig gi / 'od yangs rtse 342

rardo / / dpa nga /gdags rol ba'i bka' drin zhu/ / 'degs mtshon lha dar/ 'phrug rgun 'brum mdog bcas zla tshes dge bar phul/ ces pa stong skor sprul ba'i sku la phul pa'o/ /rdo ṭwāṃdī ༵ dīdi hrī hūṃ rdoṭī bye /ṭwāṃ/ ༷༷/ ṭwāṃdhritrī rdodiX bhe ṭwāṃ ༷dī /ga /༵ṭwāṃhūṃ pa'i sgor zhugs thos pa'i grangs bsags kyang / / sgon me rlung gis bskyod ltar g.yeng ba yi/ / dge sbyong rgan pos rings nas mchid 'di gsol/ / a don skye med dbyings su bcing grol kun/ / ro mnyam nyid gzigs dmigs med snying rje yis/ / hor sog yul gyi 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal/ / chen por 'god bzhin bde bar bzhugs lags sam/ / bskal ba bye ba phrag brgyar goms pa yi/ / bzang po'i thugs bskyed dus su smin pa las/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa spel pa'i rten 'brel sgo/ / stong phrag gcig car 'byed bzhin bzhugs lags sam/ / bkra shis dge mtshan ri mo g.yas phyogs su/ / 'khyil ba'i chos dung sgra snyan 'dzam bu yi/ / gling 'dir khyab par sgrogs slad phyogs kun tu/ / byon nas gzhan phan 'phrin las spel lags sam/ / 'di phyir phan pa'i don chen ma grub par/ / na tshod yol ba'i dge sbyong rgan po yang / / 'tsho ba bde zhing lus ngag mi dal ba/ / tsam gye dge sbyor 'bad blo'i khul du mchis/ / slad kyang zhabs pad yun du brtan pa yi/ / thabs tshul thugs bskyed go cha mi lhod cing / / gong gi gong du gsol ba'i dgos don gsum/ / gtso bor thugs la zhen pa'i bka' drin mdzod/ /dal 'byor rten gyi dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon/ / dam chos tshul mo3

༄/ /yo ca bayopa'asgronas rsāng ཿma/bzhin sgrub pa'i yal 'dab rgyas/ / don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal bzang gis/ / dud pa'i thub bstan dga' tshal mdzes byed gang / / rnyog bral nges 'byung sems kyi dzing bu las/ / nyer 'khrungs tshul khrims padma dkar po'i tshal/ / bshad sgrub sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi gtams pa ni/ / thar 'dod rkang drug nyer 'tsho'i dpyid du che/ / khyad par rgyal ba'i gsung rab sgo brgya'i lcags/ / nyams myong thur mas nang nas bye ba yis/ / legs bshad gtun pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyis/ / dzogs ldan mgron du gnyer la rjes yi rang / 'di na lhag bsam dkar ba'i dam bca' yi/ / shing bal dge ba'i 'dab ma la chags kyang / / grags skam bser bus brtan pa 'phrog pa yis/ / rtse gcig gtad so bral ba'i ngang du mchis/ / slad kyang chos brgyad shun pas ma gos pa'i/ / nyams myong 'bras bus thugs kyi mdzod bkang zhing /zhar byung 'chad spel bya ba'i 'khor lo yis/ / bstan la ri mor bgyid pa sngar bzhin 'tshal/ / khyad par don gnyis phan bde'i legs tshogs kyi/ / rtsa ba gzugs sku'i mthun sgrub mi g.yel zhing / / gzhig bral srung ba rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi/ / go cha nam yang lhod pa med par mdzod/ / kun mkhyen bla ma'i 'phrin las phyogs kyi mthar/ / spel ba'i lhag bsam grub pa'i skyes bu khyod/ /rnam dkar bzhed dgongs 'grub phyir bdag gis kyang / / mchog gsum rgya mtshor gsol 'debs snying nas bgyid/ /'di ni sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa chen po gu shi tshe 'phel la gnang ba'o/ /thub bstan snang ba'i dpal yon can/ / rnam 'byor nor bu'i gdengs ka yis/ / mngon mtho spobs pa'i gtsug mdzes pa/ / mchog sprul gdengs can dbang po'i drung / / mang thos 'dzin ma'i khyon nyul yang / / myong nges dbul ba'i dā ri dra/ / snyan tshig mgrin pa'i rgyang glu mkhan/ / dge sbyong rgan 344

rasna / / ra /je ngatham gapos mchid 'di gsol/ / bshes gnyen nyin mo'i mgon gyis bzung / /bzang po'i bag chags 'dab brgya grol/ / dam pa'i rang rtags dri bzang can/ / skyes mchog padma dkar po khyod/ / chos 'dul spyod pas kun tu gtsang / / rim gnyis rnal 'byor sbrang rtsis gtams/ / skal bzang bung pa'i nyer 'tsho ste/ / thub bstan dga' tshal rgyan du gyur/ / dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho las/ / 'phos pa'i 'phrin yig ngang mo dkar/ / dar gyi sru sdug bkra ba yis/ / dpyid kyi dga' ba mtshon pas spro/ / slad kyang thos pa'i rgya mtsho chus mi ngoms/ / rnam dag khrims kyi shel la dri ma min/ / bstan 'gro lhag bsam khur du mi 'bral ba/ / sngon rabs dam pa'i rnam thar rang gi mdzod/ / de skad mgrin pa ri bo'i zom/ / las 'ongs 'phrin gye chu rlabs 'phreng / / bsgyud pa'i dri ma sbyong byed de/ / sim pa'i mchod yo na nyid du spros/ / rten bcas tshes dge ba la/ /bkra shis dge mtshan su sti'i sgrar drangs pa'i/ / snyan brjid lha yi rol mo 'bum dang bcas/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gis/ / byin rlabs a stiṣiñtsa'i chab sbrengs te/ / mnga' thang rtsibs stong rdzogs pa gser sbyang gi / 'khor lo 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i byed po ru/ /mthon mthing nam mkha'i dbyings nas dbang bskur ba/ / mi rje lha yi rgyal po mchog gi drung / / tshul khrims du kū la yi ras dkar 'chang / / gzhung mang thos pa'i bzlas bajod mthar son cing / / snyan tshig ril ba'i mchod yon 'gyed mkhas pa/ / drang srong rgan pos shis brjod 'phrin 'di gsol/ /sngon bsags bsod nams ma smad yongs 'du'i khams/ / mtho ris yon tan yal ga'i phyogs rdzogs pa/ / dpag bsam dbang por grub pa'i dge mtshan gyes/ / rgyal srid yangs pa'i do ra mdzes gyur cig / tshe dang ye shes mo5

༄/ /yo thang bayo ཿ sgronama'i ga ཿma/'od kyi gdengs ka yis/ / 'chi bdag dpung ba'i ka ba mthar byed pa/bde ldan mgon sogs tshe yi lha rnams kyis/ / mi shigs rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba tshugs/ / longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter grol ba/ / nor sbyin dbang po rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ / me tog gtsug phud rta bdag brgyad sogs kyis/ / phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phywa g.yang stsol/ / padma kura'i bka' rtags rdo rje yi/ / ri mos gtsug mdzes bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / sngon nas bsgrubs shing mchod pa'i re ba bzhin/ / bar gcod g.yul las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon sgrengs/ / tshangs dbang drag po la sogs lha chen dang / / dga' bo nye dga' la sogs klu chen po/ / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gnas bdag tshogs bcas pas/ / sde 'bangs rab rgyas nor 'dzin gang bar mdzod/ / srung zhing skyong pa 'go ba'i lha lnga dang / / khyad par dgra lha chen po bcu gsum gyes/ / dpal rtsal gzi brjid snyan pa'i grags pa sogs/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal skyed cig / ti sa'i gangs kyi spo na srab med du/ / 'phyo ba seng ge dkar mo'i ngang tshul bzhin/ /bsnyengs bral 'jigs pa med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ / dgra sde zil gnon gzi chen 'bar gyur cig / yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam yongs 'du bzhin/ / gang brtsams rnam par dkar ba'i legs byas kun/ / yid bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yis/ / chos srid zung 'brel dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / ces dge legs su byed pa'i snyan tshig gi phreng ba sngon du bstar te gleng ba skabs kyi don ni ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung 'phags yul gye bstan pa'i bdag po rim par byon pa rnams dang / bsil ldan gyi rwa bas bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir sngon gyi lo paṇa rim par byon pa mtha' dag khyad par du 'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍi ta khu dbon dang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po 346

das / / ra /ji ngathababagasogs bstan 'dzin dam pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa mtha' dag bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po re la mchod yon du 'brel ba las chos srid zung 'brel gyi legs byas sgo brgya byes te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa sha stag yin la/ yang sgos kun mkhyen 'jamadabyangayobazhad pa'i rdo rje skya'aphreng rim byon kyang 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pas nub bal bod kyi mtshams nas shar rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar slob ma dang sbyin bdag tu gyur pa sha stag yin cing / de'i nang nas tsha ba kha gsum rtsa ba so mangs rgyal khab 'di nyid skra dkar sgrol ma nas bzung yon mchod thun mong ma yin par gyur/nged la'ang de skabs nas 'brel yod pa'i thog bdag mo rin po che 'di nyid kyis sri zhu bsnyen bkur tshad med pa byas pa'i sbyin bdag gi rtsa bar yod stabs/ da lan sa'i dbang phyug dam pa nyid mchog gsum rin po po thugs rje dang rang gi sngon bsags bsod nams kyi dpung pa brtsan po dus su bdo ba la brten nas yangs pa'i rgyal khab chen po'i srid skyong bar 'byon rgyu'i skor rten 'brel legs lam phun sum tshogs pa lhun gyisagrub par byung ba'i dga' dar 'bul ba'i ched mngags kyis gtong ba'i 'os yin na'ang / nged rang da skabs ri khrod pa lta bur byas te g.yog dang khal rta mang po rten skyelakhyasamed pa'i gnas tshul rgyus yod rnams la gsal ba bzhin lags pas/ bla brang chen mo'i legs dar 'bul mis 'thus rtsis su byas te rten mtshon byed tsam du bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas/ 7mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa'i gser sku/ khe bi su'i bzhugs gdan rgyal yol sogs kyi skyes dang bcas pa 'di so mangs rgyal bu gsar ba nor bu nam mkha' bstan 'dzin rgyal sar 'khod pa'i khri 'don skabs stsal pa'o/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar gcig car phye ba'i rgyal khab yangs por 'jigs bral gdong lnga'i tshul du spyod pa mi'i dbang phyug mchog gi drung du/gcig tu rnam par dkar ba'i yid kyis zhu ba/ / skyabs gsum nor bu'i gdengs ka g.yo ba med pa'i 'od kyis spyi bor snang ba'i dge legs byin cing /chab 'bangs bde skyid 'dzin ma'i khyon yangs 'degs pa'i snying stobs kyi go 347

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronas gsung ཿma/cha ma smad pa la zhugs pa/ dpal skyong sa'i dbang phyug chen po nyid nas/chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i mdzad bzang / rgyal thabs mtshungs pa med pa'i rtsibs stong byang chub mchog gi 'bras bu'i lte bar rdzogs pa'i gser sbyangs 'khor lo gcig gis sa bya'i gnam lo smin pa 'bras ldan du grub par mdzad pa las/ slar yang bgrang bya gsar ba'i dga' ba mngon par bzhad pa'i dus ston gsar du tshes te/ snga ma bzhin gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal khab tshun chod la mdzad bzang snying po can gyi snyan par grags pa'i dge legs kyi gos dkar ci yang byen pa'i grib bsil la chab 'bangs mtha' dag bde bar ngal gso zhing / de mthus mi'i rje nyid kyi mnga' thang mtshan jus sogs kyang yar zla ltar 'phel te/ ma dros mtsho dang gdengs can bdag po'i tshul du rje 'bangs mtha' dag rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal la spyod par gyur cig gu zhes smon pa'i tshig gi rjes su 'brel ba'i legs skyes brda mtshon tsam du lha dar zung bcas phul/ jun wang snga lo pe cing nas 'khor te phyi lo yang bskyod dgos pa'i mtshams kyi lo gsar du phul ba'o/ /sku dang ye shes dbyer med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / dam pa'i don dang brdar btags chos kyi lam/ / jeg gsum 'phags tshogs mi phyed bden pas kyang / / 'jig rten skyong ba khyod la shis par sgrubs/ / chos nor 'dod thar sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar brgya/ / gcig car phye ba'i rgyal khab gangs kyi spor/ / bsod nams rnam smin ral ba gseg pa yi/ / mi rje gdong lnga'i dbang bo de yi drung / / dge ldan lugs bzang gser gyi 'khor lo'i shugs/ / 'dod dgur sgyur ba ha sa badzra gyi/ / 'bas rdul bsten pa'i bus pa bdag gis kyang / / snyan tshig nor bu'i phreng ba skyes su 'bul/ / bde gshegs 'phrin las ri mo bdud rtsis rab rgyas mu tig 'khri shing ngam/ / bu 348

das / / rang /ji ngathab garam shing 'phel zhing du dga' char 'bebs pa ma gha dha bzang ste/ / slar yang bstan la sri zhu'i sbyor ba lhur len nor 'dzin dbang mo'i brgyud/ / mdzes byed mtshungs bral sa yi dbang phyug gzugs can snying po'i zlos gar bzhin/ / bsod nams rtsa ba rab brtan g.yo ba med/ / rigs kyi ba gam mngon mtho'i rtse mo na/ / don bzang g.yer kha'i phreng ba snyan sgrogs pa'i/ /grags dkar ba dan stong phrag g.yo ba khyod/ / mchog gsum gdengs ka nor bus gtsug mdzes shing / / chos tshul musnyi ka phreng snying la bzung / / dgra 'joms ral gri'i 'khri shing rno rgyun te/ / chab 'bang gdung sel bdud rtsi'i gter kyang yin/ / mos gus nor rgyas kyis bzung ba'i/ / rnam dpyod dpung ba marnyi ras/ / bsrubs skyes gtong ba'i zla shel las/ / 'dzad med nor gyi thigs phreng spro/ / 'dir yang btung ba'i phur ma brgya phyed rgya/ / rgya yis nyer spras stong khun sgeg mo'i dar/ / dar dir snyan sgrogs gsung 'phrin bcas 'byor tshe/ / tshe dpal bdud rtsi myong bzhin dga' bas myos/ / slar kyang (yang ) rnam dpyod dpung pa'i ka ba yi/ / bstan la sri zhu 'bangs kyi byams skyong dang / / pha rol dgra sde 'joms sogs 'jug pa bcus/ / mi'u thung snyems pa'i 'bigs byed gzhom par 'tshal/ / ma smad legs byas yal ga 'bum phrag tu/ / bzhad pa'i gzhir gyur gzugs sku'i dpag bsam ljon/ / srung pa'i thabs tshul g.yel ba med zhu zhing / / smon pa'i ting 'dzin ri mo bdag kyang bgyid/ / slad ma'i 'phros kyang mes po'i ral klung ltar rgyun ldan zhu zhing da lan spyan ras smin rten stong min tsam du mdzod btags dri med zung bcas bkra shis 'khyil khri gung thang bla brang nas phul/ / so mang rgyal po ma yum bcas la'o /gser 'od 'khyug pa'i gzhal med khang bzang mchog / gser gyi 349

༄/ /yo thang bstan lo 0sa'i gatshi ཿma/dka' lung bzang pos stsal ba bzhin/ / gser gye khri la zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / / gser mdog 'chang ba'i bstan pa spel gyur cig / gser gyi 'khor lo sgyur ba'i dbang phyug mi'i lha 'jam pa'i dbyangs 7gong ma bdag po chen pos gser gyi bka' lung bzang po dang chabs gcig gser 'brug sder lngas mtshan pa'i na bza'/ gser bzang gzi 'od 'bar ba'i khang bzang sogs stsal zhing / gser gyi lha chen yang gdan sar phebs pa sogs legasakhyas rten 'brel gyi sgo brgya dus gcig tu phye ba'i dga' ba mchog gis yid drangs te shis pa brjod pa'i rten mtshon par gser mdog can gye nang mdzod srid du ring ba bcas zla tshes bzang por gung thang pas phul/'di'ang zam tsha gser khri rin po che la'o/ /'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyi ma khri chen mchog gi zhabs kyi padmo'i drung du/rgyal bar gyur cig / sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan bstan par gyur cig / 'phags yul gyi lugs bzhin rig byed nas bshad pa'i dge legs kyi tshig sngon du 'gro bas zhu ba ni/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag lha dang mi'i bla ma/ rlabs po che'i thugs bskyed kyi mthu bla na med pa rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po nyid lhun gyis grub bzhin pa'i mu nas dgung lo lnga bcur phebs pa'i ba yar gyi thog drangs te/slad mar yang dzasbu'i ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling 'di'i 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba dang / kun la phan pa dang bde ba'i mchog sbyin rgya cher stsol ba'i dga' ston chen po khri phrag du ma rim par 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo mtshon byed bkra shis pa'i nang mdzod/ dngul gye maṇḍal/ dar tshon sna lnga'i 'dogs bcas/ sgrol dkar gyi bris sku hor gos ljang gu'i mtha' can/ tshe mdo gser bris/ rnam rgyal mchod rten/dngul srang lnga bcu/ yid bzhin 'gug pa'i lcags kyu bcas bkra shis 350

ra / / ༄ 'i/spro pabs go'akhyil pa'i gling nas bkra shis pa'i dus bzang por phul/ 'di zam tsha gser khri rin po che la'o /rmog 'phreng zhes bya ba'i prastara'o//rmāṭwāṃwā rnott+waṃḥhūṃrmibyursārtsedhahaṃbyeX tshe~Xltu gyis ༵snorayi//shuñtsharshadzña rsā todriX(tsārnyi / ba// pa da daje /ste/ nga // rnam dag tshul khrims lus stobs rab rgyas thub bstan gangs kyi ri sul skyong / /rnam grol ye shes mche sder mi bzad las nyon glang po'i klad pa 'gems/ /rnam gsum rigs pa'i mig rtsa dmar 'khrugs nye bar zhi ba'i dbyengs su 'phyo/ /rnam mang 'khor tshogs dang bcas dgra bcom lnga brgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog spos dang mar me dri bzang chab/ /gtsang 35/

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/marasbyar ba'i zhal zas ro brgya ba/ / chos gos gsum dang gsil byed lhung bzed sogs/ / rung mthun mchod sprin rgya mtsho gus pas 'bul/ / thog ma med nas bsags pa'i bcas rang gi / nyes ltung sgrib pa ma lus mthol zhing bshags/ / srid mtsho las brgal nyer zhi mngon du mdzad/ / rgyal bstan 'dzin cing spel la rjes yi rang / / gzugs sku zhi ba'i dbyings su mi sdud par/ / 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du legs bzhugs nas/ / sde snod gsum gyi gaṇḍi sgra bo ches/ / 'gro ba ma rig gnyid las slong bar mdzod/ /dge tshogs kun kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog / 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru byin gyis rlobs/ / mdor na 'phags tshogs rnam kyi thugs rje dang / /bdag cag dad pas dgra bcom che rnams kyi/ / gzugs sku tshul dang mthun par bsgrubs pa sogs/ / dus gsum dge tshogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/ / mkha' mnyam lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i gzhi/ / thub pa'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du/ / tshang la ma nor blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan/ / phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig / sde 'dir tshul khrims lang tsho'i dpal 'bar zhing / / rgya chen mang thos nor bu'i rgyan 'phreng can/ /lung rtogs bshad sgrub gar gyis rtsen pa yi/ / bstan 'dzin 'chi med gzhon nus gang gyur cig / yul ljongs su yang nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi/ /rje 'bangs mtha' dag stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas/ / yon mchod kun kyang chos srid rdzogs ldan gyi/ / kun dga' gsar pas rtag tu rtsen gyur cig / tshul 'dir 'bad cing 'brel ba thogs pa kun/ / rtag tu dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten thob cing / / 'phags pa'i dgra bcom tshogs kyis rjes bzung ste/ / rnam grol nor bu'i gling du phyin gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni or du su tā lad shog gi dgon pa bkra shis chos gling gi khri thog pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen 352

༄/ / ༄ ryā'ajam dpal rgya mtsho sogs nas bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas kyi ched du dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i sku brnyan ri bo rtse lngar bzhugs pa ma phyi byayote gsar bskrun skabs smon tshig cig dgos spyo skul ma byung ba ltar/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /353

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama' gsung 'bum/༄7/ / snyan dngags kyi dper brjod rtsom 'phro can bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / grol pa ni/'dab stong rtse na zla ba'i me long ngos/ / ting 'dzin bir gyis bris 'dra tshangs sras ma/ / snyan 'gyur rgyud mangs sgra las ngag gi dpyid/ / 'dod dgur 'jo ba lhag pa'i lha der 'dud/ / yang / snyan 'gyur rgyud mangs sgra dang sbyar ba yi/ / legs bshad rol mo rnam par spro ba'i gnyen/ / ngag la ngag gi dpal ster dbyangs ldan mas/ / sdeb legs tshig gi 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzod/ / rigs ni/ dkar gsal ri dwags mtshan ma yi/ / mdzes sdug snyem pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ / zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pa/ / blo ldan yid kyi lcags kyu bzhin/ / yon por blta ba'i zur mig gi / 'od kyi zhags pa ring po yis/ / rna lung nor bu'i mdzes sdug kun/ / dal gyi 'dren pa'i 'dab bu mkhan/ / mchu sgros bim pa'i dga' tshal dbus/ / tshems 'phreng zla ba'i myu gu las/ / bsung zhim bsil zer spro ba yi/ / dbyangs ldan mthong bas dang ba 'phel/ / mdzod ni/ dkar zhing gsal la dri ma med/ /mdzes sdug dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ / zur mig ga bur gzeg ma yis/ / yid kyi gdung ba sel byed cing / / dga' ba'i kurdo khong nas rgod/ / 'dzum dkar bdud rtsi'i 'od rlabs kyis/ / blo gros chu gter rgyas par byed/ / sgeg cing rab tu dgyes pa'i nyams/ / ri dwags gzugs kyis 354

༄/ / snyanadang rabarjodartsoma'aphrocagarnam par ngoms/ / dbyangs ldan ma ni kho bo'i lha/ / 'dus pa ni/ dmar ser sku yi nyin byed las / / phyag g.yas mkha' la brkyangs pa ni/ / rab dmar glog gi rtse dga' yis/ / shes bya'i khor yug gzhal byed bzhin/ /nor bu'i snye ma g.yur za zhing / / sgra ldan gser sbyang gdu bu yis/ /mkhrigs ma'i phyogs su brgyan pa 'dis/ / srid che'i mdzes sdug bdag gir byed/ / gang gi yal 'dab rtse mo na/ / rtsen pa ral gri'i gdengs ka yis/ / kun rmongs mun pa'i dra ba dag / cig car nyid la gcod par byed/ / shis brjod ni/ 'grib med 'od kyi rtse dga' yis/ / dus kyi mun pa mthar mdzad pa/ / ye shes snang ba bla na med/ / tshe mtha' yas pas shis par mdzod/ / phyag ni/ thugs rje'i pi wang dang po'i rgyud/ / brdung ba tsam gyis rmong ba'i gzings/ / 'joms byed dri za'i na chung ma/ / dbyangs can lha der snying nas 'dud/ / dngos po nges bstan/ bcad lhug spel ma'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ / sde bzhi'i gtam gyi ri bong mtshan mas mdzes/ / sgra don rgyan gyi 'od dkar dra ba can/ / legs bshad zla shel thub bstan mkha' la 'dren/ / dal zhing rgyu ba so ga'i nyin byed kyis/ / gnam sngon me long zhu ba smig rgyu'i chab/ / spang gshong yangs por 'khyil 'dra'i chu mtsho las/ / lu ba'i skar tshogs mkha' la 'thor ba bzhin/ / sil sil 'bab pa gtsang ma'i chab rgyun can/ / ljang sngon nags tshal mdzes pas smad khebs zhing / / sprin dkar stod g.yog g.yo ba'i ri sul na/ / khu byug myos pa'i gsung snyan dal gyis sgrog / 'od stong gzi byin ma bzod skar ma'i tshogs/ / sa la 'phos 'dra grong khyer chen po'i dbus/ / gser gyi rgyal mtshan 'phreng bas mdzes pa ni/ nyi ma'i dmag tshogs rjes su babs pa bzhin/ / skyon bral ston gyi mkha' la rta ljang can/ / 'bar ba'i zer gyis phye 355

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgonas gsung 'bum/ba'i 'dab stong 'phreng / / tshar dngar skyed tshal dbus kyi dzing bu na/ /gzhon nu khrus kye rtse dgas rnam par rol/ / chang gis myos pas zim zim lta byed cing / / dga' mgur rol ba'i bde bas spu long rgyas/ / 'on kyang da dung 'dod pa'i pho nya mo/ / gzhan dang dus btab las 'das gdung bas mnar/ / yid kyi shing rta 'gro dang 'ong pa yis/ / nye bar 'tshams sbyar dga' ba'i dga' ston che/ / dar bas rigs sras gsar ba'i ku mud da/ /'phelab yar tshes zla ba'i myu gu bzhin/ / rta rmig gis bslang rdul gyis chu 'thung 'gog / ri bo ral byed glang po'i dpa' sgra can/ / mi bzad g.yul gye dgra sde'i dpung bcom tshe/ / rgyal po'i sde bzhi'i mnga' thang ngang gis 'phel/ / rten 'byung 'dun na 'don gyis gros btab ste/ / dpyad 'jog lta ba'i pho nya 'gro 'ong gis/ / dngos 'dzin btson ra bshigs nas gnyug ma'i sems/ / pha rol zhi ba'i gling der dal gyis songs/ / go ḍā ba'i sbyar ba/ padma'i rtse na snyan pa'i glu len ma/ / nyi ma'i mdangs bkra mu tig 'od ldan ma/ / ma ltar gus pas bsten no dbyangs ldan ma/ / ma g.yel brtse bas gzigs pa ma dor zhig/ 'di yang / rab dkar ka ma la yi gdan steng na/ / dkar zhing mdzes pa ngang ba'i bu mo dkar/ / 'dzum dkar bsil ba'i 'od dkar spro ba yis/ / blo yi kunda rgyas pa'i mdzes sdug dkar/ / lho ba'i sbyar ba/ shes rab chung yang khengs ldan mkhas rloms tshogs/ /'thad 'thad tshig gis phal cher mgo skor zhing / / tshig 'khri kho nas mi tshe chud gzon pas/ / tshang tshing khor yug khang yang phan pa chung / / 'di yang /shes rab med na khengs kyang mkhas pa min/ / khe tshong kho nar 'tham tshe btsun pa min/ / khe 'dod phugs su 'chang phying bzang po min/ / chos med chos pa'i gzugs kyes sa 'di khang / / lho ba'i rab dwangs/ mtho zhing brjid 356

༄ / /snyanadang rabarjod ma'aphro zagachags shar ri'i rtse mo nas/ / sbrin bral ston gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa la /dal gyis 'dzeg pa'i zla ba bdud rtsi'i 'od/ / mun pa'i gdung sel bsil ba'i dpal du shar/ / shar ba'i rab dwangs/ ye shes me long ngos la mngon dga' ba/ / dad pa'i bu mo mgrin pa'i rdza rnga yis/ / phul byung shis par bsgrubs pa'i yid mtsho las/ / sdeb legs tshig gi me tog mkha' la 'thor/ / lho ba'i mnyam nyid/ 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mi yi rol gar can/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa yis/ / theg mchog mthar thug gsang chen durnyu snyi/ / brdung tshe mkhas rloms yongs kyi khengs pa 'phrog /shar ba'i mnyam nyid/ kun gsal yangs pa'i do ra mdzes pa'i dpyed/ /'od dkar ga bur 'gyed pa kurdo'i gnyen/ / tsha ba'i gdung 'phrog bsil ba'i mchog ster ba/ / lus can snying gi dga' ba gzugs can bzhin/ /snyan pa lho phyogs pa'i sgra'i nyams/ / rgya che rgya mtsho ltar zab rgyal ba'i thugs/ / mkha' ltar yangs la nya rgyas zla ltar gsal/ / ma smad phul byung spob pa mi dpog pas/ / rnam kun rtogs pa'i stobs zhes rnam par bstod/ / shar ba'i rkang ba la bskor ba/ mtha' yas gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i don/ / mthar 'dzin nad kun sel ba sman gcig pu/ / mtha' bral zab mo rten cing 'brel 'byung lam/ / mthar gyi goms pas srid pa'i zug rngu gcod/ / tshig la bskor ba/ bim pa'i tshal na bung ba'i na chung ma/ / snyan pa'i glu len sbrang rtsi'i snye mar rol/ / rab dga' rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar ri mo 'dis/ / srid pa'i bde la sred pa 'phel bar byed/ / ring bor bskor ba/ ma lus mkhas pa'i snying la dpyid 'jo ba/ / dbyangs ldan ma khyod lhag pa'i lhar bsten na/ / brtse bas dgongs nas ma g.yel dus kun tu/ / 'dzad med ngag gi dngos grub ma lus stsol/ / shar ba kho na 'dod 357

zhu/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung lam/pa'i rjes khrid/ sgros bar las byung sgra dbyangs snyan sgrog cing / / sbrang rtsis spregs pa'i bsung ldan bhra ma ra / / 'dab stong rtse na gar gyis rol ba la/ / ba mo'i reg pas gnod par ma gyur tam/ / spang bya grong pa'i tshig /'dod ldan snying du sdug pa'i bu mo khyod/ / mthong bas chags pa'i yid ni bzung bar dka'/ / mal stan bde bar 'o dang 'khyud pa yis/ / 'khrig pa'i bde la spyod par mi byed dam/ / spong byed kyi nyams/ me tog mda' can srid las rgyal byed pa'i/ / ba dan lta bur dkar mdzes lus phra khyod/ /dga' ba'i grong khyer yangs por yid srubs kyi/ / dga' ston che la rol bar mi byed dam/ / 'tshams sbyor la zhugs pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab rgyas rta ljang can/ / bsil zer ldan pa yis kyang mi phyed pa/ / cig car 'byed byed sgeg mo'i 'gram chang gis/ / 'thor tshe ba ku la de rang dbang ci/ /ngag tshig don la zhugs pa/ dmar pa'i bzhin ldan drag po'i dbugs 'byin cing / / pha rol lus la rdo rje'i gdengs ka yis/ / bsnun pa las skyes bzod dka' zug rngu'i tshogs/ / kun rtog spros pa'i sde dang lhan cig rgyas/ / dmigs bsal/ chos la yid rton bu mo mtshan ldan ma/ / drin ldan pha ma'i 'dod pa sgrub byed cing / / 'khor 'bangs tshogs la rjes su chags pa'i sems/ / mi 'dor ya rabs ngang tshul mchog gis mdzes/ / lho ba'i gzhon pa/ / pad dkar 'phreng bas mdzes pa'i skyed tshal na/ / ge sa ras myos bung ba'i na chung ma/ / sbrang rtsi'i snye ma 'chang zhing snyan 'gyur gyi/ / glu dbyangs len bzhin dal gyis rgyu bar byed/ / shar ba'i brjod dka' ba/ gtum drag rngams brjid gar gyis srid gsum khyon/ / 'dar byed hūṃ sgra drag pos ri bo bsnyil/ / hrig hrig sdang mig g.yo bas dgra sde'i snying / / lkog mar 'bros byed khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed/ / lho ba'i don 358

sa / /snyanadang rabardzobartsoma'athocagagasal/ khyab 'jug yid kyi rol ba marka ras/ / chu mtshor byings pa'i sa chen 'degs pa na/ /rmig pa spu gris gdengs can tshogs kyi lus/ / bcad pa'i khrag gis chu gter dmar 'od 'dzin/ / yang / ma dros gdengs can bdag po'i mthu dpal las / / 'chi med dzing ring ngos la sprin dkar gyi/ /bla re bres tshe sbrang char 'bab mthong nas/ / char 'dod bye'u dga' ba'i dbyangs kyis brel/ / shar ba'i don gsal/ yangs pa'i gser ldan ma 'di chu gter dbus/ /byings tshe 'jug pa bcu pa phag rgod kyi/ / rnam par rtsen pas gyen du btags pa na/ / zla ba'i ma ma mtshams sprin mdangs kyis mdzes/ / yang / 'jig rten skyong ba klu dbang tshogs kyi mthu/ / zhing ba'i bsod nams dpyid du smin pa las/ / mkha' dbyings chu 'dzin dra bas khebs pa na/ / tsa ta ka rnams dbyangs snyan glu ru len/ / lho pa'i rgya che ba/mtshungs med 'dren pa nyin mor byed pa yi/ / zhabs skyes bkra shis rdul gyis gtsug mdzes tshe/ / gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis gang la'ang /snang ba gzhan la brten pa'i don ma mchis/ / yang / 'byor dang gtong ba zla med me long gdong / / gang la slong ba'i skye po de dag gi / dbul ba'i sdug bsngal lhag ma zad pa'i phyir/ / sbyin pa'i bdag po gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ / shar ba'i rgya che ba/ me tog 'khri shing rgyas pa'i dga' tshal na/ rtsen pa'i na chung nor bu'i 'od pag las/ / dpyangs pa'i dril chung sil sil 'khrol ba yis/ / drug skyes glu dbyangs snyan pa'i kheng pa 'phrog / yang /rgyal phran stong gi zur phud gdengs ka yis/ / lan gcig min par gus pas bsten bya ba/ / sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba yi/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal khab che/ / shar ba'i brjid pa/ bde gshegs gsung rab rab 'byams dka' gnad kun/ / 'grel la phul byung rnam 359

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i yo ga 'a4/dpyod zla bral ba/ / 'jigs bral smra dbang mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ / 'dzam gling mkhas pa ma lus gtsug na mdzes/ / lho ba'i brjid pa/ji lta ji snyed chos rnams ma lus/ / thugs su chud pa rgyal ba'i nyi ma/ / ye shes padmo rgyas byed de la/ / bhra ma ra yi dbyangs kyis bstod do/ / yang /ku mud da ltar dkar zhing gsal la/ / mu ti ka bzhin 'od rab 'phro ba/ /ma smad lang tsho rab rgyas a ma / / 'dod ldan snying la u dum wa ra/ / lho ba'i mdzes pa gtam la sbyar ba/ sprin dkar dal gyi g.yo 'dra'i sa srung steng / / 'chi med bdag po'i lag nyal rdo rje yis/ / sbyin skyes g.yul ngo bzlog par mdzad pa na/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i grags snyan ldir/ / yang / blo bzang rgyal ba'i gsung gi mdzod phye ste/ / bstan pa'i gnad kun rdzogs par gsal ba yis/ / mtha' 'khor kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di yang / / dbus 'gyur zhes byar grags pa don dang ldan/ / bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ mu tig 'khri shing yang dag rgyu ba bzhin/ / 'dod ldan skye bo dga' byed dga' ma yis/ / zur mig 'od zhags spro ba'i rtse mo ni/ / rna lung phon po'i bar du rdzogs ma gyur/ / shar ba'i gtam la sbyar ba/ ki la sha ri'i dpal 'dzin gnyis 'thung gi / steng 'gyeng grags pa'i mu khyud rtse brgya yis/ / lhun po nyung dkar gnas la 'god byed na/ / nyams chung lha min bcom la mtshar du ci/ / yang / 'jam mgon bla ma'i legs bshad 'od stong gis/ / mdo rgyud pad tshal rgyas pa'i gangs ljongs 'dir/ / 'og min zhes byar grags pa'i rnga bo che/ / rdung ba des kyang bsgrun du ga la yod/ / bsngags pa la sbyar ba/ sred ldan snying la kun dga' gsar ba'i ro/ / sbyin byed lang tsho ma yi zur mig gi / dkyus ring yid srubs 'phrul gyi nyag phran de/ / 'jig rten gsum gyi mthar yang rdzogs ma gyur/ / ting nge 360

༄ / /snyanams rabarjod me'adzabasgoga'adzin gyi yon tan spyir bstan pa/ / dbang phyogs sa 'dzin rtse nas 'od stong can/ /dgyes pa'i rang zhal ngoms tshe padmo rnams/ / dga' ba'i ge sar so 'phreng rgod pa na/ / phrag dog ldan pa'i ku mud zum par gyur/ / chos gcig bkod pa/ 'gram chang gzeg mas bskyangs pa'i ba ku la/ / dga' zhing chags pas rab tu rgod pa na/ rkang gdub kyis bsnun mya ngan med pa yang / / khrel ba'i yid kyis cung zad rgod par byed/ / yang / mi bzad dgun gyi grangs reg rgyas pa na/ / nyal 'gro ma rnams chab rom gur du mnal/ /khor yug mdzes byed ri bo'i 'phreng ba yang / / kha ba'i gur khang phug tu gnyid la yur/ / chos du ma bkod pa / 'od stong chu lha'i bang bar mnal ba na/ / skar ma'i do shal legs bgos sngo bsang mar/ / dus btab zla ba gzhon nus bgrod pa'i tshe/ / skyengs ldan sprin gyis sgrib g.yog ci yang byed/ /yang / nyin phyed lho yi lam du bros gyur cing / / sa 'dzin kha ba'i thor tshugs bcings pa na/ / rtsi shing tshogs rnams shugs ring 'byin byed cing / / na chung nyal 'gro ma rnams spubs su bros/ / rigs rang bzhin brjod pa / phul byung mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab 'bar zhing / / yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs snyan rna bar 'jeb/ / chos rnams kun la gzigs pa sgrib med pa/ / dus gsum bde bar gshegs rnams gtan gyi skyabs/ / yang /bgrang yas rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i gter/ / gcig gyur bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal gyi sgeg / dbyangs can dga' mar rab dgyes ngag gi lha/ /dpal ldan brtan pa'i 'khor los bdag skyongs shig / bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa/ de nyid gzigs pas srid mtsho las brgal zhing / / brtse chen goms pas zhi ba'i mtha' bkag nas/ / mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i grong mchog der/ / gdul bya gzhan yang 'khrid mdzad ston pa mchog / yang /361

༄/ /yo ca bayoryā7ryā khrung las/gzhung brgya 'chad pas rmongs pa'i mun sel zhing / / rtsod ngag nga ros rgod (rgol)ngan klad pa 'gems/ / rtsom pas mkhas kun yid dbang 'gug byed pa/ / ma lus bstan pa'i snang byed drin can rje/ / yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa/ 'dab brgyad snying gi ze 'brur 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / lan gcig min par yang yang bsten pa las/ / rab rmongs mun pa sel zhing gsung rab kyi/ / dgongs don 'byed pa'i blo gros snang ba rgyas/ / yang /'dren mchog dam pa'i zhal gyi bum bzang las/ / 'phos pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi gsar ba'i rgyun/ / snying khar sem pas mkhas dbang daṇḍi'i gzhung / /'grel la mi 'jigs dge ba'i spob pa rgyas/ / rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa/ rmongs mun dra ba gcod pa'i ral gri dang / / utpal 'chang zhing rin chen rtse phran tshogs/ / g.yur du za ba'i zur phud lan bu lngas/ / gtsug mdzes smra ba'i rgyal po snying gi dpyid/ / yang / phul byung rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dbus/ /lha brgya'i zur phud 'od chags nor bu'i khrir/ / sbyin skyes klad 'gems zho 'thung rtse brgya ba/ / 'dzin byed lha dbang bsod nams dpal gyis mtho/ / chos dpe/ dbyangs can zhal gyi mchu sgros 'dzum par las/ /thag bzang bzhi bcu'i tshems 'phreng gsal ba ni/ / 'tshams sprin khong las gsar tshes zla ba bzhin/ / dkar zhing gsal bas 'jig rten kun yid 'phrog / yang / gtum chen khro bo'i dbang po gshin rje'i gshed/ /pa spu'i khong las me lce'i tshogs 'phro ba/ / bai zur rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ri bo la/ / rta gdong me yis 'khyud ltar rngams shing brjid/ / dngos dpe/bcom ldan mthu stobs bdag po'i zhal khyim ni/ / 'jigs rung dbyar gyi char sprin gtibs pa bzhin/ / spyan gsum sdang mig yon por blta ba yang / /glog dmar 'khyug pa'i dpal la rnam par 'khu/ / yang / rgyud 362

sa / / snyanadang rabardzobartsoma'aphrocagamang sgra la 'khu ba rgyal gsung gis/ / legs par bstan pa 'chi med bdud rtsi bzhin/ / de don goms pas zhi ba'i dpal 'thob pas/ / lha dbang bdud rtsir rol ba'i khengs ba 'phrog / bzlog pa'i dpe/ blo dang brtson par ldan pa'i yon tan bzhin/ / yar tshes zla shel 'di ni 'phel rtsom zhing / /de yis sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor spel ba ltar/ / mdzes sdug kun da'i dga' tshal rgyas par byed/ / phan tshun dpe/ bung ba'i na chung padma'i tshal la bzhin/ / blo ldan skye bo chos la legs gnas shing / / de don rtse gcig sgrub la brtson pa ltar/ / rkang ba drug pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis myos/ / yang /bcu drug cha shas yongs gang zla ba ltar/ / shong dpang mkhyen pa'i dpal yon rab rgyas shing / / de yi legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed pa bzhin/ / zla shel bdud rtsi gsar ba'i thig 'phreng spro/ / nges pa'i dpe/ rab 'byams gsung rab kun gyi dka' gnas la/ / gzigs pa chags thog mi mnga' 'dren pa mchog / gang gi mkhyen rab 'di ni kun gsal ma/ / kho nar mtshungs kyi dpe zla gzhan yod min/ / yang / 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i 'khrul med lung rigs kyis/ / rnam par dag byas dge ldan bstan pa 'di/ / gser sbyang btso ma kho na'i rjes 'gro ste/ / dpe gzhan srid pa 'di na 'ga' yang med/ / nges med dpe/ gnas skabs mthar thug legs tshogs ma lus pa/ / gang las 'byung ba rin chen byang chub sems/ / lha yi dpag bsam ljon pa'i rjes 'gro ste/ / de lta gzhan 'ga' mchis na'ang mtshon par nus/ / bsdus pa'i dpe/ mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan rten bzang 'di/ / rnyed dka' kho nas yid bzhin nor bu dang / / mtshungs pa min te 'di nyid la brten nas/ / legs tshogs ma lus 'dod dgur 'jo bas kyang / / phul byung dpe/ rnam 'dren shākya'i tog dang tsong kha ba/ /363

༄/ /༅ ca bayo pa'isgronama'i khrung 4ma/'phags yul rdo rje gdan dang bsil ljongs 'dir/ / zab gsang chos kyi sgra dbyangs bsgrags pa las/ / gzhan du tha dad dbye ba'i skabs ma mchis /rab rtog (btags) gi dpe/ srid 'byor rgyas pa rgud pa'i mtha' can du/ / ston byed dmar phyogs zla ba snyems mi 'tshal/ / 'dab stong mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i pad mo yang / / lo 'bras 'grul ba'i ngang tshul ston phyir ro/ / rmad byung gi dpe/ rab dkar kai la sha ris dbang sngon gyi/ / zur phud bcings te snyan 'gyur rgyud mang sgras/ / skal bzang rna bar bdud rtsi'i dpal ster na/ / ngag dbang lha mo khyod kyi dpe zlar 'os/ / rmongs pa'i dpe/ / gangs kye ri bo dal gyes rgyu bar ni/ / 'khrul ba skyed byed gnyis 'thung dbang bo la/ / lta bar 'dod pas rab dkar kai la sha / mthong tshe lcags kyu'i sbyor ba rtsom pas brel/ / the tshom gyi dpe/ sprin bral ston gye nam mkha' dwangs pa la/ / nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor cig car shar ba'am/ / gtum chen khro po'i dbang po'i zhal khyim ngos/ / ldang mig g.yo snyam bdag yid 'phyang mo nyug / gtan phab ('bebs)kyi dpe/ mtha' bral lam bzang ji bzhin gsal mdzad khyod/ / sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub dang mtshungs kyang / / mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du bltams pa'i phyir/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags par nges/ / sbyar ba'i dpe/ dri ma dang bral mdzes sdug yongs su rdzogs/ / mthong bas yid la kun dga'i dpyid 'jo ba/ / sgra dbyangs lha mo'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ / nya gang bsil zer bdag po'i rjes su 'gro/ / mnyam nyid dpe/ / kun sbyor rmongs pa'i dra ba drung phyung ste/ / chos kun thugs su chud pa shākya'i tog / rgya mtsho'i gling du bgrod pa'i ded dpon bzhin/ / ma nor lam bzang gsal bar ston phyir ro/ / smad pa'i dpe/ chu 'dzin stug po'i sgrib g.yogs dang bcas shing / / ku mud da 364

sa / /snyanadang rabarjod blanga'aphrocasatshal zum byed nyi ma 'dis/ / dus las mi yol kun la stoms pa yi/ / rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ji bzhin mtshon du med/ / bsngags pa'i dpe/ lha yi rdzing ring pha mtha' mi mngon zhing / / zla ba'i ma ma nor bu'i gter du grub/ / zla shel skyon gyi dri mas ma gos te/ / de dag rnams dang 'jam mgon khyod thugs mtshungs/ / brjod 'dod dpe/ rab dkar bsil zer rdzogs pa'i dpal ldan nam/ / sngo bsang ra ra'i mtshan mas sbags kyang rung / / tshangs sras lha mo'i zhal dang kun da'i gnyen/ / mngon par mtshungs zhes brjod 'dod yid la bcags/ / 'gal ba'i dpe/ dbyangs can lha mo'i zhal dang ston ga'i zla/ / yid 'ong mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i kun da rnams/ / ngo mtshar kun dga'i dpyid du gcig gyur kyang / / tha dad rnam par gnas 'dis 'gal bar sems/ / dgag pa'i dpe/ legs par bshad pa'i don gyis dben gyur zhing / / 'dod ldan srid par 'ching byed rgyud mangs la/ / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gran bzod pa'i/ / yon tan cha shas tsam yang dmigs su med/ / ngo bstod kyi dpe/ mchod sbyin brgya ba 'chi med rigs su 'khrungs/ / nga las nu khyod 'dzam gling mir gyur kyang / / sa steng 'jig rten dbang du byed pa la/ / lha yi dbang po nyid dang khyad par ci/ / de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ dkar gsal lang tsho yongs su rgyas pa 'di/ / zla ba ma yin dbyangs can gzhon nu'i sku/ / mdangs sngon rnam bkra 'di yang ri dwags gzugs/ / ma yin bai ḍūrya yi rgyud mang lags/ / thun mong min pa'i dpe/ phul byung mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis kyang / / ji lta ji sted chos kun gzigs pa yi/ / dpe zla srid zhi'i khams na gzhan med pas/ / rang nyid mtshungs dper bstan pa rgyal ba'i thugs/ / 'byung min gyi dpe/sred dang zhi ba'i mdzes sdug ma lus pa/ / 'jig rten byed pos gcig tu 365

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronasa'i rsāng 'bum/bsdus pa bzhin/ / utpal zur mig g.yo ba'i dbyangs can zhal/ / 'dren byed yul gyi bdud rtsi bla na med/ / 'tshams 'di nas srid min gye dpe dang /mang ba'i dpe dang / rnam 'gyur gyi dpe rnams kyi dpe brjod ma rnyed/'phreng ba'i dpe/ bdag tu 'dzin pa las ni chags sogs bzhin/ / de las sna tshogs las bzhin de las kyang / / skye ba'i kun nyon bzhin du slar yang ni/ / srid sogs skye bas 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'jug / ngag don las bzhin sgra gcig pa ni/ mnyen lbugs phyag gi sor mo g.yo ba yis/ /snyan 'gyur rgyud mang rnam par 'khrol ba ni/ / sprin gyi sbugs ma mngon par g.yo ba'i dbus/ / dbyar rnga dal gyis rgod bzhin rna bar snyan/ / bzhin sgra du ma ni/ gser ri ji bzhin brjid chags thub dbang sku/ / nyi ma bzhin du 'bar ba'i 'od 'phro zhing / / 'tshams sprin ji bzhin ngur smrig gos bzang gis/ / klubs pas skye dgu'i yid la dga' ba ster/ / zla bo dngos po'i dpe/dge ldan bstan pa'i gnyen gyur mang na yang / / mkhas grub smra ba'i seng ger 'gran nus su/ / rkang 'thung gsar bas skyed tshal gang gyur kyang / / lha yi dpag bsam ljon pa'i do zla med/ / mtshungs sbyor dpe/ pu lo ma dgra lhun po'i rtsar gnas shing / / gdong lnga ldan pa gangs ri'i spo la 'gying / / lha yi dbang pos lha min pham byed cing / / 'phrog byed khros pas gnyis 'thung klad pa 'gems/ / rgyu'i dpe/ gzi byin lang tsho rgyas bas nyi ma dang / lus can gdung ba sel bas 'od dkar can/ / 'dod dgu'i dngos grub ster bas dpag bsam dang / / mtshungs pa 'jam mgon lhag pa'i lha der 'dud/ / rtags 'dres kyang skyon med pa/ rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dpal gzhon nu khyod/ / ngag gi dngos grub stsol la dbyangs ldan bzhin/ /khyod kyi yum gyur sgra dbyangs lha mo yang / / phul byung spobs pa stsol la khyod 366

ra / /snya gas ra 'tsho gdang mtshungs/ / tshig 'dres kyang skyon med pa/ 'dren mchog dam pa'i rnam par thar ba ni/ / dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kun dang mthun/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi mdzad pa yang / / zla shel lta bur 'gro la gcig tu bsil/ / dpe mchog dman byung yang skyon med pa/ lus dkar ldan pa'i sder 'phreng dra ba bzhin/ / thub pa'i phyag sor dra bas yongs 'brel zhing / / snyan 'gyur 'bum ldan de yi gsung dbyangs ltar/ / sprin dkar khong las 'brug sgra snyan par sgrogs/ / skyon ni/ rgyal bo bzhin du khengs ldan lus phra ma/ / khyod gdongs dkar mdzes rgyu skar stong phrag bzhin/ /dbyibs legs phug ron dga' ma'i rjes 'gro zhing / / tshangs dbyangs dang mtshungs snyan 'gyur mgrin glu len/ / bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ mtshan dpe'i dpal kun rdzogs pa lha yi lam/ / ngur sprig gos bzang mtshams sprin gsar bas 'khyud/ / zhal khyim zla shel 'dzum pa'i rba rlabs can/ / klu yi dbang phyug rgyal po 'gro ba'i skyabs/ / ma bsdus ba'i gzugs can/ /'phags yul mkhas pa'i gangs ri las 'ongs shing / / lung dang rigs pa'i rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba yi/ / phul byung legs par bshad pa'i gaṅgā ma/ /'khrul ba'i rdul gyi rnyog pas ring du dben/ / bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ 'jam mgon thugs kyi kun gsal yangs pa'i ngos/ / zab yangs mkhyen pa'i nyin byed rtse dga' yis/ / thub pa'i dgongs don 'dab brgya bzhad pa na/ / thar 'dod bung ba'i tshogs rnams dga' bas rtsen/ /mtha' dag gzugs can/ rgyal sras spyod pa'i lus stobs rab rgyas shing / / phul byung mkhyen brtse'i gshogs zung g.yo ba can/ / lung rigs mgrin pa'i rdza rnga sgogs pa yi/ / bshes gnyen ngang ba'i ded dpon bsngags par 'os/ / cha shas gzugs can/ ma smad snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brtan 367

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/cing / / phyin drug spyod pa'i lo 'dab phang phung g.yo/ / bsdu bzhi'ime tog rnam par bkra ba yi/ / blo ldan rgyal ba'i sras rnams phyag gi yul/ / cha shas can gyi gzugs can/ 'jam dbyangs sku yi gser sbyangs lhan po la/ /rmad byung mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab rgyas shing / / sna tshogs nor bu'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa yis/ / thar 'dod yid la kun dga'i dpal yon ster/ / yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can/ bgrang yas rgyal ba'i tshe dang ye shes kyi/ /ngo mtshar rab rgyas bde ldan zhing gi gtso/ / gang gi thugs rje bdud rtsi'i thigs 'phreng gis/ / spyi bor reg pas 'chi med dga' ston thob/ / ldan pa'i gzugs can/ 'jam dbyangs mdzes sku gser sbyangs ri bo'i spor/ /nor bu'i gtsug rgyan 'od stong rab 'bar zhing / / mnyen lcugs phyag sor yal ga g.yo ba'i rtser/ / rno ldan ral gri'i 'dab 'phreng g.yo bas mdzes/ /mi ldan pa'i gzugs can/ dbyangs can sku yi 'o mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ / nor bu'i rgyan 'phreng glog 'od rab 'phro zhing / / zhal dkyil rab rgyas zla ba'i me long ngos/ / smin ma'i utpal 'khri shing rnam par g.yo/ / mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can/ 'jam mgon khyod sku li khri'i rgya mtsho las/ /'dzin byed rba rlabs byi ru'i 'khri shing g.yo/ / snyan 'gyur gsung gis thar 'dod yid 'phrog cing / / mkhyen pas chos kun ma 'dres gsal ler gzigs/ / khyad par gzugs can/ rgyal kun thugs rje zla ba'i ma ma las/ / blo bzang kun da'i gnyen gcig shar ba na/ / padma'i mdzes pa zum par ma gyur kyang / / thub bstan ku mud dga' tshal cir yang bzhad/ /'gal gzugs/ rta ljang bdun gye shing rtas ma drangs shing / / sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan rgyas par mi byed pa'i/ / thub dbang nyin byed mngon par shar ba na/ / skal bzang sa mos tshal rab rgyas par 'gyur/ / rgyu'i gzugs can/368

༄/ / snyanadang rabardzog ma'aphrocagabagrang yas rgyal ba'i yab gcig mkhyen pa'i gter/ / rmongs pa'i tsha gdung sel bas bsil zer can/ / mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rgyas pas nyi ma ste/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub 'byung bas gter kyang yin/ / sbyar ba'i gzugs can/ mtho ris rten bzang yangs pa'i do ra ru/ / nyer btab sa bon dus su smin pa yi/ / ma smad 'bras bu mchog gi dga' ston la/ / skal bzang skye bo 'dod dgur longs su spyod/ / dpe gzugs/ ye shes 'od kyi shing rta'i dmar 'od kyis/ / 'khyud pa'i khro rgyal zhal dkyil na kra'i grong / / rab 'bar rta gdong me lce dang 'grogs pa'i/ / chu gter rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dpal la 'gran/ / ldog pa can gyi gzugs can/ legs bris tshogs rnams lha yi dpal 'byor dang / / rgyal rnams kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin la rol/ / srid pa'i 'byor ba 'grib pa'i ngang tshul 'dzin/ / kun bzang mchod tshogs dus kyi mthar yang rgyas/ / 'gog pa'i gzugs can/ 'jam mgon thugs kyi chu gter las 'phos pa'i/ / sngon med legs bshad gsar pa'i zla ba 'dis/ / lta ngan tshang tshing ma lus sreg byed na/ / bsil zer byed pa nyid du ji ltar grub/ / mnyam 'jog gzugs can/ mkhas grub smra dbang rig pa'i 'od non gyis/ / rgol ngan 'byung po'i bya rnams long bar byas/ / rang lta mchog 'dzin ri la gti mug gi / mun par skyabs 'tshol rang mtshang des kyang nongs/ / gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ khyod 'al zla ba gsar ba'i skyed tshal dbus/ / smin 'khyog ha ri ṇa yi gar mkhan ma/ / rnam par rtsen des blo gsal gzhon nu yi/ / snying la bsil pa'i dga' ston ci yang sbyin/ / bston dor gzugs can/ mdangs bzang rnam par bkra 'di ngur sprig gos/ / ma yin 'char ga'i mtshams sprin gzhon nu ste/ /bsung zhim 'di yang tshul khrims dri ngad mchog / ma yin dpal gyi dum bu 369

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgronas gsung ཿma/kun dga'i dri/ / rigs thog ma'i gsal byed/ gtsug phud lnga pa gangs ri'i spor 'gying zhing / / mtshams sprin 'od chags ral ba'i khur gyi mdzes/ /mi bzad sder mo'i gdengs ka g.yo ldan zhing / / nga ros gnyis 'thung tshogs kyi klad pa 'gems/ / bya ba thog ma'i gsal byed/ mngon par spro'o zla shel bsil ba'i zer/ / 'dab stong gnyen gyis tsha zer dra ba ste/ / rin chen 'byung gnas las ni rlabs kyi 'phreng / / rgyal rnams kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ro/ / yon tan thog ma'i gsal byed/ / rnam par mdzes so mkha' la bsil zer can/ / 'o ma'i chu gter dbus na 'khor lo'i lag /'dab stong padma'i rtse mor bhra ma ra/ / blo ldan snying gi ze'u 'brur 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / rdzas thog ma'i gsal byed/ shes rab ral gri 'dzin mdzad mkhyen pa'i gter/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i rmongs pa drung 'byin cing / / gnas lnga rigs pa'i blo gros rgyas mdzad pas/ / skal bzang snying la kun dga'i dpal yon skyed/ / rigs brjod bar gyi gsal byed/ 'dab ma'i rlung gis ri bo ral byed cing / / gzi byin ser skya'i dpal 'bar nam mkha' lding / / mi bzad shugs drag sder mo'i gdengs ka yis/ / klu dbang tshogs kyi snying rtsa skog mar 'byin/ / bya ba brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ /legs bshad zab mo'i gtam gyis mkhas rloms dang / / nyin byed gzi yis srin bya long bar byed/ / yid srubs dga' ma dang mtshungs mdzes ma yis/ / zur mig g.yo bas 'dod ldan skye bo yang / / rigs brjod pa mtha'i gsal byed/ bsod nam ye shes tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs/ / sgrib gnyis mun pa'i sa bon drung nas phyungs/ / stobs dang mi 'jigs yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bya ba brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed/ zla shel 'dzum pa'i rlabs kyes chu bo'i 370

༄ / /snyanadang rabarjod thega'aphro gagater/ / sbrang char snyoms par 'bab pas lo tog bcud/ / chos ldan rgyal pos chabs 'bangs bde skyid dang / / bshes gnyen dam pas legs tshogs 'phel bar byed/ 'phreng ba'i gsal byed/ brtse chen snying por 'chang ba'i lta ba dang / / rin chen byang chub sems las rgyal ba'i sras/ / de las dus gsum bde bar gshegs rnams dang / / de yi gsung las nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ / 'gal ba'i gsal byed/ rnam dag nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyis/ / lus la brnag dka'i gdung ba ster byed kyang / / ma nyams tshul bzhin bsten pas skye bo yi/ / yid kyi gdung ba mtha' dag sel bar byed/ / don gcig gsal byed/ / snying stobs mthu ldan rgyal sras rtag tu ngus/ / rab dmar khrag gis 'dzin ma'i rdul mnan zhing / / sha dang rus pa zong du bsgyur byas te/ /'gro ba'i don phyir bla med byang chub bsgrubs/ /sbyar ba'i gsal byed/ sngo bsang baiḍūr zhun ma'i mdangs 'dzin cing / /pha mtha' tshad kyis gzhal bar mi spobs pa/ / 'chi med lam yangs steng gi phyogs su ste/ / zla ba'i ma ma lhun po'i mtha' la gnas/ / don bskor ba/dri bzang khang ba rgyas pa'i dga' tshal dbus/ / sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan g.yo ba'i rtse mo na/ / chu skyes ze'u 'brur rol ba'i rkang drug tshogs/ / 'dab stong bcud kyis myos pa'i glu dbyangs sgrog / tshig bskor ba/ mkha' dbyengs chu 'dzin dkar po'i 'phreng ba dkrigs/ / dwangs pa'i mtsho nang rab dkar wu ba dkrigs/ / dga' tshal yangs por mdzes pa'i rkang 'thung dkrigs/ /dbyangs can mchu sgros dbus na tshems 'phreng dkrigs/ / tshig don gnyis ka bskor ba/ dbyar skyes chu 'dzin 'phreng ba dkrigs pa'i dbus/ / glog dmar g.yo zhing 'brug sgra snyan par sgrog / rnam bkra sgro gdugs blum por g.yo ba yi/ / mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i glu dbyangs snyan par sgrog / byung 371

༄/ /yo ca bstan yo ཿ ryāng ཿma/ba 'gog pa/ bgrang yas bskal bar bgrod dka' sangs rgyas lam/ /gcig (tu) grub pa'i snyan grags 'ud po che/ / 'on kyang dus gsum rgyal ba'i thabs mkhas 'phrul/ / rdzogs pa'i gsang chen nus pa bsam mi khyab/ / da lta ba 'gog pa/ skye 'gro'i srog la dbang bsgyur nyi ma'i bu/ /mi bzad thod dbyug 'phyar ba ci yi slad/ / 'jam mgon bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ / ldang mig tsam gyis thal bar byed min nam/ / ma 'ongs pa 'gog pa/ mi yi dbang phyug mchog khyod slad du'ang / / 'byor ldan kho nar dgyes pa'i 'dzum ston na/ / nyams chung chab 'bangs tshogs rnams bde ba'i sar/ / 'bros phyir khyod zhal phyi nas mthong mi 'gyur/ /chos 'gog pa/ thub mchog bdud sde'i dpung gis bskor ba na/ / gcig tu byams pa'i tshul la gnas pa rdzun/ / gal te bden na yid srub rab gdungs shing / / mchi mas brnangs bzhin rang yul zlog pa ci/ / chos can 'gog pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo gsal ba'i rta ljang can/ / khor yug tshad kyi rang bzhin bzung bar dka'/ / 'od stong gzi byin ma bzod 'dren byed kyis/ / phra zhib ring du blta ba'i go skabs bral/ / rgyu 'gog pa/ 'grug sgra drag pos ri bo ral byed cing / / bde 'thung dmar 'od dang 'grogs rdo char gyis/ / zhing ba'i snying rtsa sgog mar 'bros byed kyang / / bdag bzung zhing sa med pas bdag mi 'jigs/ / 'bras bu 'gog pa/ cher snyigs dus dang yul gyi mtha' la brten/ / sna tshogs rkyen gyi rol ba mtha' yas kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i dga' ston nyams med pa/ / bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chos grwa che/ / rjes gnang gis 'gog pa/ srid 'byor 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i chen po rnams/ / 'byor ldan kho nar dgyes na de dag skyongs/ / blo ldan thar ba 'dod rnams skyabs gzhan du/ / 'tshol phyir de dag don du dogs mi 372

ra / /snya gas ra 'ahre caga'atshal/ / dbang gis 'gog pa/ 'jam mgon bla ma mchog khyod 'phags yul du/ / byon tshe rnam par dkar pa'i dgongs bzhed kun/ / dbus 'gyur bstan pa'i dpyid du smin 'gyur mod/ / de lta na'ang ljongs 'dir brtan par bzhugs/ / ma gus pas 'gog pa/ ji snyed srid zhi'i dpal kun dge ba dang / / mi 'dod gdung ba'i tshogs rnams sdig las skye/ / 'on kyang bdag ni rang bzhin gleng ba tsam/ / khyed nyid rang gi mos pa ji bzhin mdzod/ / shis brjod kyis 'gog pa/ grogs dag lha chos sgrub par mi byed na/ / 'di snang tsam gyi bde bas 'tsho gyur cig / bdag ni phyi ma med pa'i phyag bgyis te/ / dben pa'i ri la thos don sgrub tu 'gro / tsub mo sa 'gog pa/ ka ye bdag la re ba'i slob bu rnams/ / bstun pa bskyed de thos bsam mi bgyid / / rang dang mthun pa'i slob dpon ga'an sten cig /bdag gis deng nas gdams ngag 'bogs mi nus/ / grogs kyis 'gog pa/ mi g.yo'i sar gnas rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams/ / zhi bder rol bar bathed tshe myur du mdzod/ / kun la phan dgongs phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams kyis/ /slong bar mdzad tshe de las 'da' bar dka'/ / 'bad pas 'gog pa/gces shing 'phang ba'i blo gsal gzhon nu rnams/ / dgyes phyir ci bder bzhugs zhes brjod 'dod kyang / / 'phral yun 'bras la bsam tshe dka' spyad la/ / bskul tshig lan 'ga' thal te ci byar yod/ / ga'an dbang gis 'gog pa/ las ngan 'bras bu smin pa 'ga' zhig gis/ / gdung sel zab mo'i gdams pa dgos zhes smra/ / 'di na bde sdug 'gyur ba mtha' yas rnams/ / las kyis bskrun phyir de dang bgro bar 'tshal/ / thabs kyis 'gog pa/ 'od stong ldan khyod chu lha'i phang ba ru/ / gal te gzims par bzhed na de bzhin mdzod/ / pad tshal mdzes pa zum par mi 'gyur slad/ /373

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i ryā khrung ཿma/tsha zer 'od kyi 'breng ba bzhag 'tshal lo/ / khro bas 'gog pa/ 'byor pas dbul zhing 'du ba 'khrugs pas mnar/ / phan re'i dus su byol ba'i khrel 'das rnams/ / phyi nas bde skyid mnga' thang dar ba'i tshe/ / 'dzum zhal lhug par bstan kyang dgos pa skyi ci/ / mya ngan gyis 'gog pa/ 'di na la la ngal brgyas bsgrubs pa yi/ / nor rnams bsod nams gter tu ma sbas shing / /'phral yang longs su spyod par ma nus pa/ / chom pos khyer tshe zug rngu snying la 'dzin/ / 'gyod pas 'gog pa/ brtson shes mthu dang bral phyir rgyal bstan la/ / 'khor lo gsum gyis ri mor ma byas shing / / bzang po'i rdzu yi rang sde skyong ba sogs/ / srid kyang ma bzung gnyis med ngang du rgas/ / the tshom gyis 'gog pa/ rnam par dkar 'di dbyangs can mdzes sku 'am/ / zla 'od lhung pa'i kai la sha 'am ci/ / snyan 'gyur rgyud mang sgra yi dpal ldan phyir/ / gdos bcas gangs kyi ri bo min par sems/ / sbyar bas 'gog pa/ rnyed dka' brgya lam zhig na rnyed gyur tshe/ / phun tshogs 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i don che ba/ / dal 'byor rten bzang nor bu 'di thob tshe/ / rgya mtsho'i klong gi nor bu des ci bya/ / don gzhan 'gog pa/ 'dod la srid pas dam du bcings pa rnams/ / lha dbang dpal la rol yang tshim mi 'gyur/ / rab 'bar rta gdong me lce'i 'phreng ba des/ / rgya mtsho'i chu tshogs btung yang ngoms pa med/ / rgyus 'gog pa/ 'dren mchog dam pa'i zhabs sen bkra shis rdul/ / dregs ldan lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug tor rtser/ / mchog tu mdzes kyang bstod bsngags 'os min te/ / tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i nus mthu kho nar zad/ / kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa/ e ma grags pa'i gzhir gyur thams cad sgrol/ / gces dgu gtong ba'i sgra la mtshal du ci/ / rang bder ma chags gzhan phan khur chen gyes/ / mi skyo 374

༄/ / snyanadang rabarjodabyuga'aphrocaga'aphags chen dam pa'i ngang tshul lags/ / khyad par la gnas pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ yid la ring du rol ba'i dbyangs ldan ma/ / zag med ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzod/ / mkha' dbyings chu 'dzin dkar po'i klong las kyang / / sbrang char dal gyis 'bebs pa ma lags sam/ / sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa/ rnam 'dren mtshungs med stobs bcu mnga' ba yis/ / rgud pa'i mun pa drung nas 'byin par byed/ / 'gro ba'i sgron ma gsal ba'i 'od snang gis/ / smag rum gdung ba'i go skabs 'phrog bar byed/ / 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa/ mtha' bral lta ba thang cig goms pas kyang / / ring nas 'dris pa'i dngos 'dzin hrul bor byed/ / mi brtan skad cig g.yo ba'i glog 'phreng gis/ / mtshan dus rgyun chags mun pa'i smag rum sel/ / mi 'os ba'i don gzhan bkod pa/ bsil ba'i zer brgya 'phro ba'i zla shel gyes/ / yi dwags tshogs la tsha ba'i gdung ba ster/ /kye ma bsam gyis mi khyab las kyi mthu/ / smin pa'i ngang tshul 'di 'dra bzlog par dka'/ / 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul dge ba'i bshes/ / gtsug gis bsten pas don gnyis legs tshogs 'phel/ / bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po rgyal mtshan rtser/ / mchod pas phum tshogs 'dod dgu'i re ba skong / / 'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa/ pha rol mi bsrun dgra yis glags lta yang / / rten gyur sa yi bdag pos de lta min/ / nyi 'od reg pas tsha gdung skyed 'os kyi/ / bsil sbyin re ba'i gdugs kyis bsreg mi 'os/ / mi 'os shing 'os don gzhan bkod pa/ thub pa'i rjes 'jug 'ga' yang rten 'byung gtam/ / spong bar byed na gzhan sde smos ci 'tshal/ / skyon yon shes pa'i mi yang dug za na/ / rma bya rang gi zas la cis mi spyod/ / yan lag gcig gis ldog pa can/375

༄/ /yo ca gas pa'isgronama'i rsāng ཿma/gzi byin rab rgyas dad pa'i rgyal po khyod/ / dkar mdzes dbyangs snyan sgra yi dga' ston gyis/ / g.yas 'khyil dung dang mtshungs kyang sgro gshog gis/ /'phur lding gar gyis rol bas tha dad dbye/ / gnyis kyis ldog pa can/mun pa'i dgra dang bde ldan zhing gi gtso/ / 'od stong gzi byen 'gyed par mtshungs ba ste/ / 'on kyang de ni gling bzhi'i khor yug dang / / khyod sku'i 'od kyis zhing brgya cig char gsal/ / sbyar ba'i ldog pa can/ rgyal ba'i rjes zhugs ye shes lnga sgrub par/ / rgyal sras rnams dang mu stegs kun tu rgyu/ / mtshungs kyang blo ldan thar ba'i lam bzang du/ / 'gro 'o mu stegs rnams ni de las gol/ / 'gog pa can gyis ldog pa/ gzi brjid 'bar zhing dbyig gi mdzod 'dzin pa/ / mi yi dbang phyug khyod dang gdengs can gtso/ / mtshungs kyang mi bzad sbrul gdug spro ba des/ / sa dbang khyod la 'gran pa'i skabs yod min/ / gtan tshigs can gyis ldog pa/ skal bzang skye bo'i snying gi dpyid gyur cing / / phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jo bar mtshungs na yang / / 'jo sgeg rol ba'i nyams kyis dben pa'i phyir/ /dpag bsam shing de mtsho byung do zla min/ / rten gyis ldog pa/ rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje dbyangs ldan ma/ / dri za'i na chung dbus na 'gyeng zhing bzhugs/ / bcu drug cha shas yongs gang zla ba ni/ / rgyu skar khrod na gsal phyir mtshungs ma yin/ / dpe las dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa/ dbang po'i gzhu ris 'jam mnyan reg byas dben/ / longs su nyer spyad kun dga'i ro dang bral/ / lha yul pañtsa li ga'i gos bzang la/ / yid 'ong 'dod pa'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ / 'byed byed mtshungs pas ldog pa/ dbyangs can zhal dang ston ga'i zla shel gnyis/ / dkar zhing yid la kun dga' ster bar mtshungs/ / 'on tang khyod zhal smin ma 'khyog pos mtshan/ / bsil zer 376

sa / / snyanadang rabarjod yo'aphro po'abyed pa ri bong gzugs kyis mdzes/ / mtshungs chos ma zin pa'i 'byed byed/ rab dkar padmo skyed tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan/ / gnyis skyes rgyal po 'chi med lam gyis rgyan/ / sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan bsung zhim spro byed cing / /zla shel ga bur 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'gyed/ / rigs mthun ldog pa/ stug po'i chu 'dzin dra bas mi sgrib cing / / 'char dang nub pa'i dbang du ma gyur pa/ / chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal ba'i nyi ma des/ / 'gro la snang ba'i dga' ston ci yang spro/ / dus la sbyar ba'i srid pa can/ ma bcad par yang 'dab ma'i 'phreng ba lhung / / ma bkrus par yang yal ka skya bor gyur/ / ma bsta na bar yang mi rtag go byed pa/ / skyo ba'i shugs ring 'byin pa'i dgun gyi shing / / nang la sbyar ba/ rgyud du ma drangs rked pa gzhu ltar gug / ma brjes skra dang bzhin gyi kha dog 'chol/ / skrags pa min yang yan lag shigs shig 'dar/ / dgra yis ma bcom gzhon nu'i lang tsho stor/ / ngo bo tsam brjod pa/ ma bgos bsung zhim spro ba'i padma dkar/ / ma phyis bar yang 'dam rdzab dri ma bral/ / phrag dog med kyang zla ba mthong tshe zum/ / ma brkus par yang srid ldan yid dbang 'gug / spyi'i bsdus brjod/ / chu rgyun gtsang ma nye bar gnas pa la/ / 'dod dgur longs su spyod pa'i mthun ldan yang / / ba tshwa can gyi khron pa'i chu rgyun phyir/ / lus sems ngal bar byed pa yid re skyo/ / khyad gzhi tha dad kyang khyad chos gcig pa'i bsdus brjod/lha yi mchod yon gting mtha' dpag dka' zhing / / gang gis bsten na lus sems gdung ba sel/ / skyon ldan ro dang lhan cig mi gnas shing / / rlabs 'phreng g.yo bas blo chung skrag par byed/ / khyad chos mtshungs shing mi mtshungs pa/ dza hu'i bu mo nor bu'i mdzod 'dzin zhing / / gdengs can dbang po'i tshogs kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ / yan lag brgyad ldan baidrur zhun ma'i 377

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mdangs/ / rnam bkra der ni khrus kyis 'jug par rigs/ / sngon med bsdus brjod/ bzod dka' brang 'gro gdug bas ma bsten zhing / / nam yang thur du bgrod min gaṅgā ma/ / gang gi ngogs su khrus kyi rtse dga' la/ /gzhol ba de dag mchog tu skal ba bzang / / khyad 'phags phul byung / rab dkar ka ma la yi 'dab 'phreng rtser / / 'od dkar blum por spro ba'i lding khang dbus/ / gangs ri'i mdangs 'dzin 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / stong phrag zla ba'i 'od kyis mtshon du med/ / the tshom phul byung /lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyid/ / bzhin legs gar rol he ru ka yi sku/ / gdos bcas thogs reg bral ba'i mkha' dbyings dang / / 'dres samagazhan du mchis snyam khyogs la 'phyang / / nges pa phul byung / ye shes nyid kyang ngo mtshar thabs mkhas kyis/ / rnam par 'phrul pa'i gzugs sku ldan par nges/ / rin chen rgyan mang g.yur du za ba'i rten/ / stong sangs kun gsal ma yi nus ma yin/ / ngo mtshar phul byung / cung zad bsdabs pa tsam gyis srid pa gsum/ / shigs shig g.yo mdzad gshin rje'i gshed po yis/ / bcu drug zhabs kyis bskal brgyar mnan byas kyang / / g.yo med 'dab brgya ba 'di ngo mtshar che/ / sems ldan rab rtog spu sdug rnam bkra dpyid kyi pho nya mo/ / lhung lhung snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa ni/ / phul byung dbyar gyi dus ston gsar ba khyod/ / yun ring bzhugs zhes gsol ba 'debs pa bzhin/ / sems med rab rtog lho yi rlung gis bskyod pa'i tsan dan gyi/ / ljon pa'i tshogs rnams yal ga g.yo ba ni/ / grub rigs tshogs kyi bste gnas 'di'o zhes/ / drang srong che rnams mgon du 'bod pa 'dra/ / ting 'dzin rab rtog nyan byed dbang pos tsha zer 'phreng ba yis/ / chu skyes gzhon nu'i 'dab rgya bkrol ba na/ / dbyig gi khu ba bag 378

sa / /snyanarang rabarjod me'abrocagamed btung ba bzhin/ / myos pa'i ger sar rdul tshogs skyug pa bzhin/ /snyam sgra can/ dpyid dus rlung nag 'tshub mar g.yo ba ni/ / mi gtsang rdul tshogs byi dor byas par snyam/ / dogs sgra can/ mi zad dus kyi 'thor rlung drag po yis/ / dbyar gyi lang tsho byer zhing bros kyi dogs/ / nges sgra can/de nas sbrengs (sbrang ) char dal gyis 'bebs pa ni/ / rdul tshogs gnon pa'i thabs la zhugs par nges/ / 'dra ba'i sgra can/ de tshe dbang gzhu rnam par bkra ba yang / / dbyar gyi lang tsho rgyas pa ngoms pa 'dra/ / min nam sgra can/ ston dus rtsi bcud phun sum tshogs pa ni/ / lha yi dpal las brkus pa ma yin nam/ / skyed byed kyi rgyu/ skal bzang rnam 'dren bu ram shing ba yis/ / 'phrin las 'od kyi snang ba ris med du/ / spros pa'i mthu las nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon/ / rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dpal gyis khyab par gyur/ / nyams byed kyi rgyu/ 'jam dpal rdo rje mi yi gar rol ba/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad sgra dbyangs kyis/ / thub bstan dpal la sdang ba mtha' dag gi / yid ni mi bzad zug rngus gdungs bar byas/ / rnam 'gyur gye rgyu/ nor bu 'od 'bar mdzes pa'i pho brang dbus/ / na chung tshogs rnams snyan pa'i glu len kyang / / yid 'byung rab rgyas shākya'i sras po yis/ / de kun mi bzad gshed ma lta bur gzigs/ / thob byed kyi rgyu/dpal ldan bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i zhabs kyi rdul/ / snying khar bkod de ngal ba brgyas bsten pas/ / gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i gnad la thogs med du/ / 'jug pa'i blo gros snang ba rgyas par gyur/ / phyi shes byed kyi rgyu/snyan sgrog 'dab chags tshogs kyi gdangs chag cing / / chu klung rnams kyang sgra med spubs su zhugs/ / ri klung mtha' dag kha ba'i rdul gyis khebs/ / mi rnams lus la grang ba'i spu long rgyas/ / nad shes byed kye rgyu/ zab brling 379

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i me'i khrung 'ayo/chos sgra thos tshe bag 'khum zhing / / don med 'chal gtam smra tshe mgo 'phang mtho/ / rnam dkar las la btsud tshe thabs kyis 'bros/ / lto gos zas nor mthong tshe ngang gis 'du/ / snga nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ tshe sngon mi bzad sdig pa ma byas shing / / 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad kyis ma btab la/ / phyi rol dgra yis gtse bar ma byas pas/ / skal bzang snying la bde ba'i dga' ston rgyas/ / zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ thub dbang 'jig rten mig ni zum gyur cing / / rgyal bstan rtsa lag phal cher 'das pa na/ / khrel yod tshul las 'das pa'i cher rlom 'ga'/ / rmongs rtul skye bo'i khrod na ci yang spyod/ / phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ ngang ba 'di dag 'chal sgrog blon po min/ / nye'u chung bag med 'gyu ba'i btsun mo min/ / rlabs 'phreng 'di dag gdug pa'i dpung tshogs min/ / jid 'di rgyal srid min phyir snying du sdug / spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ nyes brgya'i 'byung gnas rang nyid gces 'dzin blo/ / rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyis ring spangs pas/ / de dag thugs la zag med bde ba'i dpal/ / nam yang nyams pa med par ngang gis 'phel/ / rgyu med pas med pa skyed pa'i byed rgyu/ dge ldan lugs bzang kun gyes bkur ba'i zol/ / mkhas grub dam pas dgag par ma mdzad na/ /'jam mgon rjes zhugs re ba'i lta log dang / / rtsang spyod hral pos sa 'di hrul por byed/ / ring 'bras kyi rgyu/ sa chen dpung bas 'dzin pa mi yi rjes/ / chab 'bangs tshogs rnams chos bzhin bskyangs pa na/ / ring na gnas pa'i mi bsrun dgra sde'i tshogs/ gus pa'i yid kyis khyod zhabs bsnyen par byed/ / rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa/ dpal ldan stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ / bla med ye shes bdud rtsi brnyes pa dang / / lhan cig bgrang yas zhing khams rgya mtsho ru/ / sna tshogs tshul gyis 'gro ba 'dren par 380

sa / /snyanadang rabarjod yo'aphrocagamadzad/ / rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba/ mi bzad srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dir/ / skye ba'i rnam 'phrul bzung ste da dung yang / / de yi yan lag yongs su goms pa'i mthus/ / sna tshogs las kyi lam la 'jug par byed/ /rigs min gyi rgyu/ thub rnams brtan pa 'phrog pa'i mdzes sdug gi / la nga tsho rab rgyas dbyangs can kun da'i gnyen/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid la rol pa'i mod/ / chags dang rmongs pa'i ku mud zum par gyur/ / rigs pa'i rgyu/bgrang yas rgyal ba'i ngag gi dngos grub kun/ / mdzes sdug lha mo'i rnam rol 'od dkar can/ / yid la rol bas blo gros ku mud da/ / rnam par rgyas pa'i dga' ston ci yang thob/ / zur gyis phra mo/ ring nas rna ba'i grags 'bar rjes zhugs te/ / slong bar 'dod kyang gzi byen ma bzod pa'i/ / mu to'i sdug bsngal gzigs pa'i sa skyong gis/ / nor bu'i gdub gor mdzes pa'i phyag g.yas brkyangs/ / rnam pas phra mo/ / yid srubs sgeg mo bslu brid la zhugs shing / / bdud sde'i dpung gis lan brgyar mtho brtsams tshe/ /mnyam pa nyid du ba spu'i rtse mo yang / / g.yo bar mi mdzad 'dzum ldan shākya'i tog / 'os pa'i cha/ mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sar legs bshad kyi/ / gsung gleng bgyid par bskul tshe mgo bo na/ / ring mo zhig nas zhugs pa'i khrag 'khrug gis/ / nad ro dus su ldang la ci byar yod/ / mi 'os pa'i cha/ mi bzad sdig la zhugs pa'i mya ngan gyis/ / gdung bas lha chen smre sngags shor ba yang / / slob ma'i tshogs pa rjes su brtse ba yis/ / 'phags pa'i bden pa ston par mdzad pa lags/ / cha las smad pa/ ma bslab par yang yon tan thams cad shes/ / phrad pa tsam nas dgyes pa'i 'dzum 'al ston/ / kun gyi bka' sgrub drang po'i rang bzhin can/ / 'di dag gzhan gyi bya ba'i grogs su bzang / / cha las bstod pa/ sdom gsum khur gyi ngal ba 381

༄/ /yo ca ༄na pa'isgronasa'i ཿnga lam/brgyal gzir zhing / / nyin mtshan med par thos bsam bya bas brel/ / gos skya 'tsho bas dbul ba'i mtshan nyid pa/ / 'byor ldan skye bo rnams kyi snying rje'i yul/ / rim pa can gyi rgyan/ e ma dwangs shing bsil ba'i chab 'di yang / / rang rang las kyi rnam par 'phrul ba yis/ / yi dwags dud 'gro mi dang lha rnams la/ / rnag khrag gnas dang chu dang bdud rtsir gyur/ / dngos thob kyis dga' ba/ legs bshad gtam gye dga' ston spel mkhas shing / /zhi dul 'grogs na bde ba'i rigs smra khyod/ / mthong zhing bka' mchid 'phel ba'i dga' ba 'di/ / gzhan gyis ster nus min phyir slar yang byon/ / gzugs brnyan gyis dga' ba/ mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar thub ba'i nyi ma yi/ / mdzes sku mthong ba'i lam las 'das gyur kyang / / de yi zhal skyin skye dgu'i bsod nams zhing / / jo shāka snang brnyan mjal bas rab dga' rgyas/ / sgeg pa'i nyams/ glo bur nyid du so skye'i sa las 'das/ /kun du sbyor ba'i 'ching ba rang sar chad/ / brgya phrag bcu gnyis yon tan gter rdol bas/ / dang po'i sa la rab dga' ci yang 'thob/ / drag shul gyi nyams/ las gshin khros pa'i sdang mig glog gi 'od/ / 'ur 'ur me rlung dang 'grogs spros pa yis/ / ri rab khong na gnas pa'i bstan dgra yang / /lce snying lkog mar 'dong ste brgyal bar byed/ / dpa' pa'i nyams/ mi bzad g.yul gyi sbyor ba ma bshams shing / / mkho dgu'i longs spyod sbyin pas ma bsdus par/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam dpyod dpung ba yis/ /'jig rten gsum gyi tog gyur tsong kha pa/ / snying rje'i nyams/ sil sil sgra sgogs nor bu'i 'od pag can/ / 'jam mnyen gos bzang g.yo ba lha yi bu/ / glo bur dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs sa gzhi la/ / sog les gshags shing gtub pa ji ltar bzod/ / mi sdug pa'i nyams/ gdon gyis brlams 382

sa / / snyanadang rabarjod yo'aphro gapas g.yang sar mchong gyur kyang / / sdig pas bzung ba'i srog ni ma btang bar/ / khrag bcas klad pa ldag cing skyug byed la/ / nang khrol sa la 'phyang bzhin khyor khyor 'gro / bzhad gad kyi nyams/ gzhan gyi longs spyod ba spu'i nyag mas kyang / / gos par mi bzod chos ldan grogs po khyod/ / gos tshags legs par chings shig tshogs kyi dbus/ / rin chen char du bstel ba'i ngo mtshar 'byung / / rmad byung gi nyams/ e ma mkha' la sprin dkar 'phreng ba 'khrigs/ / ljon shing tshogs rnams gsar 'khrungs 'dab mas mdzes/ / khu byug rnams kyang gsung snyan lhang lhang sgrogs/ / dbyar gye dga' ston phun sum tshogs par gyur/ / 'jigs rung gi nyams/ ngams nag zhal dkyil mun pa'i 'khor sa cher/ / yon por lta ba'i spyan rtsa dmar 'khrugs cing / / ba spu rno tsub me lce'i 'phreng ba can/ gtum chen khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje'i gshed/ / gzi brjid kyi rgyan ni/ mkhas grub smra dbang rigs pa'i gad rgyang gis/ / srid pa'i khor yug 'dar bar byed na yang / /nyams chung khyed cag skrag par mi bya ste/ / glen lkug skye bo rtsod pas gzhom bya min/ / rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ bshul ring lam zhugs dub pa'i grogs po khyod/ / bsil ldan ljon pa 'di nyid bsrung ba'i phyir/ / re 'ig bzhugs dang bdag ni phyogs gzhan du/ / dwangs shing bsil ba'i chab rgyun tshol du 'gro / kun phan gyi rgyan ni/ mthon po'i rigs 'khrungs lha btsun byang chub 'od/ / lha cig dī bam ka ra bsil ljongs 'dir/ / spyan 'dren las la zhugs tshe 'phags mas kyang / / mtha' 'khob yul du 'byon pa'i bskul ma mdzad/ / bsam pa rgya che ba/ srid pa'i 'dam du bying byed las nyon gyi/ 'tshing ba kun bcad 'phags pa'i gnas brtan tshogs/ / zhi ba'i bde la bskal brgyar gzhol nus kyang / / rgyal ba'i bka' las mi 'da' 383

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung tshom/srid na gnas/ / 'byor ba rgya che ba/ baiḍūr gtsang ma'i gzhi la lha dbang gzugs/ / stong phrag cig char shar ba'i rnam rol gyes/ / mngon par dga' ldan lha yi na chung tshogs/ / dpag yas mchod pa'i bye brag bstar bas brel/ / chos la bston pa/ dbyangs can sor mo'i rtse na g.yo ba 'di/ /baiḍūrya yi rgyud mang ma yin te/ / rmongs pa'i dra ba ma lus gcod byed pa'i/ / shes rab ral gri'i gdengs ka yin bar nges/ / yul la bsnyon pa/rta ljang shing rtas drangs pa'i nyin byed 'dis/ / snang ba'i dga' ston ster zhes grags gyur kyang / / mig ldan 'byung po'i bya yi tshogs rnams kun/ /long bar byed pas mun pa'i gter du nges/ / rang bzhin la bston pa/ /'di snang tsam gyi bde ba'i dga' ston la/ / sbyor ba'i thabs tshul ston pa'i snying sdug dag / grogs po min te thar ba'i srog 'phrog pa'i/ / mi bzad dgra yi dwangs ma yin par nges/ / tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba/ thogs reg gdos bcas bem po'i skyon dang bral/ / rab sngo beeḍūrla yi kha dog 'dzin/ / 'od stong rab 'bar nyi ma gzhon nus brgyan/ / rab dkar bsil zer byed pa yis kyang mdzes/ / tha dad tshig 'dra sbyar ba/ sgrib g.yogs skyon gyi dri ma dang bral zhing / / 'jig rten khams rnams kun la mthun par 'jug / lus can yongs la snang ba'i dga' ston mchog / ster phyir grags ldan ral ba'i rtse na mdzes/ / bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba/ / bgrang yas rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab gcig gyur dngos/ / mi shes rmongs pa drung nas 'byin pa'i gnyen/ / blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad dang / / 'jam mgon thugs rje'i zer gyis bdag blo rgyas/ / bya ba 'gal min sbyar ba/ ngan rtog dri ma bsal te mdo dang sngags/ / zung 'jug bstan ma'i snying po gsal mdzad pa/ / sngon med chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'di thos 384

༄ / /snyanadang rabajod bsa'aphreng gatshe/ / 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis par snying nas dad/ / 'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar ba/ / ring nas srid par 'khyam pa kun yid la/ / gnas zhing sna tshogs rnam 'phrul 'grub pa'i rgyu/ / rigs kyi nus pa yongs su smin pa las/ / srid pa'i gdung ba rim gyis zhi bar 'gyur/ / nges pa can gyi sbyar ba/ / bdag gi gtsug mdzes lha yi 'dren pa 'di/ / zas gtsang sras po yin gyi sprin zhon min/ / yid la rnam rol zla ba'i cod paṇa 'di/ / ngag dbang lha mo yin gyi mgrin sngon min/ / nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba/ lus can yongs la phan dang bde ba'i dpyid/ / ster mdzad bshes gnyen dam pa kho nar nges/ / 'on kyang 'dod dgu'i dga' ston stsol ba yi/ / bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po dag kyang mthong / / 'gal med kyi sbyar ba/ bur ba rā dzā lha brgya'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /mi yi seng ge mi mthun phyogs las rgyal/ / 'jig rten 'dren byed gzi byin rab rgyas zhing / / bdud rtsi'i gter khyod 'gro la kun dga' ster/ / 'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba/ / 'od stong 'phro yang pad tshal zum byed min/ / bcu drug lang tsho rgyas kyang chags dang bral/ / 'dod pa bsreg kyang khro ba'i rnam 'gyur spangs/ / 'gro pa'i tog gyur nam yang bslu ba med/ /yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ 'chi med bdag po'i skyed tshal mdzes pa'i rgyan/ / phul byung dpag bsam gsar ba'i ljon pa ni/ /brtse ba'i yid dang brtson par mi ldan yang / / lha rnams dga' ba'i dga' ston g.yur du za/ / rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ e ma chu gter lan brgyar ma bsrub cing / / padma dkar po'i tshal las ma 'khrungs yang / / mdzes sdug rdzogs pa dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i zhal/ / mthong bas skal bzang yid la kun dga' ster/ / bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/khros pas sdang mig g.yo bar mi byed la/ rno ngar ldan pa'i mtshon cha ma 'phang 385

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'ithonama'i g.yo ཿma/zhing / / drang srong dmod pa'i dug ni ma spros par/ / yid srubs sder bcas 'joms mdzad zas gtsang sras/ / rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ ha ri tsan dan brdar ba'i bsung zhim dang / / bkod legs nor bu'i do shal mi ldan yang / / tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i mthu nyid las/ / 'jig rten kun yid 'phrog byed u pra li/ / rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad par bajod pa/ bgrang yas bskal pa'i bar du ma goms shing / / lus srog sbyin pa'i ngal brgya ma bsten par/ / gsang chen rdo rje zeg pa'i myur lam gyis/ / tshe gcig zung 'jug sar bgrod thos pa dga'/ / bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor/ 'phags yul rigs pa'i dbang phyug phyogs kyi glang / / de yi sras po dpal ldan chos kyi grags/ / bsil ldan ljongs 'dir mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ / smra ngan 'joms pa'i grags pa bla na 'bar/ / smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor/ mi brtan rgyal po dgyes pa'i dga' ston dang / / rang 'dod 'ching ba'i grogs kyi phan gtam dang / /mi mngon thal bas g.yogs pa'i me bdag rnams/ /gang gis bsten na yun du phung bar 'gyur/ / gzhi tha dad bya ba 'gal ba/byang chub shing dbang drung du thub pa'i thugs/ / zag med dga' bdes yongs su gtams pa na/ / nag po'i rtsa lag sde dang bcas pa'i bdud/ / mya ngan zug rngu mi bzad srid la rten/ / gzhi gcig byed pa 'gal ba/ ma cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ / khro zhing 'khrugs pa'i dgra la 'jigs ster zhing / / ma rung g.yul las rgyal ba'i sgra skad gyis/ / ming po rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dga' bar byed/ / gzhi gcig chos du ma 'gal ba/ lus kyi kha dog dkar yang bsam pa gnag / nga rgyal rloms pa che yang yon tan chung / / stobs 'byor mnga' thang dar yang grags pa rgud/ / ma rabs skye bo de lta su yis bsten/ / rdzas 'gal ba/ mun pa'i zhal dkyil nyi zla'i sdang 386
