༄ / /snyan ca rabarjod cesa'aphroca༅gamig can/ / gangs ri'i mche ba glog gi ro 'dzin g.yo/ / lha mchog ma ca ka la'i gzugs kyi sku/ / dran pa yis kyang dgra sde'i snying rtsa 'dar / / las 'gal ba/ blo ldan byang chub sgrub la gzhol ba rnams/ / sdeg can dmyal bar skyur bzhes ma lags kyang / / de dag dben par lha chos sgrub pa na/ /ma rabs rnams ni don med khro bas mnar/ / sbyar ba'i 'gal ba/ phul byung rin chen gter gyur 'jings las thon/ / ma smad dpal gyi cha shas yongs su rdzogs/ / kun la phan pa'i 'od zer 'bum 'gyed des/ / skal bas dman pa kha cig long bar byas/ / skabs min bstod pa/ drag zhan mang po'i 'grog lug mi dgos pas/ / mtho dma' gang du 'phur kyang rje gcod med/ / bde ba'i yid myos mgrin pa'i rdza rnga sgrog / dkar mdzes ngang mo de yi skyid pa la/ / mthu phun tshogs kyi zol bstod/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro'i rol gar tsong kha pas/ / gdug can rgya 'dre btul la ngo mtshar ci/ / shākya seng ge de yis sa steng gi / bdud rigs ma lus cig car bcom min nam/ / dpa' ba phun tshogs kyi zol bstod/ rgol ngan log par smra ba stong gi mgo / rigs pa'i gad rgyang gcig gis 'gem mdzad pa/ / dge legs dpal zhes grags snyan sgra che yang / / rgol ngan de snyed 'joms pa sdig re lce/ / stobs phun tshogs kye sbyar ba'i zol bstod/ mi yi dbang phyug dpal dang grags pa ni/ / chu srin rgyal mtshan klong du mi bgrod na/ / ci slad pha mtha' mi mngon dpal gyi sde/ / longs su spyod pa'i khengs ba 'dzin par byed/ / mchog gi nges bstan/ gtsug rgyan nor bu'i 'od chags zur phud lnga/ / gnag snum phra la shig shig g.yo ba 'dis/ / rmongs ba kun bsregs du ba'i ri mo bzhin/ / blo gros snang ba rnam par bkra ba mtshon/ / mchog min nges bstan/ rin chen gser las snye'u mu tsi 387

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan ba'i sgonas gsung 'bum/ga'i/ / zong gi dga' ston lhag par rgyas pa 'dis/ / drang po'i lam bgrod mkhas pa'i skye bo las/ / 'byor ldan blun rmongs klad chung brin par ston/ /yon tan lhan cig brjod pa/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar dang / / ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rol gar lhan cig bstan/ / de nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i grags snyan dang / / thub dbang bstan pa'i snyeng po lhan cig rgyas/ / bya ba tha dad pa'i lhan cig brjod pa/ yid la dbyangs can dran pa'i mos gus dang / / lhan cig kun gsal lam du zla zer rgyas/ /skyed tshal dbus su sbrang rtsi'i snye ma dang / / lhan cig spyi bor lag pa'i 'dab ma zum/ / bya ba gcig pa'i lhan gcig brjod pa/ gdul bya'i blo mun sel ba 'chad pa'i dpal/ / smra ngan spobs pa 'phrog byed rtsod pa'i ngag /mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog rtsom pa'i dga' ston gsum/ / lhan cig sgrub pas thub bstan nyin mor byas/ / yongs brjes kyi rgyan ni/ ris med bsil ljongs 'gro la 'phrin las kyi/ / dga' ston bkye bas de dag gtsug gi nor/ / zhabs zung 'khor lo'i rgyan du 'phrog mdzad pa/ / phyag na padmo blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ / shis pa brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ gnas rnams kun la gzigs pa chags thogs bral/ / lus can yongs la brtse bas bu bzhin dgongs/ / bdud rigs rtsad nas gzhom pa'i mthu mnga' ba/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang pos khyod la srungs/ / gcig la gcig bsten gyi rab spel/nya gang zla ba la 'khu dbyangs ldan ma'i/ / zhal dkyil 'o ma'i chu gter 'dzum rlabs kyis/ / 'chi med na chung tshogs kyi snyem pa ni/ / mtshar sdug lang tsho'i dpal dang lhan cig 'phrogs/ / stobs mtshungs rab spel ni/ mdzes sku'i lhun po mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis brjid/ / gsung snyan dri za'i rgyud mangs rjes su 'gro / gnas lugs gzigs pas srid mtsho 'dar mdzad pa/ /388

༄ / /snyan ca rabarjod chesa'adzabasgogabashes gnyen dam pas dus kun skyongs gyur cig / dang por yod pa/lam lam 'bar ba ral gri'i rno rgyun gyes/ / kun tu rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod mdzad pa/ / dpal ldan brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i gzi byin gyis/ / blo gros 'dab brgya khong nas rgod par mdzod/ / gnyis par yod pa/ bgrang yas rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang ba kun/ / snyan snyan rgyud du 'khrol ba'i dbyangs ldan ma/ / mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'o mtsho ru/ / rtag par bzhugs la ngag gi dpal grub mdzod/ / gsum par yod pa/ rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor 'dab 'phreng spro ba'i gzhi/ / zung 'jug snying por 'chang ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ / dung dung gus pa'i yid kyis nyer bsten na/ / mchog thun grub pa'i dga' ston char du 'beb/ / bzhi bar yod pa/ gang gi thugs rje 'chi med sgeg mo yi/ / 'gram chang gzeg ma'i cha yis bran pa na/ / rmongs pas nyer bcings bdag blo'i ba ku la/ / lhag lhag ba'ad pa'i dpal ster drin can rje/ / dang po gnyis la yod pa/ khyug khyug rtsen pa'i gar gyis rol ba dang / lhang lhang snyan pa'i glu dang rol mo sogs/ / ngo mtshar dpal kun rdzogs pa rgyal po'i khab/ / 'chi med bdag po'i khang bzang dpal la 'khu/ / dang po dang gsum par yod pa/ ldem ldem mngon par bzhad pa padmo'i tshal/ / 'dab 'phreng ge sar rgyas pa'i ba gam ngos/ / dir dir stan pa'i glu dbyangs len pa yi/ / rkang drug 'phreng ba dal gyis 'khor zhing rgyu/ /dang po dang bzhi par yod pa/ yang yang rnyed dka' dal 'byor dbang gi rgyal/ / don gnyis legs pa'i dpyid 'jo 'di thob tshe/ / ltar snang srid pa'i bde la ma chags par/ / myur myur chos kyi snying po len par rigs/ /gnyis pa dang gsum par yod pa/ rab dkar chu 'dzin lang long g.yo ba'i dbus/ / lhung lhung dbyar gyi rnga gsang snyan sgrogs shing / / sim sim sbrang 389

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'icanasa'i gsung 'bum/char snyoms par 'beb pa yi/ / dbyar gyi dus ston gsar ba'i rab dga' rgyas/ / gnyis pa dang bzhi bar yod pa/ 'phags bod mkhas pa'i gzhung gi dka' gnas la/ / yang yang 'bad pa'i lus sems ngal byas kyang / /chos don 'byed pa'i blo dang mi ldan na/ / phyir phyir rmongs ba'i dra ba nyid du 'ching / / gsum pa dang bzhi bar yod pa/ 'o ma'i mtsho nang pad dkar zla gdan la/ / rnam rol smra ba'i rgyal bo ngag gi lha/ / ldem ldem g.yo ba ral ba'i thor cog rtser/ / lhag lhag 'od 'bar nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ /dang bo gsum la yod pa/ / lhang lhang rta skad 'tsher bas srid gsum 'geng / / 'ur 'ur rdog ma'i gseb nas me rlung spro/ / 'jigs 'jigs gar gyi nyams brgya'i rol ba can/ / khro rgyal rta mchog rol bas dus kun srungs/ / dang bo gnyis dang bzhi bar yod pa/ rang rang gces par 'dzin pa'i dbang gyur te/ / yang yang drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rnams la/ / log par bsgrubs pa'i las kyi chu klung gis/ / mang mang skye bo srid pa'i rgya mtshor khyer/ /phyi ma gnyis dang dang por yod pa/ ldir ldir 'brug sgra dal gyis rgod pa na/ / sgro gdugs blum por bskor ba'i mdongs mtha' rnams/ /ling ling mdzes pa'i gar stabs bsgyur byed cing / / hrig hreg 'dren byed sprin sngon khongs su gtod/ / phyi ma gsum la yod pa/ yon tan rtsa ba bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ / zab zab dka' ba'i gnad la ma sbyangs par/ / mang mang mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'chad 'dod pa/ / shig shig 'dar ba'i dga' ston bsgrub par zad/ / bzhi gar yod pa/ mdzes mdzes snying po ma lus bsdus pa'i sku/ / snyan snyan dri za'i 'jig rten rdzogs pa'i dbyangs/ / gsal gsal chos kun ma 'dres gzigs pa'i thugs/ /yang yang bsngags par 'tshal lo dbyangs ldan ma/ / chod pa dang po gnyis kyi 390

sa / /snyanadang rabarjod ma'aphrocagazung ldan/ legs bshad nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od snang gis/ / legs byas dpal gyi 'dab brgya bzhad pa na/ / smra ba ngan pa'i ku mu da tshal kun/ /cig car zum pa'i ngo mtshar e ma rmad/ / dang po dang gsum par yod pa/rnam 'dren bu ram shing ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ / ngan rtog 'khrul ba'i dri ma phra mos kyang / / rnam par dag pa dge ldan lugs bzang zhes/ / grags pa'i ba dan srid pa'i khong las brgal/ / dang po dang bzhi bar yod pa/ mkhas rloms glang po'i klad 'gem nga ro can/ / rnam dag rig pa'i lus stobs rab rgyas shing / / gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i ral ba gsig pa yi/ / mkhas mchog gdong lnga'i dbang po bsngags par 'os/ / bar ba gnyis la yod pa/ /mnyen lcug phyag sor rtse mos bskul ba yis/ / snyan 'gyur rgyud mangs sgra dang lhan cig tu/ / snyan tshig 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ngag gi lha/ / dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ma des bdag skyongs shig / gnyis pa dang bzhi bar yod pa/ pu lo ma dgra bde 'byung tha gu'i lto/ / 'jig rten mes po la sogs dregs ldan tshogs/ / kun gye gtsug rgyan nor bus zhabs bsten pa/ / 'jig rten gsum gye mgon gyur shākya'i tog / phyi ma gnyis la yod pa/ ris su ma chad lus can mtha' dag la/ / bu gcig lta bur brtse ba'i dbang gyur cing / /shes rab mchog gi nyin byed 'od stong gis/ / shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus cig car gsal/ / snga ma gsum la yod pa/ dkar zhing gsal ba 'o ma'i chu gter ngogs/ / dkar 'jam 'dab stong rtse na zla ba'i dbus/ / dkar mdzes bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal 'bar ba/ / rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter des dge legs stsol/ / dang po dang gsum pa bzhi bar yod pa/ smra ngan stong gi dregs pa'i ral ba kun/ / bden gsung tshig gis sa la bsnyil mdzad pa/ / smra dbang yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ / smra ba zla med 'dren 391

༄/ /yo ca bayo lo sgonayo gsung 4ma/mchog zas gtsang sras/ / phyi ma gsum la yod pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i chu gter bsrubs pa'i bcud/ / blo bzang legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od snang gis/ / blo gros 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal bzhad pa na/ / blo ldan rkang drug dga' ba'i glu dbyangs sgrogs/ / bzhi gar yod pa/ rnam dag lam ston dge ba'i bshes la bsten/ / rnam mang gzhung la ngal brgyas zhib tu sbyangs/ / rnam bkra rig pas yang yang dpyad byas na/ / rnam 'dren thub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs par 'gyur/ / bzhi gar yod kyang rigs mi gcig pa/rab 'byams gsung rab kun gyi dka' gnad la/ / rab gsal blo yi 'jug pa thogs med cing / / legs bshad skye ba lnga ba'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / legs byas khor yug yangs pa'i khyon kun 'geng / / dang po gsum pa dang gnyis pa bzhi par 'dra ba/ bdag 'dzin srad bus dam du bcings ba rnams/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol ba'i slad/ / bdag med gtam gyi seng ge'i sgra bsgrags tshe/ / srid pa'i tshang tshing ma lus 'dar bar byed/ / thog mtha' gnyis 'dra zhing bar ba gnyis 'dra ba/ bstan pa'i rjes zhugs rim pa mtha' yas kyang / / rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ / rgyal sras tshul bzung 'jam mgon bla ma yi/ / bstan pa rin chen mchog 'di zla dang bral/ / chod cing ma chod pa snga ma gnyis 'dra zhing phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba/zab zab man ngag gnad du grags pa can/ / zab zab gter gyi rgya yis bcings rnams las/ / mang mang rim byon mkhas pas bsten pa yi/ / mang mang gzhung lugs chen mo de dag zab/ / thog mtha' gnyis 'dra zhing bar ba gnyis 'dra/ chil chil g.yo ba'i rlabs 'phreng dang 'grogs te/ / ling ling zlos gar bsgyur ba'i ngang mo rnams/ / ling ling 'phur zhing lding ba'i gshog rtse yis/ / chil chil wu ba'i me tog mkha' la 'thor/ / bzhi gar yod 392

༄ / /snyanarang rabarjod bla/'dza'atshagapa/ chem chem rol mo'i brda mis spyan 'dren na/ / chem chem sa gsum g.yo ba'i goms stabs kyis/ / chem chem myur du byon la dgra bgegs kun/ /chem chem thal bar rlogs shig sa ma ya / / bzhi ga'i dbus kyi chod cing ma chod pa/ bde gshegs gsung rab rab 'byams dka' gnad kun/ /'byed pa'i mkhyen rab rab rgyas tsong kha pa/ / gang gi gsung rab rab gsal 'od snang gis/ / dri med shes rab rab rgyas dga' ston thob/ / chod pa kho na/ / ngo mtshar kun dga' kun nas rgyas pa'i dpyid/ / khor yug kun khyab kun bzang mdzad pa'i rlabs/ / lus can kun la kun dgar spro ba'i gnyen/ / 'dren mchog kun la kun nas phyag bgyid do/ / bzhi ga'i mtha'i chod pa/ kye ma rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal ba dkon/ / mjal kyang thos bsam tshul bzhin byed pa dkon/ / tshig tsam thos kyang nyams len byed pa dkon/ / sgrub la zhugs kyang mtha' ru 'khyol ba dkon/ / bzhi ga'i mtha'i chod cing ma chod pa/ sdang mig khong las spros pa'i me 'ur 'ur/ / dri 'dzin lam tu 'khrug pa'i rlung 'ur 'ur/ / zhal nas drags sngags nga ro'i gdangs 'ur 'ur/ / stangs stabs gar gyis rol ba'i sgra 'ur 'ur/ / bar mchod pa/rnam gsal mar me'i 'od kyis rang khyim gsal/ / 'od gsal rta ljang can gyis 'jig rten gsal/ / zab gsal ting nge 'dzin gyes dmigs rten gsal/ / dkar gsal dbyangs kyi rgyal mos bdag yid gsal/ / bar mtha' chod cing ma chod pa/ dbyangs can gsung snyan snyan pa'i dbyangs snyan snyan/ / gdub 'khrol sil snyan snyan pa'i sgra snyan snyan/ / rgyud mang skad snyan snyan pa'i gdangs snyan snyan/ / chos kyi gtam snyan snyan sgrog grags snyan snyan/ / thog bar du chod pa/ rnam dkar legs byas rnam brgyas bskrun pa'i sku/ / rnam mang legs bshad rnam par sgrog pa'i gsung / / rnam pa 393

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'isgronama'i rsāng dzom/thams cad rnam kun gzigs pa'i thugs/ / rnam 'dren dam pa rnams la snying nas 'dud/ / dang po dang gsum pa'i thog mtha' dang gnyis pa bzhi thog bar gye chod cing ma chod pa/ mtshar mtshar srid pa'i bde 'byor ngo mtshar mtshar/ / mtshar mtshar skad cig yal ba'i mtshar mtshar po/ /mtshar mtshar da dung sgrub la yid mtshar mtshar/ / mtshar mtshar byed pa 'di 'dra mtshar mtshar snyam/ / bzhi ga'i thog mtha'i chod pa/ snyan 'gyur rol mo'i khrod na rgyud mangs snyan/ / snyan pa'i glu la dri za'i mgur dbyangs snyan/ / snyan tshig gzhung la danḍi'i legs bshad snyan/ / snyan pa kun las rgyal ba'i grags pa snyan/ / bzhi ga'i thog mtha'i chod cing ma chod pa/gsal gsal nyi ma'i 'od kyis kun gsal gsal/ / gsal gsal lha yi mdun sar snang gsal gsal/ / gsal gsal me long ngos na gzugs gsal gsal/ / gsal gsal yid mtshor dbyangs can dkar gsal gsal/ / gnas gsum kwa'i chod pa/ mdzes pa'i zhal khyim mdzes sdug lan bus mdzes/ / mdzes pa'i thor tshugs mdzes byed tog gi mdzes/ /mdzes sdug rgyan 'phreng mdzes par bstar bas mdzes/ / mdzes pa kun bsdus mdzes ldan lha mo mdzes/ / gnas gsum ma'i chod cing ma chod pa/ldem ldem pad dkar ldem ldem 'dar ba dang 'grogs rlabs 'phreng sngo ldem ldem/ /ldem ldem ngang mo ldem ldem g.yo zhing 'phur lding rol ba'i gar ldem ldem/ / ldem ldem goms 'gros ldem ldem dal gyis rgyu ba'i gnyis 'thung lhod ldem ldem/ / ldem ldem skyal zhing ldem ldem rtsen pa'i na chung bde ba'i 'gying ldem ldem/ / mtha' thog sbyar ba/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ / rgyan drug mchog gnyis grags pa'i ba dan mchog / mchog tu mdzes pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul/ / yul gru phal ba gzhan gyi do zla 394

sa / /snyanadang rabarjod ma'aphro gamin/ /dang po gsum pa dang gnyis pa bzhi bar bzlas pa/ dkar gsal (zla ba )dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /mi bzad ('od ldan )snying gi gdung ba sel bar byed/ /dkar gsal (dbyangs can )dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ / mi bzad snying gi (bloldan )gdung ba sel bar byed/ /zla ba dang po gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi bar bzlas pa/ mdzes zhing yid 'ong ngang ba'i bu mo dkar/ / (dbyangs can ) snyan 'gyur mgrin rnga sgrog pas kun dgar byed/ / mdzes zhing yid (dbyangs can )'ong ngang ba'i bu mo dkar/ /snyan 'gyur mgrin rnga sgog pas kun dgar byed/ / dang po bzhi ba dang gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa/ mkha' la dal gyis rgyu bar byed/ /rab dkar mdangs ldan gnyis skyes ngang pa'i rgyal po rgyal/ / rab dkar mdangs ldan gnyis skyes rgyal/ / mkha' la dal gyis rgyu bar byed/ / (zla ba)dang po gnyis par bzlas pa/ thub bstan gangs ri skyong pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ / thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba'i gnyen (ngang ba'i rgyal bo )gcig pu/ /'jam mgon bla ma blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ / sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ / dang po gsum par bzlas pa/ mtha' bral lam bzang ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa/ / 'phags mchog klu sgrub smra ba bla na med/ / mtha' bral lam bzang ji bzhin gsal mdzad pa/ / 'jam mgon bla ma gangs can bstan pa'i bdag / dang po bzhi bar bzlas pa/rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod 'dzin/ / mthu stobs dbang phyug bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag / mi brjed gzungs thob gnas brtan dga' bo yang / / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang mdzod 'dzin/ /gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa/ rgyal kun yab gcig rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul/ / 'dzad med ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i lha/ / 'dzad med ngag gi 395

ro༅/ /gungathang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/'dod pa 'jo ba'i lha/ / rgyal yum dbyangs kyi dbang phyug dga' mar dgyes/ / 'dzad med ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i lha/ / rgyal yum dbyangs kyi dbang phyug dga' mar dgyes/ / gnyis pa bzhi bar bzlas pa/ sna tshogs sprul pa'i rol ba pha mtha' yas/ / gdul bya'i mos pa ji ba'in cir yang 'char/ / de bzhin gsung gcig nyid du gsungs pa yang / / gdul bya'i mos pa ji bzhin cir yang 'char/ / gsum pa bzhi bar bzlas pa/ bla ma mgon po gnyis su ma mchis par/ / rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ / las nyon bar chad ma lus bsal du gsol/ / las nyon bar chad ma lus bsal du gsol/ / dang po gnyis gsum du bzlas pa/ deng nas byang chub bar gyi skyabs mdzod cig / deng nas byang chub bar gye skyabs mdzod cig / deng nas byang chub bar gyi skyabs mdzod cig / skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum/ / dang bo dang gsum pa dang bzhi bar bzlas pa/ rnam par dkar zhing rab mdzes kun dga'i dpyid/ / pad dkar ji bzhin zla dang dbyangs can yang / / rnam par dkar zhing rab mdzes kun dga'i dpyid/ / rnam par dkar zhing rab mdzes kun dga'i dpyid/ / gnyis pa gsum bzhir bzlas pa/ mgon khyod yi dam chos srung mkha' 'gro ru/ / bsten no de bzhin bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig / bsten no de bzhin bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig / bsten no de bzhin bdag gi skyabs mdzod cig / lan bzhir bzlas pa/ dbang mchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ / dbang mchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ / dbang mchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ / dbang mchog de yis gong du smin par byed/ / tshigs bcad bzlas pa/ (yon tan )sngon bsags bsod nams dge ba'i mthu las byung / / sde bzhi'i phun tshogs sgrub pa'i gzhi dang rten/ /396

sa / / rabarjongs 'cha gaskye bo rnams yid mngon par dga' byed cing / / gang la ldan pa de yi don rnams 'grub/ / (nor ) sngon bsags bsod nams dge ba'i mthu las byung / /sde bzhi'i phun tshogs sgrub pa'i gzhi dang rten/ / skye bo rnams yid mngon par dga' byed cing / / gang la ldan pa de yi don rnams 'grub/ /zung ldan chen po/ dgos 'dod (dpag bsam )kun 'byung (nor bu )dgos 'dod kun 'byung / / dgos 'dod kun 'byung (smonalam/) dgos 'angod kun 'byung (nor bu )dgos 'dod kun 'byung (byang chub kye sems)/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung (sangs rgyas )dgos 'dod kun 'byung chos/ / dbos 'dod kun 'byung (dge 'dun ) dgos 'don kun 'byung (bla ma)/ /(dpag bsam )yang na/ chags pa med pa (rten byang sems )chags pa med(longasaspyod la )/ / chags pa med pa (phyibathol )chags pa med pa (chog 'dzin)/ /chags pa med pa (lan)chags pa med(rnam smin)/ / chags pa med pa chags pa med (rnam rtog nam g.yeng )/ / 'dres pa'i zung ldan/ngag la ngag gi dpal ster ma/ / ma khyod 'grigs 'grigs tshig gi sbyor ba kun/ / kun dgar 'jo bas longs spyod 'khor lo mchog / mchog tu grub pa'i dga' ston grub par mdzod/ / rkang ba bzlog pa/ rgyal sras rgyal ba dam pa 'dren mchog mkhas/ / mkhas mchog 'dren pa dam pa rgyal sras rgyal/ /lha yi lha mchog skyabs mgon 'gro 'dren rnams/ / rnam 'dren 'gro mgon skyabs mchog lha yi lha/ / tshigs bcad phyed bzlog dkar tsheng mdzes ldan dbyangs mchog lha mo sgeg / gzugs mdzes rab bkra rnam mang rgyan sdug mtshar / / mtshar sdug rgyan mang rnam bkra rab mdzes gzugs/ /sgeg mo lha mchog dbyangs ldan mdzes zhing dkar/ / rnga bor bzlog pa/mchog gyur dpal ldan dge legs bde ster mchog / mchog brnyes grub 397

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronaḥ ga 'bum/dbang smra la mkhas shing btsun/ / btsun zhing dul ba spyod tshul tshangs ldan mdzes/ /mdzes ldan khrims dag rnam kun skyon bral brjod/ / brjod bral skyon kun rnam dag khrims ldan mdzes/ / mdzes ldan tshangs tshul spyod pa dul zhing btsun/ / btsun zhing mkhas la smra dbang grub brnyes mchog / mchog ster bde legs dge ldan dpal gyur mchog / dbyangs a o e u bzhir nges pa/ gang la rab dang ldan pa mtha' dag la/ /blo gros dngos po mchog stsol 'khor lo'i mgon/ / dge legs gter chen spel byed ye shes che/ /phul byung lhun grub dus gsum kun tu 'jug / i a e/ dkar gsal cha shas rab gang dbyangs can zhal/ / mi shig snying dkyil ting 'dzin bir gyes bris/ / rnam pa thams cad zlas pa la 'bad na/ / bden zhen bsreg byed ye shes me chen spel/ / a u gnyis su nges pa/ yang dag lta ba gsal bar mdzad pa la/ / phul byung klu sgrub gzhung kun thugs su chud/ / ngag la dbang mdzad 'jam dbyangs bla ma gang / / mun 'khrul drung phyung tshul lugs zur du bzungs/ / a gcig bur nges pa/ / rtag chad mtha' las 'das pa yang dag lam/ / yang yang bsam pas lta ngan rang sar 'gag / gnad rnams mtha' dag lam lam shar ba na/ / dga' dang dad pas rab gang a la la/ / bkra shis/ /398
༄/ /stagaco rabarjo—'a྾ba glang gcin/phyed 'khor/kun 'khor37

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / che rabs rjes 'dzin gyi glon chig dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs so/༄7/ / dngos grub kun 'byung thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / rigs gsum kun 'dus rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ / dang po'i mgon po 'jigs med dbang po'i sde/ / dbyer med thugs rje bden pas deng 'dir skyongs/ / rgya ṭwāṃni ṭwāṃ ༵༷ bye ṭwāṃX ༷ ༷༷ṭaṃ ༵ ༷ shaṃ/rdobaX/ rdo mazlo ༷ṭwāṃrdo ṭwāṃbye ṭwāṃ ༷ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ rdoX/ |sding/ du ༷/༷ ༷ṭwāṃshaṃ ṭwāṃbheṭwāṃ /zlostu/༵/ ṭwāṃ~X du ṭwāṃ baspyaX hūṃtt+waṃ ༷ ni ṭwāṃdī rto nghru// mthu/ nihūṃ bskyed dpung pa yis/ / gang du bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba der/ /bdag sogs kun kyang 'bral med rjes bzung nas/ / zab gsang gsung gi bdud rtsis skyong gyur cig / khyad par thugs rje'i gter chen mgon khyod kyis/ / sa mkhan mdzad nas yid dga' chos 'dzin du/ / skyes te byams mgon yab sras mnyes byed cing / / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog / deng nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / khyod zhabs gus pas mchod pa mi gtong zhing / / mdo sngags lam bzang tshul bzhin sgrub pa yis/ / rtag tu khyod mnyes 'ba' zhig sgrub par shog / mchog gsum ngo bo 400

༄/ /cherabasarje 'abla ma'i thugs rje dang / / rten 'byung bslu med chos dbyengs bden pa'i mthus/ /bsam sbyor rnam dag dge tshogs la brten nas/ / ji ltar smon pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni chen po'i 'ud tsam ma yin par bshadasgrub kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba'i skyes mchog dam pa mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i tshe rjes 'jug grwa slob spyi nas bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon tshig cig dgos tshul bskul ma byung ba ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes dben gnayoyid dga' chos 'dzin du bris pa'o/ /sarbamagolam̐//401

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'thum/༄7/ / dge spyor rgya mjug tu 'don rgyu'i smon chig mdor bsdus bzhugs so/༄7/ / dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam bskal bzang gi / rnam 'dren rgyal ba stong dang bde gshegs brgyad/ / sangs rgyas so lnga nye sras brgyad la sogs/ / rgyal ba sras bcas thugs bskyed bden pa'i mthus/ / bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bgyis pa/ / mi mthun rkyen gyis nam yang mi gzhom zhing / / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyes bsngags pa yi/ / 'bras bzang mtha' dag 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig / g.yeng zhing bsam sbyor dman pas bgyis rnams kyang / / phul byung dge ba'i dngos por bsgyur byas te/ / de yi mthu las sngon bsags sdig ltung kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / 'di snang 'gag tshe nye ba'i sras rnams kyis/ / dbugs dbyung bde ba can du 'khrid pa dang / / der ni 'od dpag med mgon zhal mthong ste/ / gsung gi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston myong bar shog / skye zhing skye bar bshes gnyen dam pa yis/ / 'bral med rjes bzung bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang / / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i rkyen gyes mi g.yo bar/ / sa lam bgrod pa myur du mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa 'jigs med yar 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ / btsun pa 7bkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / / sarba mgo li1402

༄ / /myur 'aresabs mis/༄7/ / myur 'byon gsol 'debs kyi skor nyam thag skye bo'i gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sa / / steng ya gi dga' ldan lha yul na/ / mgon mi pham rgyal pa'i thugs kyi sras/ / rje mi bskyod dgyes bzhad thugs rje can/ / bu nyam thag gdung ba'i dbyangs 'di gson/ / skyabs dkon mchog gsum 'dus bdag nyid la/ / rje 'jigs med dbang por gsol ba yi/ / mtshan snyan pa'i ba dan srid na g.yo/ / pha bka' drin can de gang na bzhugs/ / sku nam mkha'i nor bu 'od dang bral/ / gsung tshangs dbyangs bdud rtsi'i sgo mo 'gag /thugs mkhyen brtse dngos su mi mthong bas/ / phyogs gar bltas mya ngam thang stong 'dra/ / gzugs mthong tshad mi sdug btson rwa bzhin/ / sgra thos tshad mi snyan rna bar tsub/ / gros da lta bsam pa da lta brjed/ / sems mya ngan sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'dis skyo/ / da rmongs pa'i mun nag smag rum na/ / las nyon mongs gcan gzan gdug pas gtses/ / da 'bros pa'i phyogs kyang mi shes tshe/ / kye thar pa'i sa mkhan gang du gshegs/ / nor bsam 'phel yod dus mi shes par/ / phyi'i rgya mtshor yod skad yi re mug / rje bla ma bzhugs dus mi bsten par/ / da dag pa'i zhing la 'bod de skyo/ / snyan sgrib pa med pas gsan na yang / / lan gsung ba las ngan bdag mi thos/ / 'al 'dzum pa'i nyams kyis gzigs na yang / / nga chu bur mig gis mthong mi nus/ / yid gdung ba'i dug gis khyab byed pa'i/ / gtam ngan pa'i sbrul nag 'jug pa'i 403

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgronaba'i gsung 'bum/sgo / las ngan pas sprul pa'i rna ba 'di/ / dus sngar nas 'on na ci ma rung / / lar dran pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa yis/ / sems mya ngan me lce 'bar pa'i rten/ / lus nad mang dug gi 'khri shing 'di/ / tshal stong du gas na dga' ba la/ / sngon brtse ba'i ma yis bu la bzhin/ / chos blang dor rjen par bstan pa'i dus/ / ro mnyam pa nyid du gnyid log pas/ / byur 'gong bo bdag la snyir yang tshim/ / sku mi rtag sgyu ma'i tshul bstan yang / / thugs mkhyen brtse'i ngang las mi g.yo zhes/ / lung dri ma med par gsungs bden na/ / thugs brtse ba'i spyan ras phyir la gzigs/ / thugs mkhyen rab mdzad spyod 'phrin las sogs/ / 'od dkar po'i bsil zer ma 'gyur kyang / / sku'i cha shas gsar du tshes pa yi/ / mchog sprul pa'i zla ba myur du byon/ / mgon chos rgyal la sogs srung mar yang / / dus da dung mthu zhig yong srid na/ / sku'i yang srid 'khrul bral myur gsal te/ / yongs bstan 'gro'i mgon gyur 'phrin las mdzod/ / dus ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed dang / / nged dpon slob mi phyed dad pa'i mthus/ / sku'i yang srid nyi ma gzhon nu yi/ / 'od dge mtshan snang ba rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni jun wang dang yobor rnam gnyis kyis gtsos gzhan du mas kyang nye bar bskul 'ing /gtso bor rang sems dad gdung drag pos bskul ba la brten nas rje nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos bsten pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pa'o/ /bshad ṭwāṃX spritt+waṃ nadzñā zlo zlo yam/tshan/ dīrnyi ༷dī dī ṭwāṃ rnyi dī kun dzee sam she ṭwāṃnani rdo/ rje/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rol ba/ / zla med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /spangs dang ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing / / gzhan phan sbrang rtsa'i rgyal 404

༄ / /myur 'debs tres/mtshan bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob chos kyi rje/ / bka' drin mtshungs med mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyod kyis bka' drin dran pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ / bskyod pa'i thal sbyar snyim pa'i me tog can/ / rtse gcig gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs na/ / brtse bas dgongs shing bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ / gdug pa'i spyod tshul glang po'i dpa' sgra can/ / cher snyigs lnga bdo'i dus kyi nags mtha' na/ / nyam chung bus pa rang dgar 'khyam pa rnams/ / dpa' po khyod kyi thugs rjes 'dor rigs sam/ / dbus 'gyur zhes bya gser gye rnga chen yang / / khyod kyi thugs rje g.yogs ma dang bral na/ / dpal dang 'byor pa'i 'od ris bkra na yang / / zab gsang chos kyi sgra de gang nas sgrogs/ / de slad chos sku'i lha dbang g.yo med kyang / / skal bzang dad pa'i baiḍūr sa gathi la/ / gang 'dul mdzad pa'i gar gyis rol ba yi/ / gzugs sku'i snang ba 'gog med bstan du gsol/ / bdag kyang deng nas tsher rabs thams cad du/ / khyod zhabs padmo 'bral med gus bsten nas/ / ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i legs smon yang / / khyod kyi thugs rje bden pa'i mthus 'grub shog / ces rje btsun bla ma dam pa dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa'i tshe gsol 'debs smon tshig 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dka' bcu 'jigs med mkhas ma chog gis bskul ngor dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs rdul gtsug gis bsten pa'i/ 7btsun pa dgon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bres pa'o/ /bshad sgrub rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo yis/ / blo bzang chos kyi srid la mnga' bsgyur ba/ / skal ldan gdul bya rgya mtsho'i gnyen gcig bu/ /mtshungs med bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ / thegs gsum dge 'dun 405

༄/ /༅ ca bas ba'i sgronama'i khrung 'byam/rgyu skar bye ba'i mgon/ / gsung gsang 'phrin las 'od kyi dra bas 'khyud/ /spang dang rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ / bka' drin dran pas dad pa'i dri bzhon gyes/ /bskyod pa'i thal sbyar snyim pa'i me tog can/ / rtse gcig gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs na/ / brtse bas gzigs pa nam yang ma g.yel zhig /kye ma ma la chos dbyings nub ri'i rtser/ / bstan pa'i nyi ma mthong ba'i lam las 'das/ / mdo smad bstan pa'i pad tshal yongs su zum/ / blo gsal rkang drug dga' ba'i snang ba nub/ / mgon khyod bgrang yas bskal bar gzhan phan la/ / gzhol ba'i go cha brtsan po mi 'dor na/ / snyigs ma'i brlang spyod lhag par 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ / bu chung spyos pa'i ma bzhin brtse bar mdzod/ / rigs rus cho 'brang mi dman shar ri'i rtser/ / dge mtshan bdud rtsi'i gzegs ma spro ba yi/ / mchog sprul zla ba'i myu gu 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /snying gi mun pa sel ba'i dga' ston stsol/ / thugs bskyed rnyogs pa med pa'i mtsho las skyes/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'dab brgya mngon par bzhad/ / 'azin las dri bsung phyogs mthar khyab pa yis/ / thub bstan 'chi med dga' tshal mdzes gyur cig / mkhyen brtse'i chu 'dzin g.yo ba'i zlos gar las/ / rgyal dbang grags pa'i legs bshad sprin gyi sgras /rdzogs ldan dbyar gyi lang tsho rgyas mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med mchog sprul dam pa myur gsal shog / bla ma yi dam chos srung rgya mtsho dang / / khyad par lha chen gur mgon lcam dral gyi/ / mthu stobs dpung bas dgra sde'i g.yul bcom ste/ /smon pa'i re 'bras lhun gyes grub par shog / ces yul mdo smad kyi ljongs su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan dam pa grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dge 'dun 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi zhal snga nas 406

༄ / /myur 'aresabamadzams/gzugs 'i bkod pa nyer zhi'i dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe slar yang mchog sprul myur 'byon gyi smon tshig 'di ni/ rje btsun dam pa de ga'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i rab 'byams pa ngag dbang chos 'byor gyis bskul ngor btsun ba dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /phul byung stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / dag pa don dam dbyings kyi rang bzhin chos/ / byang chub yan lag rnam sbyor dge 'dun te/ / bslu med skyabs gsum bden pas shis par sgrubs/ / dge ldan lugs bzang yangs pa'i mkha' ngos la/ / 'dun ldan thugs bskyed 'od dkar dra bas 'khyud/ / skal ldan gdul bya rgya mtsho'i gnyen gcig pu/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / sde snod gsum gyi rlabs phreng mngon par g.yo/ / rnam dag bslab gsum nor bu'i tshogs kyis gtams/ / theg gsum gdengs can bye ba'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob chos kyi rje/ / skal dman mig gis mthong ba'i lam las 'das/ / nyam chung bus pa brtse ba'i mgon gyis bor/ / srid pa'i rgya mtsho brgal pa'i gru gzings shig / kye ma gdung pa'i 'o dod su la 'bod/ /'on kyang spros bral dbyings su 'khor 'das kun/ / mnyam nyid bde stong rol bar gzigs pa yis/ / dmigs med snying rje'i go cha mi lhod pas/ / bdag sogs mgon med 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ / rigs rus cho 'brang mi dman dga' tshal du/ / mchog sprul gsar pa'i 'dab brgya rgod pa las/ / ngo mtshar rtags kyi dri bsung spro ba yis/ / snying gi gdung ba sel ba'i dge legs stsol/ / ring nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed lte ba las/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i rtsibs stong 'bar ba yis/ / blo bzang chos kyi srid la mnga' bsgyur te/ / 'gro kun gtan bde'i dpal la sbyor gyur rku7

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 4ma/cig / rtag tu khyod zhabs padmo gus mchod de/ / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med myong ba yis/ / 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ma lus lhun grub par/ / byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ / yi dam mchog gsum chos srung kun gye dngos/ / rje btsun bla ma'i thugs rje bden pa'i mthus/ / ji ltar smon pa'i 'dod don ma lus pa/ / gegs med lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dge ldan bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyi yang srid myur 'byon 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dam pa sprul sku blo bzang dam chos yar 'phel zhabs sdod dpon po bcas kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon meyodaben gnas dge 'phel bsam gtan gling du bris pa'o/ /chos 'dul gangs kyi ri bo'i spor 'gying zhing / / mdo dang rgyud sde'i ral ba'i khur gyis brjid/ / chos mngon dri med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs sgrogs/ / mkhas mchog gdong lnga'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ / tshul khrims dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ / phul byung ting 'dzin ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes/ / rnam 'byed shes rab snang ba'i dga' ston 'gyed/ / grub dbang kurdo'i gnyen la gsol ba 'debs/ / mang du thos pas gsung rab gdams par shar/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas spangs rtogs mngon du gyur/ / thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /mtshungs med bshes gnyen rnam thar bsam zhing dad/ / dkon mchog mthu dang gzhan phan thugs bskyed kyi/ / bden pas yang srid 'khrul med myur gsal zhing / / slar yang mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /bshad sgrub thub bstan dar zhing rgyas gyur cig / dus mthar thub bstan snying po spel ba la/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / /408

༄/ /myur 'byonagasora'adebasakyi na/rlabs chen thugs bskyed smon lam lhan cig pa'i/ / bden pas re 'bras lhun gyis grub par shog / skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / / tshos sogs dang / / rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang / / 'es sogs bya/zhes nges pa don gyi bshes gnyen dam pa bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po dus 'khor slob zur dkon mchog dar rgyas pa'i sku'i yang srid myur 'byon 'di ni/ nyed kyi bka' slob rab 'byam sa pa yon tan rgya mtsho dang rdo ram pa dkon mchog rab brtan gnyis kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa/'o/ /ba'i ranghru paṭwā de nghrudhi rdordo/ yongasalha ༷ dīX dīsgyu ༷gudī nga'/dren/ ༵༷dhi ṭwāṃ ༵ dzhai pa/ / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / kun bzang spyod pa'i zla shel dri ma med/ / rmad byung thugs bskyed ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes/ /thub bstan ku mud bzhad pa'i dpal yon can/ / snying gi mun sel bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ / bka' drin dran pa'i dad pa'i dri ba'on gyis/ /dbang med bskyod pa'i dang sems padmo'i kha/ / mgon po gang du gshegs pa'i zhing khams der/ / phyogs nas gdung bas gsol 'debs 'di dgongs shig / rgyal sras dpa' po rnying rje'i go cha can/ / 'khor 'das mnyam nyid sgyu ma'i rol par shes/ / dngos kun lhan skyes bde bar sdom mdzad rnams/ / srid pa'i skyon gyis 'jig par ga la 'os/ / de phyir khyod kyi thugs rje sbrang char gyis/ / 'tsho ba'i nyam chung myu gu sngon po'i tshal/ / 'joms pa'i than khyer gdung ba 'phrog pa'i slad/ / thugs rje'i sprin chen slar yang gtibs par mdzod/ / rnam grol thar pa'i lam bzang lta ba'i mig /mtha' med srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru/ / gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis 'grub pa'i rten/ / re sa gzhan na med do brtse bas dgongs/ /409

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung ཿma/rigs rus cho 'brang mi dman shar ri'i rtser/ / dge mtshan khyung sngon skyes kyis drangs pa yi/ / mchog sprul mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'od brgya ba/ blo bzang bstan pa'i dpal du myur gsal shog / dmigs med snying rje'i rang gzugs myur mdzad mgon/ / ye shes lnga bdag rgyal chen sku lnga dang / / khyad par gnas chung rdo rje'i dregs ldan gyis/ / don 'di gegs med 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ / mdor na bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje dang / /bdag cag dad mos rten 'byung mi bslu bas/ / mchog sprul nyin mo'i snang ba myur gsal te/ / bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas gyur cig / ces mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis byang phyogs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa blo bzang mkhas mchog gi zhal snga nas kyi yang srid myur 'byon 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed sprul sku blo bzang thub bstan nyi ma sogs dam pa de nyid kyi sku'i gam gcar rnams kyis bskul ngor chos smra ba'i btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes rdzong dkar bkra shis dar rgyas gling nasabris pa'o/ /ye shes dri ma med pa'i lding khang nas/ / brtse ba'i spyan gyis 'gro la rtag gzigs pa/ / dus gsum bde gshegs sras dang bcas pa yis/ / snying gi gdung ba sel ba'i dge legs stsol/ / rigs grol brgyad ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso/ / lung rtogs bstan pa dam chos bdud rtsi'i gter/ / sku bzhi'i lang tsho dar pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / skyabs gsum ngo bo bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ / phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal bstan nyi 'od 'grib/ / lnga phrag snyigs ma'i mun pa kun nas 'thibs/ / dam pa'i mgon gyis mya ngam thang du bor/ / kye ma gdung bas 'o dod su la 'bod/ / gzhan phan kho nar gzhol ba'i dpa' bo rnams/ / rab 'bar dmyal ba'i gnas su mi skyo na/ / dmu rgod 'gro ba'i ngang tshul mi dgongs par/ / mdzes sku snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul 410

༄ / /myur 'debs sgos/bstan du gsol/ / cho rigs gtsang ma'i skyed tshal nyams dga' bar/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul dri bsung rdzogs pa yi/ / mchog sprul puṇḍa ri ka snyer 'khrungs te/ / phan bde'i sprang rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed par shog / tshul khrims lte ba las thon shes rab kyi/ / rtsibs stong rdzogs pa ting 'dzin mu khyud can/ / lung rtogs bstan pa yongs la mnga' 'byor pa'i/ / chos kyi rgyal po'i srid la dbang bsgyur shog / rdo rje'i g.yar dam gnyan po lhur bzhes pa'i/ / bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis kyang / / ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu ma lus pa/ / gegs med lhun gyi 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / zhes bstan pa'i gsal byed ra ngan sprul sku dge 'dun bstan pa dar rgyas pa'i sku'i yang srid myur 'byon 'di ni sprul sku dkon mchog chos 'phel sogs nas bskul ngor btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /bslu med dkon mchog thugs rje'i kun gsal mar/ / bde stong dbyer med ye shes zla shel khams/ / brtse chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'od dkar can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rnam dag khrims ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i gtso/ / gzhan phan thugs bskyed zab rgyas gdams pa'i gter/ / grub pa mchog brnyes dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ / skyabs gsum ngo bo gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ / khyod kyi thugs rje'i chu 'dzin grib bsil la/ / ngal bso bgyid pa'i nyam thag 'gro ba kun/ / glo bur nyid du snyigs ma'i tsha gdung gis/ / bsregs pa'i skal dman gdung ba ji ltar bzod/ / srid la rjes chags snying rje'i dbang gyur cing / / srid 'i mnyam nyid gzigs pa'i sems dpa' che/ / srid gsum lhan skyes bde bar sdom mdzad rnams/ / srid pa'i skyon gyes 'jigs par ga la 'os/ / de phyir thugs bskyed lha yi dga' tshal du/ / mchog sprul padmo'i myu gu nyer 'khrungs te/ / dam pa'i ngang tshul dri bzang spro ba yis/ / thar 'dod rkang drug yid 411

༄/ /༅ ca bam pa'i sgronama'i khrung 'a4/la dpal ster shog / ring nas thugs bskyed dam bca' nyer dgongs la/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i 'od brgya 'bar ba yi/ / yang srid nyi ma gzhon nu'i skur bstan nas/ / bshad sgrub bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par mdzod/ / nam yang mi bslu mchog gsum thugs rje dang / / bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ / ji ltar smon pa'i don kun lhun grub ste/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig / ces rje btsun bla ma dam pa mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dkon mchog bde chen pa'i zhal snga nas kyi sku'i yang srid myur 'byon 'di ni dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs sdod rnams nas bskul ba ltar/btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /mtha' yas 'gro la rjes su chags pa yis/ / thugs rje spyan gyis nam yang mi 'dor ba/ / bslu med skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / dpal ldanabla ma snying gi ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ / thub bstan snying po'i yang snying bla med pa/ / mdo sngags zab rgyas chos tshul bdud rtsi yis/ / skal ldan yid kyi re ba skong ba'i gnyen/ / 'dren mchog thugs rje'i gter khyod bdag la dgongs/ / sngon byung rgyal dang rgyal sras mtha' dag gi / gdul ba'i zhing du ma gyur bdag cag la/ / thugs rje'i zhal skyin khyod las gzhan med na/ /glo bur zhi ba'i dbyings su ci slad gzhol/ / nyams chung dmigs bu med pa'i bus pa bdag / las nyon gcan gzan gdug pa'i nags khrod du/ / thar pa'i sa mkhan khyod kyis yal bor na/ / kye ma gdung ba'i 'o dod su la 'bod/ / 'on kyang skal dman las kyis nongs pa las/ / rgyal sras snying rje'i go cha mi lhod pas/ / nyer zhi'i mkha' las gzugs sku'i zla snang gi /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar bstan du gsol/ / ma smad thugs bskyed te se'i gtsug tor las/ / 'phrin las rlabs kyi phreng ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ / som nyi'i rnyog bral yang srid lha yi chab/ / gdul bya'i bsod nams 'dzin mar 412

༄ / /myur 'debs mi /'bebs gyur cig / rnam dag khrims kyi rtsa ba rab brtan cing / / thos bsam bsgom pa'i me tog ci yang bkra / 'phrin las dri bzang phyogs brgyar spro ba yis/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i dga' tshal mdzes gyur cig / nam yang mi bslu mchog gsum thugs rje dang / / rdo rje'i g.yar dam lhur mdzad srung ma'i mthus/ / ji ltar smon pa'i re 'bras ma lus pa/ / gegs meng bde lag nyid du 'grub gyur cig / bdag kyang deng nas skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / bla ma'i zhabab skyes mchod pa mi gtong zhing / / bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/ / gtan bde'i dga' ston dpal la rol gyur cig / ces bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa sprul pa'i sku bstan pa chos ldan pa'i zhal snga nas kyi yang srid myur 'byon 'di ni/ chas pa go yu nang nayonyid la lhos bcas spyi tshogs dang / a 'khor brag dkar ri khrod pa bcas kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /༷dul tt+waṃ ṭwāṃṭwāṃ paṭwāṃ bye ༷ ༷༷ ༷nga kṣiṃ ༷ṭwāṃ shlau~X/ stan/ ṭwāṃhūm̐dī ṭwāṃX ༷ ṭwāṃṭwāṃ dbang tshogs kyi bden stobs dang / / blo bzang rgyal bstan srung ma'i 'phrin las kyis/ / ngo mtshar dge mtshan dri bsung mngar ba yi/ / yang srid tsan dan ljon pa myur 'khrungs shog / dal 'byor rten gyi yu ba rab tu brtan/ /rgya chen mang thos dar gyi sham bu g.yo/ / bsang gsum dbang gi rgyal po'i tog mdzes pa'i/ / dge mtshan 'od snang kun tu rgyas gyur cig / ces bstan pa'i gsalabyed ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las kyi yang srid myur 'byon 'di ni/ stos bcas rnams kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o /413

༄/ /yo ca b.lo rsā sgroname'i khrung ཿma/༄7/ / bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor dang lam rim gyi smon lam bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru nā thā ya/ 'dir bla mgon dbyer mi phyed pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la/ skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/ dge ba'i 'dun pa shugs drag po'i sgo nas/ spyi bor pad nyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng / / hūṃ yig mthing nag 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ / myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ / sku mdog mthing nag srin po khros pa'i tshul/ / phyag g.yas gri gug thod 'phreng ḍā ma ru/ / g.yon na thod khrag rtse gsum 'gas pa 'dzin/ / sbrul gyi rgyan spras stag lpags sham thabs can/ / me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa yi/ / spyi bor skyabs gsum kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ / bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma thugs rje'i gter/ / chos 'chad mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas glegs bam bsnams/ / dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa gnyis ga'i gnas gsum du/ / yi ge gsum mtshan hūṃ yig 'od zer gyes/ /chos kyi dbyengs nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/ / sras bcas rgyal bas bskor ba spyan drangs te/ / thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur/ / khyad par lhan skyes dga' ba'i rol ba yi/ / 'od kyi dra bas 'brel ba'i snang stong gzugs/ / gcig dang du mar snang yang mi phyed pa'i/ / bdag nyid gcig tu dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ / thog med dus nas dug gsum dbang gyur te/ / mi bzad sdig ltung je snyed bgyes pa kun/ / rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis mthol bshags na/ / bla mgon dbyer med thugs rjes byang gyur 414

༄ / / racer sgotha'abyoradang lamadzamasmosalam cig / mchog gsum mthu dang chos dbyings bden pa'i stobs/ / sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgyas sprul pa las/ / bshams dang yid kyis mos bzhin mchod pa'i sprin/ / ma tshang med pas sa gsum khyab pa 'dis/ / bla ma ma gon po dbyer med thugs dam bskang / / mtha' yas skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang / / dam pa'i chos kyi bar chad kun zhi zhing / / yang dag lam bzang 'grub par byin gyes rlobs/ / skyes bu gsum gyi lam gye rim/ pa yis/ / rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' dag sgrub byed cing / / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun 'gag ste/ / rang rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis zlobs /mdor na deng nas byang chub bar/ / khyod min re sa gzhan med pas / / blud zhi'i 'jigs pa kun sel zhing / / dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / bla ma mgon por dbyer med la/ / bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /mgon po bla ma dbyer med la/ bdag ni gus pas skyabs su 'chi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / bar gcod ma lus sel bar shog / ces bdunanam/ nyer gcig gam/ brgya stong sogs 'don/ mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs kun tu bdag / rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa dang / / de yi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen kun/ / myur mdzad mgon pos g.yel med bsgrub gyur cig / khyud par du yang skye ba'i phreng ba ru/ / bla ma mchog gis 'bral med rjes 'dzin 'ing / / nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba sogs/ / rnam dag lam bzang mngon du 'gyur bar thog / 'di snang 'gag tshe bla ma mgon po yis/ / 'jigs rung bar do'i g.yang sa las bsgral te/ / zhing mchog bde ba can dang po ta lar/ / skyes nas sku gsum go 'phang myur thob shog / ces sogs bsngo smon bya 'ing / bla ma mgon po'i spyi bo nas mar thibs te de'i thugs gar bzhugs/ mgon po yang rang gi spyi bo nas dbu 415

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/ma'i lam brgyud de snying gar byon nas bzhugs par bsams la rgyun du bla ma lha'i snang ba dang ma bral pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang / ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod pa/ bya byed kun la de nyid dpang por bzhugs te blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa sogs tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la 'bad par bya'o/ / zhes bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor rgyun 'khyer du bya ba 'di ni dad brtson blo gros mchog dang ldan pa khyom tsa rab 'byams pa 'jigs med tshul khrims kyis bskul ba'i ngor btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes da tshang lhun grub gling du bris pa'o/ /phul byung mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar bcom ldan 'das/ / de yis legs gsung lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ / tshul bzhin bsgrub pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sde/ / skyabs gsum ngo bo bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ / bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje'i bden pa'i mthu/ / rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las mi yol bas/ / bdag gis ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu kun/ / yid la brnag pa de bzhin 'grub gyur cig / deng nas brtsams te skye zhing skye ba ru/ /mi khom brgyad spangs dal 'byor rten thob cing / / don che rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul bsam nas/ / snying po len phyir gcig tu gzhol par shog / de tshe bshul ring lam gyi sa mkhan bzhin/ / 'di phyi'i legs tshogs 'dun ma kun gyi gzhi/ / lam ston bshes gnyen kho nar yid ches pas / bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin bsten par shog / phul byed gdon chen skyon rtog blo bkag nas/ / sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus gyis/ / bkur ste rnyed dang bka' bzhin sgrub pa yi/ / mchod pa'i sgo nas rtag tu mnyes byed shog / mgon des brtse bas rjes su gdams pa bzhin/ / brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po'i bcud/ / skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa la/ / thos bsam sgom pas tshul bzhin slob par shog / ring min nges par 'jig rten pha rol 'gro / ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal 416

༄ / / rachenasha'ala'abyoracasamabazod glags med/ / de las skyob pa dkon mchog gsum du nges/ / de yi bka' khrims las 'bras blang dor yin/ / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / /thugs rje byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / chung ngu'i lam la myong ba rnyed par shog / 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba'i skabs med cing / / sdug bsngal kun gyi rtsa ba ma rig par/ / mthong ste rnam dag bslab gsum nyams len gyis/ / nyer len ljon pa'i sa bon 'dzoms pa gces/ / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / /thugs rje byen rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / 'bring gi lam la myong ba rten par shog / mkha' mnyam drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma rgan rnams/ / srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol pa'i snying stobs kyis/ / bla med byang chub go 'phang bsgrub pa la/ / rgyal sras spyod pa ma tshang med pa dgos/ / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / thugs rje byen rlabs bdud ste'i chu rgyun gyis/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / chen po'i lam la myong ba rnyed par shog / blang dor gnas kun sgrib byed rmongs pa'i mun/ / sel byed yang dag lta ba'i 'od stong can/ / zhi gnas go la'i lam nas rgyu ba yis/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus skem par byed/ / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / thugs rje byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / rnam dag zhi lhag zung 'brel thob par shog / sangs rgyas las dkon rdo rje theg pa yis/ / tshe gcig 'tshang rgya'i myur lam sgrub pa la/ / thog ma'i 'jug sgo rnam dag dbang bzhi dang / / dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig sdom pa yin/ / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / thugs rje byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / mi nyams sku bzhi'i sa bon zeb par shog /gzhi yi skye shi bar do gsum sbyangs te/ / lam dang 'bras bu'i sku gsum 'grub 417

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgroname'i khrung 'bum/byed pa/ / tha mal zhen bral lha yi 'khor lo yi/ / nga rgyal gsal snang zung 'jug bskyed rim yin/ / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / thugs rje byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / bskyed rim phra rags rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog / las rlung rgyu ba dhu tir thim pa las/ / byung ba'i lhan skyes dga' ba'i ye shes mchog / rnam kun stong ba'i dbyings dang ro gcig tu/ / zhugs pas snang zhen dri ma ma lus sbyong / / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / thugs rje byen rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / grol byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa mthar phyin shog / de ltar tshe rabs kun tu bla ma yis/ /rjes bzung mdo sngags lam bzang legs bgrod na/ / 'od 'bar mtshan dpe'i sku dang bde chen thugs/ / dbyer med dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon du 'gyur/ / des na bla ma thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / / thugs rje byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / phyin ci log gi blo sna kun byang ste/ / zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig / mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / bla ma mchog gis dgyes bzhin rjes 'dzin cing / / ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub pa lhur blang bas/ / 'gro kun don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces bla ma'i thugs rje bskul te tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gye smon tshig la mthun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs skor cha tshang ba 'di ni dad brtson rnam dpyod ldan pa 'jam dbyangs don grub sogs don gnyer can du mas bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa 'dis kyang yang dag pa'i lam la bag chags khyad par can theb par gyur cig /418

ra dza/ / ra 445ra rta babacas/mthogadza ga༄7/ / bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul bzhugs so/ /༄za/ / 'dir bla mgon dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang gi spyi bor pad nyid tshogs bdag steng / / myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gter/ / sku mdog mthing nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs/ / zhal gcig phyag drug spyan bgrad mche ba gtsigs/ / g.yas na gri gug thod phreng ḍā ma ru/ / g.yon gyis thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa 'dzin/ / thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon phreng ba 'phyang / / sbrul gyi rgyan spras stag lpags sham thabs gsol/ / brkyang bskum gar gyis 'gying ba'i spyi bo ru/ / skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / gser mdog phyag gnyis rin chen dril bu bsnams/ / nor bu'i rgyan spras skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs/ / gnyis ga'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan pa'i/ / hūṃ yig 'od kyis dngos brgyud bla ma dang / / phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i skyabs gnas ma lus pa/ / bsdus te drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ / bla ma'i thugs ga'i 'od zer ser po dang / / mgon po'i thugs ga'i 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs/ / phan tshun 'dres pa 'od dang bde ba'i ngang / / thugs rje mthu stobs dbyer med bdag nyid gyur/ / na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo gu ru te/ badzra bī ra dī re ṇa thi ye/ za ka ḍā ki ni/ dzo ka dzo ki ni/ sarba bud dhā ya/ bo dhi satwa shar ṇi gatstsha mi kyai/ zhes lan gsum/ bla ma yid dam dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ / mkha' 'gro bstan srung thams 419

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ / 'di phyi'i rgud pa'i mun sel sgron me mchog /bslu med skyabs kyi dam par gsol ba 'debs/ / dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ / 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs gang du yang / / khyod min re ba'i skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ / 'bral med thugs rje'i phyag gis bzung du gsol/ / phyi rol gdon bgegs nyer 'tshe bsal du gsol/ /nyon mongs kun rtog rgyu ba bcad du gsol/ / skye shi bar do'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol/ /mi khom ngan song skye ba'i sgo bkag ste/ / zhing mchog bde ba can der drang du gsol/ / shugs drag snying rje chen po'i dbang gyur te/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs ma rgan 'gro ba rnams/ / sgrol ba'i mthu dang ldan parabyen gyes rlobs/ / zhes brjod cing de dag gi don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas/bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog /mgon po bla ma dbyer med la/ / bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi/ / bar chad ma lus sel bar shog / ces pa'i gsol 'debs lan brgya rtsa sogs bya/ de nas/ spyi bo'i mgon po dbu ma'i lam brgyud de/ / snying gar bzhugs shing de yi 'dab ma rnams/ / zum pa'i rtse mor rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dngos/ / 'od 'bar gser gyi rdo rjes mtshan par gyur/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs kun tu bdag / rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa dang / / de yi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen kun/ / myur mdzad mgon pos g.yel med bsgrub gyur cig / ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di yang dad brtson blo dang ldan pa dge slong blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /madhali/ /420

༄/ / mgogayogribase labartenapa'ibos rnala'abyor/༄7/ / mgon po grib sel la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dam chig rdo rje'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄7/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med thugs rje'i mthus/ / sdig ltung bag chags bcas pa kun sbyong zhing / / mchog thun dngos grub ma lus sgrub pa yi/ / rnal 'byor zab mo'i gdams pa 'dir zhugs shig / de'ang grib sel gyi gdams pa grub chen gyi gzhung las/ bshags pa bya zhing dam tshig bskang / / dam tshig bskang na dngos grub 'byung / / zhes pa ltar/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub gang zhig sgrub par byed pa la'ang dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas rgyud gtsang ba zhig gal che la/ dam tshig nyams chags skong bor byed pa'i thabs kyi rim pa mang na'ang / snyigs ma'i lus dus 'dir bla ma yi dam chos skyong thams cad la brten pa'i nyams chags thams cad spyong byed du bla ma mgon po dbyer mi phyed pa'i sgo nas grib sel gyi rnal 'byor skyong ba 'di las zab pa med pas/ de'i tshul 'god pa la/ mgon po'i sku bris 'bur ci rigs kyi rten dgram ste mchod pa legs par bsham sa/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / khyad par byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam dang / bla ma mgon po dbyer mi phyed pa'i mos gus shugs drag po'i sgo nas/ 'di ltar gdon par bya'o/ / rang gi spyi bor hūṃ yig 'phro 'du las/ / ye shes mgon po 'al gcig phyag drug pa/ / spyan gsum bgrad cing rno ba'i mche ba gtsigs/ / dbu skra smin ma sma ra me ltar 'bar/ / gri thod mgo phreng rtse gsum ḍā ma ru/ / 'gas pa 'dzin cing stag lpag sham thabs gsol/ / sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan spras 421

༄/ /gung ca bstan ba'itshoname'i gsung 4ma/g.yer kha 'khrol/ / g.yon bskyang stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ / pad nyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i gdan la bzhugs/ / ma cig las mkhan bzhi sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ / de yi spyi bor bka' drin gsum ldan gyi/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog dung ltar dkar/ / g.yas pa shel gye rdo rje thugs gar 'dzin/ / g.yon pa gser gyi dril bu dkur brten pa'i/ /gnas gsum sa bon yig brgya'i sngags kyi phreng / / dkar dmar mthing gas bskor ba'i hūṃ yig gis/ / dngos brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kun/ / spyan drangs rtsa ba'i bla mar dbyer med bstems/ / rdo rje gsum gyi lha yang spyan drangs te/ / 'bru gsum yig brgya bcas la thim par gyur/ / blo bzang rgyal kun thugs rje'i ngo bo nyid/ / dkon mchog gsum dngos bla ma rin po cher/ / gsol ba 'debs so sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ / de ltar gsol ba btabs pas gnas gsum gyi/ / sngags phreng las babs bdud rtsi sku lus gang / / bla ma yi dam lha tshogs la brten pa'i/ / dam tshig nyams chags mtha' dag byang bar gyur/ / gdul bya'i don slad zhi khro'i skur bstan yang / / nges don bla ma mgon po dbyer med par/ / gsol ba 'debs so sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun/ / lhag med byang zhing dag par byin gyes rlobs/ / de nas bla mgon sku yi 'od 'dres shing / / bla ma'i sngags phreng gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /babs te mgon po 'khor bcas gnas gsum gang / / de la brten pa'i nyes kun dag par byas/ / slar yang bla mgon gnyis ga'i gnas gsum gyi/ / sa bon yig brgyar bcas pa'i bdud rtsi'i chus/ / bdag sogs bgro ba kun gyi lusagang ste/ / sgo gsum sdig ltung ma lus dag par gyur/ / ces dmigs pa dang bcas te yig brgya bzla/ 'brel nas 'char dka' na gong gi byang bar gyur zhes 422

༄/ / mgodapogribasela'ibartenapa'irākha'arnala'abyor/dang / dag par byas zhes pa'i mtshams gnyis su yig brgya ci 'grub re bzlas te bla ma dang mgon po la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chags sbyong ba'i dmigs pa so sor yun du bskyangs/ de ltar yig brgya nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa sogs bzlas te/ slar yang /blo bzang rgyal kun thugs rje'i ngo bo nyid/ / dkon mchog gsum ngangos bla ma rin po cher/ / gsol ba 'debs so mdo sngags lam bzang kun/ / myur du rgyud la skye bar phyin gyes rlobs/ / gdul bya'i don slad zhi khro'i sgur bstan yang / / nges don bla ma mgon po dbyer med par/ / gsol ba 'debs so mdo sngags lam bzang kun/ / myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis zlobs/ /zhes sho lo ka gnyis ci mang bzlas/ srid las nges 'byung blo kha chos la phyogs/ / chos kun bla med byang chub lam du 'gro / bden zhen gdon dang phyi rol nyer 'tshe sogs/ / lam gyi bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i gnas su 'gro ba na/ / gnad gcod bar do'i 'jigs skrag mi 'byung zhing / / 'dzum pa'i zhal bstan gsung gis dbugs phyungs te/ / bde ba can gyi gnas der drang du gsol/ / mdor na 'di phyi bar do gang du yang / / mgon dang dpung gnyen khyod min gzhan med pas/ / nam yang 'bral ba med par rjes bzung ste/ / srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med thugs rje'i gter/ / bdag gi snying gar padma'i gdan bzhugs la/ / bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ / de ltar gsol ba btabs pas bla ma dang / / mgon po dbyer med 'dres te rang la thim/ / gnyug sems bla ma mgon po'i skur bzhengs te/ / 'du 'bral med par snying dbus rtsen gyur cig / ces snying gar gsal btab nas snying padma'i rnam par gnas pa'i 'dab ma rnams zum pa'i phyi rol tu sngags phreng gis bsdam pa bcan 423

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithonama'i gsung 'bum/parabyas par bsam la/ dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs kun tu bdag ces sogs dang / skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / zhes sogs bsngo bas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / zhes nges don gyi bshes gnyen dam pa blo bzang dkon mchog pas mtshon rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang mgon po dbyer mi phyed pa'i sgo nas grib sel gyi dmigs pa gtso bor bton pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dam tshig rdo rje'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog dge legs kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /424

༄༅/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/༄khya/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa bi har nyasma0 /༄7/ / rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ / snang stong srin po'i gar bsgyur nag po che/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'bas pad la/ / btud nas de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ / de la dang po yi dam gyi bdag bskyed dang bskang rdzas byin rlabs sogs dkyus bzhin sngon du btang la/mahrī khyi wikṛtānan4phaṭa/ masubhāwa shurnya sarba dhadru swabhā wa shurnyonyarta/stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las paṃ las padma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du gi las tshogs bdag dkar po/ de'i steng du hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur ba las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug pa cher 'bar ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nasaspyan gsum dgra la sdang mig g.yo ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/ bar ba gnyis kyis thod pa'i phreng ba dang rtse gsum/ tha ma gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs la dar ljang gu'i ska rags bcings te ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du spyo las lha mo nag mo dre'u rta la zhon cing ral gri dang nal thod 'dzin pa/ mdun du khro las khye ṭa pā la gri gug thod pa bzung ste dom nag spyon pa la zhon pa/ g.yas su dzi las dzin mi tra ḍa ma ru dang thod 425

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu ṭaṃ las ṭakki rā dzā cang te'u dang thod pa 'dzin pa/g.yon du traka las bdud mgon trakkad nag po rta nag la zhon cing ru mtshon dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ gzhan yang 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ga'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer gyis shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod shing tsan dan rkang gcig pa'i drung nas nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs ma hā kā la che/ / dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / khre ṭa pā la la sogs pa'i/ / 'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs/ / bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ / dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ / oṃ shrī ma hwa kā la ye sa pa ri wā ra yi bye hi/ khri nyer gcig brjod/ dza : baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ padma ka ma la ye snyi/ chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang / / ma rung kun 'dul khros pa'i sku/ / bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms mdzad pa'i/ / nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye sa ba ri wā ra arnya pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/ nas/ pāhūṃ/ bu1/ ju pe/ ā lo ke/gadhe/ nee blu du/ shabha pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hwa kā la ye sa ba ri wā ra rū ba/ shabha/ gadhe/ ra sa/ sbarsha pā tī smo hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ mchod do/drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud bar bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gye lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la khro ge ṭa bisnan bi nā ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā oṃ ā :/ sbyo mabo nag mongakhā hi oṃ ā hūṃ/ oṃ geta pā las/ oṃ dzin mi tra྾ / oṃ ṭa kki rā dzam / oṃ du ya ka dzam rtu phadra phaṭa oṃ ā :/ oṃ shrī ma hā 426

༄/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/kā la shā sa na nas hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa su hā oṃ ā rtu/ gzhan yang gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā :/ mgon po'i spyi gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku mdog ser po/ g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon gser gyi dril bu bsnams pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs dang ldan pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po la phog mgon po'i sku las 'od zer 'phros te bla ma la phog pas gnyis ka 'od dang bde ba'i rang bzhin du 'bar te dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ bdag sogs mar gyur sems can thams cad rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ / brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ / bla ma dang mgon po dbyer mi phyed pa'i bdag nyid can la gsol ba 'debs so/ /na mo bu rdzu ya/ na mo gu ru te/ badzra bī ra bī re ṇa shī ye/ ḍa ka ḍa ki ni/dzo ka dzo ke ni/ sarba burdo ya/ bo dhi satwa sha ra ḍi gatstsha mi kye/ las gsum/phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' khyed rnams kyis sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas byen gyis rlobs shig da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du nga/ 'dug sa 'di nyin du byin gyis rlobs shig mgon po'i spyi gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i 427

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gatshi ཿma/bla ma sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs gar bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/yig brgya bzlas la/ bshags pa ni/ hūṃ rdo rje 'chang dbang rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / / legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ / dngos grub 'byung gnas dngos rgyud bla ma la/ / log lta'i dbang gis brnyas smod bgyis pa dang / / dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin ma bsrung dang / / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas legs bsags nas/ / bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod brtson par ma byas dang / / ser sna'i dbang gis mchod gtor spyan gzigs rten/ / rgyu chung phud nyams lhag mas sbags pa sogs/ / sgo gsum 'khrul ba'i nongs pa ci mchis pa/ / bla ma mgon po'i spyan sngar snying nas bshags/ / bzod par bzhes la bu bzhin bskyang du gsol/ / hūṃ/ rab 'byams kun bzang mchod sprin mtha' yas pas/ / stong gsum khyon kun rgyas par 'gengs pa yis/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang myur mdzad thugs rje'i gter/ / mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / / dmar nag khrag gi mchod yon chal chil g.yo/ / gdug can dbang po'i me tog ri ltar spungs/ / bam chen gsar rnying bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dis/ / myur mdzad mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / / zhun chen sgron me'i phreng ba tshar du dngar/ / khrag mkhris dri chab gaṅgā'i rgyun la 'gran/ / sha rus zhal zas snyan brjid rol mo 'dis/ / myur mdzad nga / / skam rlon mgo phreng sbrul gye chun po dang / glang lpags stag sham rus rgyan phyag mtshan drug / zhing chen 428

༄༅/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/g.yang gzhi rgyu ma'i do shal gyis/ / myur mdzad nga / / rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang rta mchog glog ltar 'gyu/ / g.yag ro gzhol chen lug nag spyi dkar dang / / bya nag gser mig ling ling g.yo ba 'dis/ myur mdzad ྾ /dom ltar rngam pa'i khyi nag mdur zhing rgyug / bya rog rgyal mtshan g.yab dar nag po dang / / rten gtor bskang gtor dus gtor gnyan po yis/ / myur mdzad nga / / gri snying mda' dar srog 'khor bla rdo dang / / rim gnyis bzlas brjod gsang ba'i bris sku sogs/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas ci mchis pas/ / myur mdzad ྾ / 'dod yon lnga dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ / nyi zla lhun po gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin chen gyis/ / myur mdzad ྾ / ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan kyang / / spyan ras gzugs dbang thugs rje'i bdag nyid du/ / yid ches rtse gcig dad pa'i gsol 'debs kyis/ / myur mdzad mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / / thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas/ / bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ / bzlog pa ni/ hūṃ/ chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ / lha chen mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ / zhes pa nas/ thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la spyo rtu mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ / dus 'dir bdag la stsal tu gsol/ / 'khor dang bstan pa longs spyod rnams/ / rgyas par mdzod cig srung ma'i tshogs/ / mgon po'i spyi gtsug tu drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas thod pa'i cad te 'u nam mkha' la khrol lo lo 'khrol zhing / phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs gar 'dzin pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid can/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis mkha' 'gro dang srid gsum thams cad dbang du sdud nus pa zhig 429

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ཿ sgronayo ga 'bum/bzhugs/ mgon po'i dpral ba'i sirdu ra'i steng du yi ge hrī dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa bcu gsum yongs su gyur pa las/ gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas ḍa ma ru 'khrol zhing / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis dmar sgor sgor gar mdzad pa bcu gsum du gyur/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dmar la sprug pa 'phros/ mgon po dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phog pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams ḍa yoru drag tu 'khrol zhing spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa dang / mgon po yang ḍa ma ru dang g.yer kha'i sgra sgog cing spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs/ zhal nas ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing gar mdzad pas mgon po dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku'i cha thams cad las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu khams gsum thams cad khyab par 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad dbang du 'dus/ dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du 'bab bar gyur/ oṃ badzra na ra kro kro hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hwa kā la khro khye tu bi snyan bi nā ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la shā sa na u ba ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pabyi ma ka lo a yi i dam ratna tra ya/ a pa ka dī ṭwāṃ/yate bra ti dzā/ sma ra si/ tad yi rda dukhye kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/kṛ zlo gro ṇḍa/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ spyo ma mo nag mo betta li sernya ku lu ku lu ma hā ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ oṃ ge tra pā la bisgyun hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzin mi tra wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭakki rā dzā sa ma ya spyo : phaṭa/ oṃ du ya ka dza ma hwa kā la tra kkang hūṃ phaṭa/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las yi las rlung ram̐ las me/ ā las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum 430

༄za/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba de'i nang gi phyogs bzhi dang dbus su byi edzre khaṃ hūṃ las sha lnga/ mtshams bzhi dang dbus su li māṃ paṃ rta baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ / de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa oṃ dang hūṃ la phog oṃ las bdud rtsir rgyun babs/ hūṃ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bkug pa dang lhan cig tu rdo rje zla ba oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung bas ro mnyam du gyur te dri ma med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i gyur/ oṃ ā :/ lan gsum/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi spu gu can du gyur ba'i 'od kyi spu gus gtor ma jubs te gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas thugs rgyud tshim par byur/ hūṃ ring po drug brjod de/ oṃ badzra ma ṭwāṃ ༷ rdob ༵ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃs // ༷ po di ༷ka hūṃ ṭwāṃ ༷ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵ ༵ bye ṭwāṃ ༵ twa rdo khasnya ༷ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵ /tra ka ra grogro ta mi sa ra kta ru ti kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum gyis lha mo dang / gnod sbyin bzhi la rang rang gi sngags kyi mjug tu ba bla ta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ zhes btags pa gsum gyis dbul/ shā sa na'i mjug tu ba bee ta btags pa gsum gye dam can rgya mtsho'i chogs gzhan spyi la dbul/ oṃ bri ma hwakā li ye sa pa ri wā ra arbhe pra tī tstsha hūṃ sā hā/ nas shasta'i bar gyis mtshad/oṃ badzra ma hā kā la khro ge tra nga ka hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā oṃ 〉 rtu / spyo ma mo 431

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/niX mo rdo ༷ ༵ ༷ ༵ hūṃ tt+waṃ/ phaṭa.oṃ ༵ṭa tra swā pāhā la zlo ṭwāṃ hūṃ pha/ ༵ ༷gosdi/ po ༵dhiX bcas la/ / bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ / dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang / / theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / / bstan pa 'jig dang dbyen byed dang / / bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang / / rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ / de dag nag po chen pos sgol/ / a spu ka mā ra ya phaṭa/mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngo/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ / nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ / phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ / g.yas pa gri gug bar ba 'phreng ba 'dzin/ / tha ma ḍa ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ / g.yon thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ / de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ / drag po'i zhal ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ / spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ dpral bar sirgyo ra yis legs par byugs/ / spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab bstan/ / khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ / rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ / shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / / dkon mchog dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ / rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / / ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal tu gsol/ / bhyodaka' ba dang du blangs nas khyod bsgrubs na/ / ma g.yel ma g.yel ma cig re ma tī/ / lus srog 'ben du btsugs nas khyod bsgrubs na/ / bsten pa'i tshe na ma cig snying ma ring / / rakta mtsho ltar bskyil nas khyod bsgrubs na/ /432

ro༅/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/bskul ba'i tshe na ma cig bang ma bul/ / gtor ma ri ltar spu ngas nas khyod bsgrubs na/ / rbad pa'i tshe na ma cig mthu ma chung / / khyod kyi g.yog ni mi bsrun gdug pa can/ / chu srin gdong can dgra bgegs sgrol la shog /slad kyi rjes 'brang seng ge'i gdong ba can/ / dam nyams dgra bo'i sros rtsa chod la shog / ma cig dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyos / / sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog pa dang / / mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsal tu gsol/ / hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po'i shar gyi bka' nyan pa/ / gnod sbyin khye tra pā la las mdzod cig / dpal ldan mgon po'i lho yi bka' nyan pa/ / dbang phyug dzi na mi tra las mdzod cig / dpal ldan mgon po'i nub kyi bka' nyan pa/ / gzin rje ḍakki rā dza las mdzod cig / dpal ldan mgon po'i byang gi bka' nyan pa/ / bdud mgon trakkad nag po las mdzod cig / hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po'i bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ / khre tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang / / ṭakki rā dza tra kkad re ma ti/ / phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang ris mgon po'i tshogs/ / dam can rgya mtsho'i srung ma khyed rnams kyis/ / byen gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / bla ma mgon po'i dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung zhing skyong ba dang / / rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la/ / sdang zhing gdug pa'i sems 'chang dgra bgegs kun/ / ma lus rdul phran bzhin du tshar chod la/ / 'khor dang longs spyod bshad sgrub mthun pa'i rkyen/ / thams cad yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar mdzod/ / mjug gi mchod bstod/ lhag chad kha bskang ba/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na gshegs gsol/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa sogs dkyus ltar bya'o/ /433

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/smras pa/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gter/ /sgrub thabs snying por dril ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ / 'di phyi bar do'i 'jigs tshogs las grol te/ / bla ma mgon po'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di ni dad brtson ldan pa dge slong blo bzang shes rab kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /na mo gu ru ma hā kā lā ya/ mgon po'i rgyun 'khyer mdor bsdus bya tshul ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed skur bzhengs pa'i/ / mdun du ā las mtshan ldan ka pā lar/ / dam rdzas lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga/ / sbyangs rtogs spar byas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ / oṃ ā :/ lan gsum/ mdun du pad nyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng / / ye shes mgon po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ / gri thod mgo 'phreng rtse gsum ḍā ma ru/ / zhags pa 'dzin cing brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs/ /sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan spras stag sham gsol/ / dpal ldan lha mo gnod sbyin bzhi la sogs/ / 'khor tshogs dang bcas gnas rnams 'bru gsum gyes/ / mtshan pa'i hūṃ yig 'od kyis dur khrod che/ / bsil ba tshal nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ / spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur / / chos dbyings ngang las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ / ma rung gdul phyir khro bo'i gar mdzad pa/ / myur mdzad mgon po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing / / phyi dang nang gi mchod tshogs ma lus 'bul/ / de yi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / dngos brgyud 'dren pa kun gyis bskor ba rnams/ / 'od du 'bar bas mgon po 'khor bcas dang / / 'dres te bla mgon dbyer med bdag nyid gyur/ / bdag sogs nam mkha'i mthas gtugs 'gro ba kun/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma kun dang myur mdzad mgon/ / dbyer med ngo bor 434

༄za/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/snying nas gsol 'debs na/ / gnas 'dir da lta nyid du byin gyes rlobs/ / slar yang zhi ba'i mdangs ldan bla ma yis/ / rgyas btab rdo rje gsum gye lha yi tshogs/ / spyan drangs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis nyams chag dang / / sgo gsum nyes pa ma lus byang bar gyur/ / grib sel gyi man ngag dang bcas yig brgya mang du bzla/ mun pa'i khrod na rgyu ba'i spyod pa bzhin/ / sgo gsum bgyib log par gyur ba kun/ / thugs rje che ldan spyani sngar mthol byed na/ / sgrib bral chos kyi dbyings su dag par mdzod/ / lhun grub bde chen rol ba las byung ba'i/ / phyi nang gsang ba de nyid mchod pa'i sprin/ / ma tshang med pas mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ / thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur cig / gri thod 'phreng ba rtse gsum ḍā ma ru/ / zhags pa zhing chen glang lpags mgo 'phreng dang / / stag sham rus pa'i rgyan drug sogs 'bul gyi/ / bzhes nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ / mdor na bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ / zag med mchod tshogs rgya mtsho dgyes bzhes te/ / phyi dang nang gi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / / mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gzi byin gyis/ /gnas gsum ḍā ki'i tshogs rnams bskul ba yis/ / brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun la dbang bsgyur te/ / phun tshogs 'dod dgu char du bstel bar mdzod/ / oṃ badzra na ra kro kro hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/dmigs rim dang bcas bzlayopa bya ba ni/ oṃ badzra ma rwa kā la khro ge tra bigrun bi na ya ga( hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mgon po'i snyeng po la bsnyen pa bya/ / oṃ bri ma hwa kā la shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e kha a paṣpe ma kā lo/ a yo i di ratna tra ya / a pa kā dī ṭī/ ya ti pra ti dzā/ sma ra si/ tad i di ngu khye/ kha la khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra / gritna gritna/ brnyi brnya/ ha na ha na/ da nya 435

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i 0sa'i gsung 4ma da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hwa/ zhesartsa sngags mang du bzla/ 'khor rnams kyi sngags ni/ sbyo ma mo nag mo be tā li sernya ku lu ku lu ma hā ba bee ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ ge tra pā la bi rnyin hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ṭa kki rā dza sa ma ya spyo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ du ya ka dza ma hā kā la tra kkad hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams ci rigs bzla/ yangs shing rgya che mtshan ldan thod pa'i nang / / sha lnga bdun rtsi lnga sogs rdzas rnams kun/ / sbyangs rtogs sbar byas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che/ / mgon po 'khor dang bcas pas dgyes par rol/ / zag med bde ba'i mchog sbyin gtor ma'i tshogs/ / dgyes bzhin bzhes nas bstan dang bstan 'dzin kun/ /brtse bas skyong zhing mchog thun dngos grub kyi/ / dga' ston zad mi shes pa'i dge legs stsol/ / hūṃ/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ / zhes pa nas/ ci 'dod dngos grub myur du stsal tu gsol/ / rgyal kun snying dze'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs/ / snang stong sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul srin po'i skur/ /bzhengs te bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong mdzad pa/ / lha chen nag po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /nam yang mi 'bral bdag gi mgon mdzad de/ / yang dag lam gyi 'gal rkyen kun sel zhing / / 'dod don ma lus 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ /yig brgya lan gsum bzla zhing bzod gsol bya/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ / sogs dang / mgon po bla ma dbyer med la/ / zhes sogs gdung shugs drag pos lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod/ dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs kun tu bdag / ces pa nas/ myur mdzad mgon pos g.yel med sgrub gyur cig / rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang med na gshegs gsol bya'o/ / bla ma yid 436

༄/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/dam chos srung thams cad dang / / khyad par myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang gi / thugs rjes bden pas mkha' mnyam bstan 'gro yi/ / legs tshogs ma lus rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di ni u cu mu chin thog nas rab 'byams pa chos skyabs kyis 'di lta bu shin tu bsdus pa zhig dgos mas bskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa'o/ /na mo badzra snyir wā ya/ de'ang rje btsun mai tri pa chen po'i gsung las/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba las byung ba bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed po 'di nyid kyis 'phrin las kyi nus pa dang lnga na pa ra bya'o/ / zhes gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas chos skyong gzi byen bskyed par byas na pha rol gyi byad phur dang zlog pa sogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs pas stobs che bar khyung po'i yig chung sogs las gsungs la/ bdag skyed gzhan rje'i gshed la byed pa dang de'i sgo nas gzi byin bskyed pa 'brel tshul mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa la dpag na man ngag 'di chos rgyal lta bu la lhag par yang rigs 'gre sbyar chog par mngon/ byed pa'i mtshams kyang bzlas pa dngos gzhi'i mgor byed par gsungs pas/ na ra kro kro gi bzlas ba zin pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po'i spyi bor hūṃ yig mthing nag me 'od 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang mthu stobs nus pa ma lus pa khro bo'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba'i rnam par spyan drangs te hūṃ la thim/hūṃ de nyid mgon po'i spyi bo nas zhugs te thugs gar sleb pa na khro bo gathin rje'i gshed shin tu drag cing rngam par gyur/ de dang gnyi ga dbyer med du 'dres pas 'jig rten gsum na nga las nus pa che ba med snyam du dgongs shing mthu stobs dang gzi brjid 'bar bas khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa/437
