༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung ཿma/sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin du sgrogs shing 'phrin las rab 'byams thogs med du bsgrub par gyur par bsams la bzlas pa bya/ chos rgyal dang gnyis ka la byed na ye shes kyi mgon po sogs kyi spyi bor zhes sbyor zhing /chos rgyal gcig pu la byed na'ang de'i bzlas pa'i mgor/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i spyi bor hūṃ yig / ces skabs dang sbyar bas chog go / zhes pa 'di'ang 7skyabs mgon mchog gi bka' lung spyi bos mnos te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du bris pa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed/ hrī khyi sa bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pad nyi ma he'i gdan la ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las dam can chos kyi rgyal po ma he khros pa'i zhal can/ g.yas pas thod dbyug 'phyar zhing /g.yon pas dus kyi zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu sbom zhing thung la g.yon pa rkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i g.yon phyogs su rtsa dang rtse gsum las tsa muṇḍi nag mo rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ pho brgyad mo brgyad la sogs pa gshin rje'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par bee thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ tsa rtu baṃ to gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga spyan drangs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ de'i ngo bo khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga bas dbu brgyan par gyur/ kā la rū ba sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya wā/ kā la rū pa sa ri wār arnya/pu ṣpe sogs kyiyomachod/ ma.ā0hūṃ btags la nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs mdun du spyan drangs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dam 438

༄༅/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag par bsam la yig brgya bzla/ hūṃ/bla ma yi dam chos kyi rgyal po'i tshogs/ / khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal bgyis nongs pa kun/ / shugs drag 'gyod pa'i yid kyis mthol bgyid na/ / brtse chen thugs rje'i stobs kyis byang gyur cig / dgyes pa skyed byed phul byung mchod pa'i sprin/ / khrag gi mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra/ / sna tshogs spyan gzigs go mtshon gtor ma sogs/ / phyi nang gsang rten ma tshang med pa yis/ / chos kyi rgyal bo yum chen tsa muṇḍi/ / 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / / dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun 'i 'ing / /legs tshogs ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / pha rol mi bsrun gdug pa'i bsam sbyor sogs/ / mi 'dod nyer 'tshe'i rigs rnams ma lus pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i dpung gis phyir bzlog ste/ / las bzhi'i 'phrin las g.yel med sgrub par mdzod/ / oṃ kā la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsa muṇḍi hūṃ phaṭa/ces bzlas/ yig brgya 'don/ gtor ma nang mchod sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gye spu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ sngags kyi mjug tu ba bla ta btags pas gtor ma dang / mchod pa dang nang mchod dbul/ rab 'byams bde gshegs 'khor lo'i ye shes dang / / dbyer med dbyings kyi mkha' las snang stong gzugs/ / gtum drag tsha zer stong 'bar nyi ma'i bu/ / srid gsum skye dgu'i srog bdag khyod la 'dud/ / mun pa mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang zhing / / dus kyi sdang mig yon po glog ltar g.yo/ / gad rgyangs drag pos sdig can mthar byed pa/ / gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / deng nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i lung rtogs dam chos kun/ / 'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi 439

༄/ yo thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung lam/zhing / / 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ / oṃ 〉 rtu mu chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam la/rnam dag bsam pas zhes sogs bsngo/ smon gyis mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ / ces pa 'di ni a ro hor chin shog nas dge tshul blo bzang 'jigs med kyis bskul ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /bla ma gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ / 'jam dpal rdo rje khro bo'i zlos gar gye/ / rjes zhugs dmag zor rgyal mo'i zhabs pad la/ / gus pas btud nas sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ / de yang dpal ldan lha mo'i bsgom bzlas mdor bsdus nyams su len par 'dod pas/ bris 'bur gyi sku dang mchod gtor legs par bshams/ skyabs semasadang yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon tu btang / dngos gzhi la/hrī jo sa bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las rang gi mdun du mi mgo'i wu ba 'khrogs pa'i khrag mtsho zhag gi rba rlabs g.yo ba'i dbus su kham nagablung dmar 'tshub ma'i nang du dre'u gwa ba'i steng du spyo yig mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo mdog nag mi sdug srin mo'i gzugs can/ g.yas pa rdo rje'i be con 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas nal thod thugs shar 'dzin pa/ brgya phyed khrag 'dzag mgo phreng mgul bar 'phyang zhing / lnga phrag thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan can/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig g.yo zhing rnon po'i mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ nad rkyal la sogs pa dgra bo 'joms pa'i chas sna tshogs 'dzin cing gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor o/ mgrin par ā byugs gar hūṃ/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ byang shar mu le ting gi khrag mtsho nas dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas 440

༄༅/ /mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/skad cig gis spyan drangs/ spyo dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ / 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ / sngon gyi dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ / gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ / e ā ra li tho tho dza dza nag mo gdug can dregs pa can/ / kun tu khyab pa'i gzugs ston pa/ / nag mo'i gtso mo dre'u rta chibs/ / 'dir byon dre'u rta'i gdan la bzhugs/ / dza : baṃ ho slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang lha rnams spyan drangs te/ dbang gi lhas dbang skur/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yum dang bcas bas dbu brgyan par gyur/ spyo dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa las byung ba'i/ / chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ / dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas bstan dgra ma lus brlag par mdzod/ / oṃ kā li de sde sa pa ri wā ra arnya/ pābyi/ puṣpe/ zu pe/ ā lo ke gadhe/ ni blu rya/ shasta/ 0pa/ shasta/ gadhe/ ra sa/ spar sha pra tī smo hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ mchod do drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ ā ཿ/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs te/yig brgya bzla/ de nas/ spyo rdo rje 'chang sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /dngos grub kun gyi rtsa bar ma mthong bas/ / sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa rnams/ / 'gyod pa'i gdung ba drag pos so sor bshags/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas la yang / / bsnyen bsgrub g.yel zhing mchod gtor chag pa dang / / dam nyams grib phog dam rdzas sbags pa sogs/ / thugs dang 'gal ba gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ / mdor na bzang ngan spros pa'i mtha' bral ba/ / chos kyi dbyings la nongs pa ma mchis 441

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung ཿma/kyang / / kun rdzob 'khrul snang sgyu ma'i rol pa kun/ / rdo rje gsum gye thugs rjes byang gyur cig / spyo rnam kum mchog ldan lha yi dzing ring ngos/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin 'byung bzhi'i 'du 'bral las/ / legs 'ong mchod pa'i sprin phung mtha' klas pas/ / ma cig 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig /snying khrag dron mo'i mchod yon lbu ba 'khrogs/ / dbang po lnga yi me tog tshar du dngar/ / gsur chen dud pa baiḍūr mchod sdong bzhin/ / 'do gsal sgon me nyi zla'i rjes 'gro zhing / / zhag dang mkhris pa'i dri chab rgya mtshor 'khyil/ / sha dang rus pa'i zhal zas lhun por spungs/ / rngam brjid ngar dbyangs drag po'i sgra sgogs pas/ / dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam pa skangs/ / sprin gyi shugs 'chang rta nag rlung ltar 'phyo/ / mi bsrun g.yag rgod rdo rje'i rwa rtse gdangs/ / lug nag spyi dkar sha rgyas spu sdug 'jol/ / bya nag gshog 'jings gar gyes lha lam 'gengs/ / dom nag mchegatsigs dgra po'i srog la rngams/ / rdo rje'i go khrab sna tshogs mtshon cha dang / / rma bya'i gdugs mdzes 'tshub ma'i gur khang 'dis/ / dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs/ / dre'u rkyang ser srin po'i thod sga can/ / lpags pa'i gdan byas sgrul gyi gong rmed la/ / nad rkyal sho de'u mtshon gru bying dmar sogs/ / dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i chas kyis mtshan pa 'dis/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs/ / rdo rje be con nal thod khram shing dang / / thod skam dbu rgyan mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng / / zla nyi sbrul seng snyan rgyan re ba'i gos/ / mi lbags g.yang gzhi stag lpags sham thabs 'dis/ / dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs/ / dmar chen gtor ma'i ri bo mkha' la bsnyegs/ / srog sngags 'khor los mtshan pa'i mda' bo che/ / gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla rin chen 442

༄/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/bdun/ / mi phyed gdung shugs drag pos 'bul lags na/ / dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dmabaskangs/ / thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag gsos gyur nas/ / bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /spyo chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ / dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis/ / zhes sogs kyis bzlog pa bya/ sngags 'khor bsal btab ste/ / bhyo ragrospyogrogro spyo spyo ragro thun bhyo kha la ra ka chen mo ragro a bya ta bya thun sbyo 'u lu ngu lu hūṃ spyo hūṃ/ zhes ci mang bzlas ba'i mthar yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i lngags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol par gyur/oṃ kā li de wī sa pā ri wā ra yi de ba bee ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ kā li de wī sa pā ri wā ra zhes pa'i mjug tu a sogs btags pa'i mchod pa dang / oṃ ā : btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ spyo dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis/ / mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung / / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe bsring / / dge 'dun sde rnams srungs shing skyongs/ / rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon mdzod la/ / pha rol dgra po ma lus pa/ thal pa'i rdul du brlag par mdzod/ / spyo dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig dbyangs can ma/ / ma rung 'dul phyir srin mo khros pa'i gar/ / mi bzad gdug pa'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas pas/ / dmag dang zor gyi las mdzad khyod la bstod/ / sku mdog mthing nag baiḍūr ri po la/ / rab 'bar bskal pa'i me yis 'khyud pa bzhin/ / spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad pa tsam gyis kyang / / dgra bgegs ma lus 'joms mdzad khyod la bstod/ / zhal dkyil char sprin nag po'i klong yangs nas/ / ro 'dzin glog dmar g.yo ba'i gar dang bcas/ / ha ha'i gad rgyang drag pos bdud kyi 443

༄/ /ca thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/sde/ / snying rtsa skog mar 'byin mdzad khyod la bstod/ / mi sdug gzugs su bstan yang zhi ba'i thugs/ / chos dbyings bde ba'i ngang las mi g.yo ba/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor yongs kyi ma/ / dngos grub gter chen khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo'i bka' nyan pa/ /gdong can gnyis dang dus kyi rgyal mo bzhi/ / tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ / dam can 'khor tshogs rgya mtshor bcas la bstod/ /deng nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ / phyi dang nang gi 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / / tshe bsod stobs 'byor rnam dkar bshad sgrub sogs/ / legs tshogs yar ro'i zla bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ / mdor na byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ / rtse gcig gus pas bsrung mar khyod brten na/ / nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe yis/ / 'phren las sdongs grogs g.yel ba med par mdzod/ / de nas mjug gi mchod bstod dang /yig brgyas lhag chad bskang ba/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na gshegs gsol sogs dkyus bzhin byas la bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / ma cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma'i/ / bskang 'phrin mdor bsdus snying por dril ba 'di/ / bkod pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun/ / dam chos bsgrub la bar chad med par shog / ces lha mo'i bskang 'phrin mdor bsdus 'di ni rigs lam smra ba rab 'byams pa dkon mchog dngos grub kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyel du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jigs med bstan 'dzin no/ /na mo badzra pā ṇa ye/ mchod gtor khang brtsegs ma sogs 'du byas/skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ hrī ṣi sa bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du hūṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru 4la

༄/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas shing / 'khor sa gsum dang ldan pa/khrus kyi dzing bu/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ gter bum/ dpag bsam gye shing la sogs pas spel mar bskor ba'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rang ba'in gyi khang bu brtsegs pa dgu yod pa'i dbus ma'i nang du pad zla la chas las rgyal mtshan bos mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa phul nas de dag gi byin rlabs dang / 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor mtha' dag bsdus te bee la zim/ de yongs su gyur ba las rgyal bo chen po ngal gsos po/sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang /g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ seng ge dkar mo'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil mo krungagis bzhugs shing / sku la gser khrab gsol ba/ nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas gzi byin rab tu rgyas shing / phrag gong gnyis su nyi zlas brgyan pa/ phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs so sor pad zla'i gdan la/shar du dzasta la ser po rin po che/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po bum bzang /nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu/ byang du ku bee ra nag po ral gri/shar lhor yang dag shes ser po gser gri/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po mdung / nub byang du lngas rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs/ byang shar du bi tsi kuṇḍa li dkar po gri phub bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin zhing / rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la bcibs pa/gzhan yang gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ya thugs gar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ bee sa 'dzin yo5

༄ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 4ma/dbang po'i byang phyogs nas/ / rin chen mang sprul rnam thos sras/ / blon po rta bdag brgyad la sogs/ / 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ / bai shra ma na ye a garsha ya dza oṃ bai swāhwa/ oṃ ratna mu ku ṭa a sti khye ñtsa mi/ ka ma la dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ / kha gdangs mche gtsigs gdong lnga 'bar ba'i steng / / ga shal nor bu'i rgyan spras ngal gsos po/ / nga rgyal ser sna'i dgra 'joms khyod la bstod/ / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye sa pa ri ltar prokṣarṇa/arnya/ pāhūṃ/ añdza ma nee/ pukhye/ nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ bee shra ma na ye sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa snu dza me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ bañtsa ka ma gu ṇa'i gnas su/ aṣā mgo la dang / ma hā sasta ratna yang bcug ste dbul/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs te yi ge brgya pa bzla/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras thugs rje'i gter/ / 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ / bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rnams ma bcangs shing / / mi gtsang smad pa'i las la zhugs pa sogs/ / rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun/ / gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i yid kyi mthol bgyid na/ / spros bral chos kyi dbyengs su dag par mdzod/ / rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgyes byed mchod pa'i sprin/ / 'bru lnga snying po lnga dang rin chen lnga/ / bkra shis rtags rdzas gling bzhi lhun por bcas/ / phyi rten cang shes rta dang nang gi rten/ / lung thang phreng ba gsang rten 'khor lo sogs/ / dus gsum dge tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor kun/ / dmigs med ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyis/ / gus pas dbul lo thugs dam skong gyur cig / bdag cag dpon slob mi nor bcas pa yi/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi ba dang / / tshe dpal bsod nams mkho dgu'i longs spyod kun/ / dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas pa'i sdongs grogs 446

༄༅/ / mgon po'i gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa/mdzod/ / rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa chos skyong gi thugs ga'i sngags phreng la phog de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi phun tshogs thams cad bsdus shing sngags phreng rang gi lte ba nas zhugs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ ta du thā hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e bye hi/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ sarba aze me sā dha ya/ tabyu thā/ oṃ su dha ni/ su ra ti/su ma ti/ su su ṣe/ hi li mi li swāhā/ oṃ bee shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ oṃ dzambha la dzā lend+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ spru rṇa bha dra ye swā hwa/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swā hwa/ rma ku per ye swā hā/ oṃ sam pañdza na ye swā hā/ oṃ gu bye ta na ye swā hwa/ oṃ pañdzi ka ye swā hā/ oṃ tsi zhi kuṇḍa li ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las sbyo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ 'od du zhu ba las/ lha'i zhal zas dri ro phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum/ gong gi snyeng po dang 'khor so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ba bee ta btags pas gtor ma phul/ arnya sogs kyis mchod/ bai dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa'i/ / yon tan rang bzhin rgyal ba rin chen mang / / byang phyogs gnod sbyin skyong ba'i sde dpon gye/ / rnam rol 'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin khyod la bstod/ / dpag yas nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes te/ / ma lus 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel byed cing / / sgrub pa po la 'dod dgu'i dpal ster pa/ / rgyal chen yid bzhin nor bu khyod la bstod/ / dngos grub gter gyur btsun mo sras dang blon/ / khyad par nor pha7

༄/ /gung thang bayo ཿ sa'i ga4 'bum/gyi dbang phyug rta bdag brgyad/ 'khor dang bcas la gus pas phyag bgyid na/ / 'dod don ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ / ces bstod/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la/ oṃ badzra satwa ā ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / zhes sogs dang / oṃ wa rtu yu ma shes pa rang bzhin gyis gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bris sku la thim par gyur par bsams/ shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ / zhes pa 'di ni u rad (o rod)shog nas dad brtson ldan pa tho yon dge slong dge legs rgya mtshos bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ / 448

༄/ / dpalamagosazhalabazhipa'igator 'bulajogag༄7/ / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i gtor 'bul dngos grub kun 'byung dang bstod pa rngams pa'i sgra sgogs gnyis bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ / bde chen lhan skyes dga' ba'i rang bzhin las/ / snang stong srin po'i rol gar gdong bzhi pa/ / yum bzhi srid gsum dregs pa'i sde dang bcas/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs kyes gnas 'dir gshegs/ / mdun du 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus/ / khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i chos 'byung nang / / pad nyi mi ro brtsegs pa'i gdan khri la/ / dgyes bzhin bzhugs te rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod/ / sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon 'geng ba'i/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang / /sbyangs rtog sbar byas dmar chen gtor ma'i tshogs/ / gus pas 'bul lo thugs dam bskang gyur cig / bde chen rgyal po bcom ldan te ru ka / khro bo'i skur bstan rdo rje nag po che/ / mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo yum bzhi 'khor bcas la/ / snying nas 'dud do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / rdo rje 'chang sogs rtsa rgyud bla ma yis/ / bka' bsgos g.yar dam gnyan po dgongs mdzod la/ / sde 'dir phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / / chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig / khyad par nyes med nyes par blta ba'i dgra/ / bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig can 'di/ / gnyen bshes rtsa lag rgyud dang bcas pa kun/ / lo dang zla ba zhag tu ma bzhag par/ /449

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i me'i gsung 'bum/ltas dang cho 'phrul 'jigs pas spa bkong ste/ / nad dang gnod pa'i gnam lcags thog mda' yis/ / tshe srog dbang thang zas nor longs spyod kun/ /thal ba'i rdul du rlog cig sa ma ya/ / bskul lo zhing skyong chen po las la bskul/ / rbad do nag po chen po dgra la rbad/ / mthu rtsal dus la bab kyi mthu ma chung / / dam bzhag dus la bab kyi dam ma 'dral/ / yum chen ma mos rdal yams dgra la thongs/ / dregs pa sde brgyad 'khrugs pas cho 'phrul ston/ / gri thogs bshan pa'i tshogs kyis dgra bo 'di'i/ / srog rtsa chod la snying khrag zhal du stob/ / mdor na bdag cag dpon slob dge 'dun sde/ /kun gyi bsrung ma'i gtso bor mnga' gsol gyi/ / nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe yis/ / las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub la ma g.yel zhig /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ / dge 'dun thugs mthun bslab gsum nyams len dang / / mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba kun/ / gegs med lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / dus gtor dang dmigs bsal gyi skabs ma gtogs rgyun ldan las mdzod cig / ces pa'i mtshams nas/ mdor na zhes pa dang sbyor/ zhes dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba la gtor 'bul byed tshul bsdus pa 'di ni/ mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po dus 'khor dpon slob 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang / smra ba'i khyu mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog dar rgyas/ las sna mang dang bcas nas grwa tshang gi tshogs 'don tu dgos tshul ltar 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /brkyangs bskums gar gyes rol bas drag po chung ma dang bcas ngan song srid pa gnas nas skrod/ / shes rab phag mor rjes chags rol bas srid mthar spyor zhing mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde chen bdud rtsis myos/ / khro chags brjid ldan gzi 'bar gzugs sku'i mkha' dbyings rab dkar rus pa'i rgyan 450

༄/ /dpalamagogazha bzhipa'igator 'a༄phreng rgyu skar tshom bus mdzes/ / te ru ka dpal dpa' bo'i dbang phyug de la btud nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi ba la bstod par bgye/ / dmar chen dri snom gcan gzan nga ro rgyud mar sgogs shing ro langs kyis gang rab 'jigs durakhrod na/ / rba rlabs nam mkha'i mthar 'khyud bam chen mgo phreng lbu ba rab gsal khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong / / 'ur 'ur nag po'i dud sprin dang 'dres srid pa'i pha mtha' za byed ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ / pad nyi dgra bo bsnol ma'i gdan la brkyangs bskums gar mdzad lha mchog ma hā kā la khyod la bstod/ / yan lag rags shing lho ba rab 'phyang mi sdug srin po'i gzugs can mdog nag mun pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /dmar ser me yi ral ba gsig cing bcu gnyis nyi ma 'bar 'dra'i sdang mig yon po'i tsha zer 'phro/ / ljags 'dril khrag gis rab bsgos mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing gtum drag ha ha'i gad rgyangs mthar/ khro khri phe zhes mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud cing sa gsum dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i khyon kun 'dar bar byed/ / gri gug gis gtub dgra snying khrag dron gyis gang thod pa zhal du stob cing dgyes pa'i rkan sgra sgrogs/ / gnam lcags ral gri bdud rigs mgo bo bregs te brgya phyed phreng ba khrag gi rgyun ldan mgul bar 'dzin/ / mdung thung bgegs kyi lto bar bsnun pa'i rgyu rlon ga shal la 'khril sbrul nag chun po stong gis spras/ / g.yer kha'i sgra ldan 'og pags kyis bcing stag sham g.yo ba'i gar mkhan rdo rje nag po gdong bzhi ba/ / gang gi phyogs bzhir mig sman mar gad ro hi ta ka gser gyi brag ri rab mtho'i rtse mo can/ / mun nag dang 'dres me lce'i gos gyon gad mo rgod cing sa chen g.yo ba'i gom stabs bsgyur ba bzhin/ / g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo sigo li zhes rab tu khro zhing rngams pa'i yum chen srin mo bzhi/ / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 451

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/sreg byed gzi byin med dpung 'bar ba'i 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtshor bcas la bstod/ / mdor na mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don slad brtan g.yo'i dngos kun mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde ba'i 'khor lo cher/ / sdom mdzad dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams yongs kyi dbang phyug mchog gi gnas der bgrod pa ma rdzogs pa/ / de srid he ru ka yi bka' rtags rdo rje'i ri mos gtsug mdzes legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas kyis/ / sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pa'i bgegs kyi dpung tshogs sde dang bcas pa thal bar rlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / 'dir smras pa/ dpal gyi mgon po rdo rje gdong bzhi bar/ / bstod pa'i rol mo rngams pa sgra sgrogs 'di/ / byed po he ru ka yi zhabs bsten pa'i/ /7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me yin/ /452

sa / /chosargyalabasnyeg dngabacag༄༅/ / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa kha skong gsang sgrub kyi bskang ba dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ / na mo gu ru badzra bhi ra wā ya/ rgyal yum de nyid nogs pa'i shes rab la/ / rgyal ba'i yab tu gyur pa'i ngo mtshar yang / / rgyal sras tshul du rtsen pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ / rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha pa la 'dud/ / ha har bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs mthon po yis/ / srid pa gsum po shig shig 'dar byed cing / / nam mkha'i dbyings su rwa gdengs ma te'i gdong / /gshin rje gshed pos bgegs las rgyal bar mdzod/ / bla ma rdo rje 'jigs byed zhabs pad la/ / gus pas btud nas las gshin rigs gsum gyi/ /bsnyen sgrub rim pa dam pas bshad zin 'ga'/ / shin tu go sla'i tshul gyis bre bar bya/ / de la 'dir las kyi gshin rje phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub tshulabazhin du bya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis thog mar gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa gtso bor gsungs kyang / gnas khang lta bur byed na/ mun pa shin tu 'thib pas rngams gnag pa/ kha lhor blta ba dngos sam/ yang na yid kyis de lta bur mos te/ gza' dang rgyu skar sogs kyang mngon spyod kyi las dang mthun par 'char pa'i tshes la/ thun tshod kyang de lta bu nas mgo rtsom par bshad do/ / de la thog mar gnas khang byi dor legs par byas/ yi dam dang las gshin rigs gsum gyi rten 453

gung thang bstan pa'izla snye'i gsung 'bum/rnams go rim bzhin du bkram/ de'i mdun du stegs bu mthon po'i steng du/lcags snod lta bur nas nag rjen btags las byas pa'i gtor ma khru gang las mi chung bar bya dgos la/ de yang yi dam gyi gtor ma dkyus ltar dang / phyi sgrub la dpal bshos zur gsum pa rtse mor thod dbyug dang rdo rje'i tog gis spras shing / me ri sogs kyis brgyan pa/ nang sgrub kyi dbyibs de mtshungs la gri thod kyis brgyan pa dang / gsang sgrub kyi gtor ma nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can/ phyi sgrib kyi gtor ma'i g.yon du/ tsa muṇḍi'i gtor ma mtho gang las mi chung brtse gsum gyis mtshan pa dang / mtha' skor du mtheb kyu sogs phyag bzhes ma nyams par tshul bzhin du bshams/ mdun du 'bul gtor dang nyer spyod sogs ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dam nyams kyi rdzas sogs kyis ma sbags pa'i gtsang zhing gya nom pa/ phud ma nyams shing / g.yo zol gyis ma bslad pa dang / khyad par du yang 'di'i bsnyen pa'i yan lag la med du mi rung ba/ mi rkang gi gling bu/ thod pa'i ḍa ma ru/ sha chen gu gul bsres pa'i spos sbyor/ nang mchod sogs yo byad rnams tshags su tshud par byas/ ro gdan dngos ma 'byor yang / ro ras lta bu la bris pa'am/ tha ma'ang yid kyis de lta bur mos pa'i stan la 'khod/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / yi dam gyi mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas/rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan po la gnas pa zhig med mi rung bar dgos te/ rang la de lta bu'i gdong ci yang med par skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag po 'di lta bu la bka' bsgo ba ni/ rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba thung ngur byed pa'i sbyor ba lhur len pa yin par shes par bya'o/ / de ltar lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang khyad par can 'byung ba la yang bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa tshul bzhin du bsten nas mnyes par byas pa las/ smin byed dbang gi chu bo nyams pa med 454

༄ / /chosargyalabasnyegasgrungakha dadangabacagapar mnos pa zhig dgos shing / de'i sngon du'ang 'chi ba mi rtag pa nas bzung ste/ thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pas rgyud legs par sbyangs pa zhig dgos pas/ thog mar rang rgyud la rmang gzhi de dag tshang ma tshang blta dgos kyi/ dang po nyid nas mtho mtho dang rngam rngam 'ba' zhig la dasa' bas ni gar yang mi phyin no/ / khyad par du yang las kyi gshin rje 'di snyed lam gye 'gros dang bstun pa'i srung ma bshad pa'i skabs su/ skyes bu chung ngu'i tshas skyong du gsungs pa'i don 'chi ba mi rtag pa la sbyar nas bshad pa'ang yod la/gtso bo 'di nyid las dkar nag gi shan 'byed yin zhing / skyes bu chung ngu'i lam gyi srog kyang las 'bras kyi spangs blangs 'di nyid yin pas/ de'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ des na las 'bras kyi blang dor tshul bzhin du byas te/ dam tshig dang sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrungs na/ bsten sgrub kyang logs su mi dgos par chos skyong rang dbang med par 'khor ba'i rten de las lhag pa med cing / de dag yal par bor nas bzlas brjod dang dmod bcol ci tsam byas kyang / yi dam chos srung rnams thugs khrel pa'i rgyu las ma 'das pas dam tshig dang sdom pa gtsang ba shin tu gal che'o/ / de la las gshin rigs gsum po 'di ni/ gzhan gyi chos skyong tha dad pa gsum lta bu ma yin par/ rtsa ba dam can chos rgyal gcig pu de nyid sgrub pa po'i mos pa tha dad pa'i dbang gis las so so la sku'i rnam pa ston tshul tsam yin pas/dkyus gcig tu bsgrub pa'i tshe yang / mngon rtogs sogs gsal 'debs pa'i tshul rags pa tsam zhig so sor byas kyang / cho ga'i cha rnam pa thams cad nas ma 'dres pa mi dgos pas/ 'dir yang phyi sgrub nang sgrub gnyis kyi mngon rtogs sogs dkyus ltar byas te/ de'i bar du gsang sgrub kyi skor rnams 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ yi dam kyi bsgom bzlas gtor 'bul rnams 455

yo thang bstan pa'i sa khrung 'bum/grub pa'i rjes su hrī khye sa bsangs/ su bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma/ zhes pa nas/ lin dmar po gyen du langs pa/yang mdun gyi nam mkhar padma dang nyi ma dang ma he dmar po'i gdan gyi steng du yi yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad cing / sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor mtha' dag bsdus te yi yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog dmar nag rab tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ byi ru'i ri bo la bskal pa'i mes 'khyud pa lta bu/ ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong dang ldan pa/ 'bar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug cing / me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba'i sma ra dang / smin ma dmar ser gyen du badzes pa/ mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thugs gar 'dzin cing / thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlom pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / lego dmar po gyen du langs pa/ gzhan yang padma dang nyi ma zhes sogs/ phyi sgrub kyi mngon rtogs dkyus ltar byas/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe yang gsum ga lhan cig tu spyan drangs te/ dam tshig pa so so la thim pa'i mos pa dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyang lhan cig tu byas pas chog la/gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas ni/ rang yi dam gyi rten brten pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i tshe/ shar sgo'i rta babs kyi rgyab thad drang gi nam mkhar gsal 'debs par gsungs so/ / nang mchod 'bul ba'i tshe/ yam rā dzā sarba sirnyis ba ri wā ra oṃ ā :/ zhes pa bcug cing / bstod pa thun mong du bya/ snga phyi'i thun gang rung gcig ma gtogs par 'di nas bzlas pa la zhugs pas chog kyang /456

sa / /chosashākya khabasgongacasangabacazlagabaskang bshagasabyed pa'i tshe/ hūṃ bla ma mchog dang / zhes pa nas/ spros bral chos dbyengs ngang du bshags par bgyi/ / zhes pa'i rjes su/ hūṃ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / / dge sdig shan 'byed chos kyi rgyal po sogs/ / ye shes spyan ldan srung ma 'khor dang bcas/ / ma lus bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ / thog med dus nas srid pa'i btson rar tshud/ / ser sna la sogs nyes brgya'i lcags kyis bsdams/ / rmongs pa'i mun pa 'thib po'i dbang gyur te/ / las 'bras tshul la blang dor log par bsgrubs/ / dngos grub rtsa ba bla mar skyon brtags shing / / yi dam lhag pa'i lhar yang som nyi bgyis/ / chos skyong srung ma'i bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba sogs/ /sgo gsum nyes pa'i tshogs kun mthol lo bshags/ / dngos grub kun gyi rten du gyur pa yi/ / bsrung sdom bcas pa'i mtshams las 'das pa dang / dam rdzas gtor ma sogs la nyams grib kyis/ / sbags pa'i nongs pa ci bgyis mthol lo bshags/ / dbul phongs ser sna'i skyon du ma rtogs par/ /phyi phyir 'jungs pas sbyin pa mi gtong zhing / / 'dod la sred pas gzhan nor blangs pa sogs/ / khyod kyi dam tshig las 'gal bgyis rnams bshags/ / yab rje rgyal ba'i bstan la 'khu ba'i dgrar/ / drag pos las kyi tsham rngam mi ston par/ / zas nor gtam gyis byams par bskyangs pa sogs/ /khyod kyi thugs dang 'gal ba bgyis rnams bshags/ / mdor na bzang ngan spros pa'i mtha' bral ba/ / chos kyi dbyings la nongs pa ma mchis kyang / / kun rdzob 'khrul ngor bkra ba'i nyes ltung kun/ / brtse chen thugs rje'i stobs kyis byang gyur cig / bskang ba ni/ hūṃ/ mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde ba'i rol pa las/ / ting 'dzin gsal pa'i ri mo mchod pa'i sprin/ / sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin bkra ba yis/ / chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas 457

yo ca bstan yo yo ga4 'bum/dgyes gyur cig / khrag gi mchod yon rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo/ / dbang po'i me tog 'dab ma 'bum du bzhad/ / sha chen dud sprin lha yi lam kun 'gengs/ / tshil chen sgon me nyi zla'i 'od la 'khu/ / khrag dang zhag gi dri chab rgya mtshor 'khyil/ / sha dang rus pa'i zhal zas lhun por spungs/ / snyan cing brjid pa'i rol mo 'brug ltar sgogs/ / phyi dang nang gi nyer spyod dam pa 'dis/ / bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po'i thugs dam bskang / / chos rgyal yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs dam bskang / / 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / / thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas/ / bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs brlag pa dang / / dbul zhing phongs pa'i sdug bsngal bsal byas te/ / rnal 'byor dam chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen kun/ / 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /bskal ba'i me 'od 'phro ba'i brag gi ris/ / rab tu rngam pa'i ngar sgra sgrogs pa bzhin/ / kha dog dmar nag rno ba'i rwa gdengs shing / / rus pa'i rgyan sprasagatum drag ma te 'dis/ / bla ma gshin rje gshed sogs/ sho lo ka gnyisashong dang 'dra/ zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i gter chen po/ /char du bsnyil pa'i nor bu bsam 'phel dang / / yangs shing rgya che mtshan ldan ka pā la/ / dmar ser bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ba 'dis/ / bla ma nas/gangs ri'i mdangs ldan thod pa'i dbu rgyan dang / / chil chil khrag 'bab brgya phyed mgo bo'i 'phreng / / mu tig 'od chags rus pa'i do shal sogs/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyi bye brag dam pa yis/ / bla ma nas/ gzhan yang lhun po nyi zla'i rna cha can/ / gling dang gling phran bkra shis rtags rdzas tshogs/ / rin chen bdun dang go mtshon zas nor sogs/ / dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin phung 'dis/ / bla ma gshin rje nas/ lhun gyis grub pa'i 458

ri spru (15gdangosagrub stsol/ / zlog pa thun mong dang bzlas pa'i skabs su/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes bzazhing gtor 'bul gyi tshe yang / ya ma rā dzā sarba sid dhi sa pa ri wa ra yi da ma ba bla ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bcug la/ nang marakyang sngar ltar dbul/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ gang zhig yid la dran pa'i bsil zer gyis/ / dbul zhing phongs pa'i tsha gdung 'jil byed cing / /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun dar rgyas byed pa/ / chos rgyal yid bzhin nor bu la phyag 'tshal/ / rin chen ro hi ta ga'i lhun po la/ / rab 'bar glog gi zhags pas 'khyud pa bzhin/ / sgu mdog dmar nag rab 'jigs srin po'i gzugs/ / gtum drag tsham rngam 'phro ba khyod la bstod/ / dmar ser me yi ral ba mkha' la gsig / ha ha'i gad rgyangs drag pos srid gsum 'gengs/ / brkyang bskum zhabs gnyis brdab pas sa chen g.yo/ / rgyal bstan srung ma'i gtso bo khyod la bstod/ / 'jig rten gsum gyi dpal 'byor ma lus pa/ / dbang du sdud pa'i nor bu rin chen dang / / bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ba'i ka pā la/ / g.yas g.yon phyag gis 'dzin mdzad khyod la bstod/ / ye shes rang bzhin rab 'bar byin za yis/ / sde dang bcas pa'i bdud rnams sreg byed cing / / sgrub pa po la dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ / bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po khyod la bstod/ / 'jam mgon ngur smrig gar bsgyur tsong kha pa'i/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa kun/ / 'dzad med dngos grub char gyis skyong mdzad pa'i/ / chos skyong chen po khyod la snying nas 'dud/ / bdag cag deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ / dam chos sgrub pa'i bar gcod mi 'byung zhing / / phyi dang nang gi mthun rkyen ma lus pa/ / 'dod dgur lhun gyis grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ / ceyopas bstod/ de dag ni gtso bor ngag 'don gyi rim pa tsam ste/459

yo ca bstan rsāthonayo ga ཿma/gtso bor gyur pa bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ nang sgrub la rang yi dam du gsal pa'i thugs ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ hūṃ yig mthing kha'i 'og tsam la padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūṃ yig dang / mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba gsal btab/ chos rgyal gyi thugs gar yang de lta bu'i sngags 'khor zhig gsal btab ste/ rang gi thugs ga'i sngags 'khor te nyid drag tu bskyod/ sku'i dbyebs brgyud de/ shangs bug g.yas nas byung /chos rgyal gyi shangs bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ thugs ga'i sngags 'khor gyi dbus kyi sa bon la sib kyis thim/ slar yang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku'i dbyibs brgyud de shangs bug g.yas nas byung / rang gi shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs te thugs gar 'khod/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'gal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor zhing / de la yi ge rnams las sngags kyi gdangs zab mo 'brug sgra bzhin du 'u ru ru sgogs bzhin pa dang / me stag dmar chem chem 'phro ba de lta bu bsam dgos la/ de lta bu'i sngags kyi 'phreng ba brgyud mar 'khor bas/ chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul te/rang la lta mi nus bzhin du 'dud cing gus pa'i tshul gyis zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rab 'byams gang bcol thams cad bdag gis bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes shing dam bcas par bsams te/ sngags bzlas pa la 'jug dgos shing / phyi sgrub la sngags 'khor gnyis ga'i dbus kyi sa bon la yi yig mthing ga dang / tsa mu rnyi'i thugs gar rtse gsum la gnas pa'i rtsa yig gi mthar /sngags 'khor 'god dgos kyi/ dmigs pa'i khyad par gzhan 'dra'o/ /nang sgrub kyi sngags/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa 'di nyid yin par grags che la/ phyi nang gnyis ga'i sngags gcig par bzhed pa yang yod de dpyad par bya'o/ / gsang sgrub kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ thugs 460

rirdo ga pa/(19gagar nyi gdan gyi steng du dbus su nor bu 'bar ba la gnas pa'i yi yig dmar po dang / mtha' skor du/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sarba sid dhi hūṃ zhes pas bskor bar bsams te/ sngags 'phreng spro bsdu sogs snga ma dang 'dra yang /dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ 'di'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu dang / zhags pa'i rnam pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros nas/'jig rten gyi khams kun tu khyab pas zas nor longs spyod mtha' dag dang khyad par rgyal blon sde 'bangs sogag gang zhig dbang du bsdu bar 'dod pa thams cad rang dbang med par khab len gyis lcags phye bsdus pa bzhin du bkug ste dbang du 'dus par bsam la bzlas pa bya'o/ / bsnyen pa'i tshe cung zad 'tshub pa'i rnam pa byung na/ chos rgyal gyi spyi bor rdo rje nag po rtse lnga ba'i lte ba'i nang du/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig mthing nag 'od zeradrag tu 'bar ba zhig gong gnon gyi tshul du gsal btab des 'tshub zhi bar ma nus na/ rdo rje'i lte bar 'jigs byed ma te'i zhal can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ che chung tshon gang ba zhig gsal btab/ des kyang ma non par shin tu 'tshub cing las bsgrub par ma nyan pa'i rnam pa 'byung na/gnam lcags kyi rang bzhin gyi rwa rtse dang mig pa shin tu no ba'i ma te la gnas pa'i 'jigs byed/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig gsal btab ste/ de la ye shes pa bcug / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nus mthu yang 'od zer gye rnam par bsdus te bstem pas gzi byin dang ldan par bsams la/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'phros ba'i 'od zer gyis/ de'i thugs rgyud bskul bas drag tu khros te gar mdzad cing / ma tes kyang chos rgyal gyi dbu'i steng du yan lag bzhi drag tu brdab nas zing zing 'khrab pas/ chos rgyal bzod glags med par gyur nas las gang bcol bsgrub pa'i g.yar dam bor 461

gung thang bayo ba'itshonace'i gsang 'tham/bar bsam mo/ / phyi ma 'di dmigs pa shin tu 'tshub pas/ yi dam gye bsnyen sgrub tshad dang ldan pa'i gdeng ma thob par gtan nas bya mi rung la/de lta bu yod kyang brgya la thabs med byung na ma gtogs shin tu 'dzem par bya dgos so/ /'khu zhing zlog na srog mnan pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer chos skyong gi thugs ga'i sa bon la phog pas/ de'i gzi byin bkrag mdangs thams cad bsdus te/ rang la thim par bsam/ chos skyong phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i thabs ni/ thun 'jog khar de'i thugs ga'i sngags 'khorade nyid dbus kyi sa bon la thim/ sa bon yang shangs bug nas thon/rang gi snying kha'i sa bon la thim par bsam mo/ / dam tshig nyams chag skong ba ni/ rang dang chos skyong gnyis ga'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ yig dkar po re dang / yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kye 'phreng ba gsal btab ste/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzla zhing / dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag par bsam/ gzi byin bskyed pa ni/ rang dang chos rgyal gnyis ga'i thugs gar nyi gdan la hūṃ yig mthing nag re bsam zhing /rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa de'i thugs gar phog de'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las kyang 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus te/ de la thim pas hūṃ yig de nyid/ 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kye rnam par gyur cing / ba spu'i bu ga rnams kyang de lta bus gang bar bsam/ de ltar bzlas pa byas pa'i bsnyen grangs ni/ rab bye chen/ 'bring 'bum phrag bcu/ tha ma'ang sum 'bum bzla dgos par gsungs la/ bsnyen pa tshad dang ldan par song nas/ mjug tu kha skong gi sbyin sreg grub na legs pas/ de'i tshul yang ji ltar byed snyam na/ mgon 462

da / /ཿdzab 'ab(5mugapo sogs kyi sbyin sreg logs su snang bas dpe 'gre byas te/ me lha'i thugs gar chos rgyal tsam zhig bskyed pa sogs/ zur rnams bsgyur nas chos rgyal sbyin sreg gsar rtsom gyi ming zhig len pa las sla yang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung dris lan zhig tu/ kho rang gi sbyin sreg yod pa yin nam/ 'jigs byed sbyin sreg byas pas chog ces zhus pa'i lan gyi mchan bur/ 'jigs byed dang chos rgyal bskyed/ gzhan 'dra zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jigs byed sbyin sreg ji lta ba bzhin la/ mdun du las gshin gtor chog ltar bskyed dgos pa yin te/ 'dir nam gye tshe yang yi dam chos skyong 'di gnyis zung 'brel du bya ba ni/ man ngag gi gnad khyad par can yin pas/ tshul de 'dra ma go na/ gnad stor ba'i sngabs bde bde re la gdams pa'i mthil du 'dzin pa 'byung nyen che bar snang ngo / /gnyis pa bsgrub pa'i rnam bzhag ni/ lcags mkhar dang 'brel ba'i skor rnams paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las 'byung ba rgyun gyi phyag bzhes su bstar bzhin pa las shes dgos shing / gtor ma'i bca' thabs/'khoram dang ligo bri tshul de dag gi rdzas/ dgra bo 'gug cing gzhug pa'i tshul/ rtags mtshan gyi khyad par sogs mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig ni/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las 'byung ba ltar yin la/ skyob pa'i lha dang bral bar bya ba'i tshul zhal las shes dgos zhes kha 'phang mdzad snang bas/ de nyid ji ltar yin snyam na/ kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga bya ba ni/dang po srung 'khor dang phye/ de rjes srung mdud/ de nas go cha/ de nas 'go ba'i lha dang 'byed pa yin la/ des kyang ma grub na/ dgra bo'i lha srung rnams dgra bor nyid la khros nas/ de nyid gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i snying gi thad du gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i rnam par gyur te/ g.yon 463

ca thang bayo ཿ sgronama'i gatshi 'a4/skor du 'khor bas snying khrag dmar chil gyes byung / de nas 'khor lo de nyid sdig pa kha dgu mig dgu pa zhig tu gyur te/ dgra'i sha khrag rnams lhag med du zos par bsam mo/ / gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni sgrub pa'i skabs su/dgug gzhug byas pa'i ligo de nyid dgra bo dngos su bsams te/ gnas lnga dang / tshigs rnams su gzer btab/ skud pa nag pos rgya gram du bcings/ thod pas steng nas bkab pa'i srub la yang / sngags dang spel tshig bris/ stegs bu gru gsum pa'i khar bzhag bdag bskyed dang las gshin gyi skyed chog gnad du 'gro nges pa byas/ de rjes skabs skabs su thun brab cing / snga dro phyi dro dang thun snga phyir bzla rgyu'i sngags mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ shin tu khros 'khrugs rngam pa'i gshin rje rnams kyis mtshon cha'i char phab ste/ shin tu nyam thag pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i dgra bo de nyid thal ba'i rdul du brlag nas/ sha rus lhag med du gsol ba'i dmigs pa bya tshul sogs mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung las 'byung ba bzhin bya la/mjug gi mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ lhag chad kha bskang ba/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol zhing / bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa sogs ni dkyus ltar ro/ / khams gsum za byed gshin rje'i gshed po yi/ / bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje'i bsnyen sgrub kyi/ / rnam bzhag cung zad smras pa'i dge ba des/ / byang chub bsgrub la bar chad med par shog / ce4chos kyi rgyal po phyi nangagasang gsum gyi bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa kha skong gsang sgrub kyi bskang ba dang bcas pa 'di ni dad brtson rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog bsod nams kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mesachoyogrwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du bris pa'o/ /464

ra / / tor 0〈sma 'astso gabathershag༄khya/ / chos rgyal rnam gsum gyi gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa bzhugs so//༄7/ / 'jam dpal dpa' bo khros pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ / gshin rje'i gshed po mi yi rnam rol ba/ / chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang rgyal ba'i bka'/ / bden pa'i dngos po deng 'dir grub par mdzod/ / lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ / sgo med lcags mkhar chen po bcu drug nang / / dge sdig las kyi shan 'byed stangs 'dzin pa/ / chos kyi rgyal po phyi nang gsang gsum po/ / yum chen ma mo nag po tsamu ṇḍi/ / pho brgyad mo brgyad gshin rje'i pho nyar bcas/ / sngon gyi g.yar dam gnyan po nyer dgongs te/ / rnal 'byor 'phrin las sgrub phyir gshegs su gsol/ / dgra bo'i sha khrag rus pa las byung ba'i/ / mchod yon nyer spyod sogs dang khyad par du/ / dmar chen gtor ma ri bo ltar spungs nas/ / 'bul lo gtum drag rngam pa'i tshul gyis rol/ / sngon tshe bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyis/ / spyi bor dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya bkod de/ / dus mthar nga yi bstan pa srungs shig ces/ / ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bcas dus la babs / / dge ldan bstan la 'tshe ba'i bdud rigs kun/ / mi bzad dus kyi 'gas pas ske bcings te/ / zhing chen dbyug pas thal bar brlag byas nas/ / mthar byed zhal gyi me dpung nang du stob/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang / / dge 'dun thugs mthun bshad sgrub bya ba rgyas/ / bdag sogs 465

nyad gartsa bor bsten pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams tshad mar mdzad pa bzhin no/ /kha cig rgyud 'di dag rtsod bcas yin zhing / rtsod bral gyi khungs med zer pa ni rang gi de nyid ston par zad de/ gser 'od dam pa'i le'u bco lnga pa las/ g.yul gyi las la rtag tu dgyes/ / zhes dang / rtag tu dar gos nag po gyon/ / zhes dang / ram bya'i mdongs la gdugs byas te/ / rtag tu lha mo khyod mchod na/ / zhes sogs dmag dang zor la dgyes pa'i mtshan sgra cha lugs dang bcas pa gsal bar gsungs so/ / gzhan yang 'jigs byed kyegator sngags su/ khe tsa rā ya zhes pa gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal ldan lha mo la gsungs pa dang / gzhan chos skyong mang po'i sgrub thabs su dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs cung zad 'dra mi 'dra ba mang du gsungs la/ de ltar gyi bstod pa rgya gzhung yang mang du byung ste/ mdor na/ phyi rol nyid du dgra bgeg gdug pa'i gshed/ / nang du bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed nyid la/ / zag med bde ba chen po ster mdzad ma/ / zhes pa ltar/ yab 'jam dpal khro tshul rim pa gsum gyis yum dbyangs can khros pa gsum dang / ye shes kyi mgon po'i yum 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/chos kyi rgyal po'i yum tsa muṇḍi sogs thams cad dpal ldan lha mo 'di dang ngo bo gcig ste/ rnying ma'i phur srung re ma ti'ang 'di dang gcig par bzhed pas/ ming brgya ma la mtshan stong ma/ / gang nas bos kyang khyod kyi ming / / zhes pa ltar/ 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das zhi drag rnam pa sna 468—— —466

sa / /dpa ra༄tshong026skogasgrub/tshogs par 'char ba'i mtha' gzung du med kyang ngo bo zag med chos sku'i ngang las g.yo ba med pa ni rgyal ba byams pa mgon pos/ gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ / gang tshe bya ba phan gyur ba/ / de dang de la der snang ngo / / zhes pa ltar gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang kho na yin tshul shes te phyir mi ldog pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa rnyed pa ni srung ma bsnyen pa'i man ngag gi snying po de kho na nyid kyi rten mchog tu gyur ba yin pas gnad 'di la gzab par bya yi/ bstan srung ye shes pa yin tshul gye phyogs tsam yang ma go bar rdzas dang bca' shom mang po'i sab sub/ rol mo'i drag brdung / bskang ba'i grangs gsog tsam gyes srung ma'i thugs rgyud bskul bar 'dod pa gnas ma yin pas/ tshul 'di dag legs par bsams te rmang gzhi tshugs nges shig bya ba gal che'o/ / sgrub pa'i dus kyi khyad par ni rdo rje nag mo dbang phyug ma'i rgyud las/zla ba gcig la rgyu ba ni/ / nyi shu dgu ste gtor ma btang / / zhag gcig dag la rgyu ba ni/ / nangs nub nyin gung mtshan gung gnyis/ / gnad nas bos shing 'phrin las bcol/ / lo gcig dag la rgyu ba ni/ / tshes gcig lo gsar gnyan po la/ / rgyu ste gtor ma sbyin par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyi ma ni deng sang lo gsar tshes gcig la gtong ba'i tshes gtor dang / lha mo 'jig rten du gshegs shing rgyu ba'i dus dang bsgrigs pa'i cha nas gshegs gtor zhes grags pa 'di nyid yin/ zla ba dang zhag gi rgyu dus de rgyun pa'i bsnyen sgrub gtor ma sogs kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas/ bsnyen sgrub thog mar rtsom pa'i dus mar ngo'i nyi shu dgu'i srod lta bu la byas na legs/ spyir lha mo 'di nyid sgrub pa la gal che ba ni/ bsnyen pa 'dug pa'i gnad dang gcig / sgrub pa gnas pa'i gnad dang gnyis/ / bskul ba dgyes pa'i gnad dang gsum/ / man ngag las tshogs gnad dang bzhi/ / rdeg pa thun 469

༄/ /ca thang bayo yotshonama'i rsāng 'bum/zor gnad dang lnga/ / 'phangs pa dus sbyor gnad dang drug / myur mgyogs sbyin sreg gnad dang bdun/ / gnod pa las gzhug gnad dang brgyad/ / ces gnad brgyad gsungs pas/ dang po ni dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa dang ldan pas gnas mtshan nyid tshang bar phyi nang gsang ba'i rten tshang bas sgrub dgos pa yin/ gnas brag dang chu 'thab sa ma mo'i 'dun sa/ srin bya dang bdud bya skyung ka sogs gnas pa kha byang shar du blta ba dngos sam yid kyis de lta bur mos/ rten bzhi ni phyi'i rten bya rog gi gsob ma nyams ba'i nang du ro ras la bris pa'i lha mo'i tsa kli dang 'bru sman gyis bkang / mgul du dar nag la bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan dang bka' bsgo bris pa btags te rab gnas byas pa dang / nang rten nal bu'i gso ba snying ga man khrag sna zas sna mtshon cha/ 'bru sna sogs kyis bka' ba'i steng du lha mo'i sku dang / snying ga nas mgrin pa'i bar lha mo'i sngags dang spel tshig ro ras la gri khrag gis bris pa dang / mgo'i nang bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan dang bka' bsgo bris pas bkang / phyi nas mngal khrag gis thig le byas/ gos nag bsgos/ lag tu rgyal mtshan dang mgo bor rma bya'i gdugs phub ste lhar bskyed/ brtan bzhugs sogs bya/ gsang rten nal bu'i snying gi rtsa sbubs su lha mo'i sku dang / sngags padma raktas bris pa bcug snying gi nang thams cad rdo pha wang la bhyo bris pa dang / sman sna dar sna 'bru sna sogs kyis bkang nas dar dmar nag gis dril la/ brag nag por skyes pa'i snyug ma bya rog gi sgros brgyan cing / ltong dmar po nas sgo'i bar sngags bris te bcug pa/gnam lcags sam gri lcags kyi mde'u can/ rtsa bar dgra la sbyo zhes bris shing dar nag gis brgyan pa'i dar nag des gri snying mda'i mgul du btags/nas nag gis bkang ba'i sgom mam gtor ma la btsugs nas rab gnas sngar 470

༄ / /nas/ ra༄rngo7026steg( ba/bzhin bya/ bsham tshul mgon khang gi phu lta bu shin tu dben par nang rten gye gsob bzhag / de'i gdong ba'i thad du gsang rten gyi snying 'bab pa byas te mda' dar mdun du bzhag de'i phyi ngos kyi steng nas bya rog bi gsob brgyangs/ de'i phyi nas bee con nal thod/ phyag rgya drug khram shing sho rde'u dkar nag nad rkyal/ mtshon gru/ re nag dre'u'i gsob bam gzugs/ bong bu kwa ba/ rtse gsum/ ral ) byang khres/ ne'u le/nag po lnga'i gzugs dang / dar nag gi g.yab mo/ re lde go khrab mtshon cha sogs dngos dam bris pa'i spyan gzigs kyis bskor/ mtha' yol bas bcad de mi mthong bar bya/ de kho na nyid kyi rten ni sngar bshad zin to/ /de nas yol ba'i phyir thang ga bsham/ de'i mdun drang thad du bskang gtor/de'i g.yas su phebs gtor/ g.yon du bzlas gtor/ gtor ma'i mdun du g.yas su sman mchod dang / g.yon du rakta gnyis ka thod pa'i snod du bshams/ gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su yi dam gye gtor ma/ ga'an yang sngon 'gro'i mchod gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang skabs gang bder bsham/ / ḍa dril rnga rol rkang gling sogs dang / spos sbyor rgyas pa'am ma 'byor na sha chen gu gul cung zhi bsres pa sogs yo byad tshang bar bya/bdag bskyed kun gzigs lnga pas rdo rje gzhon nu gtso bor byed par gsungs la/ gong smos ltar 'jam dpal khros pa'i rnam pa so so dang mthun par 'ang shes rab bla ma sogs kyis dgra nag dang / mkhas pa mang pos gshed dmar yi dam du mdzad kyang / rang re rdo rje 'jigs byed la sgo kun nas 'brel che'o/ / gtor ma bsham tshul gong du bshad pa de sgrub gzhi ras bris lta bu la brten pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ gtor ma che ba de nyid sgrub gzhir byas te lhar bskyed pa yin na bskang gtor chung ba zhig mdun du 'jog pa'am thun so sor 471

༄/ /yo thangabayo yotshonas bang ཿma/'bul rgyu'i mtheb kyu snod du bsgrig nas 'jog / lhar skyed tshul yang dang po mngonatogs kyi dkyus ltar byed la/ thun phyi ma rnams kyi chos bon las mi skyed par sngar yod gsal 'deb kyi tshul du/ srab mthur gdug pa'i sgrul lasakhyas pa/ de'i steng du dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo zhes sbrel zhing gzhan 'dra/ bsnyen grangs gtso bor byas te thun la rgyas bsdus gtod na/mchod phreng sngags 'bul dang / oṃ kā li de wī sa ba ri wār ma hā pañtsa amṛ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rakta kha kha khā nyi khā hi/ ma hā ba lidha kha kha khā nyi khā nyi/zhes pas sman ra ka gtor gsum phul/ yan lag bdun pa man chad gtor chog rgyas pa ltar byed pa'am/ shin tu bsdus pa la mos na kho bos bris pa'i gtor chog lta bus kyang rung / bsnyen sgrub gnad du 'gro ba ni dam tshig nyams chag bskang ba la rag las shing / de'i tshul me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i le'u las/ nyams pa chen po bskang thabs ni/ /gtor ma khri dang sbyin sreg khri/ / de bzhin tsa ra gsum gyis bskang / / des kyang skong bar ma gyur na/ / dang po mkha' lding gsum gyis bskang / / zhes srog chags rgyu skong ngam bam skong du grags pa dang / me mchod kyi rdzas sna re yin kyang khri'i grangs gsog pa dang / gtor ril khri'am gang 'byor la sngags khris grangs tshang bar byas te bskang tshul mang du gsungs kyang / rgyud sde kun dgongs pa mthun zhing grags che bas 'jug pa bde la gnad tshang ba rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs te yi ge brgya pa bzla ba 'di yin pas/de'i tshe rdo rje gsum gyi lha'i thugs gar oṃ 〉 rtu dkar dmar mthing gsum la yig brgyas bskor ba las bdud rtsi de lta bu'i rgyun phabs/ lha mo 'khor bcas kyi gnas gsum gang bas sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad byang / rang dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/472

sa / /dpal rargya'atshaba'ibasnye shasgrub/gnas gsum dang lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sku gsung thugs la brten pa'i dam tshig nyams chag dang / sgo gsum gye sdeg sgrib thams cad dag 'du re gyis phyir thon/ lus dwangs gsal shel slong lta bu dang / sems bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du gnas par bsams la 'bru gsum dang yig brgya gang mang bzla/ bskang bshags rnams kyang tshig ris ltar dmigs rnam yid la byed bzhin pas ma yengs par gdon/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang yid du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las sngags 'phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa byung / zhal nas thon/ lha mo'i 'al du zhugs/thugs ga'i spyo la thim/ lte ba nas byung / rang gi lte ba nas zhugs hūṃ la thim/ mgal me'i 'khor mo ltar sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams kha dog sngo nag me 'od 'phro ba byur ba drag pa tsub pa can du rtse gcig tu dmigs te bzla bar bya zhing / mgyogs pa dang / bul ba dang / ma dag pa'i skyon bsal te/rtse gcig pa'i dmigs pa rno zhing smra brjod dag pos bzla dgos pa ni rgyud de nyid kyi le'u brgyad pa las/ sngags zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro'i srog rtsa yin/grangs kyang mang la zur yang ma chag ste/ / gu gu tsheg drag dag kyang ma nor na/ / lha mo nag mo dngos su 'grub pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bsnyen grangs kyang de nyid las/ sa ya bzlas na nag mo mngon du 'ong / bye ba bzlas na phyag rgya ston par byed/ / 'bum phrag bzla bzhin dang / dus zla ba drug sogs sam ma mtha' 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa'i skyon dang bral 'ing /mtshams kyi bar ma chad par bzla dgos/ bsnyen sngags ni bhyo bdun ma yin/ srog sngags me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi gleng gzhi'i skabs bcom ldan 'das dang / phyag rdor/ rta mgrin/ ral gcig ma rnams la phul ba bzhi/ sngags kyi le'ur tshar gcig bcas 'byung ba nang gses su'ang dpe 473

༄/ /gung thang bayo ཿsgronaryā rsāng 'bum/phal cher la mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'byung bas kha tshon gcod dka'ang / ma ma tra ka rakṣa kha mu tra ru lu ru lu hūṃ spyo zhes pa 'di phal cher gyi nang du yod pas btags na legs/ spel tshig gzhan rnams kyang bcug par 'gal ba med/dpe re gnyis la phra min ma he/ zhes pa zhig 'dug pa de/ gzhan phal cher gyi nang na/ bla ma ma ha re zhes pa zhig 'dug pa de'i yi ge log pa yin nam dpyad/ las sbyor lta bu dmigs bsal gye skabs ma gtogs bsnyen pa tsam la srog sngags 'di spyor mi dgos/ 'di'i dam tshig tu bud med thams cad la lha mo'i sprul pa dang 'khor dang bdag gi ma dang sring mo'i 'du shes byas nas smod pa dang 'thab rtsod sogs gtan nas byar mi rung ngo / / bya nag gcan gzan char rlung bu yug 'tshub ma chen po la smod pa spong / bud med nal bu byung ba la dga' bar byed/ bu la mgron bu sogs zan ster ro/ /'phreng ba la gzhan reg tu mi 'jug dam tshig nyams pa dang byes su 'grogs mi nyan/ rtag tu dam sel la 'dzem/ lo gsar tshes gcig gi nang dus dang zla re'i bco lnga'i nang dus su dus kyi gtor ma ma chag pa bya/nyi ma 'char ka nub ka ru thun gtor 'bul/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod pa dang / rang gi bya ba mdun ma kun gyi blo gtad byed/ brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga srog bzhin du bsrung ba rnams gal che/ mnyes ma mnyes kyi rtags dang drod tshad sogs me lce 'bar ba'i le'u bcu gnyis par mang du gsungs kyang mdor bsdu na/ sha 'phrig cing seng ges kyis 'gro ba rlung dmar glo bur du 'tshub pa/ khang pa 'tshegs pa/ sgo brdung ba/ thib gnon byed pa / 'od 'khyug pa/ dri chen po glo bur du 'thul ba sogs ni rtags kyi rnam pa zhig yin la/ 'on kyang de la brten nas skrag sngangs dang /nyams mi dga' zhing / sgrub pa las g.yel na 'tshub ltas dang / sgrub pa la 474

༄ / /ngas ra༄1'tshaba'i26steg(13/je spror 'gro na grub pa'i mtshan ma yin/ gzhan yang rmi lam du ma sreng chung ma bran mo/ dre'u dang bya nag lug nag sogs rmis pa dang / bud med dkar mo'am sngon mo rgyan can gyis bza' btung 'dren pa dang / 'dud pa dang / gos dang / rgyan ster ba sogs dris na bzang la/ bud med gzugs mi sdug pa dang / 'gying ba dang / 'phya ba dang / rdzas sba ba sogs ni dbang du ma 'dus pa'i rtags yin/ lhag par dam tshig nyams na mi lam du mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa dang / bud med 'thab pa dang / bya nag 'dzings pa dang / khrag gi na bun 'khrugs pa dang / lus la phyar ba bkab ba dang / bdag chus khyer ba sogs rmi'o/ rmi lam ngan na bka' chad 'ong bas bshags pa drag tu bya/ bud med mtshan ma ston pa/ spyo lab byed pa sogs ni dam sri'i ngo yin pas dam sri bzhi gnon pa'i man ngag bzhin bya/ bud med thal mo brdab pa rmis na dam rdzas ma gtsang ba yin pas man ngag bzhin du bshags so/ / bud med lce rtse ston pa byung na snying po chad pa yin pas sngags dag par 'don no/ / bud med so sgra sgrog na gzhan dang 'thab mo 'ong / bud med rgod pa mthong na dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rtags/sbyor ba mthong na dngos grub ster ba'i rtags/ rgyang glu len na 'grub thag ring / ngo la mchi ris yod na rims nad 'ongs/ gar stabs byed cing byung na ci bsam 'grub/ gling bu 'bud pa mthong na gtor ma 'dod pa yin/phrengab 'dren pa mthong na sbyin sreg 'dod pa yin/ skyes pa dang bud med rgyan gos can las la 'gro ba'am/ dmag chas can rmi na las spyor byed ran pa sogs gzhung nas bshad pa dang / blos dpyad de shes par byas la skabs su gang bab kyi thabs bya gal te 'bad kyang ma grub na ma mo'i snying khrag jub pa'i sbog chog sogs yod kyang ha cang 'chun dka' la/ mgon po'i man 475

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgronama'i khrung ཿma/ngag 'dir rgyas bka' chog par gsung pas/ rigs bdag gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal sras bcas kyi mthu stobs ma lus pa bsdus te thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim/ de las 'od zer 'phros lha mo'i thugs ga'i sngags phreng la thim pas mthu stobs thogs pa med par gyur bar bsams/ des kyang ma grub na 'jigs byed khres (khros)'khrugs rngam pa'i tshul gyis spyi bor gar mdzad pas lha mo bzod blags med par gyur te las gar bcos sgrub par bsams la srog sngags btags nas bzla/ nad rims zhi ba sogs gtso bor byed na bzlas pa'i tshe rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon dang / lha mo'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas yul 'khor de'i nad rims thams cad du ba dang khug sna dang sprin lta bu'i rnam par bsdus te gtor ma la thim par bsams la/ gtor 'bul gyi dus de zag medakyi bdud rtsir gyur ba lha mo'i zhal du drangs nas dmar seb kyis gsol bas rang dang yul 'khor gyi skye bo thams cad nad dang bral bar bsam/gdon zhi ba'i phyir du yin na rang la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo de dag gi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad bsdus te gtor ma la thim par bsam pa ma gtogs gong dang 'dra/ tshe bsod rgyas pa gtso bor byed na/ gtor ma'i rgyu la rin po che brdar ba'i phye ma'i mang du btang zhing shin tu bzang bar bshams pa dang / spyan gzigs mchod pa sogs kyang ci 'byor rgyas par bshams/ bzlas pa'i tshe dmigs pa ni rang dang lha mo'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang gi khyim dang bsgrub bya'i khyim gser gyes byugs pa ltar byas/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang / bang mdzod thams cad nor bgyis khengs pa sogs su bsam zhing / gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe gtor ma la 'jig rten khams kyi phun tshogs pa thams cad bsdus la 476

ra / / ngasapa ra(1'a mo'i /dbul dbang sdud la/ rang dang lha mo'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas dbang du bsdu bya rnams la phog de rnams kyi sems rang la dang ba dang gdung ba'i dbang du song bas mgo bo'i cod paṇa rkang pa la reg par bsams la sngags bzla zhing / gtor ma la'ang dbang du bsdu bya de dag gi zas nor sogs bsre ba byung na myur/ drag po la nang gses kyi dbye ba mang zhing / spyir zhi ba gsum la gtor sgrub dang / drag po la gtor chen dang mdos sogs gtso bor gsungs pas/ gtor sgrub kyi dmigs skor phal cher bsnyen pa'i skabs su'ang dgos so/ / de'ang bsten sgrub las gsum zhes pa'i go don ni 'jig rten na pha rol po dang g.yul 'gyed par nus pa'i dpung gi tshogs rnams la thog mar zas gos dang nor sogs byin nas mgu bar byed pa ltar/ dam tshig dang sdom pa legs par bsrungs shing lha'i rnal 'byor dang bzlas brjod mchod gtor sogs la yun ring du 'bad nas lha mo mnyes shing rang la nye bar byed pa'i sbyor ba la 'bad par byed pa ni bsten pa'o/ / de nas pha rol po g.yul 'gyed pa'i phyir du dpung gi tshogs de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te go bskon pa dang mtshon cha chas su 'jug pa sogs byed pa dang 'dra bar/ bsnyen pa tshad du thengs nas las la sbyor ba'i nye rgyu ligi dang / rdzas dang sman dang 'brub khung dang / thun la sogs pa chas su gzhug cing / las la sbyor ba'i nye rgyu lhag ma rnams dang / las de la thugs rings par bskul ba dang bzlas pa'i rnam pa gzhan byed pa ni sgrub pa'o/ / de nas dmag gi tshogs de dag g.yul 'gyed pa dang 'dra bar las de dang de la dngos su thun sngags drug sogs kyi bzlas pa dang / bsgral chogazor las sogs byed pa las sbyor yin zhing / rtsa ba bsnyen pa'i ga'i thengs pa gal che bas 'dir de'i rim pa cung zad phye ba yin gyi/ phyi ma gnyis dang 477

༄/ /ca ca bayo yo sgronayo kṣang las/gzhan yang las tshogs mang du yod pa rnams ni so so'i yi ge las shes par bya/sgrubagazhi ras bris yin na gshegs gsol byas tshe ar chog lta bur 'gro nyen yod pas/ spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams bris sku dang dbyer mi phyed par gyurabyas la/ su bra teṣṭhas brtan par bya/ gtor ma la brten ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa tsa kli'am/ rten rdzas rgyab kyi bris thang sogs la dmigs te/ rten dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur bya ba'am/ dam ye gnyi ga sngar ltar bstem yang rung / lhag par bsnyen pa'i dus dpal ldan lha mo rang la thim nas snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i thig le dang dbyer med du gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ ā tsā ma ko tiṣṭha badzra hūṃ/ zhes brtan par byas na 'grub thag nye ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad khyad par can yod do/ / srung ma'i gtso mo ma gcig re ma ti'i/ / bsnyen pa'i nyams len snying po nyung gsal 'di/ / bsdebs pas bdag sogs gdon bgegs bdud sde las/ / rgyal zhing blo bzang rgyal bstan rgyas gyur cig / ces dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub la 'jug pa'i man ngag khrag 'thung dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhar sngon chos skyabs ti yan chi'i sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / or du su hang gin pe li'i shog gi dad brtson lhag bsam dad ldan pa dge slong dkon mchog dpal bzang bcas kyis bskul pa'i ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes 'phral du spyor ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags ram ba dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /478

sa / / tor ba sdug༄7/ / rnam sras gtor 'bul bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /na mo gu ru rgya 'dir rgyal chen rnam thos sras la mchod gtor 'bul bar 'dod pas mchod pa gtsang ma dkar gsum gyi gtor ma khang brtsegs ma'am blum po rgyan ldan/ ḍā dril sogs 'du bya/ skyabs sems sngon du btang / rang nyid skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje'am rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma'ang stong pa'i ngang las sbyo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du khaṃ 'od du zhu ba las lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ 〉 rtu/ lan gsum gyes byin gyis brlabs/ bai ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs lcang lo can/ /rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gzhal yas nas/ / re 'dod kun skong rgyal chen yum sras blon/ /rang rigs 'khor tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /lus can phongs pa sel ba'i thugs skyed bzhin/ /gus ldan bdag sogs kun gyi mgon mdzad phyir/ /'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin rgyal chen ngal gsos po/ /'khor bcas dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ / ri rab gling dang gling phran rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rtags rdzas nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga/ /phyi nang gsang rten ma tshang med pa yis/ /nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon kun bkang ste 'bul/ /khyad par dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba yi/ /479

༄/ /yo ca b.lo ཿ sa'i khrung 'a4/mchod gtor ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar bskyil/ / zag med bdud rtsi'i ngo bor byin brlabs nas/ / gus pas 'bul lo dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol/ / nyin byed gzi 'bar gser gyi ri bo yis/ / 'dod dgu'i char chen phyogs su 'bebs pa bzhin/ / brjid cing lhun chags skye dgu'i re skong ba/ / rgyal chen yid bzhin nor bu khyod la 'dud/ / khyod zhabs gus pas bsten cing mchod byed na/ / dbul phongs phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun bsal te/ / chos srid dpal 'byor legs tshogs ma lus pa/ / dbyar gyi chu gter ji bzhin rgyas par mdzod/ / gnas skabs chos mthun 'byor pa 'phel ba dang / / mthar thug nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin mthus/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dbul ba kun bsal nas/ / phun tshogs don gnyis dpal la sbyor gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dad ldan dge slong dkon mchog tshul khrims kyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/ /480

da / / /spyi pa'ab:rerware phro/༄7/ / rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po dregs pa lcam sring bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa las bzhi'i 'phrin las sngun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//༄/ / 'jam dpal rgyal kun thugs kyi rang bzhin dngos/ /gshin rje'i gshed po'i gsung gi sgyu 'phrul gar/ / srog bdag dmar po'i sku yi rnam rol la/ / 'dud do 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ /gzi ldan dbang phyug bka' nyan dmar nag ces/ / mthu stobs grags stan dbyar rngas phyogs khyab pa/ / de yi bsnyen sgrub ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ / dam pa'i gsung bzhin mdo tsam spel bar bya/ de'ang las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pas blang dor tshul bzhin du sgrub cing / dad pa dang snying rjes rgyud brlan pa/ chos skyong chen po 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba man ngag dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i gang zag gis gang du sgrub pa'i gnas ni/dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen gyi rgyud las/ ri gsum 'dus dang chu gsum 'dus/ / dur khrod dbus su bdag nyid sgrub/ / ces gsungs la/ so sor byas na yab kyi sgrub gnas brag dmar po gshin rje khros pa'am/ seng ge gnam du 'phyo ba 'dra ba'i 'gram dang chu brag 'thab pa 'ug pa dang srin byas skad bsgrag cing btsan yod nges pa'i gnas su sgrub/ yum gyi gnas ri gsum 'dus pa'i 'gram ma mo gnas pa'i dur khrod du sgrub/ de dag ni gshin tu sgrub pa myur pa'i gnas yin la/ de dag ye ma grub na dur khrod 48/

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/dam brag phug dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rang gi sgrub khang la khyi dmar gyi khrag gis bsgos pa'i chus chag chag gdab/ sa dmar gyis byugs la srog bdag dmar po'i bse mkhar du mos pa bya/ dus ni tshes nyer dgu la sogs pa gza' phur bu'am mig dmar dang 'phrod pa'i tshe sgrub khang du yi dam dang gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi bris 'bur gyi sku sogs rten legs par dgram/ phyi rten du rta dmar po/ g.yag kham pa/ ra skyes dmar po/khyi dmar po/ lug nag po lcags kha rnams kyi phrum phrum dang / sog 'bum la lcam dral gyi srog snying rgya shog la gser ram gri khrag gis bris pa'i mthar/rten 'di la bzhugs nas sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor gnas dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ 'khyer pa po la cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs la myur du khug cig ces pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa dar dmar po'i skud pas dkris/ 'bru sna sman sna/ rin chen dar zab dang bcas pa'i thum bu dar dmar pos dril ba mi mngon par btags te chog bzhin du btsugs pa dang / nang gi rten du smyug rgod tshigs gsum pa'i spubs sman dang rin po ches bka' ba dur bya'am 'ug pa'i sgos brgyan/ gri lcags kyi mde'u gri rgyus kyis bsdams par gri khrag gis ltong la yi ge pra bris/ skyed pa la dzamade'u la rbad bris pa'i mgul du dar zab dmar po kha longs la yab kyi srog snying gser gyis bris pa dang / dar nag la yum gyi srog snying gser gyis bris pa btags/ yum gyi rten du seng ldeng gi phur bu sor brgyad pa dar nag gis spras pa/ las mkhan gyi rten zangs dmar gyi phur bu sor brgyad pa gri rgyus mgul du btags pa'ang bsham/ gsang ba'i rten du smyug rgod tshigs dgu pa'i mgo mjug tu seng ldeng gi rdo rje rtse lnga ba phyed pas bkag pa'i nang yi dam gyisrog sngags kyi mjug tu gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi srog sngags 'bru bzlog ste 482

ra / / phra masakwa bapa'itsasgo pa/gser gyis bris pa'i shog dril gyis bkang ba dang / ra skyes dmar po'i rlid pu'i nang du gri khrag dang rgya snag gis lcam dral gyi srog snying spel tshig dang bcas pa tshar mang po bris pa gzug / sku'i rten du dur khrod kyi ras la gri khrag gis bris pa'i sku tsa ka li dang / gsung gi rten du 'di'i rgyud dang sgrub thabasakyi po ti/ thugs kyi rten du gsang ba'i bla rdo/ shan pa'i lag nas byung ba'i ra dmar po'i tsitta dang / lug nag po'i tsitta'i nang du yab dang yum gyi snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa gser ram gri khrag gis bris pa'i shog dril dang dril dang sman dang dri dang rin po che dang dar zab kyis bkang ba rnams bshams pa'i mdun du stegs kyi khar zangs gzhong sogs rin po che'i snod bzang po'i nang du khrag chang gis sprus pa'i zan la yab kyi gtor ma zur gsum khru gang las mi che zhing mtho gang las mi chung ba dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du de las cung zad chung ba'i lha mo dang las mkhan gyi gtor ma zur gsum re re/ de gsum gyi mthar de las chung ba'i gri thogs brgyad dang rol bshan nyer gcig gi gtor ma bshos bu gru gsum rtse zur shin tu rno ba brgyad dang / de'i phyi rol tu de 'dra nyer gcig gis bskor ba'i mthar bcad kha phyir bstan pa'i mtheb kyus bskor/ bsdu na/ dbus kyi de gsum gyi mthar mtheb kyu chung ba nyer gcig gis bskor la/ de'i steng gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du mtheb kyu che ba re re bzhag pas kyang rung ngo / de thams cad kyang shayig dang snying sna tshogs/ khyad par ra skyes kyi sha khrag gis brgyan pa la/la phug sgog btsong / 'bras chan/ khur ba sogs bza' bca' sna tshogs pas mtha' bskor/ rten gyi mda' yod na tsa ka li dang bcas pa dbus kyi gtor ma la btsugs/ de dag gi mdun du khrag chang gi gser skyems/ dbang bo'i me tog sha chen dang ra tshil gu gul sogs kyi bdug 483

༄/ /yo ca b.lo lo yo khrung ཿma/spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen gyi dri chab/ btsan bshos dkar dmar/ thod rnga rkang gling sogs rol mo'i bye brag du ma/ gzhan yang bskang rdzas sogs dngos sam bag zan sogs las byas pa'am/ ri mor bris pa rnams kyang legs par bsham/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du nang mchod rdor dril ḍā ma ru/ g.yab dar sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya/ bde ba'i stan pa 'khod de skyabs sems sngon du btang / rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs yi dam gyi bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms/ mchod pa dkyus ltar byen gyis brlabs la chos skyong 'khor bcas skyed pa ni/ sgrub gzhi bris 'bur gyi sku sogs byed na de nyid la dmigs shing / rten gtor byed tshe de la dmigs nas hrī khyi la sogs pa'i sngags kyis bsangs oṃ su bhā wa shurha sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrug pa'i dbus su zangs kyi ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du padma nyi ma rta ro mi ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la pra dang zangs gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing / g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs kyi glo snying thugs gar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na bse'i ru mtshon dmar po bsnams pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs nas ljags rnam par bskyod pa/spyan gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'bar zhing dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings pa mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la zangs kyi beg tse dang dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan 484

༄ / /ba gsapa lcamasang sgrubapa'ichenas/ cing / zhabs la sag lham dmar po gsol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du mi las rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma sku mdog sngo nag gdong ba bse/ so dung / smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral ba la mchong dang mu men gyes brgyan cing / gser gye rna rgyan 'phyang ba/ gcer mo spyan dang zhal bgrad cing / g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la 'phyar zhing g.yon lcags kyi phur bu bgegs la 'debs pa/dred mo mi zan la zhon pa/ gtso bo'i g.yas su pra las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mdung dar 'phyar thing g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon cing lce spyangaspyon pa la zhon pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgeg la 'o dod 'bod pa/gtso 'khor gsum gye shar du mi dmar khra ma/ lhor ri tsi mi dmar/ nub tu kro dhi mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag ko shing / shar lhor rma kri mi dmar/lho nub tu ro kri mi dmar/ nub byang du gi shang mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste/ gri thogs brgyad dang bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing /g.yon la la rgyu ma'i lag rdog byed pa/ la la glo snying mchin pa 'drad pa/ la la snying khrag klad pa 'dag pa/ la la sha khrag sbar gyis 'debs pa/ la la rus pa rkang mar 'cha' ba/ la la pags pa dmar bshus byed pa/ la la sha gdan dmar po 'dings pa/ thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog len pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang ba glang gi ko ba rlon pa gyon pa/ gzhan yang btsan dmar stong / bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong / ma mo 'bum sde/the'u rang stong la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dpag tu med pas 485

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i me'i khrung ཿma/bskor ba'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyis spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par bee thugs gar hūṃ/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar ma ru tse'i durakhrod brag dmar po mchong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs/ kyai yul gcig mya ngam 'das pa bdun gyi pha rol na/ / mda' na khrag mtsho phu na zangs brag brtsegs/ /mi ro rta ro mang po gcal du bkram/ / mi khrag rta khrag du ma mtsho ru 'khyil/ / khor yug zangs ri'i phreng bas kun nas bskor/ / bse mkhar smug po mchong gi ba gam can/ / thod pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas/ / chos skyong dregs pa lcam sring gshegs su gsol/ / 'khor tshogs bshan pa'i tshogs kyang gshegs su gsol/ / zhing bcu'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dul ba dang / / rnal 'byor bdag gis las bcol sgrub pa'i phyir/ / da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ / da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / / rings pa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /nag po'i phyogs dang gang la dmigs pa yi/ / gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog / ces gnyan los mdzad pa'i spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad dang / rgyas par byed na a mo ghas mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad/ kye phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na/ / nyi ma byang shar mtshams shed nas/ / srog bdag dmar po spyan 'dren no/ / sgrol gying chen po spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ / me rlung 'tshub pa'i pho brang dbus/ / rakta khrag gi rgya mtsho nas/ /srid pa'i bu mo spyan 'dren no/ / gar gyi dbang phyug gshegs su gsol/ /srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas/ / drag po sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ / las mkhan dmar po spyan 'dren no/ / rgyug byed pho nya gshegs su gsol/ / rab gtum rngam pa'i pho brang nas/ / khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i khor yug nas/ / gri 486

༄/ /bltabacodregayopalhamasang sgrubapa'ini pa/thogs brgyad po spyan 'dren no/ / bshan pa nyer gcig gshegs su gsol/ / brag dmar mchong lding pho brang nas/ / bdud btsan gnod sbyin srin po dang / / ma mo the'u rang spyan 'dren no/ / dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ / ma thogs myur bar las la byon/ / rings pa'i tshul gyis mchod gtor bzhes/ / bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las rnams/ / ma g.yel myur du grub par mdzod/ / ragro praṇa ādma sa pa ri wā ra a gakhye ya dza ྅ baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ padma ka ma la ya snyi/ zhes spyan drangs la gdan phul/ oṃ rasmo pra ṇa ādma sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya ste/zhes dam tshig bsgrags/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan nas/ / mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i/ / sgrol gyeng bshan pa dmar po la phyag 'tshal/ /bka' yi 'khor gnas ye shes srung ma'i tshogs/ / rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i bde ster gsang ba'i yum/ / las byed bshan pa gtum po sde lnga dang / / ma mo the'u rang tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ / ces phyag bya/ gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor dam tshig gi rdo rje bkod par bsams la/ rasmo pra ṇa ādma sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti pra ma tha/ sa ma ya ra kṣartu/zhes dam la bzhag rakro pra ṇa yādma sa pa ri wā ra a: pra tī tsā ye swāhā/ de bzhin du shasta'i bar sbyar la mchod pa dbul/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni rgyas par spro na/oṃ mchod do sku bzhi'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ lha chen ma hā de ba'i 'al du oṃ 〉 rtu/ a tsarya nyi 'od grags pa'i zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ sras zla ba nag po'i zhal du oṃ bee ḍū/ paṇa chen g.yadha ra'i zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba'i zhal du oṃ ā shā/ gnam kha'u dar ma seng ge'i zhal du oṃ 487

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ཿ khrung 'a4/〉 rtu/ sa chen kun dga' snying po'i zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ shud pu bkra shis 'od zer gyi zhal du oṃ ā rtu/ 'dar 'phyar ru pa rin chen bzang po'i zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ bo dong ba brtson 'grus rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ ā hūṃ/ jo sras bla ma rin chen gyi zhal du oṃ ā rtu/ slob dpon shes rab mtsho'i zhal du oṃ ā ḍū/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ ā :/ lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum gyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge'i zhal du oṃ ā :/ chos rje rin chen bkra shis kyi zhal du oṃ ā :/ stobs lda na yon tan mgon po'i zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ bla ma gzhon nu dpal ba'i 'al du oṃ 〉 rtu/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ chos rje shes rab rin chen gyi zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ ā rtu/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ ā rtu/ tā ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel gye zhal du oṃ ā :/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi zhal du oṃ bee ḍū/ zur chos dbyings rang grol gye zhal du oṃ ā :/ thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ 'khrul zhig mang thos rgya mtsho'i zhal du rma 〉 rtu/rje 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ ā0dzee/ rdo rje 'chang gnub ston bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ zhes dang / ga'an yang / mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ ā ḍū/ gnyan chen dharma skyabs kyi zhal du oṃ ā0ju/ rje chos rgyal dpal bzang po'i zhal du rma ā rtu/ rje dpal ldan seng ge'i zhal du oṃ ā :/ bla ma bsam 'grub bzang po'i zhal du oṃ ā :/ rje rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ ā hūṃ/ rje rnam rgyal bzang po'i zhal oṃ 〉 rtu/ rje don yod rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ rje kun 488
