ra / / ༷drobaka pa /dga' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal oṃ ā ྅/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ ā :/ rje yon tan mchog gi zhal du oṃ ā :/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ ā :/ rgyal ba blo bzang don grub kyi 'al du oṃ ā ྅/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal du oṃ ā ka/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'al du rma ā :/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ mthu stobs dbang phyug stobs ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ ā :/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i 'al du oṃ 〉 rtu/'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ ā ྅/ de ltar brgyud pa gnyi ga'am gang mos sbyar ba'i mthar/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā ḍū/ 'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ ā :/ de ltar brgyud pa gnyi ga'am gang mos sbyar ba'i mthar/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ 〉 rtu/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā (/ oṃ rasmo pra ṇa ādma pa ri wā ra oṃ 〉 rtu/ zhes dbul/ yang brel dus phyi mchod kyi mjug tu ragro pra ṇa la 'bru gsum sbyar nas nang mchod phul kyang rung / de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par bsams la yig brgya nyer gcig sogs bzlas te/ byin rlabs rtsa ba dngos brgyud bla ma dang / /dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ / bar chad kun sel chos 489

༄/ /yo ca bam ༅ ༅ཿ ga 4ma/skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ / brtse ba'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag gsang sngags theg pa'i zem skas las/ / zung 'jug nor bu'i pho brang 'jug pa'i gegs/ / rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag kun/ / bla ma yi dam srung mar mthol lo bshags/ / ma nyams phyi nang gsang rten dam rdzas bcas/ / bsnyen sgrub rgyun gtor dus kyi gtor ma sogs/ /tshul bzhin ma bgyis le lo'i dbang gyur te/ / srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal rnams mthol lo bshags/ / sems nyid rang bzhin mkha' ltar rnam dag kyang / / glo bur nyon mongs sprin gyis g.yogs pa'i mthus/ / nongs par gang gyur bshags dang bshags yul dang / / bshags bya dmigs med ngang du dag gyur cig / ces gdung shugs drag pos bya'o/ / de nas thugs dam bskang ba bskang rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i gnod sbyin lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyes mi khyab pa zhig gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig / ces brjod la/oṃ sarba bid pūr prur sur sur/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rgyas par byed na sngags drug phyag rgya drug ting nge 'dzin drug dang bcas pas kyang byin gyis brlabs/kyai/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog / zag med bde chen skyed pa'i mchod rdzas su/ / dbang po'i gzhu ris ji bzhin ches bkra bas/ /bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig / dgra bgegs snying gi khrag rgyun mtsho ltar 'khyil/ / dbang po'i me tog gnam sa'i khyon kun gang / / mi sa'i dud sprin zhun chen snang gsal 'bar/ / ga bur dris sbags 490

༄ / / tsho bas(1bapa'ishu'i5pa/khrag zhag mkhris pa'i dri/ / sha rus phung por spungs pa'i zhal zas dang / /snyan brjid 'bud dkrol rol mo'i bye brag gis/ / bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ / nyams chag sel zhing dngos grub ma lus stsol/ / rta dmar zhur can dmar ser rnga rngog g.yo/ / rdo rje'i rwa ldan g.yag rgod 'brug ltar ngar/ / rab dkar og zhol 'phyang ba'i bse yi ra/ /mkha' lding bse yi bya khra dur bya dang / / srin bya 'ug pa la sogs 'phur lding rol/ / 'jigs rung shā na stag gzig dom dred sogs/ / khrag gis myos pa'i gcan gzan grangs med pa/ / rnal 'byor 'phrin las thogs med sgrub phyir 'bul/ / bor dmar tshangs can rin chen rgyan lda na dang / / bse khrab dmar po zangs kyi stong 'brel can/ / rab dmar lcog dar 'bar pa'i bse yi rmog / bse lham bdud sde 'joms pa'i zangs gri dang / / dgra bgegs glo snying khrag gi zham chu 'bab/ / bse yi ru mtshon ba dan dmar pos mdzes/ / hong khung ligi rtsangs dmar srad bus bskor/ / bstan dgra 'joms pa'i cha rkyen rnams kyang 'bul/ / rgyu rlon mgo 'phreng dra ba tsitta'i tog / mi ro'i rgyal mtshan g.yang gzhi'i bla bres can/ / mchong dmar kha bad mdzes pa'i bse mkhar dang / / 'khor sa bar dang bcas pa gsang ba'i mdos/ /'dre bya'i sgros brgyan gri lcags mde'u can/ / dar dmar mgul bar 'chang ba'i mda' bo che/ / bris sku gsang rgyud phyag mtshan sa bon bcas/ / gnod sbyin chen po dgyes pa'i rten du 'bul/ / dar nag 'chang ba'i seng gi kyi la ya/ / dri rgyus mgul du bcings pa'i zangs phur 'bar/ /ka ṇi gas bris srog sngags kyis gang ba'i/ / sprug rgod tshigs dgu mtha' gnyis rdo rjes mtshan/ / ra dmar lpags shun rgyal mtshan gsang ba'i snying / /lug nag tsitta srog sngags kyis gtams pa/ / gsang ba'i bla rdo srog 491

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'bum 'khor kha spyor sogs/ / dbang gi rgyal po dgyes pa'i rten du 'bul/ / sgrub pa'i mchod pa ni/ sku bzhi'i sa bon smin byed dbang bzhi'i chus/ / legs gtams rang rgyud dag pa'i rin chen snod/ / dngos grub sbrang rtsi'i ro mngar 'byung ba'i gzhi/ / gces par bsrungs bskyangs dam tshig chu skyes bzhad/ / so sor thar dang rgyal sras rig 'dzin gyi/ / bcas mtshams rnam par dag pa'i dri bsung ldang / / yengs med srog bdag 'khor bcas rtse gcig tu/ / bsgoms pa'i ting 'dzin gsal snang sgro na me sbar/ / de ltar bsnyen sgrub la gzhol brtson pa'i rgyun/ / dal med 'bab pa'i dri chab rba rlabs g.yo/ / bde bas stong ba nges pa'i zag med ro/ / thugs dam bskul ba'i snyan 'gyur nga ro'i sgra/ / de ltar mchod yul mchod rdzas rang nyid sogs/ / btags tsam bden par 'dzin pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /gnas lugs phu thag chod pa'i dpa' bo yis/ / mnyam bzhag g.yul ngor bcom pa'i yang dag snying / / snang stong bstan srung chen por 'bul lags na/ / bdag la mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsol/ yang na bskang bshags bsdus pa/ kye/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can/ / zhes sogs dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa de byas kyang 'thus/ de nas/ kye/ chos sku yangs pa'i pho brang nas/ / dregs pa lcam sring 'khor bcas kyis/ / zhes sogs spyi ltar byed pa'am/ kyai khyed la 'phrin las zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ / rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la bar gcod pa'i/ / lha klu gnod sbyin grul bum la sogs pa/ / gdon chen stong phrag brgyad cu zlog tu gsol/ / rlung mkhris bad gan 'dus pa la sogs pa'i/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog tu gsol/ / 'jigs shing skrag dang dngangs pa la sogs pa'i/ / ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog tu gsol/ /492

ra / / ༄ ༷dribata pa 'itsasde la/chu tshod drug cu rtsa bzhi bar gcod pa'i/ / blo bur drug cu rtsa bzhi bzlog tu gsol/ / sngon las 'phral rkyen gnyis kyi bsdus pa yi/ / rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong bzlog tu gsol/ / rnal 'byor tshe tshad phugs su ma 'khyol bar/ / dus min 'chi ba rnams brgyad bzlog tu gsol/ / rmongs byed rengs byed rmugs byed brgyal la sogs/ / gshis ngan gum pa bco brgyad bzlog tu gsol/ /tshangs dang dbang phyug la sogs phyi rol pa'i/ / srid pa'i khram rnams thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pa'i/ / lha 'dre'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ / ma mo'i khrag zor gshin rje'i 'phrul 'khor sogs/ / bdud kyi khram kha btab pa bsgyur du gsol/ /phur bu'i gdab las gnod sbyin gzer nad dang / / rgyal po'i byo 'bog gtong ba bzlog tu gsol/ / btsan gyi gya gyu mon pa'i gcer rgyug dang / /'bal mo'i drug 'dab sa bsgyur bzlog tu gsol/ / 'byung bo'i thod zor 'ang zhung btsog dmar dang / / byas pa'i mda' zor 'ben pa bzlog tu gsol/ / dngos dang nyams dang rmi lam mtshan ma ngan/ / ro langs 'byung po'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ / lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skeg la sogs/ /skyes pa'i skar ma'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ / phyogs ngan bdud gcod bzhigashed spar phung dang / / mo ltas rtsis zur ngan pa bzlog tu gsol/ /spyang ku ngu zhing wa brgyal srin bya rgod/ / gzhan gyis cho 'phrul gtong ba bzlog tu gsol/ / bzlog bsgyur bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus pa/ / dam can khyed kyis myur du sgrub par mdzod/ / ces lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum gyis mdzad pa'i bzlog pa bya zhing rten 'bul sogs kyang rgyas par byed 'dod na de'i gdung las 'byung ba ltar byas na rung / de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ chos skyong lcam sring gi thugs gar 493

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i 07 khrung 'a4/nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sngags phreng gis bskor ba la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ rang dbang med par bka' nyan cing ci 'dod pa'i las bsgrubs par bsams la/ oṃ pra ṇa ā tma kṣi ru bu ru ṣa lo hi ta sarba shahūṃ mār ya: phaṭa/ces yab kyi sngags dang / oṃ ragro ya ma tsitta dzwa la ram̐ pra te de wī hūṃ/ srog la ya ma dza sarba shazhu mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/ ces yum gyi sngags sprel nas thun bzhir bcad de mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla'o/ / de'ang rgyud las/sum 'bum grangs kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ bla ma dam pa rnams bzhi 'gyur du byas pas 'bum phrag bcu gnyis kyis bsnyen par bzhed cing / 'di la mtshan ma gtso che bas mdun gyi snying la sogs pa'i rten rdzas rnams 'gul zhing 'phar ba dang / tsheg sgra la sogs pa'i sgra 'byin pa dang /me 'bar ba la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang dngos nyams rmi lam la sogs par lcam dral 'khor bcas zhal mthong ba dang / mi dmar bo sha'i ral pa can dang / bud med nag mo khrag gi ral pa can dang / mi chen dang sngags pa chas bzang rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ chu bo chen po rba rlabs 'khrugs pa/lung ba mes khengs pa/ go gyon zhing chas su zhugs pa'i rta ba mang po brgyug pa/ dmag dpung chen po/ bud med gzhon nu mang po dga' zhing rtse ba/khyi dmar po chen po dang / spyang ku dang mi dred la sogs pa/ rta dmar zhur dang g.yag sngon po shin tu che ba srin bya 'ug pa la sogs pa rnams cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa lan gcig tsam ma yin par yang yang 'byung ba ni nye ba'i rtags yin la/ dngos su snying mi dga' ba dang / 'jigs shing ba spu ldang ba dang /nyams dang rmi lam du mdze pho mang po byung ba ni zlog pa'i rtags yin pas yi dam gyi nga rgyal bskyed cing lta ba la blo 'jog bskang bshags la 'bad pa lhur bya/ rang nyid lto cher song zhing sha 'dod pa dang / rmi lam du rang la 494

sa / / bakha' lcamachenaswā bapa'icha'i pa/gzhan gyis ston mo byed pa dang / sha chang 'dren pa dris na gtor ma 'dod pa'i rtags yin pas mchod gtor shin tu gzabs/ de nas gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyes brlabs la/ chos skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can du gyur pas gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/oṃ ragro pra ṇa ādma sa pa ri wā ra sarba bighan sha hūṃ i di ba bee ta kha kha khā nyi khā nyi/ zhes lan bdun gyis dbul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod nas/ kye/rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru tse yi gnas srung / li yul chos kyi srung ma/mahā de wa'i bka' nyan/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can dang / yum srin mo khrag gi ral pa can kyi sras gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg tse can/ sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ 'khor srog gcod bshan pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sha khrag dmar gye gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs stod/ bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen thams cad sol/mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad drag po'i chad pas skad cig nyid la thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod cig/ a mu ka sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod la thal mo lan gsum brdab bo/ / gtor rdzongs 'di tshar chen gyi gsung yin la/ gdon bgegs 'i ba sogs gtso bor byed pa'i tshe/ kye/ ma mo thams cad kyi bka'i dpon po/brag btsan thams cad kyi bka'i dpon po/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi gtso bo/gnod sbyin thams cad kyi yang rtse/ rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar mo/gnod sbyin zangs kyi beeg tse can/ 'khor ma mo dang the'u rang 'bangs su 495

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i me'i gsung 'bum/'khol ba/ srung ma khyed rnams dang po gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' las ma 'da'/ bar du ma hā de wa'i bka' las ma 'da'/ da lta rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bka' nyon la/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di 'bul gyi/ 'dod yon lnga char bzhin du 'bab par gyur cigarnal 'byor pa 'khor bcas la steng lha'i gdon zhi bar gyur cig 'og klu'i gdon zhi bar gyur cig bar btsan gyi gdon zhi bar gyur cig sdang ba'i dgra zhi bar gyur cig gnod pa'i bgegs zhi bar gyur cig oṃ raklo'i sngags bzlas la thal mo brdab/ drag tu bskul ba'i tshe/ kye dmar chen gtor ma ro brgya dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod/ mahwa de wa'i bka' nyan/ rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha/ ma ru tse'i gnas srung / li yul chos kyi srung ma/ 'dod khams ma mo'i mnga' bdag btsan dmar stong gi dmag dpon/ gshin rje rnams kyi gtso bo/ gnod sbyin rnams kyi yang rje/ bdud dang srin po'i kha gnon/ dgra dang bgegs kyi bshan pa/ dam tshig nyams pa'i rjes gcod/ mna' zan yongs kyi dbugs len/ rnal 'byor bdag gi pho nya/ri 'dzin rkun gyi srog shing / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra pa/ legs nyes gnyis kyi stangs 'dzin/ bden rdzun gnyis kyi shan 'byed/ dge sdig gnyis kyi zam kha pa/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kye ral pa can/ yum srin mo khrag gi ral ba can gnyis kyi sras gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg tse can/sring mo srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ las mkhan bshan pa srog bdag dmar po/ sgrol byed kyi gying brgyad/ rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig btsan dmar stong / bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong / ma mo 'bum/the'u rang stong / snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs 'khor dang 496

༄/ /bstanasangadregasapa lcamasang sgrubapa'idzamapa/bcas pa khyed rnams la 'bul ba yin pas/ bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phangs stod/ dge 'dun gye sde skyongs/gtsug lag khang gi srung ma mdzod/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ dus da nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad lus dang sems kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa dang / mi nor zas gsum dbang du bsdu 'ing / thos bsam sgom pa'i 'phrin las thams cad 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du'ang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku la bsdo ba/ dkon mchog gsum la skur ba 'deb pa/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams la sdang tshing sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba phyin ci log byed pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyi pho rgyud rtsad nas phyung / mo rgyud drungs nas phyung / chung rgyud mngal nas skoms/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa'i rten phur thon/ skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ mdza' ba'i bshes dang phye/ mkho ba'i yo byad gtor/ ltag nas bdud chod/ mdun nas mdangs phrogs/khong nas snying phyungs/ rnam shes rten dang phrol/ drag po'i las kyis tshar chod la/ thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i las mdzod cig a mu ka sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces seng ge 'bum gyi gsung las 'byung ba'i dmod bcol 'di nyid bya/ de nas bstod cing 'azin las 'chol ba ni/ kye rgyal kun mkhyen dang brtse ba'i kun gsal nas/ / srog bdag dbang po'i sprin sgra cher rgod cing / / drag po'i 'phrin las rdo rje'i thog mda'i gzis/ / dam nyams brag ri phye mar bsnyil la bstod/ /tsha zer bye ba'i zhun mas nyer byugs 497

༄/ /༅ ca bstan ཿ me'i khrung ཿma/pa'i/ / padma rā ga'i lhun po ldem pa bzhin/ / bdud dgra 'byung bo'i spyi bor khyod sku ni/ ling ling gar gyis rol ba khyod la bstod/ / 'bar ba'i zangs gri mkha' dbyings gdengs pa'i mod/ / padma'i gnyen kyang dregs pa yongs dor te/ / sbrang rtse'i rgyal mtshan grogs bcas khyed nyid kyi/ / zhabs pad bsnyen pa'i brtson pa bsten la bstod/ / dgra dpung brlag pa'i dpa' rtags ru mtshan ni/ / khyab 'jug gnas kyi pha mtha' bsnyegs pa bzhin/ /khrag rgyun chal chil 'bab pa'i glo snying dang / / nyag phran dha nur bcas pa 'dzin la bstod/ / khyod zhal kun khyab yangs pa'i lte ba nas/ / yon por lta ba'i spyan rtsa'i glog phreng 'khyug / drag shul ha har rgod pa'i sgra brgya bas/ / dgra bgegs glo snyeng skog mar 'byin la bstod/ / dus kyi byin za'i phung po spungs pa'i dbus/ / beeḍūr lhun po 'gying ba'i gar stabs rtser/ /tsha zer dbang po'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa bzhin/ / brjid mdzes nyams kyis rol ba'i sring la bstod/ / bka' sdod srog gi bdag po dus mtha'i nyi/ / mthu stobs 'od gzi'i reg bya tsha ngar gyes/ / nag po'i rtsa lag lhun po rgya mtshor bcas/ / lhag mar byed pa'i las mkhan khyod la bstod/ / khrag rlon dwangs mas byugs pa'i dbyig 'dzin steng / / pad rag sa 'dzin bgrang yas rgyu ba bzhin/ / bdud sde'i srog la rngams shing rab 'phyo ba'i/ / gri thogs bshan pa'i tshogs la bstod par bgyi/ / bstod bskul gzhan byed spro na thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang /yang mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyes mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'di'ang byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che bar grags pas/ hūṃ gnas mchog rgya gar yul gye dam sri mdzod/ / sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ / 'gying ba'i gar dang dpa' ba'i gom stabs can/ / ha shang yul gyi dgra lha mdzad la 498

da / / bgasal zaba'i/sde mi/bstod/ / khyod ni ma ru tse yi gnas srung mdzad/ / zhal gdangs mche gtsigs sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs/ / dbu skra ltag bcings zangs kyi ral ba can/ / li yul chos kyi srung ma mdzad la bstod/ / dpa' bo bod yul ma mo'i dmag dpon po/ / phyag g.yas zangs gris dgra bgegs srog dbugs gcod/ / g.yon pa dgra snying mda' gzhu bse mdung can/ /gshin rje rnams kyi stong dpon khyod la bstod/ / yid 'phrog ma mo rnams kyi dgyes sde bo/ / rngam pa'i nga ros srid gsum dbang sdud cing / / dregs pa'i nga ros ri rab thal bar byed/ / brag btsan rnams kyi kha dpon khyod la bstod/ / rab 'jigs gnod sbyin rnams kyi rje bo ste/ / dad brtson dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub pa po'i/ / grogs mdzad zhing bcu ma lus sha la rol/ /lhasren sde brgyad gtso bo khyod la bstod/ / spyo ma gcig srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar mo/ / sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ / g.yas pa ral gri g.yon pa phur bu thogs/ / padma gar gye dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed kyi bka' nyan ma/ / gdong bse so dung smin g.yu me ral can/ / dbu skra mchong dang mu men rgyan gyis spras/ / e ka dza nī'i gsung sdod ma la bstod/ / nag phyogs lha min rnams kyi g.yul zlog ma/ /'jigs pa'i dred mo mi zan rab zhon nas/ / bstan pa bsrung phyir phyogs rnams kun tu rgyu/ / bse yi skyes bu'i sna 'dren ma la bstod/ / rab 'jigs ma mo 'bum gyi dbang mo che/ / dkar nag dmar ser ljang ba'i tshogs kyi bdag / rin chen thod skam dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ / rgyan chags ma mo mthu mo che la bstod/ / rab 'jigs gsang ba'i ma mo yal kham can/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ / rnam 'phrul mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ / cho 'phrul yongs kyi sna 'dren ma la bstod/ / kye/ las 499

༄/ /gung thang bstan ba'i sgron me'i gsung 'bum/mkhan chen po srog bdag ma rung ba/ / myur mgyogs lce spyang zhon nas phyogs bcur rgyug / zhags pa dmar thogs dgra bgegs 'ching zhing 'dren/ /sgrol byed bshan pa dmar po khyod la bstod/ / 'khor gyi bshan pa srog bdag rngam pa brgyad/ / g.yas pa zangs gris dgra bgegs mgo lus gzhog /g.yon pa spar bas sha khrag za zhing bldag / gying chen dregs pa'i rgyal po khyod la bstod/ / srog gcod bshan pa shi nyu rtsa gcig ni/ / dregs pa'i nga ros stong gsum ma lus 'gengs/ / mgyogs pa'i shugs kyis stong gsum khyab par rgyug / mi bzad dgra bo'i srog gcod khyod la bstod/ / srog bdag bka' nyan las byed bshan pa 'bum/ / gdong dmar bka' nyan las byed ma mo 'bum/ / gzhan yang pho nya bran g.yog sngags par bcas/ / rnal 'byor srung ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / rnal 'byor 'dod don bsam bzhin 'grub pa dang / / sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog / bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du sgrub par mdzod/ / ces pas bstod/ / 'phrin las 'chol ba ni/ hūṃ/ 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed la sogs/ / rim byon rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga ru/ / rdo rje'i g.yar dam zhal gyis 'ches pa bzhin/ / deng 'dir 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ / rnal 'byor snying gi padmo bzhad pa'i dbus/ / bla ma yi dam chos skyong dbyer med du/ / 'bral med bsten te rtse gcig gsol 'debs na/ / yid la re 'bras smin par mi mdzad dam/ /mthu stobs 'od stong ldan khyod gtsug bsten bzhin/ / bar gcod smag rum mthug pos sgrib srid na/ / nag phyogs bdud sde'i mun pa mthar byed pa'i/ / stobs ldan nyin mo'i dbang phyug su la re/ / tha mal mi min cung zad bsten pas kyang / / bar chad mi mthun sel bar nus mthong na/ / ye 500

༄ / / bakha'apa༄ bongasgrubapa'itha'i pa/shes spyan ldan khyod la bsten pa bdag / nag phyogs bdud kyis gtses pa 'thad dam dgongs/ / de phyir mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung bskyed la/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ / chos mthun 'dod don 'grub pa'i mi mthun phyogs/ / thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / bslab gsum rim gnyis tshe bsod dpal 'byor sogs/ / legs tshogs dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa dang / / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kun/ / ma tshang med par dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba spyi yi dgra / rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba sgos kyi dgra / nges ngor gsod dang bsad bya'i spros bral yang / / brtse bas chos kyi dbyings su myur du sgol/ / brtse ba'i ma dang byams pas skyong ba'i dpon/ /ci 'dod sgrub pa'i gnyen dang blo gtad grogs/ / zug rngu skyong pa'i sman sngags ma lus pa/ / khyod nyid kho nar re 'o ma g.yel zhig / phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan phyogs bcur dang / / bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ / dge 'dun sde rnams thugs mthun bshad sgrub 'phel/ /'gro kun bde skyid dpal la rol par mdzod/ / ces dang / drag tu bskul tshe lcam sring gsum/ gri thogs brgyad/ bshan pa nyer gcig dpal mgonabadun cu dang bcas pa so so'i skul gnyan los mdzad pa 'don blang / rgyun par tshig nyung la byin rlabs myur brgyud tshig sor ba'ag gi bskul 'di nyid bya ste/ kye/gnod spyin zangs kyi beg tse can/ / sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig / ma hā de wa'i bka' nyon la/ / gshin rje'i gshed po'i las mdzod cig / gdong dmar mo yi sna drongs la/ / nyams pa'i srog rtsa myur du chod/ / sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig / sbyorig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ / gshin rje'i gshed po'i bka' nyan ma/ /5()1

༄/ /༅ ca b.lo rsāzlanasa'i khrung ཿma/e ka dza ṭi'i gsung sdod ma/ / lha min 'bum gyi g.yul bzlog ma/ / bse yi skyes bu'i sna 'dren ma/ / ma mo 'bum gyi dbang mo che/ / rgyan cha ma mo mthu mo che/ / gsang ba'i ma mo yal kham can/ / cho 'phrul yongs kyi sna 'dren ma/ / sdang ba'i dgra la cho 'phrul thongs/ / nga yi nor gyi rting la rgyug /srog bdag dmar pos rting la rgyug / nga dang 'gras pa'i dgra bo la/ / cho 'phrul sna dgu thongs la shog / sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig / de nas spyi bstab ni/ kye byang shar ma ru tse yi dur khrod nas/ / mchong dmar brag la brten pa'i gnas bcas pa/ / sgol gying chen po srog bdag dmar po dang / / srog bdud chen mo bse yi lan phran can/ / lcam sring khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ / las mkhan srog bdag dmar po 'khor dang bcas/ / sgol byed bshan pa gri thogs brgyad po dang / / rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor dang bcas/ /bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong dang / / btsan dmar stong gi dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ / ma mo 'bum dang ze'u rang stong la sogs/ /ston pa'i bka' nyan bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ / 'dir gshegs rgyan gye gtor ma 'di bzhes shig / dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems 'di bzhes shig / ra dmar khrag chang mchod yon 'di bzhes shig / sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan po gtong / / da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs rten du 'bul/ / rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin gces par skyongs/ / rnal 'byor bdag gi gnas lus longs spyod dang / / 'khor dang yo byad bzhon pa la sogs pa/ / bcol lo bltos so srung ma mthu rtsal can/ / nyin gsum bya ra rgyang nas ma g.yel zhig / mtshan gsum mel tshe drung nas ma g.yel zhig / rtag tu sgrub pa'i 502

༄/ /bstag dregayopalhamasang sapa'irimapa/sdongs grogs ma g.yel zhig / bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig / sdang ba'i dgra la mngon pa'i rtags ston la/ / rnal 'byor bdag gi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ / bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i spyi dgra dang / /rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe/ / ma nyes log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ / dpal mgon khyod kyis sgrol la bstan pa srungs/ /zhes brjod cing mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar dang bcas gtor ma byang shar mtshams su gtor stegs kyi khar gtang ngo / / yang na bstod pa'i mjug tu chos skyong drag tu bskul te/ gtor ma gnam lcags kyi thog me 'bar bar bsam la dgra phyogs su 'phang yang rung ngo / / de'ang bsnyen mtshams byas te thun bzhi sogs su sgrub pa'i skabs gtor ma sogs lhar gsal ba ma bsdus pas/ thun rjes ma'i tshe sa bon las mi skyed par sngar yod gsal 'deb kyi tshul du bya/ bsnyen pa gnad du 'gro ba la gegs se ba bogs 'byin gyi gnad shes dgos shing / de'ang pho g.yel na mos gcun pa dang /mo g.yel na phos gcun par rgyud las gsungs pas/ de'i sngags kyis sna drangs te bzla zhing dmigs pa'ang des bskul bar mos na legs/ yang /oṃ ā0rtu/ oṃ yā to te ka u u u/ oṃ ragro ya ma tsitta dzwa la re pra ti de sde hūṃ/zhes sogs mgo bsgyur ba dang / oṃ ha pra ma ar zhes sogs dkrug pa dang mas bzlog gi bzla tshul dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i sbog chog yod kyang 'tshub che bas/ de las 'jam zhing 'chun che ba'i zab gnad kyi dmigs pa skyong tshul ni/ mdun gyi 'khor rnams ming sring gsum la 'dus/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas spros pas 'od zer dmar po rlung dang bsdongs te song bas lcam sring gsum po 'od kyi sna la drangs/ sna bug g.yon nas 'jug pa'i rlung dang lhan cig zhugs/ rtsa a wa byu tī'i nang brgyud/ lte 'og gi chos 'byung 503

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'itshonamatha gsung ཿma/dmar po gru gsum pa'i nang du khrag gi rgya mtsho'i klong na bzhugs par bsams/gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas gzi byen bskyed cing dbang du bya ba'i dmigs pa skyong tshul gzhan las 'byung bas rgyas bkab kyang mi 'brel ba min yang /'dir be'u bum las 'byung ba bzhin byed na/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su bla ma rta 'grin dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis tsan dan gyi be con dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rta mgo ljang sngon spyi bor thon cing / khro bo'i chas rnams rdzogs pa brkyang bskum du bzhugs par bsam/ de'i thugs gar hūṃ yig dmar po nyi ma la gnas par bsgom/lcam sring gi thugs gar rang rang gi sa bon nyi ma'i steng na yod pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar gye gnas nas las kyi srog bdag ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstem/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu stobs/ dregs byed sde brgyad stobs ldan/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i snod bcud kyi nus mthu thams cad drag po mngon spyod kyi bdag nyid du spyan drangs nas lcam bral gsum la thim pas drag cing rngam pa gtum zhing khros par bsam/ de nas bla ma rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas 'od dmar po 'phros/ lcam dral gsum la phog dmar lam lam bdag la chags pa'i dbang gis ji ltar 'dod pa sgrub cing dbang du 'dus par bsam/ so so'i thugs ga'i sa bon gyi dbyibs nas srog gi snying po byi ru'i mdog lta bu dmar zhing 'tsher ba ba thag lta bu la spubs so yod pa nar gyi byung zhing rta mgrin gye thugs ga'i hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la thim pas srog snying dbang du 'dus pas skad cig kyang 'da' mi nus par bsams nas sngags gnyis drag tu bzlas pa ni mi 'khu zhing las sgrub nye ba'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gdams pa'o/ / skabs 'ga' zhig tu dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i phyir 504

sa / /ba gas pa'ajamatsha sgrubapa'itha'i pa/las la sbyor ba na/ rta mgrin gye thugs ka nas tsan dan gyi dbyug pa dmar nag me 'od 'phro ba gsum spros te srog snying spubs can gsum gyi nang nas mar song / so so'i thugs ga'i sa bon gyi dbus su gnas pa las bzod par dka' ba'i me stag 'phros pas/ lcam sring gi sku'i cha rnams mes gang bas 'dar zhing gdungs la khros shing 'khrugs pas ma bzod de/ de gsum las las kyi bshan pa stong gsum gang ba dpag med spros/ dgra babegs dmigs bya rnams bsad gzir sogs thogs med du byas par bsams nas bsang sngags nyer gcig tsam mam ci rigs bzlas pas rtags 'byung nges/thun mtshams su lcam dral 'od du zhu nas rang rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon la thim/ de'ang snying ga'i rta mgrin gyi thugs ga'i hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la thim pas/rta mgrin hūṃ yig dang bcas pa de bla ma yi dam bstan srung lcam sring 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam zhing lta ba zung 'jug mtha' bral la ci gnas su 'jog cing rlung bum pa can kha sbyor du gzung bar bya ba ni bsnyen pa'i man ngag gi snying po yin no/ / phyi rten zung 'jug na sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi nye sar g.yag lug ra rta khyi bya mi dmar po rnams dbang po tshang zhing mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba la dar dmar nag gi cod paṇa/ rnga ma dmar po dril bu g.yer ba rnams kyis brgyan cing bsang dud byas sgrub pa'i bum chus legs par bkrus/ zung dang bris sku'i bar dar tshon sogs kyis sbrel/ ru mtshon rnams phyar/ gu gul gyi dud pa dngar gsur rgyun mi 'chad par gtong / bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i g.yag dmar zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs pa/ lug dmar ind+radī la'i rwa can/ ma mo nag mo kha skya spyi dkar/ ra skyes dmar po mthing gi rwa can/ rta mchog dmar po rlung ltar 'phyo ba/ khye dmar dung so stag ltar rngam pa/ btsan bya dmar po khyung ltar lding ba/ mi 505

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'a4/dmar stobs chen glog ltar 'khyug pa rnams ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ zab pa dbyengs su ro gcig pa/ byed las gnod sbyin lcam dral mnyes par byed pa/ dus 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du byung bar bsams la sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab/ de nas rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūṃ g.yag dmar zhol chen sprin ltar gtibs pa ni/ / mdzes pa'i sru sdug rwa dang rnga yab can/ / dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / rab brjid mdzes pa'i btsan lug dmar po ni/ / gser mig dung so ind+ranī la'i rwa/ / dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma mo nag mo ni/ / mdzes pa'i spu sdug kha skya spyi dkar la/ / dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / ra skyes dmar po mthing gi ra co can/ / rmig pa lcags la spu rtsar me stag 'phro/ / dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / rta mchog dmar po rlung gi shugs can la/ / mdzes pa'i spu sdug rnga rngog brjid dang ldan/ / dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ /gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / stag ltar rngam pa'i khyi dmar dung so ni/ / brjid ldan dregs pa'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgog /dmar nag dar gye cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / btsan bya dmar po bse khra dung khra sogs/ / mkha' lding 'dab bzang bya yi tshogs rnams la/ / dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / mi dmar stobs chen srin po'i cha lugs can/ / las kun byed pa'i stobs ldan 506

ra / / ba khung (1bapacha riske/dpa' bo ni/ / dmar nag dar gyi cod paṇa mang pos brgyan/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / rang phyogs skyong ba'i go khrab sna tshogs dang / / dgra bo 'joms pa'i stobs ldan mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /bdud las rnam rgyal dar gyi ru mtshon rnams/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus dza gad chang / / dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i snying khrag dron mo dang / / gsur chen dud pa sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra/ / gnod sbyin lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / mthun pa'i dam rdzas tshang ba 'di dag gis/ / mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ / khyad par yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ / tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / / thos bsam sgrub pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/ / snyan grags phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par mdzod/ / de nas me tog 'thor zhing / bkra shis gang zhig sogs kyis shis brjod bya/ /gtang rag gi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ e ma bde stong rang bzhin las/ / dmar chen khrag gi mchod yon 'di/ / lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ / bzhes nas dngos grub mchog stsol cig / rma rasmo praṇa ādma sa pa ri wār a pra tī tstsha hūṃ swā hā/ rkang ba gnyis par/ dmar chen rakta'i zhabs bsil 'di/ / dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog 'di/ / drag po'i rdzas kyi dud sprin 'di/ / zhun chen sgon me 'bar ba 'di/ / zhag dang mkhris pa'i dri chab 'di/ / dgra bgegs sha rus gtor ma 'di/ / snyan cing brjid chags rol mo 'di/ / zhes bsgyur cing 〉hūṃ nas shabha'i bar btags pa dang /spyan lam mdzes pa'i gzugs mchog 'di/ / rna bar snyan pa'i sgra mchog 'di/ / shangs la zhim pa'i dri mchog 'di/ / ljags la mngar ba'i ro mchog 'di/ / sku la 'jam pa'i reg bya 'di/ / zhes pa'i mthar/ rū pa sogs 507

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i khrung 'bum/sbyar/ nang mchod dbul zhing bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis bstod/yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / gang yang bdag blo zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ bsgrub gzhi ras bris yin na/mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams bris sku dang dbyer mi phyed bar gyur bar bsam/ bsgrub gzhi gtor ma yin kyang de'i tsa ka li sogs la bstim na rung la/ yang na rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ de nas bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /de'ang bka' nyan srog bdag dmar po 'di nyid kyi chos skor ā tsarya nyi 'od grags pas rgya gar bam po dmar po bya bar gter nas phyung ste bsgrubs pas dgra la mig gis bltas pa tsam gyis 'chi ba byung / de'i sras zla ba nag po khros pa'i mod la dgra 'chi zhing / de'i sras ga yadha ra'am atsand+ra dmar po sgrub pa zhag gsum gyis dgra 'chi ba byung / de dag nas bla ma gnyan dang mar ba sogs la rim par brgyud de 'ongs pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid sgrub tshul la'ang gnod sbyin rkyang bsgrub tu bsgrub pa/ gdong dmar ma rkyang sgrub tu bsgrub pa/ gtso 'khor gnyis su bsgrub pa/ lcam dral gsum du bsgrub pa/bshan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub pa/ rol bshan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bskor ba/thams cad sbrags te sgrub pa/ de la'ang myur zhing rno ba'i phyir dgra po pho sgrol ba'i ched du pho rgyud gtso bor sgrub pa/ dgra bo mo sgrol pa'i phyir mo rgyud gtso borasgrub pa/ pho sgrub la'ang btsan rgod ltar sgrub pa rta la zhon pa/ srog bdag ltar sgrub pa ra skyes la zhon pa/ bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa rkang thang can la sogs pa mang bar yod cing / de la brten pa'i las sbyor yang / rgyud las/ rlid pu brdab na cho 'phrul yong / / sprug ma brdab na rims nad 508

༄ / /ba ༄ gsapa lcamasang sgrubapa'i rimapa/yong / / spu rnams bsog na ltas ngan yong / / thun la bsngags la zor la 'phang / /yang na rkyang pa yang na sbrags/ / zhes sogs kyi don bzhin drag po btsan gyi rkyal 'bud la sogs pa mang du yong ba rnams 'di'i chos skor gyi be'u bum las shes dgos pas/ 'dir gtso bo bsnyen pa'i rim pa tsam mag bshad pa yin no/ / mthu stobs gnam lcags 'bar pa'i thog mda' yis/ / mi bsrun dgra sde phye mar rlog byed pa/ / dregs pa'i bstan srung bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i tshul/ / cung zad phye ste bkod pa'i dge tshogs mthus/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang / / sri zhu lhur len bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ / phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ / phul byung dge mtshan lhun gyis grub gyur cig / ces rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po dregs pa lcam dral bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa las bzhi'i 'phrin las lhun grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong dam pa or tu su o thog jo nong tā pe li bsod nams rab rgyas dge 'dun gyi sras che ba kun bzang rab brtan rgya mtshos dbang chas cha tshang /dngul srang lnga'i maṇḍal/ lha rdzas mdzod btags bcas nan gyis bskul ngor 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ /tshogs 'khor bya bar 'dod pas tshogs rdzas gtor ma rnams legs par bshams/ lha'i nga rgyal la gnas te nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ snod rnams snang mdzad sku yi rdo rje'i bdag / ā mchod gtor dpag med gsung gi rdo rje'i bdag / hūṃ rnal 'byor mi bskyod thugs kyi rdo rje'i bdag / e ma ho rdo rje gsum gyi rol par gyur/ / phyogs dus kun khyab mtha' dbus bral ba la/ / 'gro dang 'ong ba'i skyed dbri ma mchis kyang / /kun rdzob mos ngor tshogs kyi mgron du gshegs/ / rang rang dgyes pa'i 5()9

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgronasa'i khrung ཿma/gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ / oṃ tshogs kyi 'khor lo mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ / 〉 zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos bla ma mchod/ / hūṃ lhan skyes bde stong dbyer med ngang du rol/ / ho mchog tu dgyes pas byin rlabs char chen phobs/ / oṃ tshogs kyi 'khor lo mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ / ā zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos yi dam mchod/ / hūṃ lhan skyes bde stong dbyer med ngang du rol/ / ho mchog tu dgyes pas dngos grub char chen phobs/ / oṃ/tshogs kyi 'khor lo mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ / ā zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos lcam sring mchod/ / hūṃ lhan skyes bde stong dbyer med ngang du rol/ /ho mchog tu dgyes pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs/ / oṃ tshogs kyi 'khor lo mkha' ltar rgya che ba/ / 〉 zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos 'khor tshogs mchod/ hūṃ lhan skyes bde stod dbyer med ngang du rol/ / ho mchog tu dgyes pas rang rang las mdzod cig / da nas las kyi rdo rjes/ hūṃ rnam par mi rtog dpa' bo'i tshogs/ / bde chen ngang du rol bar mdzod/ / ces brjod nas tshogs bkram zhing tshul dang mthun par spyad/ tshogs lhag bsdus te slob dpon gyis kha bkrus btab la/ oṃ ā ju gis byin gyis brlabs/gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral bka' 'khor gye/ / phyi bzhin 'brang zhing lhag la rol pa'i tshogs/ / rngam pa'i tshul gyis stob cing phyogs kun nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bya ra mdzod/ / ces brjod cing khang steng ngam phyogs gtsang mar gtor/ tshogs kyi mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsams/ / gser skyems 'bul bar 'dod pas/ hūṃ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / / rgyud sde bzhi yi yi dam lha/ / gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ / bdag gi mgon dang skyabs mdzod cig / gnod sbyin srog bdag dmar po dang / / srid pa'i lha mo las mkhan bcas/ / gser 510

da / / ba bsdusapa 'irware la/skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ / rtag tu srung skyob g.yel med mdzod/ / gri thogs bshan pa'i tshogs rnams dang / / btsan bdud ma mo ze'u rang tshogs/ / gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ / bstan pa'i dgra bo rtsad nas phyungs/ / gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ / khams gsum dbang du 'du ba dang / / tshe dpal 'khor dang longs spyod rnams/ / bsam bzhin rgyas pa'i bkra shis stsol/ / ces bya'o/ /51/
'a ba rje

dkon 4gag daryā 'ji༄ med da4rsārsha/ /bshad spyonapa'i jagaphar 4༄raryā/ /lung rtorkanya 4nga gi meyi/ /skye ste'i morga munasel ba 'di rma4nga /go da4 mang paṇḍisha ོda pa'i ྾ 4da ྾ ban stes te mkha grub yorga kyi ga4 ma rje ༄na dkon mchog ༄na pa'i me'i khrung 'bumajapeskunazud par 4na ma sbyar mag a ri'i zam pa'i thes mkhaparabug chewu/ tha 2 4'i mi 7kyi cho 0

spyi khyab jus 'god pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/ṣṭha zo/ ོ ma shā3zhu chen pa/ dbus skyabs/ṣṭha po ma rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ ting 'dzin bkra shis/maṣṭhaza zo lo ma pomadzes cha jus 'god pa/ garma rdo rje tshe ring /zam mapo zo jopar zhus 'gan 'khur pa/ tshe ring mtsho mo/tshorṣaṣṭhatsho ma4 lo༄7/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/(da)gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes brtsams/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho ping li byang lam ang 14pa/ sbrag ang 10ཿ13kha par ang grangs 5813ཿ76)pe cin kreng ta'o par khang nas par btab/2006lo'i zla 1par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2006lo'i zla 1par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad 8507thaza11687lo 102 dpar shog dpar grangs 0ཿ1—2 000 deb rer sgor 34 00
